abarth.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

abarth.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU Water ingress into the airbag control unit (ECU) could result in illumination of the warning light and in the worst case unintentional deployment of the airbag.
abarth.remedy: Seal the airbag ECU compartment

abarth.defect: STEERING SWIVEL  JOINT MAY FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL The possibility exists that the swivel joint stem of the front suspension vertical links maybe of an incorrect size. This can lead to the generation of noise whilst driving and the possibility of suspension disconnection following a violent impact to the front axle and subsequent loss of vehicle control.
abarth.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the swivel joint stems checked for the presence of play and will be replaced if any is found.

abarth.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE FRONT CROSSMEMBER INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED Vehicles may have been fitted with the front crossmember incorrectly tightened.
abarth.remedy: Check and tighten the bolts on the front crossmember to the prescribed torque. Replacement of the steering rack if necessary.

abarth.defect: FRONT WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE It has been identified that the possibility exists that water may ingress into the front windscreen wiper motor. Should this occur the wipers may become inoperative. In conditions of poor visibility this may result in impaired driver visibility.
abarth.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front windscreen wiper motor fitted with a protective cover.

abarth.defect: EGR PIPE COULD FRACTURE DUE TO A POTENTIAL NON-CONFORMITY The EGR pipe could fracture due to a potential non-conformity the fractured pipe may damage the alternator resulting in a loss of battery voltage and potentially a loss of engine power.
abarth.remedy: The pipe must be checked and if incorrect replaced with a new  part.

abarth.defect: INEFFECTIVE/INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF A LOCK NUT ON THE STEERING GEAR ROD Vehicles may have been produced with ineffective/incorrect tightening of a lock nut on the steering gear rod.
abarth.remedy: Check for the correct tightening of the lock nut and check/adjust wheel alignment if tightening was required.

abarth.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
abarth.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

abarth.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A FAULTY LEFT OR RIGHT SIDE HALF-SHAFT A number of vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty left or right side half-shaft (drive shaft).
abarth.remedy: The half-shaft identified as faulty according to traceability data must be replaced

abarth.defect: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY DISPLAY INCORRECT INFORMATION Due to a nonconformity in the production process the instrument cluster may stick and display incorrect speed information.
abarth.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the instrument cluster.

abarth.defect: WATER INGRESS TO ABS CONTROL UNIT Water may enter the ABS (antilock brake) control unit through a harness connector. This will cause the ABS control unit to malfunction and the fault warning lamp to illuminate.
abarth.remedy: Fit a new ABS wiring harness which has watertight connectors.

abarth.defect: THE BRAKE LINE RETAINING CLIP MAY NOT BE FIXED CORRECTLY TO THE TUCKER ON THE DASHBOARD The brake line (pipe) may not be fixed correctly
abarth.remedy: Check the clip is fixed correctly and replace damaged brake pipes

abarth.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
abarth.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

abarth.defect: DOOR LOCKS MAY MALFUNCTION AND ALLOW DOORS TO OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY On a number of Fiat Fullback vehicles in some weather conditions (high temperatures) the mechanism inside the door lock may not function as intended. This can allow the door(s) to open unintentionally.
abarth.remedy: The door locks must be replaced with compliant components.

abarth.defect: REAR SUSPENSION MAY FAIL During the assembly of the vehicle it is possible the right hand rear suspension coil spring was damaged. Over time any damage could lead to the failure of the coil spring.
abarth.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the coil spring.

abarth.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
abarth.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

abarth.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
abarth.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

abarth.defect: INTERIOR FAN WIRING MAY CHAFE ON DASHBOARD SUPPORT The interior fan wiring may chafe on a dashboard support.  This could result in a short circuit and a fire in the fan unit.
abarth.remedy: Fit additional insulation and protection to the fan electrical  wiring.

abarth.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL COULD FOUL ON THE FLOOR Possibility that the accelerator may foul on the floor mounted pedal stop
abarth.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a modified throttle pedal stop.

abarth.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
abarth.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

abarth.defect: POSSIBIITY OF FIRE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT A fire might occur in the engine compartment as a result of the waste gate excess pressure pipe being incorrectly routed.
abarth.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected to ensure the waste gate pipe is correctly routed and fixed in the appropriate clips.

abarth.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
abarth.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary

adria.remedy: An enhanced retention bracket system will be installed on affected panoramic roof windows. Customers who are unable to immediately present their vehicle for repair will be provided with instructions for an interim precautionary measure.

adria.defect: 165-ISOFIX For certain vehicles the ISOFIX mountings may have inadequate weld seams at the attachment points. In the event of a vehicle crash the forces transmitted through a child seat attached to the ISOFIX anchorages may cause the bracket to fracture resulting in an increased risk of injury to the child.
adria.remedy: Vehicle owners are instructed not to use the ISOFIX attachment points until a technical inspection and if necessary a retrofit or repair has been carried out by an authorised dealer. Vehicles that pass the inspection may continue to be used; vehicles that fail will be retrofitted accordingly.

adria.remedy: Vehicle owners are instructed not to use the ISOFIX attachment points until a technical inspection and if necessary a retrofit or repair has been carried out by an authorised dealer. Vehicles that pass the inspection may continue to be used; vehicles that fail will be retrofitted accordingly.

agco.defect: THE MOUNTING PLATE COUNTERBORES MAY BE DRILLED TOO DEEP THEREFORE REDUCING THE STRENGTH OF THE BRAKING BOOSTER The mounting plate counterbores may be drilled too deep therefore reducing the strength of the braking booster.
agco.remedy: Conduct a check of the brake booster and replace if necessary.

agco.defect: THE MOUNTING PLATE COUNTERBORES MAY BE DRILLED TOO DEEP THEREFORE REDUCING THE STRENGTH OF THE BRAKING BOOSTER The mounting plate counterbores may be drilled too deep therefore reducing the strength of the braking booster.
agco.remedy: Conduct a check of the brake booster and replace if necessary.

agco.defect: A REDUCTION IN BRAKE PERFORMANCE MAY OCCUR WHILST  IN A TOWING OPERATION AND UNDER HIGH LOAD A reduction in brake performance may occur whilst in a towing operation and under high load.
agco.remedy: Conduct a conversion of the disc brakes on the rear drivetrain.

agco.defect: On affected vehicles manufacturing residues may be present in certain batches of the affected steering hydraulic system. On affected vehicles manufacturing residues may be present in certain batches of the affected steering hydraulic system.
agco.remedy: Replace the central control block steering servo and steering cylinder and flush the connecting hydraulic line.

ajs.defect: The rear brake and exhaust bracket may come into contact with the road when the rear brake is applied if the securing bolts are to come loose The rear brake and exhaust bracket may still come into contact with the road when the rear brake is applied if the securing bolts are to come loose.
ajs.remedy: Provide and fit an additional bracket to ensure that the original bracket does not come into contact with the road.

ajs.defect: THE REAR BRAKING SYSTEM HAS A DEFECT WHICH CAN CAUSE A LOSS OF BRAKING WHEN THE REAR BRAKE IS APPLIED The rear braking system has a defect which can cause a loss of braking when the rear brake is applied.
ajs.remedy: Check the rear brake performance. Bleed brakes to release any trapped air in the system or replace the rear brake master cylinder if necessary.

ajs.defect: THE REAR BRAKING SYSTEM HAS A DEFECT WHICH CAN CAUSE A LOSS OF BRAKING WHEN THE REAR BRAKE IS APPLIED The rear braking system has a defect which can cause a loss of braking when the rear brake is applied.
ajs.remedy: Check the rear brake performance. Bleed brakes to release any trapped air in the system or replace the rear brake master cylinder if necessary.

ajs.defect: The rear brake and exhaust bracket may come into contact with the road when the rear brake is applied if the securing bolts are to come loose The rear brake and exhaust bracket may still come into contact with the road when the rear brake is applied if the securing bolts are to come loose.
ajs.remedy: Provide and fit an additional bracket to ensure that the original bracket does not come into contact with the road.

ajs.defect: THE REAR BRAKE AND EXHAUST BRACKET MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE ROAD WHEN THE REAR BRAKE IS APPLIED IF THE SECURING BOLTS ARE TO COME LOOSE The rear brake and exhaust bracket may come into contact with the road when the rear brake is applied if the securing bolts are to come loose.
ajs.remedy: To immediately stop riding and provide and fit a reinforced bracket with an extra securing point. Additionally provide a locking nut on the back of the securing bolt to help prevent the bolt coming loose.

al.defect: BRAKING SYSTEM MAY NOT OPERATE As a result of a small dimensional error the Bowden cable which actuates the braking system could detach. Should this occur the braking system would fail to operate.
al.remedy: The affected caravans are being recalled to have the subject cables replaced with quality assured versions.

al.defect: POSSIBILITY OF BRAKES LOCKING ON On a limited batch of caravan axles there exists a possibility of the expander clutch disengaging from the brake shoes. This is due to the introduction of a modified shoe which offers slightly less engagement with the expander clutch. Should the problem occur it may cause the brakes to bind or lock.
al.remedy: Recall the affected caravans for examination and rework as necessary. Where modified shoes are fitted the existing clutch will be replaced with a modified version. Additionally all boxes of replacement brake shoes will contain a warning that they must be fitted with the latest expander clutch.

al.defect: POSSIBILITY OF WHEEL ATTACHMENT It is possible that the wrong amount of protection lacquer has been applied to the brake drums. This could allow settlement of the road wheel during use. This can cause the loosening of the securing bolts which could result in the detachment of the road wheel.
al.remedy: Recall all affected axles inspect and if require replace the brake drums.

al.defect: CRACKING OF CARAVAN STABILISER It is possible that cracking may occur around the rear fixing holes of the stabiliser housing.
al.remedy: Recall the affected caravans and replace the original stabilisers with quality assured units.

alexander.defect: SERVICE DOORS NOT OPENING WITH EMERGENCY CONTROLS Service doors not opening with emergency controls.
alexander.remedy: Carry out a software update

alexander.defect: SERVICE BRAKE MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE It has been identified that the possibility exists that the footvalve piston may become dislodged. Should this occur the service brakes may become inoperative.
alexander.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the service brake footvalve replaced.

alexander.defect: FAILURE OF EMERGENCY DOOR Rear emergency exit door frame may fracture.
alexander.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcing corner brackets to the top and bottom of the rear end of the door.

alexander.defect: BRAKE FAILURE COULD OCCUR Right hand rear brake actuator may contact axle casing when brake pads wear and calliper/actuator assembly move inboard. Actuator band clamp bolt may fracture resulting in separating of actuator service portion from main actuator body. If the concern occurs the stopping distance for the vehicle will increase.
alexander.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and reposition the clamp band to ensure no risk of a foul condition remains. The clamp bolt will be examined for signs of contact and replaced if witness marks present.

alexander.defect: High voltage emergency shutdown can be overridden by intelligent charging On affected vehicles the high voltage emergency shutdown can be overridden by intelligent charging when low voltage batteries state of charge drops below a specific level.
alexander.remedy: Update drive module software and dashboard display software

alexander.defect: High voltage emergency shutdown can be overridden by intelligent charging On affected vehicles the high voltage emergency shutdown can be overridden by intelligent charging when low voltage batteries state of charge drops below a specific level.
alexander.remedy: Update drive module software and dashboard display software

alexander.defect: Cummins’ ISB4.5 210HP EuroVI Engine Valve Cover Cracking Safety Campaign On vehicles with the affected engine the piston crown may develop a crack creating elevated crankcase pressure leading to a fracture of the valve cover. A fractured valve cover may allow oil to escape and in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
alexander.remedy: Install a crankcase pressure sensor and a pressure relief valve.

alexander.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY RELEASE WITHOUT WARNING It is possible that during the manufacturing test of the Hand Brake Valve that damage occurred to the handle locker.  It is then feasible that the handle locker could come to rest in an unsecured position which could subsequently allow the handle to move to the released/drive position and result in a vehicle roll-away.
alexander.remedy: Recall all effected unit and check for damage. If found to be damaged replace the hand brake valve with a new quality assured item.

alexander.defect: SECURITY OF WATER TANK The appliance mounted water tank may break loose and hit the rear of the crew cab in an accident situation.
alexander.remedy: Recall the affected appliances and reinforce the existing water tank security measures by attaching the tank to the chassis rear crossmember with high tensile duplex nylon ties.

alexander.defect: REAR SPRING BOLT COULD FRACTURE AND MIGRATE The rear suspension spring locating bolt could fail and migrate.
alexander.remedy: Fitment of an anti-migration bracket.

alexander.defect: FRONT SPRING MAY BREAK Front spring may fail allowing excess axle movement.
alexander.remedy: Fitting of an axle catcher bracket and bush to limit movement.

alexander.defect: FRONT SPRING MAY BREAK Front spring may fail allowing excess axle movement.
alexander.remedy: Fitting of an axle catcher bracket and bush to limit movement.

alexander.defect: SEAT BELT MAY DETACH FROM MOUNTING A seat belt reinforcing bracket has been omitted during the retrofitting of kits to passenger seats on certain vehicles. As a consequence the anchorage may not meet the required standards.
alexander.remedy: Fit reinforcing brackets.

alexander.defect: SERVICE DOORS NOT OPENING WITH EMERGENCY CONTROLS Service doors not opening with emergency controls.
alexander.remedy: Carry out a software update

alexander.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY FOUL It has been identified that the steering column universal joint may make rubbing contact with the column's outer casing. It is not thought that this will cause the steering to lock up.
alexander.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a small part of the column retaining lug removed.

alexander.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to overheating of the brake disc failure of the adjacent brake may occur resulting in brake loss.
alexander.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a brake hose re-route kit which positions the hose further from the brake disc thus ensuring that in the event of a brake overheat the hose/s are not affected.

alexander.defect: REAR SPRING BOLT COULD FRACTURE AND MIGRATE The rear suspension spring locating bolt could fail and migrate.
alexander.remedy: Fitment of an anti-migration bracket.

alexander.defect: REAR BRAKE CALIPER MAY CONTACT CHASSIS It has been identified that the possibility exists when the rear brake pads are close to the end of their service life that the brake caliper may contact the chassis frame.
alexander.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear bump stop bracket re-profiled thus providing additional clearance to accommodate maximum caliper travel.

alexander.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFORT On some TRISTOP� actuators the chambers may not have been correctly assembled and the load from power spring and pressure is not fully taken. Under certain circumstances the parking side and the service sides of the actuator could separate and the actuator could lose functionality. Ultimately this could lead to a loss of braking functionality and/or brake failure. Critical applications are vehicles such as city buses or garbage collection vehicles (subject to a high parking brake frequency).
alexander.remedy: Identify and replace affected actuators.

alexander.defect: On affected vehicles there is a potential issue relating to the Hispacold HVAC system which may result in a fire when a vehicle is left unattended. On affected vehicles there is a potential issue relating to the Hispacold HVAC system which may result in a fire when a vehicle is left unattended
alexander.remedy: Service Bulletin Reference 966 Rev 3 must be adhered to.  A permanent solution is being investigated.

alexander.defect: On affected vehicles there is a potential issue relating to the Hispacold HVAC system which may result in a fire when a vehicle is left unattended. On affected vehicles there is a potential issue relating to the Hispacold HVAC system which may result in a fire when a vehicle is left unattended
alexander.remedy: Service Bulletin Reference 966 Rev 3 must be adhered to.  A permanent solution is being investigated.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat 600 Steering gear pinion safety recall On affected vehicles the steering rack fitted may not conform to specification and result in an increased force to rotate the steering wheel.
alfa romeo.remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering rack will be replaced

alfa romeo.defect: Side airbag/head airbag crash sensor not correctly connected Affected vehicles fitted with the side airbag/head airbag may not have the side crash sensor connected correctly which may in a worst-case scenario result in non-deployment of the airbag in a side impact/crash.
alfa romeo.remedy: To check the correct engagement/connection of the side crash sensor.

alfa romeo.defect: Front suspension control arm ball joint Affected vehicles may not have the correct installation and tightening between the suspension control arm and the steering knuckle joint.This may possibly result in the control arm bolt becoming detached from the knuckle seat whilst the vehicle is in motion In the worst case this could lead to loss of vehicle control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check installation of joint and if necessary correctly install joint.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL Oil may leak from the Power Take Off Unit which may cause the unit to seize and possible loss of vehicle control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply sealant to the core plug and to fit a retaining clip.

alfa romeo.defect: SPARE WHEEL MAY DETACH The spare wheel located under the vehicle may become detached from the vehicle.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the spare wheel lifting and securing mechanism.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: UNINTENDED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG The electrical wiring loom may chafe on the steering column and cause the unintentional deployment of the drivers air bag.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check wiring loom for damage and reposition it clear of the steering column.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

alfa romeo.defect: SECURITY OF SEAT BELT A number of the subject vehicles have been fitted with seat belts manufactured by TRW the attachment systems of which may not remain secure in an accident situation.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check the date of production on the seat belt buckles and replace those within the critical batch.

alfa romeo.defect: POTENTIAL FUEL LEAK The fuel delivery pipe from the pump may due to engine movement become strained at its connection to the injector rail.  This could result in a fuel leak.
alfa romeo.remedy: Fit two additional support clips to the fuel delivery pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

alfa romeo.defect: THE RIGHT SIDE OF DRIVE SHAFT MAY FAIL Drive shaft may fail.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the right hand drive shaft

alfa romeo.defect: ENGINE SUSPENSION REACTION BRACKET NOT FITTED ON THE TRANSMISSION SIDE Some vehicles were assembled without the engine suspension reaction bracket fitted on the transmission side. The vehicles must be repaired by fitting the missing components (transmission reaction bracket and washer). The defect can be detected by noise and vibration being emitted from the front area of the vehicle. If ignored a possible consequence is a failed differential box resulting in oil leakage and in some cases the drive shaft could become disengaged and drop below the vehicle whilst in motion.
alfa romeo.remedy: Fit the missing components (transmission reaction bracket and washer).

alfa romeo.defect: THE HANDBRAKE EFFICIENCY COULD BE LOST DUE TO THE PARKING BRAKE CABLE PRODUCTION PROCESS The parking brake efficiency could be lost due to a production problem with the cables.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replacement of the parking brake cables on affected vehicles.

alfa romeo.defect: INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR VEHICLE LIGHTING MAY FAIL It is possible under extreme conditions that the wiring harness under the dashboard could come into contact with the steering column. This over a period of time may result in the chaffing of wires in the harness. If this should occur then it is possible both the exterior and instrument lights could fail.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to provide additional security of the wiring loom.

alfa romeo.defect: POWER STEERING PUMP MAY FAIL The batch number of the power steering pump must be checked and if found to be from a faulty batch replaced. On the faulty batches there is nonconformity of the external supply and in certain circumstances the power steering pump may fail causing the driver to use additional input to steer the vehicle therefore delaying the directional movement of the vehicle.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the production date of the pump and if the power steering pump is from a faulty batch replace the pump.

alfa romeo.defect: ELECTRICAL WIRING MAY OVERHEAT There is a risk that under severe operating conditions the engine radiator fan supply cables could overheat with a possible short circuit and fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and modify the cables.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER MAY MALFUNCTION DURING DEPLOYMENT Due to a non-conformity in the supplier's production process the front seat belt pretensioner could malfunction in the event of a collision.
alfa romeo.remedy: Correct operation will be restored by applying a service kit designed for this purpose. Affected vehicles will be recalled to have this fitted.

alfa romeo.defect: THE DRIVE AXLE MAY TOUCH THE WIRING The drive axle may touch the wiring with consequent damage to the wiring.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the correct layout of the wiring inspect its condition and reposition or replace as necessary

alfa romeo.defect: NON CONFORMING STEERING KNUCKLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED Non-conforming steering knuckles may have been fitted.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the installed steering knuckles and replace if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: FAULT IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE Due to a fault in the airbag control module software the airbag system may fail to be active without this being indicated on the instrument panel.
alfa romeo.remedy: Carry out an update to the airbag control module and instrument panel software.

alfa romeo.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY In the event of a significant frontal collision the driver's airbag may not deploy correectly due to a non-conformity which occurred in the supplier's production process. The airbag when deployed may cause injury to the driver due to contaminated parts within the airbag module.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF ENGINE BAY FIRE It has been identified that on a small number of vehicles the possibility exists there may be a short circuit situation within the engine additional heater system during the warm up period which could lead to a fire within the engine compartment.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the electrical supply to the additional heater modified; in order to avoid the possibility of the short circuit occurring.

alfa romeo.defect: INEFFECTIVE/INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF A LOCK NUT ON THE STEERING GEAR ROD Vehicles may have been produced with ineffective/incorrect tightening of a lock nut on the steering gear rod.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check for the correct tightening of the lock nut and check/adjust wheel alignment if tightening was required.

alfa romeo.defect: FIRST GEAR COULD BE ENGAGED WHILST THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION AND THE SHIFT LEVER IN THE D POSITION First gear could be engaged with the vehicle in motion and the shift lever in the D position.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the transmission control module software

alfa romeo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

alfa romeo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

alfa romeo.defect: VACUUM PUMP DRIVE PIN Brake vacuum pump drive coupling dog may fail as a result of breakage. This could result in a loss of power assistance at the brake pedal.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a quality assured replacement drive pin to the vacuum pump.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE PIPE DAMAGE On certain vehicles it is possible that the power steering high pressure hose may contact the offside front rigid brake pipe. This could result in damage to the brake pipe with a resultant reduction in braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for a check on the positioning of the pipes involved and adjustment of the pipe clearance where necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: SUSPENSION COIL SPRINGS MAY BREAK Under environmental conditions that require the intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits may infiltrate the rubber plate which supports the front suspension springs initiating seats of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
alfa romeo.remedy: To avoid damage to a tyre in the event of spring breakage a plate will be fitted which will contain the spring.

alfa romeo.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK AND RISK OF FIRE Due to the incorrect profiling of a rigid fuel pipe at the quick fit connection with the flexible fuel pipe for the injection manifold. The possibility exists that a fuel leak may develop at the connector and result in a fire in the engine compartment.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a locking insert fitted within the quick fit connector in order to prevent the connector from becoming loose.

alfa romeo.defect: CLUTCH MAY FAIL On a number of RHD ALfa Romeo 147 and GT models there is a possibility that the clip which secures the connecting pin between the clutch cylinder and the clutch pedal may become detached resulting in loss of clutch operation.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a redesigned retaining clip.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The  fuel return pipe on 2.0 16v JTD engine variants may interfere with the engine mounting and/or fuel filter.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check and re-route the pipe and fit a protective sheath.

alfa romeo.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

alfa romeo.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY IN PRODUCTION THE SIDE MARKER LIGHTS ARE NOT FUNCTIONING Due to a nonconformity in production the side marker lights are not functioning.
alfa romeo.remedy: The proxy file of the vehicle must be updated to allow the marker lights to function as intended.

alfa romeo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The fuel return pipe may contact the engine sound insulation cover. This may cause a deterioration of the pipe and if not rectified a leak of fuel.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a holding fastener to the fuel return pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE POINT NOT CONFORMING The rear seat belt anchorage points do not conform to specification which could in the event of a collision result in the insecurity of the seat belt.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and upgrade the seat belt anchorage to the correct specification by the fitment of an additional bracket.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It may be possible for the handbrake cable to foul the rigid brake pipe at the right hand rear suspension arm. In time this could lead to wear of the rigid brake pipe and as a consequence there maybe a loss of brake fluid and longer stopping distances.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the routing of the handbrake cable and fit rubber pads to the rigid brake pipe to prevent fouling.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK FROM THE FUEL PRESSURE AND TEMPERATURE SENSOR Due to a production nonconformity there may be the possibility of a fuel leak from the fuel pressure and temperature sensor.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the front fuel supply pipe and sensor.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE RISK OF FIRE AND LOSS OF POWER ASSISTED STEERING There is a possibility that the high pressure power steering pipe may contact the exhaust downpipe which may result in a risk of fire and loss of power steering assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check pipe for contact with exhaust and fit extra retaining bracket to power assisted steering pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: UNINTENDED  ACTIVATION OF SIDE WINDOW AIRBAGS It is possible for the side window air bags to deploy unintentionally.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the air bag central control unit.

alfa romeo.defect: SOME ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS MAY MALFUNCTION DUE TO WATER INFILTRATION On some Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles due to a potential nonconformity some electric-electronic components may malfunction as a result of water infiltrations and their performance may be compromised. The vehicle may not function as the driver expects it to during use including unintended activation and opening of the rear liftgate door at vehicle speeds up to 3.1 MPH. An unintended activation and opening of the rear liftgate door may result in a loss of unrestrained cargo. Lost cargo may create a road hazard and could cause a following vehicle to crash without prior warning.
alfa romeo.remedy: Sealing and/or application of sealants in specific places will ensure full parts conformity is restored.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: THE HANDBRAKE CABLE CONNECTOR ON THE REAR BRAKE  CALLIPER MAY BREAK The handbrake cable connector on the rear brake calliper may break
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the rear brake calliper conformity and replace if necessary

alfa romeo.defect: NON-CONFORMITY IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE Non-conformity in the airbag control module software
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the airbag control module software

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE There is a possibility of a short circuit in the ABS control unit due to infiltration of chemical solutions.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace ABS module with modified type which is also fitted with plastic cover

alfa romeo.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

alfa romeo.defect: On affected vehicles diesel fuel leaks may possibly occur due to the vehicle being fitted with a fuel return pipe without protective tape.  This could cause a potential deformation of the fuel return pipe and in extreme cases could lead to fuel leaks and the risk of fire in the engine compartment. On affected vehicles diesel fuel leaks may possibly occur due to the vehicle being fitted with a fuel return pipe without protective tape.  This could cause a potential deformation of the fuel return pipe and in extreme cases could lead to fuel leaks and the risk of fire in the engine compartment.
alfa romeo.remedy: The application of protective tape around the fuel return pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL Oil may leak from the Power Take Off Unit which may cause the unit to seize and possible loss of vehicle control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply sealant to the core plug and to fit a retaining clip.

alfa romeo.defect: REPLACE ELECTRICAL POWER STEERING Due to a non-conformity in the production process the electrical power steering (EPS) must be replaced. This will prevent a potential loss of steering assistance. Loss of EPS functionality could increase the risk of a collision occurring.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the Electrical Power Steering unit

alfa romeo.defect: SEAT MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED DURING A COLLISION The seat may not remain in position when subjected to greater than normal driving forces such as those involved in an impact. This may possibly cause injury to the driver/passenger seated in the right hand front seat. The right hand front seat guides may not conform to design specification and installation specifications.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the installation of the original seat guide. If it does not conform replace the seat cushion structure (guide).

alfa romeo.defect: VEHICLE STABILITY MAYBE AFFECTED It has been established that the anti-roll bar may not conform to specification.  This should result in a noise from the suspension but in extreme cases vehicle stability could be compromised.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace anti-roll bar with quality assured one.

alfa romeo.defect: STEERING COULD BECOME INCREASINGLY STIFF. It has been identified that; due to a possible lack of lubricant between the steering rack and pinion the steering may become increasingly stiff to operate. This can eventually lead to damage to the steering rack teeth. As a consequence the steering operation of the vehicle may become increasingly difficult.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering rack inspected for damage. If no damage is evident the rack and pinion will be lubricated. Should any damage be in evidence the steering rack will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: TYRE SIDEWALL MAY CRACK It has been identified that Pirelli tyre type 215/40 ZR18 89W PZERO NERO annotated  MO  and F223 may suffer cracking of the sidewall. This can lead to loss of inflation pressure and under certain conditions can have an adverse effect on the safe handling of the vehicle.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject tyres replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF OFFSIDE FRONT BRAKE PIPE Offside front brake hose may chafe
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and fit new pipe if necessary

alfa romeo.defect: THE INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY DETACH The intercooler sleeve may detach.
alfa romeo.remedy: The retaining metal band must be replaced with a new component

alfa romeo.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED Incorrect profile (flaring) of the end of the steering shaft at the upper steering column universal joint. This may give the possibility of the steering column becoming disconnected from the universal joint with a consequent loss of vehicle steering.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the profile and flaring of the end of the steering shaft at the upper universal joint and where necessary renew the shaft.

alfa romeo.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the tightening torque of the steering shaft upper fixing bolt may not be correct. This may result in the emission of noise and in extreme cases breakage of the shaft which will result in loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolt checked for correct torque which if necessary will be set to the correct specification. If the torque is outside of the rework stipulated range the shaft will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration.
alfa romeo.remedy: The repair is a check of the PBU valve code and replacement of the 48-volt battery if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY IN PRODUCTION THE SWIVEL PLATES ON WHICH THE TWO FRONT SEATS ARE ANCHORED MUST BE REPLACED Due to a nonconformity in production the swivel plates on which the two front seats are anchored must be�replaced.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the swivel plates onto which the front seats are anchored.

alfa romeo.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNITENTIONALLY On vehicles fitted with comfort instrument panel when the passenger's airbag has been deactivated it is possible in some cases that it will reactivate spontaneously.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE MAY BE REDUCED It has been identified that due to the inlet filter for the exhaust gas recirculating valve (EGR) being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This can give rise to the possibility of ice forming within the pipe during periods of low ambient temperature with the possibility of reduced brake servo assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR valve solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If this is not the case new solenoids with separate filters will be fitted.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL TANK MOUNTINGS Fuel tank rear mountings may not inadequately secure the tank with a risk of possible disengagement.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcement plates to rear tank mountings.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: The calibration for urea pump diagnostics in the ECU (Engine Control Unit) is not fulfilling regulation requirement The calibration for urea pump diagnostics in the ECU (Engine Control Unit) is not fulfilling the regulation requirement.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update to the ECU (engine control unit) calibration software.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING There is a possibility that the weld on the steering shaft at the lower universal joint fitting maybe absent.  If there is an absent of the weld at the joint this may lead to a loss of steering.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and inspect steering shaft to ensure weld is present if not renew steering shaft.

alfa romeo.defect: FIRST GEAR COULD BE ENGAGED WHILST THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION AND THE SHIFT LEVER IN THE D POSITION First gear could be engaged with the vehicle in motion and the shift lever in the D position.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the transmission control module software

alfa romeo.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF BRAKE PIPES. Possible chafing of front rigid brake pipes at near side front against the plastic wheel arch liner or against the gearbox mounting. Also at the off side front against the engine timing belt cover.
alfa romeo.remedy: Reposition any chafing brake pipe to comply with the manufacturer's prescribed clearance between adjacent parts. Renew any brake pipe that has been chafed beyond a serviceable condition.

alfa romeo.defect: HEATER/CLIMATE CONTROL WIRING ABRASION MAY RESULT IN  A SHORT CIRCUIT. It has been identified that the possibility exists of interference between the heater/climate control wiring and a dashboard bracket due to a missing retainer clip. In this condition abrasion of the wiring may occur with the attendant risk of an electrical short circuit
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for damage to the subject wiring which if this has occurred will be repaired and repositioned. In all cases a new clip will be fitted.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel delivery pipe adjacent to air filter may chafe. This in time could lead to leakage of fuel in the engine compartment and a consequent risk of fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel delivery pipe and where necessary replace the pipe containment channel.

alfa romeo.defect: INCORRECT SPARE WHEEL Some vehicles with alloy wheels may have been supplied with an unsuitable space saver spare wheel. If fitted this spare wheel could cause interference with braking system components.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace any unsuitable spare wheels with correctly specified versions.

alfa romeo.defect: MANUFACTURERS PLATE INFORMATION INCORRECT The manufacturer's plate information may refer to vehicles with a capacity of 8 hundred weight rather than 7 hundred weight.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the manufacturer's plate with one that is correct to the vehicle.

alfa romeo.defect: U-BOLTS ON REAR AXLE MAY BREAK The U bolts securing the leaf spring to the rear axle may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This may result in the U bolts breaking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the U bolts checked to ensure there is no damage and that they have been tightened to the correct torque.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK There is a possibility that fuel may leak from a faulty recirculation pipe connector.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if required change pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: LOOSENING OF FRONT SUSPENSION Gradual loosening of the front suspension may result in noise and deterioration of the suspension and handling characteristics.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the original equipment front suspension reinforcing plates and fasteners with modified components.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM MOUNTINGS - FAILURE OF WELD There is a possibility that corrosion may be present near the welds for the front suspension arm front mountings on the front cross member.Should this be the case in time this could lead to noise whilst driving and the possibility that the weld could fail. Failure of the weld may lead to loss of vehicle stability.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicle will be checked to ascertain whether corrosion is present near the front suspension mountings. If this is found to be the case the front cross member will be replaced. If corrosion is not present a front cross member strengthening kit will be fitted.

alfa romeo.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNITENTIONALLY On vehicles fitted with comfort instrument panel when the passenger's airbag has been deactivated it is possible in some cases that it will reactivate spontaneously.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK After repeated activation of the fuel heater cover in cold conditions an electric connector  the fuel heater cover  may overheat. This may allow air ingress which could cause difficulty starting the engine or engine stalling. In extreme cases fuel may leak onto the road surface.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the condition of the heated diesel filter cover and  connector. If deteriorated or damaged replace the cover or connector.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

alfa romeo.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE AND/OR CLUTCH SYSTEM COMPONENTS MAY BECOME DAMAGED BY MINERAL OIL The brake/clutch system components may be damaged and system performance may decay as a result of the potential presence of mineral oil in the brake-clutch fluid because the components are not compatible with mineral oil. As a result brake/clutch system performance may deteriorate.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the components in the brake-clutch system.

alfa romeo.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration.
alfa romeo.remedy: The repair is a check of the PBU valve code and replacement of the 48-volt battery if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: THE SEATS MAY NOT LOCK IN THE CORRECT POSITION The seats may not lock in the correct position.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check and replace the seat frame if necessary

alfa romeo.defect: A POSSIBILTY OF THE REAR BRAKE DISCS HAVING MICRO CRACKS There is a possibility of the rear brake discs having micro-cracks.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the rear brake discs.

alfa romeo.defect: POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL The tie rod for toe in adjustment could fail at the threads and cause loss of vehicle control. This is due to a nonconformity in production.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace both rear tie bars.

alfa romeo.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

alfa romeo.defect: CORROSION OF METAL BRAKE PIPES Prolonged exposure to the effects of road salt corrosion may result in perforation of the metal brake pipes and a consequential loss of braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace corroded brake pipes and apply corrosion prevention treatment to all brake pipes.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION CROSS MEMBER MAY FRACTURE It has been identified that the chassis front cross member may have a weld which does not conform to specification. This may lead to a creaking noise being heard under braking and could in time lead to the cross member cracking in the area of it's mounting to the vehicle's body.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front cross member replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.

alfa romeo.defect: The positive lead on the auxiliary battery terminal may not be tightened correctly. The positive lead on the auxiliary battery terminal may not be tightened correctly
alfa romeo.remedy: The integrity of the positive lead terminal must be checked and if it is damaged it must be replaced. If it is not damaged the correct torque must be applied to the nut to ensure correct tightening.

alfa romeo.defect: A HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS CONNECTOR MIGHT NOT BE TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION A High Voltage Harness connector might not be to the correct specification
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the connector and if required replace the harness.

alfa romeo.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: THE REAR RIGHT BRAKE CALLIPER COULD DISPLAY MICRO CRACKS The rear right brake calliper could display micro-cracks
alfa romeo.remedy: The production date must be checked and if necessary the brake calliper must be replaced

alfa romeo.defect: TRANSMISSION MOUNT MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a nonconformity in the transmission casing mount material there is a possibility that the casting may fail.  This may affect the control of the vehicle.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the mounting with new quality assured item.

alfa romeo.defect: Some vehicles may have been fitted with a braking system module that contains an electronic glitch/bug. Brake lights may remain illuminated when cruise control engaged.�
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the software of the body computer module.�

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR Fuel leakages may occur and fumes may form inside the passenger compartment
alfa romeo.remedy: Fit a new plug and seal to the fuel fitter assembly

alfa romeo.defect: SEAT BELT PRE TENSIONERS MAY FAIL TO ACTIVATE On some Punto vehicles it has been found that the seat belt pre-tensioners may fail to activate although normal activation of the seat belt is assured.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to shorten the safety tabs in the inertia reel.

alfa romeo.defect: RISK OF REAR BRAKE LOCK UP It has been identified that on subject vehicles the rear brake back plate retaining bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification. Should the bolts work loose this can result in noise illumination of the ABS warning light and in extreme cases wheel lock.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked and tightened to the correct specification.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK Possible short circuit and fire risk in engine coolant booster heater wiring circuit during engine warm up period.
alfa romeo.remedy: Modify the electrical wiring fit a re-rated protective fuse and install modified mounting bushes.

alfa romeo.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL In some circumstances the headlights can switch off without warning which will increase the risk of an accident.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the Body Computer with new improved software.

alfa romeo.defect: REAR CROSS MEMBER WELDING  MAY CRACK It has been identified that the possibility exists that a non conforming weld may be present on the vehicle's rear cross member with the fixing bracket for the wheel axle hub. This non conformity in time; could cause the weld to break and crack the rear cross member which could have an adverse effect on the vehicle's stability.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject cross member identification numbers and weld markings checked; to ascertain whether they conform. Should this not be the case the cross member will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: INCORRECTLY POSITIONED FUEL PIPE Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
alfa romeo.remedy: : Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE There is a possibility that the fuel hose from the diesel filter to the high pressure pump may chafe on the fuel filter housing. In time this could result in a fuel leak and the possibility of an engine compartment fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the routing of the hose checked at which time if the hose is not damaged a new bracket will be fitted to prevent chafing. If the hose is damaged it will be replaced in addition a new bracket will be fitted.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

alfa romeo.defect: UNINTENDED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG Possible water ingress into the electronic control unit (ECU) could result in unintentional deployment of the drivers air bag and passengers air bag where fitted.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for water ingress into the ECU and replace if necessary. Fit water protection to the ECU in all cases.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAYBE AFFECTED Vehicles fitted with rear brake drums may suffer contamination of the brake lining.   This is due to the entry of water and detritus into the drum through the back plate.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a gasket to the back plate where the handbrake cable enters the brake drum through the back plate.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY FRACTURE There is a possibility that the brake pedal is of incorrect specification and could eventually fracture.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace brake pedal with quality assured type.

alfa romeo.defect: The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect (4835 kg instead of 4955 kg). The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect.
alfa romeo.remedy: The CoC and registration documents must be replaced to reflect the correct data.

alfa romeo.defect: SOUND DEADENING GUARD MAY BECOME DETACHED It is possible for the fastenings of the sound deadening guard to become loose. Consequently the guard could become detached whilst the vehicle is in motion.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace all the fastenings with new captive fasteners and bolts.

alfa romeo.defect: Certain kinds of vehicle acceleration could cause the speed limiter to turn off. Certain kinds of vehicle acceleration could cause the speed limiter to turn off.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the software of engine control module.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL VAPOUR RE- CIRCULATION PIPE MAY BECOME DAMAGED The fuel vapour re-circulation pipe could foul against the air-conditioning compressor pulley resulting in possible damage to the pipe and the risk of fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and reposition re-circulation pipe away from compressor pulley.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER COULD MALFUNCTION DURING DEPLOYMENT Due to a potential non-conformity in the supplier's production process the front seat belt pretensioner could malfunction and the front seat belt pretensioner may not function as intended in the event of a deployment. The locking mechanism operates independently from the pretensioner therefore locking mechanism functionality is still guaranteed.
alfa romeo.remedy: Fit new seat belt assembly to either the driver or passenger front seat or both. The seat belt assembly to be replaced will be determined on the vehicle VIN/ chassis number which will be checked against a list to ensure the correct operation carried out.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Scudo Rear suspension springs Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

alfa romeo.defect: Engine Control Module calibration Low In-Use Performance-Ratio On affected vehicles there is a requirement to update the Engine Control Module (ECM) calibration due to a production non-conformity and not fulfilling emission regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the ECM software calibration

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Scudo. Multifunction screen fixings. On affected vehicles the radio display screen may be incorrectly secured.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the fixing of the screen and add any missing fixings.

alfa romeo.defect: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended. On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

alfa romeo.defect: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended. On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Ducato 2024. Proxy update. Vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements Affected vehicles may have the urea system management menu missing from the instrument panel. This may result in warning messages not being displayed on the instrument panel cluster depending on the urea level. In this condition the vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check and if necessary install modified software.

alfa romeo.defect: Ground connections On affected vehicles there could be a loss of certain ground connections for some electrical harnesses which may result in the loss of several vehicle functions.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat 500 BEV Panda and Tipo. Instrument panel cluster software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case. If the customer seeks to reactivate the AEB after previously deactivating it during the same driving cycle (key on/off) it will remain deactivated however the icon on the cluster to alert about deactivation remains off. This does not meet regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update front camera software.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Professional Ducato. Instrument panel cluster software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case. If the customer seeks to reactivate the AEB after previously deactivating it during the same driving cycle (key on/off) it will remain deactivated however the icon on the cluster to alert about deactivation remains off. This does not meet regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update front camera software.

alfa romeo.defect: SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) Diagnosis issues Affected vehicles may have been equipped with Engine Control Unit (ECU) software not fulfilling regulation requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update to the ECU software.

alfa romeo.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
alfa romeo.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: TYRE VALVE MAY BREAK  CAUSING RAPID DEFLATION (STEEL WHEELS) It has been identified that due to manufacture from an incorrect material the tyre inflation valve may break. Should this occur rapid deflation of the tyre and possible vehicle instability would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the tyre inflation valve replaced on all steel wheels including the spare.

alfa romeo.defect: REAR AXLE MAY MOVE It is possible the rear axle leaf spring retaining bolts were not tightened to the correct specification during production.  This could allow movement between the axle and leaf spring. In extreme circumstances this could cause the vehicle to lose control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the U bolts with new items and tighten them to the correct specification.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LEAKAGE FROM FUEL TANK DUE TO CORROSION Possibility of fuel leakage from the fuel tank due to corrosion
alfa romeo.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled during which time the fuel tank will be inspected for corrosion. Should corrosion be found the fuel tank will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.

alfa romeo.defect: THE DRIVE SHAFT MAY FAIL DUE TO A NON-CONFORMITY IN THE MATERIAL The drive shaft joints may fail
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the drive shaft or shafts as required

alfa romeo.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: UNDESIRED ACCELERATION OF THE VEHICLE MAY OCCUR  WHILST ACTIVE CRUISE CONTROL IS OPERATIONAL Undesired acceleration of the vehicle may occur whilst active cruise control is operational.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the software in the brake system module.

alfa romeo.defect: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM OF THE STEERING COLUMN The steering column height adjustment mechanism could accidentally release.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the steering column mechanism.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL The tyres fitted to affected vehicles are incompatible with the weight capacity of the vehicle. This may cause a tyre failure due to incorrect loading of the vehicle.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace existing tyres with those of a load index compatible with the vehicle's weight capacity.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK LEADING IN EXTREME CASES TO FIRE The fuel pump protection bracket is not to conformity and in the event of an accident the fuel feed pipe could be damaged leading to an increased risk of fuel leakage and possible fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel pump feed protection bracket and reposition the fuel feed pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: DROPSIDE PANEL MAY DETACH It has been identified that the possibility exists that breakage of the dropside hinge fastening plate may occur on vehicles fitted with a factory installed dropside body. This can result in the detachment of the dropside panel.
alfa romeo.remedy: Subject vehicles will be recalled at which time the hinge fastening plates will be changed.

alfa romeo.defect: POTENTIAL RISK OF ACCESS STEP DETACHING FROM VEHICLE BODY Potential risk of access step detachment from the vehicle body.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replacement of the access step fasteners.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY WILL BE REDUCED A reflective heat shield may be incorrectly fitted or missing. This could lead to the servo pipe being damaged and the loss of brake servo assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to ensure correct fitment of the reflective sheath.

alfa romeo.defect: UNSCHEDULED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG It is possible that a heavy impact on the underside of the vehicle could cause unscheduled activation of the airbag.
alfa romeo.remedy: On affected vehicles the air bag control unit will be replaced with a modified component.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY REDUCE The Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC) system does not operate properly when the space saver spare wheel is fitted. This could lead to the VDC warning lamp operating and may lead to reduced braking efficiency if the brakes are vigorously applied.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new VDC electronic control unit that has upgraded software installed.

alfa romeo.defect: Incorrect information displayed on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
alfa romeo.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

alfa romeo.defect: SECURITY OF SEAT BELT A number of the subject vehicles have been fitted with seat belts manufactured by TRW the attachment systems of which may not remain secure in an accident situation.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check the date of production on the seat belt buckles and replace those within the critical batch.

alfa romeo.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the possibility exists that a disconnection of the handbrake cable may occur which can result in the handbrake becoming inefficient.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fitment of the handbrake cable to the actuating lever checked. If found to be incorrect the situation  will be rectified. If the handbrake cable is found to be damaged it will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

alfa romeo.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY The brake vacuum pump may not function correctly.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the brake vacuum pump of affected vehicles

alfa romeo.defect: THE SEATS MAY NOT LOCK IN THE CORRECT POSITION The seats may not lock in the correct position.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check and replace the seat frame if necessary

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE Due to the inlet filter for the EGR valve being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This could result in the possibility of ice forming in the brake servo vacuum pipe in conditions of low ambient temperature. As a consequence this may lead to reduced servo assistance to the braking system.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If theses are not evident new solenoids with separate air filters will be fitted.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK A fuel leak may result due to cracking of the recirculation pipe flange on the fuel tank when the tank is filled to the maximum.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel tank inspected for cracks and replaced if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: CHAFING OF POWER STEERING PIPE On some cars a hose longer than specified could have been erroneously fitted with consequent possible interference with the engine. Such interference could in the long run cause the perforation of the hose oil leakage and a potential risk of fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and a check on the length of the hose. In cases where the hose is found to be too long it will be shortened to the right length or if damaged will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: REAR BRAKE HOSE MAY CHAFE SUSPENSION When fully loaded the rear brake hoses may contact the anti roll-bar upper attachments and a plastic shield. This could damage the hoses and cause fluid loss with a consequent reduction in braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for rerouting of the rear brake hoses. Any hose found to be damaged will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY NEED INCREASED FORCE DURING APPLICATION There is a possibility that the valve in the Brake Booster Vacuum Pump may not be compliant. This can result in loss of vacuum assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace pump.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT IN ENGINE COOLING FAN CONTROL UNIT A short circuit may occur in the engine cooling fan control unit with a resultant risk of overheating.
alfa romeo.remedy: Fit a new cooling fan control unit.

alfa romeo.defect: The vehicle may not comply with ECE Regulation 16 Amendment 07 where all seats must be equipped with a safety belt reminder function with visual and audible indication of seat belt status. The vehicle may not comply with ECE Regulation 16 Amendment 07 where all seats must be equipped with a safety belt reminder function with visual and audible indication of seat belt status.
alfa romeo.remedy: Conduct a software update to ensure the seat belt indication is available for all occupied seats.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE On batteries fitted with non-watertight caps rainwater from the windscreen may run into the battery and result in a leakage of battery contents. This leakage may damage the adjacent fabric reinforced rubber brake servo pipe and reduce or cancel the servo assistance available when braking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have a cover fitted to the battery and checking of the brake servo pipe for damage.

alfa romeo.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
alfa romeo.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
alfa romeo.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: Integrated Dual Charging Module (IDCM) may not be connected correctly Affected vehicles may have a non-conforming tightening torque applied to the 12V battery recharge cable the two ground cables and the two HV (high voltage) connectors. This could potentially lead to a fire in a worst-case scenario.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check for the presence and that the correct torque has been applied to the 12V battery recharge cable the two ground cables and the two high voltage connectors (nut).

alfa romeo.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
alfa romeo.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.
