alfa romeo.defect: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
alfa romeo.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

alfa romeo.defect: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
alfa romeo.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

alfa romeo.defect: VIN label and CoC addendum Affected vehicles may have a tyre load index on the vehicle that is lower than the declared rear axle capacity.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replacement of the manufacturer's label fitted to the vehicle and supply the customer with an addendum to the COC (Certificate of Conformity).

alfa romeo.defect: Roof anti-pinch system Certain vehicles may have been equipped with an open roof anti-pinch system which does not operate according to specification.
alfa romeo.remedy: If required the two motors will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: Roof anti-pinch system Certain vehicles may have been equipped with an open roof anti-pinch system which does not operate according to specification.
alfa romeo.remedy: If required the two motors will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat 600 MHEV and BEV. Front camera Affected vehicles are fitted with a front camera with an incorrect hardware ID which causes an error code within the car system. Once an error code is set and recorded the camera is always in fault mode whenever it is switched on. This will result in the ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance System) remaining inactive. This inactive status is a nonconformity with regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the front camera.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat 600 fuel pipe On affected vehicles there is a risk of a fuel leak at the high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections which in a worst-case could result in a vehicle fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check and tighten high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections.

alfa romeo.defect: Alfa Romeo Junior fuel pipe On affected vehicles there is a risk of a fuel leak at the high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections which in a worst-case could result in a vehicle fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check and tighten high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections.

alfa romeo.defect: Alfa Romeo Tonale. Infotainment screen. DCSD software update Vehicle reliability and your safety are a major concern for Alfa  Romeo. On some Alfa Romeo Tonale vehicles the infotainment  display may not activate at key-on remaining completely black. This situation is a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: The free of charge repair is the Alfa Romeo retailer who will update the  vehicle software. Alfa Romeo ref: F50P.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Professional Doblo tyre label On affected vehicles the tyre pressure label may show incorrect or missing information which does not meet regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the tyre pressure label.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Scudo seat fixing On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
alfa romeo.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Ducato may have been fitted with the incorrect radio Affected vehicles may have been fitted with the incorrect radio. The radio fitted does not have rear view camera functionality and therefore may not comply with regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the radio.

alfa romeo.defect: 2024 Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV Advanced Driver Assistance  Systems Radio software On affected vehicles equipped with an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality the AEB/LKA (Active Emergency Brake/Lane Keep Assist) can be deactivated simultaneously. The vehicle does not therefore meet regulatory requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: Install updated software over the air (OTA).

alfa romeo.defect: Alfa Romeo Giulia and Stelvio. Lane Keep Assist acoustic signal Vehicle reliability and your safety are a major concern for Alfa Romeo. On a  number of Alfa Romeo Giulia and Stelvio vehicles there is a requirement to  update the software of the Instrument Panel Cluster. This is required to  ensure that the acoustic emergency signal sounds after the Lane Keep Assist  system is deactivated and ensure it complies with the regulatory  requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: The free of charge repair is the Alfa Romeo retailer will update  the vehicle software. Alfa Romeo ref: F538.

alfa romeo.defect: Alfa Romeo Giulia and Stelvio. Lane Keep Assist acoustic signal Vehicle reliability and your safety are a major concern for Alfa Romeo. On a  number of Alfa Romeo Giulia and Stelvio vehicles there is a requirement to  update the software of the Instrument Panel Cluster. This is required to  ensure that the acoustic emergency signal sounds after the Lane Keep Assist  system is deactivated and ensure it complies with the regulatory  requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: The free of charge repair is the Alfa Romeo retailer will update  the vehicle software. Alfa Romeo ref: F538.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV. Brake pedal On a number of Fiat 600 vehicles due to a production  nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake  pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a  rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal  disengagement In the event of brake pedal failure the  Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can  be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled  stop. Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency  Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent  collision.
alfa romeo.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Fiat dealer  checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct  assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance  with Fiat reference F53D.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat 500 BEV High Voltage battery negative pole connection On affected vehicles the fastening nut may be missing from the negative terminal of the high-voltage battery pack which could result in a loss of torque failure to start the vehicle and in extreme cases it could present a possible fire hazard.
alfa romeo.remedy: The affected vehicles will have the high-voltage battery replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

alfa romeo.defect: Alfa Romeo Junior BEV and MHEV. Brake pedal On a number of Alfa Romeo Junior vehicles due to a production nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal disengagement In the event of brake pedal failure the Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled stop. Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent collision.
alfa romeo.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Alfa Romeo dealer checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance with Alfa Romeo reference F53E .

alfa romeo.defect: Alfa Romeo Junior BEV and MHEV. Brake pedal On a number of Alfa Romeo Junior vehicles due to a production nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal disengagement In the event of brake pedal failure the Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled stop. Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent collision.
alfa romeo.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Alfa Romeo dealer checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance with Alfa Romeo reference F53E .

alfa romeo.defect: Alternator Protection On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity there may be contact or a reduced clearance between the fuel Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. Under wet conditions there is a possibility that this insufficient clearance may lead to water infiltration creating an electrical arc which could trigger a thermal event such as overheating. In the worst-case scenario this could result in a risk of fire in the engine compartment.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. In addition check the distance between the fuel Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. If the distance is less than 10 mm re-position the pipe or replace the pipe if damaged.

alfa romeo.defect: Alfa Romeo Giulia cable (wiring harness) branch On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity the wiring harness leading to the headlamp ECU could become damaged by tyre interference with the wheel arch liner which could result in error messages being displayed and a loss of headlamp low beam functionality.
alfa romeo.remedy: Inspect wiring harness and wheel arch liner for damage and repair or replace as necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

alfa romeo.defect: Fiat Professional 2025/2026 Ducato (290/295). Fuel pipe leak Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The threaded portion of the brake linkage rod in the brake control system may not be to conformity. This could result in a reduction of braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check rod and replace if found not to meet conformity.

alfa romeo.defect: POWER ASSISTED STEERING CONCERN Possible failure of low pressure power steering pipe connection with leakage of fluid and loss of power assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles replace all high and low pressure oil supply and return pipes. Replace oil cooler and refill system with upgraded specification PAS oil.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY REDUCE The Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC) system does not operate properly when the space saver spare wheel is fitted. This could lead to the VDC warning lamp operating and may lead to reduced braking efficiency if the brakes are vigorously applied.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new VDC electronic control unit that has upgraded software installed.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE FLUIDS AND EXTENDED PEDAL TRAVEL The brake hoses may chafe on the wheel aches and in extreme cases cause a brake fluid  leak. The driver will be informed of the defect by the illumination of a warning lamp on the dashboard. If ignored then this will result in longer than expected stopping distances.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and visually inspect the front brake hoses reinforcement and protection. The brake hoses if worn will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that the front suspension arm ball joint retaining nuts may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This may result in a metallic noise a vibration through the steering wheel and ultimately a loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the ball joint nuts checked for tightness to the correct torque and replaced if the former is not the case.

alfa romeo.defect: THE BALLAST SUPPORT BRACKET WELDED TO THE REAR FLOOR COUD BREAK The ballast support bracket welded to the rear floor could break
alfa romeo.remedy: Add two new fixings for each ballast support

alfa romeo.defect: A POSSIBILTY OF THE REAR BRAKE DISCS HAVING MICRO CRACKS There is a possibility of the rear brake discs having micro-cracks.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the rear brake discs.

alfa romeo.defect: REAR WHEELS MAY LOCK UP The gearbox assembly may fail due to an internal breakage inside the gearbox. This may cause the rear wheels to lock up.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace gearbox

alfa romeo.defect: ELECTRIC SLIDING REAR DOOR Electric Sliding door may open inadvertently.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and upgrade door control system ECU.

alfa romeo.defect: THE THIRD (HIGH LEVEL) BRAKE LIGHT MAY NOT FUNCTION The third (high level) brake light may not function.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the software to activate the third brake light function.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK FROM THE FUEL PRESSURE AND TEMPERATURE SENSOR Due to a production nonconformity there may be the possibility of a fuel leak from the fuel pressure and temperature sensor.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the front fuel supply pipe and sensor.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE PIPE MAY CHAFE ON CABLE BRACKET The metal brake pipe between the master cylinder and the ABS unit may chafe on a cable bracket.  A seriously damaged brake pipe will reduce the braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check brake pipe condition and clearances.  Renew any damaged pipes.

alfa romeo.defect: IF REAR SEAT BELTS ARE NOT FASTENED AND PRETENSIONERS ARE DEPLOYED THE LATCH COULD BE RELEASED In case of an accident if the rear seat belts are not fastened i.e. if the rear seat is not occupied by a passenger or is occupied by a child restraint system coupled only to the Isofix anchors and the pretensioners are deployed the rear seat latch could be released. The contents of the rear luggage area if unsecured could enter the cabin area
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the latch bezels with bezels the shape of which prevents the seat belts from interfering with the latch and releasing the seat in the event of a pretensioner deployment.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE The transmission could unexpectedly switch to the N position due to a nonconformity in the transmission wiring assembly process.
alfa romeo.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram the transmission control module. Where necessary replace the transmission wiring

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER STEERING The power assisted steering low pressure pipe may chafe on a hose clip.  This could result in the loss of the hydraulic fluid and power assistance of the steering.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the steering low pressure hydraulic pipe for damage and reposition the hose clip where necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the tightening torque of the steering shaft upper fixing bolt may not be correct. This may result in the emission of noise and in extreme cases breakage of the shaft which will result in loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolt checked for correct torque which if necessary will be set to the correct specification. If the torque is outside of the rework stipulated range the shaft will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTENT AIRBAG ACTIVATION The air conditioning condenser drainpipe may in some instances become blocked with the possibility that the condensate may leak into the passenger compartment and the air bag central control unit. This contamination may cause the air bag warning light to illuminate and in some cases; cause inadvertent activation of the air bag.
alfa romeo.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the condensate drainpipe will be refitted; and re-profiled to remove any restriction.

alfa romeo.defect: DOOR PANEL MAY CAUSE INJURY In the event of a side impact on a small number of vehicles fitted with the Sabelt seat option the door side panels may break in an unsuitable way and possibly cause injury to the occupants.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the door panels.

alfa romeo.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING The steering column to steering wheel shaft may not have been assembled correctly. If not corrected noise and play will become apparent and if these warnings are not acted on eventually steering control could be lost.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary refit the steering column correctly to the steering wheel shaft.

alfa romeo.defect: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY BECOME DETACHED The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the current sleeve and respective metal bands with modified parts.

alfa romeo.defect: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY DETACH FROM THE THROTTLE BODY The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body.  The engine management warning light will illuminate and a loss of power may occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the current retainer with a new version to ensure the sleeve connection between intercooler sleeve and throttle body.

alfa romeo.defect: REDUCED BRAKE PERFORMANCE It has been identified that the rear brake shoe lining material may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. This could result in a reduction in brake performance from the rear brakes.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the conformity of the brake linings and if found to be incorrect replace with new brake shoes which meet the correct conformity.

alfa romeo.defect: INCORRECT TORQUE OF WHEEL BOLTS The road wheel fixing bolts may not have been correctly torqued and could loosen over a period of use.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the wheel fixing bolts for correct torque and tighten or renew as appropriate.

alfa romeo.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL The headlights may fail because of a Body Control Computer software problem.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

alfa romeo.defect: BODY SECURING BRACKETS MAY FAIL The lower fastening brackets which secure the body to the chassis are not manufactured to specification. As a result the brackets may fail and render the body not fully secure.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the body securing brackets with ones manufactured to specification.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

alfa romeo.defect: DUE TO INCORRECT TYPE APPROVAL DATA PROCESSING THE MANUFACTURER'S PLATE (VIN PLATE) AND REGISTRATION DOCUMENT MUST BE REPLACED Due to incorrect type-approval data processing the manufacturer's plate (VIN plate) and registration document must be replaced.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the VIN plate and update the registration document as required.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE There is a possibility that the fuel hose from the diesel filter to the high pressure pump may chafe on the fuel filter housing. In time this could result in a fuel leak and the possibility of an engine compartment fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the routing of the hose checked at which time if the hose is not damaged a new bracket will be fitted to prevent chafing. If the hose is damaged it will be replaced in addition a new bracket will be fitted.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

alfa romeo.defect: STEERING WHEEL AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY It has been identified that due to the non-conforming layout of the airbag wiring and missing cut-proof protection the airbag wiring may interfere with the steering wheel wiring terminal. This can cause the abrasion of the wiring itself. This abrasion may cause a short-circuit and consequent inadvertent deployment of the steering wheel airbag.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the airbag wiring and apply cut proof padded tape.

alfa romeo.defect: CAMSHAFT MAY FAIL Due to an error in the production process the engine camshaft may break.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the camshaft.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE VACUUM ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE In some cases due to the non-compliance of the engine ECU software the engine failure warning lamp may illuminate. As a consequence the vacuum assistance available to the braking system may be reduced.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-programme the engine ECU with updated software.

alfa romeo.defect: THE SPORT MODE SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS The �Sport� mode system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

alfa romeo.defect: INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR VEHICLE LIGHTING MAY FAIL It is possible under extreme conditions that the wiring harness under the dashboard could come into contact with the steering column. This over a period of time may result in the chaffing of wires in the harness. If this should occur then it is possible both the exterior and instrument lights could fail.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to provide additional security of the wiring loom.

alfa romeo.defect: CLUTCH MAY FAIL On a number of RHD ALfa Romeo 147 and GT models there is a possibility that the clip which secures the connecting pin between the clutch cylinder and the clutch pedal may become detached resulting in loss of clutch operation.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a redesigned retaining clip.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: Affected vehicles equipped with the option BRM (carbon ceramic matrix brakes) may face a braking management issue due to unexpected control unit signals. This may potentially lead to a carbon ceramic disc rupture with a resultant risk of loss or degradation of braking performance. Affected vehicles equipped with the option BRM (carbon ceramic matrix brakes) may face a braking management issue due to unexpected control unit signals. This may potentially lead to a carbon ceramic disc rupture with a resultant risk of loss or degradation of braking performance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Reprogramme the BSM (Braking System Module) with updated Software.

alfa romeo.defect: INCORRECT SPARE WHEEL Some vehicles with alloy wheels may have been supplied with an unsuitable space saver spare wheel. If fitted this spare wheel could cause interference with braking system components.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace any unsuitable spare wheels with correctly specified versions.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF LOWER ENGINE STABILISER ROD The lower engine stabiliser rod may crack or break. This could result in detachment of the off side drive shaft on full lock.
alfa romeo.remedy: Inspect the stabiliser rod welding and fit a new rod where found necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling. On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling.
alfa romeo.remedy: The repair is an upload of modified ECU software.

alfa romeo.defect: FRACTURE OF FRONT COIL SPRINGS The anti noise plastic shields fitted to the bottom of the front suspension coil springs may permit the accumulation of a high level of humidity under certain environmental conditions. When combined with the presence of salt and small stones etc. this condition may cause breakage of the spring(s) and subsequent tearing of the tyre as a result of the fractured coils contacting the tyre wall.
alfa romeo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a modified ventilated spring sheath and inspection of the front coil springs.

alfa romeo.defect: On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling. On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling.
alfa romeo.remedy: The repair is an upload of modified ECU software.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On certain vehicles the front brake discs may not be the required thickness for the vehicle definition. This concern may result in reduced braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the front brake discs.

alfa romeo.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: UNDESIRED ACCELERATION OF THE VEHICLE MAY OCCUR  WHILST ACTIVE CRUISE CONTROL IS OPERATIONAL Undesired acceleration of the vehicle may occur whilst active cruise control is operational.
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the software in the brake system module.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE PIPE CONNECTOR MAY CRACK AND LEAK On some right hand drive 156 vehicles the brake master cylinder supply pipe connectors could develop cracks and leak hydraulic fluid with a possible reduction in braking efficiency of one of the two circuits.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall potentially affected vehicles and replace suspect connectors and two rubber flexible pipes on the brake master cylinder with new upgraded ones.

alfa romeo.defect: SUPPLEMENTARY HEATER WIRING MAY BECOME DAMAGED AND CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT On some Fiat 500L vehicles a layout non-conformity could cause abrasion of the supplementary heater (PTC) wiring. This could result in possible electric short-circuiting with the possibility of a loss of some vehicle safety. In the worst case it could cause a vehicle fire..
alfa romeo.remedy: Apply a cut-proof sheath on the supplementary heater wiring to protect it from abrasions.

alfa romeo.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration.
alfa romeo.remedy: The repair is a check of the PBU valve code and replacement of the 48-volt battery if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT WIPER MAY FAIL An internal fault with the wiper motor could cause it to stop working. In some rare cases the windscreen wipers may stop working while in operation.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the manufacturing date of the wiper motor and add a supplementary earth wiring harness if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: THE AUTOMATIC HEADLIGHT POSITION SENSORS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CALIBRATED The automatic headlight position sensors may not have been calibrated and therefore the function does not comply with the requirements of ECE R48
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalibration of the automatic headlight position sensors and alignment of the headlights.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

alfa romeo.defect: The vehicle may not comply with ECE Regulation 16 Amendment 07 where all seats must be equipped with a safety belt reminder function with visual and audible indication of seat belt status. The vehicle may not comply with ECE Regulation 16 Amendment 07 where all seats must be equipped with a safety belt reminder function with visual and audible indication of seat belt status.
alfa romeo.remedy: Conduct a software update to ensure the seat belt indication is available for all occupied seats.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF FRONT SPRING A specific batch of vehicles have been equipped with front suspension coil springs which may suffer from localised corrosion. This can cause breakage of the springs with an adverse effect on vehicle control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original coil springs with quality assured examples.

alfa romeo.defect: ROUTING OF BRAKE VACUUM PIPE MAY BE INCORRECT In some cases due to the non compliant routing of the brake servo vacuum supply pipe damage to the pipe may occur with the possibility that braking assistance might be reduced.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject pipe checked and re-routed. Should any damage be found the pipe will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

alfa romeo.defect: UNSCHEDULED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG It is possible that a heavy impact on the underside of the vehicle could cause unscheduled activation of the airbag.
alfa romeo.remedy: On affected vehicles the air bag control unit will be replaced with a modified component.

alfa romeo.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY OF THE FUEL RETURN PIPE DIESEL FUEL LEAKS MAY OCCUR Due to a nonconformity of the fuel return pipe diesel fuel leaks may occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the conformity of the fuel return pipe and if necessary replace.

alfa romeo.defect: INCORRECTLY POSITIONED FUEL PIPE Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

alfa romeo.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES On ABS equipped Punto vehicles contact may take place between the brake compensator springs and the rear (metal) brake pipes. This could damage the pipes causing loss of brake fluid and reducing the efficiency of the service brake.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY It has been identified that the hand brake lever may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. It could result in the vehicle rolling away.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the hand brake assembly with a new quality controlled assembly

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
alfa romeo.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: ANTI-ROLL BAR BUSH WEAR It has been identified that the front anti-roll bar bushes may wear after a period of time. Should this occur noise will be generated by contact between the anti-roll bar and the metal sleeve of the bush.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front anti-roll bar replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: Affected vehicles equipped with the option BRM (carbon ceramic matrix brakes) may face a braking management issue due to unexpected control unit signals. This may potentially lead to a carbon ceramic disc rupture with a resultant risk of loss or degradation of braking performance. Affected vehicles equipped with the option BRM (carbon ceramic matrix brakes) may face a braking management issue due to unexpected control unit signals. This may potentially lead to a carbon ceramic disc rupture with a resultant risk of loss or degradation of braking performance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Reprogramme the BSM (Braking System Module) with updated Software.

alfa romeo.defect: INCORRECT LOAD CAPACITY LISTED FOR INTERIOR HOOKS It has been identified that the maximum load capacity for the load restraint hooks in the load compartment of the vehicle has been incorrectly written in the Owner Handbook.  The correct load capacity is 500 daN and not the 625 daN as written. If the correct load capacity of 500 daN is not adhered to then the load hooks may not retain the load due to overloading. This could result in an unsecured load with the potential for loss of control of the vehicle.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to attach a load capacity label within the load compartment and install an additional amended page to the Owner Handbook.

alfa romeo.defect: MORE FUEL THAN ACTUALLY PRESENT IN THE TANK COULD BE DISPLAYED ON THE INSTRUMENT PANEL . More fuel than actually present in the tank could be displayed on the instrument panel
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the software of the control module which governs fuel level management

alfa romeo.defect: On the affected vehicle the tightening torque applied to the steering rack during production may be insufficient. On the affected vehicle the tightening torque applied to the steering rack during production may be insufficient.
alfa romeo.remedy: The repair is replacement of the left steering pinion tie rod retainer nut and apply the correct torque.

alfa romeo.defect: SEAT MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED DURING A COLLISION The seat may not remain in position when subjected to greater than normal driving forces such as those involved in an impact. This may possibly cause injury to the driver/passenger seated in the right hand front seat. The right hand front seat guides may not conform to design specification and installation specifications.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the installation of the original seat guide. If it does not conform replace the seat cushion structure (guide).

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK Interference could occur between the gearbox wiring harness and the cover for the brake pedal cross shaft located in the front foot well. In time this could damage the harness and cause a short circuit with a consequent risk of fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and protect the wiring harness by fitting a length of protective strip to the lower edge of the cross shaft cover.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

alfa romeo.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

alfa romeo.defect: THE START & STOP SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS The Start & Stop system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
alfa romeo.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

alfa romeo.defect: POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING MAY BE LOST The wiring for the power steering electric pump may interfere with the edge of the left front wheel arch. This may cause damage to the wiring and a loss of power steering assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected so the wiring can be placed in a protective pipe. The wiring and pipe will then be secured in the correct position.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF REAR WHEEL BEARINGS On a specific batch of rear wheel bearings the outer bearing race may break up during certain operating conditions leading to failure of the bearing and hub detachment.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection and replacement of the affected bearings.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE INTERFERENCE BETWEEN FUEL SUPPLY AND RETURN LINES Possible interference between the fuel supply and return lines.
alfa romeo.remedy: Reposition the pipes to avoid interference.

alfa romeo.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR FROM THE FUEL TANK Due to a non-conformity in production fuel leakage may occur from the fuel tank
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the fuel tank

alfa romeo.defect: POTENTIAL FIRE The fuel return pipe connector at the injectors may overtime wear and leak. The leaking fuel is a fire risk and also could be hazardous to other road users.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel return pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: SECURITY OF SEAT BELT A number of the subject vehicles have been fitted with seat belts manufactured by TRW the attachment systems of which may not remain secure in an accident situation.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check the date of production on the seat belt buckles and replace those within the critical batch.

alfa romeo.defect: REAR BRAKE HOSE MAY CHAFE SUSPENSION When fully loaded the rear brake hoses may contact the anti roll-bar upper attachments and a plastic shield. This could damage the hoses and cause fluid loss with a consequent reduction in braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for rerouting of the rear brake hoses. Any hose found to be damaged will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL Oil may leak from the Power Take Off Unit which may cause the unit to seize and possible loss of vehicle control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply sealant to the core plug and to fit a retaining clip.

alfa romeo.defect: POTENTIAL MOVEMENT OF THE BATTERY Potential movement of the battery and consequent breakage of the battery wires.
alfa romeo.remedy: A battery spacer must be fitted

alfa romeo.defect: HANDBRAKE CONCERN The handbrake cable may have been incorrectly fitted and could become disconnected from the rear brake mechanism.  This would result in the handbrake becoming ineffective.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check that the handbrake cable is correctly connected to the rear brake mechanism and fit a new cable where it is not.

alfa romeo.defect: ACCELERATOR MAY STICK It has been identified that the possibility exists that the accelerator pedal's rotation pin may not have been inserted correctly. In this condition the accelerator pedal might stick.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the accelerator pedal checked for the presence of the pin. Should the pin be found to be missing the accelerator pedal will be changed.

alfa romeo.defect: ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY BE DEACTIVATED In some circumstances the driver and passenger may experience consequent switching off of the instrument panel light and possible deactivation of other electronic systems such as the ABS and airbags. The concern is caused by loose connections at the ignition switch contact holder block.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition switch contact holder block.

alfa romeo.defect: REDUCTION OF BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY OCCUR Brake pedal could be stiff to depress requiring more input from the driver to stop as a result of insufficient brake assistance caused by low vacuum at low engine speed while at high altitude immediately after starting.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an electric vacuum pump to supplement the engine vacuum system.

alfa romeo.defect: MORE FUEL THAN ACTUALLY PRESENT IN THE TANK COULD BE DISPLAYED ON THE INSTRUMENT PANEL . More fuel than actually present in the tank could be displayed on the instrument panel
alfa romeo.remedy: Update the software of the control module which governs fuel level management

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE After extended high speed running brake servo assistance may be lost due to petrol contamination of the servo diaphragm.
alfa romeo.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the servo brake vacuum pipe and checking of the brake servo efficiency.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK A fuel leak may result due to cracking of the recirculation pipe flange on the fuel tank when the tank is filled to the maximum.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel tank inspected for cracks and replaced if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: SUSPENSION COIL SPRING MAY BREAK Under environmental conditions that require intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits accumulate inside the noise-insulating protective sheath located on the front suspension springs creating areas of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front coil springs with those of a new type.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE RISK OF FIRE AND LOSS OF POWER ASSISTED STEERING There is a possibility that the high pressure power steering pipe may contact the exhaust downpipe which may result in a risk of fire and loss of power steering assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check pipe for contact with exhaust and fit extra retaining bracket to power assisted steering pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL CONCERN The accelerator pedal may foul on its travel limiting stop and prevent the engine from decellerating when the pedal is released.
alfa romeo.remedy: Fit a modified pedal travel limiting stop.

alfa romeo.defect: REDUCTION OF BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY OCCUR Brake pedal could be stiff to depress requiring more input from the driver to stop as a result of insufficient brake assistance caused by low vacuum at low engine speed while at high altitude immediately after starting.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an electric vacuum pump to supplement the engine vacuum system.

alfa romeo.defect: ROOF BARS MAY FAIL It has been identified that certain after market roof cross rails (not supplied by Alfa Romeo) could set up resonance frequencies within the rail that could in time lead to breakage of the longitudinal roof rails.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a new set of longitudinal roof rails.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES On ABS equipped Punto vehicles contact may take place between the brake compensator springs and the rear (metal) brake pipes. This could damage the pipes causing loss of brake fluid and reducing the efficiency of the service brake.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

alfa romeo.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU Water ingress into the airbag control unit (ECU) could result in illumination of the warning light and in the worst case unintentional deployment of the airbag.
alfa romeo.remedy: Seal the airbag ECU compartment

alfa romeo.defect: STEERING SWIVEL  JOINT MAY FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL The possibility exists that the swivel joint stem of the front suspension vertical links maybe of an incorrect size. This can lead to the generation of noise whilst driving and the possibility of suspension disconnection following a violent impact to the front axle and subsequent loss of vehicle control.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the swivel joint stems checked for the presence of play and will be replaced if any is found.

alfa romeo.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE FRONT CROSSMEMBER INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED Vehicles may have been fitted with the front crossmember incorrectly tightened.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check and tighten the bolts on the front crossmember to the prescribed torque. Replacement of the steering rack if necessary.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE It has been identified that the possibility exists that water may ingress into the front windscreen wiper motor. Should this occur the wipers may become inoperative. In conditions of poor visibility this may result in impaired driver visibility.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front windscreen wiper motor fitted with a protective cover.

alfa romeo.defect: EGR PIPE COULD FRACTURE DUE TO A POTENTIAL NON-CONFORMITY The EGR pipe could fracture due to a potential non-conformity the fractured pipe may damage the alternator resulting in a loss of battery voltage and potentially a loss of engine power.
alfa romeo.remedy: The pipe must be checked and if incorrect replaced with a new  part.

alfa romeo.defect: INEFFECTIVE/INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF A LOCK NUT ON THE STEERING GEAR ROD Vehicles may have been produced with ineffective/incorrect tightening of a lock nut on the steering gear rod.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check for the correct tightening of the lock nut and check/adjust wheel alignment if tightening was required.

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE PIPE MAY CHAFE ON PAS PIPE MOUNTING BRACKET The fitting of an incorrect connector between the brake pipe and the master cylinder may cause the brake pipe to chafe on a power steering pipe support bracket. In the worst case this could result in a fluid leak and a reduction in braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the connector brake pipe and seals.

alfa romeo.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
alfa romeo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

alfa romeo.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A FAULTY LEFT OR RIGHT SIDE HALF-SHAFT A number of vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty left or right side half-shaft (drive shaft).
alfa romeo.remedy: The half-shaft identified as faulty according to traceability data must be replaced

alfa romeo.defect: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY DISPLAY INCORRECT INFORMATION Due to a nonconformity in the production process the instrument cluster may stick and display incorrect speed information.
alfa romeo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the instrument cluster.

alfa romeo.defect: WATER INGRESS TO ABS CONTROL UNIT Water may enter the ABS (antilock brake) control unit through a harness connector. This will cause the ABS control unit to malfunction and the fault warning lamp to illuminate.
alfa romeo.remedy: Fit a new ABS wiring harness which has watertight connectors.

alfa romeo.defect: THE BRAKE LINE RETAINING CLIP MAY NOT BE FIXED CORRECTLY TO THE TUCKER ON THE DASHBOARD The brake line (pipe) may not be fixed correctly
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the clip is fixed correctly and replace damaged brake pipes

alfa romeo.defect: BRAKE AND/OR CLUTCH SYSTEM COMPONENTS MAY BECOME DAMAGED BY MINERAL OIL The brake/clutch system components may be damaged and system performance may decay as a result of the potential presence of mineral oil in the brake-clutch fluid because the components are not compatible with mineral oil. As a result brake/clutch system performance may deteriorate.
alfa romeo.remedy: Replace the components in the brake-clutch system.

alfa romeo.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE RISK OF FIRE AND LOSS OF POWER ASSISTED STEERING There is a possibility that the high pressure power steering pipe may contact the exhaust downpipe which may result in a risk of fire and loss of power steering assistance.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check pipe for contact with exhaust and fit extra retaining bracket to power assisted steering pipe.

alfa romeo.defect: DOOR LOCKS MAY MALFUNCTION AND ALLOW DOORS TO OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY On a number of Fiat Fullback vehicles in some weather conditions (high temperatures) the mechanism inside the door lock may not function as intended. This can allow the door(s) to open unintentionally.
alfa romeo.remedy: The door locks must be replaced with compliant components.

alfa romeo.defect: REAR SUSPENSION MAY FAIL During the assembly of the vehicle it is possible the right hand rear suspension coil spring was damaged. Over time any damage could lead to the failure of the coil spring.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the coil spring.

alfa romeo.defect: GEARBOX MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED The wiring loom connected to the transmission oil pump may chafe against a support bracket and damage the wiring.. Damaged wiring may cause loss of drive or adversely affect gear changes.
alfa romeo.remedy: Check the wiring for any damage and repair as required. If the wiring is not damaged reposition the wiring.

alfa romeo.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

alfa romeo.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

alfa romeo.defect: INTERIOR FAN WIRING MAY CHAFE ON DASHBOARD SUPPORT The interior fan wiring may chafe on a dashboard support.  This could result in a short circuit and a fire in the fan unit.
alfa romeo.remedy: Fit additional insulation and protection to the fan electrical  wiring.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL COULD FOUL ON THE FLOOR Possibility that the accelerator may foul on the floor mounted pedal stop
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a modified throttle pedal stop.

alfa romeo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
alfa romeo.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBIITY OF FIRE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT A fire might occur in the engine compartment as a result of the waste gate excess pressure pipe being incorrectly routed.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected to ensure the waste gate pipe is correctly routed and fixed in the appropriate clips.

alfa romeo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary

alfa romeo.defect: THE AUTOMATIC HEADLIGHT POSITION SENSORS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CALIBRATED The automatic headlight position sensors may not have been calibrated and therefore the function does not comply with the requirements of ECE R48
alfa romeo.remedy: Recalibration of the automatic headlight position sensors and alignment of the headlights.

allied.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel may leak from connections for the fuel tank breather and vent hoses on to the ground.  Poor engine running may be experienced accompanied by the engine management warning light. The fuel on the ground can be a hazard for other road users.
allied.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the existing connections for the breather and vent hoses with modified items that allow from an expansion space for fuel within the tank so that excess fuel cannot enter the breather line or carbon canister.

allied.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Due to a non-conformity in manufacture there is a risk of damage to the fuel tank in some vehicles leading to a fuel leak under certain circumstances.
allied.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected. Remove and inspect the fuel tank. Where necessary replace the fuel tank.

alpina.defect: Integrated Braking System On affected vehicles an unexpected loss of hydraulic brake assistance may occur and may result in a different pedal behaviour under specific conditions an extended braking distance may be experienced and ABS/Stability control may be impaired
alpina.remedy: On the affected vehicles the Integrated Brake System will be replaced

alpina.defect: THE BLOWER-REGULATOR WIRING COULD BE DAMAGED AND COULD LEAD TO PARTIAL CONTACT OF INDIVIDUAL WIRE STRANDS The blower-regulator wiring could be damaged and could lead to partial contact of individual wire strands.
alpina.remedy: The blower-regulator wiring harness will be inspected and a new part will be installed. Additional components will be replaced if necessary as determined at the time of repair.

alpina.defect: THE PLUG-IN CONTACT OF THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE ON THE FRONT POWER DISTRIBUTION BOX CAN BECOME DAMAGED BY VEHICLE VIBRATIONS AND FRICTIONAL CORROSION The plug-in contact of the positive battery cable on the front power distribution box can become damaged by vehicle vibrations and frictional corrosion.
alpina.remedy: Replace the plug-in contact on the positive battery cable by installing a repair cable.

alpina.defect: Luggage Compartment Lashing Rail ALPINA XD3 On affected vehicles the screw connection for the luggage lashing rails may not withstand the forces in situations of a rear end impact. This may result in the lashing rail to not crumple as expected in these situations.
alpina.remedy: On affected vehicles the luggage lashing rail screws will be replaced along with additional washers.

alpina.defect: THE BLOWER-REGULATOR WIRING COULD BE DAMAGED AND COULD LEAD TO PARTIAL CONTACT OF INDIVIDUAL WIRE STRANDS The blower-regulator wiring could be damaged and could lead to partial contact of individual wire strands.
alpina.remedy: The blower-regulator wiring harness will be inspected and a new part will be installed. Additional components will be replaced if necessary as determined at the time of repair.

alpina.defect: THE BRANCH-OFF POINT OF THE MAIN BATTERY CABLE MAY CORRODE The branch-off point of the main battery cable may corrode.
alpina.remedy: The branch-off point will be checked and reworked appropriately depending on the level of corrosion present.

alpina.defect: THE PLUG-IN CONTACT OF THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE ON THE FRONT POWER DISTRIBUTION BOX CAN BECOME DAMAGED BY VEHICLE VIBRATIONS AND FRICTIONAL CORROSION The plug-in contact of the positive battery cable on the front power distribution box can become damaged by vehicle vibrations and frictional corrosion.
alpina.remedy: Replace the plug-in contact on the positive battery cable by installing a repair cable.

alpina.defect: THE BRANCH-OFF POINT OF THE MAIN BATTERY CABLE MAY CORRODE The branch-off point of the main battery cable may corrode.
alpina.remedy: The branch-off point will be checked and reworked appropriately depending on the level of corrosion present.

alpina.defect: THE DRIVER'S FRONT AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS DESIGNED The driver's front airbag may not deploy as designed.
alpina.remedy: The driver front airbag gas generator will be replaced.

alpine.defect: On affected vehicles the fuel supply to the engine can be reduced or even made impossible due to the friction of the impeller an internal component of the fuel pump. On affected vehicles the fuel supply to the engine can be reduced or even made impossible due to the friction of the impeller an internal component of the fuel pump.�
alpine.remedy: Replace the pump gauge module and/or reprogram the injection computer software.

alpine.defect: Upper section of the front bumper (softnose) For affected vehicles the upper section of the front bumper (Soft nose) -presents a risk of weld failure between the skin and the liner
alpine.remedy: Replacement of the upper part of the front bumper.

alpine.defect: Incorrect Label Tyre Informaiton On certain vehicles the wheel rim width - engraved on the rear wheel rims (left and right) is not compliant
alpine.remedy: Current engraving will be removed and replaced with correct new ones.

alpine.defect: On affected vehicles there is a potential fault with the fuel pump module.  This could result in the vehicle not starting and in rare circumstances a loss of torque or engine stalling. On affected vehicles there is a potential fault with the fuel pump module.  This could result in the vehicle not starting and in rare circumstances a loss of torque or engine stalling.
alpine.remedy: Replace the fuel pump module and reprogram the injection computer.

andover.defect: INSUFFICIENT WELD PENETRATION ON DRAWBAR MAY RESULT IN TRAILER DETACHMENT It has been identified that insufficient weld penetration at the reinforcement bush for the extending drawbar caused trailer detachment.
andover.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a non-extendable drawbar.

anteo.defect: HYDRAULIC UNIT SUPPORT FAILURE It is possible that the hydraulic pump/control unit could fall from the vehicle whilst it is in motion.  There has been only one reported detachment of a unit in Australia but Anteo are conducting the recall on safety grounds.
anteo.remedy: Recall affected units to have an additional mounting support fitted.

apec.models: REAR BRAKE DISC FOR FORD TRANSIT
apec.defect: DISC BOLT HOLES HAVE INCORRECT THREAD The half shaft retaining bolt holes in the rear disc may have an incorrect thread. Retaining bolts may fit but may become loose and fall out. This would allow the half shaft and wheel/hub assembly to detach from the vehicle.
apec.remedy: Replace affected components with discs which have the correct thread. Check and where necessary replace retaining bolts. Manufacturer also advises to replace brake pads and hub seal.

apec.models: BRAKE DRUM DRM9926 FOR VAUXHALL CORSA
apec.defect: WHEEL BEARING RETAINER MAY BE INSECURE Brake drum DRM9926 for Vauxhall Corsa  (BATCH CODE 181116C) The circlip that holds the bearing in may not be inserted correctly this would allow the bearing to become loose. This could allow the wheel to detach.
apec.remedy: Replace the brake drum/bearing assembly with a correctly manufactured version.

apollo.defect: TREAD PATTERN MAY SEPARATE The tread may detach which will be progressive. The warnings are: increasing vibrations and noise. If the warnings are ignored the tread can separate from the steel belting which leads to reduced handling and eventually to tyre 'blow out'.
apollo.remedy: Recall the tyres that are likely to be affected and replace them with quality assured product.

aprilia.defect: Aprilia RS-Tuono 457 E5+ Aprilia RS-Tuono 660 E5+ Left hand grip replacement For affected machines the materials used in the production of the left-hand grip has been found to contain a chemical substance that does not comply with current health and safety regulations and could pose a risk of interference with the endocrine and reproductive systems.
aprilia.remedy: Replacement of the left-hand grip.

aprilia.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED The brake master cylinder push rod and boot are allowing air to pass into the master cylinder which will gradually extend the movement of the lever until the efficiency of the brake is compromised.
aprilia.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the brake master cylinder push rod and boot.

aprilia.defect: SUDDEN LOSS OF POWER The engine may lose performance/stall due to valve/s dropping due to premature wear of the valve cap.
aprilia.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the upper cups of the intake and exhaust valves.

aprilia.defect: REAR WHEEL MAY LOCK The fastening which fixes the front sprocket to the gearbox output shaft may slacken and cause abnormal noise to occur from the nearside of the engine. If the noise is not heard or ignored eventually the rear wheel will lock. This will increase the risk of an accident.
aprilia.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the diameter of the recess on the secondary gearbox shaft. Fit a revised sprocket fastener kit or where necessary fit both a new secondary shaft to the gearbox and a revised sprocket fastener kit.

aprilia.defect: BRAKE CALLIPER MOUNTING SCREWS MAY BECOME LOOSE The bolts retaining the brake caliper carrier plates may become loose.
aprilia.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected replace the brake caliper carrier plates and fixings.

aprilia.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT It has been established that a manufacturing defect in the rotor of the fuel pump installed in the aforementioned machines can cause failure of the pump. This may cause the engine not start or it can cause the engine to stall if the machine is being used in particularly high ambient temperatures.
aprilia.remedy: Recall all affected machines to check and if require place the fuel pump.

aprilia.defect: FRONT BRAKE PERFORMANCE The front brake line may chafe against the oil supply pipe and leak fluid. In the worst case the performance of the front brake will rapidly diminish.
aprilia.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to fit a plastic guard.

aprilia.defect: THROTTLE MAY NOT CLOSE DUE TO THE INGESTION OF DEBRIS It has been identified that road debris and or stones can enter the throttle body and obstruct the throttle linkage causing the throttle to remain open.
aprilia.remedy: Recall all affected machine to fit protective cover to throttle body assembly and where necessary replace throttle cable body and upgrade the ECU software.

aprilia.defect: FRONT FORKS MAY NOT RETURN TO NORMAL RIDE POSITION. An out of tolerance internal spacer within the front forks can if it reaches maximum compression not return to its original position.  This could cause difficulties in control of the machine.
aprilia.remedy: Recall the affected machines and replace the internal spacer with the correct specification one.

aprilia.defect: FRAME MAY CRACK It has been identified that on subject machines cracking of both main frame members can occur.
aprilia.remedy: Recalled machines will be fitted with a steel support in the subject area.

aprilia.defect: INCORRECT VALVE SPRINGS FITTED TO ENGINE Incorrect specification inner valve springs have been fitted to the engine inlet and exhaust valves. Failure of the engine could result.
aprilia.remedy: Fit replacement inner valve springs.

aprilia.defect: DRIVE CHAIN MAY BREAK It has been identified that in some instances a link within the drive chain may break under particular riding conditions and after high mileage.
aprilia.remedy: Recalled machines which have covered less than 12000km will have the chain replaced. Machines which have covered in excess of 12000km's will have the chain and sprockets replaced.

aprilia.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED The brake master cylinder push rod and boot are allowing air to pass into the master cylinder which will gradually extend the movement of the lever until the efficiency of the brake is compromised.
aprilia.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the brake master cylinder push rod and boot.

aprilia.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT It has been established that a manufacturing defect in the rotor of the fuel pump installed in the aforementioned machines can cause failure of the pump. This may cause the engine not start or it can cause the engine to stall if the machine is being used in particularly high ambient temperatures.
aprilia.remedy: Recall all affected machines to check and if require place the fuel pump.
