The sealing cap may move and prevent lubrication reaching the vacuum pump causing it over a period to seize. The driver will probably note increasing input is necessary to stop the vehicle. Should the vacuum pump fail completely the vehicle can still be braked albeit with increased pressure applied to the foot brake control.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the sealing cap of the intake camshaft. If necessary the sealing cap in the camshaft will be secured with a spacer.

bmw.defect: A possible degradation of the propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture. A possible degradation of airbag propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the drivers airbag module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: REMAINING PARTICLES IN THE CELLS OF THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY CAN CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT In very rare cases welding beads were not always completely removed in the cleaning process during battery production.
bmw.remedy: Test and replace the High Voltage batteries if affected.

bmw.defect: PISTONS IN REAR BRAKE CALIPERS MAY NOT BE COATED TO SPECIFICATIONS The fault affects the brake system in particular the brake calipers on the rear axle. Because of a faulty coating hydrogen gas (approximately 10 ml) could be created in the coating of the piston of the brake caliper.  This will be completely outgassed during the first 2 months after the production process causing longer brake pedal travel.  Under certain circumstances the relevant brake pressure cannot be build up in the rear brake circuit. As a result the brake force of the  system may be reduced by up to 30%.  The driver may feel a soft brake pedal and a reduction of the brake performance. In certain cases the rear brake circuit could fail leading to increased risk of an accident.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the brake system will be bled.

bmw.defect: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER MAY LEAK OVER TIME AND CAUSE THERMAL INCIDENT The Exhaust Gas Recirculation cooler may leak over time and cause thermal incident.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the EGR cooler module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: THE BONDING OF THE TYPE LABEL AND/OR NOISE SIGN IS NOT PROCESS-RELIABLE The bonding of the type label and/or the noise sign is not process-reliable.
bmw.remedy: The type plate and the noise sign are to be replaced.

bmw.defect: OIL MAY LEAK FROM OIL PUMP AND MAY CONTAMINATE REAR WHEEL The circlip which holds the spring loaded thermostatic element in the oil pump housing may work loose and cause oil to leak out and make its way to the rear wheel whilst the motorcycle is ridden and may place safety of rider at risk.
bmw.remedy: Recall affected motorcycles and check circlip location. If faulty oil thermostat unit will be replaced.

bmw.defect: THE CABLE LENGTHS FOR THE ELECTRIC CONNECTION OF THE HALL SENSOR INSIDE THE SEATBELT BUCKLE COULD BE TOO SHORT The cable lengths for the electric connection of the hall sensor integrated inside the seatbelt buckle could be too short.
bmw.remedy: R; The front seat belt buckles will be checked and replaced if they are found to be faulty.

bmw.defect: POSSIBLE FLUID LEAK FROM POWER STEERING The threaded unions on the pressure lines for the power steering gear may not have been sufficiently tightened and could leak oil. Leaking oil could cause the power steering system to fail and in extreme cases escaping oil could ignite on hot engine components.
bmw.remedy: Check union bolts for signs of leakage. If leaks are found at either of the unions the steering gear will be replaced. If no leaks are found the union bolts will be checked for correct torque.

bmw.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE IMPAIRED Rear suspension relay lever pivot joint bearings may corrode through ingress of water. This can cause stiffness in the bearings and if not attended to over a protracted period the resistance in the bearings can eventually lead to the joints failing and sagging of the suspension to the extent that it will allow the rear wheel cover to lower onto the rear tyre. Should this event occur the speed and possibly the directional control could be impaired.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the original relay levers with re-designed relay levers.

bmw.defect: THE BONDING OF THE TYPE LABEL AND/OR NOISE SIGN IS NOT PROCESS-RELIABLE The bonding of the type label and/or the noise sign is not process-reliable.
bmw.remedy: The type plate and the noise sign are to be replaced.

bmw.defect: OIL COOLER MAY LEAK The engine oil cooler feed pipe may disconnect and leak oil. This may reach the front brakes and affect the braking efficiency.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles replace engine cooler pipe.

bmw.defect: REAR SPOILER TO BOOT LID MAY NOT BE ATTACHED SECURELY Vehicles may not have had the rear spoiler properly attached
bmw.remedy: The screw connection of the rear spoiler will be inspected and if necessary screws installed.

bmw.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL In individual cases the oil pump may no longer provide the required oil pressure. This may cause severe engine damage. Additionally the occurrence of critical driving situations cannot be ruled out because the oil pressure may drop suddenly while driving.  The driver will usually notice a drop in the engine oil pressure due to the check control message ''Low oil Pressure''. It is also possible the engine block will be damaged and as a result engine oil may be lost.
bmw.remedy: The oil pump will be replaced with the correct version.

bmw.defect: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY The defect concerns the front passenger air bag. The skin of certain instrument panels was not correctly scored. In case of accident with air bag deployment the predetermined breaking point will not tear open resulting in the air bag deploying in the instrument panel. This will lead to insufficient restraint effect and possibly release of parts of the air bag system into the passenger compartment.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the instrument panel.

bmw.defect: REAR AXLE CARRIER MAY FAIL It has been identified that defects in a material joint may have resulted during the heat treatment of individual components of the rear axle carrier. This may result in failure of the holders of the links and struts even under normal driving conditions. Should the holder of a link fail whilst the vehicle is in motion the handling characteristics of the vehicle would undergo an unexpected change which could result in an accident.
bmw.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked and if necessary fitted with a quality assured rear axle carrier.

bmw.defect: Undetected EGR System leaks may cause thermal activity in the intake manifold Undetected EGR System leaks may cause thermal activity in the intake manifold.
bmw.remedy: The engine management control unit (DDE) will be programmed with improved software incorporating the latest OBD functionality.

bmw.defect: FRONT BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED Air may form in the front brake master cylinder reservoir and enter the brake system. This will lead to longer travel of the brake lever with a possible loss of braking efficiency.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines likely to be affected to fit a mesh insert into the front brake master cylinder reservoir. In addition an explanatory page will be added to the vehicle owner's manual.

bmw.defect: STATIC ELECTRICITY MAY ACCUMULATE IN THE FUEL FILLER TUBE Static electricity may accumulate in the fuel filler tube.
bmw.remedy: Fit a modified fuel filler tube assembly incorporating a ground wire.

bmw.defect: THE CABLE LENGTHS FOR THE ELECTRIC CONNECTION OF THE HALL SENSOR INSIDE THE SEATBELT BUCKLE COULD BE TOO SHORT The cable lengths for the electric connection of the hall sensor integrated inside the seatbelt buckle could be too short.
bmw.remedy: R; The front seat belt buckles will be checked and replaced if they are found to be faulty.

bmw.defect: THE BEARINGS OF THE FUEL INJECTION PUMP MAY FAIL The bearings of the high pressure fuel injector pump may fail after a short travelled distance (approximately 3000 to 6000 miles) This leads to a total failure of the engine's fuel supply which results in the engine stalling.
bmw.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the fuel injector pump.

bmw.defect: BEARING DAMAGE WITHIN ENGINE Standard quality testing discovered that one particular supply part in the engine does not meet the required long-term properties. It is not possible to completely rule out bearing damage within the engine.
bmw.remedy: In affected machines the engine will be replaced or repaired.

bmw.defect: POSSIBLE UNSCHEDULED DEPLOYMENT OF SIDE AIRBAGS AND ACTIVATION OF BATTERY ISOLATOR SWITCH In certain driving conditions it is possible for the side airbags and the battery terminal (safety isolation switch) to trigger when this is not necessary ie when no accident has occurred.
bmw.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and recode the airbag control unit.

bmw.defect: THE MALFUNCTION INDICATOR LIGHT IS NOT ACTIVATED PROPERLY IN THE EVENT OF A FAULT The malfunction indicator light is not activated correctly in the event of a fault.
bmw.remedy: Install a software upgrade to the malfunction indicator system.

bmw.defect: THE BATTERY CABLES ON THE 48V STARTER GENERATOR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY SECURED DURING PRODUCTION The battery cables on the 48V starter generator may not have been sufficiently secured during the production process.
bmw.remedy: Check the screw connection of the 48V positive / negative battery cables on the starter generator and rework if necessary.

bmw.defect: EXCESSIVE INCREASE OF COOLING SYSTEM TEMPERATURE COULD LEAD TO A BURSTING OF THE HEATER MATRIX RADIATOR Excessive increase of cooling system temperature could (in a worst case) lead to a bursting of the heater matrix radiator.
bmw.remedy: Fitting an additional thermostat and modified hoses into the heating system to bypass the heat exchanger if overheating was to occur.

bmw.defect: IF THE HEAD AIR BAG IS DEPLOYED THE IGNITOR MAY SEPARATE FROM THE INFLATOR Curtain airbags may have propellant which may have a humidity level higher than specification and in the event of a collision may not deploy correctly increasing the risk of injury.
bmw.remedy: Replace the airbags on affected vehicles.

bmw.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT It has been identificed that there is a software errors in the Digital Motor Electronics-E engine control unit which can cause a faulty setting of the idle controller. This can result in the engine cutting out stopping or stalling when the engine is at idle speed and declutched. With any mechanical faults within the engine it can increase the potential for the engine to cut out stopping or stalling. This can therefore place the rider at risk under certain riding conditions or situations.
bmw.remedy: Recall all affected machines to install new updated software.

bmw.defect: FLUID LEAK MAY RESULT IN BRAKE FAILURE It has been identified that vibration can cause the flaring of the front brake pipe to crack resulting in a brake fluid leak. If allowed to continue un-rectified front brake failure may result.
bmw.remedy: Recalled machines will have the subject brake pipe replaced.

bmw.defect: SIDE STAND CONNECTION MAY BEND/BREAK On G310-models the side stand connection might bend or in extreme case brake. It is not possible to completely rule out an insecure standing position of the vehicle where this fault occurs.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the side stand connection will be checked for prior damage and an additional Bearing block for reinforcement purposes will be installed.

bmw.defect: THE BEARINGS OF THE FUEL INJECTION PUMP MAY FAIL The bearings of the high pressure fuel injector pump may fail after a short travelled distance (approximately 3000 to 6000 miles) This leads to a total failure of the engine's fuel supply which results in the engine stalling.
bmw.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the fuel injector pump.

bmw.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The top seat belt automatic reel with pyrotechnic ignited pre-tensioner fitted is mounted too close to the sound insulation both nearside and offside. If the vehicle is involved in a substantial collision where the pre-tensioners are deployed a fire may occur as it is possible for the hot gases to ignite the sound insulation.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to rework the sound insulation fitted to both nearside and offside and if necessary fit new top seat belts

bmw.defect: A STARTER MOTOR BOLT MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED INCORRECTLY AND BECOME LOST INSIDE THE TRANSMISSION BELL HOUSING A starter bolt may have been installed incorrectly and become lost inside the transmission bell housing.
bmw.remedy: The starter motor will be removed and checked for a bolt that is adrift any damage found will be rectified.

bmw.defect: VARIATION TO ELECTRICAL RESISTANCE IN THE BLOWER REGULATOR WIRING HARNESS CONNECTOR Over time irregularities in the crimp connection in conjunction with relative movements of the tin coated connector at the end of the wiring harness which connects to the tin coated blower regulator pin could lead to frictional corrosion. In combination with very high current flow which would occur which could lead to a temperature increase. As a result the blower regulator wiring could be damaged and could lead to partial contact of individual wire strands. this could result in an irregular current flow further overheating and increase the risk of fire.
bmw.remedy: The blower regulator wiring harness will be inspected and a new part will be installed.

bmw.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY The driver's air bag inflator may rupture during deployment. Metal shards may pass through the air bag material  and cause injury to occupants.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag and inflator assemblies.

bmw.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Some engines are fitted with an additional water pump for the turbo charger. In some circumstances a crack may develop which then leads to melting of the plug connections and the housing. Further heat development may then lead to scorch damage. In exceptional cases such overheating can lead to smouldering of the water pump.  If smouldering occurs an engine compartment fire and vehicle fire cannot be excluded.
bmw.remedy: The water pump will be replaced for a new more robust version.

bmw.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The in tank fuel pump may contain sub components that have not been correctly nickel plated. This may cause excessive friction leading to the fuel pump being inoperative. The driver may experience a no start condition or in the worst case an engine stall. A warning lamp and error message will display. Steering and brakes will still function.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the in tank fuel pump with a modified version.

bmw.defect: The high-pressure fuel rail may not have been produced according to specifications The high-pressure fuel rail may not have been produced according to specifications.
bmw.remedy: Replace the high-pressure fuel rail.

bmw.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER MOUNTING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the lower rubber mounting on the metal bush of the rear shock absorbers may fail to meet the quality requirement. Dependant on the mileage and operating conditions the rubber mounting may come completely free from the shock absorber. If this occurs the bodywork would no longer be supported above the wheels causing it to come into contact with the wheel concerned. Should this occur the possibility exists that a critical driving condition might occur or even the risk of an accident.
bmw.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear shock absorbers checked and replaced if necessary.

bmw.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT It is possible that the multi-function switches can fail which can result in the kill-switch function being tripped. This can result in the engine cutting out and the loss of other functions.
bmw.remedy: Recall affected machines for a new improved switch to be installed.

bmw.defect: THE PRESSING FORCE OF THE BEARING BUSHING INTO THE CRANKCASE MAY BE OUT OF SPECIFICATION The engine counterbalance shaft bearing bushing into the crankcase may be out of specification
bmw.remedy: Replace the engine of affected vehicles

bmw.defect: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER MAY LEAK OVER TIME AND CAUSE THERMAL INCIDENT The Exhaust Gas Recirculation cooler may leak over time and cause thermal incident.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the EGR cooler module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: IF THE HEAD AIR BAG IS DEPLOYED THE IGNITOR MAY SEPARATE FROM THE INFLATOR Curtain airbags may have propellant which may have a humidity level higher than specification and in the event of a collision may not deploy correctly increasing the risk of injury.
bmw.remedy: Replace the airbags on affected vehicles.

bmw.defect: THE BONDING OF THE TYPE LABEL AND/OR NOISE SIGN IS NOT PROCESS-RELIABLE The bonding of the type label and/or the noise sign is not process-reliable.
bmw.remedy: The type plate and the noise sign are to be replaced.

bmw.defect: THE ISOFIX CHILD RESTRAINT U-LOOP MAY BREAK OFF THE CARRIER PLATE The ISOFIX child restraint U-Loop may break off the carrier plate resulting in the child seat no longer being secure.
bmw.remedy: Weld an additional metal angle bracket to each ISOFIX U-Loop

bmw.defect: THE BATTERY CABLES ON THE 48V STARTER GENERATOR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY SECURED DURING PRODUCTION The battery cables on the 48V starter generator may not have been sufficiently secured during the production process.
bmw.remedy: Check the screw connection of the 48V positive / negative battery cables on the starter generator and rework if necessary.

bmw.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION LINKAGE/POSSIBLE HANDLEBAR CRACKING A. The nut securing the front suspension telelever joint may under extreme circumstances become loose for RS and GS models B. Handlebar cracking may occur on high mileage R1100RS SE (Ergonomic) version machines.
bmw.remedy: A. Replace the telelever joint nut with an improved version incorporating a self locking adhesive. B. On affected R1100RS SE machines replace the original handlebars with an improved version.

bmw.defect: ABS MAY FAIL In certain exceptional circumstances (constant use of the ABS) it is possible for the ABS to stop functioning.  This is as a  result of excessive pressure building up in the ABS system.
bmw.remedy: To recall the machines that are likely to be affected and fit a pressure restrictor into the hand brake control hydraulics.

bmw.defect: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER MAY LEAK OVER TIME AND CAUSE THERMAL INCIDENT The Exhaust Gas Recirculation cooler may leak over time and cause thermal incident.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the EGR cooler module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: ENGINE CONTROL UNIT  CONTROL OF FUEL PUMP Insufficient control of the fuel pump by the engine control unit the fuel pump may stop functioning in certain driving conditions which could lead in individual cases to a drop of the fuel pressure.  When the fuel pressure drops an engine stalling cannot be excluded.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the engine control unit will be reprogrammed

bmw.defect: THE CONTROL RING OF THE BACKREST RECLINER IN THE SECOND SEAT ROW MAY BREAK The control ring of the recliner of the backrest in the second seat row may break due to insufficient material performance.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the seat frames of the second seat row will be replaced.

bmw.defect: AFFECTED VEHICLES MAY BE FITTED WITH BRAKE DISCS WHICH ARE NOT TO SPECIFICATION Affected vehicles may be fitted with brake discs which were not produced according to the specifications
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the brake discs will be checked and if necessary replaced

bmw.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR Due to the ingress of moisture it is possible that a short circuit can occur in the additional coolant pump for the exhaust turbocharger. The driver will be informed of the issue by a warning message on the display in the instrument panel.  If not addressed it is possible for further heat build up in the pump which may cause the plug connection and housing to melt and in extreme cases a localised fire in the engine compartment or vehicle.
bmw.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the additional coolant pump.

bmw.defect: During the supplier s production process of the battery cells a manufacturing defect occurred. During assembly of the cell the cathode plate may have been damaged and a broken piece may have entered the interior of the cell. During assembly of the HV Battery cell the cathode plate may have been damaged and a broken piece may have entered the interior of the cell.  BMW strongly recommends refraining from charging the high-voltage battery and to not use the vehicles until the repair is performed. BMW also recommends parking the vehicle outdoors and not in the immediate vicinity of buildings.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the defective cell modules of the high-voltage battery will be replaced.

bmw.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE Due to a fault with an internal connection within the Fuel Filter Heater (FFH) it is possible that during temperatures below freezing the FFH can remain permanently activated. This will normally cause the FFH to overheat which will result in the inability to start the vehicle due to a flat battery. This can occur even when the ignition is turned off. However in extreme cases it could cause a vehicle fire.
bmw.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the FFH.

bmw.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION COULD FAIL The fixed fork tube can suffer preliminary damage due to unusual incidents with momentary high stress without the user noticing the damage. Through longer usage with high stress the pressed in seal plug can loosen. This usually leads to oil leaks a clacking noise as well as increasingly imprecise drivability. If these signals are not perceived or ignored and further high stress incidents occur the plug may become completely loose. Subsequently critical driving conditions cannot be ruled out.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and retrofit with an additional fixed fork bush or � if the preliminary damage is too much � the fixed front tubes are replaced by appropriately modified new parts.

bmw.defect: A possible degradation of the propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture. A possible degradation of airbag propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the drivers airbag module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: THE BATTERY CABLES ON THE 48V STARTER GENERATOR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY SECURED DURING PRODUCTION The battery cables on the 48V starter generator may not have been sufficiently secured during the production process.
bmw.remedy: Check the screw connection of the 48V positive / negative battery cables on the starter generator and rework if necessary.

bmw.defect: EPS MAY NOT PERFORM AS SPECIFIED Due to a component in the integrated control module not being to specification it is possible power steering assistance may fail. If this happens the EPS warning lamp will illuminate and a check control message will appear on the dashboard display. Directional control will be maintained albeit with additional driver input.
bmw.remedy: Recall vehicles likely to be affected to replace the steering box.

bmw.defect: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER COULD LEAK OVER TIME Leaking glycol coolant could create in combination with soot and oil sediments in the EGR module ignitable deposits.
bmw.remedy: The EGR cooler will be internally inspected with an endoscope and replaced if evidence of leaking is found.

bmw.defect: THE BONDING OF THE TYPE LABEL AND/OR NOISE SIGN IS NOT PROCESS-RELIABLE The bonding of the type label and/or the noise sign is not process-reliable.
bmw.remedy: The type plate and the noise sign are to be replaced.

bmw.defect: FRONT BRAKE PIPES MAY LEAK. The front brake pipes may leak brake fluid which can be noticed in the first instance by seepage of brake fluid from the front hose/s and a lowering of the fluid level in the reservoir. The next stage of failure would be a spongy feeling to the brake control and dripping fluid from the brake hoses. If all the previous indicators have not been noted and rectified the brakes will eventually not apply.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to check which brake hoses are fitted and if not the latest version fit new brake hoses.

bmw.defect: MANUFACTURING DEFECT WITH WINDING OF CELL-INTERNAL FILMS FOR HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY The safety recall relates to a problem with a cell module within the high-voltage battery.
bmw.remedy: Replace the affected high-voltage cell module.

bmw.defect: CORROSION ON LOWER STEERING SHAFT Instances of corrosion on the corrugated section of the lower steering shaft have occurred. This could lead to eventual weakening of the shaft.
bmw.remedy: All vehicles fitted with corrugated type lower steering shafts will have them replaced with quality assured examples.

bmw.defect: A possible degradation of the propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture. A possible degradation of airbag propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the drivers airbag module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: THE STEERING COLUMN  SHAFT COULD DETACH FROM THE DOUBLE JOINT The steering column shaft assembly may detach from the bottom double joint.
bmw.remedy: Check the bottom end of the steering shaft and if required resecure the shaft using a new screw.

bmw.defect: THE OBD SOFTWARE COULD MISINTERPRET CERTAIN INPUT PARAMETERS FOR THE ENGINE MANGEMENT SYSTEM During a service visit the affected vehicles have been updated with software that could misinterpret certain input parameters for the engine management system.
bmw.remedy: The control units will be reprogrammed with an improved version of software.

bmw.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER MOUNTING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the lower rubber mounting on the metal bush of the rear shock absorbers may fail to meet the quality requirement. Dependant on the mileage and operating conditions the rubber mounting may come completely free from the shock absorber. If this occurs the bodywork would no longer be supported above the wheels causing it to come into contact with the wheel concerned. Should this occur the possibility exists that a critical driving condition might occur or even the risk of an accident.
bmw.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear shock absorbers checked and replaced if necessary.

bmw.defect: INCORRECT HEADREST RODS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE BACKREST OF THE SECOND ROW OF SEATS ON THE OUTER SIDE Incorrect headrest rods may have been installed in the backrest of the second row of seats on the outer side.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the outer headrest of the second seat row will be checked and replaced if necessary.

bmw.defect: SIDE STAND CONNECTION MAY BEND/BREAK On G310-models the side stand connection might bend or in extreme case break.  It is not possible to completely rule out an insecure standing position of the vehicle where this fault occurs.
bmw.remedy: On affected machines the side stand connection will be checked for prior damage and an additional bearing block for reinforcement purposes will be installed.

bmw.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL It has been identified that during the manufacturing process cracks may have formed in the area of the brake disc body. Subsequent surface treatment means that any such crack will not be detectable at a later date. Should a crack have formed this may cause the brake disc to fail whilst the vehicle is in motion causing the affected brake to become inoperative.
bmw.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear axle brake discs checked for the affected production date. The brake discs will be checked if necessary.

bmw.defect: A possible degradation of the propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture. A possible degradation of airbag propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the drivers airbag module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL COULD BE LOST The Anti - Roll Bar fitted to the rear axle has too large a diameter. Detachment may occur with loss of directional control
bmw.remedy: Recall affected vehicle and replace Anti - Roll  Bar.

bmw.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The timing-chain tensioner is subject to wear because of a manufacturing defect . This means that gradually the timing chain is no longer adequately tensioned and as a result it slips its sprockets. If not rectified the engine could die while the vehicle is being ridden.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the timing chain tensioner.

bmw.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTNENT LOSS OF ENGINE POWER Due to a hardware fault within the digital engine electronic control unit the possibility exists that the unit could fail completely resulting in loss of engine power.
bmw.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the control unit with a quality assured item.

bmw.defect: ELECTRIC FUEL PUMP MAY FAIL Due to a manufacturing defect which causes premature wear of the fuel pump commutator it is possible that the engine might cut out whilst driving.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel pump.

bmw.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF CONTROL The bolts securing the rear axle support should not be re-used after removal. Affected vehicles may have had the rear axle support refitted after repair work using the original fitted bolts. These may work and though noise and vibration are likely continued use may affect the vehicle's handling.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the rear axle support bolts.

bmw.defect: THE CLUTCH COVER SCREWS MAY LOOSEN The clutch cover screws may loosen due to a faulty anti-friction coating on the screw threads.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the screw for attaching the clutch cover will be replaced.

bmw.defect: THE MATERIAL QUALITY OF THE SCREWS USED FOR SEAT BELTS AND REAR SEATS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATIONS. The material quality of seat and seatbelt screws may not be according to specification.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the screws will be replaced in specific locations on the seat belts or rear seats.

bmw.defect: TYRES MAY HAVE CUTS IN SIDE WALLS. Cuts have been observed on isolated Continental tyres fitted to vehicles. The cuts (1-5 cm in length) are of varying severity and can lead to a loss of tyre pressure. This can destroy the tyre if the vehicle continues to be driven.
bmw.remedy: Recall affected vehicles examine all tyres and replace any found with cuts in the sidewalls.

bmw.defect: THE BEARINGS OF THE FUEL INJECTION PUMP MAY FAIL The bearings of the high pressure fuel injector pump may fail after a short travelled distance (approximately 3000 to 6000 miles) This leads to a total failure of the engine's fuel supply which results in the engine stalling.
bmw.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the fuel injector pump.

bmw.defect: REDUCED REAR WHEEL GUIDANCE The screwed connection between the frame and the fixed bearing stud for the rear swinging arm may loosen. This results in the rear wheel not being kept aligned as required causing reduced rear wheel guidance. In certain conditions this can lead to critical riding situations.
bmw.remedy: Check and tighten mounting bolts for rear wheel swing arm.

bmw.defect: FRONT BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED Air may form in the front brake master cylinder reservoir and enter the brake system. This will lead to longer travel of the brake lever with a possible loss of braking efficiency.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines likely to be affected to fit a mesh insert into the front brake master cylinder reservoir. In addition an explanatory page will be added to the vehicle owner's manual.

bmw.defect: STEERING DAMPER MAY BECOME DEFECTIVE. It has been identified that the steering dampers on likely to be affected machines may become defective due to the coating of the inner section of the cylinder becoming partially detached then partially clogging the oil bores. This can result that the action of the steering damper  becoming stiff.
bmw.remedy: Recalled machines will have the steering damper replaced.

bmw.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL Rain/moisture may enter the side stand switch and cause the engine to cut out or not to start.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the side stand switch.

bmw.defect: CRACKS MAY APPEAR WHERE THE OIL HOSE OF THE OIL COOLER CONNECTS WITH THE OIL PIPE Oil cooler may crack and leak.
bmw.remedy: On affected bikes the oil cooler will be replaced.

bmw.defect: ENGINE PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that the use of a faulty tool during engine assembly has led to isolated incidents of damage to the spark plugs. When the engine is in use the  insulator of the central electrode may become displaced and contact he ground electrode. Should this occur it  will have a detriment effect on engine performance.
bmw.remedy: Recalled machines will have the suspect spark plugs replaced.

bmw.defect: On affected vehicles ingress of transmission fluid may occur to the integrated transmission control unit within the mechatronic module On affected vehicles ingress of transmission fluid may occur to the integrated transmission control unit within the mechatronic module
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the transmission mechatronic module will be replaced

bmw.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER MOUNTING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the lower rubber mounting on the metal bush of the rear shock absorbers may fail to meet the quality requirement. Dependant on the mileage and operating conditions the rubber mounting may come completely free from the shock absorber. If this occurs the bodywork would no longer be supported above the wheels causing it to come into contact with the wheel concerned. Should this occur the possibility exists that a critical driving condition might occur or even the risk of an accident.
bmw.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear shock absorbers checked and replaced if necessary.

bmw.defect: CORRECT CHAIN TENSIONERS MAY NOT BE FITTED It has been identified that in production the left hand chain tensioner may have been fitted to the right hand side of the machine.
bmw.remedy: Recalled machines will have the chain tensioners checked for correct installation and rectified if found to be incorrect or damaged.

bmw.defect: FRONT BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED Air may form in the front brake master cylinder reservoir and enter the brake system. This will lead to longer travel of the brake lever with a possible loss of braking efficiency.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines likely to be affected to fit a mesh insert into the front brake master cylinder reservoir. In addition an explanatory page will be added to the vehicle owner's manual.

bmw.defect: REAR SUSPENSION PIVOT STRUTS ARE NOT TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION OR REQUIRED STABILITY During installation pivot struts that did not correspond to the specification and that did not have the required stability were installed on the rear suspension strut.
bmw.remedy: Replace the relay lever.

bmw.defect: BRAKE PERFORMANCE COULD BE AFFECTED It is possible that the vehicle has been fitted with 16 inch front brake discs instead of the required 17 inch brake discs.  If this is the case extreme braking could result in the over heating of the brake system and introduce vapour (air) bubbles into the brake fluid.  This could affect the braking performance.
bmw.remedy: Recall all potentially affected vehicles and check the size of the brakes discs on the front axle.  If 16 inch brake discs are found replace these with the correct 17 inch brakes discs and brake pads.

bmw.defect: AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT FAULT DUE TO INADEQUATE CODING DATA WHICH COULD LEAD TO ACTIVATION Possible unintentional activation of the front airbags due to inadequate coding data.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the airbag control unit will be encoded.

bmw.defect: POTENTIAL FIRE RISK The power steering box housing may not be machined to the correct specification. This could cause an over pressurisation of bellows due to the insecurity of a snap ring and result in a sudden loss of hydraulic pressure. Oil will then be sprayed onto hot engine components and may ignite.
bmw.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to have the steering box replaced.

bmw.defect: FRONT BRAKE PIPES MAY LEAK. The front brake pipes may leak brake fluid which can be noticed in the first instance by seepage of brake fluid from the front hose/s and a lowering of the fluid level in the reservoir. The next stage of failure would be a spongy feeling to the brake control and dripping fluid from the brake hoses. If all the previous indicators have not been noted and rectified the brakes will eventually not apply.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to check which brake hoses are fitted and if not the latest version fit new brake hoses.

bmw.defect: REAR WINDOW PANE MAY DETACH The rear side windows and the rear windscreen all made from a synthetic polycarbonate may detach from the vehicle causing a danger to other road users and possibly pedestrians.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the rear side windows and if necessary the rear windscreen with conventional glass windows.

bmw.defect: AN INCORRECT INSTALLATION OF THE HEAD AIRBAGS ON DRIVER AND PASSENGER SIDE WOULD RESULT IN AN INCOMPLETE INFLATION Driver and passenger side head airbags may have been twisted on installation
bmw.remedy: The head airbags on the driver and passenger side will be checked and if necessary reworked

bmw.defect: During supplier s production process of the battery cells a manufacturing defect occurred with the winding of cell-internal films for the high-voltage battery. During supplier�s production process of the battery cells a manufacturing defect occurred with the winding of cell-internal films for the high-voltage battery.
bmw.remedy: The defective cell module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: CAMSHAFT SUPPORT HOUSING BEARING CAPS MAY BECOME LOOSE It is possible that the camshaft bearing cap screws could come loose on the affected vehicles.
bmw.remedy: Check and replace camshaft support housing or complete cylinder head as required.

bmw.defect: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER MAY LEAK OVER TIME AND CAUSE THERMAL INCIDENT The Exhaust Gas Recirculation cooler may leak over time and cause thermal incident.
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the EGR cooler module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: FINAL DRIVE MAY BECOME UNSUPPORTED It has been identified that the possibility exists that the front threaded fastener of the paralever link may become insecure. In the worst case the screw could fall away resulting in the final drive being unsupported.
bmw.remedy: Recalled machines will have the subject screw replaced.

bmw.defect: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION MODULE COULD LEAK OVER TIME The Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) Module could leak over time�and cause thermal incident.
bmw.remedy: The EGR cooler will be internally inspected with an endoscope and replaced if evidence of leaking is found.

bmw.defect: WHEEL MAY DETATCH It is possible that during maintenance work on brake discs and/or wheel changes threaded fasteners might have been over tightened. The over tightening can result in cracks in the wheel flange. In the course of a lengthy service life the cracks can propagate and under worst-case conditions lead to fracture of the bolted join and the wheel separating from the machine. Initially owners will be warned of the concern and when the new components are available the owners will be notified so the components can be replaced.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the aluminium wheel flange with a steel flange.

bmw.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED The front brake hose may not have sufficient flexibility due to the position of the chafe guard. This may lead to chafing and eventually leakage of the brake hose. If leakage occurs stopping distance will be greater leading to a higher risk of collision.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front brake hose.

bmw.defect: BRAKE DISCS MAY BECOME INSECURE In later models the bolts retaining the front brake disc may not remain secure for their service life. In earlier models the head of the bolts may damage the speed sensor cable when the machine is ridden.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to 1. (earlier models) fit new threaded fasteners to the brake disc and alter the speed sensor cable routing. 2. (later models) alter the speed sensor cable routing.

bmw.defect: AUXILIARY WATER PUMP'S ELECTRONIC CIRCUIT BOARD COULD LEAD TO A SHORT CIRCUIT The auxiliary water pump may short circuit causing a thermal incident.
bmw.remedy: The Auxiliary Water Pump of the affected vehicles will be replaced.

bmw.defect: THE PIVOT PIN MATERIAL DOES NOT HAVE THE CORRECT QUALITY AND THE YIELD STRENGTH IS NOT SUFFICIENT The material of the pivot pin which connects the swinging arm to the rear bevel gear does not have the correct quality
bmw.remedy: On affected bikes the pivot pin will be replaced. Furthermore the repair manual will be revised as the pivot pins needs to be replaced by any related repair.

bmw.defect: TYRES MAY HAVE CUTS IN SIDE WALLS. Cuts have been observed on isolated Continental tyres fitted to vehicles. The cuts (1-5 cm in length) are of varying severity and can lead to a loss of tyre pressure. This can destroy the tyre if the vehicle continues to be driven.
bmw.remedy: Recall affected vehicles examine all tyres and replace any found with cuts in the sidewalls.

bmw.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY The igniter for  the certain airbag modules may not have been correctly manufactured which may affect air bag deployment in the event of a collision.
bmw.remedy: Where necessary replace affected airbag modules.

bmw.defect: MACHINE CAN BE RIDDEN WITH SIDE STAND EXTENDED The mounting of the side-stand switch with a circlip is insufficient. As a result of this the side-stand switch may work loose and be damaged. If the side-stand switch does not function correctly the engine is no longer switched off when the side-stand is extended and a gear engaged. It would be possible for the driver to drive off with the side stand extended.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to modify the side stand switch mounting. The switch will be bolted on.

bmw.defect: CORROSION COULD OCCUR WITHIN THE UNANODIZED CALLIPER PISTON BORE Corrosion on the surface of the calliper could impair the piston's clearance within the bore.
bmw.remedy: Check and replace callipers if found to be corroded.

bmw.defect: BRAKE DISCS MAY BECOME INSECURE In later models the bolts retaining the front brake disc may not remain secure for their service life. In earlier models the head of the bolts may damage the speed sensor cable when the machine is ridden.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to 1. (earlier models) fit new threaded fasteners to the brake disc and alter the speed sensor cable routing. 2. (later models) alter the speed sensor cable routing.

bmw.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INABILITY TO ENGAGE GEAR OR DECLUTCH Possibility that the pin operating the master cylinder may have been welded incorrectly. Resulting in the inability (on failure) to de-clutch or engage a gear.
bmw.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles inspect the subject weld and replace the clutch pedal if the weld is found to be faulty.

bmw.defect: The clutch cover screws may loosen due to a faulty anti-friction coating on the screw threads. The clutch cover screws may loosen due to a faulty anti-friction coating on the screw threads.
bmw.remedy: The 10 screws of the clutch cover need to be replaced by new ones. For the repair a new gasket (clutch cover seal) should be used if available.

bmw.defect: ON AFFECTED VEHICLES SEAT BELT MOUNTING BOLTS MAY NOT BE SECURELY ATTACHED On affected vehicles seat belt mounting bolts may not be securely attached.
bmw.remedy: Check connections of both front seat belts and rework if necessary.

bmw.defect: PLUG IN CONTACT CABLE MAY MALFUNCTION The positive battery cable to the front distribution box behind the glove box can become damaged by vibrations and frictional corrosion. This may cause a loss of electrical connection to the distributions box. Symptoms include being  unable to gain entry or start the car but the most common are a flickering instrument panel or uneven engine performance. However if the electrical connection is completely lost this will also affect the operation of the vehicles lighting systems; e.g. sidelights or hazard warning lamps.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a suitable repair to the battery cable positive cable.

bmw.defect: CRASH PADS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ON THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY DURING VEHICLE ASSEMBLY Crash pads may not have been installed on the high-voltage battery during vehicle assembly.
bmw.remedy: Vehicles will be inspected and if necessary the crash pads will be retrofitted.

bmw.defect: FRONT CALIPER COULD BE INSECURE The front brake caliper might not be fully secure. As a consequence of this the brake caliper can get loose and in the worst case the brake could be lost.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and rework the screw connections of the brake caliper.

bmw.defect: BACKREST COULD FOLD FORWARD UNDER HEAVY LOAD The latching element of the Easy Entry Kit on the driver's seat does not lock correctly into the lower swinging arm. As a result the backrest could fold under heavy load such as in a collision or unsecured load in the rear and harsh braking.
bmw.remedy: The vehicle that is likely to be affected will be recalled and a new seat mechanism fitted. R/2018/027 refers.

bmw.defect: THE OBD SOFTWARE COULD MISINTERPRET CERTAIN INPUT PARAMETERS FOR THE ENGINE MANGEMENT SYSTEM During a service visit the affected vehicles have been updated with software that could misinterpret certain input parameters for the engine management system.
bmw.remedy: The control units will be reprogrammed with an improved version of software.

bmw.defect: GEARBOX MAY FAIL Loss of drive may occur due to gearbox failure.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the gearbox with a quality assured unit.

bmw.defect: RESTRICTED FUEL SUPPLY COULD CAUSE ENGINE TO STALL The sealing cap of the pressure-limiting valve in the fuel tank delivery module may be damaged. This concern could lead to a reduction in fuel transfer from the left side to the right side of the fuel tank. Therefore it is possible for the engine to stall even though the fuel gauge would show fuel present.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fuel pressure of the delivery module and the distance of the cap on the pressure-limiting valve. Where necessary the delivery module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INADVERTENTLY The front air bags may trigger unnecessarily and the possibility of occupant injury cannot be excluded.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to recode the air bag control unit.

bmw.defect: INCORRECT ROUTING OF THE GEARBOX WIRING HARNESS An incorrect routing of the gearbox wiring harness could lead to wiring harness damage
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles the transmission wiring harness will be reworked

bmw.defect: The driver and front passenger airbags may deploy with too much explosive force causing sharp metal fragments to be released into the cabin. The driver and front passenger airbags may deploy with too much explosive force causing sharp metal fragments to be released into the cabin.
bmw.remedy: Replace the driver and front passenger airbags.

bmw.defect: THE INTEGRATED BRAKE SYSTEM HYDRAULIC UNIT MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED INCORRECTLY The Integrated Brake system hydraulic unit may have been produced incorrectly
bmw.remedy: Replace the Integrated Brake system hydraulic unit.

bmw.defect: Undetected EGR System leaks may cause thermal activity in the intake manifold Undetected EGR System leaks may cause thermal activity in the intake manifold.
bmw.remedy: The engine management control unit (DDE) will be programmed with improved software incorporating the latest OBD functionality.

bmw.defect: On some diesel vehicles glycol leakage from the EGR-Cooler may occur.  In very rare cases this could lead to the melting of the Intake manifold and in very rare cases result in a possible fire. On some diesel vehicles glycol leakage from the EGR-Cooler may occur.  In very rare cases this could lead to the melting of the Intake manifold and in very rare cases result in a possible fire.
bmw.remedy: Initial warning letter with advice to be sent with follow up Letter to call in vehicles for rectification work to be carried out on the affected vehicles once parts are available.  The EGR cooler will be replaced with an optimised component.

bmw.defect: THE FLANGE OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL PUMPS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ATTACHED TO THE CYLINDER HEAD CORRECTLY The flange of the HPFP may not have been attached to the cylinder head according to specifications.
bmw.remedy: Both High Pressure Fuel Pumps will be replaced.

bmw.defect: Undetected EGR System leaks may cause thermal activity in the intake manifold Undetected EGR System leaks may cause thermal activity in the intake manifold.
bmw.remedy: The engine management control unit (DDE) will be programmed with improved software incorporating the latest OBD functionality.

bmw.defect: RISK OF FIRE The positive battery cable routed from the vehicle battery to the engine bay consists of one cable in the luggage compartment and one cable in the underbody.  Both cable are connected by a screw connection and covered by a plastic cover.  In single cases the plastic cover may have been fitted incorrectly during the vehicle production.  Over time an incorrectly fitted cover could cause the screw connections to come loose leading to an increased resistance also humidity may affect the connection and cause high resistance and drop in current.  This can lead to the vehicle not starting and in extreme cases the connection could over heat leading to the possibility of a fire in the luggage area.
bmw.remedy: The clips on the battery will be checked the cover replaced and sealed.

bmw.defect: WHEEL BOLTS ON LEFT SIDE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY The wheel bolts (left side) that may not have been tightened to specifications
bmw.remedy: On the affected vehicles all wheel bolts on the left side will be replaced and tightened to specifications.

bmw.defect: A possible degradation of the propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture. A possible degradation of airbag propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the drivers airbag module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: POSSIBLE CORROSION OF THE BULKHEAD CONNECTOR OF THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE The branch-off point of the main battery cable may corrode
bmw.remedy: The branch-off point will be checked and reworked appropriately depending on the level of corrosion present

bmw.defect: A possible degradation of the propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture. A possible degradation of airbag propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the drivers airbag module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: A possible degradation of the propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture. A possible degradation of airbag propellant tablets could lead to an over-aggressive combustion in the event the airbag is activated which may cause the inflator body to rupture.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the drivers airbag module will be replaced.

bmw.defect: ISOFIX CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEM MAY BECOME INSECURE ISOFIX mountings are fixed to a cross member. As a result of vibrations and type of seat used it is possible for the ISOFIX mountings to become insecure and in rare cases break off.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and a metal angle bracket will be welded to each of the four ISOFIX brackets in the back seats to reinforce the mounting.

bmw.defect: WATER CAN ACCUMULATE IN THE BOWDEN CABLES FOR THE THROTTLE VALVE Water can accumulate in the Bowden cables for the throttle valve during intensive cleaning or longer rainy trips.
bmw.remedy: On affected vehicles the Bowden cables and the Bowden cable holder on the gas handle will be replaced.

bmw.defect: POTENTIAL RUPTURE OF DRIVER FRONT AIR BAG INFLATOR The front drivers air bag may not deploy correctly on activation.
bmw.remedy: Check and replace the drivers front air bag if required.

bmw.defect: Undetected EGR System leaks may cause thermal activity in the intake manifold Undetected EGR System leaks may cause thermal activity in the intake manifold.
bmw.remedy: The engine management control unit (DDE) will be programmed with improved software incorporating the latest OBD functionality.

bmw.defect: In rare cases the starter motor can inadvertently be activated permanently presenting a risk of a thermal event In rare cases the starter motor can inadvertently be activated permanently presenting a risk of a thermal event.
bmw.remedy: Rework the starter motor assembly.

bmw.defect: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAYNOT  DEPLOY CORRECTLY It is possible a recess on the inside of the instrument panel was not machined correctly. The recess is the predetermined break point of the instrument panel when the front passenger airbag is activated. If the milling has not been carried out correctly the proper deployment of the front passenger airbag cannot be ensured.
bmw.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the milling of the predetermined break point. Where necessary the instrument panel will be replaced.

bmw.defect: DAMAGE OF THE FUNCTIONAL GROUP SHIFT FORK/ SELECTOR SLEEVE/ GEARWHEEL MIGHT OCCUR Gear change my not be performed correctly
bmw.remedy: On affected bikes the shift forks the shifting sleeve 5th / 6th gear and the gear wheel 6th gear will be replaced

bmw.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL Rain/moisture may enter the side stand switch and cause the engine to cut out or not to start.
bmw.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the side stand switch.

bockmann.defect: A manufacturing error of the tyres  195/50 R13 C (EAN 6953913155432) with DOT 4720 could lead to a loss in tyre pressure or a burst tyre A manufacturing error of the tyres 195/50 R13 C (EAN 6953913155432) with DOT 4720 could lead to a loss in tyre pressure or a burst tyre.

bond.defect: Rovelo All Weather 4RS tyres - displaying incorrect directional marking Due to a manufacturing error an ‘inside’ sidewall marking has been printed on the outer sidewall on some tyres. The 'inside' marking should not be printed on directional tyres at all.
bond.remedy: Replace the incorrectly marked tyre with a new tyre.

bott.defect: BATTERY MAY FAIL PREMATURELY The vehicle is equipped with additional electrically operated equipment which can result in the standard vehicle battery being subjected to high consumption due to the constant charging and discharging. It is therefore possible that after a number of years the condition of the battery can deteriorate to such an extent that an internal failure could result in the battery exploding.
bott.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and replace the standard vehicle battery with heavy duty high amperage deep cycle AGM battery.

bova.defect: INTEGRITY OF REAR AXLE SECURING BOLT The rear axle securing bolts may shear.
bova.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the original bolts replaced with quality assured examples.

bova.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF ROOF HATCH The roof emergency escape hatch may vibrate loose from it's retaining catches and in very windy conditions could detach from the vehicle.
bova.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a modified pin and screw to the roof hatch mechanism and a check on the operation of the hatch operating handle. Where necessary handles will be replaced with longer versions.

bova.defect: SEIZURE OF FRONT BRAKE ADJUSTER The front brake caliper brake adjusting mechanism may seize due to the ingress of water over a period of time.
bova.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the caliper with a version incorporating improved sealing arrangements.

bova.defect: POSSIBLE OIL LEAK AND FAILURE OF GEARBOX It is possible that following a large number of retarder operations the retarder change over valve springs could fail causing damage to the valve seals which results in oil leaks from the valves. In extreme circumstances total failure of the gearbox due to lack of lubrication can occur.
bova.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and renew the retarder change over valve return springs. Issue service information advising that the springs should be renewed every 250000 kms.

bpw.defect: A faulty seal in the caliper housing can under some circumstances allow moisture to enter the caliper and cause corrosion on the internal automatic brake adjustment mechanism A faulty seal in the caliper housing can under some circumstances allow moisture to enter the caliper and cause corrosion on the internal automatic brake adjustment mechanism.�

bradshaw.defect: Goupil H&D Battery Cell On affected vehicles the batteries could experience degassing or short circuit which in rare cases could pose a risk of fire.
bradshaw.remedy: The battery will be replaced on affected vehicles.

bradshaw.defect: Goupil H&D Battery Cell On affected vehicles the batteries could experience degassing or short circuit which in rare cases could pose a risk of fire.
bradshaw.remedy: The battery will be replaced on affected vehicles.

bradshaw.defect: Goupil H&D Battery Cell On affected vehicles the batteries could experience degassing or short circuit which in rare cases could pose a risk of fire.
bradshaw.remedy: The battery will be replaced on affected vehicles.

braunability.defect: Standard lockable bar The Standard Lockable bar have 9 feet (screws) in the bar which are screwed in by a robot arm and then ‘swaged’ over in a press so that they cannot be undone. The ‘swaged’ process was not carried out correctly for some of the parts manufactured and so the screws could be undone by hand.
braunability.remedy: Install the replacement SL Lockable Seat Fixtures.

braunability.defect: Turnout 4E On affected swivel bases the safety guards which limit movement of the seat and swivel base in the event of a collision may not have been fitted.
braunability.remedy: Fit the safety guards to the affected swivel bases.

braunability.defect: Turny 6-way In the seat frame the two bolts holding the trapezoid screw in place may be missing. If the bolts are missing there is a risk that the 6-way base may unintendedly slide to its lowest possible position.
braunability.remedy: Inspect the seat frame and where identified install the missing bolts.

braunability.defect: Transfer Board The transfer board can cause wear of the occupant safety belt after some time of usage.
braunability.remedy: A protection tube for the safety belt will be issued to prevent wear.

braunability.defect: ONE GROUND CABLE IS INCORRECTLY INSTALLED One ground cable is incorrectly installed which means an under dimensioned cable is incorrectly connected to the wrong grounding point.
braunability.remedy: Repair kits have been developed which include instruction on how to replace the affected cable.

braunability.defect: Some supplied parts (Seat Feet) are made out of an incorrect aluminium alloy. Some supplied parts (Seat Feet) are made out of an incorrect aluminium alloy.
braunability.remedy: Replace the components with units to the correct specification.

brc.defect: IN A COLLISION CORRECT EMISSION OF LPG GAS MAY NOT OCCUR In a fire the LPG may not exhaust from the tank effectively. Therefore there is risk of the LPG fuel tank exploding causing further risk to occupants and any other person near the scene.
brc.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected (Europa 1) and replace the affected valve with a modified type (Europa 2).

brembo.defect: POTENTIAL DETACHMENT OF BRAKE PAD FRICTION MATERIAL FROM BACK PLATE Brake pad friction material detachment from backplate.

bri.defect: Camera Re-routing On affected vehicles the cable for the Digital Video Recorder (DVR) and camera has been routed in front of the roof mounted passenger airbag.
bri.remedy: Reroute the DVR and camera cables along the manufacturer's loom located behind the airbag unit.

bridgestone.defect: TREAD SEPARATION MAY OCCUR There is a possibility that in certain circumstances and operating conditions that tread separation and rapid tyre deflation may occur. This could result in the vehicle handling being affected.
bridgestone.remedy: Recall affected tyres and replace with quality assured type.

bridgestone.defect: TYRE BODY PLY DEGRADATION MAY OCCUR It has been identified that a number of the subject tyres have experienced a torque-induced degradation in a body ply when fitted on the rear axle of Triumph Rocket III's (MY 09/09). This can result in the tyre inner liner cracking which can result in a slow loss of the inflation medium. the condition being communicated to the rider through vibration at moderate road speeds. The condition does not affect the front tyre.
bridgestone.remedy: Recalled machines will have the rear tyre replaced. Additionally the front tyre will also be replaced due to the tyre brand matching requirements of the machine.

bridgestone.defect: Bridgestone Duravis Eco R660 16'' Tyre Recall The affected tyre is more susceptible to cuts and partial penetrations than anticipated when used in rugged and wet environments. These cuts can lead to moisture intrusion and subsequent oxidation of the tyre belt. resulting in tyre deformation and if use continues without detection may result in tread delamination. (The number of vehicles affected to which these tyres are fitted is 62216 vehicles)

TREAD SEPARATION MAY OCCUR There is a possibility that in certain circumstances and operating conditions that tread separation and rapid tyre deflation may occur. This could result in the vehicle handling being affected.
bridgestone.remedy: Recall affected tyres and replace with quality assured type.

bridgestone.defect: TREAD SEPARATION MAY OCCUR There is a possibility that in certain circumstances and operating conditions that tread separation and rapid tyre deflation may occur. This could result in the vehicle handling being affected.
bridgestone.remedy: Recall affected tyres and replace with quality assured type.

brink.defect: TOWBAR MAY DETACH The bolted joints fixing the towbar kit to the chassis of the vehicle may loosen. In an extreme situation where the vehicle continues to be driven with loose bolted joints the towbar kit may detach from the vehicle.
brink.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary rework the towbar kit.

britax.defect: SLIPPAGE OF HARNESS ADJUSTER A potential problem has been identified with the harness adjustment system on some Britax Freeway and Mothercare Rally child car seats. This could mean that the occupant is not afforded full protection in emergency stop or accident situations.
britax.remedy: The manufacturer is advising purchasers of the problem via a press announcement and by notices at retailers. All affected seats will be replaced free of charge by the manufacturer on being contacted by the purchaser.

britax.defect: SLIPPAGE OF HARNESS ADJUSTER A potential problem has been identified with the harness adjustment system on some Britax Freeway and Mothercare Rally child car seats. This could mean that the occupant is not afforded full protection in emergency stop or accident situations.
britax.remedy: The manufacturer is advising purchasers of the problem via a press announcement and by notices at retailers. All affected seats will be replaced free of charge by the manufacturer on being contacted by the purchaser.

brp.defect: Instrument Cluster Malfunction - Risk of Crash On affected vehicles depending on driver usage of USB and Bluetooth connections a communication failure or memory leak may occur within the instrument cluster. This condition can cause the cluster to temporarily reset freeze or become persistently blank. Physical telltales will continue to function properly.   An inoperative or frozen instrument cluster will fail to display critical safety information including vehicle speed and warning telltales. Additionally during a cluster reset turn signals and hazard lights will temporarily deactivate or fail to respond. These conditions reduce the driver's awareness of vehicle status and limit the ability of surrounding road users to recognize the driver’s intent increasing the risk of a crash.
brp.remedy: Install modified software via an over-the-air (OTA) update.

brp.defect: Instrument Cluster Malfunction - Risk of Crash On affected vehicles depending on driver usage of USB and Bluetooth connections a communication failure or memory leak may occur within the instrument cluster. This condition can cause the cluster to temporarily reset freeze or become persistently blank. Physical telltales will continue to function properly. buell.defect: SIDE STAND MAY NOT RETRACT Due to an incorrectly manufactured side stand pivot bolt the side stand may not move backwards when the weight of the parked machine is removed from it.

buell.defect: POSSIBLE STICKING THROTTLE The engine idle control cable may become dislodged from the fuel injection system cable guide if it is incorrectly adjusted. Should this occur the throttle may not return to the idle position when the operators hand is removed from the twist grip.
buell.remedy: Fit a throttle cable securing clamp at the fuel injection inlet manifold.

buell.defect: GEARBOX MAY SEIZE Insufficient lubrication to the fifth journal may lead to the gearbox seizing and the rear wheel locking.
buell.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to add an oil jet to the clutch shaft which will increase the lubrication to the fifth gear journal.

buell.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT WITHOUT WARNING A result of the vibration at the mounting location and the mis-routing of various wires the bank angle sensor can give a false tip signal which causes the engine to cut out. This could in certain circumstances cause an accident.
buell.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to move the bank angle sensor from the original location on the battery tray to the current production location on the seat latch.

buell.defect: FRONT BRAKE MAY BECOME INEFFECTIVE The front brake line may contact the front tyre and develop a hole allowing brake fluid leakage
buell.remedy: Recall affected machines inspect the front brake line and if undamaged install line guide. If damaged  replace and reroute using 2010 model year brake line.

buell.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK Plastic fuel filter may leak.
buell.remedy: Recall affected motorcycles and replace the plastic filter with a steel bodied type and a support bracket.

buell.defect: HANDLEBAR CONCERN Certain Buell Pro-Series Competition Handlebar Kits were manufactured with a handlebar that can break.
buell.remedy: Replace all Pro-Series Competition Handlebars with stock configuration handlebars on all affected vehicles.

buell.defect: FRONT BRAKE MAY FAIL The front flexible brake hose may contact the tyre. If this occurs the brake hose will be damaged and eventually leak fluid.
buell.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to examine and where necessary reroute or reroute and replace the front brake pipe.

buell.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER MAY BREAK. There is a possibility that the rear shock absorber may break and cause the underside of the machine to drag on the ground. This may adversely affect the handling and could cause an accident.
buell.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit shock absorber reinforcing kit.

buell.defect: NO WARNING TO RIDER IN THE EVENT OF FAILURE OF THE FLASHING INDICATORS Failure of one or more of the turn signal lamps would not be indicated to the operator of the vehicle.
buell.remedy: Replacement of turn signal flasher

buell.defect: FRONT WHEEL MAY LOCK UP The front brake rotor drive pins may move out of position and contact the front brake caliper. This could prevent the front wheel from rotating without prior warning to the rider.
buell.remedy: Affected machines are being recalled to have the original equipment drive pins replaced with quality assured versions with an alternative method of retention.

buell.defect: WINDSCREEN MAY DETACH Certain genuine Buell accessory tall windscreens part numbers 58214-06Y and 58214-06YA have been supplied with fixings that do not exhibit the required durability in use once installed; this could lead to a condition where the screen becomes detached striking or distracting the rider.
buell.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the original screen fixings.

buell.defect: WINDSHIELD MAY DETACH It has been identified that on affected machines the windscreen which is mounted with rubber nuts may become dislodged or strike the rider whilst the machine is being ridden at high speed. Should either of the foregoing occur control of the machine could be lost.
buell.remedy: Recalled machines will have the windscreen remounted using upgraded fastener assemblies.

buell.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the original side stand and bolt assembly with redesigned components.

cadillac.defect: L87 Engine Loss of Propulsion The connecting rod and/or crankshaft engine components in these vehicles may have manufacturing defects that can lead to engine damage and engine failure. If the engine fails while driving the vehicle will lose propulsion increasing the risk of a crash.
cadillac.remedy: Dealers will inspect the engine. If the vehicle fails the inspection procedure the engine will be repaired or replaced. Vehicles that pass inspection will be provided a higher viscosity oil which will also require a new oil fill cap identifying the new required oil grade an oil filter replacement and an owner’s manual insert free of charge.

cadillac.defect: VEHICLE IGNITION MAY INADVERTENTLY TURN OFF It has been identified that if the key ring carries additional weight and the vehicle experiences any extreme road conditions for instance off road or harsh events then the keys can rotate away from the run position on the ignition switch. This will result in the loss of engine power and associated function. Also the air bags will not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
cadillac.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to modify the ignition keys.

cadillac.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and check whether the wiper module is of an at risk type. Should an at risk module be identified it will be removed from the vehicle and inspected for evidence of moisture ingress. Should any sign of moisture ingress be found the module will be replaced. If no evidence of moister ingress is found a breathable seal will be installed over the vent in the wiper motor cover.

cadillac.defect: POSSIBILITY OF BRAKE FAILURE It has been identified that some vehicles may have insufficient clearance between one or both of the rear brake pipes and the intermediate steering shaft. Should either of the pipes touch the shaft a hole could be worn in the pipe causing brake fluid to leak out. If sufficient brake fluid leaks from the system the brake warning light will illuminate and braking would be limited to two wheels. Once sufficient brake fluid has leaked out of the second pipe; brake failure would occur.
cadillac.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a section of the subject pipe replaced with one that has been redesigned to allow sufficient clearance between the brake pipe and the intermediate steering shaft.

cadillac.defect: POWER STEERING HOSE MAY FRACTURE AND LEAK FLUID. The power steering hose is not manufactured to specification.  Under extreme steering manoeuvres the hose may fracture and leak fluid.  If this were to occur power steering assistance would be lost and vehicles fitted with Hydro-boos power brakes would loss power brake assistance.  In addition if the fluid were to spray onto a hot surface this could result in an engine bay fire.
cadillac.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace hose with a quality assured item.

cadillac.defect: VEHICLE IGNITION MAY INADVERTENTLY TURN OFF It has been identified that if the key ring carries additional weight and the vehicle experiences any extreme road conditions for instance off road or harsh events then the keys can rotate away from the run position on the ignition switch. This will result in the loss of engine power and associated function. Also the air bags will not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
cadillac.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to modify the ignition keys.

cadillac.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ECL WILL NOT PERFORM NORMALLY The vehicle uses an Electronic Column Lock (ECL) to prevent the steering wheel being turned when the ignition key is removed.  It has been identified that the following two conditions could prevent the correct operation of the steering lock.  1.If the Power-train Control module suffers low voltage or an interruption whilst the engine is being cranked the vehicle can be driven with the steering locked.  2. During quick cranking the ECL lock pins may not fully withdraw which will result in either a noise or rattle or if there is insufficient clearance the steering wheel will not turn. If one of these conditions occurs directional control will be affected.
cadillac.remedy: Recall and rework affected vehicles

cadillac.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the roof panel.

cadillac.defect: THE FUEL COMMON RAIL CONSTRUCTION MAY DEGRADE AND CRACK The material of the fuel system common rail may degrade and crack with the result that fuel can leak into the engine bay. A situation which if a source of ignition were present could result in a fire.
cadillac.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled for inspection of the relevant component which will be replaced by a stainless steel item should this be necessary.

cadillac.defect: STEERING MAY LOCK On identified models it has been established that under certain conditions the steering locking mechanism may operate whilst the vehicle is being driven.
cadillac.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the control module reprogrammed and checks made to ensure adequate lock plate clearance. If necessary the lock plate will be replaced.

cadillac.defect: POSSIBLITY THAT THE  BRAKE PIPES MAY BE AFFECTED BY HEAT Some of the metal brake pipes are placed so that they could be affected by heat or they could be in a position where chafing could take place. If the above circumstances occur they could lead to in extreme circumstances and over a period of time either loss of brake fluid or air in the braking system. These conditions will lead to a reduction in the performance of the rear brakes.
cadillac.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected for inspection. If neccessary re-route replace the  brake pipes. On some vehicles a machining tab on the rear differential may need to be removed to allow adequate clearance for the metal brake pipes.

cadillac.defect: IF THE VOLTAGE IS LOW THE FUEL SHUT OFF MAY NOT OCCUR The possibility exists that an interruption of or low voltage supply to the power train module may allow the vehicle to be accelerated with the steering column lock still engaged. Additionally the column lock may under certain circumstances remain locked when the ignition key is in the on position thus preventing the steering wheel from being turned.
cadillac.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the PCM will be reprogrammed. At the same time the steering lock will be checked for correct tolerance and replaced if necessary.

cadillac.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE STEERING WHEEL CAN LOCK WHILST THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION Two scenarios have been identified which may result in the steering column electronic lock (ECL) engaging whilst the vehicle is in motion. (1) The design is such that when the engine is started if the steering column fails to unlock the fuel supply will be shut off if the driver attempts to move the vehicle.However if the voltage at the powertrain control model is low or interrupted fuel shut off may not occur and in consequence the vehicle can be accelerated whilst the steering is locked.(2) During engine cranking the ECL locking pin may not withdraw fully which can result in contact between the lock pin and the locking plate. This can cause noise or ratcheting when the steering is turned. Should the clearance be insufficient the possibility exists that the steering cannot be turned.
cadillac.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the electronic control unit re-programmed and lock mechanism inspected to ascertain whether there is adequate lock plate clearance. Should this not be the case the lock plate will be replaced.

cadillac.defect: OIL MAY LEAK FROM DRIVE AXLE The drive axle/s pinion seal may leak. This will initially lead to oil leaking onto the road noise and transmission drag which if not attended to will damage final drive components and in the worst case the drive axle/s could lock up and control of the vehicle could be lost.
cadillac.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the pinion seal/s

calne.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT AXLE MAY BECOME DETACHED There is a possibility that the suspension unit/axle may become detached from its mounting as a result of failure of the weld joints.
