caterham.defect: THROTTLE PEDAL MAY DETACH There is a small possibility that the throttle pedal securing bolt may work loose. This can only occur if as a minimum the securing bolt is not tightened sufficiently to completely flatten the spring washer. The bolt may work free during pedal operation. This will result in the throttle pedal coming free from its chassis anchor point causing an inability to operate the throttle pedal and an immediate reduction in engine speed.
caterham.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check that the throttle pedal Cable Post is not in contact with the head of the throttle pedal securing bolt ensure that the bolt is tightened to 25Nm and that the throttle pedal is free to operate to the full extent of its travel in both directions.

caterham.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL The steering column universal joint may fail which will lead to the loss of directional control.
caterham.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit quality assured components.

caterham.defect: POSSIBLE REAR HUB AND BRAKE CALIPER DETACHMENT It has been identified that a due to the failure of a mounting bolt/s a rear hub and brake caliper could detach.
caterham.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts replaced with ones which have been quality assured.

caterham.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF STEERING Incorrect steering rack mounting bolts may have been fitted. As a result one or more of the heads on the 4 steering rack securing bolts may fracture due to embrittlement. This may present itself to the owner visually by missing bolt head/s and/or bolts from the steering rack securing brackets. This may lead to reduced steering control and ultimately loss of steering if all bolts were to fracture.
caterham.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replacement all 4 steering rack securing bolts and associated Nyloc nuts and washers.

chassis.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and reposition the mounting points for the brake hose.

chevrolet.defect: L87 Engine Loss of Propulsion The connecting rod and/or crankshaft engine components in these vehicles may have manufacturing defects that can lead to engine damage and engine failure. If the engine fails while driving the vehicle will lose propulsion increasing the risk of a crash.
chevrolet.remedy: Dealers will inspect the engine. If the vehicle fails the inspection procedure the engine will be repaired or replaced. Vehicles that pass inspection will be provided a higher viscosity oil which will also require a new oil fill cap identifying the new required oil grade an oil filter replacement and an owner’s manual insert free of charge.

chevrolet.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE In order for proper regeneration of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) system the vehicle in the active regeneration mode directs the driver by illuminating the DPF warning light to drive the vehicle at constant speed without interruption until the DPF warning light turns off. In the event that the driver ignores the DPF warning light and the corresponding direction the DPF system as well as exhaust pipe will be abnormally overheated. This may cause a fire at the Lower Engine Compartment Cover located near the DPF system and exhaust pipe.
chevrolet.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and initially remove and discard the Lower Engine Compartment Cover. When parts are available the vehicles will be recalled to have the new Lower Engine Compartment Cover fitted.

chevrolet.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED Incorrect type of brake fluid installed at production could cause internal corrosion of the ABS module. This corrosion can lead to a gel build up inside the module which may affect the closing motion of one of the valves. There will be no external loss of fluid or reduction in fluid level but it is possible the driver could feel excessive brake pedal travel. In some circumstances there may be reduced braking performance.
chevrolet.remedy: Inspection of the brake fluid using a scan tool. Drain and replace the fluid and replace the brake fluid reservoir cap  (All models except Captiva & Epica/Tosca). Erase ''DOT 3'' text from the customers Owner's Manual (All models except Captiva & Epica/Tosca). Add  information regarding the use of DOT 4 brake fluid.

chevrolet.defect: Chevrolet UK Spark Hood Striker Replacement On affected vehicles the secondary hood latch lever may prematurely corrode at the pivot. If severely corroded the secondary latch striker may become stuck out of position and fail to properly engage.

chrysler.defect: THE ENGINE TONE WHEEL  WHICH PROVIDES A SIGNAL TO THE CRANKSHAFT POSITION SENSOR MAY FAIL The engine tone wheel which provides a signal to the crankshaft position sensor may fail.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the engine tone wheel.

chrysler.defect: SUSPENSION COIL SPRINGS MAY BREAK Under environmental conditions that require the intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits may infiltrate the rubber plate which supports the front suspension springs initiating seats of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
chrysler.remedy: To avoid damage to a tyre in the event of spring breakage a plate will be fitted which will contain the spring.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

chrysler.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT SELF LEVEL CORRECTLY It has been established that the Totally Integrated Power Module (TIPM) may be configured incorrectly thus preventing the headlamp levelling system from operating correctly.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the TIPM re-configured.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK AND RISK OF FIRE Due to the incorrect profiling of a rigid fuel pipe at the quick fit connection with the flexible fuel pipe for the injection manifold. The possibility exists that a fuel leak may develop at the connector and result in a fire in the engine compartment.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a locking insert fitted within the quick fit connector in order to prevent the connector from becoming loose.

chrysler.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The  fuel return pipe on 2.0 16v JTD engine variants may interfere with the engine mounting and/or fuel filter.
chrysler.remedy: Check and re-route the pipe and fit a protective sheath.

chrysler.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

chrysler.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY IN PRODUCTION THE SIDE MARKER LIGHTS ARE NOT FUNCTIONING Due to a nonconformity in production the side marker lights are not functioning.
chrysler.remedy: The proxy file of the vehicle must be updated to allow the marker lights to function as intended.

chrysler.defect: Passenger airbag inflator Passenger air bag may deploy incorrectly if activated.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the passenger air bag inflator.

chrysler.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The fuel return pipe may contact the engine sound insulation cover. This may cause a deterioration of the pipe and if not rectified a leak of fuel.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a holding fastener to the fuel return pipe.

chrysler.defect: REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE POINT NOT CONFORMING The rear seat belt anchorage points do not conform to specification which could in the event of a collision result in the insecurity of the seat belt.
chrysler.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and upgrade the seat belt anchorage to the correct specification by the fitment of an additional bracket.

chrysler.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It may be possible for the handbrake cable to foul the rigid brake pipe at the right hand rear suspension arm. In time this could lead to wear of the rigid brake pipe and as a consequence there maybe a loss of brake fluid and longer stopping distances.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the routing of the handbrake cable and fit rubber pads to the rigid brake pipe to prevent fouling.

chrysler.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It is possible that the wiring for the power Sliding Door can on the hinge mechanism during operation. This result in the latch mechanism overheating and lead to a possible fire or personal injury.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the wiring to be checked repaired or replaced as necessary.

chrysler.defect: UNINTENDED  ACTIVATION OF SIDE WINDOW AIRBAGS It is possible for the side window air bags to deploy unintentionally.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the air bag central control unit.

chrysler.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

chrysler.defect: THE HANDBRAKE CABLE CONNECTOR ON THE REAR BRAKE  CALLIPER MAY BREAK The handbrake cable connector on the rear brake calliper may break
chrysler.remedy: Check the rear brake calliper conformity and replace if necessary

chrysler.defect: NON-CONFORMITY IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE Non-conformity in the airbag control module software
chrysler.remedy: Update the airbag control module software

chrysler.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE There is a possibility of a short circuit in the ABS control unit due to infiltration of chemical solutions.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace ABS module with modified type which is also fitted with plastic cover

chrysler.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

chrysler.defect: On affected vehicles diesel fuel leaks may possibly occur due to the vehicle being fitted with a fuel return pipe without protective tape.  This could cause a potential deformation of the fuel return pipe and in extreme cases could lead to fuel leaks and the risk of fire in the engine compartment. On affected vehicles diesel fuel leaks may possibly occur due to the vehicle being fitted with a fuel return pipe without protective tape.  This could cause a potential deformation of the fuel return pipe and in extreme cases could lead to fuel leaks and the risk of fire in the engine compartment.
chrysler.remedy: The application of protective tape around the fuel return pipe.

chrysler.defect: REPLACE ELECTRICAL POWER STEERING Due to a non-conformity in the production process the electrical power steering (EPS) must be replaced. This will prevent a potential loss of steering assistance. Loss of EPS functionality could increase the risk of a collision occurring.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the Electrical Power Steering unit

chrysler.defect: SEAT MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED DURING A COLLISION The seat may not remain in position when subjected to greater than normal driving forces such as those involved in an impact. This may possibly cause injury to the driver/passenger seated in the right hand front seat. The right hand front seat guides may not conform to design specification and installation specifications.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the installation of the original seat guide. If it does not conform replace the seat cushion structure (guide).

chrysler.defect: THE FRONT SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN IMPROPERLY FORMED WAVE DISC The front seat belt retractor may have been built with an improperly formed wave disc.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the front seat belt retractor.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE STABILITY MAYBE AFFECTED It has been established that the anti-roll bar may not conform to specification.  This should result in a noise from the suspension but in extreme cases vehicle stability could be compromised.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace anti-roll bar with quality assured one.

chrysler.defect: STEERING COULD BECOME INCREASINGLY STIFF. It has been identified that; due to a possible lack of lubricant between the steering rack and pinion the steering may become increasingly stiff to operate. This can eventually lead to damage to the steering rack teeth. As a consequence the steering operation of the vehicle may become increasingly difficult.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering rack inspected for damage. If no damage is evident the rack and pinion will be lubricated. Should any damage be in evidence the steering rack will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: EXHAUST EMISSIONS MAY BE INCORRECT It has been identified that a number of vehicles may have a faulty absolute emissions sensor.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the manifold absolute pressure sensor replaced.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF OFFSIDE FRONT BRAKE PIPE Offside front brake hose may chafe
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and fit new pipe if necessary

chrysler.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED Incorrect profile (flaring) of the end of the steering shaft at the upper steering column universal joint. This may give the possibility of the steering column becoming disconnected from the universal joint with a consequent loss of vehicle steering.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the profile and flaring of the end of the steering shaft at the upper universal joint and where necessary renew the shaft.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE COMPARTMENT FUEL LEAK CONCERN After extended use the fuel rail crossover tube O rings may leak fuel.  This may lead to an engine compartment fire.
chrysler.remedy: Fit external seals at the fuel crossover points.  If the joints are leaking or show signs of rust the fuel rail assembly will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE MAY STALL The clutch pedal push rod may break causing the clutch function to be lost.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the clutch pedal push rod plastic spacer foam seal and interlock switch cover.

chrysler.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the tightening torque of the steering shaft upper fixing bolt may not be correct. This may result in the emission of noise and in extreme cases breakage of the shaft which will result in loss of steering control.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolt checked for correct torque which if necessary will be set to the correct specification. If the torque is outside of the rework stipulated range the shaft will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

chrysler.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration.
chrysler.remedy: The repair is a check of the PBU valve code and replacement of the 48-volt battery if necessary.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT It has been identified that the engine injector coil protection fuse on the 1.2 engines may not be to the correct rating.  Should the fuse fail it can cause the engine to cut out whilst the vehicle is in motion.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the correct rated fuse to be fitted.

chrysler.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY IN PRODUCTION THE SWIVEL PLATES ON WHICH THE TWO FRONT SEATS ARE ANCHORED MUST BE REPLACED Due to a nonconformity in production the swivel plates on which the two front seats are anchored must be�replaced.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the swivel plates onto which the front seats are anchored.

chrysler.defect: THE FRONT SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN IMPROPERLY FORMED WAVE DISC The front seat belt retractor may have been built with an improperly formed wave disc.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the front seat belt retractor.

chrysler.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNITENTIONALLY On vehicles fitted with comfort instrument panel when the passenger's airbag has been deactivated it is possible in some cases that it will reactivate spontaneously.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

chrysler.defect: BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE MAY BE REDUCED It has been identified that due to the inlet filter for the exhaust gas recirculating valve (EGR) being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This can give rise to the possibility of ice forming within the pipe during periods of low ambient temperature with the possibility of reduced brake servo assistance.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR valve solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If this is not the case new solenoids with separate filters will be fitted.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary

chrysler.defect: FUEL TANK MOUNTINGS Fuel tank rear mountings may not inadequately secure the tank with a risk of possible disengagement.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcement plates to rear tank mountings.

chrysler.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

chrysler.defect: REAR BRAKE PIPES COULD FAIL RESULTING IN A PARTIAL BRAKE SYSTEM LOSS. It has been identified that there may be insufficient clearance between the steering shaft and the rear brake pipes. Prolonged contact may result in the pipe becoming holed resulting in a partial loss of the braking system.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake pipes inspected and replaced if necessary. In every case an additional retaining clip will be installed.

chrysler.defect: The calibration for urea pump diagnostics in the ECU (Engine Control Unit) is not fulfilling regulation requirement The calibration for urea pump diagnostics in the ECU (Engine Control Unit) is not fulfilling the regulation requirement.
chrysler.remedy: Update to the ECU (engine control unit) calibration software.

chrysler.defect: Driver airbag inflator In the event that the airbag is activated excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing  injury to the vehicle occupants and / or in worst cases a fatality. The concern is caused by moisture in the air getting past faulty seals and being absorbed by the pyrotechnic biscuits in the inflator. As a result it is more likely to occur sooner in areas of high humidity and high temperature difference.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger front air bag  module which includes the inflator.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING There is a possibility that the weld on the steering shaft at the lower universal joint fitting maybe absent.  If there is an absent of the weld at the joint this may lead to a loss of steering.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and inspect steering shaft to ensure weld is present if not renew steering shaft.

chrysler.defect: FIRST GEAR COULD BE ENGAGED WHILST THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION AND THE SHIFT LEVER IN THE D POSITION First gear could be engaged with the vehicle in motion and the shift lever in the D position.
chrysler.remedy: Update the transmission control module software

chrysler.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF BRAKE PIPES. Possible chafing of front rigid brake pipes at near side front against the plastic wheel arch liner or against the gearbox mounting. Also at the off side front against the engine timing belt cover.
chrysler.remedy: Reposition any chafing brake pipe to comply with the manufacturer's prescribed clearance between adjacent parts. Renew any brake pipe that has been chafed beyond a serviceable condition.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE COULD SHUT OFF UNINTENTIONALLY The ignition module may unintentionally move  the key FOB to the  accessory position whilst the vehicle is moving and shut off the engine.
chrysler.remedy: On affected vehicles replace ignition module and key FOBs.

chrysler.defect: HEATER/CLIMATE CONTROL WIRING ABRASION MAY RESULT IN  A SHORT CIRCUIT. It has been identified that the possibility exists of interference between the heater/climate control wiring and a dashboard bracket due to a missing retainer clip. In this condition abrasion of the wiring may occur with the attendant risk of an electrical short circuit
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for damage to the subject wiring which if this has occurred will be repaired and repositioned. In all cases a new clip will be fitted.

chrysler.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel delivery pipe adjacent to air filter may chafe. This in time could lead to leakage of fuel in the engine compartment and a consequent risk of fire.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel delivery pipe and where necessary replace the pipe containment channel.

chrysler.defect: INCORRECT SPARE WHEEL Some vehicles with alloy wheels may have been supplied with an unsuitable space saver spare wheel. If fitted this spare wheel could cause interference with braking system components.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace any unsuitable spare wheels with correctly specified versions.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE COULD SHUT OFF UNINTENTIONALLY The ignition module may unintentionally move  the key FOB to the  accessory position whilst the vehicle is moving and shut off the engine.
chrysler.remedy: On affected vehicles replace ignition module and key FOBs.

chrysler.defect: MANUFACTURERS PLATE INFORMATION INCORRECT The manufacturer's plate information may refer to vehicles with a capacity of 8 hundred weight rather than 7 hundred weight.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the manufacturer's plate with one that is correct to the vehicle.

chrysler.defect: U-BOLTS ON REAR AXLE MAY BREAK The U bolts securing the leaf spring to the rear axle may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This may result in the U bolts breaking.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the U bolts checked to ensure there is no damage and that they have been tightened to the correct torque.

chrysler.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK There is a possibility that fuel may leak from a faulty recirculation pipe connector.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if required change pipe.

chrysler.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM MOUNTINGS - FAILURE OF WELD There is a possibility that corrosion may be present near the welds for the front suspension arm front mountings on the front cross member.Should this be the case in time this could lead to noise whilst driving and the possibility that the weld could fail. Failure of the weld may lead to loss of vehicle stability.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicle will be checked to ascertain whether corrosion is present near the front suspension mountings. If this is found to be the case the front cross member will be replaced. If corrosion is not present a front cross member strengthening kit will be fitted.

chrysler.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNITENTIONALLY On vehicles fitted with comfort instrument panel when the passenger's airbag has been deactivated it is possible in some cases that it will reactivate spontaneously.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED The left front brake caliper housing may have been cast from an incorrect material.  Under extreme brake application the left front brake caliper housing may rupture and affect braking efficiency.
chrysler.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace caliper

chrysler.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK After repeated activation of the fuel heater cover in cold conditions an electric connector  the fuel heater cover  may overheat. This may allow air ingress which could cause difficulty starting the engine or engine stalling. In extreme cases fuel may leak onto the road surface.
chrysler.remedy: Check the condition of the heated diesel filter cover and  connector. If deteriorated or damaged replace the cover or connector.

chrysler.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT SELF LEVEL CORRECTLY It has been established that the Totally Integrated Power Module (TIPM) may be configured incorrectly thus preventing the headlamp levelling system from operating correctly.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the TIPM re-configured.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that the brake pads fitted to the front and rear of the vehicle during production do not comply with ECE 13 Regulation.  In extreme cases this may affect the braking performance of the vehicle.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the brake pads.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE SAFETY FEATURES The Wireless Ignition Node (WIN) module may stick between the �START� and �RUN� position.  This could cause  an unintended change in ignition position to the �OFF� or �ACCESSORY� position due to spring back.  This may cause may result in the loss of certain electrical features and/or a loss of engine power power steering assist and/or power brake booster assist.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the WIN module and Frequency Operated Button Ignition Key (FOBIK�s).

chrysler.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration.
chrysler.remedy: The repair is a check of the PBU valve code and replacement of the 48-volt battery if necessary.

chrysler.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the handbrake may fail.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the handbrake assembly replaced.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The Totally Integrated Power Module (TIPM) contains an internal fuel pump relay that could on affected vehicles operate intermittently or fail without warning.  An intermittent or failed fuel pump relay could cause the engine to stall  without warning.
chrysler.remedy: Disable the TIPM internal fuel pump relay and fit an external relay.

chrysler.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INADVERTENTLY The Heating Ventilation and Air-Conditioning (HVAC)  drain tube and grommet may leak water onto the passenger compartment carpeting and/or the Occupant Restraint Control (OCR) module.  This can lead to the illumination of the airbag warning lamp and the potential for an inadvertent airbag deployment without warning.
chrysler.remedy: The HVAC drain tube and grommet must be replaced.

chrysler.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

chrysler.defect: CORROSION OF METAL BRAKE PIPES Prolonged exposure to the effects of road salt corrosion may result in perforation of the metal brake pipes and a consequential loss of braking efficiency.
chrysler.remedy: Replace corroded brake pipes and apply corrosion prevention treatment to all brake pipes.

chrysler.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION CROSS MEMBER MAY FRACTURE It has been identified that the chassis front cross member may have a weld which does not conform to specification. This may lead to a creaking noise being heard under braking and could in time lead to the cross member cracking in the area of it's mounting to the vehicle's body.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front cross member replaced.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.

chrysler.defect: The positive lead on the auxiliary battery terminal may not be tightened correctly. The positive lead on the auxiliary battery terminal may not be tightened correctly
chrysler.remedy: The integrity of the positive lead terminal must be checked and if it is damaged it must be replaced. If it is not damaged the correct torque must be applied to the nut to ensure correct tightening.

chrysler.defect: A HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS CONNECTOR MIGHT NOT BE TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION A High Voltage Harness connector might not be to the correct specification
chrysler.remedy: Check the connector and if required replace the harness.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

chrysler.defect: SIDE AIRBAG WIRING INCORRECTLY CONNECTED The Occupant Restraint Controller (ORC) side airbag wires were installed in the incorrect connector which results in the opposite side airbag deploying under certain crash conditions
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and relocate wires in the correct ORC connector

chrysler.defect: THE REAR RIGHT BRAKE CALLIPER COULD DISPLAY MICRO CRACKS The rear right brake calliper could display micro-cracks
chrysler.remedy: The production date must be checked and if necessary the brake calliper must be replaced

chrysler.defect: TRANSMISSION MOUNT MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a nonconformity in the transmission casing mount material there is a possibility that the casting may fail.  This may affect the control of the vehicle.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the mounting with new quality assured item.

chrysler.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT SELF LEVEL CORRECTLY It has been established that the Totally Integrated Power Module (TIPM) may be configured incorrectly thus preventing the headlamp levelling system from operating correctly.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the TIPM re-configured.

chrysler.defect: SEAT BELT PRE TENSIONERS MAY FAIL TO ACTIVATE On some Punto vehicles it has been found that the seat belt pre-tensioners may fail to activate although normal activation of the seat belt is assured.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to shorten the safety tabs in the inertia reel.

chrysler.defect: RISK OF REAR BRAKE LOCK UP It has been identified that on subject vehicles the rear brake back plate retaining bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification. Should the bolts work loose this can result in noise illumination of the ABS warning light and in extreme cases wheel lock.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked and tightened to the correct specification.

chrysler.defect: PARK BRAKE MAY NOT BE EFFECTIVE It has been identified that the parking brake lever clutch drum may distort and reduce the effectiveness of the parking brake. This could result in the vehicle moving inadvertently when parked.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the parking brake lever assembly replaced.

chrysler.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL In some circumstances the headlights can switch off without warning which will increase the risk of an accident.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the Body Computer with new improved software.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that an unused tyre pressure monitoring system electrical connector may become corroded and short circuit. This can lead to a variety of conditions including dead battery inoperative cruise control and engine non- start or stall
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have all unused tyre monitoring system electrical connections removed and the wiring sealed with heat shrink.

chrysler.defect: REAR CROSS MEMBER WELDING  MAY CRACK It has been identified that the possibility exists that a non conforming weld may be present on the vehicle's rear cross member with the fixing bracket for the wheel axle hub. This non conformity in time; could cause the weld to break and crack the rear cross member which could have an adverse effect on the vehicle's stability.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject cross member identification numbers and weld markings checked; to ascertain whether they conform. Should this not be the case the cross member will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: INCORRECTLY POSITIONED FUEL PIPE Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
chrysler.remedy: : Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

chrysler.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

chrysler.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT SELF LEVEL CORRECTLY It has been established that the Totally Integrated Power Module (TIPM) may be configured incorrectly thus preventing the headlamp levelling system from operating correctly.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the TIPM re-configured.

chrysler.defect: UNINTENDED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG Possible water ingress into the electronic control unit (ECU) could result in unintentional deployment of the drivers air bag and passengers air bag where fitted.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for water ingress into the ECU and replace if necessary. Fit water protection to the ECU in all cases.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAYBE AFFECTED Vehicles fitted with rear brake drums may suffer contamination of the brake lining.   This is due to the entry of water and detritus into the drum through the back plate.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a gasket to the back plate where the handbrake cable enters the brake drum through the back plate.

chrysler.defect: REAR BRAKES MAY LOCK The ABS control unit may be programmed incorrectly. This may lead to the rear brakes locking up during certain braking conditions.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect to re-programme the ABS control module.

chrysler.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY FRACTURE There is a possibility that the brake pedal is of incorrect specification and could eventually fracture.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace brake pedal with quality assured type.

chrysler.defect: The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect (4835 kg instead of 4955 kg). The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect.
chrysler.remedy: The CoC and registration documents must be replaced to reflect the correct data.

chrysler.defect: SOUND DEADENING GUARD MAY BECOME DETACHED It is possible for the fastenings of the sound deadening guard to become loose. Consequently the guard could become detached whilst the vehicle is in motion.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace all the fastenings with new captive fasteners and bolts.

chrysler.defect: PARK BRAKE MAY NOT BE EFFECTIVE It has been identified that the parking brake lever clutch drum may distort and reduce the effectiveness of the parking brake. This could result in the vehicle moving inadvertently when parked.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the parking brake lever assembly replaced.

chrysler.defect: THE EVAPORATIVE EMISSIONS CANISTER MAY BE UNABLE TO ABSORB THE NECESSARY AMOUNT OF FUEL VAPOUR DURING VEHICLE REFUELLING The Evaporative Emissions Canister may be unable to absorb the necessary amount of fuel vapour during vehicle refuelling.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the Evaporative Emissions Canister.

chrysler.defect: Certain kinds of vehicle acceleration could cause the speed limiter to turn off. Certain kinds of vehicle acceleration could cause the speed limiter to turn off.
chrysler.remedy: Update the software of engine control module.

chrysler.defect: FUEL VAPOUR RE- CIRCULATION PIPE MAY BECOME DAMAGED The fuel vapour re-circulation pipe could foul against the air-conditioning compressor pulley resulting in possible damage to the pipe and the risk of fire.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and reposition re-circulation pipe away from compressor pulley.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Scudo Rear suspension springs Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
chrysler.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

chrysler.defect: Engine Control Module calibration Low In-Use Performance-Ratio On affected vehicles there is a requirement to update the Engine Control Module (ECM) calibration due to a production non-conformity and not fulfilling emission regulatory requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Update the ECM software calibration

chrysler.defect: Fiat Scudo. Multifunction screen fixings. On affected vehicles the radio display screen may be incorrectly secured.
chrysler.remedy: Check the fixing of the screen and add any missing fixings.

chrysler.defect: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended. On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
chrysler.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

chrysler.defect: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended. On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
chrysler.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

chrysler.defect: Fiat Ducato 2024. Proxy update. Vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements Affected vehicles may have the urea system management menu missing from the instrument panel. This may result in warning messages not being displayed on the instrument panel cluster depending on the urea level. In this condition the vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Check and if necessary install modified software.

chrysler.defect: Ground connections On affected vehicles there could be a loss of certain ground connections for some electrical harnesses which may result in the loss of several vehicle functions.
chrysler.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

chrysler.defect: Fiat 500 BEV Panda and Tipo. Instrument panel cluster software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case. If the customer seeks to reactivate the AEB after previously deactivating it during the same driving cycle (key on/off) it will remain deactivated however the icon on the cluster to alert about deactivation remains off. This does not meet regulatory requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Update front camera software.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Professional Ducato. Instrument panel cluster software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case. If the customer seeks to reactivate the AEB after previously deactivating it during the same driving cycle (key on/off) it will remain deactivated however the icon on the cluster to alert about deactivation remains off. This does not meet regulatory requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Update front camera software.

chrysler.defect: SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) Diagnosis issues Affected vehicles may have been equipped with Engine Control Unit (ECU) software not fulfilling regulation requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Update to the ECU software.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY The cup plug on the automatic transmission parking pawl may be incorrectly installed. Thus even when park is selected it may be possible that the vehicle could roll away.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a bracket fitted to the transmission cup plug.

chrysler.defect: TYRE VALVE MAY BREAK  CAUSING RAPID DEFLATION (STEEL WHEELS) It has been identified that due to manufacture from an incorrect material the tyre inflation valve may break. Should this occur rapid deflation of the tyre and possible vehicle instability would occur.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the tyre inflation valve replaced on all steel wheels including the spare.

chrysler.defect: REAR AXLE MAY MOVE It is possible the rear axle leaf spring retaining bolts were not tightened to the correct specification during production.  This could allow movement between the axle and leaf spring. In extreme circumstances this could cause the vehicle to lose control.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the U bolts with new items and tighten them to the correct specification.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LEAKAGE FROM FUEL TANK DUE TO CORROSION Possibility of fuel leakage from the fuel tank due to corrosion
chrysler.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled during which time the fuel tank will be inspected for corrosion. Should corrosion be found the fuel tank will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

chrysler.defect: FRONT AIRBAG AND/OR SEATBELT PRE-TENSIONER MAY DEPLOY UNEXPECTEDLY The airbag system Occupant Restraint Control (ORC) module may experience a front airbag and/or seatbelt pre-tensioner inadvertent deployment. An inadvertent deployment while driving could distract the driver and cause a crash without warning.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ORC module. Note: Vehicles that had Safety Recall (manufacturer�s ref.M35 � DVSA ref. R/2013/120) - Occupant Restraint Control Module Filter Circuit completed must also have the ORC module filter circuit removed.  Due to issues with parts supply the recall of  WG/WJ models is suspended however KJ models remain unaffected

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.

chrysler.defect: THE DRIVE SHAFT MAY FAIL DUE TO A NON-CONFORMITY IN THE MATERIAL The drive shaft joints may fail
chrysler.remedy: Replace the drive shaft or shafts as required

chrysler.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED Brake pipes at the brake master cylinder may not be to specification and start leaking. A brake fluid leak can increase the vehicle's stopping distance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the brake pipes.

chrysler.defect: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM OF THE STEERING COLUMN The steering column height adjustment mechanism could accidentally release.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the steering column mechanism.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL The tyres fitted to affected vehicles are incompatible with the weight capacity of the vehicle. This may cause a tyre failure due to incorrect loading of the vehicle.
chrysler.remedy: Replace existing tyres with those of a load index compatible with the vehicle's weight capacity.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The cooling fan blades may fracture and separate from the fan which will in certain circumstances allow the engine to overheat.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fan assembly.

chrysler.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK LEADING IN EXTREME CASES TO FIRE The fuel pump protection bracket is not to conformity and in the event of an accident the fuel feed pipe could be damaged leading to an increased risk of fuel leakage and possible fire.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel pump feed protection bracket and reposition the fuel feed pipe.

chrysler.defect: DROPSIDE PANEL MAY DETACH It has been identified that the possibility exists that breakage of the dropside hinge fastening plate may occur on vehicles fitted with a factory installed dropside body. This can result in the detachment of the dropside panel.
chrysler.remedy: Subject vehicles will be recalled at which time the hinge fastening plates will be changed.

chrysler.defect: POTENTIAL RISK OF ACCESS STEP DETACHING FROM VEHICLE BODY Potential risk of access step detachment from the vehicle body.
chrysler.remedy: Replacement of the access step fasteners.

chrysler.defect: AIRBAG MAY MALFUNCTION It has been identified that due to corrosion there maybe a malfunction of the power supply within the Occupant Restraint Control (ORC) module. This could result in either an illuminated airbag warning lamp with the possibility of no airbag deployment in a crash necessitating airbag deployment or an inadvertent airbag deployment without an illuminated airbag warning lamp. Either of these conditions could increase the risk of a crash or injury.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle to replace the Occupant Restraint Control module.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE SAFETY FEATURES The Wireless Ignition Node (WIN) module may stick between the �START� and �RUN� position.  This could cause  an unintended change in ignition position to the �OFF� or �ACCESSORY� position due to spring back.  This may cause may result in the loss of certain electrical features and/or a loss of engine power power steering assist and/or power brake booster assist.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the WIN module and Frequency Operated Button Ignition Key (FOBIK�s).

chrysler.defect: HAND BRAKE MAY FAIL The self-adjusting mechanism may become out of range or fail to engage. Either condition could lead to the vehicle rolling away.
chrysler.remedy: Identify type of handbrake cable fitted and install short cable if not already installed. In all cases install lockout clip to the self adjust mechanism.

chrysler.defect: Incorrect information displayed on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
chrysler.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

chrysler.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the possibility exists that a disconnection of the handbrake cable may occur which can result in the handbrake becoming inefficient.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fitment of the handbrake cable to the actuating lever checked. If found to be incorrect the situation  will be rectified. If the handbrake cable is found to be damaged it will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: AIRBAG MAY MALFUNCTION It has been identified that due to corrosion there maybe a malfunction of the power supply within the Occupant Restraint Control (ORC) module. This could result in either an illuminated airbag warning lamp with the possibility of no airbag deployment in a crash necessitating airbag deployment or an inadvertent airbag deployment without an illuminated airbag warning lamp. Either of these conditions could increase the risk of a crash or injury.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle to replace the Occupant Restraint Control module.

chrysler.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

chrysler.defect: SEAT BELT MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE The D pillar sound barrier patches may loosen and drop onto the rear seat belt which may lead to the seat belt assembly becoming inoperative.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicle and fit new version of foam pads to D pillar and inspect and replace any sticking or inoperative seat belts.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF CONTROL The rear suspension control arms may corrode which in time can cause the arms to fail with the subsequence loss of control.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the rear suspension control arms.

chrysler.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The passenger airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. This could result in an increased chance of occupant injury during certain crash conditions.
chrysler.remedy: Replace air bag inflator on affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY The brake vacuum pump may not function correctly.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the brake vacuum pump of affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION On vehicles with Uconnect 8.4� screen radio the computer-controlled electronic systems may be at risk of unauthorized and/or unlawful access which may affect vehicle behaviour.
chrysler.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE Due to the inlet filter for the EGR valve being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This could result in the possibility of ice forming in the brake servo vacuum pipe in conditions of low ambient temperature. As a consequence this may lead to reduced servo assistance to the braking system.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If theses are not evident new solenoids with separate air filters will be fitted.

chrysler.defect: CENTRE REAR SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS The centre rear belt retractor may not comply with regulations.
chrysler.remedy: On affected vehicles replace centre rear belt retractor.

chrysler.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY NEED INCREASED FORCE DURING APPLICATION There is a possibility that the valve in the Brake Booster Vacuum Pump may not be compliant. This can result in loss of vacuum assistance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace pump.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT IN ENGINE COOLING FAN CONTROL UNIT A short circuit may occur in the engine cooling fan control unit with a resultant risk of overheating.
chrysler.remedy: Fit a new cooling fan control unit.

chrysler.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE On batteries fitted with non-watertight caps rainwater from the windscreen may run into the battery and result in a leakage of battery contents. This leakage may damage the adjacent fabric reinforced rubber brake servo pipe and reduce or cancel the servo assistance available when braking.
chrysler.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have a cover fitted to the battery and checking of the brake servo pipe for damage.

chrysler.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
chrysler.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

chrysler.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
chrysler.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

chrysler.defect: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
chrysler.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

chrysler.defect: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
chrysler.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

chrysler.defect: VIN label and CoC addendum Affected vehicles may have a tyre load index on the vehicle that is lower than the declared rear axle capacity.
chrysler.remedy: Replacement of the manufacturer's label fitted to the vehicle and supply the customer with an addendum to the COC (Certificate of Conformity).

chrysler.defect: Fiat 600 MHEV and BEV. Front camera Affected vehicles are fitted with a front camera with an incorrect hardware ID which causes an error code within the car system. Once an error code is set and recorded the camera is always in fault mode whenever it is switched on. This will result in the ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance System) remaining inactive. This inactive status is a nonconformity with regulatory requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the front camera.

chrysler.defect: Fiat 600 fuel pipe On affected vehicles there is a risk of a fuel leak at the high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections which in a worst-case could result in a vehicle fire.
chrysler.remedy: Check and tighten high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Professional Doblo tyre label On affected vehicles the tyre pressure label may show incorrect or missing information which does not meet regulatory requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the tyre pressure label.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Scudo seat fixing On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
chrysler.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

chrysler.defect: 2009 Chrysler Aspen Driver airbag inflator On affected vehicles the driver’s airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. An inflator rupture during airbag deployment events could result in metal fragments striking and potentially seriously injuring the vehicle occupant(s).
chrysler.remedy: Replace the drivers airbag.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Ducato may have been fitted with the incorrect radio Affected vehicles may have been fitted with the incorrect radio. The radio fitted does not have rear view camera functionality and therefore may not comply with regulatory requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the radio.

chrysler.defect: 2024 Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV Advanced Driver Assistance  Systems Radio software On affected vehicles equipped with an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality the AEB/LKA (Active Emergency Brake/Lane Keep Assist) can be deactivated simultaneously. The vehicle does not therefore meet regulatory requirements.
chrysler.remedy: Install updated software over the air (OTA).

chrysler.defect: Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV. Brake pedal On a number of Fiat 600 vehicles due to a production  nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake  pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a  rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal  disengagement In the event of brake pedal failure the  Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can  be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled  stop. Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency  Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent  collision.
chrysler.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Fiat dealer  checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct  assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance  with Fiat reference F53D.

chrysler.defect: Fiat 500 BEV High Voltage battery negative pole connection On affected vehicles the fastening nut may be missing from the negative terminal of the high-voltage battery pack which could result in a loss of torque failure to start the vehicle and in extreme cases it could present a possible fire hazard.
chrysler.remedy: The affected vehicles will have the high-voltage battery replaced.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
chrysler.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
chrysler.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
chrysler.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
chrysler.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

chrysler.defect: Fiat Professional 2025/2026 Ducato (290/295). Fuel pipe leak Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
chrysler.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

chrysler.defect: WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY FAIL TO OPERATE The windscreen wipers may fail to operate.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the windscreen wiper motor replaced.

chrysler.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR If liquid water or moisture enters the rear quarter vent window switch it may cause the switch to overheat. This can result in a burning smell or smoke being emitted from the switch or in extreme circumstances it can cause a driver�s door fire.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the rear quarter vent window switch and if required repair the electrical connector.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The threaded portion of the brake linkage rod in the brake control system may not be to conformity. This could result in a reduction of braking efficiency.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check rod and replace if found not to meet conformity.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
chrysler.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

chrysler.defect: The Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors may prematurely discharge its battery making the TPMS sensor inoperative The Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors may prematurely discharge its battery making the TPMS sensor inoperative.
chrysler.remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors.�

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE SAFETY FEATURES The Wireless Ignition Node (WIN) module may stick between the �START� and �RUN� position.  This could cause  an unintended change in ignition position to the �OFF� or �ACCESSORY� position due to spring back.  This may cause may result in the loss of certain electrical features and/or a loss of engine power power steering assist and/or power brake booster assist.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the WIN module and Frequency Operated Button Ignition Key (FOBIK�s).

chrysler.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE FLUIDS AND EXTENDED PEDAL TRAVEL The brake hoses may chafe on the wheel aches and in extreme cases cause a brake fluid  leak. The driver will be informed of the defect by the illumination of a warning lamp on the dashboard. If ignored then this will result in longer than expected stopping distances.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and visually inspect the front brake hoses reinforcement and protection. The brake hoses if worn will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: THE BALLAST SUPPORT BRACKET WELDED TO THE REAR FLOOR COUD BREAK The ballast support bracket welded to the rear floor could break
chrysler.remedy: Add two new fixings for each ballast support

chrysler.defect: ELECTRIC SLIDING REAR DOOR Electric Sliding door may open inadvertently.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and upgrade door control system ECU.

chrysler.defect: THE THIRD (HIGH LEVEL) BRAKE LIGHT MAY NOT FUNCTION The third (high level) brake light may not function.
chrysler.remedy: Update the software to activate the third brake light function.

chrysler.defect: THE EVAPORATIVE EMISSIONS CANISTER MAY BE UNABLE TO ABSORB THE NECESSARY AMOUNT OF FUEL VAPOUR DURING VEHICLE REFUELLING The Evaporative Emissions Canister may be unable to absorb the necessary amount of fuel vapour during vehicle refuelling.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the Evaporative Emissions Canister.

chrysler.defect: THE OCCUPANT RESTRAINT CONTROLLER (ORC) MAY NOT OPERATE AS INTENDED The Occupant Restraint Controller (ORC) may experience a loss of air bag and seat belt pretensioner deployment capability during a crash due to a shorting condition resulting in a negative voltage transient that travels to the Occupant Restraint Controller via the front impact sensor wires
chrysler.remedy: Replace the Occupant Restraint Control module.

chrysler.defect: IF REAR SEAT BELTS ARE NOT FASTENED AND PRETENSIONERS ARE DEPLOYED THE LATCH COULD BE RELEASED In case of an accident if the rear seat belts are not fastened i.e. if the rear seat is not occupied by a passenger or is occupied by a child restraint system coupled only to the Isofix anchors and the pretensioners are deployed the rear seat latch could be released. The contents of the rear luggage area if unsecured could enter the cabin area
chrysler.remedy: Replace the latch bezels with bezels the shape of which prevents the seat belts from interfering with the latch and releasing the seat in the event of a pretensioner deployment.

chrysler.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE The transmission could unexpectedly switch to the N position due to a nonconformity in the transmission wiring assembly process.
chrysler.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram the transmission control module. Where necessary replace the transmission wiring

chrysler.defect: THE ENGINE TONE WHEEL  WHICH PROVIDES A SIGNAL TO THE CRANKSHAFT POSITION SENSOR MAY FAIL The engine tone wheel which provides a signal to the crankshaft position sensor may fail.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the engine tone wheel.

chrysler.defect: INADVERTANT OPERATION OF AIR BAG The air bags on the subject vehicles may inadvertently deploy during a three second period after the ignition key has been turned to the off position.
chrysler.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the air bag control module.

chrysler.defect: THE FRONT SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN IMPROPERLY FORMED WAVE DISC The front seat belt retractor may have been built with an improperly formed wave disc.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the front seat belt retractor.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER STEERING The power assisted steering low pressure pipe may chafe on a hose clip.  This could result in the loss of the hydraulic fluid and power assistance of the steering.
chrysler.remedy: Check the steering low pressure hydraulic pipe for damage and reposition the hose clip where necessary.

chrysler.defect: REAR BRAKES MAY LOCK The ABS control unit may be programmed incorrectly. This may lead to the rear brakes locking up during certain braking conditions.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect to re-programme the ABS control module.

chrysler.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the tightening torque of the steering shaft upper fixing bolt may not be correct. This may result in the emission of noise and in extreme cases breakage of the shaft which will result in loss of steering control.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolt checked for correct torque which if necessary will be set to the correct specification. If the torque is outside of the rework stipulated range the shaft will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTENT AIRBAG ACTIVATION The air conditioning condenser drainpipe may in some instances become blocked with the possibility that the condensate may leak into the passenger compartment and the air bag central control unit. This contamination may cause the air bag warning light to illuminate and in some cases; cause inadvertent activation of the air bag.
chrysler.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the condensate drainpipe will be refitted; and re-profiled to remove any restriction.

chrysler.defect: DOOR PANEL MAY CAUSE INJURY In the event of a side impact on a small number of vehicles fitted with the Sabelt seat option the door side panels may break in an unsuitable way and possibly cause injury to the occupants.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the door panels.

chrysler.defect: REAR QUARTER WINDOW MAY DETACH FROM VEHICLE The fixed rear quarter glass may separate from the vehicle whilst in motion
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace Quarter Glass assembly

chrysler.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF STEERING The steering column to steering wheel shaft may not have been assembled correctly. If not corrected noise and play will become apparent and if these warnings are not acted on eventually steering control could be lost.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary refit the steering column correctly to the steering wheel shaft.

chrysler.defect: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY BECOME DETACHED The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body
chrysler.remedy: Replace the current sleeve and respective metal bands with modified parts.

chrysler.defect: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY DETACH FROM THE THROTTLE BODY The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body.  The engine management warning light will illuminate and a loss of power may occur.
chrysler.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the current retainer with a new version to ensure the sleeve connection between intercooler sleeve and throttle body.

chrysler.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INADVERTENTLY The Occupant Restraint Control (ORC) module may become contaminated by water leaking from the Heating venting & Air Conditioning (HVAC) drain grommet.  This may lead to the illumination of the airbag warning light and the potential for an inadvertent airbag deployment without warning.
chrysler.remedy: The repair is to replace the OCR module in addition to having the HVAC tube and grommet replaced

chrysler.defect: REDUCED BRAKE PERFORMANCE It has been identified that the rear brake shoe lining material may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. This could result in a reduction in brake performance from the rear brakes.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the conformity of the brake linings and if found to be incorrect replace with new brake shoes which meet the correct conformity.

chrysler.defect: INCORRECT TORQUE OF WHEEL BOLTS The road wheel fixing bolts may not have been correctly torqued and could loosen over a period of use.
chrysler.remedy: Check the wheel fixing bolts for correct torque and tighten or renew as appropriate.

chrysler.defect: ABS MAY FAIL The battery carrier tray may interfere with the ABS control unit wiring.  This may damage the wiring and cause the ABS system to fail.
chrysler.remedy: Check the wiring layout reposition if required and add protection to the harness.

chrysler.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL The headlights may fail because of a Body Control Computer software problem.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

chrysler.defect: BODY SECURING BRACKETS MAY FAIL The lower fastening brackets which secure the body to the chassis are not manufactured to specification. As a result the brackets may fail and render the body not fully secure.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the body securing brackets with ones manufactured to specification.

chrysler.defect: DIRECTION INDICATORS MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY It has been identified that the direction indicators may not function correctly.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the indicator power module reprogrammed.

chrysler.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

chrysler.defect: Passenger airbag inflator Passenger air bag may deploy incorrectly if activated.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the passenger air bag inflator.

chrysler.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

chrysler.defect: DUE TO INCORRECT TYPE APPROVAL DATA PROCESSING THE MANUFACTURER'S PLATE (VIN PLATE) AND REGISTRATION DOCUMENT MUST BE REPLACED Due to incorrect type-approval data processing the manufacturer's plate (VIN plate) and registration document must be replaced.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the VIN plate and update the registration document as required.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
chrysler.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that an unused tyre pressure monitoring system electrical connector may become corroded and short circuit. This can lead to a variety of conditions including dead battery inoperative cruise control and engine non- start or stall
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have all unused tyre monitoring system electrical connections removed and the wiring sealed with heat shrink.

chrysler.defect: STEERING WHEEL AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY It has been identified that due to the non-conforming layout of the airbag wiring and missing cut-proof protection the airbag wiring may interfere with the steering wheel wiring terminal. This can cause the abrasion of the wiring itself. This abrasion may cause a short-circuit and consequent inadvertent deployment of the steering wheel airbag.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the airbag wiring and apply cut proof padded tape.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE SAFETY FEATURES The Wireless Ignition Node (WIN) module may stick between the �START� and �RUN� position.  This could cause  an unintended change in ignition position to the �OFF� or �ACCESSORY� position due to spring back.  This may cause may result in the loss of certain electrical features and/or a loss of engine power power steering assist and/or power brake booster assist.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the WIN module and Frequency Operated Button Ignition Key (FOBIK�s).

chrysler.defect: CAMSHAFT MAY FAIL Due to an error in the production process the engine camshaft may break.
chrysler.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the camshaft.

chrysler.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT SELF LEVEL CORRECTLY It has been established that the Totally Integrated Power Module (TIPM) may be configured incorrectly thus preventing the headlamp levelling system from operating correctly.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the TIPM re-configured.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE SAFETY FEATURES The Wireless Ignition Node (WIN) module may stick between the �START� and �RUN� position.  This could cause  an unintended change in ignition position to the �OFF� or �ACCESSORY� position due to spring back.  This may cause may result in the loss of certain electrical features and/or a loss of engine power power steering assist and/or power brake booster assist.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the WIN module and Frequency Operated Button Ignition Key (FOBIK�s).

chrysler.defect: BRAKE VACUUM ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE In some cases due to the non-compliance of the engine ECU software the engine failure warning lamp may illuminate. As a consequence the vacuum assistance available to the braking system may be reduced.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-programme the engine ECU with updated software.

chrysler.defect: THE SPORT MODE SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS The �Sport� mode system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
chrysler.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

chrysler.defect: INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR VEHICLE LIGHTING MAY FAIL It is possible under extreme conditions that the wiring harness under the dashboard could come into contact with the steering column. This over a period of time may result in the chaffing of wires in the harness. If this should occur then it is possible both the exterior and instrument lights could fail.
