chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to provide additional security of the wiring loom.

chrysler.defect: STEERING COLUMN PERFORMANCE DURING AN IMPACT MAY BE COMPROMISED Because a rivet may be either missing or incorrectly installed in the steering column in the event of an impact the steering column performance could be compromised.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary install a missing rivet or replace an incorrectly installed rivet.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

chrysler.defect: RISK OF FIRE The blower motor may under certain operating conditions overheat and cause an interior fire
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit modified blower motor.

chrysler.defect: INCORRECT SPARE WHEEL Some vehicles with alloy wheels may have been supplied with an unsuitable space saver spare wheel. If fitted this spare wheel could cause interference with braking system components.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace any unsuitable spare wheels with correctly specified versions.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF LOWER ENGINE STABILISER ROD The lower engine stabiliser rod may crack or break. This could result in detachment of the off side drive shaft on full lock.
chrysler.remedy: Inspect the stabiliser rod welding and fit a new rod where found necessary.

chrysler.defect: On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling. On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling.
chrysler.remedy: The repair is an upload of modified ECU software.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE COMPARTMENT FUEL LEAK CONCERN After extended use the fuel rail crossover tube O rings may leak fuel.  This may lead to an engine compartment fire.
chrysler.remedy: Fit external seals at the fuel crossover points.  If the joints are leaking or show signs of rust the fuel rail assembly will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: THE DRIVER'S AIRBAG EMBLEM MAY HAVE BECOME LOOSE OR DETACHED The driver�s airbag emblem may have become loose or detached.
chrysler.remedy: Remove the emblem and the emblem retainers

chrysler.defect: FRACTURE OF FRONT COIL SPRINGS The anti noise plastic shields fitted to the bottom of the front suspension coil springs may permit the accumulation of a high level of humidity under certain environmental conditions. When combined with the presence of salt and small stones etc. this condition may cause breakage of the spring(s) and subsequent tearing of the tyre as a result of the fractured coils contacting the tyre wall.
chrysler.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a modified ventilated spring sheath and inspection of the front coil springs.

chrysler.defect: On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling. On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling.
chrysler.remedy: The repair is an upload of modified ECU software.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On certain vehicles the front brake discs may not be the required thickness for the vehicle definition. This concern may result in reduced braking efficiency.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the front brake discs.

chrysler.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

chrysler.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

chrysler.defect: STEERING COLUMN PERFORMANCE DURING AN IMPACT MAY BE COMPROMISED Because a rivet may be either missing or incorrectly installed in the steering column in the event of an impact the steering column performance could be compromised.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary install a missing rivet or replace an incorrectly installed rivet.

chrysler.defect: A FUEL PUMP RELAY WHICH COULD OPERATE INTERMITTENTLY OR FAIL WITHOUT WARNING A fuel pump relay which could operate intermittently or fail without warning.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the affected fuel pump and modify original wiring where necessary

chrysler.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the front seat electric heating elements may overheat.  This can under certain operating conditions result in an interior fire or personal injury.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have both front seat heating elements replaced.

chrysler.defect: SUPPLEMENTARY HEATER WIRING MAY BECOME DAMAGED AND CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT On some Fiat 500L vehicles a layout non-conformity could cause abrasion of the supplementary heater (PTC) wiring. This could result in possible electric short-circuiting with the possibility of a loss of some vehicle safety. In the worst case it could cause a vehicle fire..
chrysler.remedy: Apply a cut-proof sheath on the supplementary heater wiring to protect it from abrasions.

chrysler.defect: FRONT WIPER MAY FAIL An internal fault with the wiper motor could cause it to stop working. In some rare cases the windscreen wipers may stop working while in operation.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the manufacturing date of the wiper motor and add a supplementary earth wiring harness if necessary.

chrysler.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL Under certain operating conditions it has been identified that the engine might stall due to incorrect programming of the totally integrated power module (TIPM).
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the TPIM re-programmed.

chrysler.defect: STEERING COLUMN PERFORMANCE DURING AN IMPACT MAY BE COMPROMISED Because a rivet may be either missing or incorrectly installed in the steering column in the event of an impact the steering column performance could be compromised.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary install a missing rivet or replace an incorrectly installed rivet.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

chrysler.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL In some circumstances the headlights can switch off without warning which will increase the risk of an accident.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the Body Computer with new improved software.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF FRONT SPRING A specific batch of vehicles have been equipped with front suspension coil springs which may suffer from localised corrosion. This can cause breakage of the springs with an adverse effect on vehicle control.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original coil springs with quality assured examples.

chrysler.defect: ROUTING OF BRAKE VACUUM PIPE MAY BE INCORRECT In some cases due to the non compliant routing of the brake servo vacuum supply pipe damage to the pipe may occur with the possibility that braking assistance might be reduced.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject pipe checked and re-routed. Should any damage be found the pipe will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

chrysler.defect: WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY BECOME INEFFECTIVE It has been identified that under certain operating conditions the windscreen wipers may become inoperative. This can impair the driver's forward vision which may lead to a collision.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the integrated power module (TIPM) part number inspected. Modules found with a part number which ends in AA through AL must have two external wiper relays installed. Additionally the TIPM software will be reprogrammed.

chrysler.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY OF THE FUEL RETURN PIPE DIESEL FUEL LEAKS MAY OCCUR Due to a nonconformity of the fuel return pipe diesel fuel leaks may occur.
chrysler.remedy: Check the conformity of the fuel return pipe and if necessary replace.

chrysler.defect: INCORRECTLY POSITIONED FUEL PIPE Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
chrysler.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

chrysler.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES On ABS equipped Punto vehicles contact may take place between the brake compensator springs and the rear (metal) brake pipes. This could damage the pipes causing loss of brake fluid and reducing the efficiency of the service brake.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY It has been identified that the hand brake lever may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. It could result in the vehicle rolling away.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the hand brake assembly with a new quality controlled assembly

chrysler.defect: INADVERTANT OPERATION OF AIR BAG The air bags on the subject vehicles may inadvertently deploy during a three second period after the ignition key has been turned to the off position.
chrysler.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the air bag control module.

chrysler.defect: THE UPPER POWER STEERING HOSE MAY SPLIT AND LEAK. The power steering upper hose may split and leak. This may result in a fire.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the power steering upper return hose.

chrysler.defect: INADVERTANT OPERATION OF AIR BAG The air bags on the subject vehicles may inadvertently deploy during a three second period after the ignition key has been turned to the off position.
chrysler.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the air bag control module.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
chrysler.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

chrysler.defect: ANTI-ROLL BAR BUSH WEAR It has been identified that the front anti-roll bar bushes may wear after a period of time. Should this occur noise will be generated by contact between the anti-roll bar and the metal sleeve of the bush.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front anti-roll bar replaced.

chrysler.defect: The Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors may prematurely discharge its battery making the TPMS sensor inoperative The Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors may prematurely discharge its battery making the TPMS sensor inoperative.
chrysler.remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors.�

chrysler.defect: INCORRECT LOAD CAPACITY LISTED FOR INTERIOR HOOKS It has been identified that the maximum load capacity for the load restraint hooks in the load compartment of the vehicle has been incorrectly written in the Owner Handbook.  The correct load capacity is 500 daN and not the 625 daN as written. If the correct load capacity of 500 daN is not adhered to then the load hooks may not retain the load due to overloading. This could result in an unsecured load with the potential for loss of control of the vehicle.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to attach a load capacity label within the load compartment and install an additional amended page to the Owner Handbook.

chrysler.defect: On the affected vehicle the tightening torque applied to the steering rack during production may be insufficient. On the affected vehicle the tightening torque applied to the steering rack during production may be insufficient.
chrysler.remedy: The repair is replacement of the left steering pinion tie rod retainer nut and apply the correct torque.

chrysler.defect: SEAT MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED DURING A COLLISION The seat may not remain in position when subjected to greater than normal driving forces such as those involved in an impact. This may possibly cause injury to the driver/passenger seated in the right hand front seat. The right hand front seat guides may not conform to design specification and installation specifications.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the installation of the original seat guide. If it does not conform replace the seat cushion structure (guide).

chrysler.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

chrysler.defect: THE START & STOP SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS The Start & Stop system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
chrysler.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

chrysler.defect: INCORRECT WEIGHT RATINGS The vehicle Weight Certification label has the incorrect value for Gross Vehicle Weight Ratings (GVWR). Over loading the vehicle is possible without understanding the correct GVWR specification which could cause a crash without warning.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the Weight certification label.

chrysler.defect: POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING MAY BE LOST The wiring for the power steering electric pump may interfere with the edge of the left front wheel arch. This may cause damage to the wiring and a loss of power steering assistance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected so the wiring can be placed in a protective pipe. The wiring and pipe will then be secured in the correct position.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE INTERFERENCE BETWEEN FUEL SUPPLY AND RETURN LINES Possible interference between the fuel supply and return lines.
chrysler.remedy: Reposition the pipes to avoid interference.

chrysler.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY SELF - RELEASE The parking brake lever cable is too long which may cause the locking mechanism to extend beyond the last tooth of the sector when the park brake is engaged. This condition may cause the parking brake to self-release.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace parking brake cable with shorter cable. Additionally as part of the above recall the repair contained in Daimler-Chrysler Technical Service Bulletin 05i-801-99 relating to parking brake imbalance will be carried out on affected vehicles.

chrysler.defect: STEERING COLUMN PERFORMANCE DURING AN IMPACT MAY BE COMPROMISED Because a rivet may be either missing or incorrectly installed in the steering column in the event of an impact the steering column performance could be compromised.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary install a missing rivet or replace an incorrectly installed rivet.

chrysler.defect: The Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors may prematurely discharge its battery making the TPMS sensor inoperative The Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors may prematurely discharge its battery making the TPMS sensor inoperative.
chrysler.remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Tyre Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) sensors.�

chrysler.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR FROM THE FUEL TANK Due to a non-conformity in production fuel leakage may occur from the fuel tank
chrysler.remedy: Replace the fuel tank

chrysler.defect: POTENTIAL FIRE The fuel return pipe connector at the injectors may overtime wear and leak. The leaking fuel is a fire risk and also could be hazardous to other road users.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel return pipe.

chrysler.defect: SECURITY OF SEAT BELT A number of the subject vehicles have been fitted with seat belts manufactured by TRW the attachment systems of which may not remain secure in an accident situation.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check the date of production on the seat belt buckles and replace those within the critical batch.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

chrysler.defect: POTENTIAL MOVEMENT OF THE BATTERY Potential movement of the battery and consequent breakage of the battery wires.
chrysler.remedy: A battery spacer must be fitted

chrysler.defect: THE FRONT SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN IMPROPERLY FORMED WAVE DISC The front seat belt retractor may have been built with an improperly formed wave disc.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the front seat belt retractor.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION On vehicles with Uconnect 8.4� screen radio the computer-controlled electronic systems may be at risk of unauthorized and/or unlawful access which may affect vehicle behaviour.
chrysler.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: HANDBRAKE CONCERN The handbrake cable may have been incorrectly fitted and could become disconnected from the rear brake mechanism.  This would result in the handbrake becoming ineffective.
chrysler.remedy: Check that the handbrake cable is correctly connected to the rear brake mechanism and fit a new cable where it is not.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION On vehicles with Uconnect 8.4� screen radio the computer-controlled electronic systems may be at risk of unauthorized and/or unlawful access which may affect vehicle behaviour.
chrysler.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: RISK OF FIRE It has been identified that engine coolant might be drawn into the left side cooling fan motor connector. Should this occur an electrical short circuit will arise which may result in a fire within the engine compartment.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a left side radiator cooling fan motor wire overlay installed. Additionally the left side cooling fan motor connector will be inspected for damage. Vehicles found with a damaged radiator cooling fan motor connector will have the fan motor replaced.

chrysler.defect: ACCELERATOR MAY STICK It has been identified that the possibility exists that the accelerator pedal's rotation pin may not have been inserted correctly. In this condition the accelerator pedal might stick.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the accelerator pedal checked for the presence of the pin. Should the pin be found to be missing the accelerator pedal will be changed.

chrysler.defect: REAR BRAKES MAY LOCK The ABS control unit may be programmed incorrectly. This may lead to the rear brakes locking up during certain braking conditions.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect to re-programme the ABS control module.

chrysler.defect: ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY BE DEACTIVATED In some circumstances the driver and passenger may experience consequent switching off of the instrument panel light and possible deactivation of other electronic systems such as the ABS and airbags. The concern is caused by loose connections at the ignition switch contact holder block.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition switch contact holder block.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT Under certain conditions rough or uneven roads it is possible that the ignition switch may move to the 'Accessory' position whilst the vehicle is in motion.  This can cause the engine stop and could result in a collision.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection and the fitment of additional parts to overcome the issue.

chrysler.defect: THE OCCUPANT RESTRAINT CONTROLLER (ORC) MAY NOT OPERATE AS INTENDED The Occupant Restraint Controller (ORC) may experience a loss of air bag and seat belt pretensioner deployment capability during a crash due to a shorting condition resulting in a negative voltage transient that travels to the Occupant Restraint Controller via the front impact sensor wires
chrysler.remedy: Replace the Occupant Restraint Control module.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE After extended high speed running brake servo assistance may be lost due to petrol contamination of the servo diaphragm.
chrysler.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the servo brake vacuum pipe and checking of the brake servo efficiency.

chrysler.defect: THE EVAPORATIVE EMISSIONS CANISTER MAY BE UNABLE TO ABSORB THE NECESSARY AMOUNT OF FUEL VAPOUR DURING VEHICLE REFUELLING The Evaporative Emissions Canister may be unable to absorb the necessary amount of fuel vapour during vehicle refuelling.
chrysler.remedy: Replace the Evaporative Emissions Canister.

chrysler.defect: THE FUEL LINE JUMPER TUBE MAY CHAFE AGAINST THE THROTTLE CABLE The fuel line jumper tube may chafe against the throttle cable. This may then lead to a fuel leak.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a modified fuel line jumper tube. Additionally the tube will be re-routed and secured.

chrysler.defect: HALFSHAFT AND DRIVE MAY DISENGAGE WITHOUT WARNING. The rear axle hub may loosen and allow the half shaft to disengage from the wheel hub.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and inspect hub nuts for crimping around the circumference. If crimping is missing replace nuts.

chrysler.defect: FUEL PUMP MODULE MOUNTING CONCERN The fuel pump module mounting may leak if the vehicle is involved in a rollover collision.
chrysler.remedy: Install a secondary seal over the fuel pump module.

chrysler.defect: STEERING COLUMN PERFORMANCE DURING AN IMPACT MAY BE COMPROMISED Because a rivet may be either missing or incorrectly installed in the steering column in the event of an impact the steering column performance could be compromised.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary install a missing rivet or replace an incorrectly installed rivet.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT Under certain conditions rough or uneven roads it is possible that the ignition switch may move to the 'Accessory' position whilst the vehicle is in motion.  This can cause the engine stop and could result in a collision.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection and the fitment of additional parts to overcome the issue.

chrysler.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
chrysler.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

chrysler.defect: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY It has been identified that the front passenger air bag may deploy with too much force when certain rear facing child seats are installed.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front passenger cushions replaced and the occupant restraint system re-programmed.

chrysler.defect: SUSPENSION COIL SPRING MAY BREAK Under environmental conditions that require intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits accumulate inside the noise-insulating protective sheath located on the front suspension springs creating areas of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front coil springs with those of a new type.

chrysler.defect: BRAKE VACUUM HOSE CONCERN The brake booster vacuum hose may swell and leak due to oil contamination. This could lead to loss of power brake assist and an increase in engine idle speed. This may increase the stopping distance.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the brake booster vacuum hose.

chrysler.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The cooling fan blades may fracture and separate from the fan which will in certain circumstances allow the engine to overheat.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fan assembly.

chrysler.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL CONCERN The accelerator pedal may foul on its travel limiting stop and prevent the engine from decellerating when the pedal is released.
chrysler.remedy: Fit a modified pedal travel limiting stop.

chrysler.defect: STEERING RACK CROSS MEMBER/DIFFERENTIAL MOUNTING BRACKET CONCERN Cracking and separation of the steering rack cross member and/or the differential mounting bracket may lead to loss of vehicle control in extreme cases.
chrysler.remedy: Recall vehicles and inspect for cracks.  If cracks are evident parts will be replaced.  In all cases reinforcement brackets will be installed.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION On vehicles with Uconnect 8.4� screen radio the computer-controlled electronic systems may be at risk of unauthorized and/or unlawful access which may affect vehicle behaviour.
chrysler.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION On vehicles with Uconnect 8.4� screen radio the computer-controlled electronic systems may be at risk of unauthorized and/or unlawful access which may affect vehicle behaviour.
chrysler.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES On ABS equipped Punto vehicles contact may take place between the brake compensator springs and the rear (metal) brake pipes. This could damage the pipes causing loss of brake fluid and reducing the efficiency of the service brake.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

chrysler.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU Water ingress into the airbag control unit (ECU) could result in illumination of the warning light and in the worst case unintentional deployment of the airbag.
chrysler.remedy: Seal the airbag ECU compartment

chrysler.defect: STEERING SWIVEL  JOINT MAY FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL The possibility exists that the swivel joint stem of the front suspension vertical links maybe of an incorrect size. This can lead to the generation of noise whilst driving and the possibility of suspension disconnection following a violent impact to the front axle and subsequent loss of vehicle control.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the swivel joint stems checked for the presence of play and will be replaced if any is found.

chrysler.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED The left front brake caliper housing may have been cast from an incorrect material.  Under extreme brake application the left front brake caliper housing may rupture and affect braking efficiency.
chrysler.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace caliper

chrysler.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE FRONT CROSSMEMBER INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED Vehicles may have been fitted with the front crossmember incorrectly tightened.
chrysler.remedy: Check and tighten the bolts on the front crossmember to the prescribed torque. Replacement of the steering rack if necessary.

chrysler.defect: FRONT WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE It has been identified that the possibility exists that water may ingress into the front windscreen wiper motor. Should this occur the wipers may become inoperative. In conditions of poor visibility this may result in impaired driver visibility.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front windscreen wiper motor fitted with a protective cover.

chrysler.defect: EGR PIPE COULD FRACTURE DUE TO A POTENTIAL NON-CONFORMITY The EGR pipe could fracture due to a potential non-conformity the fractured pipe may damage the alternator resulting in a loss of battery voltage and potentially a loss of engine power.
chrysler.remedy: The pipe must be checked and if incorrect replaced with a new  part.

chrysler.defect: STEERING COLUMN PERFORMANCE DURING AN IMPACT MAY BE COMPROMISED Because a rivet may be either missing or incorrectly installed in the steering column in the event of an impact the steering column performance could be compromised.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary install a missing rivet or replace an incorrectly installed rivet.

chrysler.defect: INEFFECTIVE/INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF A LOCK NUT ON THE STEERING GEAR ROD Vehicles may have been produced with ineffective/incorrect tightening of a lock nut on the steering gear rod.
chrysler.remedy: Check for the correct tightening of the lock nut and check/adjust wheel alignment if tightening was required.

chrysler.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
chrysler.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A FAULTY LEFT OR RIGHT SIDE HALF-SHAFT A number of vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty left or right side half-shaft (drive shaft).
chrysler.remedy: The half-shaft identified as faulty according to traceability data must be replaced

chrysler.defect: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY DISPLAY INCORRECT INFORMATION Due to a nonconformity in the production process the instrument cluster may stick and display incorrect speed information.
chrysler.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the instrument cluster.

chrysler.defect: WATER INGRESS TO ABS CONTROL UNIT Water may enter the ABS (antilock brake) control unit through a harness connector. This will cause the ABS control unit to malfunction and the fault warning lamp to illuminate.
chrysler.remedy: Fit a new ABS wiring harness which has watertight connectors.

chrysler.defect: THE BRAKE LINE RETAINING CLIP MAY NOT BE FIXED CORRECTLY TO THE TUCKER ON THE DASHBOARD The brake line (pipe) may not be fixed correctly
chrysler.remedy: Check the clip is fixed correctly and replace damaged brake pipes

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION On vehicles with Uconnect 8.4� screen radio the computer-controlled electronic systems may be at risk of unauthorized and/or unlawful access which may affect vehicle behaviour.
chrysler.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

chrysler.defect: DOOR LOCKS MAY MALFUNCTION AND ALLOW DOORS TO OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY On a number of Fiat Fullback vehicles in some weather conditions (high temperatures) the mechanism inside the door lock may not function as intended. This can allow the door(s) to open unintentionally.
chrysler.remedy: The door locks must be replaced with compliant components.

chrysler.defect: WHEEL SEPERATION MAY OCCUR Insufficient grease may have been applied to the front wheel bearings which could result in the very worst cases in detachment of the wheel and hub.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front wheel bearings.

chrysler.defect: REAR SUSPENSION MAY FAIL During the assembly of the vehicle it is possible the right hand rear suspension coil spring was damaged. Over time any damage could lead to the failure of the coil spring.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the coil spring.

chrysler.defect: REAR BRAKES MAY LOCK The ABS control unit may be programmed incorrectly. This may lead to the rear brakes locking up during certain braking conditions.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect to re-programme the ABS control module.

chrysler.defect: VEHICLE ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION On vehicles with Uconnect 8.4� screen radio the computer-controlled electronic systems may be at risk of unauthorized and/or unlawful access which may affect vehicle behaviour.
chrysler.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

chrysler.defect: Driver airbag inflator In the event that the airbag is activated excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing  injury to the vehicle occupants and / or in worst cases a fatality. The concern is caused by moisture in the air getting past faulty seals and being absorbed by the pyrotechnic biscuits in the inflator. As a result it is more likely to occur sooner in areas of high humidity and high temperature difference.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger front air bag  module which includes the inflator.

chrysler.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
chrysler.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

chrysler.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

chrysler.defect: INTERIOR FAN WIRING MAY CHAFE ON DASHBOARD SUPPORT The interior fan wiring may chafe on a dashboard support.  This could result in a short circuit and a fire in the fan unit.
chrysler.remedy: Fit additional insulation and protection to the fan electrical  wiring.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL COULD FOUL ON THE FLOOR Possibility that the accelerator may foul on the floor mounted pedal stop
chrysler.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a modified throttle pedal stop.

chrysler.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
chrysler.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

chrysler.defect: POSSIBIITY OF FIRE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT A fire might occur in the engine compartment as a result of the waste gate excess pressure pipe being incorrectly routed.
chrysler.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected to ensure the waste gate pipe is correctly routed and fixed in the appropriate clips.

chrysler.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
chrysler.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary

citation.defect: VEHICLE NOT FITTED WITH A MECHANICAL PARKING BRAKE Vehicle not fitted with a mechanical parking brake.
citation.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a mechanical parking brake.

citroen.defect: Citroen Relay (X250) Wrong weight values on manufacturer plate Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a metal Manufacturer plate located in the engine compartment that shows the wrong weight values. This can lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
citroen.remedy: Check and replace the metal Manufacturer plate.

citroen.defect: Citroen Dispatch -K0 – Ground Connections On affected vehicles there could be a loss of ground connections for some electrical harnesses which could result in a worst-case scenario in the loss of several vehicle functions with safety impacts and a risk of erratic behaviour of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

citroen.defect: Citroen C3 Front seat pretentioner wires inverted. Affected vehicles may face a front seat belt pretensioner malfunction in the event of a crash due to the inversion of command wires in the Airbag ECU connector.
citroen.remedy: Replace the affected PINS in the airbag ECU connector.

citroen.defect: Citroen C5 Aircross PHEV Traction Battery On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.
citroen.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery.

citroen.defect: Alarm triggered randomly - BCM software On affected vehicles due to a Body Control Module (BCM) software weakness an alarm siren may randomly trigger when the vehicle is locked.
citroen.remedy: Update the BCM software.

citroen.defect: Alarm triggered randomly - BCM software On affected vehicles due to a Body Control Module (BCM) software weakness an alarm siren may randomly trigger when the vehicle is locked.
citroen.remedy: Update the BCM software.

citroen.defect: Citroen Berlingo -K9 Engine Software Affected vehicles may suffer a loss of Hydraulic Brake Compensation (HBC). In a worst-case scenario this can lead to reduced brake performance.
citroen.remedy: Update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration.

citroen.defect: AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT MAY NOT BE TO STANDARD The air bag control unit may be underestimating the significance of an impact for the purposes of deploying the airbags.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the airbag control unit replaced.

citroen.defect: IF THE FRONT CENTRE PASSENGER SEATING POSITION  IS OCCUPIED THE FRONT OUTER PASSENGER SEAT BELT COULD RELEASE There is a risk of inadvertent release to the front outer passenger seat belt.
citroen.remedy: Modifying the central seat buckle with foam and heat-shrinkable protective tubing.

citroen.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
citroen.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION BALL JOINT MAY DISENGAGE There is a possibility that due to incorrect machining of the suspension ball joint clamp bolt hole on the pivot the ball joint may disengage.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and replace pivot if necessary.

citroen.defect: SEATBELT MAY FAIL The tightening torque for the front and rear right hand seat belt lower mountings may not be correct to specification. This could lead to the mountings detaching and in a collision additional injury to the driver.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and rectify the tightening torques for the front and rear right hand seat belt lower mountings.

citroen.defect: FRONT AIR BAG IGNITERS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY Front air bag igniters may not deploy correctly.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected front airbags.

citroen.defect: THERE MAY BE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE APPLICATION ON THE REAR WHEEL HUB There may be an incorrect tightening torque application on the rear wheel hub.
citroen.remedy: Check the rear wheel bearing hub screws and if necessary replace the screws on both sides of the vehicle.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE SHARP EDGES PRESENT ON THE COMPONENTS OF THE CURTAIN AIR BAG AFTER DEPLOYMENT Possible sharp edges present on the components of the curtain airbag after deployment.
citroen.remedy: Install an additional metal location strap to the grab handle in the proximity of the curtain airbag.

citroen.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It has been established that the con-rod (big end) shell bearings may not have been manufactured to specification. This could lead to premature deterioration of the shells and if not identified it could result in engine failure.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace con-rod shell bearings.

citroen.defect: REAR SUSPENSION WISHBONE MOUNTING BOLTS NAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The rear suspension wishbone mountings bolts may not be correct to specification.
citroen.remedy: Replacement of the rear suspension wishbone bolts.

citroen.defect: REAR WHEEL HUB BEARINGS MAY NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION On affected vehicles the locking nut of the rear wheel hub bearings may not be correct to specification.  In extreme cases this may affect control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: The recall consists of checking the hub nut and  if the locking of the nut does not conform to specification replacing the stub axle and the hub.

citroen.defect: VEHICLES AFFECTED MAY HAVE A SINGLE WHEEL BOLT ON BOTH RIGHT HAND SIDE WHEELS WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY A single wheel bolt on both Right-hand wheels may not be tightened to the correct tightening torque.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace wheel bolts and any other associated parts if consequential damage has occurred.

citroen.defect: There is the possibility that the rubber fuel pipe could have potentially been damaged during the crimping process which could lead to a fuel leak of the low pressure fuel pipe. A rubber fuel pipe could have potentially been damaged during the manufacturing process which could lead to a fuel leak of the low pressure fuel pipe in the engine compartment that could in a worst-case scenario result in a risk of fire
citroen.remedy: To check and replace the fuel pipe

citroen.defect: WIPERS / LIGHTS/ BATTERY CHARGING MAY BE AFFECTED. An incorrect engine relay unit may have been fitted. This ECU could deteriorate and cause operating faults and perhaps failure of certain equipment
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check Engine Relay Unit and replace if not correct specification.

citroen.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a rear axle crossmember that was not manufactured according to specifications. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a rear axle crossmember that was not manufactured according to specifications.
citroen.remedy: Check and replace the rear axle crossmember if necessary.

citroen.defect: WINDSCREEN WIPER MOTOR MAY FAIL On affected vehicles an internal nonconformity in the drivers side windscreen wiper motor may lead over time to the failure of the windscreen wiper mechanism.
citroen.remedy: Replacement of drivers side windscreen wiper motor.

citroen.defect: VACUUM BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE. It has been identified that the check valve within the brake assistance vacuum pump may suffer from a non-conformity which in time may reduce the braking assistance.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles as a preventative measure will have the subject valve replaced. At the same time certain vehicles will also have the air dosing unit replaced.

citroen.defect: FRONT AIR BAG IGNITERS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY Front air bag igniters may not deploy correctly.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected front airbags.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The battery earth cable dimensions are incorrect and may cause the cable to break.  This will then cause the engine to cut out.
citroen.remedy: Replace the battery negative cable with a new dimension cable. (length and terminal)

citroen.defect: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS LOWER BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY The tightening and positioning of the seat belt lower bolts may be incorrect.
citroen.remedy: This campaign consists of checking and if necessary correcting both the position of the bolt and the tightening torque of all of the lower fixings of the seat belts.

citroen.defect: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT On the affected vehicles a possible nonconformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body could lead to water ingress in the passenger compartment. This may affect the operation of the passenger air bag. Unintended deployment is possible.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles add extra sealant and replace wet or water damaged components.

citroen.defect: TYRE MAY DEFLATE Some tyres may have suffered superficial damage when the vehicle was being transported. The front Left hand tyre may have localised damage on the tread or the inner side. The tyre may rip and deflate.
citroen.remedy: Carry out a visual check of the condition of the tyre in the affected areas and replace the tyre if necessary.

citroen.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL In the event of emergency braking or during an ESP regulation phase (e.g. avoiding manoeuvre) the hydraulic block may not prevent the locking of a wheel which could affect  control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the braking system hydraulic block

citroen.defect: SEAT BELT MAY FAIL IN A COLLISION It has been identified that on some vehicles fitted with electrically controlled seats in very rare cases and under certain impact conditions the front seatbelt may provide a diminished level of restraint.
citroen.remedy: As a preventative measure subject vehicles will have the front seatbelt buckles replaced.

citroen.defect: SPARE WHEEL MAY DETACH The spare wheel winch may fail and not secure the spare wheel to the vehicle so allowing it to detach from the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the spare wheel winch.

citroen.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING It has been identified that the position of the exterior lighting control ring may not be detected by the lighting management system and the lights may switch off without warning.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the lighting management software updated.

citroen.defect: LOSS OF POWER Due to none conformity during manufacture the resistance of the insulated base inside the Engine Control Unit (ECU) which controls the electric motor may decrease. As a result the voltage in the circuit may become unstable causing the warning light to illuminate and the driving motor power to be restricted to the fail safe control. In the worst case scenario the vehicle may not be able to be restarted and the battery may not be able to be charged.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine ECU.

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel tank mounting bolts may have been incorrectly torqued this may cause the mountings to become loose which can lead to stress on the fuel pipes and subsequently a fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to check and if necessary retorque of the mounting bolts.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY NOT START Due to none conformity during manufacture the resistance of the insulated base inside the Engine Control Unit (ECU) which controls the electric motor may decrease. As a result the voltage in the circuit may become unstable causing the warning light to illuminate and the driving motor power to be restricted to the fail safe control. In the worst case scenario the vehicle may not be able to be restarted and the battery may not be able to be charged.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine ECU.

citroen.defect: CERTAIN REAR SUSPENSION FIXING BOLTS MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION Certain rear suspension fixing bolts may not conform to specification which could cause them to break
citroen.remedy: Replace the affected bolts.

citroen.defect: THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE COULD RESULT IN EMISSIONS OF NOx WHICH DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE REGULATORY LIMITS Engine management software issue could result in incorrect emission levels.
citroen.remedy: Update the engine management software.

citroen.defect: LOSS OF STEERING The steering column to steering wheel shaft may not have been assembled correctly. If not corrected noise and play will become apparent and if these warnings are not acted on eventually steering control could be lost.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary refit the steering column correctly to the steering wheel shaft.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LEAKAGE FROM THE DIESEL RETURN PIPE FIXED TO THE INTAKE MANIFOLD. It has been identified that the diesel fuel return pipe which is fixed to the inlet manifold may be abraded to the extent that if left undetected will leak.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles as a preventative measure will have the pipe inspected for damage. If any is found the pipe will be replaced. In cases where the pipe remains undamaged it will be fitted with reinforcement.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It is possible that the fuel return pipe may chaff on the diesel fuel filter support in the engine compartment.  This can if not identified result in a fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the addition of a protective sleeve to the return pipe.

citroen.defect: INSTRUMENT DISPLAY MAY TURN OFF INTERMITTENTLY The electrical switch of the steering lock may not conform to specification. This could cause the intermittent unwanted switching off of information displays on the instrument panel.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition switch.

citroen.defect: FUEL TUBES UNDER BODY MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME The fuel pipes under the body may have been damaged over time due to a relative movement between these pipes and their surroundings
citroen.remedy: Check the condition of the fuel pipes and replacing them if necessary.  New protection will be fitted on all vehicles to prevent this damage in the future.

citroen.defect: SEAT BELT FIXING BOLTS MAY LOOSEN The fixing bolts of the front LH and RH seat belt return rail may loosen and in cases of extreme force break.
citroen.remedy: The bolts on the left and right- hand sides will be replaced.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK ONTO ENGINE It is possible that a leak can occur between the injector spill rail connection and the plastic fuel return pipe. This can cause leakage of fuel which can either pool on the engine cylinder head and then become deposited onto the road surface where it could cause a skid risk to other motorist or if the fuel comes into contact with extremely hot engine components an exhaust manifold for instance it is possible that an under bonnet fire could ensue.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the sealing of the fuel return pipe connection on each injector and if necessary replace the injectors as well as the fuel return pipes.

citroen.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
citroen.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

citroen.defect: BONNET MAY BE INSECURE The bonnet lock fixing bolts may not be fully secure which can result in noise and vibration and in rare cases insecure holding by the bonnet catch and lock.
citroen.remedy: On recalled vehicles the tightness of the bonnet lock fixing bolts will be checked and where necessary tightened to specification.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The engine electronic cooling management control strategy and the maximum temperature alert threshold could cause the engine to overheat. This could result in a warning light and a message being displayed on the instrument panel.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

citroen.defect: THE FIXING BOLT OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The fixing bolt of the front Suspension wishbone may not be correct to specification.
citroen.remedy: Replace the fixing bolts and nuts of the front suspension wishbones.

citroen.defect: BONNET MAY OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY It has been identified that the bonnet striker support may corrode. If this corrosion is not treated there is a possibility the bonnet striker support may fail which will allow the bonnet to open whilst the vehicle is in motion. Early warning signs or symptoms of corrosion can be seen by the driver around the bonnet striker support and on the leading edge of the bonnet also the bonnet may not lock correctly.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to inspect the area around the bonnet striker support and take preventive action to protect the area from corrosion which may include the replacement of the bonnet if required.

citroen.remedy: The hydraulic ABS/ESP block will be checked and if necessary replaced.

citroen.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE The front right hand drive-shaft may fail.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to check and if necessary replace the right hand drive-shaft

citroen.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY It has been established that on some C3's the rigid section of the front brake hose may be deformed or twisted. This could result in a deterioration of the braking efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and inspect the brake hose for distortion and replace if required.

citroen.defect: WHEEL MAY DETACH It has been identified that the wheel bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification. The driver may experience a vibration through the steering wheel. However if not rectified there is a risk that the wheels may become damaged over time or the wheel could in extreme cases detach from the vehicle whilst driving. This could cause loss of control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the tightness of the road wheel bolts and rectify as necessary. In certain cases the replacement of the bolt(s) and wheel(s) may be necessary.

citroen.defect: WIPERS LIGHTS AND BATTERY CHARGING MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that one component of the computer that controls the operation of the wipers lighting and battery charging is not to specification. This can result in erratic operation or failure of one or all of the specified functions.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject computer replaced.

citroen.defect: LEFT HAND CURTAIN AIRBAG MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION A component within the left-hand curtain airbag may not conform to specification and the air bag may not deploy correctly.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the left hand curtain air bag.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION SPRINGS MAY BREAK In the exceptional event of a spring breaking there could be a risk of the spring making contact with the vehicle tyre.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a suspension cup to each side of the front suspension.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On the affected vehicles a possible non-conformity in the positioning of the fuel filler neck seal near the filler cap could cause a fuel leak when completely filling up the tank.
citroen.remedy: Checking and if necessary refit seal.

citroen.defect: FRONT AIR BAG IGNITERS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY Front air bag igniters may not deploy correctly.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected front airbags.

citroen.defect: FUEL TANK MOUNTINGS Fuel tank rear mountings may not adequately secure the tank with a risk of possible disengagement.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit additional bolts or reinforcement plates to rear tank mountings depending on original build configuration.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
citroen.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance). The timing belt will be checked and if needed replaced with other components of the braking assistance system and the vacuum pump.

citroen.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE COULD BECOME LOOSE The tightening torque for the front suspension wishbone mounting bolts has proved insufficient. This can lead to loosening represented by abnormal noise
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and retorque front suspension wishbone bolts

citroen.defect: THE SEAT FASTENING TO THE ANCHOR PLATE IS NOT CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION. The seat fastening to the anchor plate is not correct to specification.�
citroen.remedy: Replace�the swivel plates onto which the front seats are anchored.�

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel filter's integrated heater may be defective and could cause the cover to distort. This could cause air ingress and fuel egress. Either could cause poor starting and a warning light should illuminate
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace fuel heater cover. Check and if necessary replace connector.

citroen.defect: BRAKING MAY BE AFFECTED Braking assistance could be adversely by freezing of moisture that may accumulate in the vacuum circuit.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that may be affected and fit a separate air vent complete with filter to each electro valve fitted to the vacuum circuit.

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been identified that vehicles fitted with 2I HDI engines may have been fitted a vacuum pump which may not be to specification. This could lead to a decrease in braking assistance.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.

citroen.defect: LIGHTS MAY SWITCH OFF UNEXPECTEDLY It has been identified that due to incorrect positioning of the exterior lighting control ring by the lighting management system the lights may switch off unexpectedly.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the lighting management software updated

citroen.defect: SEAT BELT BUCKLE STRAP MAY FAIL The seat belt buckle fitted to the second row rear seat/s may have been damaged during the production process at the supplier. In the event of an impact the seat belt buckle strap could fail and not restrain the occupant correctly.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the batch numbers and where necessary replace the seat belt buckle.

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

citroen.defect: SEATBELT MAY NOT OPERATE AS DESIGNED The seat belt locking action may not be as fast as it is designed to be.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that may be affecte check the date of manufacture of the seat belts and where necessary replace the seat belts.

citroen.defect: DOORS MAY OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY A manufacturing defect of a component within any of the four door locks could result in jamming of the internal mechanism which prevents the closing of any of the vehicle's doors or risk unexpected unlocking and opening of the doors.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the affected door locks.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles some DS7 CROSSBACK equipped with ESP (electronic stability program) may be fitted with the incorrect calibration when operating in All-Wheel Drive Affected vehicles equipped with ESP (electronic stability program) may be fitted with the incorrect calibration when operating in All-Wheel Drive
citroen.remedy: Update the ESP calibration software

citroen.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

citroen.defect: BELOW 3 DEGREES TEMPERATURE THERE IS LOSS OF THE FRONT WINDSCREEN WIPER FUNCTION WHEN THE VEHICLE STOPS AT 0MPH. When the outside temperature is below 3�C there is loss of the front windscreen wiper function when the vehicle stops at 0 mph.
citroen.remedy: Downloading a new version of BSI software

citroen.defect: BONNET MAY OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY It has been identified that the striker wire on the bonnet lining may not have sufficient support to prove it with the security for its intended purpose. This can lead to incorrect locking of the bonnet over time and could result in an unintentional release of the bonnet. The driver will received early warning signs or symptoms by the incorrect locking of the bonnet.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect and if required an additional strengthener to retain the striker cable on the inner panel of the bonnet. In some cases there maybe a requirement to replace the bonnet.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY REVERT TO BACK UP MODE.BRAKE ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE The original ECU software could generate an excessive vibration of the injection butterfly. In very rare cases the butterfly upper stop may fail causing the engine to go to back up mode which may result in a drop of brake assistance efficiency
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and download new engine ECU software and initialisation of the ECU.

citroen.defect: AIRBAG LIGHT MAY COME ON INADVERTENTLY Due to draining of the condensation from the air conditioning system into the passenger compartment the air bag warning light may activate unintentionally. This in extreme cases may cause the air bag system to malfunction.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the sealing of the pipe which drains the condensation from the air conditioning system improved.

citroen.defect: FRONT AXLE MAY DETACH The front axle fixings may not have been tightened sufficiently. This may result in the front axle becoming insecure which may in rare cases if not corrected cause directional control to become impaired.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the front axle fixings and where necessary tighten them to specification.

citroen.defect: WIPER MOTOR MAY FAIL An internal fault with the wiper motor could cause it to stop working. In some rare cases the windscreen wipers may stop working while in operation.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the manufacturing date of the wiper motor and add a supplementary earth wiring harness if necessary.

citroen.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS FITTED MIGHT NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION The High Voltage Harness might not be to the correct specification.
citroen.remedy: Check the harness conformity and replace it if necessary.

citroen.defect: WIPERS / LIGHTS/ BATTERY CHARGING MAY BE AFFECTED. An incorrect engine relay unit may have been fitted. This ECU could deteriorate and cause operating faults and perhaps failure of certain equipment
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check Engine Relay Unit and replace if not correct specification.

citroen.defect: FRONT BRAKE PIPE CHAFE CONDITION It is possible that the front brake pipe may be contacted by the anti-roll bar link rod. In extreme conditions this may result in fluid leakage and partial loss of braking.
citroen.remedy: The affected vehicles will be recalled and inspected for contact between the brake pipes and the anti-roll bar link. If no contact has taken place the pipe(s) will be re-set to ensure adequate clearance . Any pipes showing signs of contact will be replaced

citroen.defect: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminaL. Correct it if necessary and add additional protection.

citroen.defect: REAR SUSPENSION CROSS MEMBER MAY HAVE BEEN CUT The rear suspension cross member may have been cut in production. This could eventually result in failure of the cross member and cause loss of control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Replace any rear suspension  cross member found to be cut.

citroen.defect: SEAT BELT FIXING BOLTS MAY LOOSEN The fixing bolts of the front LH and RH seat belt return rail may loosen and in cases of extreme force break.
citroen.remedy: The bolts on the left and right- hand sides will be replaced.

citroen.defect: CHAFING OF BRAKE PIPES There may be inadequate clearance between one or both brake pipes at the master cylinder and a coolant pipe bracket on the cylinder head. Intermittent contact can consequently occur due to engine movement under high load. Should any of the brake
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and inspect and re-route the subject brake pipes. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

citroen.defect: INABILITY TO CHANGE GEAR Over time partial wear of the gearbox control harnesses may occur due to contact with surrounding components. Gear selection may be affected as a result of electrical faults in some rare cases including the lighting of the warning lamp on the instrument panel and the driveability of the vehicle may be compromised.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the condition of the gearbox control harness and where necessary fit additional protection.

citroen.defect: Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe. Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
citroen.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

citroen.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS FITTED MIGHT NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION The High Voltage Harness might not be to the correct specification.
citroen.remedy: Check the harness conformity and replace it if necessary.

citroen.defect: THE OPERATION OF THE BRAKE VACUMN PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED DUE TO MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected due to material detaching from the timing belt.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the timing belt and other components of the braking assistance system including the vacuum pump. Additionally alter servicing schedules depending on usage.

citroen.defect: DS7 4x4 eTense vehicles equipped with 205/55 R19 97V A class Michelin Primacy 3 tyres may experience premature wearing of the insides of the rear tyres DS7 4x4 eTense vehicles equipped with 205/55 R19 97V A class Michelin Primacy 3  tyres may experience premature wearing of the insides of the rear tyres.
citroen.remedy: Fit A class tyres of dimension 235/50 R19 103V as well as different wheel rims.

citroen.defect: THE STEERING RACK ASSEMBLY MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The steering rack assembly may not be correct to specification.
citroen.remedy: Replace the steering rack assembly and the fixings.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL An internal component of the injector may not be to specification which could reduce the fuel pressure in the injection system. The concern can prevent the engine starting and/or cause the engine to stall.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the identification number of the engine injectors. Where necessary replace the injectors.
