citroen.defect: THE REAR SUSPENSION SPRING MAY BECOME DETACHED FROM THE LOWER LOCATING CUP It is possible for the rear suspension spring to become detached from the lower locating cup.
citroen.remedy: Replace both rear suspension springs and their upper and lower locating cups.

citroen.defect: FRONT AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS DESIGNED IN A FRONTAL IMPACT It has been identified that the front air bag ECU may not take full account of frontal impacts that are below the legal threshold for triggering deployment.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the air bag ECU re-programmed.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The battery earth return cable maybe too short which during vehicle operation may cause it to fail at its gearbox mounting point.  This could result in the engine cutting out.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and replace the battery earth return cable.

citroen.defect: LOSS OF POWER Gear selection may be affected by inaccurate software being installed.
citroen.remedy: The recalled vehicles will be subject to a software upgrade.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It is possible that the fuel return pipe may chaff on the diesel fuel filter support in the engine compartment.  This can if not identified result in a fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the addition of a protective sleeve to the return pipe.

citroen.defect: REAR SEAT CUSHION MAY BECOME INSECURE Following a manufacturing issue the rear sear cushion fixings may become damaged and the cushion may not stay in place
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace rear seat cushion fixings

citroen.defect: THE OPERATION OF THE BRAKE VACUMN PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED DUE TO MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected due to material detaching from the timing belt.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the timing belt and other components of the braking assistance system including the vacuum pump. Additionally alter servicing schedules depending on usage.

citroen.defect: INCORRECT CATALYTIC CONVERTOR FITTED TO EXHAUST SYSTEM Affected Vehicles have been fitted with an exhaust system which is not correct to specification
citroen.remedy: Install correct exhaust system catalytic convertor.

citroen.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE COULD BECOME LOOSE The tightening torque for the front suspension wishbone mounting bolts has proved insufficient. This can lead to loosening represented by abnormal noise
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and retorque front suspension wishbone bolts

citroen.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE COULD BECOME LOOSE The tightening torque for the front suspension wishbone mounting bolts has proved insufficient. This can lead to loosening represented by abnormal noise
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and retorque front suspension wishbone bolts

citroen.defect: DUE TO THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE NOX EMISSIONS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS The calibration of the engine management software could result in emissions of NOx which do not comply with the regulatory limits.
citroen.remedy: Download new engine management software

citroen.defect: THE WELD PLATES OF THE TAILGATE STRUT MOUNTING PLATES MAY NOT CONFORM The weld securing the tailgate struts may not be strong enough to support the tailgate in the long term and may detach. If this happens the tailgate may not remain in the open position.
citroen.remedy: In the event of the weld not meeting conformity the tailgate must be replaced.

citroen.defect: MALFUNCTIONS IN ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS It has been identified that some ground connections of the cabin wiring harness and the fixings of the airbag control unit may not be to specification. This issue or non-compliance could cause erratic malfunctions of certain electrical equipment even in very rare cases causing the engine to cut-off or airbags malfunction.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check tightness of the ground connections and airbag control unit fixings.  If required these will need rectification.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It has been established that the con-rod (big end) shell bearings may not have been manufactured to specification. This could lead to premature deterioration of the shells and if not identified it could result in engine failure.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace con-rod shell bearings.

citroen.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF EXTENDED BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL It has been identified that a brake hose may become worn as a result of rubbing contact against the heat shield protecting the exhaust system. This may lead in extreme cases to a leak from a brake circuit which manifests itself in increased brake pedal travel.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the exhaust heat shield adjusted in order to maintain the correct distance from the subject brake hose. Should the hose display signs of wear it will be replaced.

citroen.defect: HEATER BLOWER MODULE - RISK OF FIRE There is a possibility of defective components in the heater blower which could cause a short circuit and a loss of ventilation of the passenger compartment and in an extreme condition could set fire to the wiring harness.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace heater blower module.

citroen.defect: THE PASSENGER OUTER SEAT BELT MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The passenger outer seat belts may not be correct to specification
citroen.remedy: Replace the front outer passenger seat belt.

citroen.defect: CLUTCH LEVER MAY FOUL ENGINE WIRING There is a possibility that the clutch lever may foul a moulded clip which secures the engine wiring harness. Should this occur the clip may open releasing the harness and making it liable to chafing and damage by the clutch lever.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and substitute a nylon fixing strap for the original moulded harness clip. This will ensure adequate operating clearance for the clutch lever.

citroen.defect: THE OPEN CIRCUIT DETECTION SYSTEM COULD BE OVER SENSITIVE CAUSING A NUMBER OF OPERATIONAL ISSUES A possibility that the open circuit detection system could be over-sensitivite causing a number of operational issues including sudden power loss.
citroen.remedy: Download the latest software configuration check some electronic units and replace them if necessary.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LEAKAGE FROM THE DIESEL RETURN PIPE FIXED TO THE INTAKE MANIFOLD. It has been identified that the diesel fuel return pipe which is fixed to the inlet manifold may be abraded to the extent that if left undetected will leak.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles as a preventative measure will have the pipe inspected for damage. If any is found the pipe will be replaced. In cases where the pipe remains undamaged it will be fitted with reinforcement.

citroen.defect: COOLING SYSTEM STRATEGY COULD OVERHEAT THE ENGINE. The cooling system strategy and the maximum temperature alert could cause the engine to overheat this may cause an oil leak from the sump drain cap.  Due to the incorrect operation of the warning system there is no driver alert.
citroen.remedy: The remedy involves downloading new engine management software.

citroen.defect: WHEEL BOLTS MAY BECOME LOOSE It is possible that the left hand wheel bolts may not have been torqued to the correct specification. This could lead to noise or vibration from the wheels and if not rectified it could result in wheel detachment and loss of control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if necessary re-torque the wheel bolts.

citroen.defect: STARTER SUPPLY WIRE MAY CHAFE The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary.

citroen.defect: THE FRONT HUB ASSEMBLY FIXING ON TO THE FRONT SUSPENSION DAMPER MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The front hub assembly fixing on to the front suspension damper may not be correct to specification.
citroen.remedy: Check the front hub assembly and replace if required.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that there is a risk of the engine stalling under very firm braking conditions.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the engine ECU software upgraded.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF ROAD WHEEL Under severe operating conditions and high mileage the pressed aluminium road wheels may crack around the wheel fixing holes. This could ultimately result in the detachment of a wheel.
citroen.remedy: Replace the wheels with a modified type.

citroen.defect: THE INCORRECT GEAR MAYBE SELECTED It has been identified that the reverse gear locking collar on the gear lever may not have been manufacturered to specification. This could result the incorret selection of gears.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the locking collar.

citroen.defect: MAY CAUSE DAMAGE TO DRIVE BELTS The fixing bracket of the air unit on the engine may break under the effect of vibration.  This could affect some of the surrounding components.
citroen.remedy: Remove the bracket and replace with washers

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY This concern relates to right hand drive vehicles only. There may cases of the brake linkage lever being defectively assembled which may result in a loss of braking efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected check and where necessary reposition the brake pedal relay linkage lever.

citroen.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION MAY NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION Possible slackening of the front wishbone ball joint.
citroen.remedy: Increasing the tightening torque of the ball joint and adding thread lock if the ball joint threads are found to be rusty or loose the ball joint will be replaced.

citroen.defect: THE INNER TIE RODS ARE NOT CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The inner tie rods connecting the steering rack to the track rod end are not correct to specification
citroen.remedy: Replace the steering rack inner tie rods (on both sides)

citroen.remedy: Check the affected vehicles and add the missing earthing connection wire between the box and the body if necessary.

citroen.defect: THE AMOUNT OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE MAY VARY There is a possibility that a component internal to the steering mechanism may not be manufactured to the correct specification which over time can cause the steering to become either stiff or easier to operate.

citroen.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY On affected vehicles the drivers airbag nay not be of conformity.  This non-conformity could lead to poor deployment of the airbag in the event of a collision.

citroen.defect: Citroen Berlingo Tyre Pressure Label Affected vehicles may have incorrect or missing information on the tyre pressure label.

citroen.remedy: Check the bonding of the front bumper lower trim and rectify or replace it if necessary

citroen.defect: RISK OF FIRE The starter motor wiring harness may be subject to long term wear due to rubbing. This can cause electrical problems or in the worst case a fire.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to add further protection to the starter motor wiring harness.

citroen.defect: Alternator protection Affected vehicles may have been assembled with contact or with a reduced clearance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. citroen.remedy: Replace the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator.  Check the distance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator and re‑position or replace the pipe if required.

citroen.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

citroen.defect: MCU inverter On affected vehicles the Motor Control Unit (MCU) Inverter may have a manufacturing deviation which could lead to gearbox malfunctions and the risk of an internal electrical short circuit leading to overheating or a fire.

citroen.defect: VSM software missing AEB telltale in case of blind camera. On certain Citroen vehicles the Automatic Emergency Braking Assist  telltale fails to illuminate if the front camera is blocked. No AEB warning  telltale meaning no warning light appears in the instrument cluster. An  additional pop-up appears for around 10 seconds at each key on/key off  (Driving Assistance Sensor Blind: clean sensor see User Manual). The  Automatic Emergency Braking system is operating in a degraded mode but  remains functional due to radar support.
citroen.remedy: To rectify this issue we will update the Vehicle System Management software

citroen.defect: Power Steering Wiring Harness. Affected vehicles may have a power steering harness routed between two screws where minor vibrations could cause harness damage resulting in a possible short circuit.  This could lead to a loss of power‑steering assistance and in worst case a fire.
citroen.remedy: Ensure new routing and protection of the harness by replacing the existing clip with a new one and add a cap on the bolt thread.

citroen.defect: Citroen C3 Front Camera Software versions update. Affected vehicles equipped with a multifunctional front camera module may face a non-compliance to regulatory requirements due to incorrect front camera module calibration.
citroen.remedy: Update the front camera module software and the vehicle software configuration.

citroen.defect: Speed Limitation – BCM software Affected vehicles may have the incorrect speed limit displayed.
citroen.remedy: Update the Body Control Module Software.

citroen.defect: BCM software update – Black screen On affected vehicles a software defect in the instrument cluster may prevent the cluster display from switching on when the vehicle is started resulting in a black screen.
citroen.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

citroen.defect: Water Pump Pulley On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity the water pump may malfunction which may cause a loss of engine power and result in the engine shutting down.
citroen.remedy: Replace the water pump.

citroen.defect: Water Pump Pulley On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity the water pump may malfunction which may cause a loss of engine power and result in the engine shutting down.
citroen.remedy: Replace the water pump.

citroen.defect: Citroen C3 v5 Autonomous telematics box cannot connect to server On affected vehicles there may be a software bug in the Body Control Module (BCM) which prevents a connection to the server and affects the speed limit indication system.
citroen.remedy: Update the BCM software.

citroen.defect: Citroen Berlingo (K9) Wrong Wheel Bolts. On affected vehicles the incorrect wheel bolts may have been fitted which could result in loosening or loss of the bolts.
citroen.remedy: Check the correct bolts are fitted and replace if necessary.

citroen.defect: Citroen Spacetourer (K0) Berlingo (K9) IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
citroen.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

citroen.defect: Citroen Cross carline Fuel injection common rail. On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

citroen.defect: Citroen Cross carline Fuel injection common rail. On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

citroen.defect: Citroen Cross carline Fuel injection common rail. On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

citroen.defect: Citroen Relay Fuel Pipe Leak Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY This concern relates to right hand drive vehicles only. There may cases of the brake linkage lever being defectively assembled which may result in a loss of braking efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected check and where necessary reposition the brake pedal relay linkage lever.

citroen.defect: PARKING BRAKE CABLE MAY BREAK There is a possibility that the parking brake cable may not be to the correct specification and could break at the rear section resulting in loss of parking brake.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace parking brake cable.

citroen.defect: THE STEERING COLUMN UNIVERSAL JOINT CLAMP MAY BE INCORRECTLY FITTED TO THE STEERING COLUMN The universal clamp fixing bolt is not correctly fitted in the recess at the end of the steering column.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary refit the steering column universal joint fixing.

citroen.defect: DOOR MAY OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY A manufacturing defect in one of the components of the door locks could cause jamming of the internal mechanism and prevent the closing of one or more of the vehicle's doors. In rare cases the door could unlock and open unexpectedly.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace door locks.

citroen.defect: ADHESIVE USED TO FIX SUNROOF GLASS ASSEMBLY TO OUTER FRAME MAY NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION There is a possibility that the sunroof glass assembly could detach itself from the outer frame
citroen.remedy: Replace the sunroof assembly.

citroen.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE LOST The torque settings of the fixings of the front suspension fuel tank fuel cooler and the rear wheels have been set incorrectly. Consequences of the incorrect torque settings include abnormal noise and poor operation of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Retighten to the correct torque value the front suspension fixings fuel tank fixings fuel cooler fixing and rear wheel bolts.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The engine electronic cooling management control strategy and the maximum temperature alert threshold could cause the engine to overheat. This could result in a warning light and a message being displayed on the instrument panel.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

citroen.defect: VEHICLE MAY CUT OUT The supply terminal to the engine relay unit may have been over tightened and over time this could damage the component and cause the engine to cut out. In addition this could cause the diagnostic warning lamp to illuminate in error and it may make it more difficult to start the engine.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary replace the engine relay unit.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
citroen.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

citroen.defect: FAILURE OF CAMSHAFT DRIVE BELT The camshaft drive belt may fail before the recommended replacement interval of 72000 miles. This could result in a complete loss of engine power without warning.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement camshaft drive belt.

citroen.defect: LH SEAT MAY BECOME DETACHED IN A COLLISION The left hand rear seat may not be fully secure because the right hand seat fixing may have been welded incorrectly. If the weld is incorrect the seat may detach during an accident.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary repair the seat fixing.

citroen.defect: INCORRECT SUBFRAME BOLT TORQUE MAY AFFECT VEHICLE HANDLING The bolts securing the engine cradle to the chassis may not be fully secure. There is a possibility that the bolts may loosen which will result in noise vibration and in rare cases an alteration in vehicle handling.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace all the securing bolts and tighten them to the correct specification.

citroen.defect: A PLASTIC COMPONENT INSIDE THE EXHAUST LINE COULD DAMAGE THE DIESEL PARTICLE FILTER A plastic component inside the exhaust line could under certain circumstances damage the diesel particle filter.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the particle filter.

citroen.defect: SERVICE BRAKE LINKAGE MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED. A locking clip may not have been fitted correctly to one or more of the five clevis pins connecting the footbrake relay linkage inside the cabin. Disconnection of the linkage will result in the loss of service braking.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check that all five locking clips are secure.

citroen.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU Water ingress into the airbag electronic control unit (ECU) could result in illumination of the warning light and in the worst case unintentional deployment of the airbag.
citroen.remedy: Seal the airbag ECU compartment.

citroen.defect: ABS CONTROL UNIT MAY OVERHEAT The anti lock brake control unit may overheat and cause the footbrake to revert to none anti lock mode.
citroen.remedy: Check the ABS control unit identification number and replace the control unit where found necessary.

citroen.defect: MALFUNCTIONS IN ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS It has been identified that some ground connections of the cabin wiring harness and the fixings of the airbag control unit may not be to specification. This issue or non-compliance could cause erratic malfunctions of certain electrical equipment even in very rare cases causing the engine to cut-off or airbags malfunction.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check tightness of the ground connections and airbag control unit fixings.  If required these will need rectification.

citroen.defect: REAR DAMPER MAY BECOME  INSECURE The rear dampers lower fixing bolts may become loose.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check conformity of damper lower fixing bolt and replace if necessary

citroen.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
citroen.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel injectors supply rail could develop a leak over a period of time leading to a drop in fuel pressure in the injector supply rail which can affect the operation of the stop start system. In some extreme cases the engine might not restart and a spray of petrol under the bonnet may occur which is a fire risk.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fuel injector supply rail. Where necessary replace the fuel injector supply rail.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE DISENGAGEMENT OF DRIVING SEAT CATCH There is a risk of disengagement of the drivers seat catch allowing the seat to move on its runners.
citroen.remedy: The recall operation will check the security of the seat runner which will be replaced if necessary. In some cases replacement of the seat frame will be required.

citroen.defect: SEAT BELT FIXING BOLTS MAY LOOSEN The fixing bolts of the front LH and RH seat belt return rail may loosen and in cases of extreme force break.
citroen.remedy: The bolts on the left and right- hand sides will be replaced.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
citroen.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance). The timing belt will be checked and if needed replaced with other components of the braking assistance system and the vacuum pump.

citroen.defect: AIRBAG MAY INCORRECTLY DEPLOY On affected vehicles the driver's air bag inflation device may not conform to specification. As a result may not deploy correctly during an impact.
citroen.remedy: Replace the driver's air bag module on affected vehicles

citroen.defect: FRONT AIR BAG IGNITERS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY Front air bag igniters may not deploy correctly.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected front airbags.

citroen.defect: WATER MAY PENETRATE INTO THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP CAUSING CORROSION Water may penetrate into the brake vacuum pump causing corrosion.
citroen.remedy: Replace the brake vacuum pump.

citroen.defect: RISK OF PARTIAL DE-BONDING OF GLASS PANORAMIC ROOF MOULDING. It has been identified that in the event of incorrect bonding there is a risk of the partial release of the glass panoramic roof moulding such that it becomes visible to the driver. If the concern is not rectified in the long term; the moulding could detach. It should be noted that there is no risk to the integrity of the sealing of the affected area.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the bonding of the moulding checked and replaced as necessary.

citroen.defect: THE TIGHTENING OF THE REAR SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The tightening of some rear suspension fixings may not be correct to specification
citroen.remedy: Correcting some tightening torques and replacing some nuts and bolts.

citroen.defect: A PLASTIC COMPONENT INSIDE THE EXHAUST LINE COULD DAMAGE THE DIESEL PARTICLE FILTER A plastic component inside the exhaust line could under certain circumstances damage the diesel particle filter.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the particle filter.

citroen.defect: FRONT AXLE MAY DETACH The front axle fixings may not have been tightened sufficiently. This may result in the front axle becoming insecure which may in rare cases if not corrected cause directional control to become impaired.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the front axle fixings and where necessary tighten them to specification.

citroen.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

citroen.defect: FRONT AIR BAG IGNITERS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY Front air bag igniters may not deploy correctly.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected front airbags.

citroen.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Braking maybe impaired due to some brake pipes not being manufactured to conformity.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the serial numbers of the brake pipes and to replace the brake pipes where necessary.

citroen.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR/RISK OF FIRE Repeated ingress of saline water into the connections to the Electronic Control Unit for the Anti- Lock Braking system may eventually result in a short circuit that could cause a fire in the engine compartment.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the ABS block and strengthen the sealing of the electrical connections.

citroen.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

citroen.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The brake servo pump system could develop problems with malfunction indicator lamps and audible warnings accompanied by the vacuum pump stopping. This will require the driver to apply greater force on the brake pedal to stop the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download the vacuum pump with a new version of the control software.

citroen.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT COMPLETELY DEPLOY The front passenger air bag may not fully deploy in an impact.
citroen.remedy: Fit a replacement air bag.

citroen.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL In the event of emergency braking or during an ESP regulation phase (e.g. avoiding manoeuvre) the hydraulic block may not prevent the locking of a wheel which could affect  control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the braking system hydraulic block

citroen.defect: SPARE WHEEL TYRE PRESSURE INCORRECTLY STATED ON INFORMATION LABEL On subject vehicles the indication of 2.5 bar pressure for the spare wheel  which can be found on a label affixed to the left hand door pillar  is incorrect for the vehicle specification.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a replacement label affixed to the vehicle which will indicate the correct spare tyre pressure i.e. 4.2 bar. It should be noted that at manufacturethe tyre was inflated to the correct pressure however as a precaution the pressure of the spare wheel will be checked.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION SPRINGS MAY BREAK In the exceptional event of a spring breaking there could be a risk of the spring making contact with the vehicle tyre.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a suspension cup to each side of the front suspension.

citroen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LEAKAGE FROM THE DIESEL RETURN PIPE FIXED TO THE INTAKE MANIFOLD. It has been identified that the diesel fuel return pipe which is fixed to the inlet manifold may be abraded to the extent that if left undetected will leak.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles as a preventative measure will have the pipe inspected for damage. If any is found the pipe will be replaced. In cases where the pipe remains undamaged it will be fitted with reinforcement.

citroen.defect: DUE TO THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE NOX EMISSIONS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS The calibration of the engine management software could result in emissions of NOx which do not comply with the regulatory limits.
citroen.remedy: Download new engine management software

citroen.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY BE LOST Possible oil seepage in the brake assistance circuit that could damage the brake amplifier membrane and reduce braking assistance.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the vacuum circuit valve and pipe which link the vacuum pump to the brake amplifier.

citroen.defect: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT It has been identified that due to a possible non-conformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body there is the possibility that water can enter the passenger compartment of the vehicle.  The occupants should experience either wet carpets and or a possible damp smell.  However the ingress of water into the cabin could affect the electrical operation of the airbag module which could lead to an unexpected deployment of the airbag.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to add additional sealant to the body interfaces and if required to replace any interior components damaged by the water ingress.

citroen.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
citroen.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque.

citroen.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
citroen.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel filter's integrated heater may be defective and could cause the cover to distort. This could cause air ingress and fuel egress. Either could cause poor starting and a warning light should illuminate
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace fuel heater cover. Check and if necessary replace connector.

citroen.defect: REAR SCREEN MAY NOT REMAIN IN OPEN POSITION. The ball mountings for the rear screen support struts may dislocate and the screen will not remain in open position
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check security/tightness of strut mounting balls and replace any that are damaged.

citroen.defect: AIRBAG MAY OPERATE INCORRECTLY The passenger airbag wiring harness connector may not be to specification which can cause the illumination of the warning light on the dashboard or if involved in a impact the incorrect deployment of the airbag.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the passenger airbag wiring harness.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
citroen.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance). The timing belt will be checked and if needed replaced with other components of the braking assistance system and the vacuum pump.

citroen.defect: AIRBAG MAY INCORRECTLY DEPLOY On affected vehicles the driver's air bag inflation device may not conform to specification. As a result may not deploy correctly during an impact.
citroen.remedy: Replace the driver's air bag module on affected vehicles

citroen.defect: ELECTRIC PARKING BRAKE MAY MALFUNCTION It has been identified that due to a nonconformity in one of the operating cables of the Electric Parking Brake (FSE) it is possible that insufficient application (force) will be applied. This could result in only one wheel operating or locked. The driver however will receive warning of the issue by the illumination of the Parking Brake Warning Lamp on the instrument panel along with a message on the multifuction screen.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection repair or if required the replacement of the cable.

citroen.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION MAY FAIL The front suspension wishbones fixing bolts may not be to the correct specification which could lead to a risk of them breaking. This may affetc the driver's ability to control the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the wishbone fixing bolts.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It has been established that the con-rod (big end) shell bearings may not have been manufactured to specification. This could lead to premature deterioration of the shells and if not identified it could result in engine failure.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace con-rod shell bearings.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On the affected vehicles a possible non-conformity in the positioning of the fuel filler neck seal near the filler cap could cause a fuel leak when completely filling up the tank.
citroen.remedy: Checking and if necessary refit seal.

citroen.defect: VEHICLES AFFECTED MAY HAVE A SINGLE WHEEL BOLT ON BOTH RIGHT HAND SIDE WHEELS WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY A single wheel bolt on both Right-hand wheels may not be tightened to the correct tightening torque.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace wheel bolts and any other associated parts if consequential damage has occurred.

citroen.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

citroen.defect: BRAKE PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED Residual low pressure persists in the power braking vacuum circuit which may result in the loss of power assistance when braking.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a calibrated air vent in the vacuum circuit.

citroen.defect: THE UREA INJECTOR MAY BLOCK AND LEAD TO NOX EMISSIONS OUT OF REGULATORY LIMITS On affected vehicles there may be a defect in the operation of the urea injector which may become blocked leading to NOx emissions exceeding regulatory limits.
citroen.remedy: Update the ECU software to avoid the blockage of the urea injector

citroen.defect: THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE CALIBRATION COULD BE INCORRECT. The engine management software calibration could be incorrect causing engine stall.
citroen.remedy: Upload updated engine management software.

citroen.defect: SEATBELT MAY FAIL The tightening torque for the front and rear right hand seat belt lower mountings may not be correct to specification. This could lead to the mountings detaching and in a collision additional injury to the driver.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and rectify the tightening torques for the front and rear right hand seat belt lower mountings.

citroen.defect: REAR CROSS MEMBER MAY CRACK Over a period of time a small crack can appear on the rear axle cross member particularly under conditions of repeated maximum suspension travel. The small crack could increase in size and eventually lead to the rear wheel rubbing on the wheel arch.
citroen.remedy: Replace the rear axle cross member and suspension bump stops.

citroen.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION BALL JOINT CONCERN The front suspension lower ball joint pinch bolts may not have been fully tightened.  In the worst case separation of the ball joint from the suspension arm would affect directional control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Check the ball joint pinch bolts for correct torque and tighten where necessary.

citroen.defect: THE WHEEL BOLTS MAY HAVE AN INCOMPLETE THREAD On affected vehicles the wheel bolts may have an incomplete thread.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the wheel bolts.

citroen.defect: A COMPONENT OF THE HANDBRAKE MECHANISM MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The handbrake mechanism may not be correct to specification.
citroen.remedy: Check the handbrake mechanism and if necessary replace the hand brake lever.

citroen.defect: ANTI THEFT WHEEL BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION. On the affected vehicles the tightening torques of the anti-theft wheel bolts may not be to the correct to specification.
citroen.remedy: The remedy involves correcting the anti-theft wheel bolts tightening torques.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL Due to incorrect machining it is possible that the crankshaft is not to the correct specification which can lead to insufficient lubrication of the crankshaft and subsequent engine failure.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the engine.

citroen.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On certain vehicles the front brake discs may not be the required thickness for the vehicle definition. This concern may result in reduced braking efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the front brake discs.

citroen.defect: HEADRESTS ON THE FRONT MODULAR SEAT DO NOT CONFORM TO THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION Affected vehicles may have been equipped with headrests on the front modular seat which do not conform to the design specification.
citroen.remedy: Check the conformity of the front headrests (presence of the catch); in cases of non-conformity the front headrests will be replaced.

citroen.defect: THE FITTING OF THE REAR LEFT BRAKE PIPE MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The fitting of the rear left brake pipe may not be correct to specification
citroen.remedy: Check the correct fitting of the left hand brake pipe adjust or replace the pipe as necessary

citroen.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY On affected vehicles the drivers airbag nay not be of conformity.  This non-conformity could lead to poor deployment of the airbag in the event of a collision.
citroen.remedy: Replace drivers airbag

citroen.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL The front shock absorber rod may have an internal fault which could cause it to brake. This could have an adverse affect on the front suspension and the driver's ability to control the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace both front shock absorbers.

citroen.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
citroen.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

citroen.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure.   In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

citroen.defect: THE BONNET HOOK MAY NOT BE SECURED CORRECTLY It is possible that the bonnet hook may not be secured correctly with securing nuts.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary fit new nuts or replace the bonnet assembly.

citroen.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to the Non-Conformity of the handbrake adjustment system in the handbrake mechanism it is possible that there can be a reduction in the efficiency of the parking brake.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the handbrake lever mechanism.

citroen.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL In the event of emergency braking or during an ESP regulation phase (e.g. avoiding manoeuvre) the hydraulic block may not prevent the locking of a wheel which could affect  control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the braking system hydraulic block

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LEAKAGE OF FUEL FROM THE AUXILLARY HEATER UNIT. On some vehicles equipped with a Webasto auxiliary heating unit there is the possibility of a leakage of fuel from the auxiliary heater unit.
citroen.remedy: : Modify the Webasto additional heater unit power supply routing and update the body electronic control unit software.

citroen.defect: STARTER SUPPLY WIRE MAY CHAFE The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary.

citroen.defect: ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM CONCERN A defect in the ABS (Antilock Brake) ring on the front wheel bearings may cause a malfunction of the Antilock Brake System.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit new front wheel bearings.

citroen.defect: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE REAR BRAKE CALLIPERS A non-conformity of the rear brake callipers could reduce the efficiency of the parking brake
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the callipers.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
citroen.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF VEHICLE ROLLING AWAY WHILST PARKED Instances have occurred of Xantia vehicles moving away following an incomplete application of the parking brake by the driver.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles to fit a modified parking brake lever which will prevent the driver from making only a partial application of the parking brake.

citroen.defect: THE RIVET USED TO RETAIN THE CURTAIN AIR BAG COULD BE INCORRECTLY FITTED The rivet used to retain the curtain airbag in some vehicles could be incorrectly fitted.
citroen.remedy: Check if the curtain airbag is correctly retained by the rivet and if necessary refit the curtain airbag correctly.

citroen.defect: THE BRAKE PIPE FIXINGS MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION The brake pipe fixings may not conform to specification
citroen.remedy: Checking and repairing these fixings and replacing any damaged pipes as necessary

citroen.defect: STARTER SUPPLY WIRE MAY CHAFE The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary.

citroen.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL In the event of emergency braking or during an ESP regulation phase (e.g. avoiding manoeuvre) the hydraulic block may not prevent the locking of a wheel which could affect  control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the braking system hydraulic block

citroen.defect: THE LOWER METAL ENGINE PROTECTION GUARD AND THE UNDERSIDE OF THE ENGINE EXHAUST SYSTEM  COULD TRAP MATERIAL IN IT. The possibility that the lower metal engine protection guard could trap material between it and the underside of the engine exhaust system.
citroen.remedy: Replace the metal under engine protection guard with a different design to prevent the collection of material.

citroen.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY FAIL TO RETURN TO IDLE WHEN RELEASED It has been identified that on affected vehicles a non conformity within the accelerator pedal assembly may cause interference and prevent the pedal from returning to its original position. This may result in the vehicle maintaining a degree of acceleration which can be overcome by firm braking.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the accelerator pedal changed.

citroen.defect: FRONT SEAT BELT MAY NOT LOCK CORRECTLY The front seat belts may not lock in the buckles correctly which will have the affect of the front passengers not being sufficiently restrained in the case of a violent impact.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary repair the seat belt locking mechanism.

citroen.defect: THE FILTERING PERFORMANCE OF THE DIESEL PARTICULATE FILTER MAY NOT MEET THE REQUIRED SPECIFICATION The filtering performance of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) may not meet the required specification.
citroen.remedy: Replace the DPF on affected vehicles.

citroen.defect: REAR SEAT SECURITY MAY FAIL IN AN IMPACT Possible nonconformity of the welding between the cross rail under the floor and its end piece.  This possible nonconformity may mean that the rear seats are not held correctly in place in the event of a serious impact.
citroen.remedy: Checking of the assembly and repair if necessary.

citroen.defect: VEHICLES AFFECTED MAY HAVE A SINGLE WHEEL BOLT ON BOTH LEFT HAND SIDE WHEELS WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY A single wheel bolt on both left-hand wheels may not be tightened to the correct tightening torque.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace wheel bolts and any other associated parts if consequential damage has occurred.

citroen.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY WORK LOOSE The accelerator pedal plate may have been fitted with nuts that are not of the correct specification. In time the nuts may work loose making the pedal feel insecure.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the three accelerator pedal plate fixing nuts.

citroen.defect: THE STITCHING PATTERN USED ON THE REAR SEAT BELT MATERIAL IS NOT TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION On affected vehicles some rear seat belts may have incorrect stitching on the belt material to connect the buckle to the anchor plate.
citroen.remedy: Check seat belts and relace if necessary.

citroen.defect: WIPERS / LIGHTS/ BATTERY CHARGING MAY BE AFFECTED. An incorrect engine relay unit may have been fitted. This ECU could deteriorate and cause operating faults and perhaps failure of certain equipment
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check Engine Relay Unit and replace if not correct specification.

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL LEAK It has been identified that on certain vehicles a fault may be present on the diesel fuel circuit return pipe ay the location of the pressure sensor.In the manufacture of the pipe an excess of material resulted in a reduction of the pipe's internal diameter therefore restricting the fuel flow and a risk of a diesel leak from the fuel connector.
citroen.remedy: Subject vehicles will have the diesel fuel delivery pressure in the injection pump checked. This will check the conformity of the pipe which in the case of nonconformity will be replaced.

citroen.defect: STEERING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY Incorrect assembly of the steering rack which could cause the loss of the mechanical link between the steering pinion valve and the steering rack during parking manoeuvres at full lock.
citroen.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the steering rack.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LEAKAGE FROM THE DIESEL RETURN PIPE FIXED TO THE INTAKE MANIFOLD. It has been identified that the diesel fuel return pipe which is fixed to the inlet manifold may be abraded to the extent that if left undetected will leak.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles as a preventative measure will have the pipe inspected for damage. If any is found the pipe will be replaced. In cases where the pipe remains undamaged it will be fitted with reinforcement.

citroen.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF ABS AND ESP FUNCTIONS It has been identified that the operation of the  ABS/ESP braking unit may be affected by the ingress of water.
citroen.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles to reinforce the resistance of the ABS/ESP unit to water.

citroen.defect: BRAKE SERVO MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION On the affected vehicles an internal component of the braking assistance circuit amplifier may not be in conformity. This could result in reduction of braking over time.
citroen.remedy: Replacement of the amplifier (Servo).

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It is possible that the fuel return pipe may chaff on the diesel fuel filter support in the engine compartment.  This can if not identified result in a fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the addition of a protective sleeve to the return pipe.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel filter's integrated heater may be defective and could cause the cover to distort. This could cause air ingress and fuel egress. Either could cause poor starting and a warning light should illuminate
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace fuel heater cover. Check and if necessary replace connector.

citroen.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED It is possible that the front subframe and suspension wishbones mounting bolts may not have been torqued to the correct specification.  This could result in the mounting bolt working loose and falling from the vehicle plus the possibility of the insecurity of the subframe or the front suspension wishbone. This can cause an issue with the handling or even loss of control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and retorque the front subframe and suspension wishbone mounting bolts.

citroen.defect: THE BRAKE PEDAL COULD BECOME STIFF THEREBY REDUCING BRAKING ASSISTANCE The brake pedal might feel stiff and the braking distances extended as a result of a defect in the vacuum pump.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the valve in the vacuum pump.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The engine electronic cooling management control strategy and the maximum temperature alert threshold could cause the engine to overheat. This could result in a warning light and a message being displayed on the instrument panel.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

citroen.defect: WINDSCREEN TRIM MAY DETACH It has been identified that one of the windscreen side trims is not compliant. This may lead to the side trim moving position and in rare cases detaching.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for windscreen trim compliance. Should a non-compliance be identified the side trims will be replaced.

citroen.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY REDUCE If the battery voltage is abnormally low the antilock braking system electronic control unit may not perform to specification which in rare cases may cause a reduction in braking efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the Electronic Control Unit.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It has been identified that the possibility exists that contact between the fuel return pipe and the engine shield may take place inside the engine compartment. Should this occur wear on the pipe would ensue which in the worst case; would result in a fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with an additional fastener to ensure that contact is not made and if necessary the fuel return pipe will be replaced.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
citroen.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

citroen.defect: DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE MAY LEAK The diesel fuel return pipe of the injection system for 1.6 HDI ( DV6) engines carries the risk that over time seeping of fuel may occur due to nonconformity in manufacture.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the return pipe replaced with a quality assured item.

citroen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF THE BOTTOM ENGINE MOUNTING TIE BAR An  inadequate weld on the bottom engine mounting tie bar may fail and cause a serious engine vibration and separation of one of the driveshafts.
citroen.remedy: Fit a replacement bottom engine mounting tie bar.

citroen.defect: REPLACEMENT OF HANDBRAKE LEVER There is a possibility that the handbrake will not hold the vehicle stationary if it is not fully applied.
citroen.remedy: Fit a modified handbrake lever designed to ensure that an effective brake application is always made

citroen.defect: REAR CROSS-MEMBER MAY FAIL AND CAUSE DRIVER TO LOSE CONTROL On subject vehicles a weld on the rear cross member might be non-compliant and eventually cause the weld between the cross member and the vehicle body to break. This may lead to a partial detachment of the axle and cause the driver to lose control.
citroen.remedy: Contact keepers using DVLA and manufacturer's records. Check the compliance of the weld on the O/S/R and if necessary replace the cross member.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The battery earth return cable maybe too short which during vehicle operation may cause it to fail at its gearbox mounting point.  This could result in the engine cutting out.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and replace the battery earth return cable.

citroen.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
citroen.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

citroen.defect: THE REAR HUB BEARING LOCATING BOLTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED The rear hub bearing locating bolts may be incorrectly tightened.
citroen.remedy: Check the torque of the rear hub bolts and replace the hub(s) and the bolts if necessary

citroen.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure.   In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

citroen.defect: THE TRAILER TOW BALL MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION Some trailer tow ball fixing bolts may be damaged.
citroen.remedy: Replace the two tow ball fixing bolts.

citroen.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE ON SEVERAL REAR AXLE COMPONENT FIXINGS Vehicles may have an incorrect tightening torque on several rear axle component fixings.
citroen.remedy: Check and retighten all fixings to the correct torque settings.

citroen.defect: LIGHTS MAY SWITCH OFF UNEXPECTEDLY It has been identified that due to incorrect positioning of the exterior lighting control ring by the lighting management system the lights may switch off unexpectedly.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the lighting management software updated

citroen.defect: APPLICATION OF PARKING BRAKE Due to the possibility of incomplete application of the parking brake by the driver the vehicle could roll away when parked.
citroen.remedy: The manufacturer will write to all Xantia owners enclosing an amendment for insertion in the vehicle handbook. This will amplify and reinforce the instructions relating to the operation of the parking brake.

citroen.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS FITTED MIGHT NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION The High Voltage Harness might not be to the correct specification.
citroen.remedy: Check the harness conformity and replace it if necessary.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION AND STEERING FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT TORQUE Due to a deviation in the production process certain suspension and steering fixings may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check fixings as indicated by the manufacturer. Replace any damaged fixings and tighten all relevant fixings to correct torque.

citroen.defect: STEERING MAY BECOME STIFF It has been identified that a problem may arise with the steering mechanism which can result in hardness whilst manoeuvring.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering mechanism checked and lubricated. The mechanism will be replaced if found to be damaged. At the same time certain vehicles will have key components reinforced against the ingress of water. Thus preventing operating faults in the long term.

citroen.defect: BRAKE VACUUM ELECTROVALVES CONCERN. Water ingress into the underbonnet vacuum electrovalves may cause a reduction in power assistance at the brake pedal. Malfunction of the electrovalves could also adversely affect the engine exhaust emissions.
citroen.remedy: Replace the three electrovalves as a precaution and install a protective shield over them.

citroen.defect: DOOR MAY OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY A manufacturing defect in one of the components of the door locks could cause jamming of the internal mechanism and prevent the closing of one or more of the vehicle's doors. In rare cases the door could unlock and open unexpectedly.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace door locks.

citroen.defect: Affected vehicles may have a tyre load index reported on the vehicle s CoC lower than the rear axle capacity declared on the VIN label. Affected vehicles may have a tyre load index reported on the vehicle�s CoC lower than the rear axle capacity declared on the VIN label.
citroen.remedy: Replace the VIN label and provide an Addendum to the CoC (Certificate of Conformity).

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It has been identified that a batch of fuel injector pumps supplied as spare parts may have covers manufactured from a defective material. This could cause the pump covers to develop fissures which over time may lead to fuel leakage.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel injector pump replaced.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE PREMATURE WEAR OF HANDBRAKE RATCHET PAWL Premature wear of the handbrake ratchet pawl may lead to inadvertent release of the handbrake. Problem of material hardness discovered in Quality Control tests.
citroen.remedy: All vehicles from the period of production that may have a defective lever to be recalled and a new lever fitted.

citroen.defect: VEHICLES AFFECTED MAY HAVE A SINGLE WHEEL BOLT ON BOTH LEFT HAND SIDE WHEELS WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY A single wheel bolt on both left-hand wheels may not be tightened to the correct tightening torque.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace wheel bolts and any other associated parts if consequential damage has occurred.

citroen.defect: THE RIGHT-HAND SIDE DRIVE SHAFT OUTER JOINT MAY BREAK The right-hand side drive shaft outer joint may break due to incorrect hardening of the joint pinion during manufacturing.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the right-hand side driveshaft depending on the production time stamp.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel injectors supply rail could develop a leak over a period of time leading to a drop in fuel pressure in the injector supply rail which can affect the operation of the stop start system. In some extreme cases the engine might not restart and a spray of petrol under the bonnet may occur which is a fire risk.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fuel injector supply rail. Where necessary replace the fuel injector supply rail.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible for the engine to stall due to incorrect reading of oil levels during harsh and prolonged braking.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download new software to the engine ECU.

citroen.defect: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminal and correct it if necessary.

citroen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
citroen.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

citroen.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
citroen.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

citroen.defect: Tow ball support bracket durability inadequate The tow ball bracket could not withstand mechanical constraints when subjected to the highest stress levels which can occur during the vehicle's lifetime.
citroen.remedy: The manufacturer�s remedy involves the replacement of the tow ball support bracket with a redesigned version.

citroen.defect: THE OPEN CIRCUIT DETECTION SYSTEM COULD BE OVER SENSITIVE CAUSING A NUMBER OF OPERATIONAL ISSUES A possibility that the open circuit detection system could be over-sensitivite causing a number of operational issues including sudden power loss.
citroen.remedy: Download the latest software configuration check some electronic units and replace them if necessary.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. citroen.defect: REAR SCREEN MAY DETACH It has been identified that it is possible that the rear screen seal may not be to specification. This could lead to water ingress into the boot area which in extreme cases could cause the rear screen to become insecure in its housing.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the rear screen seal.

citroen.defect: THE FILTERING PERFORMANCE OF THE DIESEL PARTICULATE FILTER MAY NOT MEET THE REQUIRED SPECIFICATION The filtering performance of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) may not meet the required specification.
citroen.remedy: Replace the DPF on affected vehicles.

citroen.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY BE LOST Possible oil seepage in the brake assistance circuit that could damage the brake amplifier membrane and reduce braking assistance.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the vacuum circuit valve and pipe which link the vacuum pump to the brake amplifier.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel filter's integrated heater may be defective and could cause the cover to distort. This could cause air ingress and fuel egress. Either could cause poor starting and a warning light should illuminate
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace fuel heater cover. Check and if necessary replace connector.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION BOLT TORQUE MAY BE INCORRECT The front suspension lower arms may not be fully secure as the mounting bolts may not have been tightened correctly. The driver will initially be alerted to there being a concern because of the abnormal noise that will develop. If the noise is ignored over a long period it is possible the suspension lower arms may detach.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the suspension bolts and tighten them to the correct torque.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY This concern relates to right hand drive vehicles only. There may cases of the brake linkage lever being defectively assembled which may result in a loss of braking efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected check and where necessary reposition the brake pedal relay linkage lever.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
citroen.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

citroen.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. citroen.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

citroen.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that due to incorrect operation of the brake servo valve the effectiveness of the assistance provided could be reduced. It should be noted that the brake function remains in operation.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject valve replaced.

citroen.defect: THE BRAKE HOSE MAY CHAFE AND LEAK The brake hoses may chafe on the wheel aches and in extreme cases cause a brake fluid  leak. The driver will be informed of the defect by the illumination of a warning lamp on the dashboard. If ignored then this will result in longer than expected stopping distances.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and visually inspect the front brake hoses reinforcement and protection. The brake hoses if worn will be replaced.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Due to a non conformity in production an engine fuel pie protective sleeve could cause wear due to contact with surrounding components.This may cause a fuel leak
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles reposition the  fuel pipe protective sleeve or replace the pipe if wear is noted.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The engine may cut out as a dimensional nonconformity of the earth cable could lead to it breaking.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the battery earth cable.

citroen.defect: BONNET MAY BE INSECURE The bonnet lock fixing bolts may not be fully secure which can result in noise and vibration and in rare cases insecure holding by the bonnet catch and lock.
citroen.remedy: On recalled vehicles the tightness of the bonnet lock fixing bolts will be checked and where necessary tightened to specification.

citroen.defect: VACUUM BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE. It has been identified that the check valve within the brake assistance vacuum pump may suffer from a non-conformity which in time may reduce the braking assistance.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles as a preventative measure will have the subject valve replaced. At the same time certain vehicles will also have the air dosing unit replaced.

citroen.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF BRAKE VACUUM ASSISTANCE Possibility of failure of the vacuum pump drive dog leading to a loss of brake assistance.
citroen.remedy: Recall the potentially affected range of vehicles and replace the drive dog on those equipped with a Magneti Marelli Vacuum pump

citroen.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL RETURNS TOO SLOWLY It has been identified that the accelerator pedal can return too slowly. This can have an effect on the driving of the vehicle
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the accelerator pedal replaced.

citroen.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
citroen.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque.

citroen.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
citroen.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It has been identified that on a small number of vehicles the engine may have been fitted with a cylinder head where the lubrication circuit is not in conformity. This could result in failure of the engine.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the marking on the camshaft carrier checked and if found to be within the effected range the engine will be replaced.

citroen.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. citroen.defect: STARTER RELAY MAY OVERHEAT Possible non-compliance of an internal component of the starter control relay could cause damage by overheating. This could cause unintended operation of the starter motor and in extreme instances; there is a risk of fire.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the Electrical relay

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel tank mounting bolts may have been incorrectly torqued this may cause the mountings to become loose which can lead to stress on the fuel pipes and subsequently a fuel leak.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to check and if necessary retorque of the mounting bolts.

citroen.defect: HARDENING OF FUEL LINES Due to the effects of age and temperature the underbonnet rubber fuel lines may harden. This could lead to the possibility of fuel leakage particularly when the engine is cold.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the existing fuel pipes with the modified versions introduced to production vehicles in 1992.

citroen.defect: THE REAR BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THESE HOSES AND A CLIP The rear brake hoses may have been damaged over time due to inappropriate movement between these hoses and a clip.
citroen.remedy: Check the condition of the rear left-hand and right-hand brake hoses and replacing them if necessary.  A new retaining clip is fitted on all vehicles to prevent this relative movement.

citroen.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS FITTED MIGHT NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION The High Voltage Harness might not be to the correct specification.
citroen.remedy: Check the harness conformity and replace it if necessary.

citroen.defect: SUDDEN LOSS OF POWER It has been establish that a build up of deposits within the engine can result in engine running and starting issues. In extreme circumstances it can cause a sudden engine stall without any warning.
citroen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and install a new software package in the engine management system.

citroen.defect: DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE MAY LEAK The diesel fuel return pipe of the injection system for 1.6 HDI ( DV6) engines carries the risk that over time seeping of fuel may occur due to nonconformity in manufacture.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the return pipe replaced with a quality assured item.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY LOOSEN The front suspension lower swivel joint may not be tightened correctly. If the bolt slackens the joint may separate. This could adversely affect the directional control of the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary correct the tightening torque of the lower swivel joint clamp bolt.

citroen.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL RETURNS TOO SLOWLY It has been identified that the accelerator pedal can return too slowly. This can have an effect on the driving of the vehicle
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the accelerator pedal replaced.

citroen.defect: ABS/ESP MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY The ABS block may not conform to manufacturer specification. This could affect the operation of the ABS/ESP systems on the rare occasions that they are activated.
citroen.remedy: The hydraulic ABS/ESP block will be checked and if necessary replaced.

citroen.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
citroen.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque.

citroen.defect: THE WELDING OF THE INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE TOWBAR MIGHT NOT MEET THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION The welding of the individual components of the towbar might not meet the correct specification.

citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

citroen.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.
