citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

citroen.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY FAIL UNEXPECTEDLY A component of the steering column may not be to specification and could fail. If this occurs there would be a loss of directional control.
citroen.remedy: The manufacturer will contact keepers of affected vehicles and advise not to use the vehicle.  Examine vehicles and on those with the affected component replace  the steering column.

citroen.defect: UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING CONDITIONS THE AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR PULLEY COULD BREAK The air conditioning compressor pulley could break and damage other components.
citroen.remedy: Replace the air conditioning compressor pulley and if necessary the protective cover.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION SPRINGS MAY BREAK In the exceptional event of a spring breaking there could be a risk of the spring making contact with the vehicle tyre.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a suspension cup to each side of the front suspension.

citroen.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

citroen.defect: PARKING BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A potential defect in the rear brake caliper may cause the parking brake efficiency to be reduced.

citroen.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE COMPROMISED The threaded portion of the brake linkage rod in the brake control system may not be to conformity. This could result in a reduction of braking efficiency.

citroen.defect: AFFECTED VEHICLES ARE NOT FULLY COMPLIANT TO EUROPEAN REGULATION (165/2014+ EU799/2016) COVERING THE SMART TACHOGRAPH REQUIREMENTS Affected vehicles are not fully compliant to European regulation (165/2014 + EU 799/2016) covering the �Smart Tachograph� requirements.
citroen.remedy: Replacing the tachograph gearbox and on certain vehicles the windscreen depending on the specification of the vehicle.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
citroen.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

citroen.defect: Affected vehicles may face the risk of perforation of the HV battery reinforcing plate/battery cover over the vehicle lifetime due to water intrusion. Affected vehicles may face the risk of perforation of the HV battery reinforcing plate/battery cover over the vehicle lifetime due to water intrusion.
citroen.remedy: A protective wax will be applied between HV battery reinforcing plate and battery cover.

citroen.defect: 1)SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY JAM FOLLOWING NORMAL OPERATION OF PRETENSIONER 2)INVOLUNTARY OPERATION OF DRIVERS AIR BAG 1) The seat belt may jam following normal operation of the seat belt pretensioners in an accident. 2) The drivers airbag may deploy involuntarily.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and:- 1) Replace the original seat belt buckle and its associated pretensioner control by new Autoliv components. 2) Upgrade the drivers airbag to the latest specification.

citroen.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that there is a risk of the engine stalling under very firm braking conditions.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the engine ECU software upgraded.

citroen.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
citroen.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

citroen.defect: DUE TO THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE NOX EMISSIONS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS The calibration of the engine management software could result in emissions of NOx which do not comply with the regulatory limits.
citroen.remedy: Download new engine management software

citroen.defect: UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING CONDITIONS THE AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR PULLEY COULD BREAK The air conditioning compressor pulley could break and damage other components.
citroen.remedy: Replace the air conditioning compressor pulley and if necessary the protective cover.

citroen.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

citroen.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.
citroen.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

citroen.defect: POTENTIAL BLOCKING OF THE UREA INJECTOR The urea injector may temporarily block
citroen.remedy: Update the engine management software

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE NON CONFORMITY OF SEALS IN FRONT WHEEL ARCHES COULD LEAD TO WATER INGRESS INTO CERTAIN ELECTRONIC UNITS Possible non-conformity of certain seals in the front wheel arches could lead to water ingress into the passenger compartment.
citroen.remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

citroen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF SERVICE BRAKE FAILURE Under conditions of heavy braking the footbrake relay cross shaft ball joint may detach from its left hand mounting. This would result in failure of the service brake.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check that the ball joint is properly located in its bush. Where this is not the case the mounting assemblies will be adjusted or replaced as necessary.

citroen.defect: REAR BRAKE CALLIPER MOUNTING BOLTS MAY BE TORQUED INCORRECTLY The rear brake caliper mounting bolts may not be to the required torque. Therefore the bolts may slacken and cause noise.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles are likely to be affected to replace the rear caliper mounting bolts and ensure they are correctly torqued.

citroen.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR On affected vehicles connectors intended to supply the electric front seats fitted to some versions are not used and are located under the rear footwell carpets.  If these connectors come into contact with water of melted snow and de-icing agents they may corrode over a period of time and cause localised electrical overheating.
citroen.remedy: The operation involves repositioning these electrical supply wires for the two front seats to move them higher up on the seat frame.

citroen.defect: THE FRONT LOWER BALL JOINT LOCATING BOLT AND FIXING NUT MIGHT HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED OR NOT FITTED CORRECTLY The front lower ball-joint locating bolt and fixing nut might have been incorrectly tightened or not fitted correctly.
citroen.remedy: Replace the bolts and fixing nuts that attach both of the front lower ball joints to the front hub assemblies.

citroen.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY DECREASE The stroke of the brake pedal which could affect the slowing down of the vehicle may be in excess of manufacturer's recommendations due to the brake bleeding operation not being fully performed.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to ensure the brakes have been fully bled and that brake travel is within manufacturer's recommendation.

citroen.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure.   In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
citroen.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

citroen.defect: SEATBELT RESTRAINING ABILITY MAY BE AFFECTED Welding on front R/H seat frame may not be robust enough by the seat buckle. Restraining ability may be impaired in an impact.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and replace seat frame if in affected batch.

citroen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

citroen.defect: TAILGATE MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY It has been identified that the possibility exists that the mounting ball on both tailgate support struts may rotate when the tailgate is opened or closed. Should one of the support struts dislocate the tailgate may not remain in the open position.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the mounting ball joints on the tailgate support struts replaced.

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel filter's integrated heater may be defective and could cause the cover to distort. This could cause air ingress and fuel egress. Either could cause poor starting and a warning light should illuminate
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace fuel heater cover. Check and if necessary replace connector.

citroen.defect: CORROSION WITHIN THE TAILGATE STRUT ASSEMBLY COULD CAUSE THE STRUT TO FAIL Non-conformity of a tailgate strut internal component may allow corrosion to develop. This may cause  the strut to fail and the tailgate may not be held open.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the struts.

citroen.defect: Suspension wishbone bolts may have been incorrectly tightened during the production process. Suspension wishbone bolts may have been incorrectly tightened during the production process.
citroen.remedy: Check and tighten wishbone bolts to the correct torque.

citroen.defect: SPOT WELDS MAY NOT HOLD On a very limited number of vehicles it is necessary to check the presence of specific spot welds on the vehicle body shell.  Should it be identified that one of the welds has been missed in production the vehicle cannot be repaired. In the long term and in very rare cases body noises and squeaking could appear.
citroen.remedy: In the rare case that the vehicle does not comply the vehicle will be removed from the road and the customer will be provided with a replacement vehicle.

citroen.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure.   In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

citroen.defect: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS LOWER BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY The tightening and positioning of the seat belt lower bolts may be incorrect.
citroen.remedy: This campaign consists of checking and if necessary correcting both the position of the bolt and the tightening torque of all of the lower fixings of the seat belts.

citroen.defect: THE OPERATION OF THE BRAKE VACUMN PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED DUE TO MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected due to material detaching from the timing belt.
citroen.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the timing belt and other components of the braking assistance system including the vacuum pump. Additionally alter servicing schedules depending on usage.

citroen.defect: THE ROUTING OF THE REAR BRAKE PIPES MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION The routing of the rear brake pipes may not be correct and could cause them to fail.
citroen.remedy: Check and replace affected pipes if necessary

citroen.defect: VEHICLE MAY CUT OUT The supply terminal to the engine relay unit may have been over tightened and over time this could damage the component and cause the engine to cut out. In addition this could cause the diagnostic warning lamp to illuminate in error and it may make it more difficult to start the engine.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary replace the engine relay unit.

citroen.defect: BUMPER MAY NOT PERFORM AS DESIGNED IN A COLLISION Affected vehicles may have a small defect in the front bumper frame. This may affect its impact absorption in the even of a collision.
citroen.remedy: If required replace front bumper frame.

citroen.defect: Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe. Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
citroen.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY This concern relates to right hand drive vehicles only. There may cases of the brake linkage lever being defectively assembled which may result in a loss of braking efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected check and where necessary reposition the brake pedal relay linkage lever.

citroen.defect: CERTAIN SEALS IN THE FRONT WHEEL ARCHES MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION Certain seals in the front wheel arches may not be correct to specification and may cause water ingress into the passenger compartment
citroen.remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required.

citroen.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a rear axle crossmember that was not manufactured according to specifications. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a rear axle crossmember that was not manufactured according to specifications.
citroen.remedy: Check and replace the rear axle crossmember if necessary.

citroen.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK There is a possibility of a brake pipe contacting the clip of the turbo-charger air inlet union. In extreme cases this could lead to a loss of brake fluid causing the brake warning lamp to come on.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and where necessary reposition the clip of the turbo-charger air inlet union. If the brake pipe shows traces of wear it will need to be replaced.

citroen.defect: STEERING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY Incorrect assembly of the steering rack which could cause the loss of the mechanical link between the steering pinion valve and the steering rack during parking manoeuvres at full lock.
citroen.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the steering rack.

citroen.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE COMPROMISED The front suspension wishbone mounting bolts might not have been manufactured to the correct specification potentially causing a risk of these parts breaking. Broken mounting bolts can be noticed by the driver through noises and poor directional control.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front suspension wishbone mounting bolts.

citroen.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

citroen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
citroen.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER STEERING It has been identified that poor protection of the power steering pump earth terminal; could result in loss of power assistance to the steering.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the power steering pump earth terminal protection reinforced.

citroen.defect: EXCESSIVE LOADING OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION COULD RESULT IN THE LOOSENING OF THE FRONT WISHBONE LOWER BALL JOINTS Excessive loading of the front suspension could result in the loosening of the front wishbone lower ball joints.
citroen.remedy: Increasing the tightening torque of the ball joint and adding thread lock to the ball joint threads if the ball joint threads are found to be rusty the ball joint will be replaced.

citroen.defect: STEERING COLUMN BEARING POSSIBLY CRIMPED TO THE INCORRECT SPECIFICATION. On the affected vehicles the crimping preventing lateral movement of the steering column bearing may not be correct to specification.  This may result in noise and play in the steering.  Ultimately it could lead to steering malfunction.
citroen.remedy: The remedy involves checking the crimping on the steering column and replacing the steering column if necessary.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION SPRINGS MAY BREAK In the exceptional event of a spring breaking there could be a risk of the spring making contact with the vehicle tyre.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a suspension cup to each side of the front suspension.

citroen.defect: MALFUNCTION CAUSING INSTRUMENT PANEL FUNCTIONS TO BECOME INOPERABLE An electronic component within the Built-in Systems Interface (BSI) may not be to the correct specification. This could cause the audio-navigation system the wipers and exterior lighting to malfunction and the warning light on the instrument panel may illuminate.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the production date of the BSI unit. Where the production date of the BSI unit is in the affected range the unit will be replaced.

citroen.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The brake servo pump system could develop problems with malfunction indicator lamps and audible warnings accompanied by the vacuum pump stopping. This will require the driver to apply greater force on the brake pedal to stop the vehicle.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download the vacuum pump with a new version of the control software.

citroen.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT Vehicles with the HDI engines but without the optional diesel fired heater may be fitted with the maxi-fuse supplying the fuel heater circuit. This can in certain cases lead to a short circuit and a consequential fire risk.
citroen.remedy: Remove the maxi-fuse.

citroen.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED It is possible that some suspension and brake components were not tightened correctly when building the car. It is possible for the components to become insecure and develop increase in noise from the suspension and increase of free play in steering. If not corrected the directional control and brakes could be affected.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and tighten the affected components to the required specifiaction: rear suspension fixings on the body brake calipers on their supports front subframe fixings on the body front hub carrier fixings on the subframe and on the shock absorbers brake hoses on the calipers and fixings of the underbody deflectors.

citroen.defect: SUSPENSION SPRINGS MAY BREAK In the exceptional event of a spring breaking there could be a risk of the spring making contact with the vehicle tyre.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a suspension cup to each side of the front suspension.

citroen.defect: THE TIGHTENING OF THE REAR SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The tightening of some rear suspension fixings may not be correct to specification
citroen.remedy: Correcting some tightening torques and replacing some nuts and bolts.

citroen.defect: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
citroen.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminal and correct it if necessary.

citroen.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE COMPROMISED The threaded portion of the brake linkage rod in the brake control system may not be to conformity. This could result in a reduction of braking efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check rod and replace if found not to meet conformity.

citroen.defect: THE FILTERING PERFORMANCE OF THE DIESEL PARTICULATE FILTER MAY NOT MEET THE REQUIRED SPECIFICATION The filtering performance of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) may not meet the required specification.
citroen.remedy: Replace the DPF on affected vehicles.

citroen.defect: VACUUM BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE. It has been identified that the check valve within the brake assistance vacuum pump may suffer from a non-conformity which in time may reduce the braking assistance.
citroen.remedy: Recalled vehicles as a preventative measure will have the subject valve replaced. At the same time certain vehicles will also have the air dosing unit replaced.

citroen.defect: ELECTRICAL HARNESS COULD MOVE FROM ORIGINAL POSITION AND WEAKEN THE HARNESS The rear window electrical harness could become displaced from its original position and present a potential thermal issue.
citroen.remedy: Check the routing of harness and replace the electrical harness if necessary. Add a fastening clip to ensure that the electrical harness will be maintained in its normal position.

citroen.defect: AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR SUPPORT MOUNTINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The tightness of one of the air conditioning compressor support mountings may not be correct to specification. This will result in an abnormal noise and possibility of the compressor becoming insecure
citroen.remedy: On  affected vehicles check the tightness of the support; where necessary the support will be replaced.

citroen.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY In very rare circumstances the vacuum pump one way valve may not function correctly which could affect the level of braking assistance.
citroen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the brake vacuum pump one way valve.

citroen.defect: THE REAR BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THESE HOSES AND A CLIP The rear brake hoses may have been damaged over time due to inappropriate movement between these hoses and a clip.
citroen.remedy: Check the condition of the rear left-hand and right-hand brake hoses and replacing them if necessary.  A new retaining clip is fitted on all vehicles to prevent this relative movement.

citroen.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY NOT APPLY FULLY A component within the parking brake assembly may not meet conformity this could result in a lengthening of the handbrake travel which could have an affect on the parking brake efficiency.
citroen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the non-conformity components.

cooper.defect: AFFECTED TYRES MAY DEVELOP BULGES OR SEPARATIONS IN THE SIDEWALL AREA OF THE TYRE Affected tyres may develop bulges or separations in the sidewall area of the tyre.

TREAD SEPARATION MAY OCCUR Following endurance testing it has been established that separation of the breaker to casing ply may occur. This can be identified by a bulge in the tread area however if the separation is not identified then loss of air may result.  This could affect control of the vehicle and in extreme cases result in a collision.
cooper.remedy: Recall affected tyres and replace them with quality assured replacements.

cooper.defect: SOME TYRES MAY BE AFFECTED BY A MANUFACTURING VARIATION THAT CAN LEAD TO A LACK OF ADHESION WITHIN THE TYRE CARCASS COMPONENTS Some tyres may be affected by a manufacturing variation that can lead to a lack of adhesion within the tyre carcass components.
cooper.remedy: All the 255/60R18 112V Cooper Zeon 4XS Sport Tyres that were produced during week 36 of 2022 (DOT case 3622) and week 37 of 2022 (DOT code 3722) must be exchanged.

cooper.defect: TYRE TREAD MAY SEPARATE It has been identified that a low tread gauge in the shoulder slot area could lead to cracking at the base of the shoulder slots. This could result in exposed belt wire and accelerated belt degradation which could result in separation.
cooper.remedy: Customers are to be contacted and the subject tyres changed free of charge.

cooper.defect: TYRE MAY DEFLATE The subject tyres may develop scattered compression cracking within the inner liner which can result in a reduction in the ability of the tyre to retain inflation pressure.
cooper.remedy: Customers will be contacted and tyres replaced free of charge.

cpi.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF CONTOL The rear sprocket bolts could shear/work loose on SM125 models. This could cause the rear wheel to lock and therefore put the rider at risk.
cpi.remedy: Complete replacement wheel assembly of a new design including sprocket and rear disc to replace the old unit.

cranes.defect: REAR AXLE HUB MAY FAIL It has been identified that there is a possibility that a rear axle hub might fracture. Additionally fractures might occur in the clutch housing due to insufficient rigidity of the material.
cranes.remedy: Subject vehicles will have the rear hubs replaced. Additionally the clutch housing with one constructed of cast iron.

crestchic.defect: Risk of Product becoming detached from trailer On certain trailers the welds are breaking allowing the unit to move resulting in the inserts being pulled freeing the unit from its mountings. Or the inserts are pulling out loosening the remaining fasteners and freeing the unit from its mountings.
crestchic.remedy: Inspect and if necessary modify the trailer's fittings and fixtures.

cupra.defect: 69C8 - Checking seat belts Terramar and Raval On affected vehicles driver and / or passenger seat belt may not be correctly secured to the lower anchor point on the B-pillar.
cupra.remedy: Check the seat belt fastening and replace if necessary.

cupra.defect: Reprogramming matrix beam headlights On affected vehicles when driving with the advanced full beam assist function a deviation of the light distribution of the Matrix Beam headlights occurs resulting in glare for both the vehicle in front and the oncoming vehicle.
cupra.remedy: Reprogram the Matrix Beam headlight adjustment control and update the vehicle baseline.

cupra.defect: Charging Limitation to 80% In CUPRA Born vehicles equipped with high-voltage batteries of a  certain type there is a suspicion that manufacturing problems may  have occurred in certain components of the high-voltage battery on  the part of the supplier.
cupra.remedy: In an initial phase customers whose vehicles are equipped with  high-voltage batteries from the affected batch will receive a recall  letter including warning labels to attach to the charging socket and  the dashboard as well as the instruction to not charge above 80%  (Battery Care Mode) for safety reasons.    Furthermore where technical requirements exist we will limit the  maximum available charging capacity of your vehicle to 80% (Battery  Care Mode) via the system.

cupra.defect: High-voltage modules replacement On affected vehicles it's possible a faulty module has been installed in the high-voltage battery which may cause either a loss of range a yellow warning lamp to light up or a risk of the battery overheating leading to a fire.
cupra.remedy: Check and replace the affected battery modules.

Therefore there is a risk of increased injury to the driver.
dacia.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the driver's air-bag with a new unit.

dacia.remedy: Fit a protective clip or replace pipe.

dacia.defect: Rear stub axle carrier mounting bolts On affected vehicles due to an insufficient tightening of the rear stub axle carrier mounting bolts at the factory the fatigue resistance of the bolt assembly is reduced.

dacia.defect: Rear Suspension Springs For certain vehicles there may be a non-conformity of the rear suspension springs that could lead to breakage.

dacia.defect: RISK OF THE KEY JAMMING IN THE START POSITION CAUSING POTENTIAL DAMGE TO THE STARTER MOTOR. There is a possible risk of the ignition switch not disengaging correctly after starting the vehicle resulting in the key jamming in the start position. In rare circumstances this may cause a thermal incident.
dacia.remedy: Replacement of the ignition switch.

dacia.defect: A risk of loss of Steering For certain vehicles there is a risk of rupture of the steering rack when subjected to high mechanical stress which could lead to loss of control and risk of an accident. Customers are requested to immediately stop driving their vehicles.
dacia.remedy: Replacement of the steering rack.

dacia.defect: Risk of parking brake actuator failing For certain vehicles a concern involving the electric traction reducer parking brake mechanism actuator or gearbox engagement actuator within the transmission may result in the parking brake mechanism actuator no longer correctly positioning the locking pawl in the “P lock”.
dacia.remedy: Replacement of the electric traction reducer parking brake mechanism actuator or gearbox Engagement Actuator.

dacia.defect: INCORRECT POSITIONING OF THE LOWER STEERING COLUMN MOUNTING BRACKET Incorrect positioning of the lower steering column mounting bracket with a risk of loosening.

Electrical cables connected to the fuse box might become loose and could cause arcing. This condition could cause for example the horn to stop working airbag/s to deploy in exceptional circumstances fire etc.
dacia.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace all fuse box cable flange nuts to new correct type nuts and tighten to correct torque.

dacia.remedy: On affected vehicles check manufacturing date of the wheel hubs and replace if required.

dacia.defect: THE CONTACT BETWEEN THE POSITIVE BATTERY TERMINAL AND THE ALTERNATOR COULD CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT Contact between the positive battery terminal and the alternator could cause an electrical short circuit.
dacia.remedy: Modify the wiring route and if necessary replace the alternator.

dacia.defect: On the affected vehicle the LPG tank may have been welded incorrectly On the affected vehicle the LPG tank may have been welded incorrectly.

daewoo.defect: HIGH ENGINE SPEED IDLE CONDITION MAY OCCUR A screw in the motorised throttle idle actuator (MTIA) could be faulty. A faulty MTIA could result in a high engine speed.
daewoo.remedy: Examine and replace the motorised throttle idle actuator where found necessary.

daewoo.defect: CRACK MAY OCCUR WITIN A CAPACITOR INSIDE THE CAMSHAFT POSITION SENSOR The Camshaft position sensor may overheat causing the engine management warning light to illuminate and in the worst case a localised thermal incident may occur
daewoo.remedy: Vehicles likely to be affected will be recalled and the sensor checked.  If affected the sensor will be replaced with a quality assured unit and an in-line fuse added

daewoo.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF FUEL FEED AND RETURN PIPES FROM FUEL RAIL The fuel feed and return pipes may detach from the fuel rail and result in a petrol leak.
daewoo.remedy: Fit improved feed and return pipe connectors to the fuel rail.

daewoo.defect: CRACK MAY OCCUR WITIN A CAPACITOR INSIDE THE CAMSHAFT POSITION SENSOR The Camshaft position sensor may overheat causing the engine management warning light to illuminate and in the worst case a localised thermal incident may occur
daewoo.remedy: Vehicles likely to be affected will be recalled and the sensor checked.  If affected the sensor will be replaced with a quality assured unit and an in-line fuse added

daewoo.defect: FRONT FLEXIBLE BRAKE HOSES MAY CRACK It is possible that the outer rubber section of the front brake flexible hoses may crack and in the longer term leak hydraulic fluid.
daewoo.remedy: Replace both front brake hoses with a new design.

daewoo.defect: POSSIBLE CLUTCH CABLE FAILURE The possibility exists that the clutch cable may break with the consequence that the clutch cannot be disengaged.
daewoo.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the clutch cable with one of improved quality.

daewoo.defect: ENGINE BAY WIRING HARNESS DAMAGE The engine bay wiring harness may be incorrectly routed allowing it to come into contact with components within the engine bay. This could result in damage to the harness.
daewoo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to re-route and install extra protection to the wiring harness. At the same time edge protection will be applied to certain brackets within the engine compartment to eliminate the risk of future chafing. Any damage already

daewoo.defect: TRANSMISSION MOUNTING BOLTS MAY BREAK. There is a possibility that the transmission mounting bolts could break.
daewoo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check correct torque and if found incorrectinspect bolts and mountings for damage and replace if necessary.

daewoo.defect: FRONT FLEXIBLE BRAKE HOSES MAY CRACK It is possible that the outer rubber section of the front brake flexible hoses may crack and in the longer term leak hydraulic fluid.
daewoo.remedy: Replace both front brake hoses with a new design.

daewoo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL LEAKAGE & FIRE RISK. There is a possibility that the fuel filter may perforate due to corrosion and fuel may leak.
daewoo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace fuel filter with modified type.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE RUPTURE OF POWER STEERING HOSE The oil hose on the pressure side of the power steering system is not to specification and could rupture with resultant loss of steering power assistance.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the pressure side hose with a modified and quality assured version.

daf.defect: WHEN USING ENGINE BRAKE OR THIRD BRAKE IN MOTION BRAKE LIGHTS ARE NOT ACTIVATED When using the engine brake/intarder or third brake in motion the brake lights are not activated
daf.remedy: Vehicle software update to the VECU

daf.defect: AUTOMATIC BRAKE ADJUSTER MALFUNCTION On axle production the breather plug may not have been removed from the rear axle spring brake units. This may result in a malfunction of the automatic adjustment of the brake expander unit.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and remove the plug from the breather hole.

daf.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL LEAK. Failure of number one injector pipe which in the worst case scenario may result in a vehicle fire.
daf.remedy: Replace number one injector pipe with a quality assured item. At the same time the remaining injector pipes will be inspected for serviceability.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF PROPELLOR SHAFT The propellor shaft fitted to a specific number of vehicles may fracture at certain high rotation frequencies.
daf.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a quality assured replacement propellor shaft.

daf.defect: WHEEL BEARINGS FITTED TO THE SECOND AXLE  MAY FAIL It has been identified that a number of repairs have been carried out on the hub seals where the bearings have not been replaced. This may lead to bearing failure.
daf.remedy: Recall the vehicles to replace the full set of wheel bearings and seals to prevent a possible bearing failure.

daf.defect: WHEEL BEARINGS MAY FAIL It has been identified that the quality of some AKE bearings fitted to the 09N044 mid-lift axle (Hendrichson manufacturer) may not be to specification. This could result in failure of the bearing and ultimately detachment of the wheel and hub.
daf.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the type of bearing and if necessary replace with the correct specification bearing.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE AIR LEAKS ON BRAKE CIRCUIT The recoiling of the pipes during fitment at production may cause the pipes to split at the pipe connection on the hand brake circuit (Circuit 3).
daf.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the inspection and if required the replacement of the brake pipes.

daf.defect: THE MATING SURFACES OF THE PROPSHAFT FLANGES MAY BE CONTAMINATED WITH PAINT The mating surfaces of the propshaft flanges may be contaminated with paint.
daf.remedy: Remove the propshaft inspect and clean the flanges. Refit with new fixings.

daf.defect: INSUFFICIENT TORQUEING OF PROPELLOR SHAFT COUPLING BOLTS The bolts coupling the propellor shaft to the differential and/or the bolts coupling intermediate propellor shaft sections may not be sufficiently torqued.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the torque of the subject bolts retorqueing where necessary.

daf.defect: CRACKING OF SPRING SADDLES Due to incorrect fitment on production the spring saddles on '1132' tandem axles may crack resulting in insecurity of the rear bogie.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for fitment of a modified and improved spring saddle.

daf.defect: POSSIBILITY OF AN OIL LEAK Possible leakage of hydraulic oil from high pressure hose - hydro pump to fan drive hydromotor
daf.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement hose

daf.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WHEEL NUTS FITTED DURING PRODUCTION Incorrect wheel nut fitment
daf.remedy: Replace affected wheel nuts and inspect wheels for damage

daf.defect: WHEN USING ENGINE BRAKE OR THIRD BRAKE IN MOTION BRAKE LIGHTS ARE NOT ACTIVATED When using the engine brake/intarder or third brake in motion the brake lights are not activated
daf.remedy: Vehicle software update to the VECU

daf.defect: STEERING DRAG LINK AND TRACK ROD BALL JOINT CLAMP BOLTS MAY LOOSEN AND AFFECT THE DIRECTIONAL CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE The nuts securing the drag link and track rod ball joint clamps may not have been pre-treated. As a result the tightness torque could be too low and the nuts could loosen which in extreme cases could lead to loss of steering.
daf.remedy: Replace suspect nuts/bolts with correct version.

daf.defect: FAILURE OF POWER STEERING PUMP A gear wheel in the power steering pump may crack causing loss of steering power assistance.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the power steering pump with a unit having a production date of 20A96 or greater.

daf.defect: WHEEL BEARINGS MAY FAIL It has been identified that the quality of some AKE bearings fitted to the 09N044 mid-lift axle (Hendrichson manufacturer) may not be to specification. This could result in failure of the bearing and ultimately detachment of the wheel and hub.
daf.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the type of bearing and if necessary replace with the correct specification bearing.

daf.defect: TOWING CROSSMEMBER AND CAB MOUNTING BOLTS On certain vehicles the bolts securing the towing crossmember and cab mountings may be defective.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of all the subject bolts. Those bolts identified as being defective will be replaced with modified examples.

daf.defect: TORQUE VALUES ON THE PROPSHAFT CENTRE BEARING AND DRIVE FLANGE MAY BE INCORRECT Torque values on the propshaft centre bearing and drive flange may be incorrect.
daf.remedy: Check and torque the propshaft centre bearing and drive flange

daf.defect: INSUFFICIENT TORQUEING OF PROPELLOR SHAFT COUPLING BOLTS The bolts coupling the propellor shaft to the differential and/or the bolts coupling intermediate propellor shaft sections may not be sufficiently torqued.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the torque of the subject bolts retorqueing where necessary.

daf.defect: PROPELLER SHAFT MAY DETACH Due to an error in production the pinion shaft may not be sufficiently hardened and may fail. This may cause loss of drive and the prop shaft may detach at the pinion.
daf.remedy: On affected vehicles examine and carry out torque check. Where necessary replace differential.

daf.defect: CONCERN THAT THE STEERING MIGHT LOCK The steering lock barrel retaining pin may become displaced and cause the steering lock to engage. Should the lock barrel come out of its housing directional control would be affected.
daf.remedy: The steering column lock will be secured with the addition of a retaining clip.

daf.defect: INSUFFICIENT TORQUEING OF PROPELLOR SHAFT COUPLING BOLTS The bolts coupling the propellor shaft to the differential and/or the bolts coupling intermediate propellor shaft sections may not be sufficiently torqued.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the torque of the subject bolts retorqueing where necessary.

daf.defect: INSECURITY OF GEARBOX The bolts securing the clutch housing to the gearbox are incorrectly torqued. This may lead to the gearbox becoming loose.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and retighten the subject bolts to the correct torque.

daf.defect: SECURITY OF REAR SPRING PIN NUT In a small number of cases the rear road spring bolt and nut have become loose.
daf.remedy: The original rear spring nut will be replaced with a modified example incorporating more locking material.

daf.defect: FAILURE OF PROPELLOR SHAFT Isolated instances of failure of the propellor shaft welding have occurred. (This campaign was launched to rework a batch of vehicles not included in Recall R1994/58).
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the propeller shaft with a quality assured unit. Replacement shafts are distinguished by having the letter S stamped on a flange.

daf.defect: PROP SHAFT CENTRE BEARING BOLTS MIGHT BE UNDER TORQUED Prop shaft centre bearing support brackets are potentially under torqued in production
daf.remedy: Check the fixing bolts of affected brackets and tightened to the correct 110Nm torque setting.

daf.defect: CRACKING OF SPRING SADDLES Due to incorrect fitment on production the spring saddles on '1132' tandem axles may crack resulting in insecurity of the rear bogie.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for fitment of a modified and improved spring saddle.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WHEEL NUTS FITTED DURING PRODUCTION Incorrect wheel nut fitment
daf.remedy: Replace affected wheel nuts and inspect wheels for damage

daf.defect: FUEL RETURN PIPE MAY FRACTURE AND LEAK There is a possibility that due to vibration the steel fuel return pipe to fuel filter may fracture and leak. Fuel may be deposited upon the engine and ignite.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace fuel return pipe with a flexible pipe.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF FLEXIBLE AIR BRAKE HOSE TO THE FRONT AXLE Possible failure of flexible air brake hose to the front axle.
daf.remedy: Replace affected hoses with an updated component.

daf.defect: BRAKE PEDAL BRACKET MAY CRACK There is a possibility that the brake pedal bracket could crack and lead to a malfunction of the brake pedal.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for inspection and if required replacement of the brake pedal bracket with an improved version.

daf.defect: TORQUE VALUES ON THE PROPSHAFT CENTRE BEARING AND DRIVE FLANGE MAY BE INCORRECT Torque values on the propshaft centre bearing and drive flange may be incorrect.
daf.remedy: Check and torque the propshaft centre bearing and drive flange

daf.defect: THE MATING SURFACES OF THE PROPSHAFT FLANGES MAY BE CONTAMINATED WITH PAINT The mating surfaces of the propshaft flanges may be contaminated with paint.
daf.remedy: Remove the propshaft inspect and clean the flanges. Refit with new fixings.

daf.defect: FAILURE OF POWER STEERING PUMP A gear wheel in the power steering pump may crack causing loss of steering power assistance.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the power steering pump with a unit having a production date of 20A96 or greater.

daf.defect: FAILURE OF POWER STEERING PUMP A gear wheel in the power steering pump may crack causing loss of steering power assistance.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the power steering pump with a unit having a production date of 20A96 or greater.

daf.defect: SECOND AXLE LOWER SPRING ARM CONCERN In some cases fitment of nylon thrust washers may allow excessive lateral movement of the second axle suspension lower spring arms. This could loosen the fixing bolts at the spring eye bracket and affect the steering control.
daf.remedy: Fit an extra support bracket at the spring eye bracket and new thrust washers.

daf.defect: STEERING DRAG LINK AND TRACK ROD BALL JOINT CLAMP BOLTS MAY LOOSEN AND AFFECT THE DIRECTIONAL CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE The nuts securing the drag link and track rod ball joint clamps may not have been pre-treated. As a result the tightness torque could be too low and the nuts could loosen which in extreme cases could lead to loss of steering.
daf.remedy: Replace suspect nuts/bolts with correct version.

daf.defect: BRAKE PIPES MAY CRACK Further to Recall 440 (R2012/059) and investigations undertaken by DAF it is suspected that the most likely cause of cracked Hytrel brake pipes in Circuit 3 (hand brake circuit) is due to stress on the air pipe in combination with a certain chemical agent that may be used in the  cleaning of vehicles.
daf.remedy: As a result it is necessary to replace Voss couplings with the Raufoss type coupling on Circuit 3.

daf.defect: TOWING CROSSMEMBER AND CAB MOUNTING BOLTS On certain vehicles the bolts securing the towing crossmember and cab mountings may be defective.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of all the subject bolts. Those bolts identified as being defective will be replaced with modified examples.

daf.defect: FAILURE OF REAR WHEEL STUDS Concern that rear wheel mounting studs may fail due to a combination of:- i) Incorrect high material hardness ii) presence of excessive 'laps' in thread forming.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and rework using quality assured wheel studs

daf.defect: INSUFFICIENT TORQUEING OF PROPELLOR SHAFT COUPLING BOLTS The bolts coupling the propellor shaft to the differential and/or the bolts coupling intermediate propellor shaft sections may not be sufficiently torqued.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the torque of the subject bolts retorqueing where necessary.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE SEPARATION OF BRAKE DISC FROM FRONT HUB The bolts securing the disc to the front hub are of incorrect quality and could fail with the result of the brake disc being no longer secured to the hub.
daf.remedy: Replace all suspect bolts with improved version.

daf.defect: STEERING DRAG LINK AND TRACK ROD BALL JOINT CLAMP BOLTS MAY LOOSEN AND AFFECT THE DIRECTIONAL CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE The nuts securing the drag link and track rod ball joint clamps may not have been pre-treated. As a result the tightness torque could be too low and the nuts could loosen which in extreme cases could lead to loss of steering.
daf.remedy: Replace suspect nuts/bolts with correct version.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF PROPELLOR SHAFT The propellor shaft fitted to a specific number of vehicles may fracture at certain high rotation frequencies.
daf.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a quality assured replacement propellor shaft.

daf.defect: TEMPERATURE THRESHOLDS AND THERMAL MANAGEMENT OF THE SCR MAY BE OUT OF CALIBRATION IN CERTAIN CONDITIONS The possibility of vehicle emission standards not being met.
daf.remedy: Vehicle software update to the management of the SCR system.

daf.defect: CRACKING OF FRONT AXLE U BOLTS On a small batch of vehicles the material quality of the front U bolts is suspect and may result in cracking of the bolts.
daf.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the U bolts replaced with quality assured examples.

daf.defect: PROP SHAFT CENTRE BEARING BOLTS MIGHT BE UNDER TORQUED Prop shaft centre bearing support brackets are potentially under torqued in production
daf.remedy: Check the fixing bolts of affected brackets and tightened to the correct 110Nm torque setting.

daf.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLLY There is a possibility that the clamp ring connecting the brake hose of the parking brake relay valve on the rear axle may have been fitted incorrectly. Should the hose detach the spring parking brake would inadvertently apply.
daf.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the position of the clamp ring checked. If found to be incorrect the hose will be cut to the required length and fitted with a new clamp ring and reinforcing sleeve.

daf.defect: Replace Airbag Module TAKATA airbags installed in certain DAF model vehicles can suffer  from degradation over time.
daf.remedy: Vehicles listed will be recalled under a Product Recall and the airbag  unit replaced.

daf.defect: Replace Airbag Module TAKATA airbags installed in certain DAF model vehicles can suffer  from degradation over time.
daf.remedy: Vehicles listed will be recalled under a Product Recall and the airbag  unit replaced.

daf.defect: Replace Airbag Module TAKATA airbags installed in certain DAF model vehicles can suffer  from degradation over time.
daf.remedy: Vehicles listed will be recalled under a Product Recall and the airbag  unit replaced.

daf.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL A number of service exchange steering boxes may fail due to the incorrect position of a circlip of the bevel box which could lead to the input shaft and gear to detach resulting in the loss of steering control.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new quality assured bevel box.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF STEERING BOX MOUNTING BRACKET The steering box mounting fitted as original equipment may not be sufficiently robust. Failure of this bracket could lead to loss of steering control.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of an improved steering box mounting bracket.

daf.defect: LOOSENING OF STEERING ARM AND TRACK ROD LEVERS The locating dowels between the stub axles and the steering arm and track rod levers may not be within the approved manufacturing tolerance. This may lead to loosening of the steering arm and/or track rod lever bolts with eventual loss of steering
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of quality assured replacement dowels between the stub axles and the steering arm and track rod levers.

daf.defect: STEERING MAY BE AFFECTED During production the bolt and nut which secures the universal joint to the steering shaft may not have been tightened correctly on production. This may cause irregularities in steering operation.
daf.remedy: Check components  and bolt tightness . Replace components where necessary

daf.defect: BALL JOINT TO TRACK ROD CONNECTION MAY BECOME LOOSE The double thread connection balljoint to the track rod can become loose caused by insufficient torquing in production.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and undo and retighten the clamp bolt with 170 Nm plus or minus 10 Nm torque. In cases where the threaded connection is loose already renew the track rod and reset the toe-in.

daf.defect: BRAKE PEDAL BRACKET MAY CRACK There is a possibility that the brake pedal bracket could crack and lead to a malfunction of the brake pedal.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for inspection and if required replacement of the brake pedal bracket with an improved version.

daf.defect: REAR NEARSIDE ROAD WHEEL STUDS MAY FAIL The rear nearside road wheel retaining nuts may have been over torqued  which could result in failure of the wheel studs.
daf.remedy: Replace the rear nearside road wheel studs and nuts and tighten to the correct torque.

daf.defect: PINION NUT MAY LOOSEN For 5.10 type axle the pinion nut may over an extended period of time. become loose due  to an undersized pinion shaft spline. This may cause the pinion flange to separate and in extreme cases the differential may seize.
daf.remedy: On affected vehicle check pinion nut for tightness and fit a locking plate to the nut to prevent nut movement.

daf.defect: WHEEL BEARINGS FITTED TO THE SECOND AXLE  MAY FAIL It has been identified that a number of repairs have been carried out on the hub seals where the bearings have not been replaced. This may lead to bearing failure.
daf.remedy: Recall the vehicles to replace the full set of wheel bearings and seals to prevent a possible bearing failure.

daf.defect: AXLE MAY DISPLACE It has been identified that during production on a number of vehicles the leaf spring of the front axle has been fitted the wrong way round. In the event that the spring should break there would be a reduction of the positional control of the front axle which is afforded by the second leaf eye wrap.
daf.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for correct orientation of the front springs which will be corrected if found not to be in compliance.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WHEEL NUTS FITTED DURING PRODUCTION Incorrect wheel nut fitment
daf.remedy: Replace affected wheel nuts and inspect wheels for damage

daf.defect: INOPERATIVE LOW FLUID WARNING The low brake fluid warning light wire between the cab connector and the engine plug at the back of the instrument panel may have been omitted.
daf.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a link harness wire to the engine plug and connector.

daf.defect: BRAKE CHAMBER DRAIN PLUG Front disc brakes air chamber drain plug was not removed during production. Consequently and condensate may freeze under extremely cold conditions and impair the effectiveness of the brake.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and remove the brake chamber drain plug.

daf.defect: INCORRECT TRACK ROD  ASSEMBLIES FITTED In some instances subject vehicles have been fitted with an incorrect track rod.
daf.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a track rod assembly of the correct type.

daf.defect: AXLE MAY DISPLACE It has been identified that during production on a number of vehicles the leaf spring of the front axle has been fitted the wrong way round. In the event that the spring should break there would be a reduction of the positional control of the front axle which is afforded by the second leaf eye wrap.
daf.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for correct orientation of the front springs which will be corrected if found not to be in compliance.

daf.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The bearings which locate the support for the telescoping adjustment of the steering column may become displaced with possible loss of steering control if a securing clip is not fitted correctly.
daf.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled during which a check of the steering shaft will be made. Should the shaft be faulty it will be replaced.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT The glow plug relay bracket can break due to vibration with a risk of causing a short circuit which may lead to the wires igniting.
daf.remedy: Replace with an improved thicker bracket.

daf.defect: CRACKING OF FRONT AXLE U BOLTS On a small batch of vehicles the material quality of the front U bolts is suspect and may result in cracking of the bolts.
daf.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the U bolts replaced with quality assured examples.

daf.defect: HOT ENGINE EXHAUST GASES MAY MELT PARK BRAKE HOSE The circuit 3 air pipe connected to the air reservoir is fitted too close to the engine exhaust. The hot gasses could melt the pipe and cause an air leak and the park brake to malfunction.
daf.remedy: Fit a new quick release coupling assembly to relocate the hose.

daf.defect: STEERING COLUMN UPPER COUPLING FIXING BOLT LOOSENS The steering column upper coupling bolt may not have been correctly torqued on production. This may lead to looseness in the upper joint and in extreme cases shaft detachment. The concern affects only vehicles produced at the Workington Plant.
daf.remedy: Replace the fixing bolt for the upper steering column coupling with an alternative type which is currently employed on the 'Volvo' Olympian.

daf.defect: SUSPECT QUALITY CAB PIVOT/STEERING BOX MOUNTING BRACKETS A number of vehicles have been built where due to material inclusions the cab pivot/steering box mounting brackets are below the manufacturers specification.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the subject bracket with one which is quality assured.

daf.defect: SEAT BELT INERTIA REEL MAY NOT LOCK. The lap belts fitted to the passenger seats may have incorrectly manufactured inertia reels. As a consequence a seat belt may not lock in a collision.
daf.remedy: Check the batch number of each seat belt and fit a quality assured replacement where necessary.

daf.defect: STEERING LEVER SECURITY CONCERN On a small number of vehicles the front axle offside and nearside track rod lever bolts are of incorrect quality and could fail which could lead to the track rod lever coming adrift.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit quality assured replacement bolts.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF FLEXIBLE AIR BRAKE HOSE TO THE FRONT AXLE Possible failure of flexible air brake hose to the front axle.
daf.remedy: Replace affected hoses with an updated component.

daf.defect: BRAKE PIPES MAY CRACK Further to Recall 440 (R2012/059) and investigations undertaken by DAF it is suspected that the most likely cause of cracked Hytrel brake pipes in Circuit 3 (hand brake circuit) is due to stress on the air pipe in combination with a certain chemical agent that may be used in the  cleaning of vehicles.
daf.remedy: As a result it is necessary to replace Voss couplings with the Raufoss type coupling on Circuit 3.

daf.defect: BRAKE PIPES MAY CRACK Further to Recall 440 (R2012/059) and investigations undertaken by DAF it is suspected that the most likely cause of cracked Hytrel brake pipes in Circuit 3 (hand brake circuit) is due to stress on the air pipe in combination with a certain chemical agent that may be used in the  cleaning of vehicles.
daf.remedy: As a result it is necessary to replace Voss couplings with the Raufoss type coupling on Circuit 3.

daf.defect: PROPELLER SHAFT MAY DETACH Due to an error in production the pinion shaft may not be sufficiently hardened and may fail. This may cause loss of drive and the prop shaft may detach at the pinion.
daf.remedy: On affected vehicles examine and carry out torque check. Where necessary replace differential.

daf.defect: STEERING MAY BE AFFECTED During production the bolt and nut which secures the universal joint to the steering shaft may not have been tightened correctly on production. This may cause irregularities in steering operation.
daf.remedy: Check components  and bolt tightness . Replace components where necessary

daf.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL A number of service exchange steering boxes may fail due to the incorrect position of a circlip of the bevel box which could lead to the input shaft and gear to detach resulting in the loss of steering control.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new quality assured bevel box.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF FLEXIBLE AIR BRAKE HOSE TO THE FRONT AXLE Possible failure of flexible air brake hose to the front axle.
daf.remedy: Replace affected hoses with an updated component.

daf.defect: BRAKE CALIPER MOUNTING BOLT MAY BREAK The bolts which secure the front brake caliper to the mounting bracket may not be to specification and could shear as a result.
daf.remedy: Check identification number on the bolt heads and replace with bolts of the correct specification where necessary.

daf.defect: FRONT BRAKE HOSES MAY FOUL TYRES On vehicles fitted with ABS the front brake hoses can foul the tyres on full lock.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and alter the fixing and routing of the front brake hoses to ensure that they cannot foul the tyres when the steering is on full lock.

daf.defect: CONCERN THAT THE STEERING MIGHT LOCK The steering lock barrel retaining pin may become displaced and cause the steering lock to engage. Should the lock barrel come out of its housing directional control would be affected.
daf.remedy: The steering column lock will be secured with the addition of a retaining clip.

daf.defect: UNSCHEDULED ACTIVATION OF STARTER MOTOR WHEN IN MOTION The starter motor may be accidentally activated as a result of the ignition switch wires shorting on the loom connector and pneumatic switch mounting plates on the steering column.
daf.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of clips/tie wraps and protective trim on the steering column/pneumatic switch plate to secure and protect the wiring loom.

daf.defect: FRONT BRAKE HOSES MAY FOUL TYRES On vehicles fitted with ABS the front brake hoses can foul the tyres on full lock.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and alter the fixing and routing of the front brake hoses to ensure that they cannot foul the tyres when the steering is on full lock.

daf.defect: BRAKE ACTUATOR PUSH RODS MAY STICK The painted brake actuator push rods may stick on the anti-grunt bush on the actuator body allowing the brakes to stick on after release at one or more wheel stations.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original actuator push rods with zinc plated versions.

daf.defect: CRACKING OF FRONT AXLE U BOLTS On a small batch of vehicles the material quality of the front U bolts is suspect and may result in cracking of the bolts.
daf.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the U bolts replaced with quality assured examples.

daf.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLLY There is a possibility that the clamp ring connecting the brake hose of the parking brake relay valve on the rear axle may have been fitted incorrectly. Should the hose detach the spring parking brake would inadvertently apply.
daf.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the position of the clamp ring checked. If found to be incorrect the hose will be cut to the required length and fitted with a new clamp ring and reinforcing sleeve.

daf.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INCORRECT BRAKE ACTUATORS On a small number of vehicles incorrect brake actuators may be fitted to the front axle brakes.
daf.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the brake actuators inspected. Any incorrect units will be replaced with the correct type.

daf.defect: STEERING COLUMN UPPER COUPLING FIXING BOLT LOOSENS The steering column upper coupling bolt may not have been correctly torqued on production. This may lead to looseness in the upper joint and in extreme cases shaft detachment. The concern affects only vehicles produced at the Workington Plant.
daf.remedy: Replace the fixing bolt for the upper steering column coupling with an alternative type which is currently employed on the 'Volvo' Olympian.

daf.defect: TWISTED REAR S CAM AT SPLINES During production of the vehicles concerned an electrical relay was not connected to the halt (or door) brake. As a result excessive air pressure can be applied to the rear brakes if the service brake is operated whilst the parking and halt brakes are
daf.remedy: The single operator involved will connect the relay to the halt brake to prevent compounding if the service brake is applied. When this operation is complete the importer will be advised on a dedicated proforma. The condition of the rear S

daf.defect: POSSIBLE AIR LEAKS ON BRAKE CIRCUIT As part of an ongoing investigation and improvement process there is a requirement to inspect the air piping connections on the hand brake circuit (Circuit 3) for completeness and serviceability.
daf.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection of pipework and report finding to manufacturer.

daf.defect: INCORRECT SPECIFICATION OF DRAWBAR CROSSMEMBER It has been identified that a number of vehicles have been produced whereby the rear cross member which carries the drawbar coupling assembly has been incorrectly specified.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the crossmember with one manufactured to the correct specification.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF PROPELLOR SHAFT On vehicles fitted with the ZF S5 42 gearbox the output flange nut may loosen. This could result in detachment of the propellor shaft.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a lock washer to prevent loosening of the output flange nut.

daf.defect: STEERING DRAG LINK AND TRACK ROD BALL JOINT CLAMP BOLTS MAY LOOSEN AND AFFECT THE DIRECTIONAL CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE The nuts securing the drag link and track rod ball joint clamps may not have been pre-treated. As a result the tightness torque could be too low and the nuts could loosen which in extreme cases could lead to loss of steering.
daf.remedy: Replace suspect nuts/bolts with correct version.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE UNSCHEDULED APPLICATION OF SPRING BRAKE As a result of possible incorrect fitment the air pipe from the parking brake valve to the connectors on the warning light pressure switch may separate and cause unscheduled application of the spring brake.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check that fitment and installation of the subject pipe conforms to the manufacturers production standard.

daf.defect: PROPELLER SHAFT MAY DETACH Due to an error in production the pinion shaft may not be sufficiently hardened and may fail. This may cause loss of drive and the prop shaft may detach at the pinion.
daf.remedy: On affected vehicles examine and carry out torque check. Where necessary replace differential.

daf.defect: POSSIBILITY OF THROTTLE STICKING It is possible that the throttle may not return to the idle position when the accelerator pedal is released.
daf.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for inspection of the throttle mechanism and adjustment of the throttle return spring where necessary.

daf.defect: AIRBAG MAY MALFUNCTION The position of the airbag electronic control unit (ECU) leaves it susceptible to water damage which may cause the airbag to malfunction.
daf.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a bracket and reposition the ECU.

daf.defect: OIL MAY LEAK It has been identified that the centrifugal filter screw cap to the engine oil cooler module on a specific number of vehicles may loosen resulting in oil leakage onto the road surface.
daf.remedy: This recall is to replace the centrifugal oil filter with a quality improved version.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE UNSCHEDULED APPLICATION OF SPRING BRAKE As a result of possible incorrect fitment the air pipe from the parking brake valve to the connectors on the warning light pressure switch may separate and cause unscheduled application of the spring brake.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check that fitment and installation of the subject pipe conforms to the manufacturers production standard.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE AIR LEAKS ON BRAKE CIRCUIT As part of an ongoing investigation and improvement process there is a requirement to inspect the air piping connections on the hand brake circuit (Circuit 3) for completeness and serviceability.
daf.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection of pipework and report finding to manufacturer.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE AIR LEAKS ON BRAKE CIRCUIT The recoiling of the pipes during fitment at production may cause the pipes to split at the pipe connection on the hand brake circuit (Circuit 3).
daf.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the inspection and if required the replacement of the brake pipes.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE RUPTURE OF POWER STEERING HOSE The oil hose on the pressure side of the power steering system is not to specification and could rupture with resultant loss of steering power assistance.
daf.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the pressure side hose with a modified and quality assured version.

daf.defect: POSSIBLE DISPLACEMENT OF BRAKE PADS The front brake disc pad retaining spring may break and allow the disc pads to become displaced. The broken parts of the spring may also damage the tyre valve.
daf.remedy: Replace the brake pad retaining springs with quality assured parts.

daf.defect: SEAT BELT INERTIA REEL MAY NOT LOCK. The lap belts fitted to the passenger seats may have incorrectly manufactured inertia reels. As a consequence a seat belt may not lock in a collision.
daf.remedy: Check the batch number of each seat belt and fit a quality assured replacement where necessary.

daf.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL A number of service exchange steering boxes may fail due to the incorrect position of a circlip of the bevel box which could lead to the input shaft and gear to detach resulting in the loss of steering control.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new quality assured bevel box.

daf.defect: LOOSE BUMPER FIXINGS MAY AFFECT STEERING CONTROL The nuts securing the front underrun protection bumper may not have been tightened sufficiently which could lead to loosening of the fixing bolts and affecting steering control.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles remove fixing bolts apply Loctite and retorque to correct figure.

daf.defect: BRAKE PEDAL BRACKET MAY CRACK There is a possibility that the brake pedal bracket could crack and lead to a malfunction of the brake pedal.
daf.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for inspection and if required replacement of the brake pedal bracket with an improved version.

daf.defect: SECOND AXLE LOWER SPRING ARM CONCERN In some cases fitment of nylon thrust washers may allow excessive lateral movement of the second axle suspension lower spring arms. This could loosen the fixing bolts at the spring eye bracket and affect the steering control.
daf.remedy: Fit an extra support bracket at the spring eye bracket and new thrust washers.

dahon.defect: HANDLEBAR POST MAY CRACK It has been identified that a combination of inaccurate machining and inconsistent quality of material can result in breakage of the radius handlebar post. Should this occur the rider may fall from the machine.
dahon.remedy: Recalled machines will be checked to ascertain whether or not they fall within the affected batch. Should this be the case the subject component will be replaced.

dahon.defect: HANDLEBAR POST MAY CRACK It has been identified that a combination of inaccurate machining and inconsistent quality of material can result in breakage of the radius handlebar post. Should this occur the rider may fall from the machine.
dahon.remedy: Recalled machines will be checked to ascertain whether or not they fall within the affected batch. Should this be the case the subject component will be replaced.

dahon.defect: HANDLEBAR POST MAY CRACK It has been identified that a combination of inaccurate machining and inconsistent quality of material can result in breakage of the radius handlebar post. Should this occur the rider may fall from the machine.
dahon.remedy: Recalled machines will be checked to ascertain whether or not they fall within the affected batch. Should this be the case the subject component will be replaced.

daihatsu.defect: CORROSION ON WIRING HARNESS CONNECTORS The terminal blades of some wiring harness connectors may corrode resulting in a failure of electrical power supply.
daihatsu.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement and modification of the relevant wiring harnesses. The replacements will incorporate moisture proof connectors.

daihatsu.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK It has been identified that a check valve within the fuel evaporative control system may develop a crack from long term use. In the worst case leakage of fuel evaporative gas vapour into the vehicle interior may occur resulting in the potential of fire in the presence of an ignition source.
daihatsu.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject check valve replaced.

daihatsu.defect: CORROSION OF FUEL TANK MAY LEAD TO FUEL LEAK Corrosion of the top of the fuel tank may result in a fuel leak.
FRONT HUB NUTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TORQUED AND COME LOOSE. Improper torque control has led to the possibility that the front hub nuts could become loose and cause vibration.
daihatsu.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the hub nut torque. Additionally any worn or damaged components will be changed.

daihatsu.defect: PROPSHAFT MAY DETACH It has been identified that failure of the propshaft universal joint may occur which can cause the propshaft to detach. On van versions the propshaft may contact the fuel tank and or the fuel lines.
daihatsu.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a quality assured propshaft.

daihatsu.defect: AIR BAG MAY DEPLOY WITHOUT WARNING Due to poor maintenance of the coolant the heater matrix may leak coolant into the air bag computer.  The water ingress could cause a short circuit which in the worst case could cause the air bag to deploy.
daihatsu.remedy: Installation of a shield to protect the ECU from leaking coolant. If the heater matrix shows signs of corrosion then this will be replaced.

daihatsu.defect: CORROSION OF FUEL TANK MAY LEAD TO FUEL LEAK Corrosion of the top of the fuel tank may result in a fuel oil leak.
FUEL TANK MAY LEAK The fuel tank could suffer from external corrosion in service and may become porous with the result that the tank could leak fuel.
daihatsu.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the fuel tank with a quality assured unit

daihatsu.defect: INSECURITY OF BRAKE PEDAL The nut securing the brake pedal may not have been tightened to the specified torque. If this is not corrected it could allow detachment of the pedal.
daihatsu.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles remove the relevant nut apply locking compound to the threads and replace and tighten the nut to the manufacturers specified torque.

daihatsu.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL UNEXPECTEDLY There is a possibility that the headlight and horn wiring circuit may fail resulting in the unexpected failure of the headlights and horn.
daihatsu.remedy: Recall likely affected vehicles for modifications to the headlight and horn circuit wiring connection.

daihatsu.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK It has been identified that a check valve within the fuel evaporative control system may develop a crack from long term use. In the worst case leakage of fuel evaporative gas vapour into the vehicle interior may occur resulting in the potential of fire in the presence of an ignition source.
daihatsu.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject check valve replaced.

daihatsu.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL UNEXPECTEDLY There is a possibility that the headlight and horn wiring circuit may fail resulting in the unexpected failure of the headlights and horn.
daihatsu.remedy: Recall likely affected vehicles for modifications to the headlight and horn circuit wiring connection.

dawes.defect: HANDLEBAR POST MAY CRACK It has been identified that a combination of inaccurate machining and inconsistent quality of material can result in breakage of the radius handlebar post. Should this occur the rider may fall from the machine.
dawes.remedy: Recalled machines will be checked to ascertain whether or not they fall within the affected batch. Should this be the case the subject component will be replaced.

decathlon.defect: STEERING MAY BE INOPERABLE The bicycle fork has been incorrectly assembled.  Control may be lost.
decathlon.remedy: recall affected bicycles check and reassemble fork.

decathlon.defect: STEERING MAY BE INOPERABLE The bicycle fork has been incorrectly assembled. Control may be lost
decathlon.remedy: Recall affected bicycles check and reassemble fork.

decathlon.defect: CHILD CARRIER DOES NOT MEET CHILD SEAT FITTING REQUIREMENTS It has been identified that the child seat does not fit correctly into the seat carrier.
decathlon.remedy: All models of this seat have been withdrawn from sale and customers have been contacted and asked to return the seat for a full refund.

del.defect: THE TAIL-LIFT TOE GUARD MAY NOT MEET ORIGINAL BS CODE OF PRACTICE REQUIREMENTS There is a rare possibility that the tail lift operators foot may jam between the toe guard and the platform.
del.remedy: Recall affected tail lifts and check toe guard dimensions for compatibility and possible modifications.

del.defect: POSSIBLE CRACK OF TAIL LIFT SIDE ARM PROFILES Possible crack of tail lift side arm profiles.
