delphi.defect: LOSS OF VEHICLE FRONT WHEEL SUSPENSION A possibility exists that the suspension wishbone may crack and in the worst case fail completely causing loss of suspension and direction control
delphi.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the wishbone.

dennis.defect: FRONT HUB CASTING MAY FAIL IN AREA OF WHEEL BOLTS. The front hub outer ring portion that houses the wheel bolts may break away from the inner nave portion fastened to the stub axle. In the worst case this would lead to detachment of the wheel.
dennis.remedy: Inspect vehicles in the affected range and replace any defective hubs found.

dennis.defect: Replace the Front suspension air bag castings On affected vehicles there is a possibility the front suspension castings could fail.
dennis.remedy: Replace the front suspension castings

dennis.defect: ADJUSTABLE STEERING LOCK MAY FAIL The column may fail to lock in position after adjusting which can leave the steering wheel in its lowest and rearmost position.
dennis.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement steering column.

dennis.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF REAR WHEELS AND HUB Rear axle tube may fracture at inner hub bearing location. This can result in the detachment of the hub and rear wheels.
dennis.remedy: Examine the rear axles on all potentially affected vehicles and fit new casings where necessary.

dennis.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL The brake actuator clamping bands on the front axle may be weakened through fouling the shock absorber top mounting when the steering is on full lock and the brake pads are worn considerably. In time the clamping ring may fail and the braking effort at the front axle will be lost resulting in much longer stopping distances.
dennis.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the top shock absorber brackets of the front axle and if there has been any signs of fouling fit new actuator clamping rings.

dennis.defect: There is a possibility that number one air tank mounting bracket could fail. There is a possibility that number one air tank mounting bracket could fail.
dennis.remedy: Replace the existing air tank brackets with a new designed bracket on specific vehicles.

dennis.defect: ENGINE COMPARTMENT OVERHEATING AND CONSEQUENTIAL FIRE RISK If a vehicle is operated in a condition where the engine bay temperature becomes excessively hot due to a defect with the vehicle there is a possible risk of damage to air supply pipes and noise insulation material and a possible risk of fire.
dennis.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace turbocharger aluminium heat shield with a fibre version. Remove foam noise insulation material from panels. Fit new type noise insulation panels/heat shields as appropriate.

dennis.defect: TO FIT WARNING DEVICE TO THROTTLE PEDAL There is a possibility of an electronic throttle pedal circuit failure which might lead to an unexpected surge in engine revs.
dennis.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and modify engine fault warning light so that it will illuminate if a partial pedal circuit failure occurs before any loss of engine speed control is experienced.

dennis.defect: THERE IS POTENTIALLY A MISMATCH OF SPLINES BETWEEN A JOINT AND THE SHAFT ON THE STEERING COLUMN. There is potentially a mismatch of splines between a joint and the shaft on the steering column.
dennis.remedy: Inspect the joint and check it is stamped with correct reference number and contact replace if needed.

dennis.defect: AIR SUSPENSION/PANHARD ROD LOCATION BRACKET MAY FRACTURE The offside front air suspension/panhard rod location bracket may fracture due to the mounting bolts losing torque and/or fracturing
dennis.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the subject mounting bolts with high tensile examples. At the same time the air suspension brackets will be checked for damage and replaced where necessary

dennis.defect: POWER STEERING PUMP FILTER Possibility of momentary loss of power from Power Steering hydraulic pump unit.
dennis.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit additional filter to pump suction line.

dennis.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF HANDBRAKE CONTROL VALVE The handbrake valve may not have been adequately lubricated on initial assembly. This could result in premature wear of the locking plunger with the risk of the handbrake being easily dislodged from the ON position.
dennis.remedy: The manufacturer has written to the operators of all potentially defective vehicles requesting them to examine the handbrake valve and apply a lubricant to the bridge piece. Should the bridge piece be found to be excessively worn the operator will

dennis.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF HANDBRAKE CONTROL VALVE The handbrake valve may not have been adequately lubricated on initial assembly. This could result in premature wear of the locking plunger with the risk of the handbrake being easily dislodged from the ON position.
dennis.remedy: The manufacturer has written to the operators of all potentially defective vehicles requesting them to examine the handbrake valve and apply a lubricant to the bridge piece. Should the bridge piece be found to be excessively worn the operator will

dennis.defect: THE ABS MODULATOR PLUGS COULD HAVE POTENTIALLY BEEN PLUGGED INTO THE WRONG MODULATOR The ABS Modulator plugs could potentially have been plugged into the wrong modulator.
dennis.remedy: Perform checks and in necessary switch the ABS modulator plugs to the correct modulator.

dennis.defect: CHAFING OF BRAKE PIPES Certain fixed and flexible braking system air pipes may chafe on the heater pipes and the heater mounting bracket in the vicinity of the rear axle.
dennis.remedy: A service engineer from East Lancs Coachbuilders has visited the operator concerned and re-routed and re-bracketed the subject brake pipes to ensure adequate clearance between them and other components.

dennis.defect: AXLE HUB BOLTS LOOSE Axle hub bolts may become insecure.
dennis.remedy: Recheck torque value of axle hub bolts to 500nm.

dennis.defect: WHEEL MAY BREAK Wheel knave may break away from the outer ring due to poor weld penetration. This could lead to the wheel breaking and could cause damage to vehicle.
dennis.remedy: Replace wheels.

dennis.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK The left hand lower noise shield may contact the vehicle silencer and cause heat damage to the shield. Whilst the shield is constructed of and supported by self extinguishing material trapped / collected debris or refuse in the area of the shield
dennis.remedy: Dennis Eagle have written to operators of all affected vehicles advising them to remove the heat shield with immediate effect and to report back to the manufacturer that this has been done.

dennis.defect: ACCELERATOR CONTROL CONCERN. The electronic throttle pedal return springs may fail resulting in the engine speed not returning to idle when the pedal is released.
dennis.remedy: Fit a new design electronic throttle pedal incorporating revised design return springs.

dennis.defect: THE ABS MODULATOR PLUGS COULD HAVE POTENTIALLY BEEN PLUGGED INTO THE WRONG MODULATOR The ABS Modulator plugs could potentially have been plugged into the wrong modulator.
dennis.remedy: Perform checks and in necessary switch the ABS modulator plugs to the correct modulator.

dennis.defect: SECURITY OF FRONT AXLE CARRIER BOLTS On the subject vehicles the wheel carrier bolts on each front hub may not have been tightened to the specified torque. This could result in detachment of the road wheel.
dennis.remedy: Dennis Specialist Vehicles have written to the operators of all potentially affected vehicles advising that the carrier bolts should be checked and tightened where necessary to ensure adherence to the manufacturers specification.

dennis.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF HANDBRAKE CONTROL VALVE The handbrake valve may not have been adequately lubricated on initial assembly. This could result in premature wear of the locking plunger with the risk of the handbrake being easily dislodged from the ON position.
dennis.remedy: The manufacturer has written to the operators of all potentially defective vehicles requesting them to examine the handbrake valve and apply a lubricant to the bridge piece. Should the bridge piece be found to be excessively worn the operator will

dennis.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF HANDBRAKE CONTROL VALVE The Knorr - Bremse handbrake control valve may have suffered premature wear. This could allow the vehicle to roll away whilst parked.
dennis.remedy: The affected vehicles to have the control valve internal mechanism examined for compliance with the valve manufacturers standards. Any valve which does not conform to these standards will be replaced.

dennis.defect: POSSIBLE AXLE MISALIGNMENT There is a possibility that the drive axle and/or the link steer axle U bolts nuts were not fully torqued during build. This may result in misalignment of the axles.
dennis.remedy: Dennis Eagle have contacted the operators of all the vehicles concerned both by telephone and in writing advising them to check and retorque the subject bolts immediately notifying the manufacturer in writing when this action has been completed.

dennis.defect: TO FIT WARNING DEVICE TO THROTTLE PEDAL There is a possibility of an electronic throttle pedal circuit failure which might lead to an unexpected surge in engine revs.
dennis.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and modify engine fault warning light so that it will illuminate if a partial pedal circuit failure occurs before any loss of engine speed control is experienced.

dennis.defect: STEERING RELAY LEVER BRACKET The second steer axle relay lever pivot bracket may crack. Complete failure of the bracket could impair the directional control of the vehicle.
dennis.remedy: Fit a modified relay lever bracket.

dennis.defect: A Degrade of emissions control component may occur A degrade of emissions control components may occur.
dennis.remedy: Trucks are monitored via software. If degradation is found then replacement of the silencer is required.

dennis.defect: STEERING ARM MAY FRACTURE Due to a lack of durability the steering lever may fracture at its fixings.
dennis.remedy: On affected vehciles replace the steering arm with a new design of arm.

dennis.defect: STEERING ARM SECURING NUTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FULLY TIGHTENED Failure of one of two steering arm attachment studs due to securing nut being incorrectly torqued. Continued use of vehicle with failed stud could lead to second stud failing and loss of directional control of the vehicle.
dennis.remedy: Contact all affected operators requesting them to carry out torque checks on the six nuts retaining the top steering lever and both bottom steering levers. Any nut/bolt found to rotate more than a quarter of one flat must be renewed.

dethleffs.defect: CONTROL UNIT COULD MELT A defect in the control mechanism for the waste water pipe and waste water tank heating system can cause scorching creating a fire risk.
dethleffs.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a new control unit.

dinex.defect: AFTERMARKET REPLACEMENT PRODUCT DOES NOT HAVE NECESSARY TYPE APPROVAL Euro VI DPF replacements don�t currently have necessary type approval.
dinex.remedy: All parts to be returned to Dinex Warrington office for credit.

disc.defect: POSSIBILITY OF QUENCHING CRACKS FROM HEAT TREATMENT IN THE MIDDLE HEX FLANGE SECTION OF THE WHEEL NUT As part of the Heat Treatment process quench cracks can occur.  These are not normally visible to the human eye.  However if the nuts are over torqued during fitment they can appear.
disc.remedy: Customer are being advised to check and replace cracked nuts with a quality assured replacement component.

dodge.defect: Fiat 600 Steering gear pinion safety recall On affected vehicles the steering rack fitted may not conform to specification and result in an increased force to rotate the steering wheel.
dodge.remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering rack will be replaced

dodge.defect: Rearview camera visibility On affected vehicles the rearview camera may not display an image when reverse is selected.
dodge.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated to rectify issue

dodge.defect: Driver airbag inflator The driver airbag inflator housing may rupture during normal airbag deployment events and metal fragments could injure components.  This  is more likely to occur if the vehicle has been exposed to high levels of absolute humidity for extended periods of time.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag inflator.

dodge.defect: Driver airbag inflator The driver airbag inflator housing may rupture during normal airbag deployment events and metal fragments could injure components.  This  is more likely to occur if the vehicle has been exposed to high levels of absolute humidity for extended periods of time.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag inflator.

dodge.defect: Passenger airbag inflator In the event that the airbag is activated excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing  injury to the vehicle occupants and / or in worst cases a fatality. The concern is caused by moisture in the air getting past faulty seals and being absorbed by the pyrotechnic biscuits in the inflator. As a result it is more likely to occur sooner in areas of high humidity and high temperature difference.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger front air bag  module which includes the inflator.

dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger front air bag  module which includes the inflator.

dodge.defect: Passenger airbag inflator The front passenger airbag inflator (PAB) may contain propellant that could possibly degrade over a period of time. This may cause metal fragments to pass through the air bag and into the vehicle interior at high speed which may result in injury to vehicle occupants in the event of a deployment event.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator assembly.

This may cause metal fragments to pass through the air bag and into the vehicle interior at high speed which may result in injury to vehicle occupants in the event of a deployment event.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator assembly.

dodge.defect: Passenger airbag inflator Passenger air bag may deploy incorrectly if activated.
dodge.remedy: Replace the passenger air bag inflator.

dodge.defect: Passenger airbag inflator Passenger air bag may deploy incorrectly if activated.
dodge.remedy: Replace the passenger air bag inflator.

dodge.defect: Passenger airbag inflator Passenger air bag may deploy incorrectly if activated.
dodge.remedy: Replace the passenger air bag inflator.

dodge.defect: Side airbag/head airbag crash sensor not correctly connected Affected vehicles fitted with the side airbag/head airbag may not have the side crash sensor connected correctly which may in a worst-case scenario result in non-deployment of the airbag in a side impact/crash.
dodge.remedy: To check the correct engagement/connection of the side crash sensor.

dodge.defect: Front suspension control arm ball joint Affected vehicles may not have the correct installation and tightening between the suspension control arm and the steering knuckle joint.This may possibly result in the control arm bolt becoming detached from the knuckle seat whilst the vehicle is in motion In the worst case this could lead to loss of vehicle control.
dodge.remedy: Check installation of joint and if necessary correctly install joint.

dodge.defect: SPARE WHEEL MAY DETACH The spare wheel located under the vehicle may become detached from the vehicle.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the spare wheel lifting and securing mechanism.

dodge.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

dodge.defect: UNINTENDED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG The electrical wiring loom may chafe on the steering column and cause the unintentional deployment of the drivers air bag.
dodge.remedy: Check wiring loom for damage and reposition it clear of the steering column.

dodge.defect: THE DEGRADATION OF THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER MAY RESULT IN VEHICLES EXCEEDING THE EMISSIONS STANDARDS The degradation of the catalytic converter may result in vehicles exceeding the emissions standards.
dodge.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module with the latest available software and replace the catalytic converters and the oxygen sensors.

dodge.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
dodge.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

dodge.defect: THE RIGHT SIDE OF DRIVE SHAFT MAY FAIL Drive shaft may fail.
dodge.remedy: Replace the right hand drive shaft

dodge.defect: ENGINE SUSPENSION REACTION BRACKET NOT FITTED ON THE TRANSMISSION SIDE Some vehicles were assembled without the engine suspension reaction bracket fitted on the transmission side. The vehicles must be repaired by fitting the missing components (transmission reaction bracket and washer). The defect can be detected by noise and vibration being emitted from the front area of the vehicle. If ignored a possible consequence is a failed differential box resulting in oil leakage and in some cases the drive shaft could become disengaged and drop below the vehicle whilst in motion.
dodge.remedy: Fit the missing components (transmission reaction bracket and washer).

dodge.defect: THE HANDBRAKE EFFICIENCY COULD BE LOST DUE TO THE PARKING BRAKE CABLE PRODUCTION PROCESS The parking brake efficiency could be lost due to a production problem with the cables.
dodge.remedy: Replacement of the parking brake cables on affected vehicles.

dodge.defect: INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR VEHICLE LIGHTING MAY FAIL It is possible under extreme conditions that the wiring harness under the dashboard could come into contact with the steering column. This over a period of time may result in the chaffing of wires in the harness. If this should occur then it is possible both the exterior and instrument lights could fail.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to provide additional security of the wiring loom.

dodge.defect: POWER STEERING PUMP MAY FAIL The batch number of the power steering pump must be checked and if found to be from a faulty batch replaced. On the faulty batches there is nonconformity of the external supply and in certain circumstances the power steering pump may fail causing the driver to use additional input to steer the vehicle therefore delaying the directional movement of the vehicle.
dodge.remedy: Check the production date of the pump and if the power steering pump is from a faulty batch replace the pump.

dodge.defect: FRONT SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER MAY MALFUNCTION DURING DEPLOYMENT Due to a non-conformity in the supplier's production process the front seat belt pretensioner could malfunction in the event of a collision.
dodge.remedy: Correct operation will be restored by applying a service kit designed for this purpose. Affected vehicles will be recalled to have this fitted.

dodge.defect: THE DRIVE AXLE MAY TOUCH THE WIRING The drive axle may touch the wiring with consequent damage to the wiring.
dodge.remedy: Check the correct layout of the wiring inspect its condition and reposition or replace as necessary

dodge.defect: NON CONFORMING STEERING KNUCKLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED Non-conforming steering knuckles may have been fitted.
dodge.remedy: Check the installed steering knuckles and replace if necessary.

dodge.defect: FAULT IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE Due to a fault in the airbag control module software the airbag system may fail to be active without this being indicated on the instrument panel.
dodge.remedy: Carry out an update to the airbag control module and instrument panel software.

dodge.defect: THE ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL WARNING LAMP MAY NOT DISPLAY PROPERLY UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS The Antilock Brake System control module may have software which prevents the Electronic Stability Control tell-tale (warning) lamp from displaying properly.
dodge.remedy: Update the AMS control module software.

dodge.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY In the event of a significant frontal collision the driver's airbag may not deploy correectly due to a non-conformity which occurred in the supplier's production process. The airbag when deployed may cause injury to the driver due to contaminated parts within the airbag module.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator.

dodge.defect: INEFFECTIVE/INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF A LOCK NUT ON THE STEERING GEAR ROD Vehicles may have been produced with ineffective/incorrect tightening of a lock nut on the steering gear rod.
dodge.remedy: Check for the correct tightening of the lock nut and check/adjust wheel alignment if tightening was required.

dodge.defect: FIRST GEAR COULD BE ENGAGED WHILST THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION AND THE SHIFT LEVER IN THE D POSITION First gear could be engaged with the vehicle in motion and the shift lever in the D position.
dodge.remedy: Update the transmission control module software

dodge.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
dodge.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

dodge.defect: THE OCCUPANT RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE (ORC) MAY INADVERTENTLY DEPLOY THE AIRBAGS AND/OR SEAT BELT PRETENSIONERS The Occupant Restraint Control (ORC) module may inadvertently deploy the airbags and/or seat belt pretensioners
dodge.remedy: Replace the ORC module

dodge.defect: SIDE AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED On affected vehicles the side airbags may not deploy.
dodge.remedy: Check installation of side airbag and where necessary replace.

dodge.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
dodge.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

dodge.defect: VACUUM PUMP DRIVE PIN Brake vacuum pump drive coupling dog may fail as a result of breakage. This could result in a loss of power assistance at the brake pedal.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a quality assured replacement drive pin to the vacuum pump.

dodge.defect: BRAKE PIPE DAMAGE On certain vehicles it is possible that the power steering high pressure hose may contact the offside front rigid brake pipe. This could result in damage to the brake pipe with a resultant reduction in braking efficiency.
dodge.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for a check on the positioning of the pipes involved and adjustment of the pipe clearance where necessary.

dodge.defect: SUSPENSION COIL SPRINGS MAY BREAK Under environmental conditions that require the intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits may infiltrate the rubber plate which supports the front suspension springs initiating seats of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
dodge.remedy: To avoid damage to a tyre in the event of spring breakage a plate will be fitted which will contain the spring.

dodge.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

dodge.defect: THE FLANGED WHEEL NUTS MAY HAVE BEEN OVER- TORQUED The flanged wheel nuts may have been over-torqued.
dodge.remedy: Inspect all wheel studs and replace if necessary. Update the user manual.

dodge.defect: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK AND RISK OF FIRE Due to the incorrect profiling of a rigid fuel pipe at the quick fit connection with the flexible fuel pipe for the injection manifold. The possibility exists that a fuel leak may develop at the connector and result in a fire in the engine compartment.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a locking insert fitted within the quick fit connector in order to prevent the connector from becoming loose.

dodge.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The  fuel return pipe on 2.0 16v JTD engine variants may interfere with the engine mounting and/or fuel filter.
dodge.remedy: Check and re-route the pipe and fit a protective sheath.

dodge.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

dodge.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY IN PRODUCTION THE SIDE MARKER LIGHTS ARE NOT FUNCTIONING Due to a nonconformity in production the side marker lights are not functioning.
dodge.remedy: The proxy file of the vehicle must be updated to allow the marker lights to function as intended.

dodge.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The fuel return pipe may contact the engine sound insulation cover. This may cause a deterioration of the pipe and if not rectified a leak of fuel.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a holding fastener to the fuel return pipe.

dodge.defect: REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE POINT NOT CONFORMING The rear seat belt anchorage points do not conform to specification which could in the event of a collision result in the insecurity of the seat belt.
dodge.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and upgrade the seat belt anchorage to the correct specification by the fitment of an additional bracket.

dodge.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It may be possible for the handbrake cable to foul the rigid brake pipe at the right hand rear suspension arm. In time this could lead to wear of the rigid brake pipe and as a consequence there maybe a loss of brake fluid and longer stopping distances.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the routing of the handbrake cable and fit rubber pads to the rigid brake pipe to prevent fouling.

dodge.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The passenger airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. This could result in an increased chance of occupant injury during certain crash conditions.
dodge.remedy: Replace air bag inflator on affected vehicles

dodge.defect: UNINTENDED  ACTIVATION OF SIDE WINDOW AIRBAGS It is possible for the side window air bags to deploy unintentionally.
dodge.remedy: Replace the air bag central control unit.

dodge.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

dodge.defect: THE TRANSMISSION MAY EXPERIENCE A BUILD UP OF PRESSURE AND HEAT INSIDE THE TRANSMISSION Expelled transmission fluid may come in contact with the turbocharger or other ignition sources within the engine compartment and lead to a vehicle fire
dodge.remedy: Replace the transmission valve body separator plate and reprogram the Powertrain Control Module.

dodge.defect: THE HANDBRAKE CABLE CONNECTOR ON THE REAR BRAKE  CALLIPER MAY BREAK The handbrake cable connector on the rear brake calliper may break
dodge.remedy: Check the rear brake calliper conformity and replace if necessary

dodge.defect: NON-CONFORMITY IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE Non-conformity in the airbag control module software
dodge.remedy: Update the airbag control module software

dodge.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE There is a possibility of a short circuit in the ABS control unit due to infiltration of chemical solutions.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace ABS module with modified type which is also fitted with plastic cover

dodge.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

dodge.defect: On affected vehicles diesel fuel leaks may possibly occur due to the vehicle being fitted with a fuel return pipe without protective tape.  This could cause a potential deformation of the fuel return pipe and in extreme cases could lead to fuel leaks and the risk of fire in the engine compartment. On affected vehicles diesel fuel leaks may possibly occur due to the vehicle being fitted with a fuel return pipe without protective tape.  This could cause a potential deformation of the fuel return pipe and in extreme cases could lead to fuel leaks and the risk of fire in the engine compartment.
dodge.remedy: The application of protective tape around the fuel return pipe.

dodge.defect: REPLACE ELECTRICAL POWER STEERING Due to a non-conformity in the production process the electrical power steering (EPS) must be replaced. This will prevent a potential loss of steering assistance. Loss of EPS functionality could increase the risk of a collision occurring.
dodge.remedy: Replace the Electrical Power Steering unit

dodge.defect: SEAT MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED DURING A COLLISION The seat may not remain in position when subjected to greater than normal driving forces such as those involved in an impact. This may possibly cause injury to the driver/passenger seated in the right hand front seat. The right hand front seat guides may not conform to design specification and installation specifications.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the installation of the original seat guide. If it does not conform replace the seat cushion structure (guide).

dodge.defect: VEHICLE STABILITY MAYBE AFFECTED It has been established that the anti-roll bar may not conform to specification.  This should result in a noise from the suspension but in extreme cases vehicle stability could be compromised.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace anti-roll bar with quality assured one.

dodge.defect: STEERING COULD BECOME INCREASINGLY STIFF. It has been identified that; due to a possible lack of lubricant between the steering rack and pinion the steering may become increasingly stiff to operate. This can eventually lead to damage to the steering rack teeth. As a consequence the steering operation of the vehicle may become increasingly difficult.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering rack inspected for damage. If no damage is evident the rack and pinion will be lubricated. Should any damage be in evidence the steering rack will be replaced.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF OFFSIDE FRONT BRAKE PIPE Offside front brake hose may chafe
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and fit new pipe if necessary

dodge.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED Incorrect profile (flaring) of the end of the steering shaft at the upper steering column universal joint. This may give the possibility of the steering column becoming disconnected from the universal joint with a consequent loss of vehicle steering.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the profile and flaring of the end of the steering shaft at the upper universal joint and where necessary renew the shaft.

dodge.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the tightening torque of the steering shaft upper fixing bolt may not be correct. This may result in the emission of noise and in extreme cases breakage of the shaft which will result in loss of steering control.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolt checked for correct torque which if necessary will be set to the correct specification. If the torque is outside of the rework stipulated range the shaft will be replaced.

dodge.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

dodge.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration.
dodge.remedy: The repair is a check of the PBU valve code and replacement of the 48-volt battery if necessary.

dodge.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY IN PRODUCTION THE SWIVEL PLATES ON WHICH THE TWO FRONT SEATS ARE ANCHORED MUST BE REPLACED Due to a nonconformity in production the swivel plates on which the two front seats are anchored must be�replaced.
dodge.remedy: Replace the swivel plates onto which the front seats are anchored.

dodge.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNITENTIONALLY On vehicles fitted with comfort instrument panel when the passenger's airbag has been deactivated it is possible in some cases that it will reactivate spontaneously.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

dodge.defect: BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE MAY BE REDUCED It has been identified that due to the inlet filter for the exhaust gas recirculating valve (EGR) being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This can give rise to the possibility of ice forming within the pipe during periods of low ambient temperature with the possibility of reduced brake servo assistance.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR valve solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If this is not the case new solenoids with separate filters will be fitted.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary

dodge.defect: FUEL TANK MOUNTINGS Fuel tank rear mountings may not inadequately secure the tank with a risk of possible disengagement.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcement plates to rear tank mountings.

dodge.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

dodge.defect: The calibration for urea pump diagnostics in the ECU (Engine Control Unit) is not fulfilling regulation requirement The calibration for urea pump diagnostics in the ECU (Engine Control Unit) is not fulfilling the regulation requirement.
dodge.remedy: Update to the ECU (engine control unit) calibration software.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING There is a possibility that the weld on the steering shaft at the lower universal joint fitting maybe absent.  If there is an absent of the weld at the joint this may lead to a loss of steering.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and inspect steering shaft to ensure weld is present if not renew steering shaft.

dodge.defect: FIRST GEAR COULD BE ENGAGED WHILST THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION AND THE SHIFT LEVER IN THE D POSITION First gear could be engaged with the vehicle in motion and the shift lever in the D position.
dodge.remedy: Update the transmission control module software

dodge.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF BRAKE PIPES. Possible chafing of front rigid brake pipes at near side front against the plastic wheel arch liner or against the gearbox mounting. Also at the off side front against the engine timing belt cover.
dodge.remedy: Reposition any chafing brake pipe to comply with the manufacturer's prescribed clearance between adjacent parts. Renew any brake pipe that has been chafed beyond a serviceable condition.

dodge.defect: HEATER/CLIMATE CONTROL WIRING ABRASION MAY RESULT IN  A SHORT CIRCUIT. It has been identified that the possibility exists of interference between the heater/climate control wiring and a dashboard bracket due to a missing retainer clip. In this condition abrasion of the wiring may occur with the attendant risk of an electrical short circuit
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for damage to the subject wiring which if this has occurred will be repaired and repositioned. In all cases a new clip will be fitted.

dodge.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel delivery pipe adjacent to air filter may chafe. This in time could lead to leakage of fuel in the engine compartment and a consequent risk of fire.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel delivery pipe and where necessary replace the pipe containment channel.

dodge.defect: INCORRECT SPARE WHEEL Some vehicles with alloy wheels may have been supplied with an unsuitable space saver spare wheel. If fitted this spare wheel could cause interference with braking system components.
dodge.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace any unsuitable spare wheels with correctly specified versions.

dodge.defect: MANUFACTURERS PLATE INFORMATION INCORRECT The manufacturer's plate information may refer to vehicles with a capacity of 8 hundred weight rather than 7 hundred weight.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the manufacturer's plate with one that is correct to the vehicle.

dodge.defect: U-BOLTS ON REAR AXLE MAY BREAK The U bolts securing the leaf spring to the rear axle may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This may result in the U bolts breaking.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the U bolts checked to ensure there is no damage and that they have been tightened to the correct torque.

dodge.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK There is a possibility that fuel may leak from a faulty recirculation pipe connector.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if required change pipe.

dodge.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM MOUNTINGS - FAILURE OF WELD There is a possibility that corrosion may be present near the welds for the front suspension arm front mountings on the front cross member.Should this be the case in time this could lead to noise whilst driving and the possibility that the weld could fail. Failure of the weld may lead to loss of vehicle stability.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicle will be checked to ascertain whether corrosion is present near the front suspension mountings. If this is found to be the case the front cross member will be replaced. If corrosion is not present a front cross member strengthening kit will be fitted.

dodge.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNITENTIONALLY On vehicles fitted with comfort instrument panel when the passenger's airbag has been deactivated it is possible in some cases that it will reactivate spontaneously.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

dodge.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK After repeated activation of the fuel heater cover in cold conditions an electric connector  the fuel heater cover  may overheat. This may allow air ingress which could cause difficulty starting the engine or engine stalling. In extreme cases fuel may leak onto the road surface.
dodge.remedy: Check the condition of the heated diesel filter cover and  connector. If deteriorated or damaged replace the cover or connector.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

dodge.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

dodge.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration.
dodge.remedy: The repair is a check of the PBU valve code and replacement of the 48-volt battery if necessary.

dodge.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

dodge.defect: CORROSION OF METAL BRAKE PIPES Prolonged exposure to the effects of road salt corrosion may result in perforation of the metal brake pipes and a consequential loss of braking efficiency.
dodge.remedy: Replace corroded brake pipes and apply corrosion prevention treatment to all brake pipes.

dodge.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION CROSS MEMBER MAY FRACTURE It has been identified that the chassis front cross member may have a weld which does not conform to specification. This may lead to a creaking noise being heard under braking and could in time lead to the cross member cracking in the area of it's mounting to the vehicle's body.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front cross member replaced.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.

dodge.defect: The positive lead on the auxiliary battery terminal may not be tightened correctly. The positive lead on the auxiliary battery terminal may not be tightened correctly
dodge.remedy: The integrity of the positive lead terminal must be checked and if it is damaged it must be replaced. If it is not damaged the correct torque must be applied to the nut to ensure correct tightening.

dodge.defect: A HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS CONNECTOR MIGHT NOT BE TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION A High Voltage Harness connector might not be to the correct specification
dodge.remedy: Check the connector and if required replace the harness.

dodge.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

dodge.defect: THE REAR RIGHT BRAKE CALLIPER COULD DISPLAY MICRO CRACKS The rear right brake calliper could display micro-cracks
dodge.remedy: The production date must be checked and if necessary the brake calliper must be replaced

dodge.defect: TRANSMISSION MOUNT MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a nonconformity in the transmission casing mount material there is a possibility that the casting may fail.  This may affect the control of the vehicle.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the mounting with new quality assured item.

dodge.defect: SEAT BELT PRE TENSIONERS MAY FAIL TO ACTIVATE On some Punto vehicles it has been found that the seat belt pre-tensioners may fail to activate although normal activation of the seat belt is assured.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to shorten the safety tabs in the inertia reel.

dodge.defect: RISK OF REAR BRAKE LOCK UP It has been identified that on subject vehicles the rear brake back plate retaining bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification. Should the bolts work loose this can result in noise illumination of the ABS warning light and in extreme cases wheel lock.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked and tightened to the correct specification.

dodge.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL In some circumstances the headlights can switch off without warning which will increase the risk of an accident.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the Body Computer with new improved software.

dodge.defect: REAR CROSS MEMBER WELDING  MAY CRACK It has been identified that the possibility exists that a non conforming weld may be present on the vehicle's rear cross member with the fixing bracket for the wheel axle hub. This non conformity in time; could cause the weld to break and crack the rear cross member which could have an adverse effect on the vehicle's stability.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject cross member identification numbers and weld markings checked; to ascertain whether they conform. Should this not be the case the cross member will be replaced.

dodge.defect: INCORRECTLY POSITIONED FUEL PIPE Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
dodge.remedy: : Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

dodge.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

dodge.defect: UNINTENDED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG Possible water ingress into the electronic control unit (ECU) could result in unintentional deployment of the drivers air bag and passengers air bag where fitted.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for water ingress into the ECU and replace if necessary. Fit water protection to the ECU in all cases.

dodge.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAYBE AFFECTED Vehicles fitted with rear brake drums may suffer contamination of the brake lining.   This is due to the entry of water and detritus into the drum through the back plate.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a gasket to the back plate where the handbrake cable enters the brake drum through the back plate.

dodge.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY FRACTURE There is a possibility that the brake pedal is of incorrect specification and could eventually fracture.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace brake pedal with quality assured type.

dodge.defect: The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect (4835 kg instead of 4955 kg). The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect.
dodge.remedy: The CoC and registration documents must be replaced to reflect the correct data.

dodge.defect: SOUND DEADENING GUARD MAY BECOME DETACHED It is possible for the fastenings of the sound deadening guard to become loose. Consequently the guard could become detached whilst the vehicle is in motion.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace all the fastenings with new captive fasteners and bolts.

dodge.defect: Certain kinds of vehicle acceleration could cause the speed limiter to turn off. Certain kinds of vehicle acceleration could cause the speed limiter to turn off.
dodge.remedy: Update the software of engine control module.

dodge.defect: FUEL VAPOUR RE- CIRCULATION PIPE MAY BECOME DAMAGED The fuel vapour re-circulation pipe could foul against the air-conditioning compressor pulley resulting in possible damage to the pipe and the risk of fire.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and reposition re-circulation pipe away from compressor pulley.

dodge.defect: Fiat Scudo Rear suspension springs Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
dodge.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

dodge.defect: Engine Control Module calibration Low In-Use Performance-Ratio On affected vehicles there is a requirement to update the Engine Control Module (ECM) calibration due to a production non-conformity and not fulfilling emission regulatory requirements.
dodge.remedy: Update the ECM software calibration

dodge.defect: Anti-lock brake system module Affected vehicles may experience an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) module software malfunction which can disable the Electronic Stability Control (ESC) system. Failure of the ESC system can in certain driving conditions cause a vehicle crash without prior warning.
dodge.remedy: Install modified software to the ABS control module.

dodge.defect: Fiat Scudo. Multifunction screen fixings. On affected vehicles the radio display screen may be incorrectly secured.
dodge.remedy: Check the fixing of the screen and add any missing fixings.

dodge.defect: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended. On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
dodge.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

dodge.defect: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended. On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
dodge.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

dodge.defect: Fiat Ducato 2024. Proxy update. Vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements Affected vehicles may have the urea system management menu missing from the instrument panel. This may result in warning messages not being displayed on the instrument panel cluster depending on the urea level. In this condition the vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements.
dodge.remedy: Check and if necessary install modified software.

dodge.defect: Ground connections On affected vehicles there could be a loss of certain ground connections for some electrical harnesses which may result in the loss of several vehicle functions.
dodge.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

dodge.defect: Fiat 500 BEV Panda and Tipo. Instrument panel cluster software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case. If the customer seeks to reactivate the AEB after previously deactivating it during the same driving cycle (key on/off) it will remain deactivated however the icon on the cluster to alert about deactivation remains off. This does not meet regulatory requirements.
dodge.remedy: Update front camera software.

dodge.defect: Fiat Professional Ducato. Instrument panel cluster software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case. If the customer seeks to reactivate the AEB after previously deactivating it during the same driving cycle (key on/off) it will remain deactivated however the icon on the cluster to alert about deactivation remains off. This does not meet regulatory requirements.
dodge.remedy: Update front camera software.

dodge.defect: SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) Diagnosis issues Affected vehicles may have been equipped with Engine Control Unit (ECU) software not fulfilling regulation requirements.
dodge.remedy: Update to the ECU software.

dodge.defect: TYRE VALVE MAY BREAK  CAUSING RAPID DEFLATION (STEEL WHEELS) It has been identified that due to manufacture from an incorrect material the tyre inflation valve may break. Should this occur rapid deflation of the tyre and possible vehicle instability would occur.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the tyre inflation valve replaced on all steel wheels including the spare.

dodge.defect: REAR AXLE MAY MOVE It is possible the rear axle leaf spring retaining bolts were not tightened to the correct specification during production.  This could allow movement between the axle and leaf spring. In extreme circumstances this could cause the vehicle to lose control.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the U bolts with new items and tighten them to the correct specification.

dodge.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LEAKAGE FROM FUEL TANK DUE TO CORROSION Possibility of fuel leakage from the fuel tank due to corrosion
dodge.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled during which time the fuel tank will be inspected for corrosion. Should corrosion be found the fuel tank will be replaced.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.

dodge.defect: THE DRIVE SHAFT MAY FAIL DUE TO A NON-CONFORMITY IN THE MATERIAL The drive shaft joints may fail
dodge.remedy: Replace the drive shaft or shafts as required

dodge.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

dodge.defect: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM OF THE STEERING COLUMN The steering column height adjustment mechanism could accidentally release.
dodge.remedy: Replace the steering column mechanism.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL The tyres fitted to affected vehicles are incompatible with the weight capacity of the vehicle. This may cause a tyre failure due to incorrect loading of the vehicle.
dodge.remedy: Replace existing tyres with those of a load index compatible with the vehicle's weight capacity.

dodge.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK LEADING IN EXTREME CASES TO FIRE The fuel pump protection bracket is not to conformity and in the event of an accident the fuel feed pipe could be damaged leading to an increased risk of fuel leakage and possible fire.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel pump feed protection bracket and reposition the fuel feed pipe.

dodge.defect: DROPSIDE PANEL MAY DETACH It has been identified that the possibility exists that breakage of the dropside hinge fastening plate may occur on vehicles fitted with a factory installed dropside body. This can result in the detachment of the dropside panel.
dodge.remedy: Subject vehicles will be recalled at which time the hinge fastening plates will be changed.

dodge.defect: POTENTIAL RISK OF ACCESS STEP DETACHING FROM VEHICLE BODY Potential risk of access step detachment from the vehicle body.
dodge.remedy: Replacement of the access step fasteners.

dodge.defect: Incorrect information displayed on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
dodge.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

dodge.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the possibility exists that a disconnection of the handbrake cable may occur which can result in the handbrake becoming inefficient.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fitment of the handbrake cable to the actuating lever checked. If found to be incorrect the situation  will be rectified. If the handbrake cable is found to be damaged it will be replaced.

dodge.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

dodge.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY The brake vacuum pump may not function correctly.
dodge.remedy: Replace the brake vacuum pump of affected vehicles

dodge.defect: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE Due to the inlet filter for the EGR valve being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This could result in the possibility of ice forming in the brake servo vacuum pipe in conditions of low ambient temperature. As a consequence this may lead to reduced servo assistance to the braking system.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If theses are not evident new solenoids with separate air filters will be fitted.

dodge.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY NEED INCREASED FORCE DURING APPLICATION There is a possibility that the valve in the Brake Booster Vacuum Pump may not be compliant. This can result in loss of vacuum assistance.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace pump.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT IN ENGINE COOLING FAN CONTROL UNIT A short circuit may occur in the engine cooling fan control unit with a resultant risk of overheating.
dodge.remedy: Fit a new cooling fan control unit.

dodge.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
dodge.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE On batteries fitted with non-watertight caps rainwater from the windscreen may run into the battery and result in a leakage of battery contents. This leakage may damage the adjacent fabric reinforced rubber brake servo pipe and reduce or cancel the servo assistance available when braking.
dodge.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have a cover fitted to the battery and checking of the brake servo pipe for damage.

dodge.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
dodge.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

dodge.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
dodge.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

dodge.defect: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
dodge.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

dodge.defect: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
dodge.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

dodge.defect: VIN label and CoC addendum Affected vehicles may have a tyre load index on the vehicle that is lower than the declared rear axle capacity.
dodge.remedy: Replacement of the manufacturer's label fitted to the vehicle and supply the customer with an addendum to the COC (Certificate of Conformity).

dodge.defect: Fiat 600 MHEV and BEV. Front camera Affected vehicles are fitted with a front camera with an incorrect hardware ID which causes an error code within the car system. Once an error code is set and recorded the camera is always in fault mode whenever it is switched on. This will result in the ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance System) remaining inactive. This inactive status is a nonconformity with regulatory requirements.
dodge.remedy: Replace the front camera.

dodge.defect: Fiat 600 fuel pipe On affected vehicles there is a risk of a fuel leak at the high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections which in a worst-case could result in a vehicle fire.
dodge.remedy: Check and tighten high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections.

dodge.defect: Fiat Professional Doblo tyre label On affected vehicles the tyre pressure label may show incorrect or missing information which does not meet regulatory requirements.
dodge.remedy: Replace the tyre pressure label.

dodge.defect: Fiat Scudo seat fixing On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
dodge.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

dodge.defect: Driver airbag inflator On affected vehicles the driver’s airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. An inflator rupture during airbag deployment events could result in metal fragments striking and potentially seriously injuring the vehicle occupant(s).
dodge.remedy: Replace the drivers airbag.

dodge.defect: 2009 Dodge Durango Driver airbag inflator On affected vehicles the driver’s airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. An inflator rupture during airbag deployment events could result in metal fragments striking and potentially seriously injuring the vehicle occupant(s).
dodge.remedy: Replace the drivers airbag.

dodge.defect: Fiat Ducato may have been fitted with the incorrect radio Affected vehicles may have been fitted with the incorrect radio. The radio fitted does not have rear view camera functionality and therefore may not comply with regulatory requirements.
dodge.remedy: Replace the radio.

dodge.defect: 2024 Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV Advanced Driver Assistance  Systems Radio software On affected vehicles equipped with an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality the AEB/LKA (Active Emergency Brake/Lane Keep Assist) can be deactivated simultaneously. The vehicle does not therefore meet regulatory requirements.
dodge.remedy: Install updated software over the air (OTA).

dodge.defect: Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV. Brake pedal On a number of Fiat 600 vehicles due to a production  nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake  pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a  rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal  disengagement In the event of brake pedal failure the  Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can  be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled  stop. Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency  Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent  collision.
dodge.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Fiat dealer  checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct  assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance  with Fiat reference F53D.

dodge.defect: Fiat 500 BEV High Voltage battery negative pole connection On affected vehicles the fastening nut may be missing from the negative terminal of the high-voltage battery pack which could result in a loss of torque failure to start the vehicle and in extreme cases it could present a possible fire hazard.
dodge.remedy: The affected vehicles will have the high-voltage battery replaced.

dodge.defect: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
dodge.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

dodge.defect: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
dodge.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

dodge.defect: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
dodge.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

dodge.defect: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
dodge.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

dodge.defect: Fiat Professional 2025/2026 Ducato (290/295). Fuel pipe leak Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
dodge.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

dodge.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

dodge.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The threaded portion of the brake linkage rod in the brake control system may not be to conformity. This could result in a reduction of braking efficiency.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check rod and replace if found not to meet conformity.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
dodge.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

dodge.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE FLUIDS AND EXTENDED PEDAL TRAVEL The brake hoses may chafe on the wheel aches and in extreme cases cause a brake fluid  leak. The driver will be informed of the defect by the illumination of a warning lamp on the dashboard. If ignored then this will result in longer than expected stopping distances.
dodge.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and visually inspect the front brake hoses reinforcement and protection. The brake hoses if worn will be replaced.

dodge.defect: FRONT DOOR LATCHES COULD FAIL TO OPERATE It has been identified that the front door latch cables may; during certain operating conditions become detached from the interior release handle housing. This can result in the door latch sticking in the unlatched position and the lock function to become inoperative.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a latch cable retaining clip installed on the right and left front door interior release handle housings.

dodge.defect: THE BALLAST SUPPORT BRACKET WELDED TO THE REAR FLOOR COUD BREAK The ballast support bracket welded to the rear floor could break
dodge.remedy: Add two new fixings for each ballast support

dodge.defect: ELECTRIC SLIDING REAR DOOR Electric Sliding door may open inadvertently.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and upgrade door control system ECU.

dodge.defect: THE THIRD (HIGH LEVEL) BRAKE LIGHT MAY NOT FUNCTION The third (high level) brake light may not function.
dodge.remedy: Update the software to activate the third brake light function.

dodge.defect: IF REAR SEAT BELTS ARE NOT FASTENED AND PRETENSIONERS ARE DEPLOYED THE LATCH COULD BE RELEASED In case of an accident if the rear seat belts are not fastened i.e. if the rear seat is not occupied by a passenger or is occupied by a child restraint system coupled only to the Isofix anchors and the pretensioners are deployed the rear seat latch could be released. The contents of the rear luggage area if unsecured could enter the cabin area
dodge.remedy: Replace the latch bezels with bezels the shape of which prevents the seat belts from interfering with the latch and releasing the seat in the event of a pretensioner deployment.

dodge.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
dodge.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE The transmission could unexpectedly switch to the N position due to a nonconformity in the transmission wiring assembly process.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram the transmission control module. Where necessary replace the transmission wiring

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER STEERING The power assisted steering low pressure pipe may chafe on a hose clip.  This could result in the loss of the hydraulic fluid and power assistance of the steering.
dodge.remedy: Check the steering low pressure hydraulic pipe for damage and reposition the hose clip where necessary.

dodge.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the tightening torque of the steering shaft upper fixing bolt may not be correct. This may result in the emission of noise and in extreme cases breakage of the shaft which will result in loss of steering control.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolt checked for correct torque which if necessary will be set to the correct specification. If the torque is outside of the rework stipulated range the shaft will be replaced.

dodge.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTENT AIRBAG ACTIVATION The air conditioning condenser drainpipe may in some instances become blocked with the possibility that the condensate may leak into the passenger compartment and the air bag central control unit. This contamination may cause the air bag warning light to illuminate and in some cases; cause inadvertent activation of the air bag.
dodge.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the condensate drainpipe will be refitted; and re-profiled to remove any restriction.

dodge.defect: DOOR PANEL MAY CAUSE INJURY In the event of a side impact on a small number of vehicles fitted with the Sabelt seat option the door side panels may break in an unsuitable way and possibly cause injury to the occupants.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the door panels.

dodge.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF STEERING The steering column to steering wheel shaft may not have been assembled correctly. If not corrected noise and play will become apparent and if these warnings are not acted on eventually steering control could be lost.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary refit the steering column correctly to the steering wheel shaft.

dodge.defect: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY BECOME DETACHED The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body
dodge.remedy: Replace the current sleeve and respective metal bands with modified parts.

dodge.defect: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY DETACH FROM THE THROTTLE BODY The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body.  The engine management warning light will illuminate and a loss of power may occur.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the current retainer with a new version to ensure the sleeve connection between intercooler sleeve and throttle body.

dodge.defect: REAR AXLE MAY SEIZE The rear axle pinion nut has been assembled without the use of a thread adhesive which could allow the pinion nut to loosen. As a result  the propshaft detach form the vehicle or the final drive could seize.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles check security of pinion nut. Dependant on outcome fit a pinion nut retainer or recondition final drive assembly.

dodge.defect: THE REAR SPOILER MAY BE FITTED SO IT IS OVER HANGING THE ROOF. The rear spoiler may be fitted so it is overhanging the roof allowing contact with the roof when opening or closing the tailgate.
dodge.remedy: The rear spoiler will be inspected for correct installation. If needed the upper spoiler section will be replaced and the spoiler reattached to the vehicle.

dodge.defect: REDUCED BRAKE PERFORMANCE It has been identified that the rear brake shoe lining material may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. This could result in a reduction in brake performance from the rear brakes.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the conformity of the brake linings and if found to be incorrect replace with new brake shoes which meet the correct conformity.

dodge.defect: INCORRECT TORQUE OF WHEEL BOLTS The road wheel fixing bolts may not have been correctly torqued and could loosen over a period of use.
dodge.remedy: Check the wheel fixing bolts for correct torque and tighten or renew as appropriate.

dodge.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL The headlights may fail because of a Body Control Computer software problem.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

dodge.defect: BODY SECURING BRACKETS MAY FAIL The lower fastening brackets which secure the body to the chassis are not manufactured to specification. As a result the brackets may fail and render the body not fully secure.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the body securing brackets with ones manufactured to specification.

dodge.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

dodge.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

dodge.defect: DUE TO INCORRECT TYPE APPROVAL DATA PROCESSING THE MANUFACTURER'S PLATE (VIN PLATE) AND REGISTRATION DOCUMENT MUST BE REPLACED Due to incorrect type-approval data processing the manufacturer's plate (VIN plate) and registration document must be replaced.
dodge.remedy: Replace the VIN plate and update the registration document as required.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
dodge.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

dodge.defect: STEERING WHEEL AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY It has been identified that due to the non-conforming layout of the airbag wiring and missing cut-proof protection the airbag wiring may interfere with the steering wheel wiring terminal. This can cause the abrasion of the wiring itself. This abrasion may cause a short-circuit and consequent inadvertent deployment of the steering wheel airbag.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the airbag wiring and apply cut proof padded tape.

dodge.defect: CAMSHAFT MAY FAIL Due to an error in the production process the engine camshaft may break.
dodge.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the camshaft.

dodge.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The passenger airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. This could result in an increased chance of occupant injury during certain crash conditions.
dodge.remedy: Replace air bag inflator on affected vehicles

dodge.defect: BRAKE VACUUM ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE In some cases due to the non-compliance of the engine ECU software the engine failure warning lamp may illuminate. As a consequence the vacuum assistance available to the braking system may be reduced.
