dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-programme the engine ECU with updated software.

dodge.defect: THE SPORT MODE SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS The �Sport� mode system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
dodge.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

dodge.defect: Driver airbag inflator The driver airbag inflator housing may rupture during normal airbag deployment events and metal fragments could injure components.  This  is more likely to occur if the vehicle has been exposed to high levels of absolute humidity for extended periods of time.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag inflator.

dodge.defect: INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR VEHICLE LIGHTING MAY FAIL It is possible under extreme conditions that the wiring harness under the dashboard could come into contact with the steering column. This over a period of time may result in the chaffing of wires in the harness. If this should occur then it is possible both the exterior and instrument lights could fail.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to provide additional security of the wiring loom.

dodge.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

dodge.defect: INCORRECT SPARE WHEEL Some vehicles with alloy wheels may have been supplied with an unsuitable space saver spare wheel. If fitted this spare wheel could cause interference with braking system components.
dodge.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace any unsuitable spare wheels with correctly specified versions.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF LOWER ENGINE STABILISER ROD The lower engine stabiliser rod may crack or break. This could result in detachment of the off side drive shaft on full lock.
dodge.remedy: Inspect the stabiliser rod welding and fit a new rod where found necessary.

dodge.defect: On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling. On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling.
dodge.remedy: The repair is an upload of modified ECU software.

dodge.defect: FRACTURE OF FRONT COIL SPRINGS The anti noise plastic shields fitted to the bottom of the front suspension coil springs may permit the accumulation of a high level of humidity under certain environmental conditions. When combined with the presence of salt and small stones etc. this condition may cause breakage of the spring(s) and subsequent tearing of the tyre as a result of the fractured coils contacting the tyre wall.
dodge.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a modified ventilated spring sheath and inspection of the front coil springs.

dodge.defect: On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling. On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling.
dodge.remedy: The repair is an upload of modified ECU software.

dodge.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On certain vehicles the front brake discs may not be the required thickness for the vehicle definition. This concern may result in reduced braking efficiency.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the front brake discs.

dodge.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

dodge.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

dodge.defect: Driver airbag inflator The driver airbag inflator housing may rupture during normal airbag deployment events and metal fragments could injure components.  This  is more likely to occur if the vehicle has been exposed to high levels of absolute humidity for extended periods of time.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag inflator.

dodge.defect: SUPPLEMENTARY HEATER WIRING MAY BECOME DAMAGED AND CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT On some Fiat 500L vehicles a layout non-conformity could cause abrasion of the supplementary heater (PTC) wiring. This could result in possible electric short-circuiting with the possibility of a loss of some vehicle safety. In the worst case it could cause a vehicle fire..
dodge.remedy: Apply a cut-proof sheath on the supplementary heater wiring to protect it from abrasions.

dodge.defect: FRONT WIPER MAY FAIL An internal fault with the wiper motor could cause it to stop working. In some rare cases the windscreen wipers may stop working while in operation.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the manufacturing date of the wiper motor and add a supplementary earth wiring harness if necessary.

dodge.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF FRONT SPRING A specific batch of vehicles have been equipped with front suspension coil springs which may suffer from localised corrosion. This can cause breakage of the springs with an adverse effect on vehicle control.
dodge.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original coil springs with quality assured examples.

dodge.defect: ROUTING OF BRAKE VACUUM PIPE MAY BE INCORRECT In some cases due to the non compliant routing of the brake servo vacuum supply pipe damage to the pipe may occur with the possibility that braking assistance might be reduced.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject pipe checked and re-routed. Should any damage be found the pipe will be replaced.

dodge.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

dodge.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY OF THE FUEL RETURN PIPE DIESEL FUEL LEAKS MAY OCCUR Due to a nonconformity of the fuel return pipe diesel fuel leaks may occur.
dodge.remedy: Check the conformity of the fuel return pipe and if necessary replace.

dodge.defect: INCORRECTLY POSITIONED FUEL PIPE Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
dodge.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

dodge.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES On ABS equipped Punto vehicles contact may take place between the brake compensator springs and the rear (metal) brake pipes. This could damage the pipes causing loss of brake fluid and reducing the efficiency of the service brake.
dodge.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

dodge.defect: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY It has been identified that the hand brake lever may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. It could result in the vehicle rolling away.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the hand brake assembly with a new quality controlled assembly

dodge.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The passenger airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. This could result in an increased chance of occupant injury during certain crash conditions.
dodge.remedy: Replace air bag inflator on affected vehicles

dodge.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
dodge.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

dodge.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

dodge.defect: ANTI-ROLL BAR BUSH WEAR It has been identified that the front anti-roll bar bushes may wear after a period of time. Should this occur noise will be generated by contact between the anti-roll bar and the metal sleeve of the bush.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front anti-roll bar replaced.

dodge.defect: INCORRECT LOAD CAPACITY LISTED FOR INTERIOR HOOKS It has been identified that the maximum load capacity for the load restraint hooks in the load compartment of the vehicle has been incorrectly written in the Owner Handbook.  The correct load capacity is 500 daN and not the 625 daN as written. If the correct load capacity of 500 daN is not adhered to then the load hooks may not retain the load due to overloading. This could result in an unsecured load with the potential for loss of control of the vehicle.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to attach a load capacity label within the load compartment and install an additional amended page to the Owner Handbook.

dodge.defect: On the affected vehicle the tightening torque applied to the steering rack during production may be insufficient. On the affected vehicle the tightening torque applied to the steering rack during production may be insufficient.
dodge.remedy: The repair is replacement of the left steering pinion tie rod retainer nut and apply the correct torque.

dodge.defect: SEAT MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED DURING A COLLISION The seat may not remain in position when subjected to greater than normal driving forces such as those involved in an impact. This may possibly cause injury to the driver/passenger seated in the right hand front seat. The right hand front seat guides may not conform to design specification and installation specifications.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the installation of the original seat guide. If it does not conform replace the seat cushion structure (guide).

dodge.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

dodge.defect: THE START & STOP SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS The Start & Stop system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
dodge.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

dodge.defect: POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING MAY BE LOST The wiring for the power steering electric pump may interfere with the edge of the left front wheel arch. This may cause damage to the wiring and a loss of power steering assistance.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected so the wiring can be placed in a protective pipe. The wiring and pipe will then be secured in the correct position.

dodge.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The passenger airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. This could result in an increased chance of occupant injury during certain crash conditions.
dodge.remedy: Replace air bag inflator on affected vehicles

dodge.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY FAIL TO RETURN TO IDLE The accelerator pedal may stick thereby causing the vehicle to react differently than the driver would anticipate.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the throttle pedal and reprogramme the ECU.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE INTERFERENCE BETWEEN FUEL SUPPLY AND RETURN LINES Possible interference between the fuel supply and return lines.
dodge.remedy: Reposition the pipes to avoid interference.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE INADEQUATE FRONT WINDSCREEN ADHESION TO THE VEHICLE BODY Possible inadequate front windscreen adhesion to the vehicle body.
dodge.remedy: Remove and replace the front windscreen urethane sealant.

dodge.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR FROM THE FUEL TANK Due to a non-conformity in production fuel leakage may occur from the fuel tank
dodge.remedy: Replace the fuel tank

dodge.defect: POTENTIAL FIRE The fuel return pipe connector at the injectors may overtime wear and leak. The leaking fuel is a fire risk and also could be hazardous to other road users.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel return pipe.

dodge.defect: SECURITY OF SEAT BELT A number of the subject vehicles have been fitted with seat belts manufactured by TRW the attachment systems of which may not remain secure in an accident situation.
dodge.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check the date of production on the seat belt buckles and replace those within the critical batch.

dodge.defect: POTENTIAL MOVEMENT OF THE BATTERY Potential movement of the battery and consequent breakage of the battery wires.
dodge.remedy: A battery spacer must be fitted

dodge.defect: HANDBRAKE CONCERN The handbrake cable may have been incorrectly fitted and could become disconnected from the rear brake mechanism.  This would result in the handbrake becoming ineffective.
dodge.remedy: Check that the handbrake cable is correctly connected to the rear brake mechanism and fit a new cable where it is not.

dodge.defect: ACCELERATOR MAY STICK It has been identified that the possibility exists that the accelerator pedal's rotation pin may not have been inserted correctly. In this condition the accelerator pedal might stick.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the accelerator pedal checked for the presence of the pin. Should the pin be found to be missing the accelerator pedal will be changed.

dodge.defect: THE DEGRADATION OF THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER MAY RESULT IN VEHICLES EXCEEDING THE EMISSIONS STANDARDS The degradation of the catalytic converter may result in vehicles exceeding the emissions standards.
dodge.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module with the latest available software and replace the catalytic converters and the oxygen sensors.

dodge.defect: ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY BE DEACTIVATED In some circumstances the driver and passenger may experience consequent switching off of the instrument panel light and possible deactivation of other electronic systems such as the ABS and airbags. The concern is caused by loose connections at the ignition switch contact holder block.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition switch contact holder block.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE After extended high speed running brake servo assistance may be lost due to petrol contamination of the servo diaphragm.
dodge.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the servo brake vacuum pipe and checking of the brake servo efficiency.

dodge.defect: THE RADIO ALLOWS FOR THE REAR VIEW CAMERA TO BE DISPLAYED LONGER THAN THE TIME ALLOWED The radio allows for the rear view camera to be displayed longer than the time allowed.
dodge.remedy: The radio software will need to be inspected and if required updated.

dodge.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
dodge.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

dodge.defect: SUSPENSION COIL SPRING MAY BREAK Under environmental conditions that require intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits accumulate inside the noise-insulating protective sheath located on the front suspension springs creating areas of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front coil springs with those of a new type.

dodge.defect: On affected vehicles the rear spoiler may be over-flush to the roof allowing contact to the roof when opening and/or closing the liftgate. An over-flush rear spoiler may become damaged when opening and/or closing the liftgate which may result in the spoiler becoming partially detached from the vehicle. On affected vehicles the rear spoiler may be over-flush to the roof allowing contact to the roof when opening and/or closing the liftgate. An over-flush rear spoiler may become damaged when opening and/or closing the liftgate which may result in the spoiler becoming partially detached from the vehicle.
dodge.remedy: Affected vehicles will require the clearances and spoiler security checked and if necessary replace the spoiler.

dodge.defect: SIDE AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY It is possible that the front door wiring may fatigue and break. Should this occur it may affect the circuitry for the side air bag which may if the vehicle is involved in a side impact result in the non deployment of the side air bag.
dodge.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for a check of the wiring and repair if required.

dodge.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL CONCERN The accelerator pedal may foul on its travel limiting stop and prevent the engine from decellerating when the pedal is released.
dodge.remedy: Fit a modified pedal travel limiting stop.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES On ABS equipped Punto vehicles contact may take place between the brake compensator springs and the rear (metal) brake pipes. This could damage the pipes causing loss of brake fluid and reducing the efficiency of the service brake.
dodge.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

dodge.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU Water ingress into the airbag control unit (ECU) could result in illumination of the warning light and in the worst case unintentional deployment of the airbag.
dodge.remedy: Seal the airbag ECU compartment

dodge.defect: STEERING SWIVEL  JOINT MAY FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL The possibility exists that the swivel joint stem of the front suspension vertical links maybe of an incorrect size. This can lead to the generation of noise whilst driving and the possibility of suspension disconnection following a violent impact to the front axle and subsequent loss of vehicle control.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the swivel joint stems checked for the presence of play and will be replaced if any is found.

dodge.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE FRONT CROSSMEMBER INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED Vehicles may have been fitted with the front crossmember incorrectly tightened.
dodge.remedy: Check and tighten the bolts on the front crossmember to the prescribed torque. Replacement of the steering rack if necessary.

dodge.defect: FRONT WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE It has been identified that the possibility exists that water may ingress into the front windscreen wiper motor. Should this occur the wipers may become inoperative. In conditions of poor visibility this may result in impaired driver visibility.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front windscreen wiper motor fitted with a protective cover.

dodge.defect: EGR PIPE COULD FRACTURE DUE TO A POTENTIAL NON-CONFORMITY The EGR pipe could fracture due to a potential non-conformity the fractured pipe may damage the alternator resulting in a loss of battery voltage and potentially a loss of engine power.
dodge.remedy: The pipe must be checked and if incorrect replaced with a new  part.

dodge.defect: INEFFECTIVE/INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF A LOCK NUT ON THE STEERING GEAR ROD Vehicles may have been produced with ineffective/incorrect tightening of a lock nut on the steering gear rod.
dodge.remedy: Check for the correct tightening of the lock nut and check/adjust wheel alignment if tightening was required.

dodge.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
dodge.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

dodge.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A FAULTY LEFT OR RIGHT SIDE HALF-SHAFT A number of vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty left or right side half-shaft (drive shaft).
dodge.remedy: The half-shaft identified as faulty according to traceability data must be replaced

dodge.defect: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY DISPLAY INCORRECT INFORMATION Due to a nonconformity in the production process the instrument cluster may stick and display incorrect speed information.
dodge.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the instrument cluster.

dodge.defect: THE DRIVER'S AIRBAG EMBLEM MAY HAVE BECOME LOOSE OR DETACHED The driver�s airbag emblem may have become loose or detached.
dodge.remedy: Remove the emblem and the emblem retainers

dodge.defect: WATER INGRESS TO ABS CONTROL UNIT Water may enter the ABS (antilock brake) control unit through a harness connector. This will cause the ABS control unit to malfunction and the fault warning lamp to illuminate.
dodge.remedy: Fit a new ABS wiring harness which has watertight connectors.

dodge.defect: THE BRAKE LINE RETAINING CLIP MAY NOT BE FIXED CORRECTLY TO THE TUCKER ON THE DASHBOARD The brake line (pipe) may not be fixed correctly
dodge.remedy: Check the clip is fixed correctly and replace damaged brake pipes

dodge.defect: THE DRIVER'S AIRBAG EMBLEM MAY HAVE BECOME LOOSE OR DETACHED The driver�s airbag emblem may have become loose or detached.
dodge.remedy: Remove the emblem and the emblem retainers

dodge.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

dodge.defect: DOOR LOCKS MAY MALFUNCTION AND ALLOW DOORS TO OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY On a number of Fiat Fullback vehicles in some weather conditions (high temperatures) the mechanism inside the door lock may not function as intended. This can allow the door(s) to open unintentionally.
dodge.remedy: The door locks must be replaced with compliant components.

dodge.defect: REAR SUSPENSION MAY FAIL During the assembly of the vehicle it is possible the right hand rear suspension coil spring was damaged. Over time any damage could lead to the failure of the coil spring.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the coil spring.

dodge.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
dodge.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

dodge.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

dodge.defect: INTERIOR FAN WIRING MAY CHAFE ON DASHBOARD SUPPORT The interior fan wiring may chafe on a dashboard support.  This could result in a short circuit and a fire in the fan unit.
dodge.remedy: Fit additional insulation and protection to the fan electrical  wiring.

dodge.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL COULD FOUL ON THE FLOOR Possibility that the accelerator may foul on the floor mounted pedal stop
dodge.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a modified throttle pedal stop.

dodge.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
dodge.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

dodge.defect: POSSIBIITY OF FIRE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT A fire might occur in the engine compartment as a result of the waste gate excess pressure pipe being incorrectly routed.
dodge.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected to ensure the waste gate pipe is correctly routed and fixed in the appropriate clips.

dodge.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
dodge.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary

dometic.defect: WINDOW MAY DETACH Due to an issue with the adhesive that attaches the window to the hinges may fail and in extreme circumstances the window may become detached from the vehicle.
dometic.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the hinge securing system.

dometic.defect: ROOF VENT MAY DETACH It has been identified that the roof vent/hood may have been fitted with the incorrect screws around the hinge area.  In additions some vents/hoods may not have been glued correctly. These issues could result in a detachment of the roof vent/hood which could pose a risk to other road users or pedestrians.
dometic.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check to roof vents/hoods and repair as manufacturers instructions.

dometic.defect: WINDOW MAY DETACH Due to an issue with the adhesive that attaches the window to the hinges may fail and in extreme circumstances the window may become detached from the vehicle.
dometic.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the hinge securing system.

dometic.defect: FIXING SCREWS OF COOLING UNIT ARE MISSING Fire could occur as a result of a screw retaining the cooling unit coming loose. The ensuing vibrations can then lead to a gas leak on the valve screw connection.
dometic.remedy: Recall the units that are likely to be affected to where necessary replace the fixings used to retain the cooling unit to carry out appropriate gas tests and rectify leaks.

dometic.defect: WINDOW MAY DETACH Due to an issue with the adhesive that attaches the window to the hinges may fail and in extreme circumstances the window may become detached from the vehicle.
dometic.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the hinge securing system.

dometic.defect: SMOULDERING MAY OCCUR A resistance may occur at the connection between the feed and the light tube which may lead to the terminal overheating and some smouldering.
dometic.remedy: Recall the units that are likely to be affected and fit new connectors.

dometic.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It is possible that water ingress into the fan motor could cause corrosion within the unit a possible short circuit or excessive heat build up. If not addressed this could result in a unit fire.
dometic.remedy: Recall all affected units for the replacement of the fan motor and installation of additional fuses for improved units.

don.defect: DURING BRAKEOPERATION THE BRAKE VALVE MAY ALLOW A SUDDEN SPIKE IN VOLTAGE WHICH MAY FEEDBACK THROUGH THE DRAWING VEHICLES CONTROL SYSTEMS. don.remedy: Install a line protector to prevent excess voltage feeding back through the brake light circuit.

ds.defect: DS DS7 Crossback Steering Wheel Calibration On affected vehicles the steering wheel calibration may not be correct.

ds.defect: DS Automobiles DS3 DS7 Radio software via OTA update On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.

ds.defect: DS DS7 Crossback BCM software Stop/Start system On affected vehicles the engine will run all the time and will not shut off in start/stop mode due to incorrect Body Control Module coding.

ducati.defect: DETERIORATION OF FUEL LINES Flexible fuel line connecting the fuel tank flange to the pressure regulator may be liable to premature degradation and subsequently leak.

ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel tank.

ducati.defect: SOME VALVE GUIDES COULD BE SUBJECT TO EARLY WEAR Some valve guides could be subject to early wear

ducati.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER ROCKER ARM MAY BE DEFECTIVE Some machine may be fitted with a potentially defective rear shock absorber rocker arm. In extreme circumstances this could fail leading to a hazardous riding condition.
ducati.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected. Check and if neccessary replace the rocker arm.

ducati.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT OIL COOLER FITTTED ON SOME MODELS MAY FAIL Possibility that the oil cooler may fail resulting in an oil leak which may contaminate the rear tyre resulting in loss of control.

ducati.remedy: On affected vehicles rerouting of the fuel tank and airbox drain hoses to prevent contact  with the horizontal cylinder exhaust manifold.

ducati.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK CAUSING THE ENGINE TO STALL The fuel pump flange and fuel tank coupling may not be to specification and therefore leak fuel. The ensuing leak will eventually cause the engine to stall.

ducati.defect: RISK OF FIRE The Air Box Breather Hose routing may lead to it touching the Exhaust Pipe. This would then constitute a potential fire hazard and make the machine dangerous to ride

ducati.defect: FUEL LINE MAY LEAK A fuel leak may occur from the fuel line to injector fitting. If left this could lead to the machine stalling or not starting.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the fuel line and fitting.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE NON CONFORMITY WITH SIDE STAND A possible non-conformity with the supplied side stand
ducati.remedy: Replace the side stand

ducati.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF CONTROL An incorrect fixing screw retaining the swing arm to the rear suspension linkage has been fitted to some machines. It is possible that the incorrect fixing screw could fail resulting in the rear suspension collapsing and the rider losing control of the machine.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to check whether the screw retaining the swing arm to the rear suspension is correct. Where the screw is found to be incorrect replace the screw.

ducati.defect: SWINGING ARM SHAFT MAY NOT BE TORQUED CORRECTLY The swinging arm anchor shafts may not have been correctly torqued at the factory. If this concern is not corrected the shafts could unwind and interfere with the foot control operation. Additionally this could affect directional control of the machine.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines likely to be affected to re-torque the swinging arm anchor shafts.

ducati.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that on affected machines the fuel hose may detach from either the fuel pump or the filter. This can result in the engine failing to start or stalling.
ducati.remedy: Affected machines will have the fuel hose clips tightened to a modified torque setting.

ducati.defect: DETERIORATION OF FUEL LINES Flexible fuel line connecting the fuel tank flange to the pressure regulator may be liable to premature degradation and subsequently leak.
ducati.remedy: Recall affected motorcycles and fit a quality assured replacement fuel line.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE FLAW IN REAR AXLE The rear wheel shaft forging may contain a flaw which could cause it to crack and subsequently fail when the motorcycle is being ridden.
ducati.remedy: Recall affected motorcycles and ultrasonically check all rear wheel shafts for flaws. Replace with quality assured shafts where appropriate.

ducati.defect: In certain collisions passenger backrest could break if it is installed incorrectly and/or used incorrectly In certain collisions passenger backrest could break if it is installed incorrectly and/or used incorrectly�
ducati.remedy: Inspect the component to reassemble it according to the procedure and to apply a warning sticker

ducati.defect: ERRATIC THROTTLE OPERATION Throttle action may become erratic due to inadequate lubrication.
ducati.remedy: Recall the potentially affected machines disconnect throttle linkage from throttle body lever clean and examine linkage. Lubricate and reassemble. Check for freedom and smoothness of operation.

ducati.defect: WHEEL MAY CRACK Tests have shown that after high mileage small cracks can appear on the hub section of the rear wheel. If these cracks are ignored the wheel could eventually collapse.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the rear wheel with one of a higher specification.

ducati.defect: POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD Potential problem with the fuel tank/fuel pump gasket. Over time the gasket could become damaged and lead to fuel leakage.
ducati.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit four additional spacers between the relevant components to ensure correct assembly of the gasket.

ducati.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER ROCKER ARM MAY BE DEFECTIVE Some machine may be fitted with a potentially defective rear shock absorber rocker arm. In extreme circumstances this could fail leading to a hazardous riding condition.
ducati.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected. Check and if neccessary replace the rocker arm.

ducati.defect: FAILURE OF SIDE STAND The side stand spring retaining plate may fail allowing the side stand to drop and possibly contact the ground.
ducati.remedy: Recall the affected machines for the installation of a modified side stand spring plate.

ducati.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT In certain conditions (down shifting or manoeuvring with the clutch disengaged with the engine at idle) it is possible that the engine stalls.
ducati.remedy: New ECU software designed to solve the problem.

ducati.defect: OIL MAY LEAK FROM OIL COOLER DELIVERY AND RETURN HOSES Oil may leak from the oil cooler delivery and return hoses which could result in contamination of the rear tyre.
ducati.remedy: Recalled machines will have the subject delivery and return hoses replaced.

ducati.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF CLUTCH CONTROL. The clutch slave cylinder may leak resulting in loss of hydraulic fluid and clutch control.
ducati.remedy: Replace clutch slave cylinder with a quality assured unit.

ducati.defect: FRONT BRAKE HOSE MAY BECOME TRAPPED The front brake flexible hose may become damaged by being trapped between the fork bottom yoke and the steering lock peg when cornering. This could result in reduced brake efficiency.
ducati.remedy: Fit a hose retaining clip to the right hand fork leg above the bottom yoke.

ducati.defect: THE SIDE STAND COULD BREAK AT THE WELD The side stand could break at the weld that joins the side stand tube with the upper forged section.
ducati.remedy: Replace the side stand

ducati.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER ROCKER ARM MAY BE DEFECTIVE Some machine may be fitted with a potentially defective rear shock absorber rocker arm. In extreme circumstances this could fail leading to a hazardous riding condition.
ducati.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected. Check and if neccessary replace the rocker arm.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE LEAKAGE OF ENGINE OIL FROM THE AIRBOX BREATHER TUBE Possible leakage of engine oil from the Air box breather tube.
ducati.remedy: Install a new completely redesigned cyclone separator.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE FLAW IN REAR AXLE The rear wheel shaft forging may contain a flaw which could cause it to crack and subsequently fail when the motorcycle is being ridden.
ducati.remedy: Recall affected motorcycles and ultrasonically check all rear wheel shafts for flaws. Replace with quality assured shafts where appropriate.

ducati.defect: SIDE STAND MAY FAIL Due to non-conformity during the production process the side stand could fail in use allowing the machine to fall. This could be a danger to people that are close to the machine.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the batch number of the side stand. If necessary the side stand will be replaced.

ducati.defect: CAMBELT MOBILE TENSIONER MAY FAIL It has been identified that the cambelt tensioners can lock against the cylinder cover which can result in damage to the cambelt.
ducati.remedy: Recalled machines will have the tensioners replaced.

ducati.defect: GEAR SHIFT LEVER PIN MAY COME OUT The interference present between the pivot pin and the gear shift lever may be incorrect.
ducati.remedy: The gear shift lever will be checked and replaced if necessary.

ducati.defect: BATTERY CHARGING SYSTEM MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to poor grounding the battery may not be charged.
ducati.remedy: Recalled machines will have a heat ground fitted to the voltage regulator which will be replaced.

ducati.defect: THE FLOATING PISTON IN THE FRONT BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER MAY CRACK Because of a manufacturing fault the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder may crack under high stress conditions typical of track use frequent ABS interventions or if a machine is dropped. This could reduce the efficiency of the front brake.
ducati.remedy: On affected machines replace the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder with a modified version.

ducati.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Due to nonconformity of the of the fuel lines it is possible that a slight fuel leak could develop.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel pipes and where necessary refit the flange bolts with thread locking compound.

ducati.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER MAY FAIL CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE MACHINE The rear shock absorber piston rod nut may come loose. The shock absorber performance may be affected possibly causing a loss of machine control.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check if the machine is fitted with an affected shock absorber.Any affected shock absorbers will be removed and returned to Ohlins service centre for counter measure repair.

ducati.defect: THROTTLE MAY JAM Factory quality testing has found the throttle housing has the potential of causing the throttle cable to jam and become inoperative. This can lead to the rider not being in full control.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the front half throttle housing and both throttle cables.

ducati.defect: SIDE STAND MAY BREAK It has been identified there is a manufacturing error in the side stand of the machine. This error can result in the side stand failing and the machine falling over.
ducati.remedy: Recall affected machines and replace the side stand with a new quality assured component.

ducati.defect: BATTERY CHARGING SYSTEM MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to poor grounding the battery may not be charged.
ducati.remedy: Recalled machines will have a heat ground fitted to the voltage regulator which will be replaced.

ducati.defect: FUEL LINE MAY LEAK A fuel leak may occur from the fuel line to injector fitting. If left this could lead to the machine stalling or not starting.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the fuel line and fitting.

ducati.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK. It has been identified that the position of the ties which secure the filler cap drain and fuel breather hoses is incorrect. In this condition the safe operation of the machine could be impaired.
ducati.remedy: Recalled machines will have the clips on the fuel breather and drain hoses inspected and replaced as necessary.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL Handlebar may fracture and affect the control of the motorcycle
ducati.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit a quality assured replacement handlebar.

ducati.defect: THE FLOATING PISTON IN THE FRONT BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER MAY CRACK Because of a manufacturing fault the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder may crack under high stress conditions typical of track use frequent ABS interventions or if a machine is dropped. This could reduce the efficiency of the front brake.
ducati.remedy: On affected machines replace the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder with a modified version.

ducati.defect: LOSS OF REAR BRAKING EFFICIENCY There is a potential for the friction material on the rear brake pads to come away from the brake pad due to a fault in the adhesion. There is a possibility if ignored the brake pads will deteriorate leading to a loss of rear brake efficiency.
ducati.remedy: Affected brake pads will be replaced.

ducati.defect: REAR BRAKE ASSEMBLY TORQUE ARM MAY BECOME DETACHED The screw and nut that fasten the rear brake linkage to the engine mounting plate may come adrift. This fault could cause the torque arm to fall off and contact the road surface. This could result in loss of braking and rider control.
ducati.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit a modified bolt and nut to the front end of the torque arm connecting the rear brake unit to the engine mounting plate.

ducati.defect: THE SIDE STAND FASTENING BRACKET MAY DEFORM FROM REPEATED STRESS AND IN EXCEPTIONAL SITUATIONS MAY FAIL The side stand fastening bracket may deform from repeated stress and in exceptional situations may fail.
ducati.remedy: The replacement of the side stand fastening bracket spring hooking plate and side stand will be carried out with re-designed parts.

ducati.defect: THE BRAKE PAD FRICTION MATERIAL MAY SEPARATE FROM THE PLATES The friction material might separate from the plates of the brake pads due to a non-conformity.
ducati.remedy: Replace the front brake pads.

ducati.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF CLUTCH CONTROL. The clutch slave cylinder may leak resulting in loss of hydraulic fluid and clutch control.
ducati.remedy: Replace clutch slave cylinder with a quality assured unit.

ducati.defect: THROTTLE MAY STICK IN OPEN POSITION The teflon bushing may slide out of the throttle cable housing and allow the throttle to stick in the open or partially open condition.
ducati.remedy: Recall the affected machines and replace the original throttle cable with a quality assured example.

ducati.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER ROCKER ARM MAY BE DEFECTIVE Some machine may be fitted with a potentially defective rear shock absorber rocker arm. In extreme circumstances this could fail leading to a hazardous riding condition.
ducati.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected. Check and if neccessary replace the rocker arm.

ducati.defect: LEAKAGE OF FUEL The supply line between the fuel cock and the fuel filter may not fit correctly and allow fuel to leak at it's attachment to the fuel cock.
ducati.remedy: Affected machines are being recalled to have the original fuel line replaced with a quality assured example incorporating improved clamping.

ducati.defect: ROTOR BREAKAGE COULD OCCUR On affected vehicles a potential defect in the production process may result in generator rotor (flywheel) breakage
ducati.remedy: Inspect and replace the rotor if necessary

ducati.defect: STEERING LOCK MAY NOT ENGAGE Software version of the Hands Free control unit revision 43 under some special conditions of use (upon instrument panel switch on) could fail to disengage the electronic steering lock.  It may then be possible to start the engine before realising the steering is still locked.
ducati.remedy: A new software version 44 has been designed to allow the reprogram of the hands free control unit.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAKAGE FROM TANK SENDER UNIT A fire risk may be caused by fuel leaking onto the cylinder head from the nylon sleeves around the wires on the fuel tank sender unit.
ducati.remedy: Recall the affected machines and replace the original sender unit with a modified/quality assured example.

ducati.defect: CONTACT BETWEEN FUEL TANK AND/OR AIRBOX DRAIN HOSES WITH HORIZONTAL CYLINDER EXHAUST MANIFOLD Affected vehicles may have been fitted with incorrectly routed fuel tank and/or airbox drain tubes. This may cause contact with the horizontal cylinder exhaust manifold. This contact could result in a fire in the lower LH area under the battery.
ducati.remedy: On affected vehicles rerouting of the fuel tank and airbox drain hoses to prevent contact  with the horizontal cylinder exhaust manifold.

ducati.defect: RISK OF FIRE The Air Box Breather Hose routing may lead to it touching the Exhaust Pipe. This would then constitute a potential fire hazard and make the machine dangerous to ride
ducati.remedy: Recall affected machines and shorten Air Box Breather Hose.

ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel pipes and where necessary refit the flange bolts with thread locking compound.

ducati.defect: NUMBER PLATE AND CHAIN GUARD MAY DETACH The bolts retaining the number plate holder and chain guard may loosen and allow the components to contact the tyre.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the chain guard and to tighten the relevant bolts to a new higher torque setting.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE OIL LEAK FROM ONE OF THE TWO HYDRAULIC TENSIONERS OF THE TIMING CHAINS Possible oil leak from one of the two hydraulic  timing chain tensioners.
ducati.remedy: Increase the tightening torque of the two hydraulic tensioners.

ducati.remedy: Recall the potentially affected machines disconnect throttle linkage from throttle body lever clean and examine linkage. Lubricate and reassemble. Check for freedom and smoothness of operation.

ducati.remedy: Replace clutch slave cylinder with a quality assured unit.

ducati.defect: CR285 Potential malfunction of the rear brake. On affected vehicles the heat reflective sheath may not correctly positioned or moves from the proper retainer on the rigid brake hose duct the ABS control unit/brake calliper rear brake hose could be damaged because of the heat coming from the rear bank exhaust manifold.
ducati.remedy: Changing the position of the heat reflective sheath on the ABS control unit/brake calliper rear brake hose and securing it with a new grey self-locking tie Part no.74142941A resistant to high temperatures.

ducati.defect: CR300 Replacement of rear wheel shaft The rear wheel shaft may lose its structural integrity and in extreme cases a crack may form which could lead to its complete failure.
ducati.remedy: Replacement if the rear wheel shaft and eccentric hub ball bearing (right side). To find the nearest authorised Ducati dealer use the dealer locator. www.ducati.com Ducati UK tel 08456 718500

ducati.defect: MACHINE MAY CUT OUT The engine may cut out because a wiring loom is not routed correctly. The loom may chafe through which can lead to a short circuit.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to re-route the wiring loom and fit a rubber protector.

ducati.defect: CR311 Replacement of rigid duct for rear brake hose Potential malfunction of the rear brake.
ducati.remedy: Replacement of rigid duct for rear brake hose located on the swinging arm. Background: To further improve the thermal protection of the rear braking system thereby reducing exposure to heat from the rear bank exhaust manifold a new elongated rigid duct complete with a specific heat reflective sleeve has been designed and introduced for the rear brake hose. The heat reflective sleeve must be intact and left in place during the upgrade. This CR311 replaces and cancels the CR285. Bikes already updated with the CR285: must ALSO perform this new upgrade. Bikes not yet updated with the CR285: must ONLY perform this upgrade.

There is a risk of improper ABS operation during braking conditions that require its activation (e.g. in an emergency or on a slippery surface) which could lead to one of the wheels locking unintentionally.
ducati.remedy: Check the motorcycle both visually and with specialised diagnostic tools and to update it if required.

ducati.defect: REAR WHEEL MAY LOSE TRACTION Due to an error in the size of the slots on rear wheel rim hub it is possible that the rear wheel rim might have been installed in the wrong way with the 4 rear wheel shaft driving pins inserted in the slots rather than in the 4 relevant holes. Should this be the case the rider might experience a noisy rear wheel and under extreme situations a loss of traction of the vehicle during use.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check for proper installation of the rear wheel rim on wheel shaft. If the wheel is installed correctly fit no.4 error-proof inserts and refit the wheel. If the wheel has been fitted incorrectly fit a new wheel rim and no.4 error-proof inserts.

ducati.defect: BATTERY MAY BE INSECURE The battery is not fully secure and will move in the carrier. This could result in the main wiring harness cables being damaged at the battery terminals and eventually the engine cutting out.

ducati.defect: 1. LOSS OF TRACTION; 2. SIDE STAND MAY FAIL 1. The lower side plate fastening bolt for the side stand may become loose and if not attended to could eventually fail allowing the machine to fall and be a risk to people in close proximity.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to: 1. Replace the locking device and retorque the final drive pulley retaining nut. 2. Re mount the side stand and plate using new torque settings thread lock and where applicable new bolts..

ducati.defect: THE BATTERY NEGATIVE CABLE TERMINAL GETS DAMAGED DUE TO EXCESSIVE TENSIONING The battery negative cable terminal may become damaged due to excessive tensioning.
ducati.remedy: Check cable routing and length fit neoprene pad under the seat.

ducati.defect: STEERING COMPONENTS MAY NOT BE TORQUED TO SPECIFICATION a) Exhaust Butterfly cable support replacement - excess heat from the catalytic converter could cause the cable support to melt or burn.   b) Ohlins Steering damper bearing - the uniball bearing could slip out of its seat.   c) Steering damper retaining screws - two retaining damper screws may slacken from original torque setting.   d) Swinging arm shafts RH and LH shafts need to be checked for correct tightness torque.  e) Front Brake master cylinder fluid reservoir tube - the front brake master cylinder fluid reservoir connection tube may interfere with the reservoir retaining screw.
ducati.remedy: a) Exhaust Butterfly cable support will be replaced with a new part of higher heat rating.   b) Steering damper bearing It is necessary to install the retaining washer to prevent this.   c) It is necessary to tighten the steering damper screws with appropriate threadlocker applied ot the original torque setting.   d)  Check Swinging arm shafts RH and LH for correct tightness torque.  e)  It is necessary to replace the nut with a new washer and re-designed retaining nut.

ducati.defect: WIRING MAY CHAFE CAUSING DAMAGE TO SYSTEMS It has been identified that the main wiring harness may come into contact with the vertical cylinder head this can lead to damage to the harness poor running with random fault codes being displayed.

ducati.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that the engine can stall at idle due to the ECU requiring to be re-mapped.

ducati.defect: REAR BRAKE ASSEMBLY TORQUE ARM MAY BECOME DETACHED The screw and nut that fasten the rear brake linkage to the engine mounting plate may come adrift. ducati.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit a modified bolt and nut to the front end of the torque arm connecting the rear brake unit to the engine mounting plate.

ducati.defect: GEAR SHIFT LEVER PIN MAY COME OUT The interference present between the pivot pin and the gear shift lever may be incorrect.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE SEIZURE OF REAR WHEEL The roller bearings on the rear hub of the subject machines may not have been lubricated when installed. This could lead to bearing seizure and locking of the rear wheel.
ducati.remedy: Affected machines are being recalled to have the rear hub bearings inspected. Any bearings which display signs of corrosion or discoloration will be replaced.

ducati.defect: FUEL LINE MAY LEAK A fuel leak may occur from the fuel line to injector fitting. If left this could lead to the machine stalling or not starting.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the fuel line and fitting.

ducati.defect: STEERING LOCK MAY NOT ENGAGE Software version of the Hands Free control unit revision 43 under some special conditions of use (upon instrument panel switch on) could fail to disengage the electronic steering lock.  It may then be possible to start the engine before realising the steering is still locked.
ducati.remedy: A new software version 44 has been designed to allow the reprogram of the hands free control unit.

ducati.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK The pipe from the brake fluid reservoir to the front brake master cylinder may abrade on a fluid reservoir mounting nut. If the situation is not addressed the pipe could eventually leak brake fluid.
ducati.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace a mounting nut fit an additional washer and reposition the brake fluid reservoir mounting bracket.

ducati.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that on affected machines the fuel hose may detach from either the fuel pump or the filter. This can result in the engine failing to start or stalling.
ducati.remedy: Affected machines will have the fuel hose clips tightened to a modified torque setting.

ducati.remedy: On affected machines replace the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder with a modified version.

ducati.defect: LEAKAGE OF FUEL The supply line between the fuel cock and the fuel filter may not fit correctly and allow fuel to leak at it's attachment to the fuel cock.

ducati.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL The engine may overheat because the water pump impeller shaft is of incorrect length and does not engage drive from the timing layshaft.

ducati.remedy: Recall all affected machines and inspect the right handside fork bottom end clamp.  If found to be outside design specification replace with quality assured replacement.

ducati.defect: POSSIBLE TWISTING OF REAR AXLE A) Under extreme circumstances it is possible for the rear axle to twist. b) Throttle linkage may require cleaning and lubrication.

ducati.defect: FINAL DRIVE SPROCKET MAY FAIL It has been identified that; the possibility exists that the final drive sprocket may fail thus impairing the safe operation of the machine.

ducati.defect: NUMBER PLATE HOLDER MAY DETACH It has been identified that due to a manufacturing deviation the number plate holder may break.

ducati.defect: DETERIORATION OF FUEL LINES Flexible fuel line connecting the fuel tank flange to the pressure regulator may be liable to premature degradation and subsequently leak.

ducati.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF CLUTCH CONTROL. The clutch slave cylinder may leak resulting in loss of hydraulic fluid and clutch control.

ducati.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL SPRAYING OUT OF THE FILLER PLUG WHEN OPENING. Possibility of fuel spraying out of the filler plug when opening it

ducati.defect: OIL LEAKAGE FROM THE HOSES. The rubbing of the oil cooler delivery and return hoses could lead to oil leakage.
