fiat.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING There is a possibility that the weld on the steering shaft at the lower universal joint fitting maybe absent.  If there is an absent of the weld at the joint this may lead to a loss of steering.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and inspect steering shaft to ensure weld is present if not renew steering shaft.

fiat.defect: FIRST GEAR COULD BE ENGAGED WHILST THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION AND THE SHIFT LEVER IN THE D POSITION First gear could be engaged with the vehicle in motion and the shift lever in the D position.
fiat.remedy: Update the transmission control module software

fiat.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF BRAKE PIPES. Possible chafing of front rigid brake pipes at near side front against the plastic wheel arch liner or against the gearbox mounting. Also at the off side front against the engine timing belt cover.
fiat.remedy: Reposition any chafing brake pipe to comply with the manufacturer's prescribed clearance between adjacent parts. Renew any brake pipe that has been chafed beyond a serviceable condition.

fiat.defect: HEATER/CLIMATE CONTROL WIRING ABRASION MAY RESULT IN  A SHORT CIRCUIT. It has been identified that the possibility exists of interference between the heater/climate control wiring and a dashboard bracket due to a missing retainer clip. In this condition abrasion of the wiring may occur with the attendant risk of an electrical short circuit
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for damage to the subject wiring which if this has occurred will be repaired and repositioned. In all cases a new clip will be fitted.

fiat.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel delivery pipe adjacent to air filter may chafe. This in time could lead to leakage of fuel in the engine compartment and a consequent risk of fire.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel delivery pipe and where necessary replace the pipe containment channel.

fiat.defect: INCORRECT SPARE WHEEL Some vehicles with alloy wheels may have been supplied with an unsuitable space saver spare wheel. If fitted this spare wheel could cause interference with braking system components.
fiat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace any unsuitable spare wheels with correctly specified versions.

fiat.defect: MANUFACTURERS PLATE INFORMATION INCORRECT The manufacturer's plate information may refer to vehicles with a capacity of 8 hundred weight rather than 7 hundred weight.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the manufacturer's plate with one that is correct to the vehicle.

fiat.defect: U-BOLTS ON REAR AXLE MAY BREAK The U bolts securing the leaf spring to the rear axle may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This may result in the U bolts breaking.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the U bolts checked to ensure there is no damage and that they have been tightened to the correct torque.

fiat.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK There is a possibility that fuel may leak from a faulty recirculation pipe connector.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if required change pipe.

fiat.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM MOUNTINGS - FAILURE OF WELD There is a possibility that corrosion may be present near the welds for the front suspension arm front mountings on the front cross member.Should this be the case in time this could lead to noise whilst driving and the possibility that the weld could fail. Failure of the weld may lead to loss of vehicle stability.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicle will be checked to ascertain whether corrosion is present near the front suspension mountings. If this is found to be the case the front cross member will be replaced. If corrosion is not present a front cross member strengthening kit will be fitted.

fiat.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNITENTIONALLY On vehicles fitted with comfort instrument panel when the passenger's airbag has been deactivated it is possible in some cases that it will reactivate spontaneously.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

fiat.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK After repeated activation of the fuel heater cover in cold conditions an electric connector  the fuel heater cover  may overheat. This may allow air ingress which could cause difficulty starting the engine or engine stalling. In extreme cases fuel may leak onto the road surface.
fiat.remedy: Check the condition of the heated diesel filter cover and  connector. If deteriorated or damaged replace the cover or connector.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

fiat.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

fiat.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty 48-volt battery. This may lead to a loss of the functionality of the battery. This may result in a risk of thermal run away in the case of water infiltration.
fiat.remedy: The repair is a check of the PBU valve code and replacement of the 48-volt battery if necessary.

fiat.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

fiat.defect: CORROSION OF METAL BRAKE PIPES Prolonged exposure to the effects of road salt corrosion may result in perforation of the metal brake pipes and a consequential loss of braking efficiency.
fiat.remedy: Replace corroded brake pipes and apply corrosion prevention treatment to all brake pipes.

fiat.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION CROSS MEMBER MAY FRACTURE It has been identified that the chassis front cross member may have a weld which does not conform to specification. This may lead to a creaking noise being heard under braking and could in time lead to the cross member cracking in the area of it's mounting to the vehicle's body.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front cross member replaced.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.

fiat.defect: The positive lead on the auxiliary battery terminal may not be tightened correctly. The positive lead on the auxiliary battery terminal may not be tightened correctly
fiat.remedy: The integrity of the positive lead terminal must be checked and if it is damaged it must be replaced. If it is not damaged the correct torque must be applied to the nut to ensure correct tightening.

fiat.defect: A HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS CONNECTOR MIGHT NOT BE TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION A High Voltage Harness connector might not be to the correct specification
fiat.remedy: Check the connector and if required replace the harness.

fiat.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

fiat.defect: THE REAR RIGHT BRAKE CALLIPER COULD DISPLAY MICRO CRACKS The rear right brake calliper could display micro-cracks
fiat.remedy: The production date must be checked and if necessary the brake calliper must be replaced

fiat.defect: TRANSMISSION MOUNT MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a nonconformity in the transmission casing mount material there is a possibility that the casting may fail.  This may affect the control of the vehicle.
fiat.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the mounting with new quality assured item.

fiat.defect: SEAT BELT PRE TENSIONERS MAY FAIL TO ACTIVATE On some Punto vehicles it has been found that the seat belt pre-tensioners may fail to activate although normal activation of the seat belt is assured.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to shorten the safety tabs in the inertia reel.

fiat.defect: RISK OF REAR BRAKE LOCK UP It has been identified that on subject vehicles the rear brake back plate retaining bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification. Should the bolts work loose this can result in noise illumination of the ABS warning light and in extreme cases wheel lock.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked and tightened to the correct specification.

fiat.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL In some circumstances the headlights can switch off without warning which will increase the risk of an accident.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the Body Computer with new improved software.

fiat.defect: REAR CROSS MEMBER WELDING  MAY CRACK It has been identified that the possibility exists that a non conforming weld may be present on the vehicle's rear cross member with the fixing bracket for the wheel axle hub. This non conformity in time; could cause the weld to break and crack the rear cross member which could have an adverse effect on the vehicle's stability.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject cross member identification numbers and weld markings checked; to ascertain whether they conform. Should this not be the case the cross member will be replaced.

fiat.defect: INCORRECTLY POSITIONED FUEL PIPE Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
fiat.remedy: : Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

fiat.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

fiat.defect: UNINTENDED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG Possible water ingress into the electronic control unit (ECU) could result in unintentional deployment of the drivers air bag and passengers air bag where fitted.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for water ingress into the ECU and replace if necessary. Fit water protection to the ECU in all cases.

fiat.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAYBE AFFECTED Vehicles fitted with rear brake drums may suffer contamination of the brake lining.   This is due to the entry of water and detritus into the drum through the back plate.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a gasket to the back plate where the handbrake cable enters the brake drum through the back plate.

fiat.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY FRACTURE There is a possibility that the brake pedal is of incorrect specification and could eventually fracture.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace brake pedal with quality assured type.

fiat.defect: The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect (4835 kg instead of 4955 kg). The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect.
fiat.remedy: The CoC and registration documents must be replaced to reflect the correct data.

fiat.defect: SOUND DEADENING GUARD MAY BECOME DETACHED It is possible for the fastenings of the sound deadening guard to become loose. Consequently the guard could become detached whilst the vehicle is in motion.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace all the fastenings with new captive fasteners and bolts.

fiat.defect: Certain kinds of vehicle acceleration could cause the speed limiter to turn off. Certain kinds of vehicle acceleration could cause the speed limiter to turn off.
fiat.remedy: Update the software of engine control module.

fiat.defect: FUEL VAPOUR RE- CIRCULATION PIPE MAY BECOME DAMAGED The fuel vapour re-circulation pipe could foul against the air-conditioning compressor pulley resulting in possible damage to the pipe and the risk of fire.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and reposition re-circulation pipe away from compressor pulley.

fiat.defect: Fiat Scudo Rear suspension springs Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
fiat.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

fiat.defect: Engine Control Module calibration Low In-Use Performance-Ratio On affected vehicles there is a requirement to update the Engine Control Module (ECM) calibration due to a production non-conformity and not fulfilling emission regulatory requirements.
fiat.remedy: Update the ECM software calibration

fiat.defect: Fiat Scudo. Multifunction screen fixings. On affected vehicles the radio display screen may be incorrectly secured.
fiat.remedy: Check the fixing of the screen and add any missing fixings.

fiat.defect: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended. On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
fiat.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

fiat.defect: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended. On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
fiat.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

fiat.defect: Fiat Ducato 2024. Proxy update. Vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements Affected vehicles may have the urea system management menu missing from the instrument panel. This may result in warning messages not being displayed on the instrument panel cluster depending on the urea level. In this condition the vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements.
fiat.remedy: Check and if necessary install modified software.

fiat.defect: Ground connections On affected vehicles there could be a loss of certain ground connections for some electrical harnesses which may result in the loss of several vehicle functions.
fiat.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

fiat.defect: Fiat 500 BEV Panda and Tipo. Instrument panel cluster software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case. If the customer seeks to reactivate the AEB after previously deactivating it during the same driving cycle (key on/off) it will remain deactivated however the icon on the cluster to alert about deactivation remains off. This does not meet regulatory requirements.
fiat.remedy: Update front camera software.

fiat.defect: Fiat Professional Ducato. Instrument panel cluster software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case. If the customer seeks to reactivate the AEB after previously deactivating it during the same driving cycle (key on/off) it will remain deactivated however the icon on the cluster to alert about deactivation remains off. This does not meet regulatory requirements.
fiat.remedy: Update front camera software.

fiat.defect: SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) Diagnosis issues Affected vehicles may have been equipped with Engine Control Unit (ECU) software not fulfilling regulation requirements.
fiat.remedy: Update to the ECU software.

fiat.defect: TYRE VALVE MAY BREAK  CAUSING RAPID DEFLATION (STEEL WHEELS) It has been identified that due to manufacture from an incorrect material the tyre inflation valve may break. Should this occur rapid deflation of the tyre and possible vehicle instability would occur.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the tyre inflation valve replaced on all steel wheels including the spare.

fiat.defect: REAR AXLE MAY MOVE It is possible the rear axle leaf spring retaining bolts were not tightened to the correct specification during production.  This could allow movement between the axle and leaf spring. In extreme circumstances this could cause the vehicle to lose control.
fiat.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the U bolts with new items and tighten them to the correct specification.

fiat.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LEAKAGE FROM FUEL TANK DUE TO CORROSION Possibility of fuel leakage from the fuel tank due to corrosion
fiat.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled during which time the fuel tank will be inspected for corrosion. Should corrosion be found the fuel tank will be replaced.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.

fiat.defect: THE DRIVE SHAFT MAY FAIL DUE TO A NON-CONFORMITY IN THE MATERIAL The drive shaft joints may fail
fiat.remedy: Replace the drive shaft or shafts as required

fiat.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

fiat.defect: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM OF THE STEERING COLUMN The steering column height adjustment mechanism could accidentally release.
fiat.remedy: Replace the steering column mechanism.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL The tyres fitted to affected vehicles are incompatible with the weight capacity of the vehicle. This may cause a tyre failure due to incorrect loading of the vehicle.
fiat.remedy: Replace existing tyres with those of a load index compatible with the vehicle's weight capacity.

fiat.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK LEADING IN EXTREME CASES TO FIRE The fuel pump protection bracket is not to conformity and in the event of an accident the fuel feed pipe could be damaged leading to an increased risk of fuel leakage and possible fire.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel pump feed protection bracket and reposition the fuel feed pipe.

fiat.defect: DROPSIDE PANEL MAY DETACH It has been identified that the possibility exists that breakage of the dropside hinge fastening plate may occur on vehicles fitted with a factory installed dropside body. This can result in the detachment of the dropside panel.
fiat.remedy: Subject vehicles will be recalled at which time the hinge fastening plates will be changed.

fiat.defect: POTENTIAL RISK OF ACCESS STEP DETACHING FROM VEHICLE BODY Potential risk of access step detachment from the vehicle body.
fiat.remedy: Replacement of the access step fasteners.

fiat.defect: Incorrect information displayed on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
fiat.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

fiat.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the possibility exists that a disconnection of the handbrake cable may occur which can result in the handbrake becoming inefficient.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fitment of the handbrake cable to the actuating lever checked. If found to be incorrect the situation  will be rectified. If the handbrake cable is found to be damaged it will be replaced.

fiat.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

fiat.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY The brake vacuum pump may not function correctly.
fiat.remedy: Replace the brake vacuum pump of affected vehicles

fiat.defect: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE Due to the inlet filter for the EGR valve being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This could result in the possibility of ice forming in the brake servo vacuum pipe in conditions of low ambient temperature. As a consequence this may lead to reduced servo assistance to the braking system.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If theses are not evident new solenoids with separate air filters will be fitted.

fiat.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY NEED INCREASED FORCE DURING APPLICATION There is a possibility that the valve in the Brake Booster Vacuum Pump may not be compliant. This can result in loss of vacuum assistance.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace pump.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT IN ENGINE COOLING FAN CONTROL UNIT A short circuit may occur in the engine cooling fan control unit with a resultant risk of overheating.
fiat.remedy: Fit a new cooling fan control unit.

fiat.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
fiat.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE On batteries fitted with non-watertight caps rainwater from the windscreen may run into the battery and result in a leakage of battery contents. This leakage may damage the adjacent fabric reinforced rubber brake servo pipe and reduce or cancel the servo assistance available when braking.
fiat.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have a cover fitted to the battery and checking of the brake servo pipe for damage.

fiat.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
fiat.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

fiat.defect: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
fiat.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

fiat.defect: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
fiat.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

fiat.defect: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity) On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
fiat.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

fiat.defect: VIN label and CoC addendum Affected vehicles may have a tyre load index on the vehicle that is lower than the declared rear axle capacity.
fiat.remedy: Replacement of the manufacturer's label fitted to the vehicle and supply the customer with an addendum to the COC (Certificate of Conformity).

fiat.defect: Fiat 600 MHEV and BEV. Front camera Affected vehicles are fitted with a front camera with an incorrect hardware ID which causes an error code within the car system. Once an error code is set and recorded the camera is always in fault mode whenever it is switched on. This will result in the ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance System) remaining inactive. This inactive status is a nonconformity with regulatory requirements.
fiat.remedy: Replace the front camera.

fiat.defect: Fiat 600 fuel pipe On affected vehicles there is a risk of a fuel leak at the high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections which in a worst-case could result in a vehicle fire.
fiat.remedy: Check and tighten high-pressure fuel pipe and rail connections.

fiat.defect: Fiat Professional Doblo tyre label On affected vehicles the tyre pressure label may show incorrect or missing information which does not meet regulatory requirements.
fiat.remedy: Replace the tyre pressure label.

fiat.defect: Fiat Scudo seat fixing On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
fiat.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

fiat.defect: Fiat Ducato may have been fitted with the incorrect radio Affected vehicles may have been fitted with the incorrect radio. The radio fitted does not have rear view camera functionality and therefore may not comply with regulatory requirements.
fiat.remedy: Replace the radio.

fiat.defect: 2024 Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV Advanced Driver Assistance  Systems Radio software On affected vehicles equipped with an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality the AEB/LKA (Active Emergency Brake/Lane Keep Assist) can be deactivated simultaneously. The vehicle does not therefore meet regulatory requirements.
fiat.remedy: Install updated software over the air (OTA).

fiat.defect: Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV. Brake pedal On a number of Fiat 600 vehicles due to a production  nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake  pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a  rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal  disengagement In the event of brake pedal failure the  Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can  be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled  stop. Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency  Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent  collision.
fiat.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Fiat dealer  checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct  assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance  with Fiat reference F53D.

fiat.defect: Fiat 500 BEV High Voltage battery negative pole connection On affected vehicles the fastening nut may be missing from the negative terminal of the high-voltage battery pack which could result in a loss of torque failure to start the vehicle and in extreme cases it could present a possible fire hazard.
fiat.remedy: The affected vehicles will have the high-voltage battery replaced.

fiat.defect: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
fiat.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

fiat.defect: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update. Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
fiat.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

fiat.defect: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
fiat.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

fiat.defect: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
fiat.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

fiat.defect: Fiat Professional 2025/2026 Ducato (290/295). Fuel pipe leak Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
fiat.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

fiat.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

fiat.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The threaded portion of the brake linkage rod in the brake control system may not be to conformity. This could result in a reduction of braking efficiency.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check rod and replace if found not to meet conformity.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
fiat.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

fiat.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE FLUIDS AND EXTENDED PEDAL TRAVEL The brake hoses may chafe on the wheel aches and in extreme cases cause a brake fluid  leak. The driver will be informed of the defect by the illumination of a warning lamp on the dashboard. If ignored then this will result in longer than expected stopping distances.
fiat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and visually inspect the front brake hoses reinforcement and protection. The brake hoses if worn will be replaced.

fiat.defect: THE BALLAST SUPPORT BRACKET WELDED TO THE REAR FLOOR COUD BREAK The ballast support bracket welded to the rear floor could break
fiat.remedy: Add two new fixings for each ballast support

fiat.defect: ELECTRIC SLIDING REAR DOOR Electric Sliding door may open inadvertently.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and upgrade door control system ECU.

fiat.defect: THE THIRD (HIGH LEVEL) BRAKE LIGHT MAY NOT FUNCTION The third (high level) brake light may not function.
fiat.remedy: Update the software to activate the third brake light function.

fiat.defect: IF REAR SEAT BELTS ARE NOT FASTENED AND PRETENSIONERS ARE DEPLOYED THE LATCH COULD BE RELEASED In case of an accident if the rear seat belts are not fastened i.e. if the rear seat is not occupied by a passenger or is occupied by a child restraint system coupled only to the Isofix anchors and the pretensioners are deployed the rear seat latch could be released. The contents of the rear luggage area if unsecured could enter the cabin area
fiat.remedy: Replace the latch bezels with bezels the shape of which prevents the seat belts from interfering with the latch and releasing the seat in the event of a pretensioner deployment.

fiat.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
fiat.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE The transmission could unexpectedly switch to the N position due to a nonconformity in the transmission wiring assembly process.
fiat.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram the transmission control module. Where necessary replace the transmission wiring

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER STEERING The power assisted steering low pressure pipe may chafe on a hose clip.  This could result in the loss of the hydraulic fluid and power assistance of the steering.
fiat.remedy: Check the steering low pressure hydraulic pipe for damage and reposition the hose clip where necessary.

fiat.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the tightening torque of the steering shaft upper fixing bolt may not be correct. This may result in the emission of noise and in extreme cases breakage of the shaft which will result in loss of steering control.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolt checked for correct torque which if necessary will be set to the correct specification. If the torque is outside of the rework stipulated range the shaft will be replaced.

fiat.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTENT AIRBAG ACTIVATION The air conditioning condenser drainpipe may in some instances become blocked with the possibility that the condensate may leak into the passenger compartment and the air bag central control unit. This contamination may cause the air bag warning light to illuminate and in some cases; cause inadvertent activation of the air bag.
fiat.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the condensate drainpipe will be refitted; and re-profiled to remove any restriction.

fiat.defect: DOOR PANEL MAY CAUSE INJURY In the event of a side impact on a small number of vehicles fitted with the Sabelt seat option the door side panels may break in an unsuitable way and possibly cause injury to the occupants.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the door panels.

fiat.defect: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST It is possible that breakage of the ancillary devices pulley on the crankshaft may occur. Should this happen there is the possibility that engine power and functions such as power assisted steering and braking assistance may be lost.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF STEERING The steering column to steering wheel shaft may not have been assembled correctly. If not corrected noise and play will become apparent and if these warnings are not acted on eventually steering control could be lost.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary refit the steering column correctly to the steering wheel shaft.

fiat.defect: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY BECOME DETACHED The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body
fiat.remedy: Replace the current sleeve and respective metal bands with modified parts.

fiat.defect: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY DETACH FROM THE THROTTLE BODY The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body.  The engine management warning light will illuminate and a loss of power may occur.
fiat.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the current retainer with a new version to ensure the sleeve connection between intercooler sleeve and throttle body.

fiat.defect: REDUCED BRAKE PERFORMANCE It has been identified that the rear brake shoe lining material may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. This could result in a reduction in brake performance from the rear brakes.
fiat.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the conformity of the brake linings and if found to be incorrect replace with new brake shoes which meet the correct conformity.

fiat.defect: INCORRECT TORQUE OF WHEEL BOLTS The road wheel fixing bolts may not have been correctly torqued and could loosen over a period of use.
fiat.remedy: Check the wheel fixing bolts for correct torque and tighten or renew as appropriate.

fiat.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY FAIL The headlights may fail because of a Body Control Computer software problem.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the software.

fiat.defect: BODY SECURING BRACKETS MAY FAIL The lower fastening brackets which secure the body to the chassis are not manufactured to specification. As a result the brackets may fail and render the body not fully secure.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the body securing brackets with ones manufactured to specification.

fiat.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

fiat.defect: THE WRONG AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IN A COLLISION In the case of a side impact the wrong airbag could deploy as a result of a software non-compliance.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply a software update.

fiat.defect: DUE TO INCORRECT TYPE APPROVAL DATA PROCESSING THE MANUFACTURER'S PLATE (VIN PLATE) AND REGISTRATION DOCUMENT MUST BE REPLACED Due to incorrect type-approval data processing the manufacturer's plate (VIN plate) and registration document must be replaced.
fiat.remedy: Replace the VIN plate and update the registration document as required.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
fiat.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

fiat.defect: STEERING WHEEL AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY It has been identified that due to the non-conforming layout of the airbag wiring and missing cut-proof protection the airbag wiring may interfere with the steering wheel wiring terminal. This can cause the abrasion of the wiring itself. This abrasion may cause a short-circuit and consequent inadvertent deployment of the steering wheel airbag.
fiat.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the airbag wiring and apply cut proof padded tape.

fiat.defect: CAMSHAFT MAY FAIL Due to an error in the production process the engine camshaft may break.
fiat.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the camshaft.

fiat.defect: BRAKE VACUUM ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE In some cases due to the non-compliance of the engine ECU software the engine failure warning lamp may illuminate. As a consequence the vacuum assistance available to the braking system may be reduced.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-programme the engine ECU with updated software.

fiat.defect: THE SPORT MODE SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS The �Sport� mode system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
fiat.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

fiat.defect: INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR VEHICLE LIGHTING MAY FAIL It is possible under extreme conditions that the wiring harness under the dashboard could come into contact with the steering column. This over a period of time may result in the chaffing of wires in the harness. If this should occur then it is possible both the exterior and instrument lights could fail.
fiat.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to provide additional security of the wiring loom.

fiat.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

fiat.defect: INCORRECT SPARE WHEEL Some vehicles with alloy wheels may have been supplied with an unsuitable space saver spare wheel. If fitted this spare wheel could cause interference with braking system components.
fiat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace any unsuitable spare wheels with correctly specified versions.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF LOWER ENGINE STABILISER ROD The lower engine stabiliser rod may crack or break. This could result in detachment of the off side drive shaft on full lock.
fiat.remedy: Inspect the stabiliser rod welding and fit a new rod where found necessary.

fiat.defect: On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling. On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling.
fiat.remedy: The repair is an upload of modified ECU software.

fiat.defect: FRACTURE OF FRONT COIL SPRINGS The anti noise plastic shields fitted to the bottom of the front suspension coil springs may permit the accumulation of a high level of humidity under certain environmental conditions. When combined with the presence of salt and small stones etc. this condition may cause breakage of the spring(s) and subsequent tearing of the tyre as a result of the fractured coils contacting the tyre wall.
fiat.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a modified ventilated spring sheath and inspection of the front coil springs.

fiat.defect: On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling. On certain vehicles equipped with an Air Conditioning compressor these may experience the condition of a powertrain shutdown in the event of an AC compressor issue. This could result in the engine non-starting or stalling.
fiat.remedy: The repair is an upload of modified ECU software.

fiat.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On certain vehicles the front brake discs may not be the required thickness for the vehicle definition. This concern may result in reduced braking efficiency.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the front brake discs.

fiat.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

fiat.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

fiat.defect: SUPPLEMENTARY HEATER WIRING MAY BECOME DAMAGED AND CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT On some Fiat 500L vehicles a layout non-conformity could cause abrasion of the supplementary heater (PTC) wiring. This could result in possible electric short-circuiting with the possibility of a loss of some vehicle safety. In the worst case it could cause a vehicle fire..
fiat.remedy: Apply a cut-proof sheath on the supplementary heater wiring to protect it from abrasions.

fiat.defect: FRONT WIPER MAY FAIL An internal fault with the wiper motor could cause it to stop working. In some rare cases the windscreen wipers may stop working while in operation.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the manufacturing date of the wiper motor and add a supplementary earth wiring harness if necessary.

fiat.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a fault in the production process the flexible rubber brake hoses may not have been correctly vulcanised. As a consequence may partially or totally restrict the internal flow of the brake hydraulic fluid. Should this happen a reduction in efficiency during braking would occur.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hoses checked to identify if they are within the affected batch. If this is the case they will be replaced with quality assured items.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column upper shaft fixing bolt may not have had thread locking agent applied to it during assembly. This may allow it to come loose causing a noise. In extreme cases this may result in a loss of steering control.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a bolt affixed with pre applied locking compound.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF FRONT SPRING A specific batch of vehicles have been equipped with front suspension coil springs which may suffer from localised corrosion. This can cause breakage of the springs with an adverse effect on vehicle control.
fiat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original coil springs with quality assured examples.

fiat.defect: ROUTING OF BRAKE VACUUM PIPE MAY BE INCORRECT In some cases due to the non compliant routing of the brake servo vacuum supply pipe damage to the pipe may occur with the possibility that braking assistance might be reduced.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject pipe checked and re-routed. Should any damage be found the pipe will be replaced.

fiat.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM MANIFOLD Fuel may leak as on some engines the fuel manifolds may not be to specification. If the fuel manifold leaks it is possible that a loss of power could occur and the engine cut out.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the fuel manifold and check it for conformity to specification. Where necessary replace the fuel manifold.

fiat.defect: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY OF THE FUEL RETURN PIPE DIESEL FUEL LEAKS MAY OCCUR Due to a nonconformity of the fuel return pipe diesel fuel leaks may occur.
fiat.remedy: Check the conformity of the fuel return pipe and if necessary replace.

fiat.defect: INCORRECTLY POSITIONED FUEL PIPE Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
fiat.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

fiat.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES On ABS equipped Punto vehicles contact may take place between the brake compensator springs and the rear (metal) brake pipes. This could damage the pipes causing loss of brake fluid and reducing the efficiency of the service brake.
fiat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

fiat.defect: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY It has been identified that the hand brake lever may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. It could result in the vehicle rolling away.
fiat.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the hand brake assembly with a new quality controlled assembly

fiat.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The upper fork on the steering shaft fork may not have been correctly fixed/'staked' onto the shaft.  This may cause a knock from the steering and in extreme cases the fork may separate from the shaft and result in loss of steering control.
fiat.remedy: To check the shaft for the presence of the 2 'Stake' markings.

fiat.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED A connector on the brake servo pipe may fail and cause a loss of vacuum assistance necessitating the driver to include additional effort when braking.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new brake servo pipe.

fiat.defect: ANTI-ROLL BAR BUSH WEAR It has been identified that the front anti-roll bar bushes may wear after a period of time. Should this occur noise will be generated by contact between the anti-roll bar and the metal sleeve of the bush.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front anti-roll bar replaced.

fiat.defect: INCORRECT LOAD CAPACITY LISTED FOR INTERIOR HOOKS It has been identified that the maximum load capacity for the load restraint hooks in the load compartment of the vehicle has been incorrectly written in the Owner Handbook.  The correct load capacity is 500 daN and not the 625 daN as written. If the correct load capacity of 500 daN is not adhered to then the load hooks may not retain the load due to overloading. This could result in an unsecured load with the potential for loss of control of the vehicle.
fiat.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to attach a load capacity label within the load compartment and install an additional amended page to the Owner Handbook.

fiat.defect: On the affected vehicle the tightening torque applied to the steering rack during production may be insufficient. On the affected vehicle the tightening torque applied to the steering rack during production may be insufficient.
fiat.remedy: The repair is replacement of the left steering pinion tie rod retainer nut and apply the correct torque.

fiat.defect: SEAT MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED DURING A COLLISION The seat may not remain in position when subjected to greater than normal driving forces such as those involved in an impact. This may possibly cause injury to the driver/passenger seated in the right hand front seat. The right hand front seat guides may not conform to design specification and installation specifications.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the installation of the original seat guide. If it does not conform replace the seat cushion structure (guide).

fiat.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

fiat.defect: THE START & STOP SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS The Start & Stop system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
fiat.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

fiat.defect: POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING MAY BE LOST The wiring for the power steering electric pump may interfere with the edge of the left front wheel arch. This may cause damage to the wiring and a loss of power steering assistance.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected so the wiring can be placed in a protective pipe. The wiring and pipe will then be secured in the correct position.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE INTERFERENCE BETWEEN FUEL SUPPLY AND RETURN LINES Possible interference between the fuel supply and return lines.
fiat.remedy: Reposition the pipes to avoid interference.

fiat.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR FROM THE FUEL TANK Due to a non-conformity in production fuel leakage may occur from the fuel tank
fiat.remedy: Replace the fuel tank

fiat.defect: POTENTIAL FIRE The fuel return pipe connector at the injectors may overtime wear and leak. The leaking fuel is a fire risk and also could be hazardous to other road users.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel return pipe.

fiat.defect: SECURITY OF SEAT BELT A number of the subject vehicles have been fitted with seat belts manufactured by TRW the attachment systems of which may not remain secure in an accident situation.
fiat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check the date of production on the seat belt buckles and replace those within the critical batch.

fiat.defect: POTENTIAL MOVEMENT OF THE BATTERY Potential movement of the battery and consequent breakage of the battery wires.
fiat.remedy: A battery spacer must be fitted

fiat.defect: HANDBRAKE CONCERN The handbrake cable may have been incorrectly fitted and could become disconnected from the rear brake mechanism.  This would result in the handbrake becoming ineffective.
fiat.remedy: Check that the handbrake cable is correctly connected to the rear brake mechanism and fit a new cable where it is not.

fiat.defect: ACCELERATOR MAY STICK It has been identified that the possibility exists that the accelerator pedal's rotation pin may not have been inserted correctly. In this condition the accelerator pedal might stick.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the accelerator pedal checked for the presence of the pin. Should the pin be found to be missing the accelerator pedal will be changed.

fiat.defect: ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS MAY BE DEACTIVATED In some circumstances the driver and passenger may experience consequent switching off of the instrument panel light and possible deactivation of other electronic systems such as the ABS and airbags. The concern is caused by loose connections at the ignition switch contact holder block.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition switch contact holder block.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE After extended high speed running brake servo assistance may be lost due to petrol contamination of the servo diaphragm.
fiat.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the servo brake vacuum pipe and checking of the brake servo efficiency.

fiat.defect: FRONT SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED It has been identified that the front seatbelt anchorage links may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. If the link is subjected to an abnormal force then it may not perform as required.
fiat.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to check the link and if required replace it.

fiat.defect: SUSPENSION COIL SPRING MAY BREAK Under environmental conditions that require intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits accumulate inside the noise-insulating protective sheath located on the front suspension springs creating areas of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front coil springs with those of a new type.

fiat.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL CONCERN The accelerator pedal may foul on its travel limiting stop and prevent the engine from decellerating when the pedal is released.
fiat.remedy: Fit a modified pedal travel limiting stop.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES On ABS equipped Punto vehicles contact may take place between the brake compensator springs and the rear (metal) brake pipes. This could damage the pipes causing loss of brake fluid and reducing the efficiency of the service brake.
fiat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the subject brake pipes to eliminate the possibility of any contact with the compensator springs. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.

fiat.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU Water ingress into the airbag control unit (ECU) could result in illumination of the warning light and in the worst case unintentional deployment of the airbag.
fiat.remedy: Seal the airbag ECU compartment

fiat.defect: STEERING SWIVEL  JOINT MAY FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL The possibility exists that the swivel joint stem of the front suspension vertical links maybe of an incorrect size. This can lead to the generation of noise whilst driving and the possibility of suspension disconnection following a violent impact to the front axle and subsequent loss of vehicle control.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the swivel joint stems checked for the presence of play and will be replaced if any is found.

fiat.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE FRONT CROSSMEMBER INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED Vehicles may have been fitted with the front crossmember incorrectly tightened.
fiat.remedy: Check and tighten the bolts on the front crossmember to the prescribed torque. Replacement of the steering rack if necessary.

fiat.defect: FRONT WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE It has been identified that the possibility exists that water may ingress into the front windscreen wiper motor. Should this occur the wipers may become inoperative. In conditions of poor visibility this may result in impaired driver visibility.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front windscreen wiper motor fitted with a protective cover.

fiat.defect: EGR PIPE COULD FRACTURE DUE TO A POTENTIAL NON-CONFORMITY The EGR pipe could fracture due to a potential non-conformity the fractured pipe may damage the alternator resulting in a loss of battery voltage and potentially a loss of engine power.
fiat.remedy: The pipe must be checked and if incorrect replaced with a new  part.

fiat.defect: INEFFECTIVE/INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF A LOCK NUT ON THE STEERING GEAR ROD Vehicles may have been produced with ineffective/incorrect tightening of a lock nut on the steering gear rod.
fiat.remedy: Check for the correct tightening of the lock nut and check/adjust wheel alignment if tightening was required.

fiat.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
fiat.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

fiat.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A FAULTY LEFT OR RIGHT SIDE HALF-SHAFT A number of vehicles may have been fitted with a faulty left or right side half-shaft (drive shaft).
fiat.remedy: The half-shaft identified as faulty according to traceability data must be replaced

fiat.defect: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY DISPLAY INCORRECT INFORMATION Due to a nonconformity in the production process the instrument cluster may stick and display incorrect speed information.
fiat.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the instrument cluster.

fiat.defect: WATER INGRESS TO ABS CONTROL UNIT Water may enter the ABS (antilock brake) control unit through a harness connector. This will cause the ABS control unit to malfunction and the fault warning lamp to illuminate.
fiat.remedy: Fit a new ABS wiring harness which has watertight connectors.

fiat.defect: THE BRAKE LINE RETAINING CLIP MAY NOT BE FIXED CORRECTLY TO THE TUCKER ON THE DASHBOARD The brake line (pipe) may not be fixed correctly
fiat.remedy: Check the clip is fixed correctly and replace damaged brake pipes

fiat.defect: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.

fiat.defect: DOOR LOCKS MAY MALFUNCTION AND ALLOW DOORS TO OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY On a number of Fiat Fullback vehicles in some weather conditions (high temperatures) the mechanism inside the door lock may not function as intended. This can allow the door(s) to open unintentionally.
fiat.remedy: The door locks must be replaced with compliant components.

fiat.defect: REAR SUSPENSION MAY FAIL During the assembly of the vehicle it is possible the right hand rear suspension coil spring was damaged. Over time any damage could lead to the failure of the coil spring.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the coil spring.

fiat.defect: FRONT HUB SECURITY Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
fiat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary

fiat.defect: UNINTENDED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Following deactivation of the passenger airbag via the dashboard menu with the ignition on the passenger airbag may be reactivated following a fast cycling (less than 2 seconds) of the ignition key (on-off-on). The passenger airbag deactivation warning light would also have been switched off but the driver may not notice. In a collision and in certain conditions an unintended airbag deployment may contribute to a loss of further control or injury to driver and/or passengers.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control unit.

fiat.defect: INTERIOR FAN WIRING MAY CHAFE ON DASHBOARD SUPPORT The interior fan wiring may chafe on a dashboard support.  This could result in a short circuit and a fire in the fan unit.
fiat.remedy: Fit additional insulation and protection to the fan electrical  wiring.

fiat.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL COULD FOUL ON THE FLOOR Possibility that the accelerator may foul on the floor mounted pedal stop
fiat.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a modified throttle pedal stop.

fiat.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The layout of the ABS wiring maybe incorrect in the area of the battery holding unit.  The wiring may on some vehicles maybe trapped and pinched exposing wiring in some area.  this may cause damage and in extreme cases a potential risk of fire.
fiat.remedy: Repair to inspect and repair the wiring using industry accepted soldered connectors

fiat.defect: POSSIBIITY OF FIRE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT A fire might occur in the engine compartment as a result of the waste gate excess pressure pipe being incorrectly routed.
fiat.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected to ensure the waste gate pipe is correctly routed and fixed in the appropriate clips.

fiat.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
fiat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary

first.defect: BALL JOINT MAY NOT BE SECURE A small batch of wishbones may have been manufactured with out a ball joint secondary securing clip. This may allow the ball joint to dislocate from its location. The ball joint is unlikely to separate but without the securing clip ball joint dislocation could have an affect on the steering.
first.remedy: Recall affected wishbones and replace with a new version which will have the secondary securing clip.

first.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST The defect affects specific front lower suspension arms designed to fit Mazda 3 and Mazda 5.  The arms may develop a stress fracture  which may allow the outer ball joint to detach. This may cause the driver to loose control.

fisher.remedy: Recall affected bicycles to modify frame by fitting a front triangle upgrade.

flying.defect: O RING SEAL INCORRECTLY SUPPLIED IN NITRILE An O ring which was incorrectly supplied in the wrong material.
flying.remedy: Replacement of O ring kit or an Overhauled Unit.

foden.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF BOLTS SECURING AXLE TRANSVERSE LOCATING RODS There is a possibility that the bolts securing the torque rods to their anchorage may fail allowing excess movement of the axle(s)
foden.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for checking of the subject bolts. Replace all 8 bolts within the assembly if any suspect bolts are identified.

If the bolt becomes detached then the integrity the fifth wheel operational function will be compromised.
fontaine.remedy: Check that the nut bolt and washer is fitted and free to rotate. Replace the nut as required using manufacturers supplied fasteners.

ford.defect: 24C24 - Transit Custom - Side window automatic reversal system / Compliance recall On affected vehicles there is potentially an issue with the window automatic reversal system (bounce back system). Under certain circumstances a closing window could exert a force of over 100N.
ford.remedy: Update driver and passenger door modules software.

ford.defect: 24S34 – Courier Hand Brake Wiring Courier vehicles where the hand brake electrical wiring could get damaged. This could result in the park brake light being illuminated at all times regardless of whether the park brake lever is physically applied. There is a risk that the customer may assume the park brake is applied when it is not increasing the risk of vehicle roll-away. In some cases the park indicator light will not illuminate although the park brake is applied. There is no hand brake function loss due to this issue.
ford.remedy: Inspect  rework if required or replace if damaged.

ford.defect: 24S33 – Kuga 2.5L PHEV supercreep On affected vehicles a recent update to the Power Control Module (PCM) software could result in the vehicle shifting into neutral and coasting to a stop. The subsequent limp home mode results in unintended acceleration or 'supercreep'.
ford.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) software

ford.defect: Frozen Rearview Camera Screen On affected vehicles there is a potential software issue causing the rear-view camera not to function as intended.

ford.defect: Transit Custom - Potential Touch Condition Between Bulkhead Bolt And Fuel Tank – Product Safety Recall On affected vehicles there may be insufficient clearance between a bulkhead bolt and the fuel tank which could cause damage over time and lead to a fuel leak.
ford.remedy: Replace the bulkhead bolt.

ford.defect: 24C02 - Transit Courier Reversing Camera Black Screen A  small number of Transit Courier vehicles which have been built where the rear-view camera turns black on the SYNC screen when the vehicle is placed in reverse. ford.remedy: Updated software to be installed

ford.defect: 26S06 Capri Explorer - Torque Inspection On Various Joints Affected vehicles may have rear axle joints that were not tightened to the specified torque during manufacturing.
ford.remedy: Check toe and camber links to subframe torques and if not according to specification change the fixings.  A check of wheel alignment is also required.

ford.defect: 26S06 Capri Explorer - Torque Inspection On Various Joints Affected vehicles may have rear axle joints that were not tightened to the specified torque during manufacturing.
ford.remedy: Check toe and camber links to subframe torques and if not according to specification change the fixings.  A check of wheel alignment is also required.

ford.defect: 25SC4 Kuga - Do not charge high voltage battery to levels above 80% On affected vehicles the high voltage battery may have some cells that could potentially develop a short circuit leading to a Stop Safely Now message and possible loss of motive power or battery thermal venting.
ford.remedy: Update the vehicle's Battery Energy Control Module software.

ford.defect: Transit Courier - Instrument Panel defect Affecting Passenger Airbag Operation Affected vehicles may have been built with a potential defect on the instrument panel due to a manufacturing process which could affect passenger airbag operation in the event of a crash.
ford.remedy: Replace the instrument panel.

ford.defect: Transit Courier - Instrument Panel defect Affecting Passenger Airbag Operation Affected vehicles may have been built with a potential defect on the instrument panel due to a manufacturing process which could affect passenger airbag operation in the event of a crash.
ford.remedy: Replace the instrument panel.

ford.defect: 26S19 Ranger PHEV - High Voltage Battery Tray Retaining Bracket Replacement Affected vehicles may experience a fracture of the High Voltage Battery front mounting bracket lower legs potentially causing the battery to drop onto the chassis frame.
ford.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery which contains the retaining brackets

ford.defect: Ranger: 10R80 Transmission Oil Pump Gears Software Update On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 20S10 may not have been delivered properly and vehicles may exhibit an issue where the transmission lubricant pump gear could fail.
ford.remedy: Update the Power Control Module and Transmission Control Module and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

ford.defect: 26S20 Transit - Lower Arm Rear Bolt Replacement On affected vehicles one of the front suspension bolts may have been overtightened during manufacturer which may cause it to weaken and fracture over time.
ford.remedy: Replace the affected front suspension bolt.

ford.defect: 25SA7 - Mustang - Powertrain Control Module Software Update On affected vehicles equipped with a Ford Performance Whipple Supercharger Upgrade Kit the updated software may not be able to detect module hardware errors leading to unintended acceleration or unintended vehicle movement increasing the risk of a crash.
ford.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module software.

ford.defect: Transit and Tourneo Courier Infotainment Software Update A number of Transit and Tourneo Courier vehicles have been identified where the warning chimes may not be operating as intended the chimes may not be audible which does not meet ECE regulation. For vehicles affected by this concern the overall functionality of the vehicle is not affected but some warning chimes may fail to sound including but not limited to intelligent speed assist forward & reverse park aid active cruise control collision warning lane departure & keeping warnings park brake seat belt minder.
ford.remedy: Apply software update

If one or both caliper mounting bolts are missing or fail the caliper may become dislodged from the axle and interfere with the wheel assembly and surrounding components.
ford.remedy: Inspect both rear brake calipers and replace any parts if necessary.

ford.defect: 25C46 - Transit Courier - Body Control Module software update Affected vehicles may experience a delay in the activation of their automatic dipped-beam headlamps when ambient light drops for example when entering a tunnel due to incorrect Body Control Module (BCM) software
ford.remedy: Update the BCM software.

ford.defect: X-Car Powertain Control Module (PCM) Software Update Affected vehicles may develop a crack in the Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF).
ford.remedy: Update software to prevent a cracked DPF.  Test and replace DPFs that are already cracked.

ford.defect: Explorer / Capri : Front Seat Back Inspection On affected vehicles a bolt fixing the front seat back with the seat base may be not have been fitted and secured correctly due to a manufacturing issue.
ford.remedy: Check the bolts are present and correctly tightened.

ford.defect: 24B64 - Transit Skeletal Chassis Inspection On affected vehicles there may be damage to a section of the vehicle’s chassis.
ford.remedy: Check the vehicle chassis and if found with a defect in the areas shown the manufacturer will buy back the vehicle.

ford.defect: 25S86 Transit Transit Custom - Potential Panther Engine Timing Idler Gear Loose On affected vehicles the engine idler gear bolt may shear resulting in the idler gear dropping and primary drive failure. This can result in complete engine failure leading to a stall and/or no start condition.
ford.remedy: Replace the idler gear and idler bolt.

ford.defect: 25S86 Transit Transit Custom - Potential Panther Engine Timing Idler Gear Loose On affected vehicles the engine idler gear bolt may shear resulting in the idler gear dropping and primary drive failure. ford.defect: 24S57 Transit Rear hub bearing Affected vehicles may experience a lack of lubrication to the rear wheel bearings leading to premature failure.
ford.remedy: Check of vehicles current mileage and where necessary inspect bearing to ensure full lubrication with parts replaced as necessary.

ford.defect: 26C32 Mustang - Windshield Wipers and Washer System Potentially Inoperative During Freezing Temperatures On affected vehicles during freezing temperatures or below the windshield wipers may become inoperative.  In other cases the windshield wipers may operate only at the high-speed setting and an inoperative windshield washer system may prevent washer fluid from being effectively used to clean the windshield.
ford.remedy: Inspect the windshield wiper system and replace the wiper motor if necessary.

ford.defect: Ranger: Side Air Curtain Deployment On affected vehicles in the event of a curtain airbag deployment the curtain airbag may not deploy fully as intended increasing the risk of injury to the occupants.
ford.remedy: Remove and replace the B-Pillar trim.

ford.defect: 26S62 Kuga – EDS Wiring touch Affected vehicles may have a touch condition between a fixing screw and push nut to the Instrument Panel (IP) wiring harness.    If the vehicle’s wiring is damaged different warning messages may appear depending on which wire is affected. These could include warnings for the airbag system eCall stability control or driver assistance features such as Lane Keeping Aid or Pre-Collision Assist.  The airbags will not deploy by accident but if an airbag warning is ignored the airbags may not work correctly in a crash.  In some cases the vehicle could lose power while driving and display a “Stop safely now” message. If this happens braking and steering will still work so the driver can safely bring the vehicle to a stop.  Damaged wiring could also cause a short circuit which may increase the risk of fire.
ford.remedy: Inspect and reposition wiring harness to increase clearance and protect surfaces and if necessary repair or replace the instrument panel wiring harness.

ford.defect: 26S56 Mustang Mach E – Rear Quarter Glass Moulding On affected vehicles the rear quarter glass trim moulding can become detached while driving.
ford.remedy: The manufacturer is currently working on part availability.  Once available they will inform owners so they can contact their dealer to schedule an appointment.  If owners experience the issue in the meantime they should contact their dealer.

ford.defect: Puma – Exhaust system cold end replacement – Compliance Recall On affected vehicles the incorrect exhaust system cold end may have been fitted during production.
ford.remedy: Replace the cold end of the exhaust system.

ford.defect: Multi Vehicle Line: Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) Unexpected Activation / Deactivation Affected vehicles have been identified where the Traffic Sign Recognition and Driver Alert System are being turned on or off without the expected notification to the driver.
ford.remedy: Update the vehicles configuration and Software.

ford.defect: Multi Vehicle Line: Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) Unexpected Activation / Deactivation Affected vehicles have been identified where the Traffic Sign Recognition and Driver Alert System are being turned on or off without the expected notification to the driver.

ford.defect: 24S18 - Transit Courier Tourneo Courier - Brake system potential contamination Courier vehicles on which the brake system may be contaminated with mineral oil. This can cause swelling of rubber components in the brake system (hydraulic seals brake hoses etc). In some circumstances if swelling occurs there is potential for the brake system to lack hydraulic pressure which may result in longer brake pedal travel and reduced brake performance therefore increasing the risk of an accident.
ford.remedy: The Ford dealer will inspect the brake system on all affected vehicles and will replace all the parts affected by this condition.

ford.defect: Focus Lane Centering Assist Software Update A number of Focus vehicles have been identified where the warning chimes may not be operating as intended. ford.remedy: Updating software in control unit.

ford.defect: THE NUTS ON THE 48V BATTERY POLES MAY NOT BE TORQUED TO SPECIFICATION The nuts on the 48V battery poles may not be torqued to specification.
ford.remedy: Remove both positive and negative poll nuts and inspect the wiring for signs of damage. Any damaged wiring will be replaced. Both nuts will be refitted and torqued to specification.

ford.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN  ISSUE WITH THE CURRENT SOFTWARE THAT CONTOLS THE FUNTIONALITY OF THE ECALL SYSTEM Vehicles may have an issue with the current software that controls the functionality of the eCall system.

ford.defect: THE HYBRID BATTERY CONNECTIONS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TORQUED TO FORD SPECIFICATION It is possible that the hybrid battery connections may not have been torqued to Ford specification.

ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and updated software will be loaded to the affected modules.

ford.defect: INSECURITY OF FRONT TOWING EYE The welds securing the front towing eye to its mounting bracket are not to specification and can result in detachment of the eye when the vehicle is under tow.
ford.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of the welds which secure the front towing eye. Where these are not to specification the welds will be reworked as per the manufacturers instructions.

ford.defect: INCORRECT DEPLOYMENT OF CURTAIN AIRBAG It is possible that some RHD Galaxy vehicles fitted with side curtain airbags may have an error with the wiring that may trigger the wrong curtain airbag to be deployed in the event of a side impact
ford.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to test the airbag system and if necessary fit a wiring adapter.
