Ford are also advising all other Galaxy owners who have purchased the subject seat.

ford.defect: THE REAR SUSPENSION TOE LINK COULD CORRODE OVER TIME LEADING TO REDUCED MATERIAL AND LOAD CAPACITY AND FINALLY BREAKAGE OF THE BOLT The Rear Suspension Toe Link bolt is exposed to corrosion growth which over time leads to reduced material and load capacity and finally to a breakage of the bolt.
ford.remedy: Replace the bolt utilising an alternative bolt supplier and update all affected vehicles.

ford.defect: INSECURITY OF REAR AXLE On vehicles where the rear axle mounting arrangement is by means of studs and bolts the axle assembly may become loose to the vehicle underbody.
ford.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of modified axle mounting blocks to the vehicle underbody and replacement of the subject studs and nuts by bolts.

ford.defect: Incorrectly configured Restraint Control Module (RCM) which can cause the restraint system not to work as intended. In the event of an incorrect crash sensor being installed throughout the life of the vehicle while in service the current software will not detect it and will not display any warnings in the dash so in the event of an accident the restraints system performance could potentially be degraded therefore increasing the risk of an injury. Incorrectly configured Restraint Control Module (RCM) which can cause the restraint system not to work as intended. In the event of an incorrect crash sensor being installed throughout the life of the vehicle while in service the current software will not detect it and will not display any warnings in the dash so in the event of an accident the restraints system performance could potentially be degraded therefore increasing the risk of an injury.
ford.remedy: Dealers will perform a configuration update in order to restore functionality.

ford.defect: INCORRECTLY TORQUED LEFT HAND SEATBELT TO SEATBELT SHOULDER HEIGHT ADJUSTER BOLT An incorrectly torqued left hand seatbelt to seatbelt shoulder height adjuster bolt.
ford.remedy: Replace the left hand seatbelt and shoulder height adjuster with new parts.

ford.defect: REAR WING (SPOILER) VALVE BLOCK MAY LEAK HYDRAULIC OIL ONTO EXHAUST The rear wing (spoiler) valve block may leak of hydraulic fluid onto the exhaust.
ford.remedy: Software update to the Fully Integrated Vehicle Controller.

ford.defect: SOME VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN ADDITIONAL BOLT THAT MAY BE LOOSE WITHIN THE ELECTRIC POWER ASSISTED STEERING Some vehicles may have been built with an additional bolt that may be loose within the Electric Power Assisted Steering (EPAS).
ford.remedy: Replace the steering gear on all vehicles affected.

ford.defect: THE TILT/SLIDE ROOF OPENING PANEL GLASS S NOT CORRECTLY BONDED TO ITS MOUNTING Tilt/slide roof opening panel glass is not correctly bonded to its mounting.
ford.remedy: Install a new roof opening glass panel on affected vehicles.

ford.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF OFFSIDE FRONT BRAKE CALIPER It is possible that some Mondeo vehicles may have been fitted with a right hand front brake caliper where the casting is not to specification. In time this may result in fluid leakage with the loss of one brake circuit.
ford.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for a check on the manufacturing date of the subject caliper. Caliper units falling within the affected range will be replaced.

ford.defect: Certain vehicles have been produced with a mismatch of information between Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) label Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and Registration documents regarding towing. Certain vehicles have been produced with a mismatch of information between Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) label Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and Registration documents regarding towing.
ford.remedy: Affected vehicles need to be returned to a Ford Authorised Dealer to have a new VIN label exchanged Certificate of Conformity or updated registration.

ford.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF UNEXPECTED BRAKING. Yaw rate sensor out of specification the effect of which may result in unexpected braking
ford.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled for inspection of the yaw sensors which will be replaced as necessary.

ford.defect: RISK OF FIRE Due to high road salt usage in winter the engine cooling fan module may suffer from corrosion and may overheat and ignite.
ford.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to modify wiring loom and to fit water shield to module.

ford.defect: POSSIBLE UNEXPECTED BRAKING. The yaw rate sensor may be out of specification which may lead to unexpected braking
ford.remedy: Recall affected vehicles inspect sensors and renew as necessary

ford.defect: THE ENGINE CYLINDER HEAD MAY  CRACK Localized overheating of the engine cylinder head may cause the cylinder head to crack.This may cause a pressurized oil leak which in extreme circumstances could  result in a fire in the engine compartment.
ford.remedy: On affected vehicles Inspect engine and cooling system. Replace affected components and  fit a Coolant Level Sensor along with  associated software  to provide and audible and visual warning to the driver.

ford.defect: HEATED WINDSCREEN EARTH POINT MAY NOT BE  TIGHTENED - RISK OF BURN DAMAGE TO TRIM It has been identified that on subject vehicles the heated windscreen earthing point may not have been tightened to the specified torque. An incorrect torque may lead to electrical arcing and in extreme cases this arcing may cause scorching or burning of the surrounding trim components.
ford.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject earthing point inspected for correct installation and torque.

ford.defect: THE IMAGE PROCESSING MODULE -A (IPMA) IS NOT CALIBRATED CORRECTLY The image processing module may not be calibrated correctly.
ford.remedy: Update the software of the image processing module.

ford.defect: SPEED CONTROL DEACTIVATION SWITCH MAY OVERHEAT AND CATCH FIRE. It has been identified that the speed control deactivation switch may overheat smoke or burn.
ford.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject switch renewed if necessary in addition to which a modified jumper harness will be installed.

ford.defect: HARD BRAKE PEDAL MAY OCCUR DURING ENGINE WARM UP During engine warm up it is possible that the non return valve within the vacuum pump may stick. It is possible that if sufficient brake applications are made before the valve releases the vacuum stored within the brake booster will be used up and a hard brake pedal and longer stopping distances may result.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a revised design of non return valve to the brake vacuum pump.

ford.defect: OWNERS HANDBOOK SUPPLEMENT REGARDING USE OF JACK The vehicle may have been supplied with a different jack to that illustrated in the owner's handbook. This may cause the jack to be used in an incorrect manner.
ford.remedy: To issue all owners/operators of affected vehicles with a supplement to the owner's handbook. This will incorporate additional diagrams and operating instructions to match the jack supplied with the vehicle.

ford.defect: RISK OF FIRE Due to high road salt usage in winter the engine cooling fan module may suffer from corrosion and may overheat and ignite.
ford.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to modify wiring loom and to fit water shield to module.

ford.defect: IN LOW AMBIENT TEMPERATURE HARD BRAKE PEDAL MAY OCCUR Hard brake pedal may occur in low ambient temperatures which is caused by a non return valve in the vacuum pump sticking.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a revised non return valve to the brake vacuum pump.

ford.defect: SEAT BELT ANCHOR BOLT SECURITY It has been identified that during production a small number of Fiesta's may not have had the right-hand side front seatbelt top anchor bolt tightened to the correct specification. This may result in the mounting not performing as intended if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
ford.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to torque the right-hand side front seatbelt top anchor bolts to the correct specification.

ford.defect: POSSIBLE LOW TORQUE CONDITION WITH THE AIR CONDITIONING CLUTCH FASTENER A/C Compressor pulley may become detached.
ford.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a new A/C compressor clutch pulley.

ford.defect: HEADLAMPS MAY SWITCH OFF WITHOUT WARNING Vehicles fitted with Adaptive LED Headlamps could experience a condition where the loss of a control signal in combination with a software error may cause the headlamps to switch off. There is a risk of collision if defect happens at night.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and updated software will be loaded to the affected modules.

ford.defect: DOOR LATCH CONCERN Some vehicles have been built with door latches which may not be to specification. An internal plastic pawl within the assembly may seize which results in the latch failing to function as designed preventing the door being securely shut.
ford.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit quality assured replacement door latches.

ford.defect: HEADLAMPS MAY SWITCH OFF WITHOUT WARNING Vehicles fitted with Adaptive LED Headlamps could experience a condition where the loss of a control signal in combination with a software error may cause the headlamps to switch off. There is a risk of collision if defect happens at night.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and updated software will be loaded to the affected modules.

ford.defect: BATTERY CABLE AND ALTERNATOR B+ STUD CONCERN. Battery cable may be misrouted and/or a loose connection at the alternator B+ stud which could cause a risk of an electrical short.
ford.remedy: B+ stud torque to be checked. Battery cable routing to be checked and any damaged cables to be replaced.

ford.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN  ISSUE WITH THE CURRENT SOFTWARE THAT CONTOLS THE FUNTIONALITY OF THE ECALL SYSTEM Vehicles may have an issue with the current software that controls the functionality of the eCall system.
ford.remedy: Carry out a software update.

ford.defect: TIPPER BED COULD RAISE WITHOUT WARNING It has been identified that the tipper bed could raise without warning due to a concern with the power system module (PSM).
ford.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the PSM replaced.

ford.defect: POWER STEERING PRESSURE HOSE MAY CHAFE ON ENGINE INLET MANIFOLD. The power steering pressure hose may chafe on the engine inlet manifold. This could ultimately result in an oil leak and a loss of power assistance to the steering.
ford.remedy: Fit latest production level revised routing power steering pressure hose.

ford.defect: RISK OF FIRE Due to high road salt usage in winter the engine cooling fan module may suffer from corrosion overheat and may ignite.
ford.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to modify wiring loom and to fit water shield to module.

ford.defect: WELD PENERTRATION ON LEFT LOWER CONTROL ARM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATION The left-hand lower control arm may be fitted to vehicles where the weld penetration does not meet specification.
ford.remedy: Inspect the left-hand lower control arm and replace if within the affected date range.

ford.defect: LOWER SEATBELT BOLT MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO SPECIFICATION The lower front seatbelt bolt may not be correctly tightened to specification.
ford.remedy: Inspect and re-torque the front lower seatbelt bolts to specification

ford.defect: FAILURE OF HEADLAMPS A possibility exists that excessive torque generated when turning on the headlamp switch may induce an internal open circuit and cause the headlamps to go out.
ford.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the headlamp switch with a revised component.

ford.defect: AIRBAG RETENTION SPRINGS MAY NOT LOCK AIRBAG TO STEERING WHEEL The driver�s airbag retention springs maybe outside of manufacturing specification and may not lock the module to the steering wheel
ford.remedy: Install a replacement airbag retention spring.

ford.defect: POSSIBLE LOW TORQUE CONDITION WITH THE AIR CONDITIONING CLUTCH FASTENER A/C Compressor pulley may become detached.
ford.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a new A/C compressor clutch pulley.

ford.defect: POSSIBLE PARTIAL DETACHMENT OF FRONT SUSPENSION LOWER ARM. It has been identified that a number of vehicles have been produced with front suspension lower arm bolts which may have been tightened to an incorrect torque. In this condition failure of a bolt may result in partial detachment of the arm from the subframe which could adversely affect the steering and stability control.
ford.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked for correct torque and tightened if necessary. Should any bolt be found to be damaged it will be replaced.

ford.defect: PARKING BRAKE RATCHET CONCERN The design of the parking brake ratchet teeth can allow a partial engagement resulting in damage to the tooth which can then slip to the next tooth. If ignored the wear will continue on the next tooth and the efficiency of the parking brake may become insufficient to hold the vehicle in place.
ford.remedy: Replace parking brake lever assembly with one that has a revised tooth profile.

ford.defect: THE MHEV BATTERY CONNECTIONS MAY BECOME LOOSE There is a potential that the vehicle's MHEV battery connections may become loose.
ford.remedy: Inspect and check torque on 48 volt battery cable connections

ford.defect: RISK OF FIRE The heated washer jets may have jet heating elements which are not correctly sealed. There is a possibility that poor sealing could lead to corrosion due to water ingress and subsequent overheating of the jets. An overheating jet element will damage the nozzle housing and may cause local heat/fire damage to the cowl grille accompanied by smoke and burning smell.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new washer jets.

ford.defect: FUEL RETURN PIPE LEAK The fuel return pipe is not specification and will degrade. This could lead to seapage of fuel.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel return pipe.

ford.defect: POSSIBLE LOW TORQUE CONDITION WITH THE AIR CONDITIONING CLUTCH FASTENER A/C Compressor pulley may become detached.
ford.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a new A/C compressor clutch pulley.

ford.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK - BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The rear brake pipe bracket to axle securing bolt may fail due to inconsistencies in bolt manufacture. Low clamp load of the joint could lead to bolt failure and subsequent fatigue failure of the rear brake bundy pipe. This would result loss of brake fluid and significantly reduced brake performance (single circuit brake operation only and soft brake pedal).
ford.remedy: The original bolt will be replaced with a new bolt and locking nut.

ford.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR There may be reduced clearance between the battery cable wiring loom and the exhaust manifold. There is a possibility that the wiring could contact the manifold and result a short circuit and possible engine compartment fire.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and apply additional heat resistant foil tape to the wiring loom and secure it away from the exhaust manifold using an additional clip fitted to the inner wing panel.

ford.defect: HARD BRAKE PEDAL MAY OCCUR DURING ENGINE WARM UP During engine warm up it is possible that the non return valve within the vacuum pump may stick. It is possible that if sufficient brake applications are made before the valve releases the vacuum stored within the brake booster will be used up and a hard brake pedal and longer stopping distances may result.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a revised design of non return valve to the brake vacuum pump.

ford.defect: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE ON DEPLOYMENT Air bag inflators may not operate as intended
ford.remedy: Replace air bag inflator

ford.defect: HARD BRAKE PEDAL MAY OCCUR DURING ENGINE WARM UP During engine warm up it is possible that the non return valve within the vacuum pump may stick. It is possible that if sufficient brake applications are made before the valve releases the vacuum stored within the brake booster will be used up and a hard brake pedal and longer stopping distances may result.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a revised design of non return valve to the brake vacuum pump.

ford.defect: VEHICLES COULD SUFFER A DIFFERENTIAL DRIVE PINION FAILURE A small number of Ford Ranger vehicles could suffer a differential drive pinion failure caused by micro cracks created during the production process.
ford.remedy: Inspect and replace rear differential parts as necessary.

ford.defect: REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLE ANCHORAGE ATTACHMENTS MAY NOT MEET THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION The rear seat belt buckle anchorage attachments may not meet the design specification.
ford.remedy: Inspect and repair the seat belt anchorage points using a Helicoil repair kit.

ford.defect: BRAKE LAMP SWITCH JUMPER HARNESS CONCERN Affected vehicles have brass terminal (instead of bronze) in the brake lamp switch jumper harness. This could lead to malfunction of the brake lamp switch.
ford.remedy: Brake lamp switch jumper harness to be replaced on all affected vehicles brake lamp switch to be inspected for heat damage and replaced if necessary.

ford.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK FROM PRESSURE LIMITING VALVE Corrosion of the rear brake pressure limiting valve may allow brake fluid to leak from a joint.
ford.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace pressure limiting valve.

ford.defect: POSSIBLE RISK OF FIRE On affected vehicles the  diesel engine Glow Plug Control Module can be affected by wet conditions.  The GPCM is not waterproof and water ingress into the module may cause overheating with the potential to result in a fire. As the GPCM has a permanent electrical live feed there is also a potential risk of an unattended vehicle fire.
ford.remedy: Replace existing module with waterproof version

ford.defect: A REAR DRIVESHAFT BEARING SUPPORT BRACKET HAS NOT BEEN FITTED WITH THE INTENDED INTERNAL BUSHES On affected vehicles the rear driveshaft bearing support bracket has not been fitted with the intended internal bushes.
ford.remedy: Fit a new driveshaft bearing support bracket.

ford.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES. The service replacement engine may have been fitted with with the rear lifting eye still attached. Under certain operating conditions the eye may contact and damage adjacent brake pipes. This could cause a loss of braking efficiency.
ford.remedy: Check for the presence of the rear lifting eye and remove if fitted. Check brake pipes for damage and if required replace.

ford.defect: THE eCALL FEATURE WILL STOP FUNCTIONING DUE TO A MALFUNCTION It may be possible that the eCall feature will stop functioning due to a malfunction.
ford.remedy: The Telecommunication Module will need to be replaced

ford.defect: The driver s seat belt might have the webbing routed through the anchor rubber trim sleeve instead of being routed through the metal anchor eyelet. The driver�s seat belt might have the webbing routed through the anchor rubber trim sleeve instead of being routed through the metal anchor eyelet.
ford.remedy: Carry out a visual inspection of the driver seat belt at the pre-tensioner. Any vehicle that has failed this inspection will be retained and the affected part will be replaced.

ford.defect: CLUTCH PRESSURE PLATE MAY FRACTURE Affected vehicles fitted with a 1.0 1.5 or 1.6 Ecoboost engine and 6-speed manual transmission could suffer clutch pressure plate fracture. This results in clutch smell reduced vehicle speed and performance. In the unlikely event of clutch pressure plate fracture a noise (thud / bang) could be heard from the vicinity of the transmission in extreme cases resulting in clutch / transmission fragments being released and striking under hood components creating a risk of smoke and fire from the under hood area.
ford.remedy: To prevent the repeated heating /cooling events a new calibration has been developed for vehicles fitted with Engine Stop Start feature. The software with the additional feature sets the Instrument panel �Wrench light� and de-rates the engine performance if prolonged clutch slip is detected. The software feature includes a drive cycle strategy for latching the wrench light and engine performance de-rate if the customer should experience repeated clutch slip events. For vehicles that do not have Engine Stop Start feature an alternative clutch kit has been released.

ford.defect: THE FUEL INJECTOR FUEL RETURN LINE CONNECTION MAY NOT BE FULLY SECURE There is a possibility that the fuel injector fuel return line connection/s may not be fully secured.
ford.remedy: Inspect the fuel injector fuel return line connections to ensure that the connections are fully secured and the locking tags are engaged.

ford.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It has been identified that a batch of engines have misaligned oil feed holes between the cylinder head and the camshaft bearings. The reduced oil flow could cause premature wear of the camshaft bearings and may also result in seizure of the engine without prior warning.
ford.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked by dealers for the presence of the relevant build code and the engine will be renewed if it is within the specified range.

ford.defect: BRAKE PIPES CHAFING It is possible that certain brake pipes may not be secured to the vehicle underbody and may chafe on the front stabiliser bar. This could result in loss of brake fluid and reduced braking efficiency.
ford.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles. Re-route and secure the subject brake pipes using additional clips. Damaged brake pipes will be replaced where required

ford.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that a small number of Fiesta and Fusion vehicles may have been built with a steering column which may have suffered damage by inappropriate handling prior to vehicle production. In rare cases there may be damage to the column upper universal joint which could result in loss of steering control.
ford.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering column universal joint inspected for signs of damage. If damage is found the steering column assembly will be replaced.

ford.defect: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE ON DEPLOYMENT Air bag inflators may not operate as intended
ford.remedy: Replace air bag inflator

ford.defect: THE RIGHT-HAND ENGINE OIL SEPERATOR MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED PRIOR TO ENGINE ASSEMBLY. Certain vehicles could have an engine oil separator that may have been damaged prior to engine assembly.
ford.remedy: Inspect the engine oil separator and if found to be damaged and/or leaking a replacement engine oil separator must be installed

ford.defect: THE LOWER CONTROL ARMS MAY BE FITTED WITH MISSING OR PARTIAL WELDS The lower control arms may have missing or partial welds
ford.remedy: Inspect the lower control arms and replace if required.

ford.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING EFFICIENCY Possible loss of one braking circuit due to brake master cylinder failure
ford.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for checking and where necessary replacement of the brake master cylinder.

ford.defect: BATTERY CABLE MAY CHAFE AND SHORT CIRCUIT Battery cable may chafe on transmission valve cover plate.
ford.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check cable insulation repair if necessary and retain cable clear of cover plate.

ford.defect: WIPER MOTOR MAY FAIL AND OVERHEAT Water may enter the wiper motor via the wiper arm spindle. If the water contains salt it is possible that an electrical short circuit can cause the wiper to fail. In extreme cases the short circuit can result in the wiper assembly overheating. The increased temperature can be high enough to melt the trim components in the area of the motor assembly.
ford.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a revised cover and sealing grommet which will replace the existing sealing system.

ford.defect: HEADLAMPS MAY SWITCH OFF WITHOUT WARNING Vehicles fitted with Adaptive LED Headlamps could experience a condition where the loss of a control signal in combination with a software error may cause the headlamps to switch off. There is a risk of collision if defect happens at night.
ford.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and updated software will be loaded to the affected modules.

fruehauf.defect: CRACKING AROUND KING PIN RETAINING WELD Maintenance inspections have revealed cracking around the periphery of the weld retaining the king pin to the upper coupler apron plate on specified trailers.
fruehauf.remedy: Depending on the condition of the coupling on inspection it will either be reworked by the addition of stiffer plates or by the replacement of the welded-in king pin by a bolt-in king pin.

fruehauf.defect: CRACKED CHASSIS/SIDE MEMBERS AND/OR TWISTING/DEFORMATION OF CHASSIS Cracked chassis/side members and/or twisting/deformation of the chassis.
fruehauf.remedy: Inspect each vehicle repair any damage and fit a sub frame where required.

fruehauf.defect: KING PIN MOUNTING MAY LOOSEN The aluminium couplers have been found to have cracks in the welds attaching the crossmembers to the side members. This could result in the trailer becoming uncoupled from the tractive unit
fruehauf.remedy: The complete upper coupler to be replaced by Fruehauf with a fully checked and modified replacement.

fruehauf.defect: POSSIBLE FRAME FAILURE Fractures have been found in the front frame bolster area near the support legs and around the rear cross member of the upper coupler.
fruehauf.remedy: Operators of likely to affected  trailers will be contacted and instructed to inspect designated areas of the 20 foot position bolster for weld failure. Should a failure be identified the trailer should be taken out of service with immediate effect. The trailer should not be put back into service until modified by the manufacturer.

fruehauf.defect: CRACKING AROUND KING PIN RETAINING WELD Maintenance inspections have revealed cracking around the periphery of the weld retaining the king pin to the upper coupler apron plate on specified trailers.
fruehauf.remedy: Depending on the condition of the coupling on inspection it will either be reworked by the addition of stiffer plates or by the replacement of the welded-in king pin by a bolt-in king pin.

fruehauf.defect: FAILURE OF SUSPENSION TRAILING ARM Suspension trailing arms may fracture forward of the axle beam. This may result in damage to the suspension or detachment of the axle.
fruehauf.remedy: Recalled trailers to be modified in 3 areas to reduce the stress levels and maintain tightness at the connection between the trailing arms and the axle beam viz 1)Replace axle bracket location plates with tee shaped key plates. 2) Replace square U-bolt

fruehauf.defect: CRACKING AROUND KING PIN RETAINING WELD Maintenance inspections have revealed cracking around the periphery of the weld retaining the king pin to the upper coupler apron plate on specified trailers.
fruehauf.remedy: Depending on the condition of the coupling on inspection it will either be reworked by the addition of stiffer plates or by the replacement of the welded-in king pin by a bolt-in king pin.

fulda.defect: 225/50R18 99W Fulda Ecocontrol HP2 On affected tyres a manufacturing variation that resulted in a partial under cure of the tread blocks may lead to tread chunking or separation.
fulda.remedy: Tyres can be identified by DOT code 1H378 JAFR 4524 on the sidewall.  Owners are asked to contact the manufacturer for a free replacement.

garmin.defect: BATTERY MAY OVERHEAT Garmin have identified that certain model Nuvi portable navigation products fitted with a specific battery and printed circuit board design can under rare circumstances overheat.  This could result in a unit fire.
garmin.remedy: Garmin have written to all known owners of these units and have instigated a comprehensive publicity exercise to request all owners to check their unit's serial number against information contained on Garmin's website.  If an affected unit is identified then the unit will be return to Garmin for the replacement of the battery. The recall is a world wide recall not just the UK and the numbers specified are related to Europe.

general.defect: L87 Engine Loss of Propulsion The connecting rod and/or crankshaft engine components in these vehicles may have manufacturing defects that can lead to engine damage and engine failure. If the engine fails while driving the vehicle will lose propulsion increasing the risk of a crash.
general.remedy: Dealers will inspect the engine. If the vehicle fails the inspection procedure the engine will be repaired or replaced. Vehicles that pass inspection will be provided a higher viscosity oil which will also require a new oil fill cap identifying the new required oil grade an oil filter replacement and an owner’s manual insert free of charge.

gilera.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT It has been established that a manufacturing defect in the rotor of the fuel pump installed in the aforementioned machines can cause failure of the pump. gilera.remedy: Recall all affected machines to check and if require place the fuel pump.

gilera.remedy: Recalled machines will be fitted with a steel support in the subject area.

gkn.defect: GKN Automotive Aftermarket Sideshafts and CV Joints Certain side shafts and CV joints manufactured in China do not meet GKN Automotive’s heightened original equipment level specifications for ultimate strength.
gkn.remedy: GKN Automotive will reimburse any customers for the cost of the recalled side shaft or CV joint and for their labour to install a replacement side shaft or CV joint of their choosing. GKN Automotive will also repurchase any remaining inventory from any distributors or retailers.

goingreen.defect: THERMISTER POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD WHEN CHARGING There has been an incident where a vehicle caught fire whilst parked and charging due to a problem with the charging unit.
goingreen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the thermistor fit an additional thermal cut out inside the charger and to replace the existing charger cover for one with fire retardant properties.

gowerings.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL The rear suspension dual purpose ram securing cap head screw may not be correctly torqued.  There is a possibility that the screw could become loose and damage the brake pipe which could result in brake failure.
gowerings.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection and if found to be incorrectly torqued carry out rework procedure as laid down by converter.

gowerings.defect: SEATBELT ANCHOR MAY BE LOOSE Rear Wheelchair lap and diagonal upper anchor securing may be inadequate
gowerings.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check/ fit belt securing device.

gowerings.defect: FUEL TANK MAY DETACH It has been identified that the studs which secure the fuel tank strap were not correctly welded to the vehicle floor. If ignored the possibility exists that the fuel tank could detach from the vehicle.
gowerings.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with modified fuel tank straps and fixings.

gowerings.defect: WHEELCHAIR RETRACTOR BELT MAY NOT LOCK Intermittent failure of the locking mechanism in the electrically operated combo retractor belts (also front wheel chair restraints). If the retractor belts fail the wheel chair and user could be insecure on loading and when loaded.
gowerings.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the electrically operated combo retractor belts.

graco.defect: CARRYING HANDLE MAY NOT LOCK IN THE UPRIGHT CARRY POSITION. The carrying handle may not have locked in the upright carry position unless it has been positively checked each time by the user.
graco.remedy: Exchange the defective seat for a quality assured replacement.

grafton.defect: LOAD LOCKING DEVICE RELEASES WHEN EMERGENCY LINE BECOMES DETACHED The load carrying skip retaining devices will release should air pressure in the trailer emergency line be lost.
grafton.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be retrofitted with a 3/2 valve which will retain the skip retaining devices in place should emergency air pressure be lost. Additionally whilst the vehicles are being modified the area in the vicinity of the sliding draw bar coupling will be inspected for fatigue or fractures.

granning.defect: SPINDLE/TUBE ATTACHMENT FAILURE. Due to possible faulty welding the spindle carrying the wheel and hub assembly may detach from the axle tube.
granning.remedy: The axle manufacturer is carrying out ultrasonic and magnetic checks on all potentially affected axles at the premises of all identified end users. The complete axle will be replaced in all cases where the weld is found to be suspect.

gray.defect: THE EMERGENCY BRAKE MAY INADVERTENTLY APPLY The emergency brake may inadvertently apply due to the 'Y' couplings not being to the required specification and failing.
gray.remedy: Recall the trailers that are likely to be affected to replace the 'Y' couplings with ones of the correct specification.

gray.defect: BRAKES MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLY It has been identified that a fitting in the emergency line had been supplied which was not suitable for trailer braking applications and had the potential to split open during operation. gray.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fitting replaced with a fitting which is suitable for the application.

gray.remedy: Examine affected units and replace the fuel tank assembly where found necessary.

great.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel filler assembly may fracture at the top of the neck. If the neck becomes detached this will result in the leakage of fuel vapour.
great.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel filler neck.

great.defect: There is a problem with the internal algorithm of the E-Call controller. There is a problem with the internal algorithm of the E-Call controller.
great.remedy: Corrective software will be applied to bring affected vehicles back into conformity.

great.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR The vehicle's central locking and alarm immobiliser systems may malfunction. This is caused by an incorrectly secured wiring harness.
great.remedy: On affected vehicles unclip harness and inspect. If necessary repair or replace harness and re-secure using correct securing method.

great.defect: On affected vehicles if the Auxiliary charge (3 pin) cable is used with household extension leads and/or substandard domestic wall sockets for an extended period there is a possibility of the auxiliary charge cable 3 pin plug having a high electrical resistance causing excessive heat build-up. This in extreme cases may cause a failure of the 3-pin cable.   If the vehicle is unlocked via the remote fob key during the AC charging process voltage is still present for a further 15 seconds within the charge socket. If the cable is unplugged from the car within this 15 second window there is a possibility of an electrical spark occurring. great.remedy: The existing 13 amp 3-pin cable will be replaced with a 10 Amp cable to prevent excessive heat build-up and the vehicle charging protocol software will be updated to the latest version.

great.defect: ELECTRICAL LOOM MAY OVERHEAT It is possible that the wiring harness that is routed under the radiator may not have been fitted correctly. This could result in chaffing or failure of the harness which will either cause electrical failure in systems and overheating.
great.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check harness secure and replace if necessary.

green.defect: LOSS OF STEERING Concentrated stress at the start of the threaded portion of the tracking link arm can cause metal fatigue which will result in a fatigue fracture. The issue can be identified during routine maintenance. However if the issue is not addressed then failure can occur and steering can fail although the vehicle can be stopped safely.
green.remedy: All the affected machines will have their steering tracking link arm replaced with a new modified arm.

haldex.defect: BOLT HEAD MAY SHEAR The relay emergency valve top cover securing bolts may shear. If this happens then air will exhaust from the top cover when the brakes are applied which will affect the performance of the brakes.
haldex.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the bolts securing the emergency valve top cover.

haldex.defect: TRACTOR/TRAILER BRAKE IMBALANCE CONCERN It has been found under certain circumstances a rubber flap located in the predominance valve chamber can become detached from its carrier plate. The flap may partially obstruct a communication port causing a higher than normal pressure being required to apply the trailer brakes. If the valve was set with predominance then a change in the braking pressures and subsequent tractor/trailer brake imbalance may result.
haldex.remedy: All predominance valves in the affected date/specification ranges are to be modified with a service kit available free of charge from Haldex.

hardstaff.defect: EXHAUST COUPLING MAY FRACTURE It is possible that the flexible exhaust coupling could fail and allow hot exhaust gases to escape onto the chassis area at the rear of the cab. This may cause the vehicle's trailer air lines (plastic piping) to melt and inadvertently apply the trailer brakes.
hardstaff.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the flexible exhaust coupling with a redesigned unit.

hardstaff.defect: DAMAGE TO WIRING HARNESS AND POSSIBLE FIRE It is possible part of the wiring harness for the HDXi Dual Fuel system may become exposed to high temperatures produced by the vehicles high pressure compressed air system. If there is contact with the compressor pipe wiring harness protective sleeve damage will occur. However if there is prolonged contact this could result in a total failure of the harness or in extreme cases a vehicle fire.
hardstaff.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check harness and install a heat shield.

harley.defect: SPORTSTER S UPPER TRIPLE CLAMP AND RECALL The upper triple clamp may fracture under extreme loading conditions. An upper triple clamp that fractures while the motorcycle is being operated could lead to a loss of control increasing the risk of a crash.
harley.remedy: Inspection of the upper triple clamp to determine if an old revision or a casting anomaly is present. If a concern is present the upper triple clamp will be replaced.

harley.defect: RIDER'S SEAT BASE THREADED INSERT FAILURE Riders seat base threaded insert failure.
harley.remedy: Replacement of seat base.

harley.defect: CLUTCH MAY NOT DISENGAGE Hydraulic clutch system may lose the ability to generate enough lift to disengage the clutch. (Hydraulic clutch failure) and possibly an incorrect clutch release plate may have been installed. These items can cause the inability to disengage the engine from the transmission during operation leading to a dangerous condition.
harley.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to clean the secondary actuator of debris and install a new release rod and rod end. Additionally to identify the type of clutch release plate and where necessary replace with one of the correct type.

harley.defect: THE BRAKE CALIPER BORE AREA MAY EXPERIENCE A BUILD UP OF CORROSION OVER TIME Brake pistons dragging in the caliper bores.
harley.remedy: Replace the brake calipers.

harley.defect: THE TRIKE MAY RESPOND INCORRECTLY TO A FAULTY REAR WHEEL SPEED SENSOR SIGNAL The Trike may respond incorrectly to a faulty rear WSS (Wheel Speed Sensor) signal.
harley.remedy: Replace the ABS software with a corrected version.

harley.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL Hydraulic clutch master cylinder may fail to disengage engine on initial gear engagement leading to the machine lurching forward and falling over. This condition gives an elevated risk of injury to the rider and bystanders.
harley.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to inspect and clean the clutch master cylinder piston. Where necessary the master cylinder piston will be replaced.

If brake fluid loss remains undetected rear braking may be compromised increasing the risk of a crash.
harley.remedy: The BCM caddy and associated hardware will be replaced on all affected vehicles. In addition the rear brake line will be inspected and if damaged will be replaced along with associated parts.

harley.defect: 2024-2026 MILWAUKEE-EIGHT AIRBOX BASEPLATE The airbox baseplate may have a blocked breather port due to a supplier manufacturing issue. A blocked breather port can result in pressure build-up in the crankcase. If the dipstick is removed while the Version: 3.0 (Jan 2025) crankcase is pressurized oil may be discharged from the fill spout creating a risk of injury.
harley.remedy: Verify that air flows through the hose and into air box backing plate.  If the air box backing plate port is blocked rework the breather passage.

harley.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF BRAKE FUNCTION ON  BIKES FITTED WITH ABS If the brake fluid has not been changed as per manufacturer's instructions deposits may form which may affect the operation of the ABS module. Continued use may lead to loss of braking.
harley.remedy: On affected vehicles flush the brake systems and replace with an uprated specification fluid.

harley.defect: POSSIBLE BRAKE FAILURE The brake fluid in the front brake system could be contaminated. The contamination can cause the brake fluid to gel and / or corrosion to the master cylinder banjo bolt threads sufficiently severe to cause leakage or failure. If either of the conditions occur it will lead to a reduction in brake performance and increase the risk of a collision / incident.
harley.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the banjo bolt brake fluid and where necessary the master cylinder.

harley.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE A possibility exists that the positive battery cable may chafe on the oil tank. This could cause a short circuit with a potential risk of fire.
harley.remedy: Recall the affected machines and replace the original positive battery cable with a modified version designed to clear the oil tank.

harley.defect: On affected machines the fastener that retains the rear shock absorber adjuster may fracture. On affected machines the fastener that retains the rear shock absorber adjuster may fracture.
harley.remedy: The existing retaining bolt for the rear shock absorber adjuster will be removed the mounting hole in the frame and the shock absorber adjuster will be drilled to accommodate the fitting of a larger diameter bolt and nut.

harley.defect: CLUTCH MAY MALFUNCTION A tear may develop in the clutch master cylinder seal allowing a slow release of pressure in the system. If this should occur there may not be sufficient clutch lift to prevent the machine creeping forward.
harley.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the clutch master cylinder piston assembly.

harley.defect: ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT FAILURE It has been identified that the subject machines have been fitted with a sub-standard 40amp circuit.
harley.remedy: Recalled machines will have the circuit breaker replaced.

harley.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The vibrations that occur during normal running of the motorcycle can turn the ignition off. If this occurs all power from the engine will be lost possibly putting the rider in danger.
harley.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition switch with an up rated component.

harley.defect: UNPREDICTABLE FUEL SUPPLY TO CARBURETTOR The use of reformulated petrol in combination with a particular usage pattern of the vacuum operated fuel valve by the rider can affect the supply of petrol to the carburettor and lead to unscheduled shutdown of the engine.
harley.remedy: The affected machines are being recalled for replacement of the original fuel valve diaphragm assembly with modified components.

harley.defect: NEUTRAL GEAR LIGHT MAY ILLUMINATE WHEN MACHINE IS IN GEAR Certain 2006 Dyna range motorcycles may have a fault which leaves the neutral light illuminated when 1st or 2nd gear is selected.
harley.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the detent arm neutral switch and shift cam assembly.

This could lead to an oil leak and or the possibility of a fire.
harley.remedy: Recalled machines will have a battery caddy installed that will protect the cable and ensure correct routing.

hino.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the handbrake lever with a unit with improved spring pressure.

In this condition teeth may slip out of place due to vibration.In extreme instances the lever may be released due to inadequate spring force inside the ratchet mechanism and the vehicle may move.
hino.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the handbrake lever with a unit with improved spring pressure.

hino.defect: Air bag inflator may rupture on activation. There is a possibility the air bag inflator may rupture on activation.  Hino has not received any reports of this occurring in its vehicles in global markets. The recall is being conducted as a precautionary measure.
hino.remedy: The remedy involves replacing the faulty air bag module with one made by a different manufacturer.

hino.defect: PARKING BRAKE LEVER MAY FAIL TO ENGAGE CORRECTLY The parking brake lever may not engage correctly when the vehicle is pulled up because the teeth in the ratchet mechanism may balance on the tooth tops. hino.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the handbrake lever with a unit with improved spring pressure.

hino.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION OF BRAKING EFFORT It has been identified that during production the front brake back plate retaining bolts may not have been tightened to the correct torque. Should the vehicle continue to be used in this condition the bolts may work loose and fail. In the worst case this could result in the front brake assembly detaching from the axle breaking the air line causing a loss of braking effort at the affected wheel station and an increase in stopping distance.
hino.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked for correct torque. If found not to be at the correct torque the bolts will be checked and replaced as necessary.

hino.defect: WIRING HARNESS MAY BE DAMAGED It has been identified that the cab wiring harness can come in contact with a support bracket within the cab which can cause chaffing damage. This can result in either the engine cutting out and/or the wiper motor suddenly stopping.
hino.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to fit additional protection to the edge of support bracket and to inspection for damage to the wiring harness.  If found damaged then repair as necessary and fit an additional vinyl protection sleeve to the harness.

hjs.defect: A WELD ON THE INLET PIPE FLANGE COULD BE MISSING On affected components the exhaust flex end clamp ring has been inadequately welded
hjs.remedy: Check components and replace defective parts

hobby.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the adhesion of the panoramic windows. An additional adhesive seam will be applied to the affected units.

honda.defect: Gear Change Pedal Bolt On affected motorcycles due to the proximity of the exhaust to the gear change pivot bolt radiant heat from the exhaust system increases the temperature of the gear change pivot bolt seat causing the painted surface to buckle and the bolt to loosen. In some cases the pivot bolt can fall off and the gear change pedal sags leaving the rider unable to change gear.
honda.remedy: Remove paint from the Gear change pedal fastening seat surface and install a modified Gear change pedal pivot bolt and additional washer.

honda.defect: Gear Change Pedal Bolt On affected motorcycles due to the proximity of the exhaust to the gear change pivot bolt radiant heat from the exhaust system increases the temperature of the gear change pivot bolt seat causing the painted surface to buckle and the bolt to loosen. In some cases the pivot bolt can fall off and the gear change pedal sags leaving the rider unable to change gear.
honda.remedy: Remove paint from the Gear change pedal fastening seat surface and install a modified Gear change pedal pivot bolt and additional washer.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It is possible for the rubber sealing boots which protect the tie rod ends from contamination and loss of lubricant to become dislodged from the joint resulting in rapid wear and possible separation. If the joint separates steering control will be lost.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the four tie rod ends.

honda.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE IF DEPLOYED Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the driver's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the driver's air bag module.

honda.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant or in a thermal issue in the interior compartment which may lead to fire.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

honda.defect: CONCERN THAT THE FUEL TANK DIE STAMPING DOES NOT MEET MANUFACTURING SPECIFICATIONS On certain machines the Fuel Tank die stamping does not meet manufacturing specifications.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines inspect fuel tank to determine if it needs to be replaced. If the inspection identifies a problem a countermeasure fuel tank will be fitted

honda.defect: THE ABSORPTION OF MOISTURE INTO THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG PROPELLANT COULD LEAD TO SLOW DEPLOYMENT OR INFLATOR RUPTURE The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture.
honda.remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly.  Honda is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The engine may hesitate or cut out due to air accumulating in the fuel strainer  which is then drawn in by the high pressure fuel pump. This in turn results in low fuel pressure leading to hesitation illuminating MIL lamp on and possible stalling.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a redesigned fuel strainer.

honda.defect: DUE TO INCORRECT MANUFACTURING THE REAR SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY WEBBING SENSOR COULD BECOME INOPERATIVE The webbing sensor in the rear centre seat belt assembly could become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Check and if the seat belt is within the affected range the seat belt will be replaced.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: 1. ENGINE MAY STALL. 2. RISK OF FIRE. During assembly of the starter relay switch sealant may have been applied incorrectly which could increase resistance across the main fuse. This may cause non starting stalling or in extreme instances a risk of fire.
honda.remedy: On affected  machines check  the starter magnetic switch and loom connection. Replace starter magnetic switch and/or  loom as necessary.

honda.defect: TOP BOX MAY DETACH DURING USE The Rear Carrier (Top Box Mounting Base) of the Genuine Honda Top Box accessory may prevent the Top Box from fully engaging to the Rear Carrier. As a result it may inadvertently detach during use and become a hazard for other road users.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and carry out a TEMPORARY repair. Check if the Genuine Honda Top Box is securely installed on the Rear Carrier. The Top Box locking mechanism will be fixed in the closed position with a unique tie band to ensure that the Top Box cannot detach from the Rear Carrier. The tie band should also NOT be removed until the permanent repair has been carried out.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT INSTALLATION OF FUEL RETURN HOSE The fuel injection return hose may of been installed with an excessive bend in its routing. This could create excessive pressure on the hose joint not designed for high pressure and result in fuel leakage.
honda.remedy: Affected machines are being recalled to have the fuel return hose re-position.

honda.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled upward toward the windshield or downward toward the front passenger�s foot well potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the front passenger�s airbag module with a new one.

honda.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INCORRECT BRAKE OPERATION. There is a possibility that the brake pedal lock pin which ensures a positive connection of the brake pedal to the braking system may be incorrectly installed. In such cases it is possible that excessive free play in the brake pedal can occur leading to incorrect brake pedal operation. The clutch may also be similarly affected.
honda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check for correct installation of the lock pins. If either lock pin is not correctly installed the pin will be re-installed correctly.

honda.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The propellant used in the air bag inflators may degrade over time due to heat cycles and exposure to moisture. In the event that the airbag is activated it may overinflate due to overly aggressive combustion of the propellant. The excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing severe injury to the vehicle occupants.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator and airbag.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The resin bracket inside the fuel pump may deform and reduce the clearance with the impeller causing the fuel pump to fail. If this concern occurs the machine could either fail to start or whilst riding the engine may stall without warning and not restart.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the pump with a modified type that uses a bracket made of aluminium.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT In certain conditions it is possible for contaminated water to penetrate into the ignition coil causing the internal components to corrode. This can result in hard starting poor engine performance and in extreme cases cause the engine to cut out.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and fit a countermeasure ignition coil.

honda.defect: POTENTIAL WIRING CHAFE SITUATION AND SHORT CIRCUIT Potential chafing of the A/C wiring harness due to inappropriate routing. This can lead to a short circuit.
honda.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the A/C wiring harness re-routed and additional protection added. If any wire insulation is worn through and the copper is exposed the harness will be replaced.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE REAR BRAKE FAILURE It is possible that the rear brake reservoir hose could be chaffed by the speed sensor guide bolt on the rear swinging arm.  This could result in abrasion damage and a subsequent fluid leak. Should this occur air could enter the system and the rear brake function could be lost.
honda.remedy: Recall all affected machines for the replacement of the hose and reservoir.

honda.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant or in a thermal issue in the interior compartment which may lead to fire.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

honda.defect: HACE TOP BOX MAY DETACH Certain roads conditions can produce inputs which can dislodge the top box from the mountings which could result in the top box falling from the machine.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the top box base unit and carrier with modified parts.

honda.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It is possible moisture or other fluids may enter the drivers window and contaminate the main power window switch. If this occurs and the switch is damaged it could overheat and cause it to melt and/or smoke.  If this situation is not identified it could result in a vehicle fire.
honda.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and check the switch. If the switch is not damaged a waterproof cover will be fitted. If the switch is damaged it will be replaced and a waterproof cover will be fitted.

honda.defect: STEERING SHAFT MAY FAIL Steering shaft received an unexpected bending force during production which may result in the shaft failing.
honda.remedy: Carry inspection and replace steering shaft if found to be damaged.

honda.defect: Abnormal data may cause engine stall or clutch disengagement whilst driving. Abnormal data may cause engine stall or clutch disengagement whilst driving.
honda.remedy: Apply software update to the Fuel injection ECU of all affected vehicles.

honda.defect: EXCESSIVE GREASE WAS APPLIED TO THE O RING OF THE RESERVOIR PISTON Within the ABS (Antilock Braking System) modulator excessive grease may have been applied to an O-ring.
honda.remedy: All affected units will have the lot number of the ABS modulator checked and if found to be within the defective lot number range the ABS modulator will be replaced.

honda.defect: SUSPENSION MAY FAIL The front upper suspension arm mounting may detach from the main frame allowing the wheel to suddenly and unexpectedly turn outwards adversely affecting the riders ability to steer the ATV.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the nearside upper suspension arm and if not replaced as per original recall the offside upper suspension arm.

honda.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the driver's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the driver's air bag module.

Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant or in a thermal issue in the interior compartment which may lead to fire.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

honda.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE IF DEPLOYED Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the driver's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the driver's air bag module.

honda.defect: HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT ILLUMINATE CORRECTLY Due to the layout of the lighting switch wiring harness the low beam headlight circuit can be pulled tighter than other wires.  After repeated use of the headlight switch the low beam terminal can become worn and poor electrical continuity may result from an accumulation of copper oxide.  In some cases the poor continuity the poor continuity or melted terminal ends will cause the wiring harness terminal ends to melt.  Poor continuity or melted terminal ends will cause the low beam head lights to become inoperative increasing the risk of accident.
honda.remedy: The dealer will inspect the low beam terminal if the terminal shows signs of melting the lighting switch and low beam terminal harness will be replaced.  If the terminal is not melted the low beam terminal harness will be replaced.

honda.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY RUPTURE IF DEPLOYED The drivers front airbag inflator could produce excessive internal pressure. If an affected airbag deploys the increased internal pressure may cause the inflator to rupture. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the inflator inside the drivers airbag module with a new one.

honda.defect: DUE TO INCORRECT MANUFACTURING THE REAR SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY WEBBING SENSOR COULD BECOME INOPERATIVE The webbing sensor in the rear centre seat belt assembly could become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Check and if the seat belt is within the affected range the seat belt will be replaced.

honda.defect: INNER PRESSURE OF THE INFLATOR MAY IRREGULARLY RISE UPON AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT RUPTURING THE INFLATOR CONTAINER Driver air bag may not ignite correctly.
honda.remedy: Replace the drivers air bag assembly.

honda.defect: REAR BRAKE MAY FAIL The rear brake pipe joint may not have been sufficiently tightened when the machine was manufactured. Continuous use of the rear brake and vibration from riding may cause the brake pipe joint to leak brake fluid. Consequently when the rear brake lever is applied poor/no brake operation will result and in the worst case scenario a crash may occur.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and for all affected units the tightening torque of the pipe joint bolt will be checked if it passes inspection then fluid level will be topped up only if it fails then the bolt will be re-torqued and the brake system will be bled.

honda.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT REAR WHEEL MAY LOCK. When the clutch lever is released but the clutch not fully engaged clutch disc judder can occur at high engine RPM when performing rapid style racing starts. The resultant stress can cause the clutch outer to fail which may result in several large pieces separating from the clutch outer which may cause rear wheel lock the engine to stop and the risk of engine oil leakage due to crankcase damage.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines for the installation of an improved clutch outer and clutch lift lever shaft anti-judder spring spring seat and friction disc.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The fuel level gauge arm holder at the fuel pump may swell during hot weather riding conditions and may become weakened. Under the riding condition of deceleration and immediate acceleration the fuel wave created inside the fuel tank causes higher load on the float arm and it could become detached from its holder. If the fuel float arm becomes detached it could result in fuel indicator error abnormal noise from fuel tank or in worst case engine stall should the arm contact the fuel pump terminals.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace complete fuel pump /float arm unit.

honda.defect: RISK OF FIRE - SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR The battery positive cable may have been incorrectly assembled and may interfere with the battery box resulting in a short circuit.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit new battery cable.

honda.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled upward toward the windshield or downward toward the front passenger�s foot well potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the front passenger�s airbag module with a new one.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE Aluminium swarf from the manufacturing process may not have been fully removed from the engine assembly. The swarf may restrict the engine oil passage reducing the lubrication capacity. This may produce an abnormal level of noise and in the worst case may cause the engine to seize.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to inspect the engine oil gallery and where necessary the engine assembly will be replaced.

honda.defect: AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the passenger's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the passenger's air bag module.

honda.defect: IT MAY BE POSSIBLE TO RIDE THE MOTORCYCLE WITH THE SIDE STAND DOWN. An incorrectly welded pivot piece on the side stand may prevent the side stand cut out switch from operating.
honda.remedy: Recall likely to be affected machines and inspect the side stand where necessary a quality assured side stand will be fitted.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that during assembly the bank angle sensor bolts were not tightened correctly. Should the bank angle sensor become loose it may cause the engine to stall.
honda.remedy: Recalled machines will have the bank angle sensor bolts checked and re-tightened as necessary.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO INNER SIDEWALL OF TYRE It is possible that the tyre inner side wall may have been damaged during the tyre/wheel balance identification process. In the worst case the tyre could deflate when the car is being driven.
honda.remedy: Examine tyre side walls and replace any tyres found to have been damaged as a result of the wheel balancing operation.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE AIR BAG INFLATOR RUPTURE Driver air bag may not deploy correctly.
honda.remedy: The inflator inside the drivers airbag module is to be replaced.

honda.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY DECREASE MOMENTARILY The engine speed may decrease momentarily when quickly opening the throttle from the fully closed position to a slightly opened position.
honda.remedy: Update engine ECU software.

honda.defect: TRANSMISSION MAY MALFUNCTION In rare circumstances the gear indicator may display neutral when the gearbox is in reverse gear. If this happens the vehicle may reverse unexpectedly and cause an incident.
honda.remedy: Recall vehicles likely to be affected to correct the unit software and inspect the reverse shift holder for deformation. Where necessary the reverse shift piece and shift holder will be replaced.

honda.defect: VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPPED WITH A FUEL PUMP MODULE MANUFACTURED WITH LOW DENSITY IMPELLARS Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers.
honda.remedy: The affected fuel pumps will be replaced.

honda.defect: IGNITION SWITCH MAY FAIL Electrical contacts within the ignition switch wear prematurely.  This can eventually cause the engine to stall without warning.
honda.remedy: Fit a new ignition switch.

honda.defect: Fuel Pump Impeller Swelling The impeller inside the fuel pump may become distorted and crack. This locks the impeller preventing fuel from being delivered
honda.remedy: Inspection of the fuel pump LOT number and replacement as required

honda.defect: TAKATA PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE Passenger airbag inflators may not operate as intended.
honda.remedy: Replacement of Airbag Assembly on affected vehicles.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The fuel pump may stop working due to a bracket inside the pump distorting and stopping the impeller from turning. This can lead to the engine cutting out and not restarting.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel pump with a modified unit.

honda.defect: MAINSTAND RETAINING CIRCLIP MAY BREAK WHEN EXPANDED TO FIT Mainstand retaining circlip may break when expanded to fit In worst case the vehicle may fall when placing on the main stand or main stand may detach while riding.
honda.remedy: Circlip and washer will be replaced with a new countermeasure part

honda.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY RUPTURE IF DEPLOYED Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the drivers airbag module.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT In certain conditions it is possible for contaminated water to penetrate into the ignition coil causing the internal components to corrode. This can result in hard starting poor engine performance and in extreme cases cause the engine to cut out.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and fit a countermeasure ignition coil.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The wiring for the indicator harness and front sub harness may fail. This can affect the headlight turn signals speedometer and alarm horn. In the worst case the engine may stall while riding.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the front sub-harness and the indicator switch harness.

honda.defect: THE GEAR LEVER POSITION MAY NOT MATCH THE TRANSMISSION MODE SELECTED The transmission shift cable lock pin may become ineffective. In consequence the gear lever position may not match the actual gear position selected in the transmission.
honda.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the lock pin with a modified type.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL WITHOUT WARNING The engine may be difficult to start and / or the engine may stall without warning from fuel starvation and will be impossible to restart. When fuel is present in the fuel pump it causes the surface of the resin inlet cover to deform and swell into a convex shape. The clearance between the inlet cover and the fuel pump's impeller reduces and the two components interfere with each other. As a result the impeller locks and stops fuel flow to the engine.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the affected fuel pump with a counter measure fuel pump.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY  FAIL Due to an inappropriate software setting of the Engine Control Unit the oil level in the engine may increase due to fuel dilution during the Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) regeneration.  If the oil level increases too much it may prevent the engine from decelerating as intended the engine may continue to run even if the ignition is switched off.  This may result in engine failure.  The driver will not have any warning of this failure.
honda.remedy: The dealer will rewrite the engine software and replace the engine oil and engine filter.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. honda.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE Electrolyte from the battery could leak onto the plastic fuel pump which can result in a crack forming. The load from the connecting hose which occurs during normal use any crack could expand and lead to a fuel leak.
honda.remedy: Recall he machines that are likely to be affect to fit a new redesigned battery box and where necessary replace the fuel pump.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL When the engine becomes hot residual torque of the rocker shaft arm sealing bolts can decrease gradually and the sealing bolt can become loose and fall out. This can result in engine oil leaking and the engine stalling.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the rocker shaft sealing bolts and washer on both intake and exhaust side of the engine.

honda.defect: A NUMBER OF NO COATING CATALSYER EXHAUST PIPES MANUFACTURED FOR TESTING PURPOSES ONLY  WERE MIXED WITH MASS PRODUCTION PARTS Exhaust Catalyser coating missing
honda.remedy: Affected units will be inspected and the exhaust pipe replaced with a new part.

honda.defect: THE LEFT CUSHION CONNECTING PLATE MAY BE INSTALLED WITH THE INSIDE AND OUTSIDE SURFACES REVERSED The left cushion connecting plate may be installed with the inside and outside surfaces reversed.
honda.remedy: The motorcycle will be inspected and if the connecting plate is incorrectly installed the connecting plate will be replaced.

honda.defect: TURN SIGNAL HAZARD SIGNAL AND HIGH BEAM DOES NOT LIGHT WHEN SWITCHES ARE OPERATED Turn signal hazard signal and high beam may not operate as designed.
honda.remedy: Replace the LED Control Unit (LCU) with countermeasure part.

honda.defect: INNER PRESSURE OF THE INFLATOR MAY IRREGULARLY RISE UPON AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT RUPTURING THE INFLATOR CONTAINER Driver air bag may not ignite correctly.

honda.defect: REAR BRAKE PIPE NUT MAY NOT BE TORQUED CORRECTLY There is a possibility that a brake pipe nut on the rear brake system may be incorrectly torqued which may lead to loss of brake fluid and loss of brake efficiency
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines and check and if required reapply correct torque to brake pipe nut

honda.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE The drive to the rear wheel may be lost due to chain link plate failure. The failures are due to incorrect heat treatment of the link plates at the supplying factory.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to ascertain the manufacturer of the drive chain. If the chain is produced by a certain manufacturer a new chain will be fitted.

honda.defect: AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the passenger's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the passenger's air bag module.

honda.defect: REAR BRAKE MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE The rear master cylinder mounting bolts may become loose. In the unlikely event that both mounting bolts become detached the operation and function of the rear brake may be adversely affected.
