honda.defect: FAULTY CONNECTOR MAY CAUSE ENGINE TO STALL AND COULD CAUSE FIRE The regulator connector within the wiring harness can generate heat due to a poor connection with the terminal wires.  This may cause the connector to overheat which could result in the engine cutting out.
honda.remedy: Recall all the affected machines to remove the terminal connector and install a permanent connection by crimping and soldering the wires together.

honda.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY RELEASE It has been identified that; if the handbrake is applied with the release button intentionally or unintentionally depressed there is a small risk that the handbrake may not latch sufficiently to hold the vehicle securely on a slope.
honda.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the handbrake assembly replaced.

honda.defect: IT MAY BE POSSIBLE TO RIDE THE MOTORCYCLE WITH THE SIDE STAND DOWN. An incorrectly welded pivot piece on the side stand may prevent the side stand cut out switch from operating.
honda.remedy: Recall likely to be affected machines and inspect the side stand where necessary a quality assured side stand will be fitted.

honda.defect: THE ABSORPTION OF MOISTURE INTO THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG PROPELLANT COULD LEAD TO SLOW DEPLOYMENT OR INFLATOR RUPTURE The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture.
honda.remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly.  Honda is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL When the engine becomes hot residual torque of the rocker shaft arm sealing bolts can decrease gradually and the sealing bolt can become loose and fall out. This can result in engine oil leaking and the engine stalling.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the rocker shaft sealing bolts and washer on both intake and exhaust side of the engine.

honda.defect: LOW BEAM HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT OPERATE. Dipped beam headlights may malfunction either when switched on or during driving.
honda.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the headlight switch with a modified part. Additionally the terminal for dipped beam operation within the wiring harness will also be changed in order to rectify any heat damage that may have occurred.

honda.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE IF DEPLOYED Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the driver's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the driver's air bag module.

honda.defect: GEARBOX MAY FAIL The countershaft 5th gear dogs used for engaging 3rd gear are broken. Although the material strength of the gear has been increased the fatigue strength was decreased due to the removal of shot peening treatment to the root of the dogs of countershaft 5th gear used for engaging 3rd gear. This led to breakage starting from the root of the dogs.
honda.remedy: Affected machines will be recalled to be disassembled and reassembled using the latest countermeasure replacement.

honda.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE IF DEPLOYED Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the driver's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the driver's air bag module.

honda.defect: PREMATURE WEAR OF STEERING LOWER BALL JOINTS Certain vehicles were manufactured with front lower ball joints that may prematurely wear out and in the worst case separate from the front knuckle. If separation occurs then loss of steering control may happen.
honda.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have both front lower ball joint assemblies replaced.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT FIXING OF THE FUEL FILLER TUBE The screw clips on the filler tube connecting the fuel filler pipe to the fuel tank may not be correctly installed. The tube may not therefore be securely fixed to the tank and/or pipe. This could permit fuel to leak from the tank in the event of a severe rear end impact.
honda.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to check for correct installation of the fuel filler tube clips. Any clip not properly installed will be retorqued correctly.

honda.defect: 23YM Civic Lithium-Ion Battery Negative Terminal Defect On affected vehicles the Hybrid HV battery may develop a fault where battery electrolyte leakage occurs that may result in a vehicle fire in a worst-case scenario.
honda.remedy: Replace the Hybrid HV battery with a modified component.

honda.remedy: Replace front tyre with a countermeasure part.

honda.defect: Headlight Beam On affected motorcycles whilst riding there is a risk the headlamp may flicker and eventually shut off.
honda.remedy: Replace the headlamp assembly with a modified part.

honda.defect: Winker Wiring Harness Short Circuit On affected motorcycles the indicator wire may have been incorrectly routed during production which may cause a short circuit that can lead to malfunctions in the turn signal system (front and rear) brake lights horn meter hazard lights taillight and license light.
honda.remedy: Check and reroute wiring harness and repair or replace it if necessary.

honda.defect: Steering Lock Screw Failure For affected machines the screw fixing the steering lock to the bottom bridge was not tightened enough and in some cases it can loosen during riding and become caught in the steering area making the steering impossible to operate and causing a fall or the steering lock to become detached.
honda.remedy: Campaign 3S4 – Temporary Repair - Until parts allocation is confirmed late May 2026 – Carry out inspection of steering lock free play with the following outcomes:- Free play detected: Replace Lock Screws. No free play detected: Retailer should mark the screw heads and instruct the customer to check the marks before each ride. If marks do not align the customer should immediately stop riding and contact their nearest Honda Authorized Retailer for advice. Campaign. 3RY – Final Repair - Following sufficient parts allocation- Replacement of the steering lock screw will be performed free of charge to all affected units. During replacement a thread-locking agent will be applied and screws tightened to the specified torque.

honda.defect: 23-24M e:Ny1 Combination Meter Total Mileage Display Malfunction On affected vehicles after the voltage of the 12V battery drops when the vehicle is started after charging or replacing the battery the ODO distance displayed on the Meter is reset to 0 miles. This does not comply with the relevant regulations.
honda.remedy: Install updated software.

honda.defect: Civic Wheel Steel Bushes Missing (Accessory) On affected vehicles the alloy steel bushes may be missing in all five positions of the alloy wheel. This may result in the wheel nuts falling off or in the worst-case scenario wheel detachment.
honda.remedy: Inspect the wheels for the presence of bush and replace wheel(s) in case of missing bushes.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT In certain conditions it is possible for contaminated water to penetrate into the ignition coil causing the internal components to corrode. This can result in hard starting poor engine performance and in extreme cases cause the engine to cut out.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and fit a countermeasure ignition coil.

honda.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT REAR WHEEL MAY LOCK. When the clutch lever is released but the clutch not fully engaged clutch disc judder can occur at high engine RPM when performing rapid style racing starts. The resultant stress can cause the clutch outer to fail which may result in several large pieces separating from the clutch outer which may cause rear wheel lock the engine to stop and the risk of engine oil leakage due to crankcase damage.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines for the installation of an improved clutch outer and clutch lift lever shaft anti-judder spring spring seat and friction disc.

honda.defect: FRAME WELDS DO NOT MEET MANUFACTURERS SPECIFICATION Some of the frame welds are not to the manufacturers specification which in could lead to cracking of the affected welded joints. In the worst case the welded area could break resulting in rear suspension or lower cross member separation.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected. Any repairs will consist will consist of reinforcement of the welds where it is identified during the initial inspection that the weld bead shape is incorrect. A new counter-measure frame will be installed if it is identified that a reinforcement weld cannot be applied.

honda.defect: POSSIBILITY THE SPEEDOMETER WILL SHOW A SLOWER SPEED THAN ACTUAL RIDING SPEED Due to a speedometer computer programme error the possibility exists that the speedometer may indicate a slower than actual speed.
honda.remedy: Recalled machines will be fitted with a countermeasure speedometer.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: THE STRENGTH OF THE HORN STAY IS INSUFFICIENT The horn stay may break whilst riding and as a result the horn will become detached
honda.remedy: Replace the horn assembly.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF LOWER HANDLEBAR HOLDER BOLTS. A combination of incorrect clearances and road vibration could result in the fracture of the lower handlebar holder fixing bolts. This could affect the directional control of the motorcycle.
honda.remedy: Countermeasure parts have been produced and will be fitted to all affected machines.

honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: REAR BRAKE MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE The rear master cylinder mounting bolts may become loose. In the unlikely event that both mounting bolts become detached the operation and function of the rear brake may be adversely affected.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary carry out appropriate repairs.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE AIR BAG  INFLATOR RUPTURE Passenger air bag may not deploy correctly.
honda.remedy: The inflator inside the passenger�s airbag module is to be replaced.

honda.defect: THE CIRCLIP LOOSENS AND CAUSES THE TRANSMISSION GEAR TO BREAK Transmission main shaft circlip could be loose.
honda.remedy: Affected units will be inspected and repaired with counter-rneasure parts.

honda.defect: IGNITION SWITCH MAY FAIL Electrical contacts within the ignition switch wear prematurely.  This can eventually cause the engine to stall without warning.
honda.remedy: Fit a new ignition switch.

honda.defect: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK WHICH MAY CAUSE FIRE It has been identified that the possibility exists that the fuel control valve diaphragm within the fuel valve assembly may not have been manufactured to specification. Due to poor adhesion of the rubber to nylon backing material fuel can seep through the nylon fibres to the vented side of the diaphragm. In the worst case fuel can drip slowly from the valve when the machine is stationary with the engine idling.
honda.remedy: Recalled machines will be fitted with a countermeasure fuel valve set.

honda.defect: IMPROPER WELDS IN FRAME CROSS MEMBER The frame welds do not meet manufacturing specifications. High loads created when riding on rough road surfaces or over pot holes can cause the affected welds to crack. In the worst case the welded area could break resulting in rear suspension collapse or lower cross member separation.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines for inspection. Any repairs will consist of reinforcement of the welds and where cracks are identified during the initial inspection a new countermeasure frame will be installed.

honda.defect: THE FRONT WIDE CAMERA MAY NOT START UP IN THE CORRECT WAY AFTER THE VEHICLE HAS STARTED The front wide camera may not start up in the correct way after the vehicle is started.
honda.remedy: Change the software in the Front Wide Camera.

honda.defect: INCORRECT TORQUE SETTINGS ON GEAR CHANGE PIVOT BOLT MIGHT CAUSE LOOSENING DURING STRONG OPERATION Possible inappropriate tightening torque settings on the gear change pivot bolt.
honda.remedy: Replace the gear change bolt with a new bolt and apply locking agent.

In the worst case the welded area could break resulting in rear suspension or lower cross member separation.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected. Any repairs will consist will consist of reinforcement of the welds where it is identified during the initial inspection that the weld bead shape is incorrect. A new counter-measure frame will be installed if it is identified that a reinforcement weld cannot be applied.

honda.defect: IF DEPLOYED THE AIRBAGS MAY ENDANGER PASSENGER The combustion rate of the airbag propellant may be too fast causing excessive internal pressure in the inflator during airbag deployment. In an extreme case the inflator casing may rupture leading to a scattering of metal fragments.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front passenger airbag assembly.

honda.defect: EXCESSIVE GREASE WAS APPLIED TO THE O RING OF THE RESERVOIR PISTON Within the ABS (Antilock Braking System) modulator excessive grease may have been applied to an O-ring.
honda.remedy: All affected units will have the lot number of the ABS modulator checked and if found to be within the defective lot number range the ABS modulator will be replaced.

honda.defect: VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPPED WITH A FUEL PUMP MODULE MANUFACTURED WITH LOW DENSITY IMPELLARS Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers.
honda.remedy: The affected fuel pumps will be replaced.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE WHEEL LOCK WHEN ABS ACTIVATED Due to a manufacturing a check valve in the Vehicle Stability Assist / Anti lock braking modulator  not operate correctly.The anti lock braking may not operate correctly resulting in possible wheel lock under anti lock braking operation. In addition the City Brake Active system (CTBA) may not operate as intended.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace Vehicle Stability Assist / Anti lock braking modulator

honda.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled upward toward the windshield or downward toward the front passenger�s foot well potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the front passenger�s airbag module with a new one.

honda.defect: INNER PRESSURE OF THE INFLATOR MAY IRREGULARLY RISE UPON AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT RUPTURING THE INFLATOR CONTAINER Driver air bag may not ignite correctly.
honda.remedy: Replace the drivers air bag assembly.

honda.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY DECREASE MOMENTARILY The engine speed may decrease momentarily when quickly opening the throttle from the fully closed position to a slightly opened position.
honda.remedy: Update engine ECU software.

honda.defect: REVERSE GEAR MAY UNEXPECTEDLY ENGAGE As the user of the machine downshifts it can be possible for reverse gear to unexpectedly engage without the use of the Reverse Assist Lever.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and install a kit of parts to the gearbox which will prevent the above situation occurring.

honda.defect: FRAME WELDS DO NOT MEET MANUFACTURERS SPECIFICATION Some of the frame welds are not to the manufacturers specification which in could lead to cracking of the affected welded joints. In the worst case the welded area could break resulting in rear suspension or lower cross member separation.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected. Any repairs will consist will consist of reinforcement of the welds where it is identified during the initial inspection that the weld bead shape is incorrect. A new counter-measure frame will be installed if it is identified that a reinforcement weld cannot be applied.

honda.defect: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER MAY FAIL CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE MACHINE The rear shock absorber piston rod nut may come loose. The shock absorber performance may be affected possibly causing a loss of machine control.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check if the machine is fitted with an affected shock absorber.Any affected shock absorbers will be removed and returned to Ohlins service centre for counter measure repair.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL WITHOUT WARNING The engine may be difficult to start and / or the engine may stall without warning from fuel starvation and will be impossible to restart. When fuel is present in the fuel pump it causes the surface of the resin inlet cover to deform and swell into a convex shape. The clearance between the inlet cover and the fuel pump's impeller reduces and the two components interfere with each other. As a result the impeller locks and stops fuel flow to the engine.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the affected fuel pump with a counter measure fuel pump.

honda.defect: ZINC OXIDE CONTAMINATION OF THE FUEL TANK FOLLOWING PRODUCTION Zinc oxide contamination of the fuel tank following production.
honda.remedy: Cleaning the inside of the fuel tank and replace the fuel pump suction filter high pressure filter and fuel pump chamber.

honda.defect: RISK OF FIRE Water and other liquids may enter the driver's side power window switch and may cause damage switch failure overheating and potentially a fire.
honda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace driver's side power window switch.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK The left hand front brake pipe may not be fully secure which could lead to the brake pipe chafing on the EGR pipe. If this occurs and remains unseen the damage could result in loss of brake fluid and the attendant loss of braking efficiency.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace and correctly secure the left hand front brake pipe.

honda.defect: SPEEDOMETER MAY READ INCORRECTLY The speed sensor coupler may become corroded due to water infiltration which can cause the transmission of incorrect electrical signals to the speedometer resulting in incorrect speed indication.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines check coupler for water infiltration and condition of terminal connectors.  Depending on the result of this inspection the relevant countermeasure will be applied.

honda.defect: ZINC OXIDE CONTAMINATION OF THE FUEL TANK FOLLOWING PRODUCTION Zinc oxide contamination of the fuel tank following production.
honda.remedy: Cleaning the inside of the fuel tank and replace the fuel pump suction filter high pressure filter and fuel pump chamber.

honda.defect: REAR BRAKE MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE The rear master cylinder mounting bolts may become loose. In the unlikely event that both mounting bolts become detached the operation and function of the rear brake may be adversely affected.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary carry out appropriate repairs.

honda.defect: BATTERY CHARGING REGULATOR/RECTIFIER ASSEMBLY MAY OVERHEAT The charging circuit regulator/rectifier assembly does not have adequate heat radiating capacity. Under continuous use conditions the assembly may overheat and cause heat damage to the regulator circuit diode. This may cause further heat increase and in the worst case may cause the resin casing to melt or catch fire.
honda.remedy: Recall all affected motorcycles and fit a modified regulator/rectifier assembly

honda.defect: BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED Brake assistance may be reduced or lost due to a manufacturing nonconformance. This could lead to longer stopping distances than the driver would normally expect.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the servo and where necessary replace the servo unit.

honda.defect: TAKATA PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE Passenger airbag inflators may not operate as intended.
honda.remedy: Replacement of Airbag Assembly on affected vehicles.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE AIR BAG INFLATOR RUPTURE Driver air bag may not deploy correctly.
honda.remedy: The inflator inside the drivers airbag module is to be replaced.

honda.defect: LOW BEAM HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT OPERATE. Dipped beam headlights may malfunction either when switched on or during driving.
honda.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the headlight switch with a modified part. Additionally the terminal for dipped beam operation within the wiring harness will also be changed in order to rectify any heat damage that may have occurred.

honda.defect: THE CIRCLIP LOOSENS AND CAUSES THE TRANSMISSION GEAR TO BREAK Transmission main shaft circlip could be loose.
honda.remedy: Affected units will be inspected and repaired with counter-rneasure parts.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT AND OR FAIL TO START It has been identified that the engine may fail to start or may stall and fail to restart. This situation is caused by the presence of water residue from the tank testing procedure being left on the fuel pump wiring connector block. This situation can result in electrolytic corrosion of the connector terminals which may then break thus interrupting the electrical supply to the fuel pump with subsequent loss of fuel pressure.
honda.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for the presence of corrosion and or water on the fuel pump connector block. Should this situation be found the fuel pump assembly will be replaced.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD SCREWS SECURED TO HIGH MOUNT STOP LAMP HOUSING MAY SHIFT AND CONTACT THE PCB CIRCUITRY The metal screws that secure the printed circuit board to the high mount stop lamp housing may contact the PCB circuitry.
honda.remedy: Affected vehicles require replacement of the high mount stop lamp.

honda.defect: BRAKE LIGHTS MAY FAIL TO ILLUMINATE. GEAR SELECTOR MAY BECOME STUCK IN PARK It has been identified that the brake lights may not illuminate when the brake pedal is depressed. Additionally it may not be possible for the driver to release the gear selector from the park(P) position.
honda.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake light switch replaced additionally a new block connector will be fitted which has additional protection against ingress of foreign substances.

honda.defect: FUEL TANK MAY LEAK Due to improper filter installation in the fuel pump unit rubber cover the stainless steel filter material may interfere with the aluminium steel fuel tank body through inlet holes in the rubber cover. In turn natural moisture contamination within the fuel tank body may cause galvanic corrosion. In time this corrosion may progress to the point where the tank may become perforated and cause fuel leakage.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit rubber cover to fuel pump to prevent interference between fuel tank body and filter material. Additionally any fuel tank with evidence of corrosion will be replaced.

honda.defect: AIRBAG INFLATOR BODY MAY RUPTURE DURING DEPLOYMENT In the event that the airbag is activated it may overinflate due to overly aggressive combustion of the propellant. As a result the excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing severe injury to the rider.
honda.remedy: On affected machines replace the airbag assembly.

honda.defect: IGNITION SWITCH MAY FAIL Electrical contacts within the ignition switch wear prematurely.  This can eventually cause the engine to stall without warning.
honda.remedy: Fit a new ignition switch.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF LOWER HANDLEBAR HOLDER BOLTS. A combination of incorrect clearances and road vibration could result in the fracture of the lower handlebar holder fixing bolts. This could affect the directional control of the motorcycle.
honda.remedy: Countermeasure parts have been produced and will be fitted to all affected machines.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL WITHOUT WARNING The engine may be difficult to start and / or the engine may stall without warning from fuel starvation and will be impossible to restart. When fuel is present in the fuel pump it causes the surface of the resin inlet cover to deform and swell into a convex shape. The clearance between the inlet cover and the fuel pump's impeller reduces and the two components interfere with each other. As a result the impeller locks and stops fuel flow to the engine.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the affected fuel pump with a counter measure fuel pump.

honda.defect: THE REGULATORY REQUIREMENT FOR EMISSIONS LEVELS ARE NOT MET The regulatory requirement for emissions levels are not met.
honda.remedy: Update the software in the Engine Control Unit to improve the performance of the emissions control system

honda.defect: POTENTIAL WIRING CHAFE SITUATION AND SHORT CIRCUIT Potential chafing of the A/C wiring harness due to inappropriate routing. This can lead to a short circuit.
honda.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the A/C wiring harness re-routed and additional protection added. If any wire insulation is worn through and the copper is exposed the harness will be replaced.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT It has been established that when the rear seat is occupied the deformation of the seat back may cause a brief interference between a protection plate and an electrical connector. This can result in the main fuse blowing causing the engine to cut out.
honda.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have an additional plastic cover placed over the subject electrical connector.

honda.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL It has been identified that the front suspension ball joints may separate causing loss of control.
honda.remedy: Recalled machines will have the front suspension ball joints replaced with quality assured items.

honda.defect: EXCESSIVE TRAVEL OF PARKING BRAKE LEVER. PARKING BRAKE PERFORMANCE AFFECTED Parking brake assy; guide plates may separate allowing parking brake cable to move within the guide plates resulting in excess travel at lever and incorrect tension in cables.
honda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace parking brake lever assembly.

honda.defect: IT MAY BE POSSIBLE TO RIDE THE MOTORCYCLE WITH THE SIDE STAND DOWN. An incorrectly welded pivot piece on the side stand may prevent the side stand cut out switch from operating.
honda.remedy: Recall likely to be affected machines and inspect the side stand where necessary a quality assured side stand will be fitted.

honda.defect: BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER MAY FAIL If the brake system undergoes any fluid replacement or bleeding of the system it is possible that the rear seal can become deformed. This can result in a brake fluid leak which will when the fluid reaches a low level illuminate the brake fluid low warning light on the dash. If the driver does not take any notice of the warning it is possible that the brake performance of the vehicle could be affected.
honda.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the rear seal with an improved one.

honda.defect: IGNITION SWITCH MAY FAIL Electrical contacts within the ignition switch wear prematurely.  This can eventually cause the engine to stall without warning.
honda.remedy: Fit a new ignition switch.

honda.defect: REAR BRAKE MAY OVERHEAT WITH A POSSIBILITY OF FIRE It is possible under certain conditions for the compensator port in the Dual Combined Brake System Secondary Master Cylinder to block. This will allow the rear brake to drag with the attendant increase in temperature which eventually could lead to a fire.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to inspect the free play of the Secondary Master Cylinder using a special tool to ensure there is no blocking of the port and if necessary replace the Secondary Master Cylinder with a modified part.

honda.defect: LIQUID COULD ENTER THE POWER WINDOW MASTER SWITCH AND A SHORT CIRCUIT COULD OCCUR Power window switch can accumulate water causing overheat and possible fire.
honda.remedy: Replace power window master switch with one designed to prevent water accumulation

honda.defect: SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED The front seat back pad mould (seat back cushion) and side airbag (SAB) are fitted to the seat back frame. The SAB is fitted underneath the pad mould and the pad mould has been designed with a slit that allows the SAB to deploy from underneath the pad mould.  Seat back pad moulds that were supplied for after-sales use were not manufactured correctly; the slit process was not completed. When a front seat pad without the slit is assembled to the car it may block SAB deployment and may not satisfy occupant protection performance which is a non-conformance to side impact regulation.
honda.remedy: Registered owners of affected vehicles will receive a notification letter that will ask them to take their vehicles to a dealership or authorised repairer for a free repair. The technician will carry out inspection to verify the condition of the front seat back pad mould and will replace the pad mould and if necessary the seat heater element and seat back cover.

honda.defect: AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the passenger's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the passenger's air bag module.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible that the bank angle sensor wire may break. If this occurs the engine may cut out and possibly not restart.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the bank angle sensor add a bank angle sensor rubber add clip joint on sensor harness and change the location of the joint clip.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STOP / STALL AND FAIL TO RE-START Improper machining of the crankpin hole along with sulphur found in the engine oil and traces of coolant which generate hydrogen sulphide can corrode the silver plating of the connecting rod bearing retainer eventually allowing the bearings to turn and causing the engine to stop.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the crankshaft assembly with new countermeasure part.

honda.defect: IMPROPER WELDS IN FRAME CROSS MEMBER The frame welds do not meet manufacturing specifications. High loads created when riding on rough road surfaces or over pot holes can cause the affected welds to crack. In the worst case the welded area could break resulting in rear suspension collapse or lower cross member separation.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines for inspection. Any repairs will consist of reinforcement of the welds and where cracks are identified during the initial inspection a new countermeasure frame will be installed.

honda.defect: UNSUITABLE CLUTCH OUTER AND HEAT TREATMENT OF JUDDER SPRING The shape of the clutch outer and heat treatment of judder spring are unsuitable. Because of that if a unit is ridden repeatedly with high engine rpm the temperature of clutch outer will become high decreasing material strength resulting in breakage of the clutch outer. The Clutch Failing could result in the Engine Locking Possibly causing the rider to fall off the bike.
honda.remedy: Clutch outer to be replaced free of charge.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE AIR BAG INFLATOR RUPTURE Passenger air bag may not deploy correctly.
honda.remedy: The inflator inside the passenger�s airbag module is to be replaced.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: HEADLIGHT MAY EXTINGUISH UNEXPECTEDLY Insufficient contact between the terminals of the headlamp connector may lead to the headlamp failure.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new wiring loom and connectors

honda.defect: LOW BEAM HEADLIGHTS MAY NOT OPERATE. Dipped beam headlights may malfunction either when switched on or during driving.
honda.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the headlight switch with a modified part. Additionally the terminal for dipped beam operation within the wiring harness will also be changed in order to rectify any heat damage that may have occurred.

honda.defect: THE ABSORPTION OF MOISTURE INTO THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG PROPELLANT COULD LEAD TO SLOW DEPLOYMENT OR INFLATOR RUPTURE The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture.
honda.remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly.  Honda is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts.

honda.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant or in a thermal issue in the interior compartment which may lead to fire.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

honda.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING FLUID It has been identified that due to heat deterioration of the rubber the power steering feed hose may leak. If ignored loss of power assistance will ensue with the chance that hydraulic oil may leak onto the catalytic converter resulting in the generation of smoke and the potential of fire.
honda.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject hose replaced.

honda.defect: TAKATA PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE Passenger airbag inflators may not operate as intended.
honda.remedy: Replacement of Airbag Assembly on affected vehicles.

honda.defect: BOTTOM OF THE FUEL TANK MAY CORRODE AND ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK The distance between the packing holder and the filler of the fuel tank cap is unsuitable. If the tank cap packing becomes swollen and climbs over the filler sealing failure occurs. When the fuel level is high in that condition if rapid acceleration and deceleration are repeated the fuel level will fluctuate making fuel leak from the gap between the filler mouth and the fuel tank cap packing. The leaked fuel will then be discharged onto the road surface via the drain tube.  The fact that fuel leakage may occur under these conditions may constitute a violation of regulations.  In addition to this if water from washing the unit enters inside the fuel tank from the sealing area the engine may malfunction. In the worst case the bottom of the fuel tank may corrode and if it is continued to be used in that state corrosion would progress and fuel may leak from the tank.
honda.remedy: Fuel tank caps for all the vehicles are to be replaced with modified parts. At the same time Honda will inspect how well the caps are sealed and if water is inside the tanks. If water is found in tanks Honda will replace fuel tanks fuel pumps and injectors for steel fuel tanks and fuel pumps and injectors for titanium fuel tanks.  Titanium fuel tanks do not get rusty and do not have to be replaced.

honda.defect: TAKATA PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE Passenger airbag inflators may not operate as intended.
honda.remedy: Replacement of Airbag Assembly on affected vehicles.

honda.defect: REAR BRAKE MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE The rear master cylinder mounting bolts may become loose. In the unlikely event that both mounting bolts become detached the operation and function of the rear brake may be adversely affected.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary carry out appropriate repairs.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The fuel level gauge arm holder at the fuel pump may swell during hot weather riding conditions and may become weakened. Under the riding condition of deceleration and immediate acceleration the fuel wave created inside the fuel tank causes higher load on the float arm and it could become detached from its holder. If the fuel float arm becomes detached it could result in fuel indicator error abnormal noise from fuel tank or in worst case engine stall should the arm contact the fuel pump terminals.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace complete fuel pump /float arm unit.

honda.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant or in a thermal issue in the interior compartment which may lead to fire.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

honda.defect: HACE TOP BOX MAY DETACH Certain roads conditions can produce inputs which can dislodge the top box from the mountings which could result in the top box falling from the machine.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the top box base unit and carrier with modified parts.

honda.defect: REAR WHEEL MAY LOCK-UP The drive shaft universal joint bearing may fail because it has not have been manufactured to specification which can lead to drive force being lost and in worst case scenario if the universal joint breaks it may interfere with the swing arm and cause the rear wheel to lock-up. This may result in a reduction in stability control and increase the risk of a crash.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the drive shaft.

honda.defect: DIESEL FUEL MAY LEAK FROM FUEL PUMP Due to a production process at the seal suppliers cracks may occur in the affected seals and could potentially lead to a diesel fuel leak.  If the seal cracks diesel may leak from the pump.  The leaking fuel could result in diesel fuel smell also there may be some smoke or in the worst case scenario a fire.  There have been no cases reported of cases of fire.
honda.remedy: A recall of the affected vehicles check the manufacturer date and serial number of the high pressure diesel pump and replace the pump if the serial number falls within the affected range.

honda.defect: BATTERY CHARGING REGULATOR/RECTIFIER ASSEMBLY MAY OVERHEAT The charging circuit regulator/rectifier assembly does not have adequate heat radiating capacity. Under continuous use conditions the assembly may overheat and cause heat damage to the regulator circuit diode. This may cause further heat increase and in the worst case may cause the resin casing to melt or catch fire.
honda.remedy: Recall all affected motorcycles and fit a modified regulator/rectifier assembly

honda.defect: WRONG SIZE BRAKE DISCS COULD REDUCE BRAKE PERFORMANCE It is possible that the brake disc or discs installed to the front of the vehicle may not be the correct size. If left unchecked it could have a detrimental effect on the vehicle as it may cause deterioration in brake performance.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check which brake discs are fitted and where necessary fit brake discs of the correct size.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE AIR BAG INFLATOR RUPTURE Driver air bag may not deploy correctly.
honda.remedy: The inflator inside the drivers airbag module is to be replaced.

honda.defect: VEHICLE MAY MOVE UNEXPECTEDLY Due to a software issue it could be possible to start the engine when the vehicle is in gear and the clutch is not depressed.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to install new software.

honda.defect: REAR SEAT BELTS MAY NOT RETRACT The rear seat belt may suffer poor retraction due to a broken webbing spool. A loose seat belt may not provide sufficient restraint to avoid injury in an impact.
honda.remedy: Examine all seat belts including the front ones and replace any that have damaged spools. Fit a guide clip to the seat belts where the spool is undamaged.

honda.defect: THE MAIN STAND BOLTS MAY BECOME LOOSE Due to repeated use of the main stand the welded nut on the stand bracket may become detached. The stand could then potentially become completely detached from the machine.
honda.remedy: Recall likely to be affected machines which will be modified in the following way. 1. 2001 machines. Inspect the condition of the main stand brackets replace the stand bolts and fit additional washers and lock nuts. 2. 2002/03/04 machines. Replace the main stand brackets and bolts and fit additional washers and lock nuts.

honda.defect: ENGINE STOP SWITCH MALFUNCTION The engine stop switch contact springs do not meet specification. Under certain riding conditions such as rough or bumpy roads the engine may misfire or stop.
honda.remedy: Recall affected motorcycles and fit a quality assured engine stop switch.

honda.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The fuel pump relay may fail which will result in either the engine not starting or stalling.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary place the fuel pump relay.

honda.defect: THE LEFT CUSHION CONNECTING PLATE MAY BE INSTALLED WITH THE INSIDE AND OUTSIDE SURFACES REVERSED The left cushion connecting plate may be installed with the inside and outside surfaces reversed.
honda.remedy: The motorcycle will be inspected and if the connecting plate is incorrectly installed the connecting plate will be replaced.

Continued use of the brake in this condition may result in fracture of the connecting rod end which could result in loss of rear braking force.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines and replace connecting rod with one made of steel instead of aluminium.

honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled and a countermeasure wiring harness fitted.

The result will be a bad connection and an open circuit which will affect the operation of the fuel pump and the bank angle sensor which may cause the engine to cut out.
honda.remedy: Recall all the motorcycles that are likely to be affected and fit a new wiring harness.

honda.defect: THE REGULATORY REQUIREMENT FOR EMISSIONS LEVELS ARE NOT MET The regulatory requirement for emissions levels are not met.
honda.remedy: Update the software in the Engine Control Unit to improve the performance of the emissions control system

honda.defect: IF DEPLOYED THE AIRBAGS MAY ENDANGER PASSENGER The combustion rate of the airbag propellant may be too fast causing excessive internal pressure in the inflator during airbag deployment. In an extreme case the inflator casing may rupture leading to a scattering of metal fragments.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front passenger airbag assembly.

honda.defect: REAR BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER CONNECTING ROD END MAY FRACTURE The connecting rod push rod end may suffer from corrosion and this could cause binding and sticking of the rear brake pedal. Continued use of the brake in this condition may result in fracture of the connecting rod end which could result in loss of rear braking force.
honda.remedy: Recall affected machines and replace connecting rod with one made of steel instead of aluminium.

honda.defect: UNEXPECTED VEHICLE BEHAVIOUR IF ENGINE STALLS Under certain conditions if the vehicle is stalled it is possible the vehicle could move unexpectedly forward or backwards depending on which gear is selected.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply new software for the IMA motor Electronic Control Unit.

honda.defect: THE GEAR LEVER POSITION MAY NOT MATCH THE TRANSMISSION MODE SELECTED The transmission shift cable lock pin may become ineffective. In consequence the gear lever position may not match the actual gear position selected in the transmission.
honda.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the lock pin with a modified type.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE AIR BAG INFLATOR RUPTURE Passenger air bag may not deploy correctly.
honda.remedy: The inflator inside the passenger�s airbag module is to be replaced.

honda.defect: THE HEAT INSULATION OF THE RESIN HOSE FOR THE OIL COOLER OUTLET PIPE IS INSUFFICIENT The heat insulation of the resin hose for the oil cooler outlet pipe is insufficient.
honda.remedy: The oil cooler outlet pipe will be replaced with a new part. A heat guard will also be fitted to prevent heat from the exhaust damaging the oil cooler outlet pipe.

honda.defect: HANDBRAKE COULD BECOME INOPERATIVE. It has been identified that the handbrake lever ratchet may not latch into position when the handbrake is applied due to the possibility of the internal push rod possibly having suffered damage during assembly. With continued usage the push rod joint can become worn causing the handbrake ratchet mechanism not to latch sufficiently. Should this occur the handbrake will become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the handbrake mechanism replaced.

honda.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled upward toward the windshield or downward toward the front passenger�s foot well potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the front passenger�s airbag module with a new one.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERTENT RELEASE OF HANDBRAKE On affected vehicles the handbrake ratchet tooth dimensions are incorrect resulting in a mismatch and incorrect engagement between pawl and ratchet teeth. Consequently the handbrake lever may disengage
honda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check date stamp on lever and if marked 200709 replace handbrake lever

honda.defect: THE HARNESS MAY BE PINCHED BETWEEN THE PILLION STEP AND THE FRAME BODY When the pillion step is assembled and the wiring harness is not correctly positioned the harness may be pinched between the pillion step and the frame body or between the luggage box and the frame body.
honda.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles will be inspected to confirm any wiring harness damage. Vehicles identified with a damaged wiring harness will receive a new replacement harness. Addition of a band will be applied to prevent reoccurrence.

honda.defect: PANNIERS HAVE NOT BEEN  INSTALLED CORRECTLY Some motorcycle pannier installation has not been fully carried out in accordance with the fitting instructions.
honda.remedy: Apply a picture label to both pannier cases and dealers to explain the correct installation.

honda.defect: VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPPED WITH A FUEL PUMP MODULE MANUFACTURED WITH LOW DENSITY IMPELLARS Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers.
honda.remedy: The affected fuel pumps will be replaced.

honda.defect: THE ABSORPTION OF MOISTURE INTO THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG PROPELLANT COULD LEAD TO SLOW DEPLOYMENT OR INFLATOR RUPTURE The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture.
honda.remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly.  Honda is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts.

honda.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel may leak from an injector and/or fuel return pipe resulting in: loss of power illumination of malfunction indicator lamp diesel fuel small smoke and in the worse case fire.
honda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary refit the injector and fuel return pipes

honda.defect: INSTRUMENT PANEL LIGHTS MAY FAIL Due to the possibility of a transistor failure in the multiplex control system the instrument panel lights may fail.
honda.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled and the affected part replaced.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE AIR BAG INFLATOR RUPTURE Passenger air bag may not deploy correctly.
honda.remedy: The inflator inside the passenger�s airbag module is to be replaced.

honda.defect: THE STRENGTH OF THE REAR CARRIER IS INSUFFICIENT TO ACCOMMODATE ITS MAXIMUM PAYLOAD The strength of the rear carrier is insufficient to accommodate its maximum payload.
honda.remedy: Remove the rear carrier.

honda.defect: DURING ASSEMBLY THE CABIN HARNESS CLIP WAS BROKEN RESULTING IN THE HARNESS NOT BEING CORRECTLY SECURED IN FRONT LEFT CHASSIS RAIL / SUSPENSION TURRET AREA During vehicle assembly the cabin harness was pulled to make the process easier to manage. By pulling the harness a clip was broken or dislodged resulting in the harness not being correctly secured in the front left chassis rail / suspension turret area. In around 10% of affected units the harness makes contact with the transmission mount. The vibration of the transmission can cause the harness to be damaged. If the conductors are exposed this can result in a short circuit and blown fuse. Customer complaints are that the engine does not start and/or the wiper does not work. The engine does not start and/or the windscreen wipers do not work.
honda.remedy: The technician will carry out an inspection of the cabin harness and harness clip to determine the required repair: Replace harness clip if it is damaged/missing; Repair the cabin harness in the case of mild abrasion to the harness outer; Replace the cabin harness in the case of exposed conductors.

honda.defect: INCORRECT TORQUE SETTINGS ON GEAR CHANGE PIVOT BOLT MIGHT CAUSE LOOSENING DURING STRONG OPERATION Possible inappropriate tightening torque settings on the gear change pivot bolt.
honda.remedy: Replace the gear change bolt with a new bolt and apply locking agent.

honda.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY RUPTURE IF DEPLOYED Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the drivers airbag module.

honda.defect: REAR SUSPENSION LOWER ARM BOLTS COULD BREAK There is a possibility that the rear suspension lower arm bolt could break due to improper heat treatment. Vehicle handling and control would be reduced.
honda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace lower arm suspension bolts with quality assured type.

honda.defect: REAR WHEEL MAY LOCK-UP The drive shaft universal joint bearing may fail because it has not have been manufactured to specification which can lead to drive force being lost and in worst case scenario if the universal joint breaks it may interfere with the swing arm and cause the rear wheel to lock-up. This may result in a reduction in stability control and increase the risk of a crash.
honda.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the drive shaft.

honda.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY DECREASE MOMENTARILY The engine speed may decrease momentarily when quickly opening the throttle from the fully closed position to a slightly opened position.
honda.remedy: Update engine ECU software.

honda.defect: REAR SUSPENSION LOWER ARM BOLTS COULD BREAK There is a possibility that the rear suspension lower arm bolt could break due to improper heat treatment. Vehicle handling and control would be reduced.
honda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace lower arm suspension bolts with quality assured type.

honda.defect: TAKATA PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE Passenger airbag inflators may not operate as intended.
honda.remedy: Replacement of Airbag Assembly on affected vehicles.

honda.defect: AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the passenger's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment
honda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the passenger's air bag module.

honda.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK It has been identified that on affected machines equipped with a CBS - combined braking system the height of the lip seal within the Proportional Control Valve (PCV) unit may be incorrect which may result in brake fluid leakage. Should the machine be used in this condition the rear brake may eventually become inoperative.
honda.remedy: Potentially affected machines will be recalled inspected and rectified if necessary using a countermeasure Proportional Control Valve.

honda.defect: THE OIL PAN BOLTS ARE NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY On affected vehicles the oil pan bolt may become loose and in worst case fall out
honda.remedy: Carry out a torque check and make the necessary repair

honda.defect: POSSIBLE AIR BAG INFLATOR RUPTURE Driver air bag may not deploy correctly.
honda.remedy: The inflator inside the drivers airbag module is to be replaced.

honda.defect: RISK OF FIRE Water and other liquids may enter the driver's side power window switch and may cause damage switch failure overheating and potentially a fire.
honda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check switch and wiring if damaged replace and then fit external  cover to switch to prevent water ingress.

honda.defect: The positions of the conveyor bar and the seat were not properly managed causing interference between the conveyer bar and the headrest. As a result the headrest may bend forward and it may not be possible to protect occupants as intended which may lead to risk of injury. honda.defect: THE STRENGTH OF THE ENGINE CRANKSHAFT CONNECTING ROD MAY BE INSUFFICIENT The strength of the engine crankshaft connecting rod may be insufficient.
honda.remedy: Check the material number and where necessary a new replacement engine will be fitted.

honda.defect: IT MAY BE POSSIBLE TO RIDE THE MOTORCYCLE WITH THE SIDE STAND DOWN. An incorrectly welded pivot piece on the side stand may prevent the side stand cut out switch from operating.
honda.remedy: Recall likely to be affected machines and inspect the side stand where necessary a quality assured side stand will be fitted.

honda.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO INNER SIDEWALL OF TYRE It is possible that the tyre inner side wall may have been damaged during the tyre/wheel balance identification process. In the worst case the tyre could deflate when the car is being driven.
honda.remedy: Examine tyre side walls and replace any tyres found to have been damaged as a result of the wheel balancing operation.

honeywell.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the brake discs and where necessary replace the discs with ones of the correct specification.

humbaur.defect: EMERGENCY BRAKE MAY NOT FUNCTION During the manufacturing process a support bracket was omitted from the braking system. Without the bracket being in place the emergency brakes cannot be applied.
humbaur.remedy: Recall the trailers that are likely to be affected and fit a support bracket to the braking system.

hummer.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The control module for heater blower speed may overheat during prolonged use. The plastic body may melt and in extreme instances cause a fire.

HOOD LOUVER MAY DETACH It has been identified that the integral clip-tabs on the hood louver may fracture causing the hood louver to lose its retention mechanism. This will result in noise from the loss hood louver which should identify the issue to the driver. If this indicator is unnoticed then detachment could occur which could cause injury and/or property damage.
hummer.remedy: Apply an adhesive to the hood louver (hood air grill panel) to secure it to the hood.

husaberg.defect: THROTTLE MAY NOT RETURN TO IDLE Due to a production fault on the upper part of the throttle grip housing the throttle cable wire may slide out of the deflection roller and become wedged between the deflection roller and the housing. This blocks the throttle slide and may result in an uncontrollable riding situation.
husaberg.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the upper part of the hand throttle control housing the deflector roller and bronze bushing.

husqvarna.defect: A DEFECTIVE DRIVE TRAIN MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED A defective drive chain may have been installed.

husqvarna.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED Anomalies in the manufacturing process have resulted in certain batches of hand brake cylinders with defective machining. This can lead to early wear of the sealing cup in the hand brake cylinder thus leading to impaired braking performance.
husqvarna.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the batch number of the hand brake cylinder. If the batch number appears on the affected list replace the hand brake cylinder.

husqvarna.defect: SEAL OF THE CLUTCH SLAVE CYLINDER MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING ASSEMBLY Deviations on an assembly line may have caused damage to the seal of the clutch slave cylinder.
husqvarna.remedy: The clutch slave cylinders must be checked and if necessary replaced.�

husqvarna.defect: FRONT WHEEL MAY FAIL Due to variations in the spoke manufacturing process some spokes on the front wheel may exhibit quality deviations. Depending on where they are fitted in the wheel care and spoke tension it is possible that individual spokes may break while riding. This can overload the remaining intact spokes and consequently cause them to break which can affected the stability of the machine.
husqvarna.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the spokes that are fitted to the front wheel.

husqvarna.defect: PISTON ROD MAY DETACH The forks may not have been correctly assembled which could lead to initially knocking and the damping in the affected strut decreasing. If the condition is allowed to progress the inside of the fork will be damaged and the fork may seize.
husqvarna.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and remove the fork cap. Check the locking nut for correct torque and tighten if necessary.

husqvarna.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED Anomalies in the manufacturing process have resulted in certain batches of hand brake cylinders with defective machining. This can lead to early wear of the sealing cup in the hand brake cylinder thus leading to impaired braking performance.
husqvarna.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the batch number of the hand brake cylinder. If the batch number appears on the affected list replace the hand brake cylinder.

husqvarna.defect: THE BATTERY VENT VALVE MAY BE MISSING ON SOME VEHICLES The battery vent valve may be missing on some vehicles.
husqvarna.remedy: Check and install the vent or replace the battery as necessary.

husqvarna.defect: VEHIICLES MAY HAVE INCORRECTLY MOUNTED BRAKE PAD HOLDING BRACKET LOCKING SPLIT PINS Vehicles may have incorrectly mounted brake pad holding bracket locking split pins.
husqvarna.remedy: The brake pad holding bracket locking split pins on the front brake caliper must be inspected for correct assembly on all motorcycles affected.

husqvarna.defect: VEHIICLES MAY HAVE INCORRECTLY MOUNTED BRAKE PAD HOLDING BRACKET LOCKING SPLIT PINS Vehicles may have incorrectly mounted brake pad holding bracket locking split pins.
husqvarna.remedy: The brake pad holding bracket locking split pins on the front brake caliper must be inspected for correct assembly on all motorcycles affected.

husqvarna.defect: IMPROVED LOCKING SPLIT PINS FOR THE BRAKE PAD HOLDING BRACKETS IN THE FRONT AND REAR BRAKE CALIPERS ARE AVAILABLE Improved locking split pins for the brake pad holding brackets in the front and rear brake calipers are available
husqvarna.remedy: The brake pad retaining pin locking split pins on the front & rear brake calipers must be replaced for an improved version on all motorcycles affected

husqvarna.defect: DAMAGE OF THE GASKET MAY AFFECT THE FUNCTION OF THE CLUTCH SLAVE CYLINDER Damage to the seal caused by deviations in assembly may impair the function of the clutch slave cylinder.
husqvarna.remedy: Inspect the slave cylinder and check which part version is fitted to the motorcycle. Replace the unit if the affected part version is fitted.

husqvarna.defect: DISTORTION OF THE FUEL TANK MAY OCCUR ON THE SEALING SURFACES IN THE AREAS SURROUNDING THE FUEL PUMP AND THE FUEL LEVEL SENSOR Distortion of the fuel tank may occur on the sealing surfaces in the areas surrounding the fuel pump and the fuel level sensor.
husqvarna.remedy: Fuel tanks to be replaced with an improved component.

husqvarna.defect: VEHIICLES MAY HAVE INCORRECTLY MOUNTED BRAKE PAD HOLDING BRACKET LOCKING SPLIT PINS Vehicles may have incorrectly mounted brake pad holding bracket locking split pins.
husqvarna.remedy: The brake pad holding bracket locking split pins on the front brake caliper must be inspected for correct assembly on all motorcycles affected.

husqvarna.defect: RISK OF FIRE The M12 aluminium fuel pump nut may not be to specification. This can lead to insufficient sealing allowing fuel to leak. In extreme cases the leaking fuel can cause damage or fire.
husqvarna.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the M12 aluminium fuel pump nut. Where necessary the seal will also be replaced.

husqvarna.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Brake caliper assembly may be incomplete on the models referred to above due to deviations in manufacturing at our supplier. The anti-rattle plates and cotters may be missing. This may lead to problems on the brake caliper through to brake failure and therefore to serious consequential events
husqvarna.remedy: Check both brake calipers (front and rear) for completeness and in particular whether the anti-rattle plates cotters and pins are present and correctly mounted. If parts are missing then fully assemble with replacement parts  in accordance with the repair manual.

ineos.remedy: A physical inspection of each potentially affected vehicle will be performed. Any non-locking nuts found will be replaced with locking nuts as required.

infiniti.defect: Q50 (V37) M30/Q70 (Y51) Propeller Shaft On affected vehicles the propeller shaft does not meet Nissans' fatigue strength standards.
infiniti.remedy: Replace the propeller shaft on affected vehicles.

infiniti.defect: ANCHORAGE POINT MAY BE INCORRECTLY POSITIONED AND MAY NOT RESTRAIN THE PASSENGER Some vehicles may have an incorrectly assembled front seat belt with the right hand seat belt fitted on the left hand side or vice versa. This could cause the seat belt upper anchorage to be used at an incorrect angle; making it difficult for the customer to apply the seatbelt or slowing the retraction speed when removing the belt. In an extreme case the front seat belt may not restrain the front seat passenger.
infiniti.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and where necessary replace the front seat belts.

infiniti.defect: AN INCORRECT FATIGUE LIMIT WAS APPLIED TO THE PROPELLER SHAFT TUBE On affected vehicles an incorrect fatigue limit has been applied to the prop shaft tube.
infiniti.remedy: Change the prop shaft with a counter measure part.

infiniti.defect: AN INCORRECT FATIGUE LIMIT WAS APPLIED TO THE PROPELLER SHAFT TUBE On affected vehicles an incorrect fatigue limit has been applied to the prop shaft tube.
infiniti.remedy: Change the prop shaft with a counter measure part.

infiniti.defect: REAR SEAT BELT MAY NOT SECURE THE PASSENGER The rear seat buckle nuts may not be fully secure.  In this condition the seat belt buckle may make a rattle noise.  In an extreme case the nut may come off and the rear seat belts will not restrain the rear seat passengers.
infiniti.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and where necessary torque the rear seat belt buckles nuts.

infiniti.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY The steering column has no electrical connection to ground other than the spiral cable. In the event that the spiral cable is damaged the airbag warning light will illuminate. If the customer ignores the warning light and continues to drive for extended periods electrostatic charge may be discharged through the electrical circuit of the drivers airbag. In an extreme case this discharge could be sufficient to trigger an unintended deployment of the driver airbag.
infiniti.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a slip ring to the steering column on all potentially affected vehicles.

infiniti.defect: VEHICLE MAY CUT OUT It has been identified that due to a software error the traction motor inverter may incorrectly diagnose communication between the inverter and the transmission control module (TCM). This can cause the inverter system to suddenly shut down. If the vehicle is being driven in Electric Vehicle (EV i.e. engine off) the power to the electric motor may be cut resulting in the vehicle coming to a sudden stop.
infiniti.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to install new software for the traction motor inverter control module.

infiniti.defect: UNDER EXTREME CIRCUMSTANCES TRANSMISSION MAY DETACH It has been identified that due to an issue during the casting process of the front of the transmission casing the casting may become cracked during the release phase of the operation. If the vehicle is driven at high speed in this condition the crack can grow and cause a vibration. In an extreme case the transmission may detach from the vehicle.
infiniti.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the transmission casing for cracks and replace any transmission are found to be cracked.

infiniti.defect: UNINTENDED ACCELERATION It has been identified that under certain circumstances the throttle position sensor may send an error signal to the Engine Control Module (ECM). As a result the ECM may not operate as intended and the vehicle may accelerate gradually without the driver operating the throttle pedal. However this acceleration can be overridden by application of the brakes.
infiniti.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to install new software of the ECM.

infiniti.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY It has been identified that due to a manufacturing error at the airbag manufacturer the chemical composition of the initiator (the compound that triggers the airbag deployment) of a limited number of passenger airbag inflators may not be to specification.  Therefore it is possible that an affected airbag may not deploy in the event of an accident.
infiniti.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to have the affected airbags replace with a new quality assured component.

infiniti.defect: STEERING / DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED Due to incorrect software in the Direct Adaptive Steering  control unit the steering wheel may be off centre and driver's may interpret this as the  steering pulling to one side. The turning circle may also be increased.
infiniti.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogramme the  Direct Adaptive Steering  control unit

If t the vehicle continues to be driven engine oil could leak onto the road and the engine might stall due to low oil level.  In an extreme case and in the presence of an ignition source there may be an increased risk of a fire.
infiniti.remedy: On affected vehicles  replace the timing chain tensioner gasket with new.

isuzu.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the supply pump inspected for this condition. If no weeping or leakage is identified the connections will be tightened to an improved torque. If the condition is evident the supply pump will be replaced.

isuzu.defect: HORN MAY NOT OPERATE The wiring harness for the horn can be inappropriately routed. If the steering is continually operated this can result in failure of the wiring due to fatigue.
isuzu.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles inspect the wiring harness and rework the harness if required.

isuzu.defect: DILUTION OF ENGINE OIL LEADING TO ENGINE DAMAGE Due to excessive clearance within the fuel injectors fuel may leak into the cylinder bores and then into the sump causing engine oil dilution. If this situation is ignored engine damage can occur additionally the engine revs may show an unintentional increase.
isuzu.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the fuel injectors replaced.

isuzu.remedy: Dealers to check the two relays are in the correct location and if not then replace them both.
