isuzu.defect: POSSIBLE INSUFFICIENT TORQUE APPLIED TO THE RETAINING BOLTS OF THE PROPSHAFT AT EITHER TRANSMISSION OR DIFFERENTIAL FLANGES Possible  insufficient torque applied to the retaining bolts of the propshaft.
isuzu.remedy: Replace any bolts nuts or washers that may have already become detached and Re-torque the propshaft  retaining bolts.

isuzu.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY INCREASE UNINTENTIONALLY It is possible that the internal contact resistance of the crimped joints for the grounding between the throttle position sensor (TPS) and engine control module may increase due to engine vibration. This can lead to an increased TPS voltage output which could lead to an increase in engine revolutions whilst at idle without any throttle input.
isuzu.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the installation of a new wiring harness.

isuzu.defect: CERTIFICATE OF CONFORMITY CONTAINS INCORRECT CO2 AND FUEL ECONOMY VALUES The Certificate of Conformity (COC) paper contains the incorrect information.
isuzu.remedy: Request customer to return old COC paper and issue new corrected COC paper.

isuzu.defect: GEAR CHANGE MAY BE AFFECTED The gearbox  in auto shift mode may not smoothly shift down through the gears as road speed decreases.
isuzu.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to re-program the electronic control unit with the correct data.

iveco.defect: RISK OF INSTABILITY It is possible that the material used for the rear anti roll bar supports may be incorrect and could collapse causing serious stability concerns.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace both the rear anti roll bar supports.

iveco.defect: MCV MY24: VEHICLE WITH IC AEBS STEP1 AND 5G0 PERFORMED The manufacturer has determined that affected vehicles have both an earlier version and a later more advanced version of the AEBS control software installed. This co-occurrence may result in different information being displayed on the diagnostic dashboard and these differences could be mistakenly interpreted as an error or a failure of the AEBS
iveco.remedy: Instrument Cluster Software update.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE LACK OF COTTER PIN OR WRONG COTTER PIN ASSEMBLY ON STEERING AXLE Possible lack of cotter pin on steering axle or possible wrong cotter pin assembly on steering axle.
iveco.remedy: Check and re-torque the nut and replacement of the cotter pin on the steering track rod.

iveco.defect: The vehicle may potentially be affected by an air leakage from the trailer hose due to detachment of the hose from the trailer hose coupling. If this event occurs it may result in an unexpected brakes activation on the trailer only. The vehicle may potentially be affected by an air leakage from the trailer hose due to detachment of the hose from the trailer hose coupling. If this event occurs it may result in an unexpected brakes activation on the trailer only.�
iveco.remedy: Installing 2 security hose clamps on both trailer hoses to avoid the potential detachment of hose/hoses from the trailer hose coupling.�

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE AIR LEAK FROM BRAKE SYSTEM Air may leak from the brake system pipes at the foot valve to multi connection block on the cab.
iveco.remedy: Replace the four air pipes and the relevant quick connectors.

iveco.defect: LEAKAGE AT REAR AXLE HOSE CONNECTIONS Some models fitted with pneumatic suspension are equipped with rotatable connectors on the rear axle brake hose connections. These connectors may leak with an adverse effect on braking performance.
iveco.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of the connector type fitted and where necessary revise to  non-rotatable connectors

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERTENT APPLICATION OF PARKING BRAKE A steel ball used to seal an aperture in the parking brake control valve may become displaced and could result in inadvertent application of the parking brake.
iveco.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to be inspected for the make of parking brake valve fitted. A securing clamp will be fitted to all the affected units to prevent displacement of the ball.

iveco.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL The left hand front brake pipe may chafe against the shock absorber which if left could result in brake operation being endangered.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected check the condition and path of the left hand front brake pipe. If necessary re-route or replace the brake pipe.

iveco.defect: CAB MAY SHUDDER UNDER EXTREME OPERATING CONDITIONS Possibility that front Cab mounting bolts may be missing resulting in that Cab may shudder under extreme operating conditions.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit new Cab mounting bolts

iveco.defect: DURABILITY OF STEERING REVERSING LEVERS It has been decided to reinforce the steering linkage reversing levers to enhance long term durability.
iveco.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original steering levers with reinforced examples.

iveco.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Some vehicles may have been fitted incorrect specification flexible brake hoses which if not checked and replaced could lead to a brake failure.
iveco.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection of the flexible brake hoses and replacement if found to be out of specification.

iveco.defect: REPEATED INTERRUPTIONS OF THE PARTICULATE FILTER REGENERATION COULD LEAD TO OVERHEATING OF SURROUNDING COMPONENTS Repeated interruptions of the particulate filter regeneration could lead to overheating of surrounding components.
iveco.remedy: Engine software update

iveco.defect: BATTERY TO STARTER CABLE MAY FOUL ON EXHAUST SYSTEM. It is possible for the electrical cable between the battery and the starter motor to foul on the exhaust system.
iveco.remedy: Fasten the cable to the vehicle chassis with a dedicated bracket.

iveco.defect: There is the potential for the rear axle pinion flange nut to loosen over time. There is the potential for the rear axle pinion flange nut to loosen over time.
iveco.remedy: Inspect the condition of the pinion flange nut and if required rework the flange nut with the correct adjustment and crimping.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT CONNECTION OF ABS SENSING SYSTEM On vehicles equipped with ABS the sensor wires may be incorrectly connected. This could result in the sensing system failing to identify which wheel may be locking.
iveco.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of the wiring connections and system function. Any instances of incorrect wiring will be corrected.

iveco.defect: CONTROL RELAY MAY OVERHEAT It has been identified that if the incorrect type of cold start element is fitted frequent use under extreme weather conditions may lead to overheating of the control relay.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the part number of the cold start element checked which will be replaced as necessary.

iveco.defect: STEERING MAY BE AFFECTED Ingress of dirt into the steering shaft sliding joint will cause the splines to wear prematurely. As the joint wears play at the steering will become apparent and over time the play will increase leading to some pulsing when the steering wheel is turned and the vehicle wandering. If all these warning signs are ignored and the vehicle is still used there will be increased difficulty in maintaining steering control.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering shaft with a modified type.

iveco.defect: EXHAUST SILENCER RETAINING BOLTS MAY FAIL It is possible for the for the exhaust silencer strap bolts to slacken which if not rectified could lead to the total failure of the silencer mounting.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the mounting bolts with new pre-coated bolts (locking compound) and tighten to the correct torque.

iveco.defect: HEATER CONTROL UNIT MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT It is possible for the Grid Heater Control Unit not to function correctly and cause overheating of the units mounting compound.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a modified Engine Grid Heater Relay and bracket.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT CONTACTS IN THE CAD LOOM WILL OXIDIZE AND OVERHEAT THE CONNECTORS Possibility that contacts within the CAD loom may oxidize and cause overheating of the connectors
iveco.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles check the connectors and reposition them within the wiring loom.

iveco.defect: TRACK AND DROP ARM RETAINING BOLTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED The retaining bolts of the drop arm and track arms may not have been tightened to the correct torque. With the possibility that the bolts may become loose.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts tightened to the correct torque.

iveco.defect: ENGINE COULD BE STARTED FROM CHASSIS CONTROL WITH CAB TILTED AND TRANSMISSION IN DRIVE There is a possibility that the engine could be started from the chassis control with the cab tilted and the transmission in drive
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit start inhibitor cable

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE LACK OF COTTER PIN OR WRONG COTTER PIN ASSEMBLY ON STEERING AXLE Possible incorrect or missing cotter pin on steered axle joint.
iveco.remedy: Check and re-torque the nut and replacement of the cotter pin on the steering rod.

iveco.defect: REAR AXLE LEAF SPRING MOUNTING MAY CRACK It has been identified that on a limited number of vehicles the rear axle leaf spring mountings may crack or fracture. Should this occur vehicle stability could be affected.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected and repaired as required.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILE AIR LOSS FROM BRAKE SYSTEM There is the possibility of an air loss from the footbrake system due to corrosion in the pressure regulator APU valve (air dryer with four circuit safety valve].
iveco.remedy: To prevent corrosion in the pressure regulator APU a new rubber diaphragm will be fitted.

iveco.defect: STEERING MAY BE AFFECTED Steering control maybe affected by loose cab to chassis mountings.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary re-torque the bolts securing the cab to the chassis.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT BRAKE PIPE CONNECTIONS ON VEHICLES WITHOUT ABS There is a possibility that the brake pipes may have been incorrectly connected.  As a consequence failure in one hydraulic circuit may result in the vehicle veering to the left or right when the brakes are next applied.
iveco.remedy: Renew and reposition the  brake pipe connections to comply with the specification.

iveco.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the possibility exists; for the engine compartment cover seal to become dislodged during service. Should this occur the seal could fall onto the engine causing a fire.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the engine compartment cover seal checked for security and condition. It will be renewed as necessary or refitted using an adhesive.

iveco.defect: RISK OF FIRE During prolonged use the heater and air conditioning circuit fuse 21 (mini fuse) may overheat in the central fuse holder. Excessive overheating of the fuse can result in melting of the plastic fuse holder.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have fuse 21 replaced with a maxi fuse.

iveco.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL Possible fitting of a non-conforming fixing screw on the front axle of vehicles with Mecbal suspension systems. If the non-conforming screws are fitted in the worst case it is possible that the front axle could become insecure and the control of the vehicle lost.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to carry out checks of fixing screws and replace where necessary.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE SLACKENING OF TOWING HOOK CROSS MEMBER RETAINING NUTS There is a possibility of slackening of the towing hook cross member retaining nuts
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the cross beam retaining bolts & nuts and the towing hook securing nuts.

iveco.defect: (1) FRONT BRAKE FLEXIBLE HOSES MAY LEAK FLUID (2) COLD START SYSTEM WIRING MAY OVERHEAT (1) Front brake flexible hoses are not to the specification consequently they may leak hydraulic fluid. (2) Engine cold start system wiring may overheat with a consequential fire risk.
iveco.remedy: (1) Fit new front brake hoses. (2) Modify the cold start system control.

iveco.defect: The Front axle leave spring retainers (U-Bolts) could work loose or may be lost during a driving cycle. The Front axle leave spring retainers (U-Bolts) could work loose or may be lost during a driving cycle.
iveco.remedy: Retighten front axle U-Bolt with an increased torque

iveco.defect: STEERING CYLINDER CLAMP BOLTS WILL NOT ACHIEVE CORRECT TORQUE It is not possible to obtain the correct torque on the steering ram and cylinder ball joint clamp bolts. Therefore after a certain time it might be possible for the ball joint to become loose on its threads.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected. Replace the nuts and bolts that clamp the ball joints to the ram and cylinder and tighten them to the correct torque.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILITY OF  EARTH LEAD TERMINAL IN CAB COMING LOOSE There is a possibility of the wiring terminal to the earth lead connections in the cab coming loose. This could cause intermittent electrical faults.
iveco.remedy: Check and where necessary tighten the earth connection.

iveco.defect: BREAKAGE OF EXTERNAL SUN VISOR Due to faults in the shape and dimensions of the sun visor during production tensions can occur following fitting to the cab and can cause the visor to break.
iveco.remedy: Modify the sun visor mountings by using a new tension free mounting bracket.

iveco.defect: A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE ABS CAN OCCUR WITHOUT WARNING WHEN THE ENGINE IS SWITCHED OFF A short circuit in the ABS can occur without warning when the engine is switched off.
iveco.remedy: Installing of a switch off relays to interrupt the power supply to the ABS ECU in vehicle key off condition.

iveco.defect: THE NOX EMISSION LEVELS  ARE HIGHER THAN APPROVAL LIMITS DECLARED AND REPEATED INTERRUPTIONS OF THE PARTICULATE FILTER REGENERATION COULD LEAD TO OVERHEATING OF SURROUNDING COMPONENTS The Nox emission levels are higher than approval limits declared and repeated interruptions of the particulate filter regeneration could lead to overheating of surrounding components.
iveco.remedy: Engine software update.

iveco.defect: PROPSHAFT MAY FAIL. The propshaft may fail due to a production fault.
iveco.remedy: Check the production date on the propshaft and replace where found necessary.

iveco.defect: REAR WHEELS MAY LOCK Operation of automatic engine brake switch may cause the rear wheels to lock on unladen vehicles not fitted with ABS.
iveco.remedy: Recall potentially affected vehicles and remove the automatic engine braking control switch.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERTENT APPLICATION OF PARKING BRAKE A steel ball used to seal an aperture in the parking brake control valve may become displaced and could result in inadvertent application of the parking brake.
iveco.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to be inspected for the make of parking brake valve fitted. A securing clamp will be fitted to all the affected units to prevent displacement of the ball.

iveco.defect: POWER STEERING PIPE CONCERN. Power steering flexible return hose may chafe on the engine crankshaft pulley.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a bracket to hold the return hose away from the pulley.

iveco.defect: The vehicle may potentially be affected by an air leakage from the trailer hose due to detachment of the hose from the trailer hose coupling. If this event occurs it may result in an unexpected brakes activation on the trailer only. The vehicle may potentially be affected by an air leakage from the trailer hose due to detachment of the hose from the trailer hose coupling. If this event occurs it may result in an unexpected brakes activation on the trailer only.�
iveco.remedy: Installing 2 security hose clamps on both trailer hoses to avoid the potential detachment of hose/hoses from the trailer hose coupling.�

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DRIVE AND LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL. It has been identified that due to insufficient clearance between the prop shaft centre bearing flange and the cross member a foul condition may exist between the two. It is therefore possible that the flange could break with possible loss of drive and vehicle control.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with new nuts and bolts and additional spacers fitted under the centre bearing which will give increased clearance between the prop shaft flange and the cross member.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT ANTIROLL BAR DOES NOT COMPLY WITH MATIERIAL REQUIREMENTS The Antiroll Bar may not comply with material requirements
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and on those with manufacturing dates of 03-21/03 - 25/03-35 replace bar.

iveco.defect: REAR AXLE SPRING SUPPORT BRACKET MAY CRACK There is a possibility that the rear axle spring support brackets may crack which could affect the vehicle's stability.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the welding of the spring support brackets checked for cracks. Should any cracking be found the drive axle casing will be changed.

iveco.defect: PROPSHAFT MAY CONTACT AXLE BEAM Under certain circumstances it is possible that the distance between the propshaft and the second front axle may be insufficient. Should axle/propshaft contact be made damage to one or both of these components might ensue.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the clearance between the propshaft and the second front axle beam checked. Should the clearance be outside of the specified parameters the suspension will be adjusted.

iveco.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel pipes may fail causing a leakage of fuel.
iveco.remedy: Replace all engine fuel pipes

iveco.defect: A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE ABS CAN OCCUR WITHOUT WARNING WHEN THE ENGINE IS SWITCHED OFF A short circuit in the ABS can occur without warning when the engine is switched off.
iveco.remedy: Installing of a switch off relays to interrupt the power supply to the ABS ECU in vehicle key off condition.

iveco.defect: REAR AXLE MAY NOT BE SECURE Incorrectly fitted panhard rod mounting bolts may fail and lead to the rear axle developing lateral movement.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit new panhard rod mounting bolts to the correct torque.

iveco.defect: CONTAMINATED AIR MAY BE DRAWN INTO INTAKE SYSTEM There is a possibility that contaminated air may be drawn into the engine air intake system (eg Cigarette ends)
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a protective grille over air intake pipe.

iveco.defect: REAR AXLE LEAF SPRING U-BOLTS MAY FAIL. It has been identified that the possibility exists that the rear axle leaf spring U-bolts may break. A situation which could affect vehicle stability.
iveco.remedy: The U-bolts of affected vehicles will be checked for dimensional compliance and changed as necessary.

iveco.defect: THE ENGINE WIRING HARNESS MAY FOUL THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD The engine wiring harness may  foul the exhaust manifold
iveco.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the routing of the engine wiring harness will be modified to prevent fouling on the exhaust manifold.

iveco.defect: There is a potential that breakage of the steering lever brackets may occur due to defective welds. There is a potential that breakage of the steering lever brackets may occur due to defective welds.
iveco.remedy: Replace the steering lever bracket.

iveco.defect: SERVICE BRAKE CONTROL VALVE The service brake foot control valve may be defective. This could result in the loss of both braking circuits.
iveco.remedy: Recall the defective vehicles to check the subject valve. Defective valves will be replaced with a new unit.

iveco.defect: STEERING CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE MAY BE LOST The Track Rod clamping bracket gaps may have closed before the correct torque has been reached which may allow the track rod to gradually work loose.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if action is required new clamping brackets will be fitted and bolts tightened to correct torque.

iveco.defect: FRONT AXLE COULD BE OUT OF ALIGNMENT It has been identified that the possibility exists that the front spring spacer plate position may be incorrectand the U bolts may not have been tightened to the correct torque setting.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the position of the spacer plate checked. The spacer plate will be renewed if found to be incorrectly positioned. In addition the torque of the front spring U bolts will be checked.

iveco.defect: NO WARNING SIGNAL TO THE DRIVER WHEN TRAILER DIRECTION INDICATOR LAMPS FAIL. It has been identified that the possibility exists that the driver will not receive a warning signal should the trailer direction indicator lamp/s fail.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the trailer lighting control unit replaced.

iveco.defect: STEERING BOLTS MAY FOUL OTHER COMPONENTS It has been identified that the swivel head on the hydraulic operating cylinder for the second steer axle may not have been installed to IVECO's specification.  This can cause fouling of other components which may affect the directional control of the vehicle.
iveco.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required reposition the hydraulic operating cylinder swivel head.

iveco.defect: REAR BRAKE PERFORMANCE MAY NOT BE AS EXPECTED It is possible in an emergency braking situation with fully laden vehicle the rear axle brakes will not be applied as expected giving a rise of extended braking distance.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the brake pressure regulator type fitted to the vehicle is the same as that list on the vehicle plate. If necessary fit a new plate. Check and if necessary adjust the load sensing valve linkage.

iveco.defect: RISK OF FIRE It has been identified that the possibility exists for the exhaust silencer to fail which can lead to overheating of a wiring harness.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the exhaust silencer replaced and a heat shield fitted to the subject wiring harness.

iveco.defect: Mounting screws of the steering box may become loose The mounting screws of the steering rack may become loose.
iveco.remedy: Replace the fastening screws of the hydraulic steering rack assembly to the front driving axle including an additional application of specific Loctite adhesive 243 to the securing screws.

iveco.defect: CAB MAY TILT WITHOUT WARNING On vehicles equipped with electric cab tilting mechanism it is possible that water may enter the control relay for the system. This can cause a short circuit in the pump control relay which will operate the tilt pump and if the driver has failed to leave the control valve in the lowered position then an involuntary tilting of the cab may occur.
iveco.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the fitment of a water tight protection to be fitted to the control relay.

iveco.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel pipes may fail causing a leakage of fuel.
iveco.remedy: Replace all engine fuel pipes

iveco.defect: INCORRECT MONITORING OF THE UREA TANK TEMPERATURE AND INSUFFICIENT PROTECTION OF THE ENGINE DATASET IN CASE OF TAMPERING. Incorrect monitoring of the urea tank temperature and Insufficient protection of the engine dataset in case of tampering.
iveco.remedy: Update of the ECU through a new software and update of the calibration software of the diagnosis of the urea tank temperature sensor.

iveco.defect: FRONT BRAKE HOSE CONNECTIONS MAY BE INCORRECTLY FITTED Front brake hoses may have been incorrectly fitted. This could result in an air leak when the footbrake is applied.
iveco.remedy: Check brake hose connections for tightness and leaks. Rectify where necessary.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF CHASSIS AROUND TOW HOOK MOUNTING Possible fracture of chassis around tow hook mounting.
iveco.remedy: Replace existing chassis reinforcements with new ones.

iveco.defect: INCORRECT MONITORING OF THE UREA TANK TEMPERATURE AND INSUFFICIENT PROTECTION OF THE ENGINE DATASET IN CASE OF TAMPERING. Incorrect monitoring of the urea tank temperature and Insufficient protection of the engine dataset in case of tampering.
iveco.remedy: Update of the ECU through a new software and update of the calibration software of the diagnosis of the urea tank temperature sensor.

iveco.defect: INDICATORS MAY FAIL There is a possibility that the side repeater lamps may not work.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and reprogramme the computer to allow the side repeater lamps to activate.

iveco.defect: TANDEM BRAKE SERVO OPERATION The hydraulic seals in the tandem brake servo may have been damaged. This could adversely affect the efficiency of the service brake.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicle range and check/replace the tandem brake servo with a quality assured unit.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE WATER INGRESS INTO CAB TILT RELAY BOX Ingress of water into the cab tilt relay box may corrode the electrical connections and impair the effectiveness of the tilt locking system.
iveco.remedy: Move the relay box from the bottom flange of the chassis to the inside of the chassis frame.

iveco.defect: BOLTS USED TO SECURE STEERING RACK TO FRONT AXLE MAY FAIL. The possibility exists that the bolts which secure the steering rack to the front axle may be of the incorrect grade 8.8 instead of R10. A situation which may result in failure of the bolts.
iveco.remedy: The bolts of recalled vehicles will be checked for compliance with the specification and changed as necessary.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILITY FOR ABS WARNING LIGHT NOT TO ILLUMINATE IF CIRCUIT FAULT OCCURS The possibility exists for the ABS warning lamp not to illuminate despite there being a fault in the circuit
iveco.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and update instrument cluster with new software

iveco.defect: IN A COLLISION THE REAR BUMPER MAY NOT PERFORM AS INTENDED Bolts may be missing from the rear bumper support brackets which in a collision may cause the bumper not to function as intended and result in additional injuries.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary restore the correct fastening of the rear bumper support brackets.

iveco.defect: EMERGENCY BRAKING SYSTEM MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE There is a possibility that the airlines have been connected incorrectly which may lead to the emergency braking system becoming inoperative.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the airline position of the airline connections. If the connections are incorrect they will be connected to the correct positions.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE CAB TILTING CYLINDER BRACKET MAY DEFORM The possibility exists that the bracket which carries the cab tilt cylinder may deform. This can lead to unforeseen dropping of the cab when in the tilted position.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the relevant bracket inspected and repaired/modified as dictated by the Iveco Market Help Desk. In all cases the lift mechanism hydraulic pressure will be reduced from 370 to 310 bar.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILE AIR LOSS FROM BRAKE SYSTEM There is the possibility of an air loss from the footbrake system due to corrosion in the pressure regulator APU valve (air dryer with four circuit safety valve].
iveco.remedy: To prevent corrosion in the pressure regulator APU a new rubber diaphragm will be fitted.

iveco.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION BALL JOINTMAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION Front suspension ball joint may not be to specification.
iveco.remedy: Check the front suspension ball joint play and if necessary replace the component.

iveco.defect: SIDE MARKER LIGHTS DO NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY It is possible that the side lights may extinguish within 30 seconds of the ignition being turned off even when the side lights have been selected. This could affect vehicle visibility during darkness.
iveco.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check side light function and if required modify the electrical wiring in the CVM unit.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERTENT OPERATION OF DRIVERS SEAT Air suspension driver's seat may inadvertently operate incorrectly positioning the driver in relation to the vehicle controls.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to change the control system on the drivers seat.

iveco.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel pipes may fail causing a leakage of fuel.
iveco.remedy: Replace all engine fuel pipes

iveco.defect: THE CONTACTS IN THE CAB LOOM MAY OXIDIZE AND OVERHEAT POSSIBILITY OF FIRE. It has been identified that the possibility exists that the contacts in the cab wiring loom may oxidize and cause overheating of the connector block. In the worst case this may result in a fire.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the suspect wires removed from the connector block. Theses will then be reconnected using heat shrink terminals.

iveco.defect: CAB MAY SHUDDER WHICH MAY AFFECT STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that an insufficient tightening torque mat have been applied to the bolts of the cab to chassis front mountings. This can cause the mounting  bolts to work loose and the cab to shudder which may affect steering control.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cab front mounting bolts checked for the correct tightening torque.

iveco.defect: ABS MAY NOT FUNCTION The wiring to the ABS modulator unit may chafe which could result in the ABS system not functioning and the ABS warning lamp illuminating.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the wiring. Where neccessary repair the wiring and in all cases fit a protective sleeve to the wiring.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY It has been identified that the possibility exists that the Duo-Duplex brake adjusting mechanism may non operate correctly. Should this be the case possible loss of front and rear brake adjustment may occur which can result in loss of braking efficiency on both the service and parking brake systems.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake stations of both the front and rear axles fitted with a modified brake adjuster kit.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE  OF LOSS OF POWER STEERING The possibility exists that power steering may be lost due to chafing of the power steering fluid pipes.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with clips; and a spacer to separate the power steering fluid pipes.

iveco.defect: Modification of the front axle brake lines The manufacturer has determined that affected vehicles may be fitted with a front-axle braking system that does not fully comply with the regulatory authority’s requirements.
iveco.remedy: Modification and optimisation of front axle brake lines on 4x2 vehicles.

iveco.defect: LOSS OF STEERING Steering control could be lost on vehicles that have been fitted with non-quality assured steering column shafts.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary replace the steering column shaft.

iveco.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY NOT PERFORM AS INTENDED On affected vehicles the eyelet connection of the parking brake secondary cable could break. If this happens the parking brake function can be affected
iveco.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace cables.

iveco.defect: REAR BRAKE CALIPER FASTENERS The rear brake caliper retaining bolts may have been under torqued.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the tightness of the relevant bolts. Renew any bolts found to be under torqued.

iveco.defect: There is the potential for the rear axle pinion flange nut to loosen over time. There is the potential for the rear axle pinion flange nut to loosen over time.
iveco.remedy: Inspect the condition of the pinion flange nut and if required rework the flange nut with the correct adjustment and crimping.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE IMBALANACE IN BRAKING EFFICIENCY There is a possibility that a braking imbalance may occur due to the fitment of an incorrect sized brake cylinder.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and replace if required a brake cylinder.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT CONTAMINATED AIR CAN BE DRAWN INTO INTAKE SYSTEM There is a possibility that contaminated air maybe drawn into the engine air intake system (eg Cigarette ends)
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a protective grille over the air intake pipe

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERTENT APPLICATION OF PARKING BRAKE A steel ball used to seal an aperture in the parking brake control valve may become displaced and could result in inadvertent application of the parking brake.
iveco.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to be inspected for the make of parking brake valve fitted. A securing clamp will be fitted to all the affected units to prevent displacement of the ball.

iveco.defect: DRIVERS SEAT RESTRAINT MECHANISM MAY FAIL The stitching of the driver's seat shock absorber retaining belt may fail allowing unrestrained movement of the seat. This could impair the driver's control of the vehicle.
iveco.remedy: Fit a retaining belt that complies with the approved specification.

iveco.defect: VEHICLE MAY BECOME UNSTABLE It is possible that under certain conditions the Momentum Stability Regulator (MSR) may not engage if the vehicle is driven too harshly. This could have an adverse affect on the stability of the vehicle and an unexperienced driver may loss control of the vehicle.
iveco.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and upload a new version of the software.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE PRESENCE OF INCORRECT BRACKET AND BUFFER ON REAR SUSPENSION The manufacturer has determined that affected vehicles may have missing or incorrect rear suspension brackets and buffer installed onto the vehicle. This could result in increased roll with a possible loss of control that could result in a roll-over of the vehicle in extreme cases.
iveco.remedy: The remedial action is to replace the bracket with correct buffer.

iveco.defect: ABS CABLE INVERSION ON FRONT AXLE BRAKE CONVERTERS 75E-100E (AOH) On affected vehicles the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) connections to the front wheels maybe be inverted this may result in an increased stopping distance and/or reduced vehicle stability control during braking that requires ABS intervention.
iveco.remedy: Check and reposition ABS cable connectors as required.

iveco.defect: Fixation of the steering gearbox on the frame Affected vehicles may have been built with a fixation of the steering gearbox on the frame which can get loose due to an incorrect tightening torque.
iveco.remedy: Inspection of the steering gearbox fixation and a potential retightening or a substitution of the steering gearbox including the support and screws.

iveco.defect: Fixation of the steering gearbox on the frame Affected vehicles may have been built with a fixation of the steering gearbox on the frame which can get loose due to an incorrect tightening torque.
iveco.remedy: Inspection of the steering gearbox fixation and a potential retightening or a substitution of the steering gearbox including the support and screws.

iveco.defect: INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF THE REAR AXLE SHAFT SCREWS On affected vehicles the half shaft screws to rear axle may not be properly tightened. The screws could therefore loosen up to a partial or total decoupling of the half-shaft from the rear axle with possible loss of direction and control of the vehicle.
iveco.remedy: Re-tightening of the screws of the rear axle half shafts to the required value.

iveco.defect: MCV MY24: VEHICLES WITH AEBS IC STEP1 AND IMPROVED ADAS PERFORMANCE ​Affected vehicles may have both an earlier version and a later more advanced version of the AEBS control software installed. This co-occurrence may result in different information being displayed on the diagnostic dashboard and these differences could be mistakenly interpreted as an error or a failure of the AEBS.
iveco.remedy: ​​Software update of all control units involved in the operation of ADAS systems.​

iveco.defect: Modification of the front axle brake lines The manufacturer has determined that affected vehicles may be fitted with a front-axle braking system that does not fully comply with the regulatory authority’s requirements.
iveco.remedy: Modification and optimisation of front axle brake lines on 4x2 vehicles.

iveco.defect: BALL PIN NOT HARDENED Following a process carried out by the supplier of the ball joints mounted on the steering transverse tie rod [track rod tube] and in order to protect end customers and guarantee the highest quality standards IVECO has decided to launch a recall campaign.
iveco.remedy: The remedy is to replace the track rod assembly with new ball joint ends OR drag link assembly depending on vehicle configuration.

iveco.defect: The Front axle leave spring retainers (U-Bolts) could work loose or may be lost during a driving cycle. The Front axle leave spring retainers (U-Bolts) could work loose or may be lost during a driving cycle.
iveco.remedy: Retighten front axle U-Bolt with an increased torque

iveco.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE COMPROMISED Due to continuous quality control it has shown on a limited number of vehicles it may be necessary to replace a component of the brake valve EBS2 in order to ensure perfect efficiency of the braking system.Failure to replace the component described could compromise the correct operation of the braking system.
iveco.remedy: Replacement of the relay piston / sealing ring on the brake value of the EBS2 (CBU) tractor.

iveco.defect: The Front axle leave spring retainers (U-Bolts) could work loose or may be lost during a driving cycle. The Front axle leave spring retainers (U-Bolts) could work loose or may be lost during a driving cycle.
iveco.remedy: Retighten front axle U-Bolt with an increased torque

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE LACK OF COTTER PIN OR WRONG COTTER PIN ASSEMBLY ON STEERING AXLE Possible incorrect or missing cotter pin on steered axle joint.
iveco.remedy: Check and re-torque the nut and replacement of the cotter pin on the steering rod.

iveco.defect: Potential damage to the front brake hose caused by an incorrect layout of the pipes and / or by the wiring provided for the optional EPB (Electronic Park Brake)  / TPMS (Tyre Pressure Monitoring System) with consequent possibility of gradual loss of efficiency of the braking system Potential damage to the front brake hose caused by an incorrect layout of the pipes
iveco.remedy: Visual check on the condition of the flexible pipe located in the area on the left front wheel side and in case of interference with the electric cable the pipe will be to be repositioned or replaced if worn / damaged.

iveco.defect: EXHAUST GAS TEMPERATURES MAY DROP BELOW THE OPTIMAL OPERATIONAL LEVEL Exhaust gas temperatures may drop below the optimal operational level for the selective catalyst reduction affecting its efficiency when reducing nitrogen oxides.
iveco.remedy: Engine software update

iveco.defect: DRIVERS CAB MAY COLLAPSE WHEN TILTED The drivers cab tilt cylinder support bracket may fail resulting in the cab collapsing when tilted.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the support bracket with a modified type.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILE AIR LOSS FROM BRAKE SYSTEM There is the possibility of an air loss from the footbrake system due to corrosion in the pressure regulator APU valve (air dryer with four circuit safety valve].
iveco.remedy: To prevent corrosion in the pressure regulator APU a new rubber diaphragm will be fitted.

iveco.defect: CAB SIDE MEMBER MAY DEFORM It has been identified that the cab lower side member may become deformed due to excessive hydraulic tilt pump pressure.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cab tilt pump pressure reduced to 310 bar. Should the cab side member be deformed a repair to rectify this will be carried out.

iveco.defect: TRACK AND DROP ARM RETAINING BOLTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED The retaining bolts of the drop arm and track arms may not have been tightened to the correct torque. With the possibility that the bolts may become loose.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts tightened to the correct torque.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILE AIR LOSS FROM BRAKE SYSTEM There is the possibility of an air loss from the footbrake system due to corrosion in the pressure regulator APU valve (air dryer with four circuit safety valve].
iveco.remedy: To prevent corrosion in the pressure regulator APU a new rubber diaphragm will be fitted.

iveco.defect: A FRAME RETAINING SCREWS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TORQUED On a number of vehicles the torque setting value of the retaining screws of the A frame guide rod joint to the  axle could be wrong.
iveco.remedy: Checks to be carried out to ensure that the correct torque is applied.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO BRAKES The brake vacuum pump body may fracture or the vanes break up causing seizure that results in loss of vacuum assistance for the brake system.
iveco.remedy: Replace the original vacuum pump with a latest level quality assured unit.

iveco.defect: POSSIBILITY OF WATER INGRESS INTO ADR BATTERY RELAY The possibility exists that water may ingress the ADR battery main relay. This may cause corrosion and the engine to stall.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a new battery connecting lead.

iveco.defect: DRIVERS CAB MAY COLLAPSE WHEN TILTED The drivers cab tilt cylinder support bracket may fail resulting in the cab collapsing when tilted.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the support bracket with a modified type.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF STEERING ARM FIXING BOLTS The bolts securing the steering arms to the stub axles may not have been sufficiently torqued at initial assembly. Should these bolts loosen this could lead to eventual loss of steering control.
iveco.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the torque of the steering arm fixing bolts. Where this is found to be insufficient the bolts will be inspected and if necessary renewed.

iveco.defect: EXHAUST GAS TEMPERATURES MAY DROP BELOW THE OPTIMAL OPERATIONAL LEVEL Exhaust gas temperatures may drop below the optimal operational level for the selective catalyst reduction affecting its efficiency when reducing nitrogen oxides.
iveco.remedy: Engine software update

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF ENGINE PERFORMANCE There is a possibility of loss of engine performance
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and reprogramme new software for Engine Control unit

iveco.defect: INDICATORS MAY FAIL There is a possibility that the side repeater lamps may not work.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and reprogramme the computer to allow the side repeater lamps to activate.

iveco.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel pipes may fail causing a leakage of fuel.
iveco.remedy: Replace all engine fuel pipes

iveco.defect: WHEEL NUT SPIGOT WASHERS MAY CRACK. The integral washer on the wheel retaining nuts may crack at maximum torque. The subject nuts have all been supplied by one of two manufacturers.
iveco.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles will be recalled. Those identified as having the subject wheel nuts will have the nuts replaced with quality assured versions.

iveco.defect: THE HEATED WINDSCREEN FUSES MAY OVERHEAT There is insufficient surface area on the removable link between the two 30 amp heated windscreen fuses. This can resulting in the fuses being overheated.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a new connection made between the fuse holder pins.

iveco.defect: There is the potential for the rear axle pinion flange nut to loosen over time. There is the potential for the rear axle pinion flange nut to loosen over time.
iveco.remedy: Inspect the condition of the pinion flange nut and if required rework the flange nut with the correct adjustment and crimping.

iveco.defect: INSECURITY OF CAB TOP AND SIDE SPOILER BRACKET It is possible that the cab top and side spoiler brackets may not be securely bonded (glued) to the cab structure.
iveco.remedy: Check the glued mountings on the top and side spoiler with a spring balance to 40-50 kg. If the bond fails reglue the brackets as per the manufacturer's instructions.

iveco.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY DECREASE On-going research and quality checks have revealed that vehicles  may be affected by possible interference between the brake hoses and the gearbox leading to potential brake hose abrasions and dispersion of brake fluid with decreased braking efficiency.
iveco.remedy: Vehicles will be inspected and brake hoses checked for damage.  The retaining clips will be repositioned and if required brake hoses replaced.

iveco.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY NOT ENGAGED CORRECTLY The hand brake release button can become detached from the ratchet control rod which prevents the pawl at the rear of the lever from engaging the ratchet. the hand brake must then be applied by the driver holding the lever in the engaged position.
iveco.remedy: Two solutions have been developed.  a. re-fitment of using high strength loctite adhesive.  b. Replacement of the button.

iveco.defect: STEERING COLUMN SHAFT MAY BE INCORRECT LENGTH An incorrect length steering column shaft may have been fitted during manufacture.
iveco.remedy: Check the length of the column shaft and replace where  necessary.

iveco.defect: ENGINE COLD START SYSTEM WIRING MAY OVERHEAT. The engine cold start system wiring may overheat resulting in a fire risk.
iveco.remedy: Modify the cold start system control.

iveco.defect: RISK OF INSTABILITY It is possible that the material used for the rear anti roll bar supports may be incorrect and could collapse causing serious stability concerns.
iveco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace both the rear anti roll bar supports.

iveco.defect: POSSIBLE WATER INGRESS ON FRONT BRAKE CYLINDER The front brake cylinder may have been installed with the chamber breather hole uppermost. This could lead to the ingress of water and subsequent corrosion of the brake cylinder.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and renew all front brake cylinders installed with the breather holes uppermost.

iveco.defect: POOR PERFORMANCE OF THE FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM Poor performance of the fuel injection system due to a fuel contamination (not linked with a quality of the fuel itself).
iveco.remedy: Replacement of the fuel filter cartridge increasing the filtration system and testing the injectors. In case of checks with negative result the electro-injectors will be replaced.

iveco.defect: There is the potential for the rear axle pinion flange nut to loosen over time. There is the potential for the rear axle pinion flange nut to loosen over time.
iveco.remedy: Inspect the condition of the pinion flange nut and if required rework the flange nut with the correct adjustment and crimping.

iveco.defect: AIR INGRESS INTO BRAKING SYSTEM In some cases a sealing plug in a connector to the braking system has permitted the ingress of air into the hydraulic fluid during the recuperation stroke.
iveco.remedy: All affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the subject connector.

iveco.defect: PNEUMATIC SUSPENSION COULD FAIL On-going product and quality checks have shown that there may be defects in the Air suspension supports.
iveco.remedy: Check the supports for the air bellow manufacturing and casting numbers and replace i required.

iveco.defect: THE HEATED WINDSCREEN FUSES MAY OVERHEAT There is insufficient surface area on the removable link between the two 30 amp heated windscreen fuses. This can resulting in the fuses being overheated.
iveco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a new connection made between the fuse holder pins.

iveco.defect: REAR BRAKE CALIPER FASTENERS The rear brake caliper retaining bolts may have been under torqued.
iveco.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the tightness of the relevant bolts. Renew any bolts found to be under torqued.

iveco.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL TO FUNCTION CORRECTLY It has been identified that the parking brake cables may be incorrectly located in the vicinity of the rear suspension leaf spring. In this condition the functionality of the parking brake may be compromised.

iveco.remedy: To replace the defective rear shock absorber bottom support bracket  within the listed chassis range with support brackets of correct conformity.

This condition could potentially not be highlighted in the vehicle as the specific warning light could not be activated.
iveco.remedy: The cluster reprogramming rectifies the issue and ensures that even in particular conditions the information is correctly displayed through the warning light in the cluster.

jack.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the kingpins.

jaecoo.remedy: To address this issue authorised dealers are required to inspect the driveshaft nut locking condition on all affected vehicles. Where any non conformity is identified corrective measures shall be undertaken in accordance with Omoda and Jaecoo UK Limited s technical instructions.

jaecoo.defect: Jaecoo 7 - Wiring Harness Incorrect Routing On a specific batch of vehicles the drivers seat wiring harness may not have been routed correctly which over time may cause it to wear or become damaged. This may stop the seat adjustment working illuminate warning lights cause a loss of the ability to change gear and in rare cases lead to unexpected engine stalling while driving increasing the risk of a collision.
jaecoo.remedy: Carry out the required inspection of the drivers seat wiring harness and inspect its condition. If necessary the wiring harness will be rerouted and any damage to the insulation repaired.

jaecoo.defect: Jaecoo 7 - Wiring Harness Incorrect Routing On a specific batch of vehicles the drivers seat wiring harness may not have been routed correctly which over time may cause it to wear or become damaged. This may stop the seat adjustment working illuminate warning lights cause a loss of the ability to change gear and in rare cases lead to unexpected engine stalling while driving increasing the risk of a collision.
jaecoo.remedy: Carry out the required inspection of the drivers seat wiring harness and inspect its condition. If necessary the wiring harness will be rerouted and any damage to the insulation repaired.

jaecoo.defect: Jaecoo 7 ICE (T1EJ) - Wiring Harness Interference Issue We have recently identified an issue concerning the Electronic Control Unit wiring harness clip in a specific batch of vehicles. Our investigation found that the ECU harness clip was not fully engaged during the assembly process. The incomplete engagement of the ECU harness clip may lead to engine warning light and an unexpected engine stall while the vehicle is in motion thereby increasing the risk of a crash.
jaecoo.remedy: ​​For vehicles within the risk scope a recall will be initiated and provide free inspection and repair for all affected vehicles. The solution includes checking and ensuring the correct installation of the harness fastener and replacing any worn harness if necessary.​

jaguar.defect: I-PACE High Voltage battery loose busbar fixings On affected vehicles the fasteners for the battery module to module electrical connecting busbars may not be sufficiently secure.
jaguar.remedy: The busbar fixings will be inspected and as required new components installed.

Jaguar Land Rover is offering owners guidance on how to maximise vehicle security and protect against theft
