lti.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL The brake disc to hub mount bolts may be loose which could when the brakes are applied cause judder and noisy braking. This could eventually result in the failure of the retaining bolts and ultimately the disc being detached from the hub.
lti.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit new bolts with loctite applied and torque the disc to hub fixing bolts to specification.

lti.defect: WATER PUMP PULLEY MAY SHEAR FROM ITS BOSS The water pump pulley may shear from it's boss and cause failure of the drive to the brake vacuum and power steering  pumps. This will result in a loss of power assistance to the brakes and steering systems.
lti.remedy: Modify the water pump pulley mounting arrangement.

lti.defect: FAILURE OF ELECTRICAL SUPPLY The starter motor terminal may fail causing interruption in the feed to various other electrical circuits. Such a failure would immobilise the vehicle and render the lighting system inoperative.
lti.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for modifications to the wiring which will prevent such an interruption from occurring.

lti.defect: STEERING OUTPUT SHAFT FAILURE As a result of a machining discrepancy the steering box output shaft may fail resulting in loss of steering control.
lti.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the steering boxes with quality assured versions.

lti.defect: STEERING DROP ARM MAY BECOME LOOSE It is possible that the drop arm on the steering idler shaft may become loose due to the loosing of the drop arm retention nut. In extreme conditions the steering operation may become erratic.
lti.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the drop arm retention nut to be removed have Loctite high strength thread sealant added to the threads and refitted then torqued to the appropriate setting.

lti.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR The battery/alternator positive lead connection has been found insecure in its crimped connector to the starter motor on a small number of vehicles. This could cause prolonged engine cranking/difficulty in starting and if they detached from the starter motor during normal driving the engine would eventually loose power. It could also result in the cable electrically shorting against metalic components in the surrounding area.
lti.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to test the cable fixing and where necessary replace the entire positive lead.

lti.defect: LOSS OF ENGINE POWER It has been identified that due to an incorrect specification the turbo intake hose may deform due to oil contamination. Should this occur the engine power would be significantly reduced resulting in an attainable road speed of less than 20mph.
lti.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the turbo hose replaced with a quality assured item.

lti.defect: CLUTCH PEDAL MAY DETACH The clutch pedal may detach from the pedal box due to a non-conformity of the pedal pivot shaft.
lti.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new pivot shaft and retaining devices.

lti.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Under bonnet fires.
lti.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to 1.  Fit fire retardant shields over the bulkhead sound insulation material 2. Replace the EGR pipes 3. Fit a new EGR heat shield to EGR pipe 4. Check the integrity and fit of all related under bonnet components.

lti.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST The axle fastner of the rear axle panhard rod may fail. This will initially cause lateral movement of the axle which if ignored may lead to loss of directional control.

lti.defect: STEERING BOX MAY FAIL Seizure of vehicle steering box resulting in sudden and unexpected loss of steering control of the vehicle. Issue came to light on the investigation of two customer vehicles which experienced the above symptoms. In both cases LTI Vehicles were able to confirm the symptoms and establish the root cause as a displaced retention circlip within the working mechanism of the steering box.
lti.remedy: LTI Vehicles will inform customers of this potential issue and recommend that they stop using their vehicle. A refurbished steering box will be supplied and fitted on all of the affected vehicles as soon as validated parts become available.

lti.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL It is possible that the handbrake cable may detach from the handbrake lever due to an issue with the quality of the weld on the cable pivot post and the lever.  In the worst case this could cause a release of the handbrake.

man.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE The brackets retaining the rear central air tank may fail. In the worst case this can result in the compressed air tank becoming detached leading to reduced braking effect and possible danger to other road users.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new bracket and clamping straps for the compressed-air tanks at the rear.

man.defect: DRIVER AND CO-DRIVER'S SEATS MAY TIP TO THE REAR The squeezer nut which is part of the scissor-type lever assembly on the seat rack may work loose.  This may cause damage to the seat rack and in extreme cases the seat rack may fail.  If this occurs there is a risk of the seat tipping rearward which could potentially affect the driver's control of the vehicle.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection and replacement of damages seat scissor-type lever assemblies as required.

man.defect: COMPRESSED AIR SYSTEM MAY FAIL The heads of the blind rivet pins may detach and in unfavourable circumstances get jammed between the valve and the seat of the blow off valve. This means that the valve will be permanently open and that it is no longer possible to fill the compressed air system completely.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected check the model and date of manufacture on the model plate. If the pins have detached find the loose headsremove them and then rebuild the drier with new seal and damping plate. If the pin heads cannot be found a new drier should be fitted.

man.defect: RISK OF FIRE The fuel pre-filter heating may fail because of damage caused by scorching on the relay and its electrical connection. In extreme cases a fire could be possible.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the relay for the fuel pre-filter heating. Where necessary replace the relay. The relay will only be re-sited if it is replaced. In all cases the protective sleeve must be fitted to the relay and wiring.

man.defect: POWER STEERING MAY FAIL It is possible that certain vehicles may have been fitted with power assistance steering pipes that have connections that have not been correctly crimped.  It is therefore possible that should they fail it will result in the loss of power assistance and the loss of fluid onto the road surface.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the power assistance steering pipes.

man.defect: PROPSHAFT MAY FAIL AND FALL OFF VEHICLE. The propshaft may fail and fall of the vehicle causing injury and damage to other road users.
man.remedy: The remedy involves installing a prop shaft catcher to prevent failing prop shafts falling off.

man.defect: SEAT HEATER MAY OVERHEAT AND CAUSE SMOULDERING. Ageing may cause the contact resistance of the seat heating to increase. In conjunction with the seat heating regulator installed this can lead to the seat overheating and smouldering in extreme cases.
man.remedy: Fit a replacement seat heating regulator. Fit new seat cushion and back rest heating elements where necessary.

man.defect: TOXIC FUMES MAY DEVELOP IN CAB It is possible in certain conditions for humidity to enter the Voltage Converter which can lead to smouldering/scorching inside of the converter producing smoke and toxic fumes.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a cover that more effectively protects the voltage converter against humidity.

man.defect: FUEL HEATER MIGHT FAIL BECAUSE OF DAMAGE CAUSED BY HEAT TO ELECTRICAL CONNECTION The fuel heater may fail due to a cable damaged by heat at the electrical connection of the fuel filter heater.
man.remedy: Fit heat protection sleeve over fuel heater electrical connector and wiring.

man.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL It has been identified that the fastening of the brake calipers on the rear axle may work loose as the result of the bolts not having been tightened to the correct torque. If this situation is allowed to continue the potential exists for the brakes on the affected axle to fail.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked by the appliance of a test torque.

man.defect: STEERING MAY BE LOST It is possible that some vehicles may have the steering hydraulic pipework mounted and secured incorrectly. In the worst case the pipework could fracture and result in the loss of power assistance to the steering.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to where necessary reposition the pipe and re-secure it in a different place.

man.defect: RISK OF FIRE The guide pin in the starter solenoid switch is incorrectly fitted which may cause the starter to overheat and cause smouldering damage.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace starter

man.defect: REAR WHEEL TRIM PANELS MAY DETACH There is the potential that the brackets for the locks of the wheel cut out trim panels may become detached causing an increase risk of collision for other road users.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace rear wheel cut out trim panels with a modified version.

man.defect: MID LIFT AXLE HANGER BRACKET CONCERN The mid lift axle front hanger bracket fixing bolts may have been insufficiently tightened. As a consequence the hanger bracket could become loose to the chassis.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles replace any damaged hanger bracket fixing bolts and tighten all bolts to the specified torque.

man.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL COULD BE LOST The steering column propshaft coupling may be connected too far beyond the toothing/splined section of the steering gear shaft.  If ignored this has the potential to affect the directional control of the vehicle.
man.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check for misalignment.  If found replace steering shaft and check for damage on the steering gear shaft.  Replace if damaged.

man.defect: VEHICLE MAY BECOME UNSTABLE The attachment of the panhard rod to the skeleton may crack. If the cracks develop the stability of the vehicle could be affected.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the panhard rod to skeleton mounting area and  where there is no damage weld on reinforcement panels and square tubes. Where damage is present carry out appropriate rectification work as advised by the Service Support Desk.

man.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED The front live axle brake anchor plates may not be secure which if not attended to could ultimately lead to the directional control being affected.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to tighten the anchor plate bolts and where necessary replace the stub axle and brake anchor plate.

man.defect: RISK OF FIRE The wiring for the auxiliary cab night heater might not be fully secure and allow the wiring to get too close to the heater exhaust pipe. The worst case scenario is the possibility of fire.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary correctly secure the wiring.

man.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE OUTBREAKS IN THE VICINITY OF THE CENTRAL ELECTRICAL PANEL. It has been diagnosed that the fire is due to thermal overload on 300-150 negative terminals. The cause being due to a transitional resistance between the cable lug and the terminal which has increased excessively because of the installation of Nord lock washers.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked to ascertain whether Nord lock washers are fitted. If not no action will be taken. If Nord lock washers are fitted they will be removed and replaced with serrated nuts. During each of these procedures the cabling will be checked for smoldering type damage.

man.defect: CONTROL OF VEHICLE MAY BE AFFECTED It has been established that the Electronic Stability Program (ESP) can malfunction which in extreme cases can cause a loss of control of the vehicle.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and disable the ESP system until a permanent fix is found.

man.defect: COMPRESSED AIR TANK MAY RUPTURE The compressed air resevoir tanks may rupture without warning which may result in material damage and/or personal injury due to parts coming loose.
man.remedy: Recall the the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the air tank manufacturer's number. Where the air tank is of the affected batches the air tank will be replaced.

man.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLY During manufacturer of the manually operated parking brake valve some of the drillings were formed incorrectly. This concern may lead to cracks forming loss of air and the parking brake applying whilst the vehicle is in motion.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the make and date of manufacture. Where necessary replace the manually operated parking brake valve.

man.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that some MAN TGL vehicles may have a problem with the steering shaft universal joint which may have been inserted too far over the teeth of the steering transmission shaft. This could result in the teeth failing to be adequately engaged with the consequence if ignored that the steering could fail.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the connection between the steering shafts checked. The components will be replaced if they show signs of damage.

man.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL The steering upper universal joint may be incorrectly located and secured on the shaft. Steering control may be affected.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehiclescheck if joint located correctly if not reposition and fit and correctly torque new securing bolt.

man.defect: STEERING ARM BOLTS BECOME LOOSE New longer bolts were fitted during a recall where spacer plates were fitted between the steering arms and their mountings. It is thought that on some vehicles the bolts were not correctly torqued and therefore there is a possibility that they could become loose.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected so that the bolts can be inspected if necessary replaced and correctly torqued.

man.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED The front live axle brake anchor plates may not be secure which if not attended to could ultimately lead to the directional control being affected.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to tighten the anchor plate bolts and where necessary replace the stub axle and brake anchor plate.

man.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLY During manufacturer of the manually operated parking brake valve some of the drillings were formed incorrectly. This concern may lead to cracks forming loss of air and the parking brake applying whilst the vehicle is in motion.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the make and date of manufacture. Where necessary replace the manually operated parking brake valve.

man.defect: WHEEL BEARING MAY FAIL Under certain operating conditions it is possible that the wheel bearing or a tyre on the leading or trailing tag axles can fail as a result of a brake overheat.  If the driver ignores warning signs it is possible the wheel and hub could detach or the tyre could blow out.
man.remedy: As an interim action recall all affected vehicles to check the tolerance on the brake calipers fitted to these axles. Where necessary the dealer will replace specific brake components and fit wheel nut indicators to act as heat/melting indicators. Full action recall all affected vehicle to have new brake calipers fitted.

man.defect: LOSS OF ELECTRICAL SUPPLY It is possible that during battery maintenance the main battery cables can foul in the battery box closing system. Repeated operation of opening and closing of the battery box can in extreme cases cause a short circuit and subsequence loss of power.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check for fouling and rectify as required.

man.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the connection between the steering shaft and the fork on the steering propshaft may work loose. This if ignored has the potential to cause the steering to fail.
man.remedy: Subject vehicle will have the steering shafts checked and replaced as necessary.

man.defect: VEHICLE ELECTRICS MAY FAIL COMPLETELY The vehicles electrical circuits may fail completely due to a faulty battery switch.
man.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the faulty switch will be replaced with a modified part.

man.defect: REAR WHEEL TRIM PANELS MAY DETACH There is the potential that the brackets for the locks of the wheel cut out trim panels may become detached causing an increase risk of collision for other road users.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace rear wheel cut out trim panels with a modified version.

man.defect: COMPRESSED AIR SYSTEM CAN FREEZE UP Air from the compressor may freeze up in the spiral cooling pipe and in the pipe upstream of the air dryer or ECAM unit. This could reduce the efficiency of the service brakes.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the spiral cooling pipe with a shorter version. Also replace the polyamide pipe leading from the steel pipe in the frame to the ECAM unit or to the air dryer by a steel pipe.

man.defect: RISK OF FIRE The fuel pre-filter heating may fail because of damage caused by scorching on the relay and its electrical connection. In extreme cases a fire could be possible.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the relay for the fuel pre-filter heating. Where necessary replace the relay. The relay will only be re-sited if it is replaced. In all cases the protective sleeve must be fitted to the relay and wiring.

man.defect: POWER STEERING MAY FAIL It is possible that certain vehicles may have been fitted with power assistance steering pipes that have connections that have not been correctly crimped.  It is therefore possible that should they fail it will result in the loss of power assistance and the loss of fluid onto the road surface.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the power assistance steering pipes.

man.defect: RISK OF FIRE The guide pin in the starter solenoid switch is incorrectly fitted which may cause the starter to overheat and cause smouldering damage.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace starter

man.defect: THE STEERING PROPSHAFT TO THE STEERING GEAR BOLT CONNECTION MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY The bolt connection of the steering�propshaft�to the steering gear may�not be tightened correctly in�production�or the hex socket fit bolt may be missing.
man.remedy: If the hex socket fit bolt is present check for correct�torque and tighten if necessary. If the hex socket fit bolt is missing replace the lower part of the steering�propshaft�and both hex socket fit bolts.

man.defect: WHEEL BEARING MAY FAIL Under certain operating conditions it is possible that the wheel bearing of the leading or trailing tag axles can fail as a result of a brake overheat on these axles.  If the driver ignores warning signs then ultimately it is possible that the wheel and hub could detach.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for a check of the tolerates on the brake calipers fitted to these axles and if required replace specific brake components

man.defect: BRAKE HOSE CONNECTORS CONCERN. Possible incorrect crimping of the front flexible brake hose connectors could result in disconnection of a hose during braking.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace any suspect brake hoses with new ones.

man.defect: TRAILER MAY BECOME DETACHED. An incorrect version of the front and rear crossmembers may allow the coupling to detach.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles - check the manufacturer and model of 5th wheel ( as this applies to VBG type 65sf sliders) and if crossmembers are of flat construction replace with modified type.

man.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL It has been identified that the fastening of the brake calipers on the rear axle may work loose as the result of the bolts not having been tightened to the correct torque. If this situation is allowed to continue the potential exists for the brakes on the affected axle to fail.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked by the appliance of a test torque.

man.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the connection between the steering shaft and the fork on the steering propshaft may work loose. This if ignored has the potential to cause the steering to fail.
man.remedy: Subject vehicle will have the steering shafts checked and replaced as necessary.

man.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL It has been identified that the fastening of the brake calipers on the rear axle may work loose as the result of the bolts not having been tightened to the correct torque. If this situation is allowed to continue the potential exists for the brakes on the affected axle to fail.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked by the appliance of a test torque.

man.defect: HAND RAIL MAY BECOME DETATCHED Double seat behind centre emergency door has an unsatisfactory mounting at side wall. If it becomes loose at the mounting  it breaks away from the side wall. This will cause the seat to drop and cause the hand rail by the centre passage way  that is attached at the top of the seat  to become detached.
man.remedy: Modify seat mounting to prevent the seat from breaking away.

It is therefore possible that should they fail it will result in the loss of power assistance and the loss of fluid onto the road surface.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the power assistance steering pipes.

man.defect: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY It has been identified that in extreme cases the mechanical lock of the Wabco park brake valve (81.52315-6089 or 81.52315-6090) may release by itself. If this occurs then there is the possibility that the vehicle could roll away.
man.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the park brake valve.

man.defect: POSSIBILITY OF CAB BECOMING DETACHED WHEN TILTED There is a possibility that the cab may become detached when tilted due to insufficient thickness of front cab mounting blocks
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for inspection and replacement of  cab bearing blocks if broken

man.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Oil may emerge from cylinder head cover in the event of engine damage. In the worst case scenario this could cause a fire hazard if leaking oil comes into contact with parts of the exhaust system.Some engine damage may cause high pressures in the crankcase. In extreme cases oil may escape at the cylinder head cover.
man.remedy: Replace cylinder head cover screws on the air intake manifold side for screws with springs

man.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLY During manufacturer of the manually operated parking brake valve some of the drillings were formed incorrectly. This concern may lead to cracks forming loss of air and the parking brake applying whilst the vehicle is in motion.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the make and date of manufacture. Where necessary replace the manually operated parking brake valve.

man.defect: ENGINE MAY BE SWITCHED OFF INADVERTENTLY It has been identified that a concern exists with the folding type ignition key in that if accidentally knocked and turned through contact with the driver's knee the engine can be switched off
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the current ignition key replaced with one with a shorter grip.

man.defect: FRONT AXLE MAY BECOME INSECURE It is possible that the front axle spring U bolt nuts may crack. If this occurs then this could in extreme cases result in the driver loosing control of the vehicle.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the defective components.

man.defect: LIFT AXLE LOCATING BRACKET MAY CRACK Mid lift axle front hanger and air bag pedestal mounting may not have been welded to the inside of the chassis mounting bracket. This could lead to stress fatigue and subsequent failure.
man.remedy: Examine affected vehicles and replace the mounting brackets where necessary.

man.defect: POTENTIAL FOR PREMATURE FAILURE OF PROP SHAFT UNIVERSAL JOINT Potential for premature failure of the propshaft universal joint.
man.remedy: Replace propshaft and with a modified propshaft that can be greased at one end (Axle end) Propshaft to be replaced every 300000km

man.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the bolts retaining the Pitman arm on trucks fitted with VOK-03 or VOK-5 axles may become loose as a result of them being incorrectly tightened during production. If ignored the potential exists for the steering to fail.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts re-torqued or replaced. In cases of damage to the Pitman arm or steering knuckle theses will also be replaced.

man.defect: FUEL HEATER MIGHT FAIL BECAUSE OF DAMAGE CAUSED BY HEAT TO ELECTRICAL CONNECTION The fuel heater may fail due to a cable damaged by heat at the electrical connection of the fuel filter heater.
man.remedy: Fit heat protection sleeve over fuel heater electrical connector and wiring.

man.defect: THE FUEL HEATER MAY FAIL DUE TO A DAMAGED CABLE The fuel heater may fail due to a cable damaged by heat at the electrical connection of the fuel filter heater.
man.remedy: Fit heat protection sleeve over fuel heater electrical connector and wiring.

man.defect: MAINTENANCE FLAP MAY OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY The maintenance flap under the driver's window may open unintentionally.
man.remedy: On affected vehicles replace snap lock in the lower area of the maintenance flap under the driver's window by a lock with latch.

man.defect: INCORRECT AIR BRAKE PIPING CONNECTIONS It has been found on some of the F2000 and TGA variants fitted with the Hendrickson Mid-Lift Axle assembly that the connections to the relay valve fitted to this application may have been incorrectly connected to the ports 41 and 1.
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check for incorrect pipe connections and rectify where found necessary.

man.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Oil may emerge from cylinder head cover in the event of engine damage. In the worst case scenario this could cause a fire hazard if leaking oil comes into contact with parts of the exhaust system.Some engine damage may cause high pressures in the crankcase. In extreme cases oil may escape at the cylinder head cover.
man.remedy: Replace cylinder head cover screws on the air intake manifold side for screws with springs

man.defect: MAINTENANCE FLAP MAY OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY The maintenance flap under the driver's window may open unintentionally.
man.remedy: On affected vehicles replace snap lock in the lower area of the maintenance flap under the driver's window by a lock with latch.

man.defect: REAR SEATBELTS MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY The rear seat belts and lock mechanisms are not compatible and may not lock correctly
man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles replace seat belts and brackets and rework cladding elements at seat belts.

man.defect: VEHICLE MAY BECOME UNSTABLE It has been identified that the possibility exists that the welded version of the rear suspension air spring carrier may fail. Should this occur vehicle instability may ensue.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject air spring carriers replaced.

man.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE The brackets retaining the rear central air tank may fail. In the worst case this can result in the compressed air tank becoming detached leading to reduced braking effect and possible danger to other road users.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new bracket and clamping straps for the compressed-air tanks at the rear.

man.defect: LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL It is possible that the above vehicles are fitted with a defective power assisted steering pump which could fail.  If this occurs it could have the potential to affect the directional control of the vehicle.
man.remedy: Recall all effected vehicles to replace the power assisted steering pump.

man.defect: POWER STEERING MAY FAIL It is possible that certain vehicles may have been fitted with power assistance steering pipes that have connections that have not been correctly crimped.  It is therefore possible that should they fail it will result in the loss of power assistance and the loss of fluid onto the road surface.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the power assistance steering pipes.

man.defect: TYRE TREAD COULD DETACH The tyre tread may detach and adversely affect the control of the vehicle. The separated tread could also adversely affect other road users.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to have tyres from the affected batches. All tyres fitted to the vehicle are to be checked including the spare. The tyres that are in the affected batches are to be changed out.

man.defect: BRAKE HOSE MAY CHAFE ON CAB STAY Under certain circumstances the offside front brake hose can be caught and chafe on the tilt cab stay support. This could result in failure of the hose.
man.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and fit an elbow between the union on the chassis frame and the hose which will route the hose clear of the stay support. Any hose showing signs of contact damage will be replaced.

man.defect: DECREASED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It is possible that the brake linings of the vehicle may wear unevenly. This could result in the vehicle suffering reduced braking performance.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and if required replace the brake pads and discs.

man.defect: MOUNTING PLATE ON REAR AXLE MAY BREAK Mounting plate for rear axle location may break and allow the axle to become insecure.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the cast mounting plate (81.43240-0141) for a modified mounting plate.

man.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL The steering may fail because some of the steering columns have not been fitted correctly to the steering box input shaft.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the steering column coupling fitment and where necessary fit a new steering column and fixings.

man.defect: BRAKES MAY APPLY WITHOUT WARNING Processing bores of the manually operated brake valves have been closed using balls. In individual cases it may occur that the balls are not secured properly in the housing and may come loose. For this reason the valves may bleed air and activate the parking brake or anti-jack knife brake.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check if an affected valve is fitted. For affected valves check the crimping is correct and fit caps to the valves where the crimping is not correct. Affected existing spare parts stock is to be returned. The vehicles supplied with new valves must also be checked and fitted with caps as necessary.

man.defect: POTENTIAL FOR PREMATURE FAILURE OF PROP SHAFT UNIVERSAL JOINT Potential for premature failure of the propshaft universal joint.
man.remedy: Replace propshaft and with a modified propshaft that can be greased at one end (Axle end) Propshaft to be replaced every 300000km

man.defect: INADVERTENT APPLICATION OF THE PARKING BRAKE It has been identified that a number of the subject vehicles have been fitted with faulty Voss air distributor check valves which do not afford the prime mover parking brake system reliable protection in the event of the trailer air supply lines becoming holed or torn away. Should a trailer air supply line disconnect or holing situation occur there is the potential for the prime mover rear axle parking  brakes to actuate causing the vehicle to slow down or in some cases suffer rear wheel lock with no driver input.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject valve replaced with a quality assured item.

man.defect: FUEL HEATER MIGHT FAIL BECAUSE OF DAMAGE CAUSED BY HEAT TO ELECTRICAL CONNECTION The fuel heater may fail due to a cable damaged by heat at the electrical connection of the fuel filter heater.
man.remedy: Fit heat protection sleeve over fuel heater electrical connector and wiring.

man.remedy: Check the bolt connection between the steering pitman and drag link. Renew the steering pitman and drag link if necessary.�

man.defect: REAR BRAKE ROLLERS CONCERN Insufficient initial lubrication of the rear brake shoe rollers may result in excessive wear of the rollers and failure or lock-up of the rear brakes.
man.remedy: Examine the rear brake rollers pins and shoes for excessive wear and damage. Fit new components where necessary.

man.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE CONNECTING PLATE TO THE REAR AXLE FASTENS MAY BREAK It is possible that the connecting plate to which the upper diagonal control arms of the rear axle location system may break. Should this occur loss of vehicle control may ensue.
man.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and change the axle location connecting plate. Additionally operators will be advised of the correct use of the rear suspension system.

man.defect: REAR AXLE MAY BECOME INSECURE It has been identified that the rear axle U bolts have been subject to failure when the vehicle is fitted with high load shock absorbers. Should U bolt failure occur the rear axle may become insecure.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject shock absorbers replaced.

man.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check hoses for chaffing if damaged replace with new and reroute to prevent further chaffing.

man.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the park brake valve.

man.remedy: Replace the steering propshaft and guide rings.

man.defect: STEERING DRAG ARM MAY FAIL It is possible that some right hand drive TGA vehicles may have been fitted with a steering drag arms that have not necessarily crack tested.  If this notice is ignored and the remedial check/repair work is not carried out this could possibly lead to the steering failing.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if necessary replace the effected parts with quality assured items.

man.defect: THE RIGHT LINKAGE ADJUSTERS ON THE REAR AXLE WERE MANUFACTURED INCORRECTLY The right linkage adjusters on the rear axle were manufactured incorrectly.
man.remedy: Replacement of the right linkage adjusters on the rear axle.

man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the defective components.

man.defect: PROPELLOR SHAFT SECURITY The gearbox output flange can come off the gearbox mainshaft whilst the vehicle is in motion and allow the propellor shaft to detach from the vehicle.
man.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original flange with a modified version which allows full tightening of the flange retaining nut.

man.defect: RISK OF FIRE The turbo charger oil pressure line may fail. This will allow oil to fall onto the road surface causing concerns to other road users. In the worst case scenario the oil could ignite and cause a fire.
man.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the oil pressure line and connecting flanges for the turbo charger and where necessary replace the exhaust pipe mounting bracket for a modified version.

man.defect: ELECTRONIC STABILITY PROGRAM MAY MALFUNCTION OR FAIL Electronic Stability Program (ESP) may contain incorrect data
man.remedy: Install the correct data file into the Electronic stability Control Unit.

man.defect: EBS MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY UNDER BRAKING It has been identified that a problem exists with the brake modules fitted to EBS 5 braking systems. The modules affected are front and rear axle  pressure controls additionally the trailer control. It is reported that the fault affects service brake operation in that it could initiate braking on one side more than the other with the possibility of the vehicle veering to one side. Should this happen an accident might ensue.
man.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the EBS control modules re-programmed as necessary.

man.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Oil may emerge from cylinder head cover in the event of engine damage. In the worst case scenario this could cause a fire hazard if leaking oil comes into contact with parts of the exhaust system.Some engine damage may cause high pressures in the crankcase. In extreme cases oil may escape at the cylinder head cover.
man.remedy: Replace cylinder head cover screws on the air intake manifold side for screws with springs

man.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the connection between the steering shaft and the fork on the steering propshaft may work loose. This if ignored it has the potential to cause the steering to fail.
man.remedy: Subject vehicles will have the steering shafts checked and replaced as necessary.

man.defect: PROPSHAFT MAY FAIL AND FALL OFF VEHICLE. The propshaft may fail and fall of the vehicle causing injury and damage to other road users.
man.remedy: The remedy involves installing a prop shaft catcher to prevent failing prop shafts falling off.

man.defect: DECREASED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It is possible that the brake linings of the vehicle may wear unevenly. This could result in the vehicle suffering reduced braking performance.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and if required replace the brake pads and discs.

man.defect: DRIVER AND CO-DRIVER'S SEATS MAY TIP TO THE REAR The squeezer nut which is part of the scissor-type lever assembly on the seat rack may work loose.  This may cause damage to the seat rack and in extreme cases the seat rack may fail.  If this occurs there is a risk of the seat tipping rearward which could potentially affect the driver's control of the vehicle.
man.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection and replacement of damages seat scissor-type lever assemblies as required.

mann.defect: FILTER MAY LEAK Due to contamination during the production process the fuel filter may leak.
mann.remedy: Contact those supplied with the filter and provide a replacement.

mann.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel filter may leak at fuel system working pressure from the top cover. This is due to a none conformance during the manufacture of the filter.
mann.remedy: Recall the filters that are likely to be affected and replace with quality assured units.

marangoni.defect: TYRE CRACKING AT JOIN OF TREAD AND SIDEWALL A specific batch of Marangoni 165 R13 M500 tyres may experience pressure loss due to cracking at the join of the tread and sidewall.
marangoni.remedy: The importer has written to all end users of the subject tyres advising them to take their vehicle back to the supplier to have the tyre inspected. Any tyres found to belong to the suspect batch will be replaced.

maserati.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility of a crack appearing in the ninety degree union connecting the vacuum hose to the brake servo unit which may result in loss of servo assistance.
maserati.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace union with modified type.

maserati.defect: STEERING RACK SUB-FRAME MAY CRACK The steering rack sub-frame may develop a crack in the area of the two fixing points nearest the steering column. This could result in the steering rack becoming loose and a reduction of vehicle control. Potential early symptoms noticed by the driver could be vibrations noises and unusual feeling through the steering wheel.
maserati.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and weld brackets of improved design to the sub-frame.

maserati.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT OF DRIVER SEAT WIRING Some vehicles may have been manufactured with an incorrect driver seat wiring harness layout which can cause the seat wiring harness to rub against metal points on the seat/seat frame assembly through normal seat adjustment operation. Over time  this can lead to an inoperative seat adjustment system and in rare cases a potential risk of fire due to an electrical short to ground between the seat wiring harness and the seat adjustment motor assembly.
maserati.remedy: Replace 2 seat circuit breakers with 25 amp mini-fuses check harness apply protective barrier and reposition if undamaged. If damaged replace harness and then ensure  repositioned and protective barrier applied.

maserati.defect: FRONT HEADLAMPS FULL LED VERSION HEADLAMP VERTICAL BEAM OUT OF COMPLIANCE Front headlamps full LED version headlamp vertical beam out of compliance.
maserati.remedy: Check and adjustment of the front headlamp vertical beam.

maserati.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL Due to a manufacturing issue the front wheel bearing can become noisy and vibrate. If the driver does not take notice of these warnings then the bearing could fail and cause loss of control of the vehicle.
maserati.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the front wheel bearing.

maserati.defect: FRONT HEADLAMPS FULL LED VERSION HEADLAMP VERTICAL BEAM OUT OF COMPLIANCE Front headlamps full LED version headlamp vertical beam out of compliance.
maserati.remedy: Check and adjustment of the front headlamp vertical beam.

maserati.defect: ENGINE CODE MARKED ON DIESEL ENGINE IN AFTERSALES IS DIFFERENT FROM THE HOMOLOGATED AND PRODUCTION CODE Engine code marked on Diesel engine replaced in aftersales is different from the homologated and Production code
maserati.remedy: Documentation will be provided to the customer stating the Italian transport authority confirm this marking is an administration error.

maserati.defect: RIGHT HAND DOOR MAY OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY Insufficient heat treatment may have been applied to the ratchet in the right hand door latch mechanism which may cause the Right Hand door to open inadvertently during driving and/or in an accident.
maserati.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right hand door latch assembly.

maserati.defect: POSSIBLE LEAK MAY OCCUR IN THE FUEL LINE AT THE QUICK RELEASE CONNECTOR There is a possibility that a leak may occur in the fuel line.
maserati.remedy: Replacement of the fuel delivery line.

maserati.defect: FUEL LINE MAY LEAK Due to material  imperfections the fuel delivery line may leak at line unions. This is more likely after prolonged use.
maserati.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel delivery line.

maserati.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT OF DRIVER SEAT WIRING Some vehicles may have been manufactured with an incorrect driver seat wiring harness layout which can cause the seat wiring harness to rub against metal points on the seat/seat frame assembly through normal seat adjustment operation. Over time  this can lead to an inoperative seat adjustment system and in rare cases a potential risk of fire due to an electrical short to ground between the seat wiring harness and the seat adjustment motor assembly.
maserati.remedy: Replace 2 seat circuit breakers with 25 amp mini-fuses check harness apply protective barrier and reposition if undamaged. If damaged replace harness and then ensure  repositioned and protective barrier applied.

maserati.defect: INCORRECT WARNING LIGHTS MAY BE DISPLAYED It is possible that due to an internal issue within the ECU of the Tyre Pressure Management System (TPMS) an incorrect warning to the driver could appear on the instrument panel even when there is not an issue with the tyre pressures on the vehicle. This could cause the driver to panic and take avoiding action when it is not required. In extreme circumstances this could cause a safety risk to the occupants of the vehicle.
maserati.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check the ECU. If found to be one of the affected components it will be replaced with a new unit.

maserati.defect: SEATBELT WARNING BUZZER MAY NOT SOUND It has been identified that due to the installation of incorrect software the seatbelt warning buzzer may not sound when the seatbelts are not engaged.
maserati.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the current software upgraded.

maserati.defect: INTERNAL MALFUNCTION OF THE CONTROL UNIT Internal malfunction of the air bag control unit
maserati.remedy: Replacement of the air bag control unit

maserati.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM COULD FAIL. It has been identified that during manufacture an incorrect tightening torque may have been applied to the front suspension ball joint retaining nuts. This can result in the ball joint becoming loose in it's taper and in extreme circumstances an increase in wear may cause the suspension arm to break.
maserati.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject ball joint retaining nuts checked for correct torque. Should this not be the case both suspension levers and the hub carrier will be changed.

maserati.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WELDING Possible incorrect welding due to human error of the 4 sections of the front engine under frame. This has been caused by an interruption in the welding process Possible brake of the welds Sub-frame can lost the correct alignment and the vehicle could lose the stability
maserati.remedy: Inspection of the welded points if welding Is defective replacement of the front sub-frame required

maserati.defect: EXHAUST ACTIVE VALVE CABLE MAY SHORT CIRCUIT DUE TO CONTACT WITH THE EXHAUST SYSTEM Exhaust active valve cable may short circuit due to contact with the exhaust system.
maserati.remedy: Check cable layout reposition and repair if necessary.

maserati.defect: VEHICLE CAN MOVE AWAY AFTER DRIVER HAS EXITED It has been identified that the gearshift lever resting position may mislead drivers into believing the vehicle's transmission is in the park position when actually the it is still in a drive gear. This could result in the vehicle moving off without the driver being in the vehicle.
maserati.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the driver's door lock and update the software to introduce a drive away inhibition strategy.

maserati.defect: REAR DOOR SAFETY LOCK INSTRUCTIONS IN MANUAL INCORRECT. Due to a printing error in the Owner's Manual and Quick Reference Guide the operation of the rear door child safety locks is incorrectly detailed. As a consequence the driver may not operate the door child safety locks correctly.
maserati.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the information pertaining to the operation of the rear door child safety locks updated.

maserati.remedy: Fit quality assured replacement fixing bolts.

This may result in the door opening without intervention although onboard software of the central locking does not allow this situation to occur over 6mph.
maserati.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the outside door handles.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRC250826 – Function test adaptation of Active Side Guard Assist (ASGA) RC2503 As part of our continuous product monitoring we have found that the detection range of the monitoring sensor may be partially covered or restricted by the vehicle body or attachments (e.g. side underride guard). This condition can potentially lead to false alarms in the instrument cluster as well as to the initiation of brake control. Road users or obstacles that are in the detection range when cornering may not be detected by the safety system or may be detected with a delay which increases the risk of an accident. mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the product safety recall your vehicle will undergo a visual inspection with the aim of determining whether the detection range of the monitoring sensor is restricted by the vehicle body or attachments.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL240710 - LEIT-SCHEU Check wiring harness routing The retrofitted DVS camera / sensor wiring harness along the chassis/cab frame may have been carried out incorrectly. As a result of an incorrectly installed DVS retrofitting scorching damage could occur in the area of the transition from the frame to the cab (swan neck) due to chafing of the wires. Depending on the nature of the damage / or level of chafing the possibility of a vehicle fire cannot be ruled out.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the planned field measure we will check the DVS retrofit was carried out on behalf of DTUK as to whether the retrofitting of the cables was carried out in accordance with the specifications in WIS and the Bodybuilder Guideline and therefore if the chassis/cab frame wiring harness is still routed correctly.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL260907 – ECO-SCHWRC - Replace holders for left and right fenders at front axle. As part of our ongoing quality monitoring we have found that the  weld seams on the front-axle fender carrier of Econic 956 vehicles may have been incorrectly executed. The affected front-axle fender is supported and positioned by a carrier that is firmly connected to the vehicle frame. Due to an employee error at the supplier the affected weld seams were incorrectly executed. Based on the hydropulse tests performed and taking into account the specific vehicle application “refuse collection” cracks are expected to develop in one of the three weld seams no earlier than after two years. As it cannot be ensured that the driver will notice the potential warning signs (vibrations of the fender carrier or fender or unusual noise) complete detachment of the fender cannot be ruled out. This may increase the risk of accident for following traffic.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the planned recall campaign we intend to replace the rear fender holders on the front axle of the potentially affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRC240607  RC2404 Inspection and replacement of the mounting supports on the vehicle frame On affected vehicles the body mounting supports can become deformed when the vehicle body is attached. mercedes-benz.remedy: Visual inspection of mounting supports any exhibiting deformation will be replaced. Version 1 mounting supports will also be reinforced with additional inserts to prevent deformation of the mounting supports.

mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the steering column coupling.

mercedes-benz.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR It is possible that the routing of the frame wiring harness could chaff on a right angle edge at a cable set bracket. mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the cable set bracket plus if required replace any damaged frame wiring harnesses.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE HOUSING OF THE TEMPERATURE PRESSURE VALVE IN THE GAS SYSTEM CAN BREAK WITHOUT EXTERNAL INFLUENCE The housing of the temperature pressure valve in the gas system can break without external influence.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE WELDING BETWEEN FUEL FILLER PIPE AND FUEL TANK MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The welding between the fuel filler pipe and fuel tank might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: FAULTY CONTROL UNIT MAY CAUSE VEHICLE TO PERFORM OUTSIDE SPECIFICATION Where a control unit coding was updated in a workshop between 3 December 2016 and 5 December 2016 the coding may not correspond to the specification and may trigger unplanned action in the vehicle. mercedes-benz.defect: AIRBAG OFF INDICATOR LAMP DOES NOT LIGHT UP IF FRONT PASSENGER SEAT IS RECOGNISED AS BEING UNOCCUPIED front passenger air bag off light does not illuminate in some circumstances

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE REFRIGERANT USED IN THE AIR CONDITION SYSTEM DOES NOT MEET LEGAL REQUIREMENTS The refrigerant used in the air conditioning system does not meet legal requirements.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the aluminium bolts of the steering gear could corrode and break due to the intrusion of moisture. On affected vehicles the aluminium bolts of the steering gear could corrode and break due to the intrusion of moisture.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF FIRE On certain 6 and 8 cylinder engine vehicles a faulty rear engine compartment panel/bulkhead may have been installed. It is therefore possible that the panel/bulkhead may contact the left exhaust catalytic converter due to insufficient clearance. If the catalytic converter is subjected to high temperatures due to heavy driving conditions i.e. full throttle or towing then there is a risk of the rear engine compartment panel igniting and a vehicle fire ensuing.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the clearance between the rear engine compartment panel/bulkhead and the exhaust catalytic converter. If the clearance is insufficient then the rear engine compartment panel/bulkhead will be replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: COOLANT PUMP MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE BETWEEN THE VACUUM SYSTEM AND THE COOLANT CIRCUIT On certain vehicles with a Diesel engine the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.

This can cause the starter to engage and cause a risk to persons working around the vehicle.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the cables and reroute the cabling.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE ENGINE COOLANT PUMP ELECTRIC LINE MAY CONTACT AND CHAFE THE ENGINE FAN The electric line for the power supply of the engine coolant pump might chafe on the engine fan.

mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the vacuum line on the brake booster with a quality assured component.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE HANDS-OFF DETECTION MIGHT NOT DETECT WHEN THE DRIVER'S HANDS ARE AWAY FROM THE STEERING WHEEL The hands-off detection might not detect when the driver's hands are away from the steering wheel.

mercedes-benz.defect: BRAKES MAY BE ADVERSELY AFFECTED During production faulty rear axle modulator/proportional valves may have been fitted.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER ASSISTED STEERING FLUID An oversize hose clamp may allow a gradual loss of Power Assisted Steering Fluid over a period of time.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace hose clamp with modified type.

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak.In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect  the rear axle casing and replace where necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: SOFTWARE UPDATE REQUIRED TO IMPROVE EMISSIONS Improve the vehicle emissions via software updates.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the diesel engine control unit software and add a supplementary booklet for the operator's manual. Check and replace NOx sensor if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the length of the transmission wiring harness might not meet specifications.. On affected vehicles the length of the transmission wiring harness might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check transmission wiring harness routing and rework if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY The software of the transmission control unit in vehicles with dual clutch transmission may not be correct. As a result the operating lock of the transmission selector lever may not function as intended causing in some circumstances the vehicle to roll when not expected.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the transmission control unit software.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SCREW CONNECTION OF THE CONTROL UNIT BOX MIGHT NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION The screw connection of the control unit box might not meet the specification.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the screw connection on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED It is possible that the steering column coupling lock may not have been installed correctly. The driver will recieve warning of the issue by noise. However in extreme circumstances it is possible that steering control of the vehicle could be affected.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the steering coupling.

mercedes-benz.defect: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION MAY MALFUNCTION It has been identified on certain 6 cylinder diesel engine/9 speed automatic transmission vehicles the starter/alternator/transmission wiring harness may be too close to the exhaust system. If it is then there is a risk that the wiring harness may suffer heat damage which can result in the transmission inadvertently selecting neutral whilst driving the Auto P function or the manual P function in the transmission not being available. The manually operated parking brake will still function.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required reroute or replace the wiring harness. The type of action is dependant on the amount of damage present.

mercedes-benz.defect: TAKATA AIRBAG MIGHT NOT DEPLOY AS SPECIFIED Certain climatic conditions may cause a chemical change to the airbag propellants�over time.�
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the driver and�passenger airbags.�

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: ENGINE HOOD MAY NOT BEHAVE AS INTENDED IN A COLLISION The reset mechanism for the dynamic bonnet (for pedestrian protection) might not have been fitted during manufacture. In the event of a head on collision where the dynamic bonnet is triggered the bonnet may not behave as designed thereby putting the vehicle occupants at higher risk of injury.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check if the bonnet reset mechanism is fitted. Where the reset mechanism is missing fit a reset mechanism.

mercedes-benz.defect: CAB MAY TILT UNEXPECTEDLY The cab tilt cylinder is connected to the frame of the cab by a pin.  This pin is secured by a hexagon head bolt.   The screw/bolt on some vehicles may not be tightened to the prescribed torque. As a result the cab may not be fully secure and in the worst case could tilt unexpectedly.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary tighten the cab tilt cylinder mounting pin securing bolt.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE LEFT REAR SEAT BACKREST LOCK MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The left rear seat backrest lock might not meet the specifications
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the left rear seat backrest lock on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR It is possible that the routing of the frame wiring harness could chaff on a right angle edge at a cable set bracket.  This could result in a short circuit which should be identified to the driver by warning lights on the instrument panel before any damage occurs.  However the manufacturer is taking steps to prevent any safety issues by recalling the vehicles.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the cable set bracket plus if required replace any damaged frame wiring harnesses.

mercedes-benz.defect: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to establish sufficient grounding of the steering components

mercedes-benz.defect: UPDATE THE SOFTWARE IN THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT Mandatory recall requiring the updating of software in the engine control unit with the Euro 5b+ N1 GR.III/N2 emissions standard.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software in multiple control units depending on vehicle specification and options.

mercedes-benz.defect: ELECTRICAL FRAME WIRING HARNESS Damage may occur at the electrical frame wiring harness along the right longitudinal frame member.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the wiring harness and repair as necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: CATALYTIC CONVERTER SUPPORT BRACKET MAY BE INSECURE The screws retaining the catalytic converter bracket on the engine bracket may have an incorrect clench. This could lead to vibration and cause the exhaust to crack.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles check screws according to manufacturer's procedures..Depending on findings either replace screws or refer to manufacturer for further guidance

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MAY  BE DEACTIVATED The communication module may be deactivated
mercedes-benz.remedy: Carry out a check of the configuration of the communication module on affected vehicles and if necessary activate the communication module.

mercedes-benz.defect: ELECTRIC POWER STEERING MOTOR DEFECTIVE Contacts inside the electric power steering motor may not have been correctly formed. Failure of these contacts would cause the loss of power steering assistance.If this happens a warning lamp will illuminate
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the electric power steering motor on affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: POTENTIAL LEAKAGE AND GRADUAL LOSS OF FLUID FROM THE HYDRAULIC STEERING SYSTEM MAY OCCUR Leakage and subsequently a gradual loss of fluid from the hydraulic steering system.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the screw connection of the hydraulic steering line and ensure the correct tightening torque is applied. Top up fluid level if required.

mercedes-benz.defect: STEERING WHEEL MAY COME LOOSE The screw securing the steering wheel to the splines may be missing. This can lead to loss of directional control thereby increasing the risk of a collision.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check for the presence of the retaining screw where necessary a screw will be fitted.

mercedes-benz.defect: TRAILER HITCH MAY DETACH Two out of the four screws/bolts of the trailer hitch may not have been tightened correctly resulting in excessive stress to the other bolts. It is therefore possible that over time the connection could fail and the trailer detach from the towing vehicle increasing the risk of incident.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fixing bolts/screws for the towing attachment.

mercedes-benz.defect: TO ACHIEVE AN IMPROVEMENT IN THE EMISSIONS  VIA SOFTWARE UPDATES Improve the vehicle emissions via software updates.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the diesel engine control unit software and add a supplementary booklet for the operator's manual

mercedes-benz.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that on some vehicles the weld seams of the transverse control arms for the front and rear axles may be faulty at the transition between the bushing and the tube. Inasmuch as there may be only spot welds present instead of a continuous weld seam. In this condition the transverse control arms cannot fully absorb the forces which might occur which can lead to the weld breaking.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject control arms checked for weld completeness. The arms will be changed if found to be non compliant.

mercedes-benz.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL On certain petrol engines the camshafts may not have been correctly manufactured. They may fail causing engine damage and the engine to stall
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace camshafts.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MAY  BE DEACTIVATED The communication module may be deactivated
mercedes-benz.remedy: Carry out a check of the configuration of the communication module on affected vehicles and if necessary activate the communication module.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the aluminium bolts of the steering gear could corrode and break due to the intrusion of moisture. On affected vehicles the aluminium bolts of the steering gear could corrode and break due to the intrusion of moisture.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the steering gear mounting bolts on the affected vehicles with steel bolts.  Should the bolts break or already be broken change the steering gear.

mercedes-benz.defect: IN CASE OF  PASSENGER- SIDE AIRBAG IGNITION THE AIRBAG FLAP IN THE DASHBOARD COULD COME LOOSE. In case of passenger-side airbag ignition the airbag flap in the dashboard could come loose.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the cover sheet of the dashboard including the passenger-side airbag flap.

mercedes-benz.defect: LEAF SPRING MAY BREAK DURING OPERATION OF THE VEHICLE Leaf spring may break during operation of the vehicle.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the leaf springs.

mercedes-benz.defect: TO ACHIEVE AN IMPROVEMENT IN THE EMISSIONS  VIA SOFTWARE UPDATES Improve the vehicle emissions via software updates.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the diesel engine control unit software and add a supplementary booklet for the operator's manual

mercedes-benz.remedy: Carry out a check of the configuration of the communication module on affected vehicles and if necessary activate the communication module.

mercedes-benz.defect: BRAKE HOSE INCORRECTLY CRIMPED A brake hose crimp connection could come loose and cause a reduction in braking effort.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the  brake hose with a correctly crimped version.

mercedes-benz.defect: CERTAIN FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION A correctly fastened seat belt could be detected as not fastened impairing the restraint system
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the relevant seat belt buckles in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: STOP START ENGINE MAY NOT RESTART The excess length of the wiring harness to the engine control unit could result in a faulty camshaft signal. This faulty camshaft signal may lead to an unintentional cancellation of the automatic starting procedure after automatic engine stop of the automatic start/stop system. In the event of a faulty camshaft signal the engine would not restart as expected following the stop procedure but can be manually restarted immediately by engaging the transmission selector lever position �N� or �D� and by operating the ignition key or the start button (with keyless go). Depending on the traffic situation however an increased accident hazard could result.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and rework the wiring harness to the engine control unit on the affected vehicles as a precautionary measure.

mercedes-benz.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On vehicles equipped with four wheel steering it is possible that if the vehicle is used where extreme axle articulation is experience the service brake lines between the ABS solenoid valves and brake chambers can suffer tensile stress and subsequently fail.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the affected brake lines.

mercedes-benz.defect: HANDS OFF DETECTION FUNCTION MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The Hands-off-Detection function (HoD) might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The position of the steering boot will be checked and corrected if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF FIRE The exhaust tailpipe variants K7D K7C and K7N can become loose. Variant K7D can fall away from the vehicle leading to a heightened risk of incident for other road users. Where an exhaust gas leak occurs this can constitute a risk of fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the seal of the exhaust tail pipe flange with a metal bead gasket.

mercedes-benz.defect: FRONT END FLAP AIR DEFLECTOR OUTER SECTION DOES NOT MATCH CURRENT SERIES PRODUCTION SPECIFICATIONS The front air deflector may become detached.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the deflector replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BALL TYPE TOW-BAR MAY NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE FATIGUE STRENGTH It may be possible that the ball type tow-bar does not meet the requirements of the fatigue strength.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Change of the ball type tow-bar of the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR AXLE BRAKE CALIPER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION Hydrogen may be embedded in the piston material of rear brake calipers.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Bleed the hydraulic brake system of the rear axle of affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: MAINTENANCE FLAP GLASS MAY DETACH It has been identified that the bonding on the glass panel of the rear left upper maintenance flap may not be to specification. This may allow the glass to vibrate and can result in either the failure (shattering) of the glass panel or the detachment of the glass panel from the frame. This can cause a risk to other road users following the vehicle.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and fit rubber buffers an additional retention medium and protective film.

mercedes-benz.defect: ON CERTAIN FRONT WHEEL DRIVE  VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AN ADDITIONAL TRACTION BATTERY THE ATTACHMENT BOLTS ON THE FRAME OF THIS HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY COULD BE LOOSE On certain front-wheel-drive vehicles equipped with an additional traction battery the attachment bolts on the frame of this high voltage battery could be loose.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Tighten the screwing of the high voltage battery module on the affected vehicles according to the respective specification.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SOFTWARE OF THE ESP CONTROL UNIT MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATIONS The software of the ESP control unit might not meet the specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software for the ESP control unit on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: VEHICLES WERE DELIVERED WITH A HIGHER TRANSMISSION OIL LEVEL THAN INTENDED Vehicles were delivered with a higher transmission oil level than intended.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the transmission oil level and drain any excess transmission oil if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE LOCKNUTS SECURING THE AIRBAG MIGHT BE INSUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED One or more of the four locknuts securing the drivers airbag might be insufficiently tightened.

mercedes-benz.defect: AIR CONDITION SYSTEM REFRIDGERANT DOES NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS The refrigerant used in the air condition system does not meet legal requirements.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The air conditioning system to be adapted for the usage of the new refrigerant (R1234yf).

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SOFTWARE OF THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS On certain vehicles the software of the engine control unit might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Conduct an update the software of the engine control unit on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the fleece filter insert of the engine oil separator may become obstructed with dirt particles. It is therefore possible that an increase in pressure within the crankcase may occur with the result that oil could escape onto hot engine parts. Should this occur a fire may ensue.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the original oil filter replaced with one of a cyclone type.

mercedes-benz.defect: DRIVER AND PASSENGER BACKREST MAY BECOME INSECURE On certain models fitted with the AMG seats it is possible that if the vehicle is involved in a side impact during very cold conditions below freezing the side cover for the back-rest member could become loose and cause injury.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the side cover with new replacement item.

mercedes-benz.defect: BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT OPERATE TO SPECIFICATION Some vehicles  may have been fitted with incorrect specification brake discs. This in extreme cases may have an affect on the brake efficiency should the vehicle have to carry out an emergency stop.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the rear brake discs.

mercedes-benz.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG GAS GENERATOR HOUSING FAILURE DURING DEPLOYMENT On affected vehicles it has been determined that drivers airbags with potentially faulty gas generator housing material may have been installed in vehicles of model series 156 176 246 205 238 & 253.  If the material of the gas generator housing fails during airbag deployment in the event of a crash the airbag system would possibly no longer have a restraint effect. In addition separating parts could enter the passenger compartment. This could lead to an increased risk of injury.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver�s airbag

mercedes-benz.remedy: Carry out a check of the configuration of the communication module on affected vehicles and if necessary activate the communication module.

mercedes-benz.defect: POSSIBLE COLLISION BETWEEN BRAKE HOSES AND WHEEL ARCH LINER AT THE FRONT AXLE Contact could occur between brake hoses and the rear segment of the front axle wing panel liner resulting in chafing.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the position of the wing liner & modify as per working instructions.

mercedes-benz.defect: TRANSMISSION MAY LOCK AT LOW SPEED The high-voltage battery charger may not have been produced to specification which could lead to an incorrect detection of an external charging cable. This in turn can lead the request for �P� to be activated. If the speed is less than 5 km/h the transmission would activate the park pawl function which will prevent the vehicle from driving further and could increase the risk of an incident.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the high-voltage charger on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: UPDATE TO THE DIESEL ENGINE CONTROL UNIT SOFTWARE TO IMPROVE THE EMISSIONS As a result of a directive from Germany�s Federal Motor Transport Authority (KBA) changes are required to certain specific calibration functions within the engine management systems of certain vehicles.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Conduct an update to the diesel engine control unit software.

mercedes-benz.defect: OIL LEAKAGE ON TURBOCHARGER The oil inlet nozzle on the turbocharger that is screwed on to the bearing housing  is sealed with a copper seal. An adhesive  that disintegrates when heated was applied in error.  This may allow oil to leak onto the turbo housing.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles correctly reseal the connection.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SOFTWARE OF THE HEADLAMPS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS. The software of the headlamps might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE ADJUSTABLE SECOND SEAT ROW MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED TO SPECIFICATIONS The second seat row might not be correctly engaged in the seat rail on one side.

mercedes-benz.defect: BRAKES MAY BE ADVERSELY AFFECTED During production faulty rear axle modulator/proportional valves may have been fitted.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace valves as necessary. **NOTE 4X2 AND 4X4  TRACTOR UNITS MUST NOT BE DRIVEN**.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE LOCKING MECHANISM FOR THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR OF THE SIDE CRASH SENSORS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The locking mechanism for the electrical connector of the side crash sensors might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the side crash sensors in the doors on the affected vehicles and replace them if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: OIL FOAM MAY DEVELOP IN THE ACTIVE CURVE  SYSTEM OIL RESERVOIR It has been determined that on Model series ML/GLE GL/GLS (166) & GLE Coupe (292) with ACTIVE CURVE SYSTEM (ACS) Oil foam may develop in the systems oil reservoir under dynamic operating conditions and at an oil level below the minimum level and escape via the ventilation bores in the cap of the reservoir.  Depending on the orientation of the two ventilation bores the escaping oil could spray onto hot component parts of the exhaust system. In this case risk of fire cannot be ruled out.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the oil dipstick of the reservoir for the ACTIVE CURVE SYSTEM.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: INCORRECT CROSS-MEMBER BOLTS FITTED The screws/bolts used for fastening the towing eyes the cross-member of the trailer hitch and the rear step for the support of the cross-member on 5 ton vehicles may be the wrong type.  This could cause the bolts to work loose and in a worst case snap.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As a precautionary measure the screw/bolts will be replaced on affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF FIRE The high pressure fuel lines have not been manufactured to the correct specification which over time can lead to crack formation and fuel leaking. Fuel escaping in the presence of an ignition source could lead to fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the high pressure fuel lines.

mercedes-benz.defect: POSSIBLE ENGINE BAY FIRE AND PARKING BRAKE FAILURE It has been identified that as a result of a cracked piston engine damage can occur whereby oil is ejected into the engine bay and may ignite after coming into contact with hot engine components. It has further been identified that the threaded portion of the brake adjuster for the parking brake may break under load due to the wall thickness being too slight. Should a failure occur the parking brake would become ineffective.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with modified engine control software and will also have the parking brake adjuster replaced with a quality assured item.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE CRANKSHAFT MAY EXHIBIT SURFACE DAMAGES The durability of the crankshaft might be impaired.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE FIXATION OF THE REAR HEADRESTS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The fixation of the rear headrests might not meet specifications.
