mercedes-benz.defect: ON CERTAIN VEHICLESTHE LENGTH OF THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE FRONT WHEEL SPEED SENSORS MIGHT NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS On certain vehicles the length of the wiring harness of the front wheel speed sensors might not meet the requirements.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the wiring harness of the front speed sensor on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: BOLTED CONNECTIONS ON FRONT SWIVEL SEATS CANNOT BE GUARANTEED Possible improperly bolted swivel seat console
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the swivelling console

mercedes-benz.defect: CERTAIN FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION A correctly fastened seat belt could be detected as not fastened impairing the restraint system
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the relevant seat belt buckles in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: UNINTENTIONAL DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG Exposure to high humidity conditions may result in corrosion that can cause the drivers front air bag to deploy unintentionally.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace air bag.

mercedes-benz.defect: TO IMPROVE EMISSIONS OF THE AFFECTED VEHICLES.CERTAIN CALIBRATIONS OF FUNCTIONALITIES MUST BE CHANGED IN THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT Improve the vehicle emissions via software updates.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the diesel engine control unit software and add a supplementary booklet for the operator's manual

mercedes-benz.defect: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY HAVE A CHEMICAL CHANGE TO ITS PROPELLANT OVER TIME The driver's airbag may have a chemical change to its propellant over time.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the driver�s airbag.

mercedes-benz.defect: THREADED CONNECTIONS AT THE STEERING BRACKET OF THE STEERING GEAR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY SECURED One or more threaded connections of the steering bracket may not have been correctly secured.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check loosen and correctly apply the required tightening torque to the affected connections.

mercedes-benz.defect: WINDOW AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED The left and right airbag actuation has been swapped due to an incorrect connector assignment on the wiring harness. In a collision where the airbags are required to deploy the incorrect airbag could be deployed with the protective affect not being ensured.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and correct the pin assignment on the airbag control plug.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT SOFTWARE NEEDS TO BE UPDATED Improve the vehicle emissions via software updates.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the relevant control unit�s software and if necessary replace the NOx sensors

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SCREW CONNECTION OF THE POWER SUPPLY ON THE STARTER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION The screw connection of the power supply on the starter might not have been installed according to specification.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the screw connections of the starter on the affected vehicles and correct them if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: COOLANT PUMP MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE BETWEEN THE VACUUM SYSTEM AND THE COOLANT CIRCUIT On certain vehicles with a Diesel engine the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: ENGINE EMERGENCY SHUT OFF ON BOARD DIAGNOSIS OR TANK/SPEEDO SIGNAL MAY BE AFFECTED Possibility of transfer of incorrect control unit software which could affect engine shut off control in an emergency situation or the on board diagnosis system or tank/speedometer signal
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace SAM control unit

mercedes-benz.defect: VEHICLE MAY STALL A potentially faulty weld between the plate carrier and the hub of a clutch could be faulty/cracked and could fail. This can cause limp-home mode to be adopted or all drive to be lost. As a result the risk of a collision is heightened.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the dual clutch of the transmission.

mercedes-benz.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel leaks in the plug area of the drain opening may occur at the fuel filter with integrated fuel heaters.  Fuel can escape and is noticeable to the customer due to a corresponding diesel odour.  The diesel can reach the road and as a result friction between the tyres and road surface may be decreased.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check filter and replace as necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: SWITCHES IN CERTAIN SEAT BELT BUCKLES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED TO SPECIFICATIONS The switches in certain seat belt buckles might not have been manufactured according to specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The affected seat belt buckles are to be  replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF A SHORT CIRCUIT The battery main cable may chafe on a bracket which may lead to a short circuit
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have an additional bracket fitted which has been deficient from production.

mercedes-benz.defect: A SOFTWARE IMPLAUSIBILITY ERROR IN THE HV 'BATTERY GATEWAY' CONTROL UNIT MAY CAUSE THE CONTACTORS OF ALL HV BATTERIES TO BE OPENED UNNECESSARILY A software implausibility error in the HV �battery gateway� control unit may cause the contactors of all HV batteries to be opened unnecessarily.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the HV �battery gateway� control unit.

mercedes-benz.defect: AIR MAY LEAK The bonding of the pressure sensors on the axle modulator and proportional relay valve brake components may be incorrect  and work loose. Leakage may occur in the area of the pressure sensor and  applied brake pressure may not be correctly regulated
mercedes-benz.remedy: On  affected vehicles replace releveant  defective components.

mercedes-benz.defect: SEVERE CORROSION OF METAL COMPONENTS IN THE REAR AREA OF THE ROOF BED Vehicles could experience severe corrosion of metal components in the rear area of the roof bed.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the mattress check for corrosion and if necessary carry out the repair of possibly corroded areas

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: The bonding between the glass panel and the sliding roof frame might not meet specifications On affected vehicles the bonding between the glass panel and the sliding roof frame might not meet specifications.  In consequence a separation of the glass panel from the vehicle cannot be excluded.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the glass panel and replace the sliding roof if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK A fuel leak may occur from the area of the fuel drain opening in the fuel filters which leaks onto the road.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the fuel filter and replace where necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR SIDE LIGHTS AND NUMBER PLATE LIGHT MAY FAIL A combination switch may fail. If this occurs the rear side lights and number plate lights will fail to function. (Brake lights and indicators will operate as normal).
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall vehicles and replace the combination switch.

mercedes-benz.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING SUPPORT It has been identified that the pins within the electric power assisted steering control unit may not have been contact welded correctly. This can result in an open circuit which will lead to a loss of power steering assistance and possible loss of control of the vehicle.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace electric power assisted steering.

mercedes-benz.defect: AIR DRIER HOUSING MAY DETACH It is possible due to its location that the muffler on the air drier may freeze and icing may occur. This can cause a blockage of the vent line; this in turn will cause the pressure in the air drier to rise beyond its venting pressure of 18.5 bar to in excess of 40 bar. This can result the top section of the air drier cartridge housing becoming detached. The driver should be aware of the issue due to the noise emitted and the brake system will still operate allow you to stop the vehicle safely. However the brake system could still be compromised.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and reposition air drier muffler.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF FIRE The high pressure fuel lines have not been manufactured to the correct specification which over time can lead to crack formation and fuel leaking. Fuel escaping in the presence of an ignition source could lead to fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the high pressure fuel lines.

mercedes-benz.defect: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR COULD RUPTURE Driver airbags equipped with non-desiccated ammonium-nitrate airbag inflators in certain climatic circumstances could over time develop a chemical alteration of the propellant.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the driver�s airbag in potentially affected vehicles

mercedes-benz.defect: THE REFRIGERANT IN THE AIR CONDITION SYSTEM DOES NOT MEET LEGAL REQUIREMENTS The refrigerant used in the air conditioning system does not meet legal requirements
mercedes-benz.remedy: The air conditioning system will be adapted for the usage of the new refrigerant.

mercedes-benz.defect: ROAD WHEEL SECURITY The wheel nuts do not meet the manufacturer's specification. This could result in road wheel loss.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the original wheel nuts with quality assured examples.

mercedes-benz.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The flange of the fuel filter may leak due to a non-compliance in the supplier's production process. Should this occur a fuel odour may arise or fuel escape.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel filter.

mercedes-benz.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It is possible that vehicles fitted with integral heaters within the fuel filter could suffer a leak in the upper plug area. This leakage should be identified to the driver by the smell of the diesel however if action is not taken to address the issue the issue could result in fuel escaping onto the road surface.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the fuel filter.

mercedes-benz.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR In certain arduous operating conditions it is possible that the air conditioning fan relay could overload and in the worst case could catch fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the air conditioning fan relay with a modified component.

mercedes-benz.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL The camshaft could break and damage the engine due to it not being manufactured to the correct specification. If the condition occurs it will lead to a sudden loss of drive thereby increasing the risk of a collision.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the intake camshaft.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE DRIVEN REAR AXLE WISHBONE ON AFFECTED VEHICLES CAN CRACK The driven rear axle wishbone on affected vehicles can crack
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check affected vehicles.  Change wishbone if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: CRACKS MAY FORM ON HOUSING OF THE HIGH-PRESSURE SIDE OF THE GAS PRESSURE REGULATOR The natural gas regulator may develop a crack
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the gas regulator on affected vehicles

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR SPRING LOWER LEAF MAY BREAK AND DETACH Due to a fault in the manufacturing process the lower leaf of the parabolic spring may break.  The leaf may detach and fall on to the road surface.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles examine spring and where necessary replace leaves.

mercedes-benz.defect: WINDSHIELD MAY DETACH It has been identified that on subject vehicles the windscreen may not have been installed to Daimler AG's strict production specifications. With the result that the windscreen may become detached.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the windscreen removed cleaned and bonded in accordance with the specification.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE HEAD RESTRAINTS OF THE LUXURY BENCH SEATS IN THE REAR MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED INCORRECTLY Bench seats in the rear may have been installed with the head restraint bars of a different bench seat and/or head restraint variant.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the head restraints in the rear area in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: CERTAIN VEHICLES MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN EQUIPPED WITH THE PRINTED OWNER'S MANUAL Certain vehicles might not have been equipped with the printed owner's manual.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Equip the affected vehicles with the owner's manual.

mercedes-benz.defect: CRUISE CONTROL MAY FAIL TO DEACTIVATE It has been identified that a fault in the brake light switch may in very rare cases cause the cruise control to not deactivate when the brake is applied.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the brake switch.

mercedes-benz.defect: FUEL LINES COULD CHAFE / BECOME DAMAGED The spacer clips on the flexible fuel lines in the engine compartment may become displaced or fall out.This could cause he fuel lines to chafe against each other and become damaged.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles Exchange clamp-type spacer clips for screw-type spacer brackets.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SOFTWARE OF THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS On certain vehicles the software of the communication module might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As a precautionary measure update the software of the communication module on the affected vehicles. This software update is planned to be performed over-the-air with no workshop visit being required.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM (eCall) DOES NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION On affected vehicles the software of the communication module for the emergency call system does not meet the specification
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system

mercedes-benz.defect: PASSENGER BENCH SEAT MAY FAIL The bolt securing the passenger seat back rest may fracture. If this happens the back rest cushion may drop. In the event of a collision the seat belt may not fully restrain the passenger as intended.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the mounting screws with additional sleeves.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE TRANSMISSION WIRING HARNESS MIGHT NOT BE ROUTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS The transmission wiring harness might not be routed according to specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Fit additional bracket to optimise the wiring routing. Check the harness connections and rework if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: LASER WELDING BETWEEN BACKREST RAIL AND BACKREST METAL FITTING OF FRONT SEATS MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION It has been determined that on certain C-Class (205) and E-Class (213) Cars with AMG performance seats the laser welding between the backrest rail and the backrest metal fitting of the driver or passenger seat might not meet the specification.  The laser welding between the backrest member and the backrest metal fitting may not withstand the required load values. As a result the fitting may detach from the backrest member. In the case of an accident this could result in a higher occupant load. Due to the delivery scenario the fault can only occur on one side of the seat.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As a precautionary measure  recall the affected vehicles and check the backrest member and replace if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: THE PASSENGER AIR BAG CUSHION MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SEWN ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION Front passenger airbag cushion may not have been sewn correctly
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace front passenger airbag on affected vehicles

mercedes-benz.defect: Various parts for the interior have been installed that lack the necessary fire certification. Various parts for the interior have been installed that lack the necessary fire certification.�
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the affected parts with alternatives that meet certification requirements.�

mercedes-benz.defect: RIVETING OF THE SEAT BELT HOUSING COVER AT FRONT SEATS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH SPECIFICATION  AND RIVETS MAY FAIL The riveting of the seat belt housing cover at the front seats may not comply with the specification.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the driver and front passenger side seat belts in the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: WHEELS  MAY DETACH It has been identified that the wheel studs of Hendrickson axles fitted with 17.5 inch wheels were tightened to a torque which was higher than that specified. It is therefore possible that the wheel studs have stretched. In this condition the wheel may no longer be secure.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject wheel studs and nuts replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR COULD RUPTURE Driver airbags equipped with non-desiccated ammonium-nitrate airbag inflators in certain climatic circumstances could over time develop a chemical alteration of the propellant.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the driver�s airbag in potentially affected vehicles

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: FRONT SEAT BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT FUNCTION The front seatbelt pre-tensioner ignitors may not perform as expected. This could increase the risk of injury to the seat occupants. The lock function of the seatbelts is not impaired.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace seatbelts with quality assured units.

mercedes-benz.defect: FAULTY PARAMETERIZATION OF EXHAUST GAS AFTERTREATMENT CONTROL UNIT Affected vehicles have a faulty parameterization of the �exhaust gas aftertreatment� control unit.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Programming update on the engine control unit.

mercedes-benz.defect: STEERING COLUMN SWITCH MODULE MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE It has been identified that the lever used to select the drive range on the steering column switch module may become inoperative due to possible damage of a circuit board. In the event of this fault occurs then manual selection of the drive range (D R N P) would no longer be possible. The Auto-P function as well as the automatic parking brake will still be available as intended. During manoeuvring the vehicle may not change the drive range as intended by the driver when operating the selector lever during standstill. This could result in an increased risk of a collision/accident.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the steering column switch module.

mercedes-benz.defect: ECU MAXIMUM ROAD SPEED LIMIT  NOT SET The maximum road speed limit was not set in the engine control unit during production.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to set the maximum road speed of the vehicle.

mercedes-benz.defect: VEHICLE MAY CUT OUT It has been identified that a possible poor contact with the fuel pump relay in the fuse and relay module unit may affect the operation of the fuel pump and cause the engine to cut out.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the manufacturing date of the fuse and relay module unit and it necessary replace it.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE HEADLIGHT ADJUSTMENT MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION The headlight adjustment might not meet the specification
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the headlight adjustment on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: INDIVIDUAL BOLTS OR CHAIN LINKS OF THE CAMSHAFT TIMING CHAIN MIGHT WEAR Individual bolts or chain links of the camshaft timing chain might wear in case of a long term operation under specific driving conditions.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the camshaft timing chain on the affected vehicles

mercedes-benz.defect: STARTING CURRENT LIMITER MAY OVERLOAD Where the car incurs severe engine damage resulting in the engine failing to turn over (engine seizure) and if the driver repeatedly attempts to start the engine despite the engine not cranking the very high electrical current could lead to overheating of the starting current limiter and the potential for a fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and install an additional fuse in the electrical line to the starter.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE DATA DOCUMENTING THE CORRECT MOUNTING OF THE TURBOCHARGER OIL FEED AS WELL AS THE OIL RETURN LINE MAY BE MISSING The HV battery pack can overheat and result in the venting of hot gas which can ignite vehicle components or in extreme cases the entire vehicle.
mercedes-benz.remedy: To prevent a vehicle fire the vehicles should not be charged using the external charging cable and the vehicles should only be driven using the default Auto EV mode only

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE TRANSMISSION WIRING HARNESS MIGHT NOT BE ROUTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS The transmission wiring harness might not be routed according to specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Fit additional bracket to optimise the wiring routing. Check the harness connections and rework if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED The brake fluid container may not have been inserted far enough into its mounts or was not secured correctly which can result in it detaching and a loss of brake fluid. The driver could become aware of this by the gradual deterioration of brake performance by having to press the brake pedal further. This can consequently increase the risk of collision.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the brake fluid reservoir on the affected vehicles to ensure it is properly engaged and if necessary fix it in the correct position.

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak. In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the rear axle casing and replace where necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: VACUUM LINE BRAKE BOOSTER MAY BREAK The connection fitting of the vacuum line to the brake booster is not to specification and my not be durable. If the connection fails the brake booster will no longer be supplied with vacuum. After a few brake applications the driver will have to apply additional pressure to the brake pedal to gain the appropriate braking effect.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the vacuum line on the brake booster with a quality assured component.

mercedes-benz.defect: SWITCHES IN CERTAIN SEAT BELT BUCKLES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED TO SPECIFICATIONS The switches in certain seat belt buckles might not have been manufactured according to specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The affected seat belt buckles are to be  replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: TWO NUTS ATTACHING THE BUSBARS WITHIN THE PREFUSE BOX IN THE TRUNK  MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED Two nuts attatching the busbars within the prefuse box may not have been installed
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the prefuse box and replace if necessary on affected vehicles

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the bolting of the 48V ground connection in the engine compartment might not be sufficiently tightened. On affected vehicles the bolting of the 48V ground connection in the engine compartment might not be sufficiently tightened.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the bolting of the ground connection and correct if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: DOORS MAY DOUBLE-LOCK UNEXPECTEDLY The double lock function for the door locks may operate even when the doors are unlocked. In this mode the interior door handles may be deactivated.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and update software.

mercedes-benz.defect: INCORRECT DOOR LOCK OPERATING LEVER ON  RIGHT SIDE OF VEHICLE MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED An incorrect operating lever might have been installed to the door locks on the right side of the vehicle.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Door locks are to be checked and replaced if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE DRIVER MIGHT TEMPORARILY NOT BE ABLE TO DEACTIVATE THE HIGH BEAM WITH THE HIGH BEAM LEVER. The driver might temporarily not be able to deactivate the high beam with the high beam lever.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The  software is to be updated on affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE ADDITIONAL LOCK FOR THE CONNECTOR OF THE SEAT BELT TENSIONER WIRING HARNESS IN THE CO DRIVER'S SEAT BENCH MAY NOT BE LOCKED The additional lock for the connector of the seat belt tensioner wiring harness in the co-driver�s seat bench may not be locked.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the condition of the additional lock and if necessary lock correctly.

mercedes-benz.defect: AN INTERNAL SENSOR WITHIN THE ELECTRIC POWER STEERING UNIT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED TO SPECIFICATIONS An internal sensor within the electric power steering unit might not have been manufactured according to specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The affected vehicles are to have the steering unit replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: ERROR IN THE DOCUMENTATION FOR SYSTEM AND VEHICLE TYPE APPROVALS Error in the documentation for system and vehicle type approvals.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Three-point seat belts have to be retro fitted to the first row of seats behind the kitchenette.

mercedes-benz.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Fuel leaks in the plug area of the drain opening may occur at the fuel filter with integrated fuel heaters.  Fuel can escape and is noticeable to the customer due to a corresponding diesel odour.  The diesel can reach the road and as a result friction between the tyres and road surface may be decreased.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check filter and replace as necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain vehicles overheating may occur at the cab to heated windscreen wiring connector plug. If not addressed and under extreme circumstances a fire may occur.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the electrical connector of the heated windscreen.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE CRANKSHAFT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS On certain vehicles with a 4-cylinder Diesel engine the crankshaft might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the engine on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: A PARTICLE IN THE FUEL RAIL MIGHT LEAD TO A LEAK BETWEEN THE FUEL RAIL AND THE INJECTOR A particle in the fuel rail might lead to a leak between the fuel rail and the fuel injector.�
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the fuel rail and fuel injectors on the affected vehicles.�

mercedes-benz.defect: DOORS ON LEFT VEHICLE SIDE (PASSENGER SIDE) REMAIN PERMANENTLY LOCKED AFTER THE VEHICLE HAS BEEN LOCKED/UNLOCKED WITH THE REMOTE CONTROL KEY Possible inability to open the left hand door externally or internally.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the affected door locks on the left side of the vehicle.

mercedes-benz.defect: PARKING LEVER MAY NOT LOCK CORRECTLY The parking lever when applied may not engage in the locked position.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a modified part to the parking brake lever assembly.

mercedes-benz.defect: FAULTY CONTROL UNIT MAY CAUSE VEHICLE TO PERFORM OUTSIDE SPECIFICATION Where a control unit coding was updated in a workshop between 3 December 2016 and 5 December 2016 the coding may not correspond to the specification and may trigger unplanned action in the vehicle. The safety and emissions systems may not react as design intent.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the software in the corresponding control units.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the oil supply for the rear axle drive shaft bearing might not meet specifications. On affected vehicles the oil supply for the rear axle drive shaft bearing might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the rear axle differential housing cover.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SOFTWARE OF THE TRANSMISSION CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATION. Under certain circumstances it might not be possible to shift into Drive or Reverse mode.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the transmission control unit software of the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: A LOCK NUT MAY BE CRACKED IN THE STEERING GEAR A lock nut may be cracked in the steering gear.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The electric power steering is to be checked and if necessary replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE WIRING HARNESS SHIELD MAY NOT PERMANENTLY WITHSTAND THE ELECTRICAL LOADS THAT ARE INDUCED UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING PROFILES The shield for the high-voltage wiring harness may not permanently withstand the electrical loads that are induced under certain driving profiles
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the high-voltage wiring harness on the affected vehicles

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SCREW CONNECTION ON THE UPPER HOOD CATCH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CARRIED OUT CORRECTLY The screw connection of the upper hood (bonnet) catch may not have been secured properly
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the torque of the screw connection and replace any missing screws if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: The function of the brake booster might be affected due to advanced corrosion in the joint area of its housing. The function of the brake booster might be affected due to advanced corrosion in the joint area of its housing.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace brake booster in vehicles that have not passed XENTRY test and require part replacement.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF FIRE This recall covers two defects:  1. The electrical cable may chafe at the bracket of the engine control unit.  This may cause a malfunction in some electrical systems. In a worst case the chafing could lead to a short circuit between un-fused positive cables and the bracket with a resultant risk of fire. 2. The oil dipstick guide tube on these vehicles is used for possible oil extraction. In some circumstances it is possible engine oil can escape via the oil dip stick guide creating a fire risk.
mercedes-benz.remedy: 1. Install an edge guard at the bracket of the engine control unit to prevent chafing of the engine/transmission wiring harness.  2. Retrofit an optimised stop plug for the oil dipstick guide tube.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BONDING BETWEEN THE GLASS PANEL AND THE SLIDING ROOF FRAME MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The bonding between the glass panel and the sliding roof frame might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the glass panel bonding on the affected vehicles and replace the sliding roof if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: ENGINE  COULD  LOSE POWER. The electrical connection in the interior of the crankshaft sensor's chip housing may be interrupted which may result in loss of power and the inability to restart engine
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace crankshaft sensor

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL251215 – VER-RADBLE As part of our ongoing quality monitoring we have determined that on Actros 963 and eActros 983 vehicles the rear wheel arch cover on the front axle could fall off. A design-related plastic rib that is too high leads to a collision between the wheel arch cover and the fender. Due to the excessively high plastic rib on the rear wheel arch cover of the front axle this may be installed with preload and thus some fastening points may not be fully engaged. As a consequence the engaged fastening points of the wheel arch cover may fracture and the wheel arch cover (931 mm x 652 mm x 70 mm approx. 1.81 kg) may completely detach from the vehicle and fall off due to the dynamic load during driving operation. This may increase the risk of accidents for other road users.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the recall campaign the excessively high plastic rib must be shortened on the potentially affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: MDEG/HDEP Euro VI standard NOx sensor monitoring inoperative The EU directive for commercial vehicles with the Euro 6 emissions standard stipulates that the NOx sensor signal is regularly checked for plausibility. The IUPR monitor (In Use Performance Ratio) was defined for this purpose. At a minimum 50% of vehicles in a class must have this monitor be active at least 10% of the possible time. This is not the case for the affected vehicles. Cause Parameter error in data record creation.
mercedes-benz.remedy: To remedy this an update software version in engine management (MCM) and exhaust gas aftertreatment (ACM) control units is required.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL250829 – Replace front axle springs – 2BLAFEVA As part of our continuous quality monitoring we have found that the leaf springs of the front axle could break on Actros 963 vehicles.  The cause of the breakage may be edge corrosion due to insufficient descaling or surface defects during the rolling process. Each of the two fault profiles can cause a fracture independently of the other.   The defective part analysis indicates that edge corrosion may result from scale residues not fully removed during the supplier's production run. Additionally the fault profile reveals that surface defects occurring during the rolling process—specifically near the edge—coincide with the initiation of breakage which is attributed to system malfunctions at the supplier's end.  The progressive edge corrosion or the surface defects from the rolling process can lead to material fatigue in the affected area. Failure of the component or breakage at the heavily stressed points of the lower leaf spring could be the consequence. Partial component loss during driving operation cannot be ruled out. The size of a potentially lost leaf spring part depends on the individual fracture pattern. This can increase the risk of an accident.
mercedes-benz.remedy: In the scope of the recall campaign both leaf springs of the front axle must be replaced on the potentially affected vehicles as a precautionary measure.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL250303 – Retrofit screws for stabilizer link bearing bracket on vehicle frame BEF-ACHSL Actros 963 and Arocs 964 models depending on the model designation up to two screws per installed axle bearing bracket may be missing. The axle bearing bracket guides the rear axle in the longitudinal direction of the vehicle. Spontaneous failure of the threaded connection can be ruled out. According to the Development department’s assessment loosening of the installed screws is possible at the earliest after approx. 600000 km.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the recall action it must be checked whether all specified threaded connections are present on the axle bearing brackets on the potentially affected vehicles. If not the missing threaded connections must be retrofitted and tightened to the specified torque.

mercedes-benz.remedy: .Affected vehicles will be recalled to be checked to ensure there is sufficient grounding of the steering components.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SEAT BELT WARNING FUNCTION DOES NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION The seat belt warning function does not meet the specification

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the manufacturing of the wiring harness to the power electronics might not meet specifications. On affected vehicles the manufacturing of the wiring harness to the power electronics might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED It is possible that the differential lock switches may have been supplied with a defective printed circuit board. mercedes-benz.defect: THE EMBOSSED LOCK SYMBOL AT THE OPERATING LEVER OF THE CHILD SAFETY LOCK AT THE REAR DOORS MAY INDICATE WRONG LOCKING STATUS The embossed lock symbol at the operating lever of the child safety lock at the rear doors might indicate the wrong locking status.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the voltage converter software of the secondary on-board electrical system might not meet specifications. On affected vehicles the voltage converter software of the secondary on-board electrical system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: ENGINE EMERGENCY SHUT OFF ON BOARD DIAGNOSIS OR TANK/SPEEDO SIGNAL MAY BE AFFECTED Possibility of transfer of incorrect control unit software which could affect engine shut off control in an emergency situation or the on board diagnosis system or tank/speedometer signal

mercedes-benz.defect: TOOL MARKS MAY OCCUR ON THE OIL PRESSURE LINE OF THE TURBOCHARGER WHICH MAY CAUSE AN OIL LEAK Tool marks may occur on the oil pressure line of the turbocharger which may cause an oil leak.

mercedes-benz.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR A seal between bonnet and engine compartment may when the bonnet is opened temporarily stick to the bonnet. If this happens the seal may detach form its fixing and can fall into the gap between engine and partition wall. It is then possible the seal can make contact with the exhaust and under certain conditions catch fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles install additional clips to retain the seal.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE MAXIMUM PERMISSIBLE ROOF LOAD OF 150 KG IS NOT DOCUMENTED IN THE OPERATING MANUAL The maximum permissible roof load is not documented in the operating manual
mercedes-benz.remedy: The vehicle operating manuals are to be exchanged. For all vehicles with canopies installed the corresponding accessory operating manual will also be exchanged

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SUSPENSION ROLLER PISTON MAY DETACH FROM THE AXLE It may be possible that the suspension roller piston detaches from the axle.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The screw connection of the roller piston on all axles has to be retightened to the torque of 92Nm.

mercedes-benz.defect: COMBUSTION ENGINE MAY FAIL TO START Incorrect software may cause the combustion engine to non start during use. Restarting the vehicle by using the key will reset the system
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles update the software for the fuel control unit.

mercedes-benz.defect: CERTAIN FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION A correctly fastened seat belt could be detected as not fastened impairing the restraint system
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the relevant seat belt buckles in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR VENT WINDOW COULD DETACH It has been identified that the pane of the rear vent window could work loose from both of the front supports. As a result it is possible that the window could detach from the body and fall away.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have both rear vent windows replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: BRAKE PEDAL  TO MASTER CYLINDER CLEVIS PIN CAN BECOME DETACHED The clevis pin which secures the brake master cylinder push rod to the brake pedal cross shaft may become detached due to the possible non-fitment of the securing clip.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE RIGHT HANDLE FOR ATTACHING THE CHILD SEAT TO THE ISOFIX BRACKET MAY BE MISSING ON THE REAR RIGHT SEAT The ISOFIX bracket might be missing on the right rear seat.

The controllability of the vehicle could therefore be impaired.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the tightening of the brake calliper holder and correct if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: CAB SUSPENSION SCREWS TO BE TIGHTENED Screw connections between the cab stabiliser and stabiliser link may not be tightened to the correct specification.
mercedes-benz.remedy: A retightening of the screws with an additional tightening angle of at least 60 degrees will be carried out on potentially affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak.In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace rear axle casing.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE LEFT REAR SEAT BACKREST LOCK MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The left rear seat backrest lock might not meet the specifications

mercedes-benz.defect: VEHICLES WITH AN OM654 ENGINE MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE BETWEEN THE VACUUM SYSTEM AND THE COOLANT CIRCUIT On certain vehicles with a Diesel engine the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.�

mercedes-benz.defect: THERE MAY BE A MALFUNCTION OF THE NEUTRAL POSITION SWITCH ON VEHICLES WITH A MANUAL TRANSMISSION The parking brake may be released due to an electrical fault in the neutral position switch.

mercedes-benz.defect: A PARTICLE IN THE FUEL RAIL MIGHT LEAD TO A LEAK BETWEEN THE FUEL RAIL AND THE INJECTOR A particle in the fuel rail might lead to a leak between the fuel rail and the fuel injector.�

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL260522 – AGM-BATT – Check printed circuit board on battery for damage As part of our continuous quality monitoring we have identified that in Actros 963 Arocs 964 vehicles with integral rear area and eActros 300/400 with fleece battery (absorbent glass mat) a thermal reaction may occur due to corrosion on the ACE chip (Advanced Connected Energy). Battery data can be evaluated via a Bluetooth interface using the integrated ACE chip. During assembly of the ACE chip at the supplier’s premises it is inserted into the recess provided between the battery terminals poured with resin (liquid plastic) and closed with the battery cover to protect against corrosion in a fully automated and quantity-controlled process. When filling with resin there may have been an insufficient fill level in the niche as well as an ACE chip inserted at an angle. The exposed connection points of the supply lines or the chip itself may corrode due to inadequate sealing. A corroded connection or corroded ACE chip may lead to increased electrical transitional resistance which may trigger a thermal reaction leading to a battery fire. In the worst case flames may spread to surrounding components or the vehicle. There is a risk of fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check printed circuit board in on-board electrical system battery for damage. Replace on-board electrical system battery (after check) if necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL260624 – LESCHUSTA – Check drag link Through a self-disclosure by the supplier ZF Friedrichshafen AG Daimler Truck AG was informed that there may have been a manufacturing deviation in vehicles of the models Atego 967 Actros 963 Arocs 964 and eActros 983 on the ball joints that are installed in steering components (e. g. drag links steering links tie rods). It cannot be ruled out that individual components did not fully undergo the prescribed hardening process and have therefore gotten into vehicles with insufficient material hardness. This may result in increased wear and in later phases reduced fatigue strength to the point of a possible fatigue fracture which would probably occur at low speeds with high steering forces (e.g. when maneuvering). In the event of such a fracture vehicle can no longer be steered and there would be a risk of accident.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of our planned recall campaign and as a precautionary measure we want to check whether insufficiently hardened components were installed in the potentially affected vehicles. Insufficiently hardened components will be replaced as part of the check.

mercedes-benz.defect: Impairment of display messages in the instrument cluster (ICUC Gen6) on B2E vehicles On vehicles equipped with the B2E electrical/electronic architecture and the ICUC Gen6 instrument cluster certain status and fault messages are not consistently displayed to the driver in the ICUC. The root cause is an error in the adaptation of the filter logic for messages originating from control units and the Vehicle Message Matrix (VMM) during the transition from ICUC Gen5 to ICUC Gen6. Among others fault messages from the ACM (Aftertreatment Control Module) and the VRDU3 (Video Radar Decision Unit) control units are affected. As a result it cannot be ruled out that individual warning messages required for the safe and proper operation of the vehicle and/or mandated by legislation may not be displayed reliably.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Remedy is to correct the failure through a software update

mercedes-benz.defect: SRC260709 – RC2502 – Failure of turn signal lamp in main headlamp As part of our continuous product monitoring we have identified that due to insufficient contact pressure from the front turn signal indicator socket inside the headlamp unit loss of contact may occur during driving operation. As a consequence of the loss of contact thermal damage may occur on the sockets' contact surfaces which may cause the turn signal indicator to fail. There is currently no information on damage or accidents that are connected to the fault profile mentioned.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the planned product safety recall the bulb holders of the turn signal lamps of both main headlamps on the potentially affected vehicles will be checked and replaced if found to be defective.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRC260720 – RC2603 – Replacment of the IAB brake actuator on the rear axle As part of our continuous product monitoring we have identified that the affected vehicles were delivered with a faulty batch of parking brake actuators the movement of which may be restricted due to dimensional inaccuracies.  In this process there may be malfunctions such as the warning lamp lighting up seized or abrading rear-wheel brakes and even locking rear-wheel brakes.  In the worst case there may be a risk of fire due to increased heat development.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the planned recall campaign the model plates of the brake actuators on the brake calipers of the rear axle undergo a visual check. If the findings indicate this the affected brake actuators will be replaced. The replacement parts required for the recall are not expected to be available until October 2026. Please use regular replacement parts if vehicles fail in the meantime due to the above-mentioned problem.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRC260707 – RC2602 – Check replace the link rod on the upper supporting joint As part of our continuous product monitoring we have identified that a defined production batch of the link rod for the upper supporting joint has not acquired the required material hardness in the production process due to insufficient inductive hardening. This may reduce the strength of the component and in extreme cases lead to fracture. Even after a fracture the brakes and steering continue to operate so that the vehicle can be driven to a safe location.However a potential fragment may end up on the roadway creating a safety risk for following traffic.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check replace the link rod on the upper supporting joint.

Even after a fracture the brakes and steering continue to operate so that the vehicle can be driven to a safe location.However a potential fragment may end up on the roadway creating a safety risk for following traffic.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check replace the link rod on the upper supporting joint.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE REAR AXLE STEEL LEAF SPRINGS MAY NOT MEET ALL REQUIREMENTS FOR STRENGTH DURING OPERATION The rear axle steel leaf springs may not meet all requirements for strength during operation
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check if the rear axle springs on the affected vehicles are a part of an affected production batch and replace them if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SUSPENSION ROLLER PISTON MAY DETACH FROM THE AXLE It may be possible that the suspension roller piston detaches from the axle.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The screw connection of the roller piston on all axles has to be retightened to the torque of 92Nm.

mercedes-benz.defect: INCORRECT MOUNTING INSTRUCTIONS SUPPLIED FOR RETROFITTING A TRAILER COUPLING Incorrect specified tightening torque for the mounting screws of a cross member to be installed in conjunction with towbar fitment.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Mounting bolts on the trailer coupling are to be replaced if already fitted. Instructions to be updated on supplied kits.

mercedes-benz.defect: STARTING CURRENT LIMITER MAY OVERLOAD Where the car incurs severe engine damage resulting in the engine failing to turn over (engine seizure) and if the driver repeatedly attempts to start the engine despite the engine not cranking the very high electrical current could lead to overheating of the starting current limiter and the potential for a fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and install an additional fuse in the electrical line to the starter.

mercedes-benz.defect: STEERING MAY BE ADVERSELY AFFECTED It has been identified that the incorrect mounting bracket for the power assisted steering pump may have been installed. This can cause misalignment of the pump and cause wear to the drive mechanism. This could result in the failure of the drive shaft and subsequent loss of power assistance for the steering.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the power assisted steering pump bracket and if require replace the bracket pump and drive shaft.

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR BENCH SEAT MAY LIFT UP FROM THE REAR IN A COLLISION & ATTACHED SEAT BELTS MAY NOT BE ANCHORED CORRECTLY On 'B' Class models fitted with 'Easy Vario' rear seat option a bolt securing the seat bench to the body may have been omitted during production. This may allow the seat bench to lift during a frontal collision.  Seat belt effectiveness may also be compromised.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles check for presence and tightness of retaining screws. Fit new screws where necessary and tighten all screws to specification.

mercedes-benz.defect: SEAT BASE MAY CRACK The Front radius angles in the driver�s and passenger metal seat base may not have been formed correctly and as a result the seat base may suffer from stress cracks which could compromise the strength of the seat base in the unlikely event of a rear end collision. The seat belt system is an integrated part of the seat.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the driver and passenger seat bases.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE COOLANT PUMP MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE. On certain vehicles the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles. Additionally a check of the vacuum system for possible contamination with coolant or engine oil will be carried out as a precautionary measure for the vehicles in this recall without the so-called fail-boost function on the ESP system.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the fuel pump impeller might not meet specifications and may deform. On affected vehicles the fuel pump impeller might not meet specifications and may deform.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the fuel pump module.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE CRANKSHAFT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS On certain vehicles with a 4-cylinder Diesel engine the crankshaft might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the engine on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: AN ELECTRICAL CONTACT INSIDE THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION An electrical contacting inside the engine control unit might not meet the specification
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the engine control unit on the affected vehicles

mercedes-benz.defect: A LOCK NUT MAY BE CRACKED IN THE STEERING GEAR A lock nut may be cracked in the steering gear.
mercedes-benz.remedy: The electric power steering is to be checked and if necessary replaced.

mercedes-benz.defect: POTENTIAL  OIL LEAK FROM TRANSMISSION OIL COOLER LINES It has been determined that it is possible that the connectors for the transmission oil cooler lines were not pressed together in accordance with specifications. As a result the transmission oil cooler lines could work loose while driving and transmission oil could leak out. Because of a deviation in the supplier�s production process it is possible that the connectors on transmission oil cooler lines from two specific batches were not pressed together in accordance with specifications.  In this case the vehicle could possibly lose propulsion due to oil loss in the transmission. The escaping oil could get onto the roadway thus increasing the risk of an accident for following traffic. Also it cannot be excluded that escaping transmission oil could come into contact with hot component parts of the exhaust system and ignite
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the transmission oil cooler lines and replace them if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: STEERING COULD BE IMPAIRED It has been established that the service life of the ABC (Active Body Control) suspension lower ball joint on the front suspension struts does not meet Mercedes-Benz strict quality requirements.  In cases of extreme loads the joint could fail which could possibly result in the vehicle losing directional control.  Reports of this issue have only occur on very high mileages vehicle which have had been subject to use in rough conditions.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the ball joint on the front suspension struts and replace the ball joints where necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: WINDOWBAG SYSTEM MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY It has been identified that the side window airbags on the Citan Crewbus are possible working to the extremes of its operating tolerance. Therefore if the vehicle was to be involved in a collision then the airbags may not deploy correctly.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to improve the operation of the side window airbag system.

mercedes-benz.defect: AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT CONNECTION   MAY NOT BE MANUFACTURED TO SPECIFICATION The connector pins of the occupant classification system to the airbag control unit might have been manufactured outside specification. After a period of time this may cause decativation of the passnger airbag.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the connector pins of the occupant classification system.

mercedes-benz.defect: STEERING SHAFT MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION Due to an error in the manufacturing process the lower steering shaft universal joint may not have been produced to the correct specification. Under heavy steering forces it is possible for the column shaft to move within the universal joint connection.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check dimensions of the universal joint and column shaft and replace where necessary.

mercedes-benz.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT Cracks in the charge air hose may possibly occur. This may subsequently lead to the engine switching to limp-home mode. In rare individual cases the engine shutting off cannot be ruled out.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the charge air hose.

mercedes-benz.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY SELF RELEASE The handbrake button may become sticky in operation and in certain circumstances may result in self release of the handbrake.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the handbrake lever.

mercedes-benz.defect: SOME ENGINE AND BODY GROUND CONNECTIONS MAY NOT BE SECURED TO SPECIFICATION Some Engine and Body ground connections may not be secured to specification.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the ground connections and if necessary tighten them according to specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the screw connection of the partition wall might not meet specifications. On affected vehicles the screw connection of the partition wall might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Check and rework the screw connections

mercedes-benz.defect: THE REFRIGERANT USED IN THE AIR CONDITION SYSTEM DOES NOT MEET LEGAL REQUIREMENTS The refrigerant used in the air conditioning system does not meet legal requirements.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Adapt the air conditioning system for usage of the new refrigerant.

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR SERVICE BRAKE MAY FAIL TO ACTIVATE AND ALLOW  VEHICLE TO ROLL BACKWARDS Affected vehicles may experience a lack of braking control on the rear axle when reverse gear is engaged.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a pneumatic control system.

mercedes-benz.defect: WHEEL FLANGES MAY SPLIT The wheel flanges may not be of sufficient strength and may split.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit modified wheels.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF FIRE On vehicles fitted with the four cylinder (OM651) engine the high pressure fuel lines may not have been manufactured to specifications. These lines may crack and allow fuel to leak. If an ignition source is present there is a risk of fire.

mercedes-benz.defect: MOUNTED SUSPENSION STRUTS ARE NOT SUFFICIENTLY REINFORCED The mounted suspension struts are not sufficiently reinforced.

mercedes-benz.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE The torque sensor of the electric power steering assistance may be damaged which can adversely affected the tightness of the housing and allow water ingress. The defect could lead to failure of the torque sensor and consequently shut off the steering power assistance and lead to an elevated risk of collision.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicle that is likely to be affected and replace the electric power steering.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE RIGIDITY VALUES OF THE SUPPORT SLEEVES ON THE THREADED CONNECTION OF THE HIGH-PRESSURE  FUEL LINES MAY BE LOWER THAN THE PRESCRIBED VALUES High-pressure fuel lines may Leak

mercedes-benz.defect: FRONT SEAT BELT END FITTING MAY NOT BE MOUNTED CORRECTLY Front seat belt may not be mounted correctly

mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace crankshaft sensor

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BALL TYPE TOW-BAR DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE FATIGUE STRENGTH It may be possible that the ball type tow-bar does not meet the requirements of the fatigue strength.

mercedes-benz.defect: EMISSION OUTPUT REQUIRES IMPROVEMENT Emission output requires improvement

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: STEERING RELAY IDLER ARM MAY FAIL The possibility exists that stress failure of the steering idler arm may occur which may result in defective steering control.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE VARIANT OF SPARK PLUGS INSTALLED MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The variant of spark plugs installed may not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: INSTRUMENT PANEL MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING The ground cable lug attached to the engine mounting bolt may break as a result of vibrations and oscillations combined with the tension caused through the routing of the cable.   Should this concern occur it is possible in the worst case scenario for the vehicle to become completely de-energised. This means a sudden failure of the instrument panel vehicle illumination the hazard warning system and the engine shuts down thereby increasing the risk of a collision.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and correct the routing of the ground line and additionally to replace the present lugs on the affected cables.

mercedes-benz.defect: SOFTWARE OF ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS On certain vehicles the software of the engine control unit might not meet specifications.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles conduct an update of the software on the engine control unit.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: Diodes were soldered onto the circuit board of 258 accelerator pedals instead of transistors during the accelerator pedal supplier s assembly process Diodes were soldered onto the circuit board of some accelerator pedals instead of transistors during the accelerator pedal supplier�s assembly process.

mercedes-benz.defect: OIL MAY LEAK On certain diesel engines the  'O' ring may not have been produced to the correct specification. This may allow oil to leak and contaminate the environment. If excessive oil is lost engine damage may occur.

mercedes-benz.remedy: As a precautionary measure update the software of the communication module on the affected vehicles. This software update is planned to be performed over-the-air with no workshop visit being required.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE RIGIDITY VALUES OF THE SUPPORT SLEEVES ON THE THREADED CONNECTION OF THE HIGH-PRESSURE  FUEL LINES MAY BE LOWER THAN THE PRESCRIBED VALUES High-pressure fuel lines may Leak

mercedes-benz.defect: THE FIXATION OF THE REAR HEADRESTS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The fixation of the rear headrests might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: AN INCORRECT DIAMETER REAR AXLE TORSION BAR (ANTI ROLL BAR) MIGHT BE INSTALLED An incorrect diameter rear axle torsion bar (anti roll bar) might be installed.

mercedes-benz.defect: AN ELECTRICAL CONTACT INSIDE THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION An electrical contacting inside the engine control unit might not meet the specification

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL250616 – Check serial number of the electric power steering pump for trailing axle – SCHKAEHPS1 As part of our continuous quality monitoring we have found that a thermal reaction may occur at the battery connection bolts of the electronically controlled power steering pump (EHPS (Electrohydraulic Power Steering)) of the trailing axle on vehicles of models eActros 983 and eEconic 956. The two battery connection points of the electronically controlled power steering pump of the trailing axle are located at the bottom in the installation position and are provided with a cover cap to protect against contact. Rain and splash water can collect in the cover cap. The water can no longer drain off due to missing drain holes. Because the battery connection points are standing in water electrochemical corrosion occurs that decomposes the bolts beyond the usual surface corrosion of the components. As a result of the corroded contact surface the transitional resistance at the terminal stud to the battery line increases and energy is released in the form of heat. Depending on the intensity and duration of the thermal reaction the battery lines and the circuit board of the electronically controlled power steering pump could ignite and in an unfavourable case flames could spread to surrounding components or the vehicle. This may increase the risk of fire. Failure of the electronically controlled power steering pump of the trailing axle has only minor effects on driving operation. There are only restrictions when reversing which however correspond to the operation of a non-steerable trailing axle. The turning circle could also be increased. However this is hardly noticeable to the driver.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the recall campaign the electronically controlled power steering pump and the cover cap must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL250617 – Check electrical connection of the electric power steering pump for trailing axle – SCHKAEHPS2 A thermal reaction may occur at the battery connection bolts of the electronically controlled power steering pump (EHPS (Electrohydraulic Power Steering)) of the trailing axle on vehicles of models eActros 983 and eEconic 956. The two battery connection points of the electronically controlled power steering pump of the trailing axle are located at the bottom in the installation position and are provided with a cover cap to protect against contact. Rain and splash water can collect in the cover cap. The water can no longer drain off due to missing drain holes. Because the battery connection points are standing in water electrochemical corrosion occurs that decomposes the bolts beyond the usual surface corrosion of the components. As a result of the corroded contact surface the transitional resistance at the terminal stud to the battery line increases and energy is released in the form of heat. Depending on the intensity and duration of the thermal reaction the battery lines and the circuit board of the electronically controlled power steering pump could ignite and in an unfavourable case flames could spread to surrounding components or the vehicle. This may increase the risk of fire. Failure of the electronically controlled power steering pump of the trailing axle has only minor effects on driving operation. There are only restrictions when reversing which however correspond to the operation of a non-steerable trailing axle. The turning circle could also be increased. However this is hardly noticeable to the driver.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the recall campaign the cover caps on the affected vehicles must be replaced with cover caps with a water drain hole and the battery terminal studs must be cleaned and sealed with corrosion protection spray.

mercedes-benz.defect: MDEG/HDEP Euro VI standard NOx sensor monitoring inoperative The EU directive for commercial vehicles with the Euro 6 emissions standard stipulates that the NOx sensor signal is regularly checked for plausibility. The IUPR monitor (In Use Performance Ratio) was defined for this purpose. At a minimum 50% of vehicles in a class must have this monitor be active at least 10% of the possible time. This is not the case for the affected vehicles. Cause Parameter error in data record creation.

mercedes-benz.defect: SRL251215 – VER-RADBLE As part of our ongoing quality monitoring we have determined that on Actros 963 and eActros 983 vehicles the rear wheel arch cover on the front axle could fall off. A design-related plastic rib that is too high leads to a collision between the wheel arch cover and the fender. Due to the excessively high plastic rib on the rear wheel arch cover of the front axle this may be installed with preload and thus some fastening points may not be fully engaged. As a consequence the engaged fastening points of the wheel arch cover may fracture and the wheel arch cover (931 mm x 652 mm x 70 mm approx. 1.81 kg) may completely detach from the vehicle and fall off due to the dynamic load during driving operation. This may increase the risk of accidents for other road users.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As part of the recall campaign the excessively high plastic rib must be shortened on the potentially affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: Title of Recall	SRL250925 – Change parameters in front radar sensor (RDF) control unit – RDF-HOE As part of our continuous quality monitoring we have identified that the vehicle-specific RDF3 (radar front end) installation height value has not been parameterized in Econic 956 Actros 963 Arocs 964 Atego 967 and eActros 983 model vehicles. Instead of the vehicle-specific installation height value a substitute value of 1 m has been entered. The substitute value is always higher than the actual installation situation. RDF3 is responsible for object recognition detecting clearance as well as close and long-range processing. It can also detect the ability to drive under and over objects which enables a radar-only reaction as part of the ABA functionality. Since the sensor value is parameterized higher than the actual installation height trucks ahead may not be detected particularly on inclines. This may lead to the fact that automatic braking by the ABA may not being triggered. Furthermore incorrect parameterization may lead to objects on the ground such as tracks manhole covers etc. being erroneously detected as obstacles causing ABA to brake the vehicle. This may increase the risk of accident.
mercedes-benz.remedy: As a permanent measure we wish to determine the installation height of the RDF3 manually and parameterize the determined value in potentially affected vehicles as part of this recall campaign.

mercedes-benz.defect: Bevel Gear installed with Wrong Ratio The wrong bevel gear may be installed on the front axle steering. The required gear ratio for HD HDH SHD RHD and Intouro is 1.117:1. A Bevel gear with ratio of 1:1 was installed. For eCitaro models the reverse misinstallation may have occurred. If a 1:1 bevel gear is installed instead of 1.117:1 the wheel steering angles required in accordance with UN ECE-R 79 (section 6.2.5) in the event of a steering system failure can no longer be achieved. Since the calculated vehicle movement does not exactly match the actual vehicle movement in a event of fault unauthorized intervention by the ESP or in articulated buses the articulation angle control (ATC) is also conceivable. This could lead to a sudden reduction of drive torque and braking of individual wheels which may impair the ability to maintain the intended driving direction. A risk to other road users therefore cannot be ruled out.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Remedy is to check the bevel gear and replace them with a correct version if necessary

mercedes-benz.defect: Emergency Valve may malfunction It has been determined that the external emergency valves may malfunction. The issue is caused by an excessively large bore diameter in a component of the door control valve. Because the diameter lies outside the specified tolerance (0.74 mm instead of the required 0.65 mm) compressed air flows back faster than the system can vent. Consequently the pneumatic self‑holding mechanism does not release and the door can only be opened if the internal emergency valve is actuated first. If the external emergency valve is actuated first the defect may prevent the door from opening. In an emergency this could hinder the evacuation of passengers by rescue services.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Remedy is to replace the door control valves on all doors on affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF CARBON MONOXIDE POISONING AND/OR FIRE On the affected vehicles the end pipe of the auxiliary air heater may not have been routed correctly due to a cut out in the vehicle floor that is possibly missing.  Exhaust from the auxiliary air heater is possibly not correctly diverted under the vehicle floor and could to some extent enter the vehicle interior. There is a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning and a risk of fire for the under floor panelling cannot be ruled out.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check for the presence of the cut out on the affected vehicles and drill this if necessary. Also the correct routing for the end pipe must be checked and where necessary corrected.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS On certain vehicles the behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF FIRE The high pressure fuel lines have not been manufactured to the correct specification which over time can lead to crack formation and fuel leaking. Fuel escaping in the presence of an ignition source could lead to fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the high pressure fuel lines.

mercedes-benz.defect: FRONT SEATS MAY NOT BE SECURED ACORDING TO SPECIFICATION The threaded connections to the rear of the front seats may not have been tightened correctly. In the case of a serious vehicle accident the seat connection may not function as designed resulting in an elevated risk of injury to the occupants.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary correct the torque of the connections at the rear of the front seats.

mercedes-benz.defect: SOME OCCUPANT SAFETY SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION Due to incorrect wiring assembly the vehicles main power supply is disconnected after airbag deployment. This will affect the operation of vehicle safety functions such as automatically unlocking doors. The SRS systems are still functional.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out manufacturer's recommended modification.

mercedes-benz.defect: STEERING POWER ASSIST MAY DEACTIVATE The connector on the electric power steering control unit may not be properly sealed against water entry. If water enters the control unit the power steering assistance can be lost. The steering assistance not working could increase the risk of collision.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the plug housing of the electric power steering.

mercedes-benz.defect: TO ACHIEVE AN IMPROVEMENT IN THE  EMISSIONS Daimler AG has come to an understanding with the (KBA) to achieve an improvement in the emissions.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Update the diesel engine control unit software.

mercedes-benz.defect: FAULTY CONTROL UNIT MAY CAUSE VEHICLE TO PERFORM OUTSIDE SPECIFICATION Where a control unit coding was updated in a workshop between 3 December 2016 and 5 December 2016 the coding may not correspond to the specification and may trigger unplanned action in the vehicle. The safety and emissions systems may not react as design intent.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the software in the corresponding control units.

mercedes-benz.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain Sprinter 907 910 model vehicles the software of the instrument cluster control unit does not correspond with the latest series production configuration On affected vehicles the instrument cluster may fail when starting.� Displays such as the speedometer fuel level indicator lamps and warning messages as well as the warning tones would not function.

mercedes-benz.defect: INCORRECTLY IMPLEMENTED THREADED CONNECTION OF THE PROPELLER SHAFT INTERMEDIATE BEARINGS AT THE UNDERBODY The threaded connection of the propeller shaft intermediate bearings at the underbody has not been verifiably documented in certain Sprinter vehicles.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Renew the screws of the propeller shaft intermediate bearing and tighten them with the specified torque in the affected vehicles.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MAY  BE DEACTIVATED The communication module may be deactivated

mercedes-benz.defect: ROTATING FRONT SEAT WIRE FIXINGS CAN LOOSEN It has been determined that on Vito models with rotating front seats (SA codes SB5/SB6) the front seats can loosen the wire fixings under the seats when being rotated.  Should the wiring harness be damaged in the worst-case scenario this could lead to deactivation of the thorax bag or to unintentional triggering of the thorax bag in the case of a short circuit caused in the process. A disarmed thorax bag is indicated via the SRS indicator lamp. The reason for this is the technical concept which allows for flexible cable harness installation depending on the seat mounting.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Since the beginning of June 2017 the series has protected the wiring from jamming and damage by using an optimized mounting clip. We will recall and bring the installation of the cables under the swivel seats on the affected vehicles up to the optimized current series status.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: VEHICLE MAY CUT OUT In rare cases the propulsion control unit may send an incorrect message. This may cause the electric power train to shut down. Power can be restored by the normal start sequence.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE WIRING HARNESS SHIELD MAY NOT PERMANENTLY WITHSTAND THE ELECTRICAL LOADS THAT ARE INDUCED UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING PROFILES The shield for the high-voltage wiring harness may not permanently withstand the electrical loads that are induced under certain driving profiles

mercedes-benz.defect: A CENTRALISING SLEEVE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED BETWEEN THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISION AND THE DIRECT SHIFT MODULE Automatic transmission Direct Shift Module fault. Vehicle may roll away or drive in a direction not intended.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the fuel pump impeller might not meet specifications and may deform. On affected vehicles the fuel pump impeller might not meet specifications and may deform.

mercedes-benz.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF CONTROL The control unit for the steered trailing axle may crack due to a warped fixing bracket and allow the ingress of moisture.This may cause a short circuit. Normally a yellow fault message will appear and the system will immediately default to safe passive steering mode. However it is possible the defect may have an adverse affect on the performance of the axle whilst the vehicle is in motion.
mercedes-benz.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the control unit bracket Check and if necessary replace the control unit.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SOFTWARE OF THE RADAR CONTROL UNIT MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION ; The software of the radar control unit might not meet the specification

mercedes-benz.defect: EXIT DOOR MAY TRAP PASSENGERS The anti-trap sensor on the exit door's leading edge may not operate as intended. This could trap a person or object in the door during closing
mercedes-benz.remedy: Adjust and modify door closing operation.

mercedes-benz.defect: ELECTRICAL STSTEMS AND LIGHTS MAY FAIL The power supply lines for the cab electrical system may not be fastened correctly at the electrical connecting point mounted on the cab firewall and as a result may be loose. A loose cable can cause implausible displays and fault messages and a complete detachment from the connecting point can lead to a complete failure of the vehicle electronics including the lights.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the fastening for the power supply at the electrical connecting point and if necessary correct the fastening and connections.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
