mercedes-benz.defect: TYRE MAY DELAMINATE DUE TO OVERHEATING If has been identified that a certain batch of tyres may be affected by progressive damage which may cause the tyre tread to detach and adversely affect the control of the vehicle. The separated tread could also adversely affect other road users.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to have tyres from the affected batches. All tyres fitted to the vehicle are to be checked including the spare. The tyres that are in the affected batches are to be changed out.

mercedes-benz.defect: REAR-AXLE SUSPENSION LEVEL SENSOR MAY BREAK On E Class vehicles without AIRMATIC blocking of the level sensor linkage may occur. In extreme cases this may lead to breakage of the level sensor linkage. The linkage is used to measure the vehicle level via a sensor. If the linkage breaks it is possible the level sensor constantly records a vehicle level that is too low. This leads to a contact pressure rise in both air spring bellows and to hardening of the rear-axle suspension causing a noticeable loss in comfort.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the level sensor linkage on these vehicles as a precautionary measure.

mercedes-benz.defect: RISK OF FIRE On vehicles fitted with the OM646 engine it is possible that an Air Conditioning (AC) hose bracket could chaff the wiring harness for the three phase alternator. If this is not rectified there is a possible risk of a short circuit which may result in a fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check for damage to the wiring and replacement if found damaged plus the installation of an additional spacer clamp.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE REAR TAILGATE SPOILER MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The rear spoiler located above the tailgate might have been manufactured outside specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: THE SOFTWARE OF THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS The software of the airbag control unit might not meet specifications.

mercedes-benz.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Bearing damage to the fan clutch may occur due to overheating.  Analyses have shown that the bearings exhibit variation in the amount of bearing play. mercedes-benz.defect: The bonding between the glass panel and the sliding roof frame might not meet specifications. mercedes-benz.remedy: Check the glass panel and replace the sliding roof if necessary.

The condensation will affect for example rear lamp clusters saloon heating. If not rectified eventually smoke with the attendant smell could occur and after a time there is a theoretical risk of fire.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a cover over the auxiliary switch panel.

mercedes-benz.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It is possible that the fuel filter could suffer a leak in the plug area of the drain opening. This leakage should be identified to the driver by the smell of the diesel however if action is not taken to address the issue the issue could result in fuel escaping onto the road surface.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the fuel filter.

mercedes-benz.defect: On affected vehicles the fuel pump impeller might not meet specifications and may deform. On affected vehicles the fuel pump impeller might not meet specifications and may deform.
mercedes-benz.remedy: Replace the fuel pump module.

merida.defect: FRONT FORKS  MAY BREAK There is a risk of the forks failing and the rider loosing control of the machine.
merida.remedy: The recalled machines will have the aluminium forks replaced with ones made of steel.

meritor.remedy: The offending tool will be returned to ArvinMeritor and replaced.

meritor.defect: INCORRECT AIRSPRING SUPPORT PLATE A small batch of semi-trailers were supplied with an incorrect airspring support plate. This could result in a reduction in trailer roll performance.
meritor.remedy: The operators of the subject semi-trailers are being advised of the situation and supplied with correctly specified airspring support plates for retro-fitment to the trailer suspension. Operators to advise ROR when the plates have been fitted.

meritor.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE DUE TO INCORRECT TOOL SPEC Use of the brake service tool MSB1010 MST1010 or MST1010VT could result in the incorrect fitment or damage to the operating shaft outer seal known as the Gama Seal. Prolonged use in these applications may result in degradation of the bearing grease.  Early indicators may include noise roughness excessive end-play high running temperatures and ABS signal error. This may lead to bearing failure axle damage and/or in extreme instances wheel located fire.
meritor.remedy: Depending on  trailer application either replace hub units or check and retorque hub assembly. Where retorquing is considered adequate recheck for symptoms and if necessary replace bearing.

meritor.defect: PREMATURE BRAKE FAILURE AND/OR WHEEL END DAMAGE It has been identified that due to a production issue there is the potential for the brake shoe web ends where they are located at the cam roller D slots to either break orfail which can cause damage to the brake shoe brake lining and possibly the inner hub bearing. This can result in a reduction in braking efficiency. However early warning signs of the issue are noise high wheel end temperatures and ABS signal errors.
meritor.remedy: Meritor has quarantined all components within the distribution network and are recovering them. For units which have been fitted Meritor is recalling all the affected components and covering cost of the replacement shoes.

meritor.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE DUE TO INCORRECT TOOL SPEC Use of the brake service tool MSB1010 MST1010 or MST1010VT could result in the incorrect fitment or damage to the operating shaft outer seal known as the Gama Seal. meritor.remedy: The offending tool will be returned to ArvinMeritor and replaced.

meritor.defect: BEARING FAILURE COULD RESULT IN WHEEL-END FIRE The wheel hub units fitted with FAG bearings may exhibit premature wear in certain trailer applications.  Prolonged use in these applications may result in degradation of the bearing grease.  Early indicators may include noise roughness excessive end-play high running temperatures and ABS signal error. If this condition remains undetected it may potentially lead to a bearing failure axle damage and in extreme cases a wheel-end fire. Timken bearings are not affected.
meritor.remedy: Recall the units that are likely to be affected and on certain trailer applications replace the hub units. Other applications check for symptoms and if necessary replace hub unit.

meritor.defect: FAILURE OF SUSPENSION ARM WELDS The weld attaching the stub axle to the suspension arm may fail resulting in collapse and displacement of the suspension
meritor.remedy: Recall the affected semi-trailers and replace the suspension arms with quality assured examples.

meritor.defect: POTENTIAL CRACK ON AN INTERNAL PIN WITHIN THE BRAKE HOUSING Possible cracked pin within the brake calliper housing.
meritor.remedy: Inspect and replace the calliper housing if required.

meritor.defect: WATER INGRESS MAY CAUSE REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been established that a number of re-manufactured D-Lisa brake calipers may have an incorrect fitment or damage operating shaft outer seal known as the Gama Seal. Under certain conditions this could allow the ingress of water or other contaminates into the brake which could result in the gradual deterioration of the braking performance.
meritor.remedy: Recall the affected calipers for a check and if found out of specification/damaged replace them.

meritor.defect: HUB BEARING INTEGRITY The hub bearings in some TE 9000 axles may be liable to premature failure. If not detected this could result in hub seizure or wheel and hub detachment.
meritor.remedy: Supply sufficient replacement hubs and bearings to all operators of affected trailers and monitor the return rate of displaced units to ensure full coverage of the vehicle parc.
