neoman.defect: STEERING ARM MAY CONTACT BRAKE CALLIPER It has been identified that the possibility exists that the steering track rod arm may contact the brake calliper with the steering on lock.
neoman.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for the relevant conflicting parts and if necessary will be fitted with replacement brake pads. It should be noted at this time that the foregoing represents an interim fix.

neoman.defect: FRONT AXLE SECURITY There is a possibility that the air suspension carrier frame on the front axle may tear at the connection (bolting) to the axle.  Therefore if not checked and rectified it may effect the security of the axle which may effect the steering characteristics.
neoman.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to check the connecting bolts between the carrier frame and axle.

neoman.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the bellows carrier with a quality assured component.

new.defect: Hand Brake replacement The teeth of the mechanical park brake pawl and ratchet can wear abnormally fast and may degrade possibly resulting in a loss of grip upon engagement of the handbrake. In the unlikely event of the hand brake lever self dis-engaging due to abnormal wear of the parts it can lead to an unexpected movement of the tractor.
new.remedy: Replace either the hand brake lever assembly or for speciality ranges of tractors the hand brake lever pawl due to a different design of the part.

new.defect: THE CURRENT LOCK TAB ON THE RETAINING NUT LOCK WASHER OF THE FRONT AXLE HUB MAY BEND OR BREAK The current lock tab on the retaining nut lock washer of the front axle hub may bend or break.
new.remedy: Replace on both left and right front axle wheel hub lock washers and retaining nuts.

ngk.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT In some operating conditions hot combustion gases can cause premature erosion of the central electrode. In extreme circumstances this may cause the engine to misfire and run rough. If this is not noticed by the rider/driver and they continue to use the vehicle it could cause the engine to cut out.
ngk.remedy: Recall all affected spark plugs and replace them.

niesmann+bischoff.defect: 2025-01 Faulty float gauge in the gas tank On affected vehicles may be fitted with a defective float gauge which could lead to overfilling of the gas tank. This could lead to the risk of a thermal event or deflagration in the heating system.
niesmann+bischoff.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the gas tank replaced.

nim.defect: Potential for failure of braking efficiency in reverse mode If a rearward force is applied to either rear corner of the unit the auto brake reverse mode can be over ridden on that side causing the unit to pivot on the opposite stationary wheel.
nim.remedy: Recall the affected units to modify the brake linkage.

nissan.defect: Nv400 X62 AdBlue Dosing Inactive For affected vehicles the AdBlue Dosing Module may not have been initialised during the production process. In this condition the AdBlue Dosing Module does not trigger AdBlue injection and therefore NOx emissions are not controlled.
nissan.remedy: The AdBlue dosing control module (ADCM) activation status will be checked.  If it is not active the AdBlue Injector will be replaced and the AdBlue Dosing Control Module activated.

nissan.defect: Ariya (FE0) Traction Motor On affected vehicles an oil seal within the traction motor may leak causing a malfunction resulting in the traction motor going into failsafe and traction torque reducing to zero.
nissan.remedy: Replace the traction motor.

nissan.defect: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY TEAR DURING INFLATION The drivers� bag may tear during inflation.
nissan.remedy: Replace the drivers� airbag of all potentially affected vehicles.

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF PARKING BRAKE It has been identified that the possibility exists that the intermediate handbrake connector may break resulting in the cable potentially separating from the connector. The possibility then exists that parking brake functionality would be lost.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject connector replaced.

nissan.defect: A NON-DESSICATED PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR WAS USED DURING PREVIOUS RECALL TO REPLACE THIS COMPONENT In 2013 Nissan announced a Recall campaign to replace Takata SPI front passenger airbag inflators. A non-dessicated passenger airbag inflator was used for the replacement. Although there have been no known incidents associated with inflators of this type Nissan has decided to replace all inflators previously repaired with a non-dessicated inflator to a new dessicated version.
nissan.remedy: Replace the front passenger airbag inflator with a new dessicated type.

nissan.defect: THE REAR BRAKE CALIPER ASSEMBLY FIXINGS MAY HAVE BEEN INSUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED The rear brake caliper assembly fixings may have been insufficiently tightened
nissan.remedy: Proactively confirm the rear brake caliper assembly torques and where necessary replace parts

nissan.defect: EXCESSIVE WEAR OF VACUUM PUMP DRIVE GEAR A concern has been identified with the vacuum pump drive gear which could wear excessively due to insufficient surface hardness. If the condition is ignored gear wear could cause the pump to cease operating which results in the loss of brake assistance.
nissan.remedy: Subject vehicles will be recalled at which time the vacuum pump drive gear will be replaced.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified that the accelerator pedal position sensor located in the accelerator pedal assembly may provide an incorrect signal due to sensor terminal wear. If this occurs the ECM will detect the sensor failure and illuminate the engine management waning lamp on the dash. It will also control and` limit vehicle acceleration. However in extreme case if this situation occurs and there is excessive dust in the throttle valve which could affect the amount of intake air then the engine could stall at idle speed.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the throttle pedal assembly.

nissan.defect: BODY CONTROL MODULE MAY FAIL TO WARN DRIVER OF INDICATOR LIGHT MALFUNCTION Due to an incorrect software setting of the Body Control Module (BCM) the system may not trigger a warning (double speed flashing) in the case of a direction indicator lamp failure.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram the Body Control Module.

nissan.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

nissan.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

nissan.defect: ENGINE INSULATION MAY REST ON TURBOCHARGER The engine bay insulation for right hand drive vehicles equipped with 2.0 l diesel engine (M9R) engine may have insufficient clearance from the turbocharger. In extreme cases this may cause the insulation to smoulder due to the high temperature of the turbocharger.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an additional bracket to position the engine bay insulation away from the turbocharger.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO RESTART The engine ignition coil may not be to the correct specification. The internal electrical components of the coil may short circuit resulting in an engine misfire. In the worst case this short circuit may cause a fuse inside the Power Distribution Module (IPDM) to fail stopping power to the ignition relay. In this condition the engine may stall and prevent the customer from being able to restart the engine.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition coil with new.

nissan.defect: HAZARD LAMPS MAY NOT OPERATE ON ATTACHED TRAILERS It has been identified that if the vehicle's ignition switch is off and the hazard lights are on they will not illuminate on any trailer attached to the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a sub-harness.

nissan.defect: POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE MAY FAIL It has been established that the casting for the heat sink on the Electric Power Steering (EPS) control unit may be out of specification. In extreme cases this can cause a failure of the EPS motor which will illuminate a warning light on the dash.  Whilst directional control is not affected it is possible that the driver will experience a sudden loss of power assistance.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affect vehicles and replace the EPS control unit.

nissan.defect: A potential concern affecting the HEVC (Hybrid Electric Vehicle Control) module software has been identified which may cause a module reset of affected vehicles.  Simultaneous pressing of brake and accelerator could cause engine stumble or stall. A potential concern affecting the HEVC (Hybrid Electric Vehicle Control) module software has been identified which may cause a module reset of affected vehicles.  Simultaneous pressing of brake and accelerator could cause engine stumble or stall.
nissan.remedy: Update the HEVC module software

nissan.defect: PROPSHAFT MAY DETACH FROM VEHICLE Insufficient torque may have been applied to the propshaft securing bolts during production and this could lead to vibration. If the concern is not rectified the propshaft may detach from the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled and inspected if necessary the propshaft securing bolts will be replaced.

nissan.defect: On affected vehicles the manufacturer will increase the maximum target efficiency of the SCR system in online dosing mode to further improve the emissions of the vehicle. On affected vehicles the manufacturer will increase the maximum target efficiency of the SCR system in online dosing mode to further improve the emissions of the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Update the software of the AdBlue Dosing Control Module.

nissan.defect: REPLACE AIRBAG INFLATORS CHECKED BUT NOT REPLACED UNDER PREVIOUS RECALL R/2015/093 The air bag inflators on affected vehicles were previously checked and deemed to be serviceable. As a precautionary measure the manufacturer has decided to replace them with new assemblies.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag assembly.

nissan.defect: REAR WHEEL BEARING MAY FAIL A concern has been identified relating to the incorrect assembly of the rear axle. This may result in excessive wear of the wheel bearings which will lead to noise occurring from the rear axle. If this is not rectified the bearing may ultimately fail resulting in the assembly becoming detached from the axle.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked and fitted with new halfshafts as required.

nissan.defect: SEAT BELTS MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED Incorrect installation of the front seat belts has occurred where the position of the left hand side and right hand side seat belts may have been swapped.  This incorrect installation affects homologation regulation and may potentially affect restraint performance.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary refit the front seat belts.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL There is a possibility that the air conditioning compressor may seize which could result in an unexpected engine stall.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the a/c compressor and the drive belt and idler roller.

nissan.defect: INCORRECT PERMISSABLE FRONT AXLE FIGURES WERE GIVEN ON THE VIN LABEL Incorrect permissible front axle figures were given on the VIN label.
nissan.remedy: Replace VIN label with new

nissan.defect: A NON-DESSICATED PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR WAS USED DURING PREVIOUS RECALL TO REPLACE THIS COMPONENT In 2013 Nissan announced a Recall campaign to replace Takata SPI front passenger airbag inflators. A non-dessicated passenger airbag inflator was used for the replacement. Although there have been no known incidents associated with inflators of this type Nissan has decided to replace all inflators previously repaired with a non-dessicated inflator to a new dessicated version.
nissan.remedy: Replace the front passenger airbag inflator with a new dessicated type.

nissan.defect: HEADLIGHT AUTO LEVELLING SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION WHEN VEHICLE IS FULLY LADEN On affected vehicles with Pulsar headlight auto levelling the initialisation process during production was incorrect.  In this condition affected vehicles may not correctly adjust the height of the headlamp aim when the rear of the vehicle is heavily laden and therefore may not comply with the specific regulation requirements
nissan.remedy: Reprogram the Intelligent Power Distribution Module (IPDM)  and re-initialise the headlamp auto-levelling system.

nissan.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM PARTICULATE FILTER It has been identified that a connector in the diesel particulate filter fuel system may not be correctly attached. If this is ignored fuel may leak from the connector during a particulate filter regeneration cycle.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the connector checked and tightened as necessary.

nissan.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF STEERING It has been identified that the possibility exists that a needle bearing has been omitted from the steering shaft. Additionally the cover screw may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This may result in the cover screw becoming loose initiating free play and noise within the steering system. Ultimately steering control may be lost.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering gear inspected. The steering gear will be replaced should this be found to be necessary.

nissan.defect: TOWBAR MAY DETACH The bolted joints fixing the towbar kit to the chassis of the vehicle may loosen. In an extreme situation where the vehicle continues to be driven with loose bolted joints the towbar kit may detach from the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary rework the towbar kit.

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING It is possible that the steering wheel boss may not have been produced to the correct specification. If a higher than normal loading is applied to the steering wheel in its normal operation it is possible that the steering wheel boss may separate from the steering column. This can result in a loss of steering control.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if necessary replace the steering wheel assembly.

nissan.defect: HEADLAMP AUTO AIM FUNCTION MAY NOT OPERATE Due to a non confromity in production the headlamp auto aim function may not operate
nissan.remedy: Reconfigure and then reinitialise the headlamp leveliser control unit on  affected vehicles.

nissan.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The manufacturer has identified that a potential air leak at the passenger airbag inflators which may allow moisture to enter the airbag inflator causing the propellant in the inflator units to deteriorate. Deterioration of the propellant may lead to abnormal deployment of the passenger airbag.  In an extreme situation this may result in separation of the airbag housing during deployment causing injury to occupants.
nissan.remedy: Inspect air bag assembly and where required replace air bag inflator

nissan.defect: HEATER FAN MOTOR MAY OVERHEAT It is possible that the heater fan motor may seize at slow speed. Under extreme conditions this may cause the internal temperature of the heater fan circuit to increase. If this occurs the thermal fuse may not cut-out which will result in an overheating of the fan and its surrounding area. The driver will find smoke being exhaled via the heater vents and in extreme circumstances there could be a vehicle fire.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the heater motor thermal fuse with an up-rated item.

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE MISAPPLICATION OF PARKING BRAKE Insufficient clearance between the ratchet internal mechanism and the handbrake lever sideplates may lead to misapplication of the parking brake resulting in the vehicle not being held.
nissan.remedy: Recall the affected vehicle for replacement of the original handbrake lever with a revised version.

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO FUEL TANK In the event of a front tyre travelling over a sharp object the object could be propelled towards the rear of the vehicle and possibly damage the front edge of the fuel tank.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a protective shield fitted to the fuel tank vulnerable area.

nissan.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF STEERING There is a possibility that a steering cover screw may not be sufficiently tight. This could lead to initially free play and noise in the steering which if not attended to eventually could result in the loss of steering control.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the steering gear.

nissan.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM PARTICULATE FILTER It has been identified that a connector in the diesel particulate filter fuel system may not be correctly attached. If this is ignored fuel may leak from the connector during a particulate filter regeneration cycle.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the connector checked and tightened as necessary.

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCED RETENTION FORCE OF THE REAR DOOR CHILD LOCK SWITCH Possible reduced retention force of the Rear Door Child Lock switch.
nissan.remedy: Fit a countermeasure part into the child lock door switch aperture of all potentially affected vehicles.

nissan.defect: REAR SEAT ISOFIX BRACKETS MAY NOT PERFORM AS DESIGNED IN A SIDE IMPACT A concern has been identified with the rear seat ISOFIX brackets of some E11 Note vehicles. In that the brackets may have been manufactured incorrectly with the potential that the brackets may not perform to the design intent in the case of a side impact. In addition the brackets may not conform to the required EC legislation.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject seat brackets replaced.

nissan.defect: BALL JOINT MAY DISCONNECT The front lower suspension/steering ball joint retaining ring may not have been manufactured to specification. This could in extreme circumstances result in the detachment of the ball joint from its housing. This can then cause loss of control of the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the lower link ball joint.

nissan.defect: BRAKE HOSES MAY CHAFE Under certain circumstances a front flexible brake hose may split leading to fluid loss and reduced brake performance.
nissan.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of modified front brake hoses.

nissan.defect: PARKING BRAKE CONCERN The locating dowel on the parking brake assembly may become detached. In this case any impact on the lever may cause its unintended release.
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement parking brake assembly.

nissan.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

nissan.defect: SUSPENSION TURRET MAY FAIL It has been identified that the welds on the left-hand front suspension turret may fail.  Should this occur the vehicle could tilt to the left-hand side and directional control could ultimately be affected.
nissan.remedy: Recall those affected vehicles for remedial work to be carried out on the suspension turret.

nissan.defect: AIRBAG MAY RELEASE HIGH TEMPERATURE GASES In the event that the driver airbag is deployed during a frontal impact small holes may occur on the surface of the airbag. The holes are caused by high temperature gases from the airbag inflator exhausting directly onto the surface of the airbag material. The high  temperature gas/airbag material may contact the drivers skin. The deployment performance of the driver airbag is not affected.
nissan.remedy: To replace the driver airbag with new.

nissan.defect: THE CHILD SAFETY REAR DOOR LOCK INDICATES THE WRONG POSITIONS IN THE OWNER'S MANUAL Rear door child lock function in the Owner�s Manual incorrectly indicates the locked & unlocked positions
nissan.remedy: Place addendum in the Owner's Manual correcting the lock and unlock position of the rear child lock.

nissan.defect: REPLACE AIRBAG INFLATORS CHECKED BUT NOT REPLACED UNDER PREVIOUS RECALL R/2015/093 The air bag inflators on affected vehicles were previously checked and deemed to be serviceable. As a precautionary measure the manufacturer has decided to replace them with new assemblies.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag assembly.

nissan.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FRACTURE DURING DETONATION It has been identified that due to the incorrect assembly of the driver airbag inflator. If the vehicle is involved in a collision and the air bag is required to deploy then the gas flow path may have been blocked increasing the internal pressure within the inflator. As a result the driver airbag inflator casing may crack and fragment.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle to inspect and where necessary replace driver airbag with a quality assured item.

nissan.defect: THE WELDED JOINT ON THE ACTUATOR PLATE WITHIN THE REDUCER MAY BE OF POOR QUALITY AND THE PARK LOCK MAY NOT ENGAGE The welded joint on the park lock actuator plate may be of poor quality and has the potential to fail during usage.
nissan.remedy: Replace the park lock actuator plate with a countermeasure part of all potentially affected vehicles

nissan.defect: PROPSHAFT MAY DETACH FROM VEHICLE Insufficient torque may have been applied to the propshaft securing bolts during production and this could lead to vibration. If the concern is not rectified the propshaft may detach from the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled and inspected if necessary the propshaft securing bolts will be replaced.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The Turbocharger boost sensor bracket may separate from the air inlet tube.  This means the boost pressure may be measured incorrectly and the engine warning lamp may be illuminated. During low-speed driving this could cause the engine to stall and not restart
nissan.remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the air inlet tube with a new one

nissan.defect: FUEL TANK MAY NOT MEET REQUIRED MATERIAL WALL THICKNESS A fuel tank that may not meet required material wall thickness specification
nissan.remedy: Check and replace the fuel tank if necessary

nissan.defect: THE REAR BRAKE CALIPER HANDBRAKE LEVER PIVOT PIN MAY BREAK DURING HANDBRAKE OPERATION The rear brake caliper handbrake lever pivot pin may break during handbrake operation
nissan.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace the rear brake caliper with a countermeasure part

nissan.defect: REAR OXYGEN SENSOR MAY FAIL If an electrical short occurs in the supply to the rear oxygen sensor the senor will fail but the driver will not see an immediate warning.  A MIL warning may display after continued driving depending on driving/vehicle characteristics.
nissan.remedy: Reprogram the ECU to display a warning if the rear oxygen sensor fails.

nissan.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The manufacturer has identified that a potential air leak at the passenger airbag inflators which may allow moisture to enter the airbag inflator causing the propellant in the inflator units to deteriorate. Deterioration of the propellant may lead to abnormal deployment of the passenger airbag.  In an extreme situation this may result in separation of the airbag housing during deployment causing injury to occupants.
nissan.remedy: Inspect air bag assembly and where required replace air bag inflator

nissan.defect: VIN GROSS COMBINATION WEIGHT  INFORMATION IS INCORRECT VIN label contains incorrect Gross Combination Weight (GCW) information for manual and CVT vehicles.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the VIN label with a new one showing the correct information.

nissan.defect: A NON-DESSICATED PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR WAS USED DURING PREVIOUS RECALL TO REPLACE THIS COMPONENT In 2013 Nissan announced a Recall campaign to replace Takata SPI front passenger airbag inflators. A non-dessicated passenger airbag inflator was used for the replacement. Although there have been no known incidents associated with inflators of this type Nissan has decided to replace all inflators previously repaired with a non-dessicated inflator to a new dessicated version.
nissan.remedy: Replace the front passenger airbag inflator with a new dessicated type.

nissan.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE DEFLATION OF FRONT LEFT HAND TYRE A conveyor used during vehicle manufacturing may have damaged the front left hand tyre.  In extreme cases the damage could lead to possible deflation of the affected tyre.
nissan.remedy: Examine tyre for damage and replace where necessary.

nissan.defect: THE REAR SEAT BACK MAY NOT BE SECURELY LATCHED WHEN RETURNED TO THE UPRIGHT POSITION AFTER FOLDING. The rear seat back may not be securely latched when returned to the upright position after folding.
nissan.remedy: Replace both rear seat lock knobs with a countermeasure part.

nissan.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It has been identified that due to an engineering fault in production a dimensional variation has occurred to the fuel pump seating. This may result in a possible fuel leak from the pump seating area whilst the vehicle is being fuelled.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel pump gasket and O replaced.

nissan.defect: A NON-DESSICATED PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR WAS USED DURING PREVIOUS RECALL TO REPLACE THIS COMPONENT In 2013 Nissan announced a Recall campaign to replace Takata SPI front passenger airbag inflators. A non-dessicated passenger airbag inflator was used for the replacement. Although there have been no known incidents associated with inflators of this type Nissan has decided to replace all inflators previously repaired with a non-dessicated inflator to a new dessicated version.
nissan.remedy: Replace the front passenger airbag inflator with a new dessicated type.

nissan.defect: On affected vehicles the child lock function on the rear door locks may be out of specification. The child lock may become disengaged when the inside door handle is operated. On affected vehicles the child lock function on the rear door locks may be out of specification. The child lock may become disengaged when the inside door handle is operated.
nissan.remedy: Replace the rear door lock assemblies on both sides with a countermeasure part.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The engine may stall as a result of the crank shaft position sensor wiring harness being incorrectly routed and possibly coming into contact with the blades of the cooling fan.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the wiring harness and re-route or replace the wiring harness as necessary.

nissan.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On affected vehicles the fuel pressure sensor may not have been tightened to the correct specification. Heat and engine vibration may cause the sensor to loosen and in extreme cases allow fuel to leak.
nissan.remedy: Tighten fuel pressure sensor on  affected vehicles

nissan.defect: REAR SEAT BELT WEBBING MAY BE DAMAGED IN A FRONTAL IMPACT There is a possibility that during a frontal impact and under specific circumstances the rear seat belt webbing may be damaged. This could increase the risk of injury to an occupant during an impact.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a protector fitted to the affected seat belt area.

nissan.defect: TORQUE APPLIED TO RHS REAR SPRING LEAF U BOLTS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The torque applied to right rear leaf spring U-bolts may not be as per specification
nissan.remedy: Inspect and where necessary rework the right rear leaf spring assembly

nissan.defect: OIL MAY LEAK ONTO HOT ENGINE COMPONENTS The turbocharger oil pipe ferrule material may have cracked during its forming process.  In this condition there is a risk that the oil pipe may lose its sealing resulting in the leakage of oil from the vehicle.  Depending on the severity of the leak and the vehicle conditions oil could contact hot areas in the engine room possibly resulting in fire.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the turbocharger oil pipe.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO RESTART The engine ignition coil may not be to the correct specification. The internal electrical components of the coil may short circuit resulting in an engine misfire. In the worst case this short circuit may cause a fuse inside the Power Distribution Module (IPDM) to fail stopping power to the ignition relay. In this condition the engine may stall and prevent the customer from being able to restart the engine.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition coil with new.

nissan.defect: BRAKE PIPE MAY LEAK An interference can occur between the steering column and the brake pipe which supplies fluid to the rear brakes which may lead to brake pipe leakage.
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and reposition brake pipe.

nissan.defect: THE PASSENGER AIR BAG MAY DEVELOP A TEAR DURING DEPLOYMENT The passenger airbag may develop a tear during deployment.
nissan.remedy: Replace the passenger airbag with new countermeasure parts

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL A concern has been identified with the engine angle and position sensors of the engine management system If ignored it could cause the engine to stall and/or make it not possible to restart
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace sensors.

nissan.defect: PASSENGER AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY Passenger air bag may not deploy correctly..
nissan.remedy: Replace passenger air bag inflator

nissan.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST A concern has been identified relating to the fitment of the steering shaft lower joint. Should the joint become detached steering control will be lost.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject joint inspected and the clamp bolt will be renewed if required.

nissan.defect: AIRBAG MAY FAIL The airbag manufacturer have informed Nissan of a  potential concern with propellant degradation of Front Passenger Airbag fitted with Smokeless Passenger Inflator (SPI). It has been confirmed that this degradation is a function of time temperature and environmental moisture. Deterioration of the Inflator propellant may under certain usage conditions lead to abnormal deployment of the Passenger Airbag. In an extreme situation this condition could create excessive pressure within the inflator during airbag deployment and may result in separation of the airbag housing.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the front passenger airbag module with a new quality controlled item.

nissan.defect: Steering wheel retaining bolt may loosen. The steering wheel retaining bolt may not have been tightened to the specified torque. If ignored it can potentially lead to a loss of steering control.
nissan.remedy: Check the torque of the steering wheel retaining bolt and tighten where found necessary.

nissan.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST A concern has been identified relating to the fitment of the steering shaft lower joint. Should the joint become detached steering control will be lost.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject joint inspected and the clamp bolt will be renewed if required.

nissan.defect: DOOR MAY OPEN DURING DRIVING The door locks may not latch correctly with the result that a door may open whilst the vehicle is being driven.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the right hand door locks replaced with quality assured items.

nissan.defect: THE CHILD SAFETY REAR DOOR LOCK INDICATES THE WRONG POSITIONS IN THE OWNER'S MANUAL Rear door child lock function in the Owner�s Manual incorrectly indicates the locked & unlocked positions
nissan.remedy: Place addendum in the Owner's Manual correcting the lock and unlock position of the rear child lock.

nissan.defect: ABNORMAL DEPLOYMENT OF PASSENGER AIRBAG The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger�airbag�inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant This could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger�airbag�to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag with a new assembly.

nissan.defect: DOOR MIRROR DIRECTION INDICATOR MAY NOT OPERATE The door mirror indicator repeater may not operate as intended when the heated rear screen is switched on.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect wiring and where necessaary rework the indicator connnections.

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCED RETENTION FORCE OF THE REAR DOOR CHILD LOCK SWITCH Possible reduced retention force of the Rear Door Child Lock switch.
nissan.remedy: Fit a countermeasure part into the child lock door switch aperture of all potentially affected vehicles.

nissan.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY The incorrect side airbag may deploy in the event of an accident.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag control unit with one containing the correct logic.

nissan.defect: BACK DOORS / HATCHBACK MAY BE UNSUPPORTED WHEN OPEN The paint coating applied to the back door gas stay does not comply with the design requirement for anti-corrosion. Therefore the outer tube of the gas stay may corrode and crack resulting in the loss of the pressurised gas inside the gas stay. In this condition the gas stay would be unable to support the opening of the back door allowing it to drop on the vehicle user.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the back door gas stay.

nissan.defect: ENGINE HOOD MAY BECOME INSECURE A potential welding concern with the lock support of the engine hood has been identified which if ignored could result in the hood not being secured when closed.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hood replaced with a quality assured part.

nissan.defect: STOP LAMP MAY NOT BE FUNCTIONING AS EXPECTED It has been identified that under certain unusual conditions the High Mounted Stop Lamp (HMSL) fitted to Navara accessory hardtops does not illuminate simultaneously with the vehicle's stop lamps. During engine start it is possible that a voltage drop can occur which may fall below the HMSL operating threshold. This may result in HMSL not illuminating following engine start.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to modify wiring and the supply to the HMSL.

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING FUNCTION There is a possibility that the lower steering column connecting rod may become disconnected resulting in loss of steering control.
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if necessary retorque steering rod bolts.

nissan.defect: THE HANDBRAKE CABLE STOPPER MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED The hand brake cable stopper may have been incorrectly formed in production and may fail.
nissan.remedy: Replace the handbrake cable and bracket with countermeasure parts

nissan.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel filter hose connector may not be fully connected to the fuel filter. If the vehicle continues to be driven in this condition a fuel leak may occur or in extreme conditions the engine may stall.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and inspect the fuel filter hose connector. If found to be faulty carry out remedial work.

nissan.defect: REPLACE AIRBAG INFLATORS CHECKED BUT NOT REPLACED UNDER PREVIOUS RECALL R/2015/093 The air bag inflators on affected vehicles were previously checked and deemed to be serviceable. As a precautionary measure the manufacturer has decided to replace them with new assemblies.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag assembly.

nissan.defect: REPLACE AIRBAG INFLATORS CHECKED BUT NOT REPLACED UNDER PREVIOUS RECALL R/2015/093 The air bag inflators on affected vehicles were previously checked and deemed to be serviceable. As a precautionary measure the manufacturer has decided to replace them with new assemblies.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag assembly.

nissan.defect: Qashqai (J12) Battery Management System For affected vehicles due to a software concern the calculated and displayed battery state of charge may rapidly fluctuate.
nissan.remedy: Reprograming of the battery management system with the latest software.

nissan.defect: XTRAIL (T33) Adaptive LED Headlight On affected vehicles the Adaptive LED Headlight (ALH) configuration may be out of specification. In this condition the ALH may not function as intended and alternate between high and low beam mode despite the presence of other vehicles.
nissan.remedy: Update the adaptive LED headlights (ALH) control module software configuration with revised parameters.

nissan.defect: XTRAIL (T33) Intelligent Speed Assistance For certain vehicles due to incorrect software calibration the Intelligent Speed Assistance may not behave as intended.
nissan.remedy: Reconfigure the associated control units to address the issue.

nissan.defect: NV300 (X82) Airbag On affected vehicles the airbag side impact sensors may not have been installed during production. Additionally some vehicles may lack the required wire harnesses for connection of the side impact sensors.
nissan.remedy: Installation of side impact sensors and where required associated cable kits.

nissan.defect: Juke (F16) Qashqai (J12) and Leaf (ZE1) VIN Scan On affected vehicles the VIN stored in the vehicle system may not match the actual VIN of the vehicle. This may lead to a situation where a vehicle user can see information related to a different vehicle resulting in a data security breach.
nissan.remedy: Replace the navigation display / control unit and the telematics control unit.

nissan.defect: Juke (F16) Qashqai (J12) and Leaf (ZE1) VIN Scan On affected vehicles the VIN stored in the vehicle system may not match the actual VIN of the vehicle. This may lead to a situation where a vehicle user can see information related to a different vehicle resulting in a data security breach.
nissan.remedy: Replace the navigation display / control unit and the telematics control unit.

nissan.defect: Juke (F16) Qashqai (J12) and Leaf (ZE1) VIN Scan On affected vehicles the VIN stored in the vehicle system may not match the actual VIN of the vehicle. This may lead to a situation where a vehicle user can see information related to a different vehicle resulting in a data security breach.
nissan.remedy: Replace the navigation display / control unit and the telematics control unit.

nissan.defect: Interstar (XDD/XDE) Accelerator Pedal For certain vehicles the end-stop breaking force of the accelerator pedal is lower than the intended technical specification. This may lead to a rupture of the accelerator pedal assembly if the pedal is pressed vigorously.
nissan.remedy: Replacement of the accelerator pedal assembly.

nissan.defect: Interstar (XDD/XDE) Accelerator Pedal For certain vehicles the end-stop breaking force of the accelerator pedal is lower than the intended technical specification. This may lead to a rupture of the accelerator pedal assembly if the pedal is pressed vigorously.
nissan.remedy: Replacement of the accelerator pedal assembly.

nissan.defect: Townstar Van (XFK) Back Door hinge Pin For affected vehicles the back door hinge pins may have been incorrectly assembled during production. In this condition the back door hinge pin may be missing.
nissan.remedy: Carry out an inspection of the rear door hinges and replace if found to be defective.

nissan.defect: Townstar Van (XFK) Rear Door Striker For affected vehicles there is a risk of head contact with the rear door latch. Due to the sharp edges of the door latch there is a risk of injury when head contact occurs.
nissan.remedy: Installation of  a cover to the striker bar to protect the customer from the sharp edge.

nissan.defect: Juke (F16) Front Seat Belt On affected vehicles the front seat belt may have been accidentally damaged during the parts preparation for assembly.
nissan.remedy: The retailers will inspect vehicles as identified as potentially affected and replace any affected seat belt assemblies.

nissan.defect: Juke (F16) Right Hand Rear Door On affected vehicles the right-hand rear door welds may be out of specification. The door may rattle and a side impact may increase the risk of deformation. In the extreme impact could cause the hinge to fail and the door to open.
nissan.remedy: Replace the rear right-hand door.

nissan.defect: WHEELS MAY LOCK IF ABS IS ACTIVATED It has been identified that due to a manufacturing issue the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) Actuator Control Unit may have contamination within it. When in use the contamination particle can migrate within the ABS unit and become trapped in a valve. In this condition the ABS may not operate as per design intent in the worst case when the ABS is activated under certain unusual driving conditions the customer may experience wheel lock and the vehicle�s dynamic behaviour would be adversely affected.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the ABS control unit and where necessary replace it with new component.

nissan.defect: ENGINE CONTROL MODULE IDENTIFICATION LABEL DOES NOT CONTAIN CERTIFICATION NUMBER Engine Control Module (ECM) identification label does not contain the certification number on the label.
nissan.remedy: Attach correct ECM label to affected vehicles.

nissan.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the parking brake levers situated on the rear disc calipers may have a fissure. This carries the potential risk that loss of parking brake function may occur due to the levers breaking.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected and affected parts replaced as necessary.

nissan.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL It has been identified that the front suspension lower ball joints on some of the subject vehicles have not been fully seated into the hub. This has resulted in the securing bolt not fitting into the groove in the ball joint shank. If the situation goes uncorrected the ball joint could detach which could result in loss of vehicle control.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for correct location of the ball joint and rectified as necessary.

nissan.defect: REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY DETACH FROM SEAT FRAME. The rear seat belt buckle retaining bolt may become loose resulting in buckle becoming detached
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and refit retorque and lock bolt.

nissan.defect: IF DEPLOYED THE AIRBAG MAY ENDANGER PASSENGER The combustion rate of the airbag propellant may be too fast causing excessive internal pressure in the inflator during airbag deployment. In an extreme case the inflator casing may rupture leading to a scattering of metal fragments.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front passenger airbag assembly.

nissan.defect: IF DEPLOYED THE AIRBAG MAY ENDANGER PASSENGER The combustion rate of the airbag propellant may be too fast causing excessive internal pressure in the inflator during airbag deployment. In an extreme case the inflator casing may rupture leading to a scattering of metal fragments.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front passenger airbag assembly.

nissan.defect: PROPSHAFT BEARINGS CONCERN. Premature wear of the propshaft universal joint bearings may lead to noise vibration and eventual loss of drive.
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new propshaft which has improved bearings.

nissan.defect: THE RIGHT HAND REAR BRAKE CALIPER COULD FAIL DURING AN ACTIVATION OF THE PARKING BRAKE The Right-Hand Rear Brake Caliper could fail during an activation of the parking brake.
nissan.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace right hand rear brake caliper.

nissan.defect: REAR OXYGEN SENSOR MAY FAIL If an electrical short occurs in the supply to the rear oxygen sensor the senor will fail but the driver will not see an immediate warning.  A MIL warning may display after continued driving depending on driving/vehicle characteristics.
nissan.remedy: Reprogram the ECU to display a warning if the rear oxygen sensor fails.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL & FAIL TO RESTART It has been identified that it is possible that the contacts in  engine control module (ECM) and ignition relay situationed in the Intelligent Power Distribution Module (IPDM) may become contaminated with silicon oxide due to the evaporating of the silicon from within the units.  In extreme cases this could result in the stalling of the engine and the failure to restart the engine.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the defective units.

nissan.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Nissan has identified that the fuel rail pressure sensor of some vehicles may have not been correctly tightened to the fuel rail of the engine and may loosen gradually due to heat and vibration of the engine.  If left undetected and the vehicle continues to be driven in this condition in extreme cases fuel leakage may occur.
nissan.remedy: Re-tighten the pressure sensor and replace the pressure sensor gasket if required.

nissan.defect: QASHQAI J12 Lithium Ion Battery For affected vehicles there is an issue involving the E power Battery Management system (BMS) where warnings and entering limp mode or loss of power cannot be ruled out.   Vehicle will not return to normal function until power-latch (IGN off for approximately 30 mins and key away from vehicle).
nissan.remedy: Reprogram the Battery Management System (BMS).

nissan.defect: INTERSTAR XDD/XDE Emissions Label For affected vehicles an incorrect Emissions Label may have been installed . As a result the label does not accurately reflect the vehicle’s actual emissions.
nissan.remedy: Replace the Emissions Label with the correct European specification  label.

nissan.defect: INTERSTAR XDD/XDE Emissions Label For affected vehicles an incorrect Emissions Label may have been installed . As a result the label does not accurately reflect the vehicle’s actual emissions.
nissan.remedy: Replace the Emissions Label with the correct European specification  label.

nissan.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The lower pinion needle bearing may have been omitted during manufacture of the steering gear due to insufficient controls in the suppliers manufacturing process. It is possible the pinion may disengage from the steering gear with loss of steering control.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and where necessary replace rack.

nissan.defect: STEERING COLUMN JOINT MAY NOT BE SECURE The Steering column may become detached from the rack due to incorrectly tightened bolt
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles check for presence of retaining nut. If present tighten nut to specified torque. If nut is absent replace bolt and screw and tighten to specified torque.  THE MANUFACTURER HAS ADVISED NOT TO DRIVE THE VEHICLE.

nissan.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

nissan.defect: REAR SIDE SEAT BELT OUTER BUCKLE MAY BREAK The rear side seatbelt  outer buckle may be of a material which has been incorrectly treated. The buckle may break in service. The seat belt would no longer offer a restraining facility
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace buckle with modified type

nissan.defect: STEERING WHEEL FIXING BOLT MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY It is possible that the steering wheel mounting bolt may not have been torqued to the correct specification. In addition this torque setting may deteriorate over time as axial tension on the steering wheel boss can be affected by temperature change. The driver will receive warning of the issue by the excessive play/movement in the steering wheel. However should the driver neglect to take notice of this warning it is possible that the steering wheel could detach and affect direction control of the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle check the torque and if required re-torque the steering wheel bolt.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL & FAIL TO RESTART It has been identified that it is possible that the contacts in  engine control module (ECM) and ignition relay situationed in the Intelligent Power Distribution Module (IPDM) may become contaminated with silicon oxide due to the evaporating of the silicon from within the units.  In extreme cases this could result in the stalling of the engine and the failure to restart the engine.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the defective units.

nissan.defect: STEERING WHEEL MAY BREAK/DETACH AND CAUSE LOSS OF STEERING Due to an error in production cracks may form in the steering wheel. This could compromise the strength of the steering wheel and in extreme conditions may detach.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the steering wheel and replace where necessary.

nissan.defect: SIDE AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY The side air bag satellite sensor may be incorrectly programmed. In the event of a collision the air bag may not deploy.
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-programme sensor.

nissan.defect: NV400 (X62) M9T Intercooler The incorrect specification of intercooler has been used for production (Euro6D instead of Euro6E).
nissan.remedy: The intercooler will receive replacement with a compliant component.

nissan.defect: NV400 (X62) GEN4 Fuel Pipe On certain vehicles Fuel Pipe characteristics may be out of specification and may have insufficient clearance between fuel pipe and engine harness.
nissan.remedy: Check of the fuel inlet pipe replacing if necessary and installing a rigid spacer on the pipe.

nissan.defect: Qashqai (J12) Fuel Pipe For affected vehicles it has been identified that there is potential for movement between the fuel pipe and its retaining clip within the engine bay this movement can potentially lead to wear on the fuel pipe. In an extreme situation this may cause a hole in the fuel pipe resulting in a potential fuel leak.
nissan.remedy: Carry out an inspection of the fuel pipe and If identified wear is within limits apply protective Grommet to fuel tube. If  wear is judged to be outside acceptable limits or a fuel leak from the fuel pipe is identified replace the fuel pipe.

nissan.defect: Interstar (XDD/XDE) Steering Rack For affected vehicles there is an issue involving the steering gear  for where damage or cracking cannot be ruled out. The consequences are that loss of assistance or in some cases loss of control.
nissan.remedy: Replacement of the  steering rack and supporting components.

nissan.defect: THE STEERING KNUCKLES MAY DEFORM AFFECTING THE STEERING PERFORMANCE The steering knuckles may deform affecting the steering performance.
nissan.remedy: Replace the front knuckle steering at both sides of all potentially affected vehicles.

nissan.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL Risk that the primary handbrake cable end - piece crimping may not conform so the handbrake cable may become detached.
nissan.remedy: Check crimping at cable end.  Replace cable if not within tolerance.

nissan.defect: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY TEAR DURING INFLATION The drivers� bag may tear during inflation.
nissan.remedy: Replace the drivers� airbag of all potentially affected vehicles.

nissan.defect: X-TRAIL T33 Lithium Ion Battery For affected vehicles the lithium-ion battery controller (LBC) on some X-Trail (T33) vehicles may not properly maintain diagnostic robustness.  It has been found that these ICs may misdiagnose abnormalities and as a result the system may enter fail-safe mode during driving which restricts motor output and prohibits charging.  Under certain conditions a loss of motive power may occur and the vehicle may stop while driving due to the loss of propulsion.
nissan.remedy: Update to the Battery Management Software (BMW)

nissan.defect: Cube (Z12) Driver Airbag For affected vehicles the Driver's Airbag module may have been incorrectly assembled during production. In this condition the driver’s airbag inflator module may detach from the steering wheel.
nissan.remedy: Check and replace driver airbag if necessary.

nissan.defect: Ariya (FE0) Headlamp For affected vehicles there is concern that the left side headlamp beam may be out of alignment.
nissan.remedy: The left side head lamp beam will be adjusted according to specification

nissan.defect: Primastar X82 Tyre Configuration For affected vehicles the tyre size has been incorrectly configured in some of the control units. In this condition the calculation of the vehicle speed for display is made using incorrect data. As a result the vehicle displays a calculated vehicle speed that is 2% lower than the actual speed of the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Reconfigure the Body Control Module (BCM) Anti-Lock braking System (ABS) and Front Camera with the correct tyre size.

nissan.defect: SEAT MAY DETACH It has been identified that there is the possibility in the event of an impact the potential insecurity of the front right hand seat base mounting may result in the seat detaching from the floor thus affecting occupant safety.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the right hand front seat base brackets welded to the correct specification.

nissan.defect: INCORRECT SOFTWARE CONFIGURATION IN COMBI METER FITTED TO PREM3 VARIANT VEHICLES Warning light not coming on with steering fault
nissan.remedy: Software upgrade

nissan.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.

nissan.defect: On affected vehicles a potential software concern may result in the combination meter screen intermittently switching OFF for 5 seconds and then switching back ON. On affected vehicles a potential software concern may result in the combination meter screen intermittently switching OFF for 5 seconds and then switching back ON.�
nissan.remedy: Over The Air (OTA) software update sent to customers vehicle updating the combination meter software only.�

nissan.defect: The torque value given in the Repair bulletin for R/2022/254 for the injector clamp bolts was insufficient. Under specific driving conditions this can cause the leakage of exhaust gasses past the injector sealing washer. The torque value given in the Repair bulletin for R/2022/254 for the injector clamp bolts was insufficient. Under specific driving conditions this can cause the leakage of exhaust gasses past the injector sealing washer.
nissan.remedy: Replace all injector sealing washers retaining plates bolts and pipes as necessary and tighten with the correct torque.

nissan.defect: REPLACE AIRBAG INFLATORS CHECKED BUT NOT REPLACED UNDER PREVIOUS RECALL R/2015/093 The air bag inflators on affected vehicles were previously checked and deemed to be serviceable. As a precautionary measure the manufacturer has decided to replace them with new assemblies.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag assembly.

nissan.defect: In certain vehicles should the driver s seat be set in the position where it coincides with a design feature in the upper rail it may in certain conditions exceed the stress limits of the rail material. In certain vehicles should the driver�s seat be set in the position where it coincides with a design feature�in the upper rail it may�in certain conditions exceed the stress limits of the rail material.
nissan.remedy: Replace the seat slide rails with countermeasure parts.�

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE WHEEL DETACHMENT In certain rare conditions where the vehicle is used fully loaded and cornering with high lateral acceleration a crack may occur on the spoke of the aluminium wheel. If this condition is ignored and the vehicle continues to be driven the crack may propagate around other wheel spokes. This condition is expected to create a change in the vehicle handling and in extreme cases could lead to wheel detachment.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the wheels.

nissan.defect: REAR BRAKES MAY LOCK UNDER LIGHT BRAKING In cold damp conditions the rear brake linings may swell and under light braking effort lock the rear wheels. This can adversely affect the vehicle's handling.
nissan.remedy: Fit improved specification brake linings.

nissan.defect: WHEEL BEARING COULD FAIL There is a possibility that a rear wheel bearing may have been overtightened at the factory. If ignored this condition could result in reduced bearing life and ultimately the bearings could fail.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the rear wheel bearings.

nissan.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY The clevis pin may displace from the brake pedal/brake booster input rod assembly as the clevis pin securing clip may not have been fitted at the factory.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a clevis pin securing clip.

nissan.defect: REAR SEAT BELT WEBBING MAY BE DAMAGED IN A FRONTAL IMPACT There is a possibility that during a frontal impact and under specific circumstances the rear seat belt webbing may be damaged. This could increase the risk of injury to an occupant during an impact.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a protector fitted to the affected seat belt area.

nissan.defect: ENGINE HOOD MAY BECOME INSECURE A potential welding concern with the lock support of the engine hood has been identified which if ignored could result in the hood not being secured when closed.
nissan.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hood replaced with a quality assured part.

nissan.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The lower pinion needle bearing may have been omitted during manufacture of the steering gear due to insufficient controls in the suppliers manufacturing process. It is possible the pinion may disengage from the steering gear with loss of steering control.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and where necessary replace rack.

nissan.defect: THE WELDED JOINT ON THE ACTUATOR PLATE WITHIN THE REDUCER MAY BE OF POOR QUALITY AND THE PARK LOCK MAY NOT ENGAGE The welded joint on the park lock actuator plate may be of poor quality and has the potential to fail during usage.
nissan.remedy: Replace the park lock actuator plate with a countermeasure part of all potentially affected vehicles

nissan.defect: TIGHTNESS OF STEERING WHEEL MOUNTING MAY NOT CONFORM WITH NISSAN STANDARDS In certain cases the tightness of the steering wheel mounting may not conform to specification.
nissan.remedy: As a preventative measure likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the steering wheel will be replaced and it's mounting strengthened.

nissan.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION CONCERN The front suspension transverse link rear pivot pin may break if subjected to an impact such as kerbing.  Failure of the pivot pin would adversely affect the stability and safe control of the vehicle.
nissan.remedy: Fit new left and right hand suspension transverse links.

nissan.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY It is possible that the vehicles brake fluid maybe contaminated with mineral oil. This can cause the seals within the system to swell and affect their sealing properties. This may require drivers to apply additional force to the foot brake and could increase stopping distances.
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to have the system flushed and replenished with clean fluid.

nissan.defect: LOSS OF STEER It is possible that the steering wheel boss may not have been produced to the correct specification. If a higher than normal loading is applied to the steering wheel typically on low speed manoeuvring it is possible that the steering wheel boss may separate from the steering column. This can result in a loss of steering control.
nissan.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if necessary replace the steering wheel assembly.

nissan.defect: FUEL FILTER SUPPORT MAY BREAK The fuel filter support bracket may crack and the fuel filter could become insecure As a result the fuel filter and or fuel tube may leak.
nissan.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel filter support bracket Check condition of filter and fuel tube. Replace if necessary

nissan.defect: POSSIBLE DEFLATION OF FRONT LEFT HAND TYRE A conveyor used during vehicle manufacturing may have damaged the front left hand tyre.  In extreme cases the damage could lead to possible deflation of the affected tyre.
nissan.remedy: Examine tyre for damage and replace where necessary.

nissan.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL A concern has been identified affecting 1.5 1.6 and 1.8 petrol engine crankshaft and camshaft position sensors (a common part). An internal failure of the component may cause the engine to stall and not restart.
nissan.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement crankshaft and camshaft position sensor.

nissan.defect: INTERNAL IGNITION SWITCH SPRING MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH A SURFACE DEFECT Ignition Switch spring defect may cause engine to be turned off while driving
nissan.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace the Ignition Switch

nissan.defect: SEAT BELTS MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED Incorrect installation of the front seat belts has occurred where the position of the left hand side and right hand side seat belts may have been swapped.  This incorrect installation affects homologation regulation and may potentially affect restraint performance.
nissan.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary refit the front seat belts.
