opel.defect: Vauxhall Vivaro – Ground Connections On affected vehicles there could be a loss of ground connections for some electrical harnesses which could result in a worst-case scenario in the loss of several vehicle functions with safety impacts and a risk of erratic behaviour of the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

opel.defect: Grandland EPS software update Due to a mechanical failure in the reducer bearing combined with a specific defect in the Electric Power Steering (EPS) software calibration affected vehicles may experience a loss of power steering which in the worst case could lead to steering lock.
opel.remedy: Update the EPS software calibration to prevent the potential loss of steering assistance.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Grandland PHEV Traction Battery On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.
opel.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery.

opel.defect: Vauxhall cross carline Driver’s Airbag - Takata On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbag inflators may deteriorate over time.  This may cause the inflators to rupture with too much force in a crash leading to serious injury or death in a worst-case scenario.
opel.remedy: Replace the driver airbag module.

opel.defect: Vauxhall cross carline Driver’s Airbag - Takata On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbag inflators may deteriorate over time.  This may cause the inflators to rupture with too much force in a crash leading to serious injury or death in a worst-case scenario.
opel.remedy: Replace the driver airbag module.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Grandland Front Seat harness On affected vehicles the wiring harness for both front seats may be routed incorrectly which may lead to a short circuit and the potential risk of a non-working airbag.
opel.remedy: Check and if necessary re-route the wiring harness.

opel.defect: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED The passenger air bag may not meet the correct specification.  In the possible event of a frontal collision front passenger airbag might not deploy as intended.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace passenger air bag module.

opel.defect: Affected vehicles may have a steering tie rod/track rod end nut that has not been tightened to the correct torque. Affected vehicles may have a steering tie rod/track rod end nut that has not been tightened to the correct torque.
opel.remedy: Replace the steering tie rod/track rod end nut and tighten to the correct torque.

opel.defect: THE REAR WHEEL HUB BOLTS ARE NOT TIGHTENED TO SPECIFICATION Vehicle rear wheel hub bolts may not be tightened according to specification and/or the incorrect wheel hub may be installed
opel.remedy: Check the bolt security and if necessary replace the rear wheel hubs

opel.defect: MOVEMENT OF WIRING HARNESS CONNECTOR TO FAN SPEED RESISTOR MAY LEAD TO CONNECTOR PLUG TERMINALS BECOMING HEAT DAMAGED Movement of the wiring harness connector to the fan speed resistor can in rare circumstances lead to electrical stress.
opel.remedy: Replacement the heating & ventilation system wiring harness with a redesigned connector plug and additional mounting points.

opel.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a rear axle crossmember that was not manufactured according to specifications. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a rear axle crossmember that was not manufactured according to specifications.
opel.remedy: Check and replace the rear axle crossmember if necessary.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGED WHEEL BOLT THREADS DUE TO A PRODUCTION PROCESS DEVIATION Possible damaged wheel bolt threads due to a production process deviation.
opel.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the wheel bolts hub and wheel.

opel.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE WITH HILL START ASSIST FEATURE The hill start hold feature exceeds the correct time specification.
opel.remedy: A Software Update to the Electronic Brake Control Module.

opel.defect: VEHICLES MAY BE FITTED WITH A NON CONFORM ACCESSORY TRAILER HITCH Vehicles may be fitted with a non-conform accessory trailer hitch.
opel.remedy: Check the batch number and if necessary replace the trailer hitch.

opel.defect: Affected vehicles may be equipped with a B-Pillar manufacturer label with incorrect weight data which can lead to a non-conformity to regulatory requirements. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a B-Pillar manufacturer label with incorrect weight data which can lead to a non-conformity to regulatory requirements.
opel.remedy: Replace the manufacturer label with one that has correct load values.

opel.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK An insufficient paint adhesion to the fuel tank sheet metal surface could lead to corrosion resulting in a fuel odour/leak.
opel.remedy: The fuel tank will be checked for delamination of the paint surface and wax applied as a preventative measure.  If necessary the fuel tank will be replaced.

opel.defect: 1) POSSIBLE STATIC SPARKING DURING REFUELLING (ASTRA MODELS ONLY) 2) AIR BAG SYSTEM MAY NOT DEPLOY 1) During refuelling the flow of fuel can cause static electricity to build up in the tank filler neck with the possibility of static sparking. 2) On some vehicles an electrical connector plug in the air bag system may not be correctly possible
opel.remedy: A) The fitting of a metal earthing clamp to the lower end of the metal ring for the fuel filler cap to ensure a conductive connection between the filler neck and the vehicle body. B) Checking that in potentially affected vehicles the subject elect

opel.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING POWER WHERE THE BRAKE PEDAL IS APPLIED SLOWLY AND CONSTANTLY Potential for a reduction in braking power where the brake pedal is applied slowly and constantly.
opel.remedy: Replacement of hydraulic brake and clutch system components.

opel.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL LEAKAGE The diesel engine fuel feed and return metal pipes may fracture and leak if the vehicle is involved in a frontal collision.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the original fuel pipes with ones of improved specification.

opel.defect: SEAT FRAME MAY FAIL The integrity of the front seat bench frame for the passengers may be compromised because of non-compliance during the manufacturing processes. Customer may hear noises coming from underneath the bench. They may also notice some cracking on the seat frame angles. If the seat fails during a collision the passengers have an elevated risk of injury.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the seat frame. Replace the seat where necessary.

opel.defect: Affected vehicles may have a too low torque on the wheel bolts that could lead to loose wheels or wheel detachment in a worst case scenario. Affected vehicles may have a too low torque on the wheel bolts that could lead to loose wheels or wheel detachment in a worst case scenario.
opel.remedy: Check and re-torque wheel bolts if necessary.

opel.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL Risk that the primary handbrake cable end - piece crimping may not conform so the handbrake cable may become detached.
opel.remedy: Check crimping at cable end.  Replace cable if not within tolerance.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that on affected vehicle's the right hand front lower control arm guide joint may be incorrectly mounted. In the worst case the lower control arm could work loose  separate from the steering knuckle and severely impair the control of the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the guide joint checked for correct mounting and replaced if the mounting is found to be incorrect.

opel.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE WITH HILL START ASSIST FEATURE The hill start hold feature exceeds the correct time specification.
opel.remedy: A Software Update to the Electronic Brake Control Module.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE OIL LEAKAGE FROM TURBO CHARGER OIL FEED PIPE We would like to make you aware that on a certain number of Astra J GTC Insignia B - Model Year 18 there is the possibility of oil leakage from the turbo charger oil feed pipe. In worst case the spilled oil may inflame on hot engine parts. Possible oil leakage from turbo charger oil feed pipe. In worst case the spilled oil may inflame on hot engine parts.
opel.remedy: check/adjust turbo oil feed pipe connector on all affected vehicles

opel.defect: POSSIBILITY OF VEHICLE FIRE In the event the radiator cooling fan is blocked there is a risk that an electrical short circuit can occur. This in turn causes damage to the cooling fan module and in the worst case could potentially result in a vehicle fire.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles check for presence of and if necessary remove battery cover. Ensure that the radiator cooling fan is not obstructed or blocked in anyway. Fit new additional wiring harness which will prevent damage to the radiator wiring harness.

opel.defect: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED The passenger air bag may not meet the correct specification.  In the possible event of a frontal collision front passenger airbag might not deploy as intended.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace passenger air bag module.

opel.defect: Suspension wishbone bolts may have been incorrectly tightened during the production process. Suspension wishbone bolts may have been incorrectly tightened during the production process.
opel.remedy: Check and tighten wishbone bolts to the correct torque.

opel.defect: STEERING COLUMN JOINT MAY NOT BE SECURE The Steering column may become detached from the rack due to incorrectly tightened bolt.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles check for presence of retaining nut. If present tighten nut to specified torque. If nut is absent replace bolt and screw and tighten to specified torque.  THE MANUFACTURER HAS ADVISED NOT TO DRIVE THE VEHICLE.

opel.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE In the event the radiator cooling fan is blocked there is a risk that an electrical short circuit can occur. This in turn causes damage to the cooling fan module and in the worst case could potentially result in a vehicle fire.
opel.remedy: In the first instance the battery cover must be removed  to prevent overheating of the wiring/module. The cover should be disposed of and  must not be refitted at any time. Check the cooling fan is not obstructed or blocked in anyway   In approximately in 4 to 6 months-time an adapter wiring harness will become available and Authorised Repairers will be instructed to install this harness to the cooling fan module. This is now closed and superceeded by 16-C-004

opel.defect: SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY FAIL Seat-belt buckle for the double cab second seat row may separate from seat connector under load.
opel.remedy: Check all seat-belt buckles of the second seat row according to the following rework instruction and install a new seat-belt buckle if necessary

opel.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF PARKING BRAKE It has been identified that the parking brake cable connector situated between the primary and intermediate parking brake cables may fracture. Should this occur the parking brake function would be lost.
opel.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject cable connector replaced.

opel.defect: BONNET CATCH MAY FAIL Due to an incorrect tightening operation in the production plant the locking function of the hood might not work correctly. This may allow the bonnet to open whilst the vehicle is in motion
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles check tightness of securing bolts and replace where necessary

opel.defect: EXTERIOR DOOR HANDLES MIGHT STAY OPEN AND THE DOOR WILL NOT BE LOCKED Exterior door handles might stay open and the door will not be locked.
opel.remedy: Check the four door handles and replace them if necessary.

opel.defect: ENGINE MAY START INADVERTENTLY Repeated key insertion could create intense wear condition on the trigger of the ignition cylinder internal component. As consequence Engine starter motor might self-crank and the vehicle moves involuntarily if the ignition key has been left in the ignition lock cylinder in the LOCK (OFF) position and a gear engaged. The concern only affects vehicles with manual transmission.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a modified ignition Key cylinder.

opel.defect: THE REAR SEAT CENTRE BELT MIGHT NOT BE FIXED CORRECTLY TO THE LOWER FASTENING POINT. The rear seat centre belt might not be fixed correctly to the lower fastening point
opel.remedy: Check and if necessary correct the fixation of the centre rear seat belt at the lower fastening point

opel.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Moisture can ingress and accumulate inside the ABS control unit. Excessive accumulation of moisture may cause a fire.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles install an additional ABS module protection cover.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT BETWEEN THE ELECTRODES OF THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY A possible short-circuit between the electrodes of the high voltage battery.
opel.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery

opel.defect: POSSIBLE CONTAMINATION OF BRAKE FLUID As a result of a production process concern a specific batch of brake calliper pistons may release hot hydrogen gas into the braking system fluid.
opel.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for on the brake calliper batch numbers.  Vehicle equipped with calliper units from the affected batch will have these replaced with quality assured examples.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Corsa F Rear axle Affected vehicles may have been built with a rear axle not properly welded.
opel.remedy: Check the rear axle assembly and replace it if necessary.

opel.defect: LOSS OF STABILITY The connection between the steering knuckle and the lower control arm may not be assembled correctly. If this condition is evident the connection could become insecure. The event can happen suddenly and unexpectedly in which case the vehicle is no longer controllable.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the connection between the steering knuckle and the lower control arm on both sides of the vehicle. Where necessary the connection will be reassembled correctly.

opel.defect: SEAT BELT LATCHING CONCERN Driver and front passenger seat belt latching mechanism may separate when loaded in a frontal impact.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit quality assured seat belt buckles.

opel.defect: STEERING RACK MAY FRACTURE Due to a manufacturing process deviation the toothed rack of the steering gear might break under extensive force application i.e. when manoeuvring at slow speed.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the build date of the steering rack. Where the steering rack is proved to be from the affected batch the steering rack will be replaced.

opel.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY DISENGAGE Due to a possible contamination of the tooth segment the handbrake pawl may not latch correctly. This may cause the handbrake to disengage.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles Replace the parking brake lever assembly.

opel.defect: THE VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE WRONG VIN PRINTED ON THE B PILLAR VIN STICKER The vehicles may have the wrong VIN printed on the �B pillar� VIN sticker.
opel.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the �B pillar� VIN sticker.

opel.defect: FUEL TANK STRAP BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO SPECIFICATION Vehicles may have fuel tank strap bolts that are not tightened according to specification.
opel.remedy: Check and re-tighten the bolts of all affected vehicles.

opel.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY DISENGAGE Due to a possible contamination of the tooth segment the handbrake pawl may not latch correctly. This may cause the handbrake to disengage.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles Replace the parking brake lever assembly.

opel.defect: AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT COULD INJURE FRONT SEAT PASSENGER Affected vehicles may have had a damaged passenger airbag module installed during production. In the event of a frontal collision gas escaping during deployment of the airbag may cause injuries to vehicle passenger(s).
opel.remedy: Replace passenger airbag.

opel.defect: STEERING WHEEL CENTRE SCREW MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY. The steering wheel centre screw may not have been tightened correctly.
opel.remedy: Replace the centre torx screw and tighten to the specified torque.

opel.defect: FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY A front seat side air bag may not deploy as intended
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

opel.defect: STEERING WHEEL AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY It has been identified that in the unlikely event of a collision where there is a need for the deployment of the driver airbag it is a possible that the drivers airbag module may separate form its mounting on the steering wheel horn plate.
opel.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the drivers airbag module.

opel.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.
opel.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

opel.defect: FRONT PASSENGER SEAT COULD MOVE WITHOUT WARNING. The fixing bolts of the front passenger seat rails to seat frame may fail and leave the seat insecure. In the event of an accident this could lessen the effectiveness of the seat belt.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front passenger seat rails to seat frame fixing bolts.

opel.defect: 3RD SEAT ROW SEATS AND 2ND SEAT ROW SHOULDER BELTS MAY BE INSECURE 3rd row seat retaining bolts and 2nd row seat belt shoulder anchor retaining bolts may not be tightened to the correct specification
opel.remedy: Re-tighten the 2nd rear seat shoulder belt bolts the 3rd row seat bolts and the 3rd row seat shoulder belt buckle bolts to the correct specification .

opel.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY PARTIALLY RELEASE Following a small number of complaints of Vauxhall Vectra and Signum vehicles rolling away due to allegedly defective handbrakes. Vauxhall engineers in conjunction with consultants and other bodies have conducted rigorous testing and found that provided the handbrake is applied correctly without depressing the release button the handbrake is perfectly safe.
opel.remedy: In line with it's priority of continuous improvement recalled vehicles will be fitted with a modified handbrake mechanism to reduce the possibility of a partial release.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK Under certain conditions the engine wiring harness may touch the bonnet hinge. With prolonged chafing this may lead to a possible electrical short circuit and if not dealt with eventual combustion.
opel.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the engine wiring harness re-routed and secured clear of the bonnet hinge.

opel.defect: SEAT BELT MAY OPEN INADVERTENTLY IN THE EVENT OF A CRASH The   buckles on seat belts fitted to the 2nd row of seats may have a weakness created during the manufacturing process. This weakness may allow the buckle to inadvertently open during a collision.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles check the traceability codes of the 2nd row seat belts. Replace those belts which have an affected code.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE TYRE FAILURE Certain vehicles within the chassis range specified may have been fitted with examples of a batch of Dunlop tyres which are the subject of a recall. The tyres were affected by a contaminant during manufacture which could cause loss of adhesion between
opel.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for examination of the tyres. Where any tyres from the affected batch are found they will be replaced.

opel.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a manufacturing deviation the base material for the telescopic tube of the intermediate steering shaft may lack the required rigidity. This may lead to breakage of the shaft which in the worst case would lead to loss of steering control.
opel.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a quality assured steering shaft.

opel.defect: DRIVERS AIR BAG CONCERN There is a risk that the drivers air bag can crack over time and subsequently may not properly inflate under deployment.
opel.remedy: Replace drivers air bag.

opel.defect: FRONT DRIVER/CO-DRIVER SEAT LOCKING MECHANISM MAY BECOME INOPERATVE Front driver and co-driver seat locking mechanism may become inoperative. Seats may become insecure.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace easy entry spring housing on driver and co-driver seat frame.

opel.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The gears within the steering rack may not have been manufactured to the correct specification which may allow them to crack over a period of time. Prolonged use could cause loss of steering control.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace steering gear assembly

opel.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY LOOSEN It is possible for the servo mounting bolts to loosen. If the noises are ignored over time it is possible for the brakes to be compromised.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the brake pedal/servo mounting nuts.

opel.defect: THE RIGHT REAR BRAKE CALLIPER MIGHT NOT BE BUILT TO SPECIFICATION The right rear brake calliper might not be built to specification.
opel.remedy: Check the production date stamp of the right rear brake calliper and replace the brake calliper if necessary.

opel.defect: 1) POSSIBLE STATIC SPARKING DURING REFUELLING (ASTRA MODELS ONLY) 2) AIR BAG SYSTEM MAY NOT DEPLOY 1) During refuelling the flow of fuel can cause static electricity to build up in the tank filler neck with the possibility of static sparking. 2) On some vehicles an electrical connector plug in the air bag system may not be correctly possible
opel.remedy: A) The fitting of a metal earthing clamp to the lower end of the metal ring for the fuel filler cap to ensure a conductive connection between the filler neck and the vehicle body. B) Checking that in potentially affected vehicles the subject elect

opel.defect: FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY A front seat side air bag may not deploy as intended
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

opel.defect: STEERING RACK MAY FRACTURE Due to a manufacturing process deviation the toothed rack of the steering gear might break under extensive force application i.e. when manoeuvring at slow speed.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the build date of the steering rack. Where the steering rack is proved to be from the affected batch the steering rack will be replaced.

opel.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL The parking brake may not hold in the applied position as a result of a nonconformity in the manufacturing process which affects the hardness of the ratchet and pawl material.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the production date of the handbrake lever assembly and replace if necessary.

opel.defect: ISOFIX CONNECTOR MIGHT BREAK DUE TO MATERIAL NOT BEING TO SPECIFICATION It has been identified that the Isofix connector which is part of the Opel/Vauxhall accessory child seat with transponder might break. This is as the result of the material not being to specification.
opel.remedy: End users will be contacted and the seat replaced.

opel.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INNER THROTTLE CABLE STICKING Due to moisture and dust ingress the inner throttle cable may stick.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the throttle cable end cover or the cable assembly as necessary.

opel.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE A small number of Vauxhall Combo D models may have a brake servo vacuum pipe connector that could break resulting in an unexpected hard brake pedal and reduced braking performance.
opel.remedy: Check and if necessary to replace the brake servo vacuum pipe with connector.

opel.defect: SUNROOF GLASS MAY DETACH A deviation in the supplier manufacturing printing process caused a high viscosity in the black print which might lead to a loss of adhesion over vehicle lifetime.
opel.remedy: Until such time a final remedy is determined affected vehicles will have additional fixation added to secure the glass roof to the vehicle.as an interim measure

opel.defect: THE BRAKE PEDAL MAY POTENTIALLY STICK AS A RESULT OF HIGH VEHICLE INTERIOR TEMPERATURES The brake pedal may potentially stick as a result of high vehicle interior temperatures causing the brake lights to activate without brake pedal pressure.
opel.remedy: To reprogram the electronic brake control module (EBCM) to enable a warning message to display.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF BRAKE PEDAL LINKAGE RETAINING CLIP. A brake pedal linkage retaining clip may become detached after high mileage. Although no incidents have been reported in the worst case a  pedal link could become detached and render the footbrake ineffective.
opel.remedy: Fit modified brake pedal linkage retaining clips.

opel.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING PERFORMANCE The servo vacuum pump may fail causing a hard bake pedal loss of engine power and the vehicle may adopt limp home  mode. A warning lamp may also illuminate.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace vacuum pump.

opel.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE Vehicles equipped with stop/start system might have a starter motor failure while driving due to thermal damage of the starter cable.
opel.remedy: Authorised Repairers will Rework the starter motor cable. If necessary replace the starter the starter cable and the starter cable nut.

opel.defect: DIESEL FILTER SECURING STRAP MAY BREAK An incorrect surface treatment on the fuel filter collar may lead to breakage of the diesel filter strap resulting in vibration and noise from the engine compartment. In the case of any mechanical pulses when driving with a broken strap or as a consequence of an accident this could result in breakage of the fuel pipes with subsequent leakage.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the diesel filter strap.

opel.defect: POTENTIAL FUEL LEAK Defective crimping of fuel return hose to metal pipe connector may result in a fuel leak.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement pipe.

opel.defect: SPARE WHEEL MAY BECOME DETACHED The spare wheel carrier winch system may allow the spare wheel to be loosely installed after the customer has used the winch. In this condition the spare wheel might move during driving which may damage and eventually break the cable and guiding pin of the winch system. In this worst case the spare wheel would become detached from the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the complete spare wheel winch system.

opel.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Moisture can ingress and accumulate inside the ABS control unit. Excessive accumulation of moisture may cause a fire.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles install an additional ABS module protection cover.

opel.defect: Update the vehicle s software in order to improve the diagnosis of the braking assistance system and avoid any risk of reduction or loss of braking assistance On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
opel.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

opel.defect: THE DIESEL PARTICULATE FILTER MIGHT BE DEFECTIVE / DEVELOP CRACKS The Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) might be defective / develop cracks.
opel.remedy: Replace the Diesel particular filters on all affected vehicles.

opel.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST The retaining ring of the steering gear pinion might be out of it's retaining groove. In the worst case the steering gear pinion may lose engagement resulting in loss of steering control
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering gear assembly

opel.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF WIRING Under certain conditions the alternator feed wire/terminal may contact the clutch cable and the instrument panel harness may chafe against the steering column. Either of these concerns could lead to short circuiting and.
opel.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles reposition the alternator terminal and secure the wiring harnesses in the bulkhead area away from moving parts.

opel.defect: RISK OF FIRE It has been identified that on vehicles fitted with the Z16XEP engine the upper oil pressure switch might release oil onto the exhaust manifold heat protection shield which could result in self ignition.
opel.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the upper oil pressure switch replaced by a screw plug. Additionally a modified oil pressure switch will be fitted in a lower position.

opel.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL The steering column intermediate shaft may have a loose press fit on the upper joint yoke. If left increased free play and a knocking noise will develop which if ignored could lead to loss of steering.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new intermediate steering shaft.

opel.defect: SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY SEPARATE FROM SEAT FRAME A certain number of Insignia A - Model Year 17 the front seat belt buckles may not be produced according specification. In a worst case the seat belt buckles may separate from the seat frame in the event of an accident.
opel.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to check and if necessary replace the seat belt buckles on all affected vehicles.

opel.defect: FRONT BRAKE HOSES  INCORRECTLY INSTALLED On a certain number of Astra K - Model Year 2016-2017 (Only converted UK Police vehicles are affected)  the front brake hoses might be incorrectly installed. This can lead to contact with the drive shaft boots finally resulting in failure/leakage.
opel.remedy: Vauxhall authorised repairers or Police Workshops are asked to reroute the brake hoses and to inspect the brake hose installation if necessary replace any damaged parts to guarantee accurate functionality of the brakes.

opel.defect: THE ENGINE PISTONS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The engine pistons may not be according to specification leading to oil entry in the inlet circuit. In a worst case this may cause an increased engine rpm for a few seconds possibly resulting in a total engine failure.
opel.remedy: Perform a test of the engine to establish if the pistons are to specification. Where necessary the engine will be replaced.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The thread on the swivel pin of the track rod end might not be to specification. Therefore when the nut was tightened onto the thread the correct clamping force may not have been attained. After high mileage damage might occur and develop. If not attended to there is a possiblility that the component might fail and steering control would be lost.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the thread on the swivel joint of the track rod end. Where it does not conform to specification replace the track rod end.

opel.defect: WINDOW ANTI-TRAP MAY MALFUNCTION The anti-pinch or auto reverse function of the window regulator may not work correctly to ECE R21 requirements. So it is possible to trap items including fingers and limbs between the window and its closure.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary replace the window regulator motor.

opel.defect: FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY A front seat side air bag may not deploy as intended
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

opel.defect: RISK OF FIRE Vauxhall has conducted an in depth investigation of fires in Zafira B models. Vauxhall has presented the evidence to DVSA and analysis has determined the root cause is improper repair to heater blower motor resistors. These actions are outside of Vauxhall�s design specifications and authorised maintenance processes.
opel.remedy: At the request of DVSA Vauxhall is now reclassifying its ongoing rework activity to a safety recall. The recall entails replacing the resistor pack and any other faulty components to return the heating and ventilation system to its original design condition.

opel.defect: INCORRECT TORQUE APPLIED TO TRAILER HITCH FITTING BOLTS It has been identified that during production an incorrect torque was applied to the trailer hitch fitting bolts.
opel.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the trailer hitch bolts replaced and tightened to the correct torque.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE PERFORMANCE Potential soft brake pedal and reduced brake performance due to water induced corrosion of the brake master cylinder and consequential fluid leakage.
opel.remedy: Replace the brake master cylinder and refill brake system with fresh fluid.

opel.defect: IT MAY NOT BE POSSIBLE TO ENGAGE THE HANDBRAKE LEVER It may not be possible to engage the handbrake lever.
opel.remedy: Check the handbrake lever locking mechanism and if necessary replace the handbrake lever.

opel.defect: ON BOARD DIAGNOSTIC SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION on a certain number of Movano B - Model Year 16 and 17 with LWK or L0D engine there are some problems of the OBD (on Board Diagnostic) which should be indicated but do not trigger the MIL (Malfunction Indication Lamp). occurs  Possible faults  which should be indicated but do not trigger the MIL (Malfunction Indication Lamp). Under worst-case conditions the OBD would recognize a failure on Exhaust System components (e.g. components of the Exhaust Gas Recirculation EGR) but would not display the failure with a malfunction indicator lamp.
opel.remedy: Reprogram the K20 Engine Control Module via SPS with the latest software available on TIS2WEB:

opel.defect: INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF THE REAR WHEEL HUB BOLTS Noises may come from the rear wheel brake and wheel pinion socket due to incorrect tightening of the rear wheel hub bolts.
opel.remedy: Replace the affected rear wheel hub bolts.

opel.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY PARTIALLY RELEASE Following a small number of complaints of Vauxhall Vectra and Signum vehicles rolling away due to allegedly defective handbrakes. Vauxhall engineers in conjunction with consultants and other bodies have conducted rigorous testing and found that provided the handbrake is applied correctly without depressing the release button the handbrake is perfectly safe.
opel.remedy: In line with it's priority of continuous improvement recalled vehicles will be fitted with a modified handbrake mechanism to reduce the possibility of a partial release.

opel.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the welds to the left front suspension-strut turret many not be to specification. This could lead to detachment of the suspension-strut turret detachment and subsequent loss of control of the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and apply additional weld seams to the turret.

opel.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ENGINE MAY STALL On affected vehicles there is a  potential chafing condition between an engine wiring harness and the transmission housing which might cause miscellaneous engines failures e.g.  engine telltale on illuminates  vehicle may not start or the engine stalls during driving.
opel.remedy: Reroute loom on affected vehicles. If necessary repair or replace loom.

opel.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
opel.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

opel.defect: SUSPENSION MAY BECOME INSECURE The longitudinal control arm of the rear axle may not be correctly fastened. This may cause the arm to break and/or detach.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles check the torque of the screw connection on the longitudinal rod  and replace nuts bolts or rear axle where necessary.

opel.defect: SEVERAL REAR AXLE FASTENING BOLTS NEED TO BE REPLACED Rear axle bolts may break or become loose
opel.remedy: Check the fastening torque and replace affected bolts on all affected vehicles

opel.defect: REAR EXHAUST PIPE MAY MOVE BACKWARDS SLIPPING OFF THE FRONT PIPE The possibility exists that the rear exhaust pipe can move backwards and slip off the front pipe. With the possibility that under body components may become damaged.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check likely to be affected under body areas and install a new exhaust clamp.

opel.defect: RIGHT FRONT SEAT WELD MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The welding to the right hand front single seat may not be to specification. In the event of an accident the right hand front seat may separate from the floor panel.
opel.remedy: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles to add two welding seams on each rear bracket on the right hand front seat pedestal.

opel.defect: FRONT PASSENGER SEAT COULD MOVE WITHOUT WARNING. The fixing bolts of the front passenger seat rails to seat frame may fail and leave the seat insecure. In the event of an accident this could lessen the effectiveness of the seat belt.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front passenger seat rails to seat frame fixing bolts.

opel.defect: THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE COMPENSATION (VACUUM) PUMP MAY NOT GET ACTIVATED . Under specific conditions (vacuum loss) the Hydraulic Brake Compensation (vacuum pump) may not get activated
opel.remedy: Reprogram the Electronic Brake Control Module (EBCM) with improved software.

opel.defect: SEAT SECURITY CONCERN Driver and front passenger seat adjuster rails may fracture and cause seat to become insecure.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcing plates to the seat runners. Fit new runners if the original ones are fractured.

opel.defect: LOSS OF STABILITY The connection between the steering knuckle and the lower control arm may not be assembled correctly. If this condition is evident the connection could become insecure. The event can happen suddenly and unexpectedly in which case the vehicle is no longer controllable.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the connection between the steering knuckle and the lower control arm on both sides of the vehicle. Where necessary the connection will be reassembled correctly.

opel.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Moisture can ingress and accumulate inside the ABS control unit. Excessive accumulation of moisture may cause a fire.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles install an additional ABS module protection cover.

opel.defect: AUXILIARY HEATER HARNESS CONNECTOR COULD OVER HEAT It is possible that the auxiliary heater harness connection could over heat or burn due to oxidization.  In extreme cases it is possible that this could result in a thermal incident.
opel.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and install heat shrink sleeves to the wining.

opel.defect: The rear toe link may have material loss over vehicle lifetime due to corrosion. The rear toe link may have material loss over vehicle lifetime due to corrosion which weakens the part. This leads to a risk of breakage while driving. In case of breakage this leads to a reduced ability to control the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Check and replace the rear toe link if necessary.

opel.defect: SEATBELTS MAY STICK WHEN PULLED OUT OR RETRACTED On affected vehicles certain seat belts might stick when pulled out and retracted.
opel.remedy: Replace the affected seat belts on the affected vehicles.

opel.defect: THE BRAKE PEDAL BOX IS NOT ASSEMBLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS There is a risk that the Brake Pedal may fall down while driving resulting in the total loss of brake performance.
opel.remedy: Check the assembly date range and replace the brake pedal box if affected.

opel.defect: Movano Smart Tachograph Affected vehicles have a smart tachograph fitted that may not comply with regulatory requirements.
opel.remedy: Replace the Tachograph Sensor Antenna(s) and adding Wiring Harnesses if necessary.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Astra Grandland Fuel pipe leakage Affected vehicles may face potential leakage of the under-bonnet fuel pipe due to a weakness of its crimping.
opel.remedy: Change the fuel pipe.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Astra Grandland Fuel pipe leakage Affected vehicles may face potential leakage of the under-bonnet fuel pipe due to a weakness of its crimping.
opel.remedy: Change the fuel pipe.

opel.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update. Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
opel.remedy: Change the ATB.

opel.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update. Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
opel.remedy: Change the ATB.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Corsa Jet cooling nozzle failure. On affected vehicles the engine is at risk of becoming damaged because of an inadequate oil supply from an oil jet cooling nozzle.
opel.remedy: Replace the engine oil and filter.

opel.defect: Vauxhall DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain. Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
opel.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

opel.defect: Vauxhall DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain. Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
opel.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

opel.defect: Vauxhall DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain. Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
opel.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

opel.defect: Cross carline Engine software On affected vehicles below 12500 miles under certain conditions engine emissions may lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
opel.remedy: Check the mileage of the vehicle and update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration on vehicles below 12500 miles.

opel.defect: Cross carline Engine software On affected vehicles below 12500 miles under certain conditions engine emissions may lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
opel.remedy: Check the mileage of the vehicle and update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration on vehicles below 12500 miles.

opel.remedy: Check the mileage of the vehicle and update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration on vehicles below 12500 miles.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Combo 4x4 Transfer Box On affected vehicles a defective 4x4 transfer box oil seal might leak resulting in the rear wheels locking up and a loss of control of the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Remove and replace the front transfer box oil seal.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Grandland X PHEV Traction Battery Affected vehicles may have a fault in the High Voltage Battery which could potentially lead to it overheating and in the worst case a battery or vehicle fire. Customers are advised to stop any plug-in charging and eSave charging until the vehicle is reworked.
opel.remedy: Update the battery management software or replace the High Voltage Battery if necessary.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Astra Corsa Mokka eVCU update Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
opel.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Astra Corsa Mokka eVCU update Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
opel.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Astra Corsa Mokka eVCU update Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
opel.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

opel.defect: Instrument Panel Cluster Software On affected vehicles a low AdBlue level message may not be displayed on the Instrument Panel Cluster.  This could lead to the possibility of not being able to start the vehicle due to an empty AdBlue tank.
opel.remedy: Update the Instrument Panel Cluster software.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Automomous Telematics Box. Affected vehicles may experience an autonomous telematic box that cannot connect to the remote server making it not possible to make calls or use other connected services.
opel.remedy: Disconnect the 12V battery and reconnect it after 15 seconds then check for a trouble code.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Automomous Telematics Box. Affected vehicles may experience an autonomous telematic box that cannot connect to the remote server making it not possible to make calls or use other connected services.
opel.remedy: Disconnect the 12V battery and reconnect it after 15 seconds then check for a trouble code.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Automomous Telematics Box. Affected vehicles may experience an autonomous telematic box that cannot connect to the remote server making it not possible to make calls or use other connected services.
opel.remedy: Disconnect the 12V battery and reconnect it after 15 seconds then check for a trouble code.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Vivaro  K0 Seat Fixation On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
opel.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

opel.defect: Vauxhall Corsa Radio software via OTA update. On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
opel.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Grandland Risk of broken bolt front control arm ball joint On affected vehicles the fixing bolts on the front left or right bracket on the lower control arm may break.  In the worst-case scenario 2 broken bolts could affect the controllability of the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Change the front left and right ball joint brackets.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Frontera Brake Pedal Bracket Connection. On affected vehicles there may be an insufficient brake pedal bracket connection due to a missing or incorrectly assembled pin. If the pin falls out the brake pedal will potentially disengage.
opel.remedy: Check the brake pedal connection confirm proper assembly and rework it if necessary.

opel.defect: MCU software On affected vehicles incorrect MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration may result in a loss of propulsion while driving.
opel.remedy: Update the MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration

opel.defect: Vauxhall cross carline Driver’s Airbag - Takata On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbag inflators may deteriorate over time.  This may cause the inflators to rupture with too much force in a crash leading to serious injury or death in a worst-case scenario.
opel.remedy: Replace the driver airbag module.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Combo (K9) Headlamp Height Level Sensor Affected vehicles may have the Headlamp Height Level sensor fitted with incorrect orientation causing the Headlamp beam to be aimed too low and does not adjust as it should.
opel.remedy: Check the Height Level Sensor for correct assembly and replace if necessary.

opel.defect: Low Pressure Fuel Pipe On affected vehicles the low-pressure fuel pipe could come in to contact with one of the ignition coil screws. This could lead to fuel pipe damage over time resulting in a fuel leak.
opel.remedy: Fix the low-pressure fuel pipe to the crankcase breather hose with a cable tie to ensure there is no contact between the ignition coil screw and the fuel pipe.

opel.defect: Traction Battery software Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
opel.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

opel.defect: Traction Battery software Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
opel.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

opel.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

opel.defect: Movano – Fuel Pipe Leak Affected vehicles may experience a diesel fuel leak from the fuel pressure damper.
opel.remedy: Replace the lower section of the fuel pipe including the damper.

opel.defect: Vauxhall cross carline Driver’s Airbag - Takata On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbags may deteriorate over time which may cause the inflator to rupture and lead to serious injury.
opel.remedy: Owners of affected vehicles should immediately cease using their vehicle when safe to do so until the recall action has been completed. Affected vehicles will have the airbag modules replaced.

opel.remedy: Owners of affected vehicles should immediately cease using their vehicle when safe to do so until the recall action has been completed. Affected vehicles will have the airbag modules replaced.

opel.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box Affected vehicles have been fitted with the wrong Autonomous Telematic Box.  This means it cannot connect to the remoter server making it impossible to make E-Calls or use Intelligent Speed Assistance.
opel.remedy: Replace the Autonomous Telematic Box.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Fuel Pipe On affected vehicles there there may be loose connections between a high-pressure fuel pipe and the engine fuel rail which potentially could lead to a leak and risk of fire.
opel.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

opel.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

opel.defect: Vauxhall Astra L E-call not working due to duplicate IMEI On affected vehicles equipped with E-call the device may not function when trying to connect to E-Call (Emergency Call) and B-Call (Breakdown Call) due to incorrect BSRF (On-board radiocommunication transmitter) configuration and as a result does not comply with regulatory requirements.
opel.remedy: Check and replace the Radio frequency connectivity box.

opel.defect: THE FIXED ROOF LUGGAGE CARRIER RAILS MAY BECOME LOOSE The vehicle�s fixed roof luggage carrier rails may become loose.
opel.remedy: Check and replace the fixed roof luggage carrier rails if necessary

opel.defect: LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE The brake vacuum pump fitted to the F8Q diesel engine can leak with the potential to allow oil to enter the brake servo with the consequence that a sudden loss of servo assistance and reduction of braking efficiency could occur.
opel.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles will be recalled and the make of the vacuum pump checked. Should this be found to be of Magnetti Marelli manufacture the pump will be changed for a quality assured unit. In addition the servo and associated vacuum pipe will be examined for oil ingress and replaced where necessary.

opel.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL THE MANUFACTURER HAS RECOMMENDED THAT AFFECTED VEHICLES ARE NOT DRIVEN UNTIL CHECKED BY THEIR OFFICIAL AGENTS. The steering system may not have been produced according to specification. There is a risk that the steering intermediate shaft may break while driving resulting in the loss of steering control.
opel.remedy: The affected vehicles must not be driven until a new intermediate shaft that does meet the manufacturer's specification has been fitted.

opel.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING POWER WHERE THE BRAKE PEDAL IS APPLIED SLOWLY AND CONSTANTLY Extended brake pedal travel and a reduction in braking power where the brake pedal is applied slowly and constantly.
opel.remedy: Replace numerous brake and clutch hydraulic components.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING IN STEERING DROP ARM AND BRACKET Cracking may occur in the steering drop arm or idler arm and bracket assembly which if not detected could ultimately affect steering control.
opel.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for examination of the subject components. Any arms or brackets identified as belonging to the affected batches will be replaced with quality assured examples.

opel.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL The mounting end of the handbrake cable may move in its support bracket.  This might result in the loss of the handbrake function.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to either have a washer installed or the replacement of the cable.

opel.defect: INCORRECT GEAR AND STEERING KNUCKLE FITTED As a result of an incorrect steering gear and steering knucle combination being fitted during manufacture the front tyres may contact the lower front suspension arms when the steering is turned on to a full lock.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace both the steering knucles. Additionally the lower suspension arms and tyres will be checked for damage.

opel.defect: THE REAR END IMPACT LIMITER MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN PRODUCTION The rear end impact limiter might not have been installed in production.
opel.remedy: Check if the rear end impact limiter is present and install one if required.

opel.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL A small number of steering knuckles on hub swivels have been manufactured incorrectly. In time these knuckles might fail with the attendant loss of directional control of the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the production date code on steering knuckles fitted to both sides. Replace the steering knuckles where required.

opel.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN ENGINE COOLING RADIATOR AIR INTAKE MODULE SEALING BAFFLE MISSING Vehicles may have an engine cooling radiator air intake module sealing baffle missing.
opel.remedy: Install the missing radiator air intake sealing baffle.

opel.defect: THE FRONT MODULAR BENCH SEAT HEADRESTS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION. The front modular bench seat headrests may not be to specification and might not be locked correctly.
opel.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected headrests and guides

opel.defect: AIRBAG MAY INADVERTENTLY DEPLOY In some circumstances there is a possibility that the side airbag may inadvertently deploy.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit additional springs to the front seats so that any electrostatic discharge will correctly earthed.

opel.defect: RISK OF FIRE In the event the heater fan resistor thermal fuse is affected by a combination of several factors there is a possible risk of fire.
opel.remedy: Replace the resistor fuse with modified type. Fit new moulding to base of windscreen and where not already done so replace heater motor assembly.

opel.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE An incorrect front brake hose may have been fitted which may allow brake fluid to leak
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace front brake hoses

opel.defect: 18 INCH ALLOY WHEELS MAY BECOME INSECURE 18 inch alloy wheels may develop cracking at high mileages in excess of 62000 miles. This may lead to a loss of clamping force at the wheel bolts and in a worse case scenario wheel detachment.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace all four wheels.

opel.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE In order for proper regeneration of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) system the vehicle in the active regeneration mode directs the driver by illuminating the DPF warning light to drive the vehicle at constant speed without interruption until the DPF warning light turns off. In the event that the driver ignores the DPF warning light and the corresponding direction the DPF system as well as exhaust pipe will be abnormally overheated. This may cause a fire at the Lower Engine Compartment Cover located near the DPF system and exhaust pipe.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and initially remove and discard the Lower Engine Compartment Cover. When parts are available the vehicles will be recalled to have the new Lower Engine Compartment Cover fitted.

opel.defect: EGR VALVE PIPE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) valve pipe may fail/break. This will allow hot exhaust gases to escape and potentially damage component in the surrounding area.
opel.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the EGR valve pipe.

opel.defect: FRONT DUAL SEAT MAY BE UNSTABLE IN A COLLISION The front dual passenger seat may fail as the welded seams may not be to specification.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect and inspect the seat frame and where necessary replace the frame.

opel.defect: VSM software Interior door handles Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
opel.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

opel.defect: VSM software Interior door handles Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
opel.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

opel.defect: Movano software - turn signal detection. On affected vehicles the Body Control Module is not correctly configured to detect a failure in the indicator lamps.  As a result if a turn indicator bulb fails it's not detected and the indicator warning does not activate.
opel.remedy: Update the vehicle configuration and the Secure Gateway Electronic Control Unit.

opel.defect: SEAT BELT LATCHING CONCERN Driver and front passenger seat belt latching mechanism may separate when loaded in a frontal impact.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit quality assured seat belt buckles.

opel.defect: LACK OF WELD PENETRATION OF ROADWHEEL SEAM WELDS The seam weld joining the wheel disc to the wheel rim may lack penetration resulting in failure of the weld and eventual detachment of the road wheel.
opel.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the road wheels with quality assured examples.

opel.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED The  lower wishbone fixing bolts might not have been tightened to the correct specification. This could lead to steering wheel noise and vibration possibly affecting steering direction while driving or accelerating (e.g. pulling to one side).
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles check tightness of bolts. If necessary replace bolts and tighten to correct specification.

opel.defect: THE U BOLT SECURING THE RIGHT HAND REAR LEAF SPRING MAY BE INCORRECTLY FASTENED The rear axle U-bolts may not be fastened according to specification.
opel.remedy: Check the tightening torque of the rear axle U-bolts and replace where incorrect

opel.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The intermediate steering shaft may not be correctly coupled to the steering column which in certain driving conditions could result in disconnection and loss of steering control.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary reassemble the intermediate steering shaft to the steering column correctly.

opel.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The gears within the steering rack may not have been manufactured to the correct specification which may allow them to crack over a period of time. Prolonged use could cause loss of steering control.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace steering gear assembly

opel.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED Due to the insufficient strength of the material used in the brake pedal bearing it is possible that the bearing could fail when extreme force is applied to it during heavy or extreme braking.
opel.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the brake pedal bearing.

opel.defect: STEERING WHEEL MAY DETACH It is possible that the steering wheel securing bolt may not have been tightened to the correct specification. This should be identified to the driver by a loose steering wheel.  However in extreme cases if the driver does not take notice of the looseness then the wheel could detach causing loss of control of the vehicle.
opel.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicle and re-secure the steering wheel securing bolt.

opel.defect: REAR SEAT CENTRE BELT MIGHT NOT RESTRAIN THE SEAT OCCUPANT IN A FRONTAL IMPACT It has been identified that during the manufacturing process the lock bar may not have been fitted to the belt retractor. In the worst case the restraint function of the rear seat centre belt might not operate correctly in the case of a frontal impact.
opel.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear centre seat belt inspected and replaced if necessary.

opel.defect: Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe. Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
opel.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

opel.defect: 1) POSSIBLE STATIC SPARKING DURING REFUELLING (ASTRA MODELS ONLY) 2) AIR BAG SYSTEM MAY NOT DEPLOY 1) During refuelling the flow of fuel can cause static electricity to build up in the tank filler neck with the possibility of static sparking. 2) On some vehicles an electrical connector plug in the air bag system may not be correctly possible
opel.remedy: A) The fitting of a metal earthing clamp to the lower end of the metal ring for the fuel filler cap to ensure a conductive connection between the filler neck and the vehicle body. B) Checking that in potentially affected vehicles the subject elect

opel.defect: POWER STEERING GEAR LOWER BEARING MAY SEPARATE Power steering gear lower bearing may separate causing intermittent increased steering effort when turning.
opel.remedy: Check lower bearing and where necessary install a new bearing or power steering gear.

opel.defect: LOWER ENGINE PROTECTION COVER The possibility that the lower metal engine protection guard could trap material between it and the underside of the engine exhaust system.
opel.remedy: Replace the metal under engine protection guard with a different design to prevent the collection of material.

opel.defect: REAR AXLE MAY DETACH Because of a manufacturing error the nearside rear stub axle could start to develop cracks at the inner radius which could eventually lead to failure of the stub axle and difficulty in maintaining directional control.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the rear axle.

opel.defect: POTENTIAL CHAFING ON THE FUEL TUBES Affected vehicles may have a chafing condition on the fuel pipes.
opel.remedy: Check and replace the fuel pipes as necessary add protectors to the pipes

opel.defect: CENTRAL DOOR LOCKING SYSTEM MAY UNLOCK THE DOORS WHILST VEHICLE IS PARKED The Central Door Locking (CDL) might unlock the doors while the vehicle is parked or the doors can only be unlocked with the mechanical key. This is caused by inadequate sealing allowing water ingress into the door connector
opel.remedy: Seal both A-pillar areas above the door connectors with sealer to avoid water ingress to the door connector.

opel.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY The driver's air bag may not deploy as intended

opel.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the DPF. Some models will also need a software change.

opel.defect: REAR AXLE HUB MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The hardening process applied to the rear wheel bearing inner ring may be incorrect. There is a possibility that a rumbling noise may become apparent which if not checked could in extreme circumstances result in the detachment of the hub and severely impaired road holding/handling.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the date stamp on the rear wheel hubs. Where necessary replace the hub bearing assembly.

opel.defect: OIL MAY LEAK IN EXTREME CASES MAY CAUSE A FIRE Affected vehicles may have been built with an incorrect crimping of the turbocharger oil feed pipe connector. This may cause oil leakage which may lead to odours smoke oil specks on the floor or engine failure. In the worst case a fire in the engine compartment could occur.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbo charger oil feed pipe.

opel.defect: FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY A front seat side air bag may not deploy as intended

opel.defect: FAILURE OF PARKING BRAKE CABLE Insufficient diameter of the handbrake cable may cause the handbrake to fail prematurely.

opel.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. opel.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

opel.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO ABS  WIRING MAY CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT AND A FIRE It has been identified that the above vehicles could be affected by moisture ingress at the ABS connector. The moisture can enter through the ground wiring connection  which can lead to the ABS not functioning correctly overheating within the connector and in extreme cases a fire.
opel.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the ABS harness plug checked for moisture ingress and where necessary the wiring harness and control unit will be replaced. In all other cases the ground cable will be secured against ingress of moisture by soldering the cable sockets and applying shrink tubes.

opel.defect: THE CLIP OF A FUEL LINE BUNDLE MAY CHAFE AGAINST THE FUEL PUMP RETURN HOSE On a certain number of Insignia B - Model Year 18 the clip of a fuel line bundle might chafe against the fuel pump hose resulting in fuel leaks and in the worst case in a risk of fire.
opel.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers will check the hose routing to turn the clip by 180� and to replace the hose and add a grommet to the fuel hose if necessary on all affected vehicles where the hose has signs of damage or leakage

opel.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
opel.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

In certain head on or rear end collisions the lap belt pretentioner will deploy but not lock in the loaded position. This can increase the risk of injury when the conditions are met. Parts for the recall will not be available until October 2015.
opel.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace both front pretentioners with lap belt.

opel.defect: WATER INGRESS THROUGH WHEEL ARCHES INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT Water ingress into the passenger compartment due to poor wheel arch sealing may lead to airbag malfunction
opel.remedy: Seal the wheel arch body seams.  Replace wiring harness and airbag control unit if necessary

opel.defect: RISK OF FIRE Water ingress to the relay on the electrical vacuum pump may cause a short. In extreme instances this may lead to fire.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace Vacuum Pump/Relay Assembly and apply special grease to electrical connectors

opel.defect: SEAT BELTS MAY BECOME INSECURE The bolt securing the outer seat belt buckles may become loose on the 2nd and if fitted 3d row seats
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles remove bolt remove washer clean and refit bolt applying thread lock

opel.defect: SEAT SECURITY CONCERN Driver and front passenger seat adjuster rails may fracture and cause seat to become insecure.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcing plates to the seat runners. Fit new runners if the original ones are fractured.

opel.defect: POSSIBLE UNEXPECTED SIDE AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT DUE TO INSUFFICIENT ELECTRICAL GROUNDING Possible unexpected side airbag deployment due to insufficient electrical grounding.
opel.remedy: Rework the affected ground studs to ensure sufficient electrical grounding.

opel.defect: LOSS OF PARKING BRAKE FUNCTION Incorrect crimping of the secondary parking brake cable ferrules.
opel.remedy: Replacement of the secondary parking brake cables the adjuster and the adjustment nut.

opel.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that cracking of the parking brake actuating levers of the rear axle disc brake calipers may lead to loss of parking brake function.

opel.defect: RISK OF DRIVESHAFT FAILURE Due to insufficient coating during manufacture the drive-shafts) may corrode and fracture. In the event that the drive-shaft is fractured the vehicle loses drive but steering and braking will be still be available.
opel.remedy: On affected vehicles replace both drive shafts.

opel.defect: SEAT ADJUSTER CONCERN The driver and front passenger seat longtitudinal adjuster latch spring may weaken and fail to lock the seat in the selected position. This could affect the drivers control of the vehicle and/or passenger safety.
opel.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the effectiveness of the adjuster latch spring. Fit a new seat base in cases where the spring is found to be defective.
