This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

peugeot.defect: The fuel line could make contact with the body and lead to fuel leakage Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.�
peugeot.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.�

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

peugeot.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
peugeot.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE PLUS ENGINE OPERATING PROBLEMS. In adverse wet weather conditions water may enter the engine management solenoid valve operating circuit. This could result in engine operating problems and a reduction in power assistance to the brake pedal if the water enters the brake vacuum circuit via the solenoid valves.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to examine and if necessary replace the engine management solenoid valves with ones sealed against the ingress of water.

peugeot.defect: On affected vehicles the hydraulic power steering hose is not according to specification which could lead to deterioration in power steering assistance or sudden loss of steering assistance. On affected vehicles the hydraulic power steering hose is not according to specification which could lead to deterioration in power steering assistance or sudden loss of steering assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Check and replace power steering hose if necessary.

peugeot.defect: CERTAIN REAR SUSPENSION FIXING BOLTS MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION Certain rear suspension fixing bolts may not conform to specification which could cause them to break.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the affected bolts

peugeot.defect: DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE  MAY ABRADE AND WEAR. It has been identified that a slight amount of play in the diesel fuel return pipe mountings on certain vehicles may over time lead to abrasion and wear of the pipe.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject clips checked and the pipe secured.

peugeot.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.�
peugeot.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAG SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION Some cases have been found where inadequate drainage of water condensing from the air conditioning system has caused water to run under the carpet. This in turn may lead to the airbag warning light coming on or in extreme cases lead to airbag systems malfunctioning.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected for modification of the drainage tube and the anti return valve.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING MAY BE AFFECTED It is possible that an engine coolant pipe can contact and chaff a brake pipe/line which can lead to damage and possible failure of the pipe.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the rerouting of the coolant pipe and if required the replacement of the brake pipe/line.

peugeot.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU There is a possibility that water may ingress into the airbag electronic control unit (ECU) compartment.  This may cause premature deployment of the airbag.
peugeot.remedy: Seal the airbag ECU compartment.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF ERRATIC OPERATION OF THE MOTORIZED THROTTLE BODY The software may cause erratic operation of the motorized throttle which may result in breakage of the throttle stop. This can result in the engine reverting to limp home mode with a possible reduction in braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Subject vehicles will be recalled and the condition eradicated by carrying out an ECU download.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

peugeot.defect: BONNET MAY OPEN WITHOUT WARNING The bonnet may not close correctly over time because a possible non-conformity with the fixing of the bonnet catch. The driver may notice in certain cases difficulty in opening or closing the bonnet easily or vibrations or slight movement of the bonnet when driving. The risk is incorrect closing of the bonnet which could lead without any warning to unwanted opening when driving.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the front bumper support. Where necessary the front bumper support will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS FITTED MIGHT NOT BE TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION The High Voltage Harness might not be to the correct specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the harness conformity and replace it if necessary

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
peugeot.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

peugeot.defect: DUE TO THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE THE NOX EMISSIONS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS The calibration of the engine management software could result in emissions of NOx which do not comply with the regulatory limits.
peugeot.remedy: Download new engine management software

peugeot.defect: INCORRECT BRAKE COMPENSATOR An incorrect load sensitive rear brake compensator may have been fitted to some 306 models.
peugeot.remedy: Potentially affected vehicles are being recalled to have the compensator examined. Vehicles equipped with an incorrect unit will have this replaced with the correct type.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERTENT OPENING OF THE ENGINE BONNET It has been identified that the welds which secure the bonnet locking assembly may prove inadequate in use. This can result in difficulty closing the bonnet or failure of the lock to properly engage.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will  have a strengthening component fitted to the bonnet lining to ensure that the trigger cable remains firmly secured to the bonnet. In very rare cases and only if necessarythe bonnet will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: BRAKE MAY BE INADVERTENTLY APPLIED In certain circumstances it is possible that the passenger could inadvertently apply the service brake. The linkage is accessed above the passenger footwell.
peugeot.remedy: Affected vehicles will have a cover fitted above the passenger footwell to close off access to the brake linkage.

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminal and correct it if necessary.

peugeot.defect: TIGHTENING TORQUE OF TOWBAR FIXING MAY BE TO WRONG SPECIFICATION Tightening of some towbar fixings may not be to correct specification.
peugeot.remedy: Checking and if necessary correcting the tightening torque of the fixings.

peugeot.defect: CERTAIN REAR SUSPENSION FIXING BOLTS MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION Certain rear suspension fixing bolts may not conform to specification which could cause them to break.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the affected bolts

peugeot.defect: THE REAR LOWER SHOCK ABSORBER MOUNTING BOLT MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT TORQUE SETTING The rear lower shock absorber mounting bolt might not be tightened to the correct torque setting
peugeot.remedy: The campaign requires the bolt to be loosened and re-torqued to the correct setting

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It has been identified that the possibility exists that contact between the fuel return pipe and the engine shield may take place inside the engine compartment. Should this occur wear on the pipe would ensue which in the worst case; would result in a fuel leak.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with an additional fastener to ensure that contact is not made and if necessary the fuel return pipe will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAG MAY INCORRECTLY DEPLOY On affected vehicles the driver's air bag inflation device may not conform to specification. As a result may not deploy correctly during an impact.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the driver's air bag module on affected vehicles

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance). The timing belt will be checked and if needed replaced with other components of the braking assistance system and the vacuum pump.

peugeot.defect: UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING CONDITIONS THE AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR PULLEY COULD BREAK The air conditioning compressor pulley could break and damage other components.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the air conditioning compressor pulley and if necessary the protective cover.

peugeot.defect: SPOILER MAY DETACH The bonding of the tailgate spoiler may not conform to specification. This could lead to a lack of adhesion and detachment of the spoiler
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the rear spoiler

peugeot.defect: SPOT WELDS MAY NOT HOLD On a very limited number of vehicles it is necessary to check the presence of specific spot welds on the vehicle body shell.  Should it be identified that one of the welds has been missed in production the vehicle cannot be repaired. In the long term and in very rare cases body noises and squeaking could appear.
peugeot.remedy: In the rare case that the vehicle does not comply the vehicle will be removed from the road and the customer will be provided with a replacement vehicle.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY NOT START Due to none conformity during manufacture the resistance of the insulated base inside the Engine Control Unit (ECU) which controls the electric motor may decrease. As a result the voltage in the circuit may become unstable causing the warning light to illuminate and the driving motor power to be restricted to the fail safe control. In the worst case scenario the vehicle may not be able to be restarted and the battery may not be able to be charged.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine ECU.

peugeot.defect: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS AND ONE GROUND CABLE MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY The tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables may not conform to specification
peugeot.remedy: Tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables.

peugeot.defect: STARTER SUPPLY WIRE MAY CHAFE The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary.

peugeot.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL AND ADDITIONALLY THERE MAY BE A RISK OF ENGINE FLOODING Brake fluid may leak from the left hand master cylinder which if not rectified will result in loss of brake. Additionally the fuel pump could be injecting too much fuel which can lead to the engine stalling.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace internal components of the master cylinder. Additionally the fuel pump will be re-calibrated to prevent the risk of the engine stalling.

peugeot.defect: TIGHTENING OF REAR SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The tightening of some rear suspension fixings may not be correct to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Correcting some tightening torques and replacing some nuts and bolts.

peugeot.defect: FRONT BRAKE PIPE MAY CHAFE ON ANTI ROLL BAR The front left hand anti-roll bar linkage may contact and chafe the brake pipe when turning the wheels to full left lock.
peugeot.remedy: Inspect and where necessary reposition the left front brake pipe.

peugeot.defect: RISK OF ENGINE STALL On the subject vehicles it has been identified that there is a risk of the engine stalling during very sporty driving conditions.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the engine ECU software upgraded.

peugeot.defect: FUEL TUBES UNDER BODY MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME The fuel pipes under the body may have been damaged over time due to a relative movement between these pipes and their surroundings.
peugeot.remedy: Check the condition of the fuel pipes and replacing them if necessary.  New protection will be fitted on all vehicles to prevent this damage in the future.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE PETROL LEAKAGE The injector retaining clamps may not have been correctly tightened. This could result in leakage of fuel from around the injectors.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and ensure that the injector clamp bolts are tightened to the manufacturers specification.

peugeot.defect: HANDBRAKE MECHANISM MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION There is a possibility that the handbrake mechanism is not to the correct specification and as a result there is a possibility that under certain conditions the vehicle could roll away.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect and test the handbrake mechanism. If necessary replace the brake pads and re-adjust the handbrake cable as specified.

peugeot.defect: THE LEFT HAND FRONT SEAT LOWER SEAT BELT MOUNTING BOLT MAY DETACH There is a possible risk of the lower seat belt mounting bolt on the front left hand seat being loose or misaligned.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check installation of bolt - if correctly installed check tightness of bolt if bolt is not located correctly replace with supplied bolt.

peugeot.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been identified that on the specified vehicles a fault may develop with the brake vacuum pump. This can result in hardening of the brake pedal with an attendant loss of braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel injectors supply rail could develop a leak over a period of time leading to a drop in fuel pressure which can affect the operation of the stop start system. In some extreme cases the engine might not restart and a spray of petrol under the bonnet may occur which is a fire risk.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fuel injector supply rail. Where necessary replace the fuel injector supply rail.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO TYRES There is a risk that the tyres may have been damaged during fitting onto the wheel rim at the factory.
peugeot.remedy: Replace all five tyres.

peugeot.defect: FAILURE OF CAMSHAFT DRIVE BELT The camshaft drive belt may fail before the recommended replacement interval of 72000 miles. This could result in a complete loss of engine power without warning.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement camshaft drive belt.

peugeot.defect: THE BONDING OF THE REAR DOOR WINDOW GLASS TO THE HINGE ASSEMBLIES MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION On the affected vehicles the bonding of the rear door window glass to the hinge assemblies may not conform to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the rear window or re- bond the rear window glass hinges.

peugeot.defect: DRIVESHAFT NUTS MAY SLACKEN The driveshaft retaining nuts may slacken due to defective peening.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the driveshaft retaining nuts for security. Any nut showing evidence of defective peening will be renewed and secured as per the manufacturers instructions.

peugeot.defect: THE FRONT HUB ASSEMBLY FIXING ON TO THE FRONT SUSPENSION DAMPER MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The front hub assembly fixing on to the front suspension damper may not be correct to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the front hub assembly and replace if required.

peugeot.defect: PEDALS MAY BE OBSTRUCTED It is possible that the air conditioning unit air diffuser ducting on the driver's side may detach which could obstruct access to the driver control pedals.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles for the fitment of an additional support part to the air conditioning unit outlet ducting.

peugeot.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY FAIL UNEXPECTEDLY A component of the steering column may not be to specification and could fail. If this occurs there would be a loss of directional control.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer will contact keepers of affected vehicles and advise not to use the vehicle.  Examine vehicles and on those with the affected component replace  the steering column.

peugeot.defect: AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY The rotary connector on the air bag system can fail and cause interruption to the air bag electrical supply. This may prevent the air bag deploying in the event of an accident.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for a modification to the air bag electrical system.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE REAR SPOILER MAY DETACH The spoiler mounting on the rear tailgate may in certain cases have some weak points and cause some noise.This may even lead to the loss of the spoiler
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the 4 spoiler fixing bolts and fit two safety straps

peugeot.defect: DUE TO THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE THE NOX EMISSIONS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS The calibration of the engine management software could result in emissions of NOx which do not comply with the regulatory limits.
peugeot.remedy: Download new engine management software

peugeot.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY In very rare circumstances the vacuum pump one way valve may not function correctly which could affect the level of braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the brake vacuum pump one way valve.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKING ASSISTANCE On the affected vehicles an internal component of the braking assistance system vacuum pump may not conform.  This could over time lead to a reduction in braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Replacement of the vacuum pump

peugeot.defect: FUSE BOX MAY CAUSE EQUIPMENT OPERATIONAL FAILURES It has been identified that the main engine fuse box is not to the correct specification. This can result in operating faults or the failure of certain equipment.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuse box replaced.

peugeot.defect: FRONT AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY The ignition module which triggers the front seat airbag may not deploy in the event of an impact. There is no indication to the driver the unit is faulty.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and  replace the front seat airbag unit.

peugeot.defect: THE STEERING COLUMN HARNESS MAY FOUL ON STEERING COLUMN On some 406 models the steering column wiring harness may foul on the steering column and lead to electrical malfunction.
peugeot.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to Peugeot dealers to have the subject harness repositioned.

peugeot.defect: FRONT SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER HARNESS There is a possibility of an open circuit in the connector on the front seat belt pretensioner harness. This may cause flashing of the airbag warning light and a loss of the pretensioning function in case of an accident.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the front seat pretensioner harness.

peugeot.defect: THE REAR SUSPENSION WISHBONE MOUNTING BOLTS MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The rear suspension wishbone mountings bolts may not be correct to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Replacement of the rear suspension wishbone bolts.

peugeot.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE INTERNAL CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE SUBFRAME IS NOT DURABLE ENOUGH. There is a possibility that the internal corrosion protection of the front subframe is not durable enough.
peugeot.remedy: Replacing the front subframe assembly.

peugeot.defect: THE WELDING OF THE INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE TOWBAR MIGHT NOT MEET THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION The welding of some components to the towbar assembly may not meet specification.
peugeot.remedy: The replacement of the towbar.

peugeot.defect: A HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY WHERE THERE IS A MISMATCH IN THE VOLTAGE OF THE INDIVIDUAL CELLS A high voltage battery where there is a mismatch in the voltage of the individual cells.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the HV traction battery

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The pressure in the fuel injection system may be too high which could lead to the engine receiving too much fuel for the given throttle opening and subsequently the engine stalling.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary adjust the fuel system pressure.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel heating device integrated in to the diesel fuel filter cover may be defective and allow heat to build up within the electrical supply connector causing the cover to distort and air to enter the fuel circuit. This could make the vehicles difficult to start and a warning light will be illuminated on the dash board. The engine could be difficult or not possible to start. In the worst cases a diesel fuel leak could eventually appear.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel heater cover. Additionally the electrical connector will be inspected and where necessary replaced.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY In very rare circumstances the vacuum pump one way valve may not function correctly which could affect the level of braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the brake vacuum pump one way valve.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance). The timing belt will be checked and if needed replaced with other components of the braking assistance system and the vacuum pump.

peugeot.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY FAIL TO RETURN TO IDLE It has been identified that within the mechanism of the accelerator pedal there is a friction lever which interacts with a sliding surface. Over time and under certain conditionsthe contact surfaces may generated excessive friction and latterly the movement of the accelerator pedal. This over time and under certain conditions will result in the accelerator pedal becoming intermittently more difficult to push; or slower to return. In rare instances the accelerator pedal can remain in the partially depressed position.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a reinforcing plate fitted within the accelerator pedal mechanism which will ensure continued correct functionality.

peugeot.defect: STEERING BOLTS MAY BE TIGHTENED INCORRECTLY Incorrect assembly of the steering rack which could cause the loss of the mechanical link between the steering pinion valve and the steering rack during parking manoeuvres at full lock.
peugeot.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the steering rack.

peugeot.defect: ROOF FLAP MAY DETACH The roof panel rear flap hinge may have a defect which will eventually allow the roof panel to detach.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to either reinforce the retention of the hinges or changing the roof panel rear flap.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The brake servo pump system could develop problems with malfunction indicator lamps and audible warnings accompanied by the vacuum pump stopping. This will require the driver to apply greater force on the brake pedal to stop the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download the vacuum pump with a new version of the control software.

peugeot.defect: THE REAR BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THESE HOSES AND A CLIP The rear brake hoses may have been damaged over time due to inappropriate movement between these hoses and a clip.
peugeot.remedy: Check the condition of the rear left-hand and right-hand brake hoses and replacing them if necessary.  A new retaining clip is fitted on all vehicles to prevent this relative movement.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
peugeot.remedy: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.

peugeot.defect: RISK OF FIRE There is a possibility of a non conformity of the engine cooling motor fan unit which can result in a failure of the unit or exceptionally in local overheating that can result in combustion of the unit.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the motor fan unit.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The brake servo pump system could develop problems with malfunction indicator lamps and audible warnings accompanied by the vacuum pump stopping. This will require the driver to apply greater force on the brake pedal to stop the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download the vacuum pump with a new version of the control software.

peugeot.defect: INCORRECT BRAKE COMPENSATOR An incorrect load sensitive rear brake compensator may have been fitted to some boxer vehicles.
peugeot.remedy: Potentially affected vehicles are being recalled to have the compensator examined. Vehicles equipped with an incorrect unit will have this replaced with the correct type.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID There is a risk of internal cracking of the 4-way brake pipe unions ( non- ABS models) or the 2 x 4 - way brake pipe unions ( ABS models). This could result in a gradual loss of brake fluid and reduced braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the four way brake pipe unions.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY In very rare circumstances the vacuum pump one way valve may not function correctly which could affect the level of braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the brake vacuum pump one way valve.

peugeot.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL AND ADDITIONALLY THERE MAY BE A RISK OF ENGINE FLOODING Brake fluid may leak from the left hand master cylinder which if not rectified will result in loss of brake. Additionally the fuel pump could be injecting too much fuel which can lead to the engine stalling.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace internal components of the master cylinder. Additionally the fuel pump will be re-calibrated to prevent the risk of the engine stalling.

peugeot.defect: VACUUM PUMP DRIVE PIN Brake vacuum pump drive pin may fail as a result of premature wear. This could result in a loss of power assistance at the brake pedal.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a quality assured replacement drive pin to the brake vacuum pump.

peugeot.defect: THE EXTERNAL DOOR HANDLE SLIDERS MIGHT NOT BE MANUFACTURED TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION The external door handle sliders might not be manufactured to the correct specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the production date stamped on the door handle slider and replace the slider if needed.

peugeot.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been identified that on the specified vehicles a fault may develop with the brake vacuum pump. This can result in hardening of the brake pedal with an attendant loss of braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On some 2.0 l HDI vehicles potential contact between the fuel return pipe and the diesel filter support may eventually cause the pipe to become worn through friction.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer has requested that some protection be added to the pipe to ensure its long-term resistance to wear.

peugeot.defect: IGNITION SWITCH FIRE RISK Key operation in the steering lock ignition switch may become stiff or could seize.  An ignition switch seized in the start position could result in a starter motor burn out.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the complete steering lock assembly.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
peugeot.remedy: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

peugeot.defect: IF THE FRONT CENTRE PASSENGER SEATING POSITION  IS OCCUPIED THE FRONT OUTER PASSENGER SEAT BELT COULD RELEASE There is a risk of inadvertent release to the front outer passenger seat belt.
peugeot.remedy: Modifying the central seat buckle with foam and heat-shrinkable protective tubing

peugeot.defect: THE REAR BRAKE HOSE MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE HOSE AND HOLDING CLIP There is a possibility that the rear brake hose may become damaged due to relative movement between the hose and the holding clip.
peugeot.remedy: Check the condition of the left and right rear brake hoses and replace them if necessary.

peugeot.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Brake fluid may leak from the left hand master cylinder which if not rectified will result in loss of brake.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace internal components of the master cylinder.

peugeot.defect: THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE COULD RESULT IN EMISSIONS OF NOx WHICH DO NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS Engine management software issue could result in incorrect emission levels.
peugeot.remedy: Update the engine management software.

peugeot.defect: THE INCORRECT GEAR MAY BE SELECTED On affected vehicles the gear lever reverse locking ring might not be to the correct specification. This could cause difficulty in selecting first and reverse gear or an error when changing between 1st and reverse..
peugeot.remedy: Replace the gear lever reverse locking collar.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

peugeot.defect: SPOT WELDS MAY NOT HOLD On a very limited number of vehicles it is necessary to check the presence of specific spot welds on the vehicle body shell.  Should it be identified that one of the welds has been missed in production the vehicle cannot be repaired. In the long term and in very rare cases body noises and squeaking could appear.
peugeot.remedy: In the rare case that the vehicle does not comply the vehicle will be removed from the road and the customer will be provided with a replacement vehicle.

peugeot.defect: DRIVERS SEAT AIRBAG MAY MALFUNCTION Affected vehicles may present friction wear on the driver's seat wiring harness. Potentially causing an electrical malfunction and in worst case scenario cause the unwanted triggering of the driver's seat air bag.
peugeot.remedy: The remedial operation consists of reinforcing and clamping the driver's seat harness.

peugeot.defect: REAR BRAKE CALLIPER MOUNTING BOLT COULD WORK LOOSE The tightening torque of the rear brake calliper mounting bolts could be incorrect.  This incorrect tightening torque may in very rare cases eventually lead to the slackening of the bolt and an increase in noise during braking
peugeot.remedy: Replace the bolts and tighten to the correct  torque

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminal and correct it if necessary.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY In very rare circumstances the vacuum pump one way valve may not function correctly which could affect the level of braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the brake vacuum pump one way valve.

peugeot.defect: THE EFFICIENCY OF HANDBRAKE AND SERVICE BRAKE MIGHT BE COMPROMISED On the affected vehicles equipped with a manual handbrake the efficiency of the handbrake and service brake may be compromised.�
peugeot.remedy: Check the rear brake caliper references and replace as necessary.�

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel heating device integrated in to the diesel fuel filter cover may be defective and allow heat to build up within the electrical supply connector causing the cover to distort and air to enter the fuel circuit. This could make the vehicles difficult to start and a warning light will be illuminated on the dash board. The engine could be difficult or not possible to start. In the worst cases a diesel fuel leak could eventually appear.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel heater cover. Additionally the electrical connector will be inspected and where necessary replaced.

peugeot.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR On affected vehicles connectors intended to supply the electric front seats fitted to some versions are not used and are located under the rear footwell carpets.  If these connectors come into contact with water of melted snow mixed with snow removal products they may corrode over a period of time and cause localised electrical overheating.
peugeot.remedy: The operation involves repositioning these electrical supply wires for the two front seats to move them higher up on the seat frame.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

peugeot.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE INTERNAL CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE SUBFRAME IS NOT DURABLE ENOUGH. There is a possibility that the internal corrosion protection of the front subframe is not durable enough.
peugeot.remedy: Replacing the front subframe assembly.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT It has been identified that the alternator terminal wiring could be positioned too close to the exhaust heat shield. Under extreme conditions this proximity could result in an electrical short circuit.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will checked and the subject terminal repositioned as necessary.

peugeot.defect: WHEEL MAY DETACH It has been identified that the wheel bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification. The driver may experience a vibration through the steering wheel. However it not rectified there is a risk that the wheels may become damaged over time or the wheel could in extreme cases could detach from the vehicle whilst driving. This could cause loss of control of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the tightness of the road wheel bolts and rectify as necessary. In certain cases the replacement of the bolt(s) and wheel(s) may be necessary.

peugeot.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO TYRE DURING FITTING Internal tyre tread may have been damaged during fitting which could lead to a loss of pressure.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace all five tyres.

peugeot.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE It has been identified that the earthing terminal for the electrical power assisted steering assembly may require reinforcing. This is necessary in order to provide the correct electrical supply to the power steering assembly and to prevent possible loss of steering assistance. In any case the vehicle's steering capacity is not altered.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the power steering earth connection reinforced as necessary.

peugeot.defect: THE UREA INJECTOR MAY BLOCK AND LEAD TO NOX EMISSIONS OUT OF REGULATORY LIMITS On affected vehicles there may be a defect in the operation of the urea injector which may become blocked leading to NOx emissions exceeding regulatory limits.
peugeot.remedy: Update the ECU software to avoid the blockage of the urea injector.

peugeot.defect: WATER MAY PENETRATE INTO THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP CAUSING CORROSION Water may penetrate into the brake vacuum pump causing corrosion.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the brake vacuum pump.

peugeot.defect: TYRES MAY DEFLATE UNEXPECTEDLY A possible non-conformity in the fitting of the tyre valves as well as an incorrect tightening torque of the valve securing nut could cause a valve to fail and a rapid loss of pressure in the tyres. The tyre pressure monitoring warning lamp would illuminate to warn the driver.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the tyre valves using a fitting jig.

peugeot.defect: EXCESSIVE LOADING OF FRONT SUSPENSION COULD RESULT IN THE LOOSENING OF THE FRONT WISHBONE LOWER BALL JOINTS Excessive loading of the front suspension could result in the loosening of the front wishbone lower ball joints.
peugeot.remedy: Increasing the tightening torque of the ball joint and adding thread lock to the ball joint threads if the ball joint threads are found to be rusty the ball joint will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF STEERING RACK It has been identified that there is a risk that the rack to subframe bolts have been overtightened with the possibility of the bolts and/or rack mounting points cracking/breaking. This could lead to noise/vibration or loss of steering accuracy.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles examine the steering rack mounting bolts. Renew the mounting bolts/nuts and replace the steering rack if the mounting points are cracked or broken.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE COMPROMISED The threaded portion of the brake linkage rod in the brake control system may not be to conformity. This could result in a reduction of braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check rod and replace if found not to meet conformity.

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

peugeot.defect: THE LOWER METAL ENGINE PROTECTION GUARD AND THEUNDERSIDE OF THE ENGINE EXHAUST SYSTEM  COULD TRAP MATERIAL IN IT. The possibility that the lower metal engine protection guard could trap material between it and the underside of the engine exhaust system
peugeot.remedy: : Replace the metal under engine protection guard with a different design to prevent the collection of material.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
peugeot.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

peugeot.defect: COOLING SYSTEM STRATEGY COULD OVERHEAT THE ENGINE. The cooling system strategy and the maximum temperature alert could cause the engine to overheat this may cause an oil leak from the sump drain cap.  Due to the incorrect operation of the warning system there is no driver alert.
peugeot.remedy: The remedy involves downloading new engine management software.

peugeot.defect: THE EFFICIENCY OF HANDBRAKE AND SERVICE BRAKE MIGHT BE COMPROMISED On the affected vehicles equipped with a manual handbrake the efficiency of the handbrake and service brake may be compromised.�
peugeot.remedy: Check the rear brake caliper references and replace as necessary.�

peugeot.defect: POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE MAY FAIL. It is possible that the wiring harness for the power assisted steering motor may come in contact with other components in the engine bay.  Should this occur then it is possible that the power steering assistance on this large vehicle may become affected.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit protection to the wiring harness.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE BREAKAGE OF ACCELERATOR CABLE There is a risk of accelerator cable breakage due to cable kinking when the accelerator pedal is released suddenly.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified accelerator pedal.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
peugeot.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may have an incorrect torque on several fixation points which could result in reduced control of the vehicle and overheating of electrical connections. Affected vehicles may have an incorrect torque on several fixation points which could result in reduced control of the vehicle and overheating of electrical connections.
peugeot.remedy: Check and tighten fixings to correct torque.

peugeot.defect: VEHICLES AFFECTED MAY HAVE A SINGLE WHEEL BOLT ON BOTH RIGHT HAND SIDE WHEELS WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY A single wheel bolt on both right-hand wheels may not be tightened to the correct tightening torque.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace wheel bolts and any other associated parts if consequential damage has occurred.

peugeot.defect: DRIVERS SEAT AIRBAG MAY MALFUNCTION Affected vehicles may present friction wear on the driver's seat wiring harness. Potentially causing an electrical malfunction and in worst case scenario cause the unwanted triggering of the driver's seat air bag.
peugeot.remedy: The remedial operation consists of reinforcing and clamping the driver's seat harness.

peugeot.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING EFFORT DUE TO AIR IN THE SERVO The tightening torque of one of the nuts of the connection between the brake servo unit and the brake pedal may be not correct to specification. This may allow air to enter the servo
peugeot.remedy: Check servo security and where necessary replace the brake servo unit

peugeot.defect: A REAR SEAT LONGITUDINAL ADJUSTMENT LEVER MAY NOT LOCK PROPERLY A rear seat longitudinal adjustment lever may not lock properly.
peugeot.remedy: Check affected seat frames and replacing them if necessary.

peugeot.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

peugeot.defect: THE FIXING OF THE FRONT WING WHEEL ARCH TRIM DOES NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION The fixing of the front wing wheel arch trim does not conform to specification.
peugeot.remedy: The repair consists of adding an additional fixing screw to the bottom of the front wheel arch trim.

peugeot.defect: DRIVESHAFT NUTS MAY SLACKEN The driveshaft retaining nuts may slacken due to defective peening.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the driveshaft retaining nuts for security. Any nut showing evidence of defective peening will be renewed and secured as per the manufacturers instructions.

This could make the vehicles difficult to start and a warning light will be illuminated on the dash board. The engine could be difficult or not possible to start. In the worst cases a diesel fuel leak could eventually appear.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel heater cover. Additionally the electrical connector will be inspected and where necessary replaced.

peugeot.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
peugeot.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque

peugeot.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING EFFORT DUE TO AIR IN THE SERVO The tightening torque of one of the nuts of the connection between the brake servo unit and the brake pedal may be not correct to specification. This may allow air to enter the servo
peugeot.remedy: Check servo security and where necessary replace the brake servo unit

peugeot.defect: THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE COULD RESULT IN EMISSIONS OF NOx WHICH DO NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS Engine management software issue could result in incorrect emission levels.
peugeot.remedy: Update the engine management software.

peugeot.defect: THE ROUTING OF THE REAR BRAKE PIPES MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION The routing of the rear brake pipes may not be correct and could cause them to fail.
peugeot.remedy: Check and replace affected pipes if necessary

peugeot.defect: FRONT RIGHT HAND LOWER SUSPENSION ARM MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The front right hand lower suspension arm may not be to specification.  As a consequence it may deform under certain impact loads.
peugeot.remedy: Check the identification markings on the suspension arm and replace where necessary.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK IF VEHICLE INVOLVED IN A ROLLOVER INCIDENT On the affected vehicles the non-return valve located inside the fuel tank may not conform to specification. If the vehicle was to roll over there is a risk of a fuel leak.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles checking the condition of the valve and replace the tank if necessary.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance). The timing belt will be checked and if needed replaced with other components of the braking assistance system and the vacuum pump.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

peugeot.defect: ON SOME TRACTION BATTERY CELLS THE ALIGNMENT OF THE ELECTRODES MAY BE OUT OF SPECIFICATION On affected vehicles the alignment of the electrodes may be out of specification on some cells of the traction batteries which may result in the release of toxic fumes or a thermal runaway.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the traction / drive battery.

peugeot.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING. It has been identified that the position of the exterior lighting control ring may not be detected by the lighting management system and the lights may switch off without warning.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the lighting management software updated.

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY There is a possibility of untimely triggering of the starter motor which if the vehicle has been left in gear could result in the vehicle jerking forward when the starter motor engages.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles and down load new software for the intelligent servo control unit.

peugeot.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
peugeot.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque

peugeot.defect: FUSE BOX MAY CAUSE EQUIPMENT OPERATIONAL FAILURES It has been identified that the main engine fuse box is not to the correct specification. This can result in operating faults or the failure of certain equipment.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuse box replaced.

peugeot.defect: WHEEL MAY CRACK Over time the rear wheel may fail as a result of the rear wheels being made with a small radius to the spoke at the rim end.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the rear wheel with a quality assured unit.

peugeot.defect: FUEL TUBES UNDER BODY MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME The fuel pipes under the body may have been damaged over time due to a relative movement between these pipes and their surroundings.
peugeot.remedy: Check the condition of the fuel pipes and replacing them if necessary.  New protection will be fitted on all vehicles to prevent this damage in the future.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED Braking assistance could be adversely by freezing of moisture that may accumulate in the vacuum circuit.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that may be affected and fit a separate air vent complete with filter to each electro valve fitted to the vacuum circuit.

peugeot.defect: THE TIGHTENING TORQUE OF THE SPARE WHEEL SUPPORT FIXINGS MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION Possible loss of the spare wheel whilst the vehicle is being driven
peugeot.remedy: Check and correcting the tightening of the support fixings.

peugeot.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL The parking brake may fail to hold the vehicle stationary when applied. If this defect occurs the driver will be alerted by a weak effort when moving the parking brake lever.
peugeot.remedy: The recalled vehicles will be fitted with a quality assured parking brake lever.

peugeot.defect: BRAKE PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED. Residual low pressure persists in the power braking vacuum circuit which may result in the loss of power assistance when braking
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a calibrated air vent in the vacuum circuit.

peugeot.defect: DOOR MAY OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY A manufacturing defect in one of the components of the door locks could cause jamming of the internal mechanism and prevent the closing of one or more of the vehicle's doors. In rare cases the door could unlock and open unexpectedly.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace door locks.

peugeot.defect: POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE MAY FAIL. It is possible that the wiring harness for the power assisted steering motor may come in contact with other components in the engine bay.  Should this occur then it is possible that the power steering assistance on this large vehicle may become affected.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit protection to the wiring harness.

peugeot.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL In the event of emergency braking or during an ESP regulation phase (e.g. avoiding manoeuvre) the hydraulic block may not prevent the locking of a wheel which could affect  control of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the braking system hydraulic block

peugeot.defect: Cooling spray nozzle potentially missing Affected vehicles may have a cylinder block with a missing cooling nozzle.  A missing nozzle means the piston may not be adequately cooled causing it to weaken deform or break and leading to sudden engine failure resulting in a loss of power and in the worst‑case scenario a thermal incident.
peugeot.remedy: Check the presence of all cooling nozzles and replace if missing.

peugeot.defect: Boxer Smart Tachograph. Affected vehicles have a smart tachograph fitted that may not comply with regulatory requirements.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the Tachograph Sensor Antenna(s) and adding Wiring Harnesses if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 308 408 3008 5008 Fuel Pipe Leakage Affected vehicles may face potential leakage of the under-bonnet fuel pipe due to a weakness of its crimping.
peugeot.remedy: Change the fuel pipe.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 308 408 3008 5008 Fuel Pipe Leakage Affected vehicles may face potential leakage of the under-bonnet fuel pipe due to a weakness of its crimping.
peugeot.remedy: Change the fuel pipe.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 308 408 3008 5008 Fuel Pipe Leakage Affected vehicles may face potential leakage of the under-bonnet fuel pipe due to a weakness of its crimping.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Automomous Telematics Box. Affected vehicles may experience an autonomous telematic box that cannot connect to the remote server making it not possible to make calls or use other connected services.
peugeot.remedy: Disconnect the 12V battery and reconnect it after 15 seconds then check for a trouble code.

peugeot.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update. Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
peugeot.remedy: Change the ATB.

peugeot.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update. Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
peugeot.remedy: Change the ATB.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 208 - Jet cooling nozzle failure On affected vehicles the engine is at risk of becoming damaged because of an inadequate oil supply from an oil jet cooling nozzle.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the engine oil and filter.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 208 instrument panel Affected vehicles may have been assembled with the wrong instrument panel cluster which may display the speed in KPH instead of MPH.
peugeot.remedy: Check the instrument cluster and replace it if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 208308 eVCU update Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
peugeot.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 3008 5008 Headrest On affected vehicles front seat headrests are not to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the fixing notches of the front seat headrests and exchange them if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 3008 5008 Headrest On affected vehicles front seat headrests are not to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the fixing notches of the front seat headrests and exchange them if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Instrument Panel Cluster software On affected vehicles a low AdBlue level message may not be displayed on the Instrument Panel Cluster.  This could lead to the possibility of not being able to start the vehicle due to an empty AdBlue tank.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Instrument Panel Cluster software.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 208 P21 Camera Video Module software On affected vehicles there may be a reduced alert time of 3 seconds instead of the regulatory requirement of 10 seconds to warn the driver that the Advanced Emergency Braking (AEB) is unavailable following an emergency braking event occurring.
peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles the camera video module software and calibration will be updated.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Traveller/Expert K0 Seat Fixation On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

peugeot.defect: Peugeot - Cross carline Radio software via OTA update On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot - Cross carline Radio software via OTA update On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 508 BCM software Stop/Start System On affected vehicles the engine will run all the time and will not shut off in start/stop mode due to incorrect Body Control Module coding.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 308 VIN label wrong rear axle data. Affected vehicles may have been built with an incorrect rear axle weight value recorded on the Manufacturer VIN Label.
peugeot.remedy: Check Manufacturer VIN Label rear axle weight and replace the label if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Traveller/Expert K0 Seat Fixation On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

peugeot.defect: Too Low Exhauxt Temperature. On affected vehicles the exhaust temperature might be too low. This may lead to unrobust environmental performance.
peugeot.remedy: Update the engine software.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 208 – Fuel Tank On affected vehicles there may be a defect present in the fuel tank threads which could potentially lead to a fuel leak.
peugeot.remedy: Check the blown-molding engraved date marking date at the bottom of the fuel tank and replace the lock nut and O-ring if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Low Pressure Fuel Pipe On affected vehicles the low-pressure fuel pipe could come in to contact with one of the ignition coil screws. This could lead to fuel pipe damage over time resulting in a fuel leak.
peugeot.remedy: Fix the low-pressure fuel pipe to the crankcase breather hose with a cable tie to ensure there is no contact between the ignition coil screw and the fuel pipe.

peugeot.defect: Traction Battery software Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

peugeot.defect: Traction Battery software Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 2008v2 Partner ESC software. Affected vehicles may have incorrect or missing tyre pressure messages displayed in the instrument cluster due to a software deviation.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Electric Stability Control calibration to ensure the correct tyre pressure warning messages are displayed

peugeot.defect: Boxer – Fuel Pipe Leak. Affected vehicles may experience a diesel fuel leak from the fuel pressure damper.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the lower section of the fuel pipe including the damper.

peugeot.defect: Traction Battery software Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

peugeot.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

peugeot.defect: Brake Pressure Modulator Valve On affected vehicles the Electronic Brake System Module is not according to specification which could potentially lead to light internal leakage of brake fluid.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the Electronic Brake System Module.

peugeot.defect: Brake Pressure Modulator Valve On affected vehicles the Electronic Brake System Module is not according to specification which could potentially lead to light internal leakage of brake fluid.
