peugeot.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box connection Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
peugeot.remedy: Change the ATB.

peugeot.defect: THE ACCESSORY ROOF RACK COULD DETACH FROM THE VEHICLE IF USED TO CARRY ITEMS OTHER THAN A ROOF BOX The accessory roof rack for the Peugeot 508 saloon could detach from the vehicle if used to carry items other than a roof box.
peugeot.remedy: A full refund will be offered by the selling retailer (return of the roof rack and receipt) and recommend the customer purchase another solution to transport bicycle(s).

peugeot.defect: VEHICLE CONTROL MAY BE LOST Front subframes on affected vehicles may show signs of damage to the left hand mounting point  caused during the manufacturing process. Over time this may affect durability and cause the mounting to fail. This can affect security of components attached to the subframe and may affect control of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Prior to failure the driver should notice excessive noise from this area. As a safety measure affected vehicles should be checked and where necessary the subframe replaced.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may have an incorrect torque on several fixation points which could result in reduced control of the vehicle and overheating of electrical connections. Affected vehicles may have an incorrect torque on several fixation points which could result in reduced control of the vehicle and overheating of electrical connections.
peugeot.remedy: Check and tighten fixings to correct torque.

peugeot.defect: Tow ball support bracket durability inadequate The tow ball bracket could not withstand mechanical constraints when subjected to the highest stress levels which can occur during the vehicle's lifetime.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer�s remedy involves the replacement of the tow ball support bracket with a redesigned version.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT VEHICLE COULD BE STARTED WITH GEAR SELECTOR IN ANY POSITION The automatic gearbox control wiring loom may become pinched. This may make it possible to start the engine whilst the car is in gear.
peugeot.remedy: Check whether the wiring loom is being pinched. Repair and reposition the loom where found necessary.

peugeot.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION CONCERN There is a possibility that the front stub axle lower ball joint fixing may have been incorrectly machined which may result in separation of the stub axle from the ball joint/lower suspension arm.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if required replace the left and right stub axles which will be carried out free of charge.

peugeot.defect: DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE  MAY ABRADE AND WEAR. It has been identified that a slight amount of play in the diesel fuel return pipe mountings on certain vehicles may over time lead to abrasion and wear of the pipe.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject clips checked and the pipe secured.

peugeot.defect: REAR AXLE FIXING BOLTS MAY BECOME LOOSE The quality of the welding at the suspension mounting reinforcement plates may not be to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the welding. Where necessary take corrective action to ensure that the reinforcement plate welding operation has been correctly completed.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY In very rare circumstances the vacuum pump one way valve may not function correctly which could affect the level of braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the brake vacuum pump one way valve.

peugeot.defect: OIL MAY LEAK In rare cases on the concerned engines a possible manufacturing nonconformity of the cylinder head may lead to an oil leak.
peugeot.remedy: Check and replace cylinder head.

peugeot.defect: COMPONENT FIXINGS COULD HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED TO INCORRECT TORQUE SETTINGS Various component fixings which have not been tightened to the correct torque settings due to incorrect tightening operations during the assembly
peugeot.remedy: Retighten the affected component fixings to assure the correct torque tightening

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On some 2.0 l HDI vehicles potential contact between the fuel return pipe and the diesel filter support may eventually cause the pipe to become worn through friction.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer has requested that some protection be added to the pipe to ensure its long-term resistance to wear.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel heating device integrated in to the diesel fuel filter cover may be defective and allow heat to build up within the electrical supply connector causing the cover to distort and air to enter the fuel circuit. This could make the vehicles difficult to start and a warning light will be illuminated on the dash board. The engine could be difficult or not possible to start. In the worst cases a diesel fuel leak could eventually appear.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel heater cover. Additionally the electrical connector will be inspected and where necessary replaced.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE DEFORMATION OF REAR SUSPENSION Possible non-conformity of the rear suspension triangles could in rare cases of stress lead to their deformation.
peugeot.remedy: Fit new right and left side lower suspension triangles.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED Braking assistance could be adversely by freezing of moisture that may accumulate in the vacuum circuit.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that may be affected and fit a separate air vent complete with filter to each electro valve fitted to the vacuum circuit.

peugeot.defect: HANDBRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED. The handbrake adjustment system may be unreliable which will reduce its efficiency under certain conditions.
peugeot.remedy: Check adjust and/or replace the brake shoe mechanisms.

peugeot.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE COMPROMISED The front suspension wishbone mounting bolts might not have been manufactured to the correct specification potentially causing a risk of these parts breaking. Broken mounting bolts can be noticed by the driver through noises and poor directional control.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front suspension wishbone mounting bolts.

peugeot.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE COMPROMISED The front suspension wishbone mounting bolts might not have been manufactured to the correct specification potentially causing a risk of these parts breaking. Broken mounting bolts can be noticed by the driver through noises and poor directional control.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front suspension wishbone mounting bolts.

peugeot.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Brake fluid may leak from the left hand master cylinder which if not rectified will result in loss of brake.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace internal components of the master cylinder.

peugeot.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR Water entering the rear doors may enter the electric window motor causing the mechanism to malfunction. In the long-term the presence of water may cause a short circuit in the motor leading to localised heating of the door panel.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit additional protection on the rear electric window motors.

peugeot.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING. It has been identified that the position of the exterior lighting control ring may not be detected by the lighting management system and the lights may switch off without warning.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the lighting management software updated.

peugeot.defect: WIPER MOTOR MAY FAIL An internal fault with the wiper motor could cause it to stop working. In some rare cases the windscreen wipers may stop working while in operation.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the manufacturing date of the wiper motor and add a supplementary earth wiring harness if necessary.

peugeot.defect: FAILURE OF THE THROTTLE STOP COULD LEAD TO A REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE The original engine software may cause erratic operation of the motorised throttle body.  This could  in rare extreme cases cause the throttle stop to break.  This will cause the engine to revert to limp home mode which possible may cause a reduction in braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Install updated software in the engine ECU.

peugeot.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL The track rod end ball joints on the steering rack may not have been torqued to the correct specification. If this is not rectified it could result in steering failure.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and re-torque the track rod end to steering arm joint.

peugeot.defect: SETTING OF BRAKE COMPENSATOR The load sensitive compensator on the braking system may be incorrectly set.
peugeot.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the compensator checked and where required adjusted in accordance with the manufacturers specification.

peugeot.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL During production it is possible the brake system may not have been bled correctly and some air may remain in the brake system. This could result in increased brake pedal travel and a possible reduction in braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to have the brake system bled.

peugeot.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.�
peugeot.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT Incorrect dimensions of the battery earth cable may in the long term lead to its breakage.  The loss of the electrical connection may lead to engine cutting out.
peugeot.remedy: The battery earth cable is to be replaced.

peugeot.defect: INCORRECT SPECIFICATION BRAKE FLUID It is possible that the brake fluid is not to the correct specification.  this over a period of time could adversely affect the brake performance.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the hydraulic fluid in the brake and clutch operating circuits.

peugeot.defect: FUEL LEAK MAY OCCUR On subject vehicles the fitting of the diesel high pressure delivery pipe may be constricted. Should this be the case a fuel leak may occur.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject pipe checked and changed if found to be fitted incorrectly.

peugeot.defect: A COMPONENT OF THE HANDBRAKE MECHANISM MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The handbrake mechanism may not be correct to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the handbrake mechanism and if necessary replace the hand brake lever.

peugeot.defect: ESP MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY Some vehicles from the affected production batch may have an issue with the effectiveness of the ESP system caused by non-conformity with the ABS/ESP hydraulic block. Consequences: This non-conformity will not affect the operation of the ABS system or the efficiency of the brakes. It may affect the operation of the ESP system on the rare occasions that it is activated; the correction of the drive delivered to the road wheel(s) when the ESP is activated may not be accurate to how it is manufactured to respond.
peugeot.remedy: The hydraulic ABS/ESP block is to be replaced.

peugeot.defect: INABILITY TO CHANGE GEAR Over time partial wear of the gearbox control harnesses may occur due to contact with surrounding components. Gear selection may be affected as a result of electrical faults in some rare cases including the lighting of the warning lamp on the instrument panel and the driveability of the vehicle may be compromised.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the condition of the gearbox control harness and where necessary fit additional protection.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It is possible that the con-rod bearing shells will not conform to manufacturer specification. This could lead to premature deterioration of the shells and in time cause the engine to fail.
peugeot.remedy: To replace the con-rod bearing shells

peugeot.defect: AFFECTED VEHICLES ARE NOT FULLY COMPLIANT TO  EUROPEAN REGULATION (165/2014+ EU799/2016) COVERING THE SMART TACHOGRAPH REQUIREMENTS Affected vehicles are not fully compliant to European regulation (165/2014 + EU 799/2016) covering the �Smart Tachograph� requirements.
peugeot.remedy: Replacing the tachograph gearbox and on certain vehicles the windscreen depending on the specification of the vehicle.

peugeot.defect: SEAT BELT BRACING ACTION MAY BE AFFECTED The seat belt locking action may not be as fast as it is designed to be.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that may be affected to check the date of manufacture of the seat belts and where necessary replace the seat belts.

peugeot.defect: THE STEERING COLUMN UNIVERSAL JOINT CLAMP MAY BE INCORRECTLY FITTED TO THE STEERING COLUMN The universal clamp fixing bolt is not correctly fitted in the recess at the end of the steering column.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary refit the steering column universal joint fixing.

peugeot.defect: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT It has been identified that due to a possible non-conformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body there is the possibility that water can enter the passenger compartment of the vehicle.  The occupants should experience either wet carpets and or a possible damp smell.  However the ingress of water into the cabin could affect the electrical operation of the airbag module which could lead to an unexpected deployment of the airbag.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to add additional sealant to the body interfaces and if required to replace any interior components damaged by the water ingress.

peugeot.defect: BRAKE PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED. Residual low pressure persists in the power braking vacuum circuit which may result in the loss of power assistance when braking
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a calibrated air vent in the vacuum circuit.

peugeot.defect: BONNET CATCH MAY NOT LATCH CORRECTLY On a small batch of vehicles the bonnet catch may not be correctly installed. If the bonnet is opened and then closed incorrectly it could result in the latch being insecure.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check the bonnet catch. Where necessary the bonnet catch will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It is possible that the con-rod bearing shells will not conform to manufacturer specification. This could lead to premature deterioration of the shells and in time cause the engine to fail.
peugeot.remedy: To replace the con-rod bearing shells

peugeot.defect: THE STEERING GEOMETRY COULD BE INCORRECTLY SET The steering geometry could be incorrectly set due to an incorrectly calibrated setting rig in the manufacturing plant.
peugeot.remedy: Check the steering alignment and adjusting if set incorrectly. If the front tyres are worn these will also be replaced.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM FUEL FILTER There is a possibility that fuel may seep from fuel filter housing due to external corrosion. A fire risk may exist.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace aluminium fuel filter with a plastic fuel filter.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS DESIGNED Incorrect manufacture of the rear bench seat bolsters could in the case of an impact hinder the deployment of the rear lateral airbags.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit modified seat bolsters.

peugeot.defect: RISK OF UNDER BONNET FIRE It is possible that a leak can occur between the injector spill rail connection and the plastic fuel return pipe. This can cause leakage of fuel which can either pool on the engine cylinder head and then become deposited onto the road surface where it could cause a skid risk to other motorist or if the fuel comes into contact with extremely hot engine components an exhaust manifold for instance it is possible that an under bonnet fire could ensue.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the sealing of the fuel return pipe connection on each injector and if necessary replace the injectors as well as the fuel return pipes.

peugeot.defect: DUE TO THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE THE NOX EMISSIONS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS The calibration of the engine management software could result in emissions of NOx which do not comply with the regulatory limits.
peugeot.remedy: Download new engine management software

peugeot.defect: FRONT WISHBONE RETAINING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The front suspension wishbone fixing bolts may have a non-conformity which could lead to a risk of them breaking. The driver would be aware of a change in the behaviour of the vehicle�s directional control.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front suspension wishbone fixing bolts

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It is possible that the con-rod bearing shells will not conform to manufacturer specification. This could lead to premature deterioration of the shells and in time cause the engine to fail.
peugeot.remedy: To replace the con-rod bearing shells

peugeot.defect: TYRE MAY DEFLATE Some tyres may have suffered superficial damage when the vehicle was being transported. The front Left hand tyre may have localised damage on the tread or the inner side. The tyre may rip and deflate.
peugeot.remedy: Carry out a visual check of the condition of the tyre in the affected areas and replace the tyre if necessary.

peugeot.defect: THE FILTERING PERFORMANCE OF THE DIESEL PARTICULATE FILTER MAY NOT MEET THE REQUIRED SPECIFICATION The filtering performance of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) may not meet the required specification.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the DPF on affected vehicles.

peugeot.defect: VSM software Interior door handles Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

peugeot.defect: VSM software Interior door handles Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

peugeot.defect: VSM software Interior door handles Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

peugeot.defect: VSM software Interior door handles Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 208 Horn sound volume Affected vehicle have a horn volume which does not comply with regulatory requirements.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the horn with one of a higher volume.

peugeot.defect: Front lower control arm fasteningg Loose On affected vehicles the front suspension lower control arm upper bolts may not have been tightened according to specification during assembly.
peugeot.remedy: Check the bolts for the correct torque and replace if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Boxer software – turn signal detection. On affected vehicles the Body Control Module is not correctly configured to detect a failure in the indicator lamps.  As a result if a turn indicator bulb fails it's not detected and the indicator warning does not activate.
peugeot.remedy: Update the vehicle configuration and the Secure Gateway Electronic Control Unit.

peugeot.defect: ELECTRICAL HARNESS COULD MOVE FROM ORIGINAL POSITION AND WEAKEN THE HARNESS The rear window electrical harness could become displaced from its original position and present a potential thermal issue.
peugeot.remedy: Check the routing of harness and replace the electrical harness if necessary. Add a fastening clip to ensure that the electrical harness will be maintained in its normal position.

peugeot.defect: THE TRAILER TOW BAR MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION Some trailer tow ball fixing bolts may be damaged
peugeot.remedy: Replace the two tow ball fixing bolts

peugeot.defect: THE OPEN CIRCUIT DETECTION SYSTEM COULD BE OVER SENSITIVE CAUSING A NUMBER OF OPERATIONAL ISSUES A possibility that the open circuit detection system could be over-sensitivite causing a number of operational issues including sudden power loss.
peugeot.remedy: Download the latest software configuration check some electronic units and replace them if necessary.

peugeot.defect: VEHICLES AFFECTED MAY HAVE A SINGLE WHEEL BOLT ON BOTH LEFT HAND SIDE WHEELS WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY A single wheel bolt on both left-hand wheels may not be tightened to the correct tightening torque.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace wheel bolts and any other associated parts if consequential damage has occurred.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible for the engine to stall due to incorrect reading of oil levels during harsh and prolonged braking.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download new software to the engine ECU.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF ROAD WHEEL It has been identified that there is a possibility that the inner edge of the alloy wheels may have been deformed when fitting the tyres. This may result in the wheel breaking.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check the wheels for damage with a special gauge and renew where necessary.

peugeot.defect: VEHICLE CONTROL MAY BE LOST Front subframes on affected vehicles may show signs of damage to the left hand mounting point  caused during the manufacturing process. Over time this may affect durability and cause the mounting to fail. This can affect security of components attached to the subframe and may affect control of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Prior to failure the driver should notice excessive noise from this area. As a safety measure affected vehicles should be checked and where necessary the subframe replaced.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INADVERTENTLY The incorrect fixing of the left hand curtain airbag can lead to incorrect deployment in the case of a left hand side impact or frontal impact with a high degree of angular bias to the left.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and re-fix the airbag correctly.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE PLUS ENGINE OPERATING PROBLEMS. In adverse wet weather conditions water may enter the engine management solenoid valve operating circuit. This could result in engine operating problems and a reduction in power assistance to the brake pedal if the water enters the brake vacuum circuit via the solenoid valves.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to examine and if necessary replace the engine management solenoid valves with ones sealed against the ingress of water.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

peugeot.defect: UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING CONDITIONS THE AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR PULLEY COULD BREAK The air conditioning compressor pulley could break and damage other components.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the air conditioning compressor pulley and if necessary the protective cover.

peugeot.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING EFFORT DUE TO AIR IN THE SERVO The bolts retaining the front shock absorber could come loose. This may adversely affect the steering control of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front shock absorber retaining bolts.

peugeot.defect: A HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY WHERE THERE IS A MISMATCH IN THE VOLTAGE OF THE INDIVIDUAL CELLS A high voltage battery where there is a mismatch in the voltage of the individual cells.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the high voltage battery.

peugeot.defect: THE REAR BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THESE HOSES AND A CLIP The rear brake hoses may have been damaged over time due to inappropriate movement between these hoses and a clip.
peugeot.remedy: Check the condition of the rear left-hand and right-hand brake hoses and replacing them if necessary.  A new retaining clip is fitted on all vehicles to prevent this relative movement.

peugeot.defect: SUSPENSION AND STEERING FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT TORQUE Due to a deviation in the production process certain suspension and steering fixings may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check fixings as indicated by the manufacturer. Replace any damaged fixings and tighten all relevant fixings to correct torque.

peugeot.defect: MALFUNCTION CAUSING INSTRUMENT PANEL FUNCTIONS TO BECOME INOPERABLE An electronic component within the Built-in Systems Interface (BSI) may not be to the correct specification. This could cause the audio-navigation system the wipers and exterior lighting to malfunction and the warning light on the instrument panel may illuminate.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the production date of the BSI unit. Where the production date of the BSI unit is in the affected range the unit will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK AND CREATE FIRE RISK It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

peugeot.defect: POTENTIAL BLOCKING OF THE UREA INJECTOR The urea injector may temporarily block
peugeot.remedy: Update the engine management software.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

peugeot.defect: HANDBRAKE CONCERN There is a risk that the secondary handbrake cable could become detached from the rear brake mechanism causing the handbrake to become ineffective.
peugeot.remedy: Check that the handbrake cable is correctly located in the rear brake mechanism.  If it is not a new cable will be fitted.

peugeot.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
peugeot.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may face the risk of perforation of the HV battery reinforcing plate/battery cover over the vehicle lifetime due to water intrusion. Affected vehicles may face the risk of perforation of the HV battery reinforcing plate/battery cover over the vehicle lifetime due to water intrusion.
peugeot.remedy: A protective wax will be applied between HV battery reinforcing plate and battery cover.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE COMPROMISED The threaded portion of the brake linkage rod in the brake control system may not be to conformity. This could result in a reduction of braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check rod and replace if found not to meet conformity.

peugeot.defect: LOSS OF POWER Due to none conformity during manufacture the resistance of the insulated base inside the motor control unit (MCU) which controls the electric motor may decrease. As a result the voltage in the circuit may become unstable causing the warning light to illuminate and the driving motor power to be restricted to the fail safe control. In the worst case scenario the vehicle may not be able to be restarted and the battery may not be able to be charged.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine MCU.

peugeot.defect: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS LOWER BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY The tightening and positioning of the seat belt lower bolts may be incorrect.
peugeot.remedy: This campaign consists of checking and if necessary correcting both the position of the bolt and the tightening torque of all of the lower fixings of the seat belts.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible that the engine may stall when lifting your foot off of the accelerator immediately after high speed usage of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download a new piece of software to the engine ECU.

peugeot.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

peugeot.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING. It has been identified that the position of the exterior lighting control ring may not be detected by the lighting management system and the lights may switch off without warning.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the lighting management software updated.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
peugeot.remedy: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
peugeot.remedy: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.

peugeot.defect: STARTER SUPPLY WIRE MAY CHAFE The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary.

peugeot.defect: WIRING HARNESS CHAFING Possibility of starter motor harness fouling on harness support bracket which may lead to damaged wiring and a potential short circuit or breakdown of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles examine harness for damage and repair where necessary. Reposition harness clear of obstructions.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 3008v2 508v2 Traction Battery Affected vehicles may have a fault in the High Voltage Battery which could potentially lead to it overheating and in the worst case a battery or vehicle fire. Customers are advised to stop any plug-in charging and eSave charging until the vehicle is reworked.
peugeot.remedy: Update the battery management software or replace the High Voltage Battery if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 3008v2 508v2 Traction Battery Affected vehicles may have a fault in the High Voltage Battery which could potentially lead to it overheating and in the worst case a battery or vehicle fire. peugeot.defect: Peugeot Expert K0 TBMU software On affected vehicles they may have been supplied with incorrect software in the Traction Battery Management Unit TBMU that can lead to a non-compliance with regulatory requirements.
peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles the TBMU software will be updated to meet regulatory requirements.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Rifter (K9) Front Brake Discs. On affected vehicles the front brake discs may not be to the required specification and may become noisy and in exceptional cases the brake disc may fail
peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles the front brake discs and pads will be replaced

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 208- Evaporation test results on EB2FA engines. Affected vehicles may exceed regulatory emission standards.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the canister purge valve (CPV) and or fuel line.

peugeot.defect: Cross carline Engine software On affected vehicles below 12500 miles under certain conditions engine emissions may lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
peugeot.remedy: Check the mileage of the vehicle and update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration on vehicles below 12500 miles.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Boxer Traffic Sign Recognition software via OTA update On affected vehicles the traffic sign recognition function does not meet regulatory requirements.  After de-activation it will remain de-activated even after vehicle restart.
peugeot.remedy: Update the radio software via over-the-Air.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 30085008 Risk of broken bolt front control arm ball joint. On affected vehicles the fixing bolts on the front left or right bracket on the lower control arm may break.  In the worst-case scenario 2 broken bolts could affect the controllability of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Change the front left and right ball joint brackets.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 30085008 Risk of broken bolt front control arm ball joint. On affected vehicles the fixing bolts on the front left or right bracket on the lower control arm may break.  In the worst-case scenario 2 broken bolts could affect the controllability of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Change the front left and right ball joint brackets.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Expert (K0) Rear Springs Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
peugeot.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Expert (K0) Display Screws missing. On affected vehicles the radio display fixing screws may be missing allowing a potential detachment of the display during a collision.
peugeot.remedy: On the affected vehicles the fixings will be checked and fitted if necessary.

peugeot.defect: MCU software On affected vehicles incorrect MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration may result in a loss of propulsion while driving.
peugeot.remedy: Update the MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 508 Selective Catalytic Reduction - diagnosis issues On affected vehicles the Engine Control Unit (ECU) software is not according to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Upload modified software to the ECU.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Boxer Wrong Proxy Configuration Affected vehicles may have an incorrect speed limitation value displayed on the instrument cluster due to a wrong configuration.
peugeot.remedy: Update the configuration in the body control module.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Traveller/Expert4- Rear Brake Discs. Affected vehicles may have been equipped with rear brake discs out of specification. These brake discs have insufficient contact with the wheel hub resulting in abnormal stress concentration.
peugeot.remedy: Check the rear brake discs and replace them and the brake pads if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Traveller/Expert4- Rear Brake Discs. Affected vehicles may have been equipped with rear brake discs out of specification. These brake discs have insufficient contact with the wheel hub resulting in abnormal stress concentration.

peugeot.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box On affected vehicles the Autonomous Telematics Box (ATB) has no connectivity to the Connected Services features and therefore does not comply with regulatory requirements.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the ATB to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

peugeot.defect: Front Camera Software On affected vehicles the Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB) function may remain deactivated in a specific use case.
peugeot.remedy: Update the Front Camera software to ensure correct activation / deactivation of the AEB system.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 308408 Door ECU software update. Affected vehicles have been equipped with a door control unit which does not have the latest software version.
peugeot.remedy: Update the door control unit software on the driver and passenger side.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel injectors supply rail could develop a leak over a period of time leading to a drop in fuel pressure which can affect the operation of the stop start system. In some extreme cases the engine might not restart and a spray of petrol under the bonnet may occur which is a fire risk.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fuel injector supply rail. Where necessary replace the fuel injector supply rail.

peugeot.defect: Alternator protection Affected vehicles may have been assembled with contact or with a reduced clearance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. There is a possibility of contact between these components leading to water infiltration and an electrical arch which could trigger a thermal event.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator.  Check the distance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator and re‑position or replace the pipe if required.

peugeot.remedy: Check the tyre class of all vehicle tyres and exchange all 4 for Class A+ tyres if necessary

peugeot.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 3008 Wheel Bolt Tightening. Affected vehicles may have improperly tightened wheel nuts following a faulty rework.
peugeot.remedy: Check the torque of the wheel nuts on all for wheels and re-tighten if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot Boxer Fuel Pipe Leak Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
peugeot.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Peugeot 208 wrong coolant liquid filled On affected vehicles the coolant used does not meet material and technical compatibility requirements.  Over time this may cause corrosion clogging deterioration of hoses and seals and coolant leakage resulting in reduced vehicle performance loss of propulsion assistance or an electrical short-circuit.
peugeot.remedy: Drain the cooling circuit and re-fill with the correct coolant liquid.

peugeot.defect: SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE CONCERN. There is a risk that the lower attachment on the front and rear left hand seat belts could be loose.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to check and if necessary tighten the seat belt fixings.

peugeot.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING. It has been identified that the position of the exterior lighting control ring may not be detected by the lighting management system and the lights may switch off without warning.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the lighting management software updated.

peugeot.defect: AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR SUPPORT MOUNTINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The tightness of one of the air conditioning compressor support mountings may not be correct to specification. This will result in an abnormal noise and possibility of the compressor becoming insecure
peugeot.remedy: On  affected vehicles check the tightness of the support; where necessary the support will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

peugeot.defect: CONCERN THAT THE LOWER AXLE SWIVEL JOINT WAS NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY There is a risk that the lower swivel joint on the front suspension has not been sufficiently tightened.
peugeot.remedy: Check the mounting and tightness of the joint if found out of specification replace the joint.

peugeot.defect: THE FIXING OF THE FRONT WING WHEEL ARCH TRIM DOES NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION The fixing of the front wing wheel arch trim does not conform to specification.
peugeot.remedy: The repair consists of adding an additional fixing screw to the bottom of the front wheel arch trim.

peugeot.defect: REAR CROSS-MEMBER MAY FAIL AND CAUSE DRIVER TO LOSE CONTROL On subject vehicles a weld on the rear cross member might be non-compliant and eventually cause the weld between the cross member and the vehicle body to break. This may lead to a partial detachment of the axle and cause the driver to lose control.
peugeot.remedy: Contact keepers using DVLA and manufacturer's records.Check the compliance of the weld on the O/S/R and if necessary replace the cross member.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The brake servo pump system could develop problems with malfunction indicator lamps and audible warnings accompanied by the vacuum pump stopping. This will require the driver to apply greater force on the brake pedal to stop the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the vacuum pump and vacuum pump relays. Additionally download with a new version of control software.

peugeot.defect: FRONT RIGHT HAND SEATBELT FIXING BOLT MAY FAIL It has been identified on a small number of vehicles that the spacer for the front right-hand seat belt fixing bolt may have been incorrectly fitted. It is therefore possible that in time this could result in the fixing for the assembly becoming insecure.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fitting of the spacer checked for compliance with the specification. If found to be necessary the trim will be repositioned and the assembly re-tightened to the correct torque.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE SEEPAGE ON THE DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE There is a risk of a manufacturing non conformity on the fuel injection diesel return pipe. This may lead to the possibility of fuel seepage.
peugeot.remedy: As a preventive measure likely to be affected vehicles will have the pipe replaced additionally the pipe will be fitted with protective sleeves.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may have a steering tie rod/track rod end nut that has not been tightened to the correct torque. Affected vehicles may have a steering tie rod/track rod end nut that has not been tightened to the correct torque.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the steering tie rod/track rod end nut and tighten to the correct torque.

peugeot.defect: INCORRECT WIRING OF LATERAL AIRBAGS AND SEAT BELT PRETENSIONERS There is a possibility that the connections for the side airbags and seat belt pre-tensioners may have been inverted on the connectors for the airbag ECU.  In the case of an impact there is a risk that the incorrect side airbag could be triggered.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and reverse the wires concerned in the Air Bag Connector

peugeot.defect: SPARE WHEEL CARRIER HEAT SHIELD COULD BECOME DETACHED The heat shield protecting the spare wheel and carrier may detach because of the vibrations it is subjected to.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to modify the heat shield or where necessary replace the spare wheel carrier which incorporates the heat shield.

peugeot.defect: CERTAIN SEALS IN THE FRONT WHEEL ARCHES MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION Certain seals in the front wheel arches may not be correct to specification and may cause water ingress into the passenger compartment
peugeot.remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required

peugeot.defect: DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE  MAY ABRADE AND WEAR. It has been identified that a slight amount of play in the diesel fuel return pipe mountings on certain vehicles may over time lead to abrasion and wear of the pipe.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject clips checked and the pipe secured.

peugeot.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS FITTED MIGHT NOT BE TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION The High Voltage Harness might not be to the correct specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the harness conformity and replace it if necessary

peugeot.defect: SEAT MAY COLLAPSE WITHOUT WARNING It has been identified that the front seats may collapse without warning. due to an electrical control box software issue.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the seat electrical control box replaced.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
peugeot.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

peugeot.defect: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS LOWER BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY The tightening and positioning of the seat belt lower bolts may be incorrect.
peugeot.remedy: This campaign consists of checking and if necessary correcting both the position of the bolt and the tightening torque of all of the lower fixings of the seat belts.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

peugeot.defect: LH SEAT MAY BECOME DETACHED IN A COLLISION The left hand rear seat may not be fully secure because the right hand seat fixing may have been welded incorrectly. If the weld is incorrect the seat may detach during an accident.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary repair the seat fixing.

peugeot.defect: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE REAR BRAKE CALIPERS A non-conformity of the rear brake callipers could reduce the efficiency of the parking brake.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the callipers

peugeot.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

peugeot.defect: SEAT BELT FIXING BOLTS MAY LOOSEN The fixing bolts of the front LH and RH seat belt return rail may loosen and in cases of extreme force break.
peugeot.remedy: The bolts on the left and right- hand sides will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
peugeot.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

peugeot.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
peugeot.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE SEEPAGE ON THE DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE There is a risk of a manufacturing non conformity on the fuel injection diesel return pipe. This may lead to the possibility of fuel seepage.
peugeot.remedy: As a preventive measure likely to be affected vehicles will have the pipe replaced additionally the pipe will be fitted with protective sleeves.

peugeot.defect: ELECTRICAL HARNESS COULD MOVE FROM ORIGINAL POSITION AND WEAKEN THE HARNESS The rear window electrical harness could become displaced from its original position and present a potential thermal issue.
peugeot.remedy: Check the routing of harness and replace the electrical harness if necessary. Add a fastening clip to ensure that the electrical harness will be maintained in its normal position.

peugeot.defect: RISK OF FIRE - HEATER BLOWER MODULE There is a possibility of defective components in the heater blower which could cause a short circuit and loss of ventilation of the passenger compartment and in an extreme condition could set fire to the wiring harness.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace heater blower module

peugeot.defect: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS AND ONE GROUND CABLE MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY The tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables may not conform to specification
peugeot.remedy: Tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables.

peugeot.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
peugeot.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

peugeot.defect: THE BRAKE PIPE FIXINGS MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION The brake pipe fixings may not conform to specification
peugeot.remedy: Checking and repairing these fixings and replacing any damaged pipes as necessary.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT BE TRIGGERED IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION On the affected vehicles an internal component within the airbag triggering ECU may have been damaged which could lead to non deployment. There are no early warning signs or symptoms for the customer to indicate if the ECU is incorrect.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer has no simple method to check the internal component.  Therefore all ECU's in affected vehicles to be changed as a precaution.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may have an incorrect torque on several fixation points which could result in reduced control of the vehicle and overheating of electrical connections. Affected vehicles may have an incorrect torque on several fixation points which could result in reduced control of the vehicle and overheating of electrical connections.
peugeot.remedy: Check and tighten fixings to correct torque.

peugeot.defect: LIGHTING HARNESS COULD OVERHEAT RESULTING IN LOSS OF SOME VEHICLE FUNCTIONS It has been identified that use of a non standard interior lighting harness may cause excessive current flow and possible overheating and damage to a control unit This can result in the loss of a number of vehicle functions.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject wiring harness modified.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF CUTS IN TYRES. Due to an incident during the vehicle manufacturing process there may be cuts in the side wall or tread of one or both of the tyres on the right hand side of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Examine the tyres fitted to the vehicle and replace any that are found to be cut.

peugeot.defect: REAR SUSPENSION FIXING BOLTS Incorrect specification rear suspension arm pivot fixing bolts could fail under arduous operating conditions possibly resulting in the rear wheel locking.
peugeot.remedy: Recall potentially affected vehicles examine the pivot fixing bolts and renew with ones of correct specification where necessary.

peugeot.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL In the event of emergency braking or during an ESP regulation phase (e.g. avoiding manoeuvre) the hydraulic block may not prevent the locking of a wheel which could affect  control of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the braking system hydraulic block

peugeot.defect: REAR DOOR WINDOW MECHANISM MAY OVERHEAT It is possible that water entering the rear door could penetrate the electric window motor. This could cause failure of the motor a short circuit overheating and possibly a fire.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and fit a protective shield.

peugeot.defect: HANDBRAKE ASSEMBLY MAY BECOME INSECURE It has been identified that the welding operation on the sleeve end panel of the handbrake system may not have been correctly carried out.  This could result in greatly reduced handbrake efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject assembly strengthened.

peugeot.defect: THE STEERING RACK ASSEMBLY MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The steering rack assembly may not be correct to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the steering rack assembly and the fixings.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may face the risk of perforation of the HV battery reinforcing plate/battery cover over the vehicle lifetime due to water intrusion. Affected vehicles may face the risk of perforation of the HV battery reinforcing plate/battery cover over the vehicle lifetime due to water intrusion.
peugeot.remedy: A protective wax will be applied between HV battery reinforcing plate and battery cover.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel heating device integrated in to the diesel fuel filter cover may be defective and allow heat to build up within the electrical supply connector causing the cover to distort and air to enter the fuel circuit. This could make the vehicles difficult to start and a warning light will be illuminated on the dash board. The engine could be difficult or not possible to start. In the worst cases a diesel fuel leak could eventually appear.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel heater cover. Additionally the electrical connector will be inspected and where necessary replaced.

peugeot.defect: THE PASSENGER OUTER SEAT BELTS MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The passenger outer seat belts may not be correct to specification
peugeot.remedy: Replace the front outer passenger seat belt.

peugeot.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

peugeot.defect: THE FILTERING PERFORMANCE OF THE DIESEL PARTICULATE FILTER MAY NOT MEET THE REQUIRED SPECIFICATION The filtering performance of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) may not meet the required specification.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the DPF on affected vehicles.

peugeot.defect: ELECTRICAL SIGNAL COULD NEUTRALISE THE SLIDING DOOR SAFETY LOCK There is a possibility that the electric sliding doors may open whilst the vehicle is in motion.
peugeot.remedy: Fit a replacement electronic control unit to the door.

peugeot.defect: THE STEERING RACK ASSEMBLY MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The steering rack assembly may not be correct to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the steering rack assembly and the fixings.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

peugeot.defect: STARTER RELAY MAY OVERHEAT Possible non-compliance of an internal component of the starter control relay could cause damage by overheating. This could cause unintended operation of the starter motor and in extreme instances; there is a risk of fire.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check and if necessary replace the  relay

peugeot.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK The rear brake hoses may contact the suspension coil springs. Should this contact occur it is possible over time and distance for the spring to abrade a hole in the hose and for the hose to leak fluid which will illuminate the brake warning lamp and could possibly lead to longer than expected stopping distances.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the positioning of the rear brake hoses and where necessary replace the brake hose/s.

peugeot.defect: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT It has been identified that due to a possible non-conformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body there is the possibility that water can enter the passenger compartment of the vehicle.  The occupants should experience either wet carpets and or a possible damp smell.  However the ingress of water into the cabin could affect the electrical operation of the airbag module which could lead to an unexpected deployment of the airbag.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to add additional sealant to the body interfaces and if required to replace any interior components damaged by the water ingress.

peugeot.defect: SEAT BELT FIXING MAY LOOSEN On the vehicles concerned the lower fixing for the left hand front seat belt may be of an incorrect specification. This may lead to the fixing becoming loose.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fixing checked and corrected as necessary.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

peugeot.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

peugeot.defect: FUEL TANK MOUNTINGS The fuel tank could be insecure due to the cross member carrying the fuel tank rear fixings not being to the correct specification.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to carry out a modification to the fuel tank rear mountings.

peugeot.defect: THE LOWER METAL ENGINE PROTECTION GUARD AND THEUNDERSIDE OF THE ENGINE EXHAUST SYSTEM  COULD TRAP MATERIAL IN IT. The possibility that the lower metal engine protection guard could trap material between it and the underside of the engine exhaust system
peugeot.remedy: : Replace the metal under engine protection guard with a different design to prevent the collection of material.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL The fixing bolts of the front suspension wishbones may not be to the correct specification. This could lead to the bolts failing and the security of the wishbones being compromised. If this occurs there is a possibility that the directional control of the vehicle could be adversely affected.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected and replace all the fixing bolts of the front suspension wishbones.

peugeot.defect: WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY FAIL The windscreen wiper wiring may be contacted by the wiper mechanism. If there is prolonged contact between the wiring and mechanism there is a risk of the wiper function failing.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary reposition the wiring.

peugeot.defect: THROTTLE MAY NOT CLOSE It has been identified that during times of freezing weather conditions the throttle may stick in the open position.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a collar at the top of the throttle cable thus preventing water ingress.

peugeot.defect: SECURITY OF PASSENGER SEATS Some passenger seat pedestals may have been incorrectly attached to the vehicle floor. This could result in the seats detaching from the floor in an accident situation.
peugeot.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have modifications to the seat pedestals carried out. The modified pedestals will be secured by bolts through the steel section of the floor.

peugeot.defect: THE FIXING BOLT OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The fixing bolt of the front Suspension wishbone may not be correct to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the fixing bolts and nuts of the front suspension wishbones.

peugeot.defect: THE FRONT SUSPENSION MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION Possible slackening of the front wishbone ball joint.
peugeot.remedy: Increasing the tightening torque of the ball joint and adding thread lock if the ball joint threads are found to be rusty or loose the ball joint will be replaced

peugeot.defect: CERTAIN SEALS IN THE FRONT WHEEL ARCHES MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION Certain seals in the front wheel arches may not be correct to specification and may cause water ingress into the passenger compartment
peugeot.remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required

peugeot.defect: TYRE MAY DEFLATE Some tyres may have suffered superficial damage when the vehicle was being transported. The front Left hand tyre may have localised damage on the tread or the inner side. The tyre may rip and deflate.
peugeot.remedy: Carry out a visual check of the condition of the tyre in the affected areas and replace the tyre if necessary.

peugeot.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.�
peugeot.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

peugeot.defect: BRAKE SERVO VACUUM PIPE Brake servo vacuum pipe may become damaged due to chafing on engine wiring harness. This could result in a loss of braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles replace and reposition the servo vacuum pipe to avoid further chafing.

peugeot.defect: SUSPENSION MAY FAIL The left hand side front chassis may have a nonconformity which may lead to a risk of poor securing of the suspension arm.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the left hand side front chassis member.

peugeot.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION MAY COLLAPSE There is a possibility that the front stub axle on one or both sides of the vehicle may have been incorrectly machined. This could result in excessive wear the lower ball joint becoming displaced and the collapse of the suspension.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and if necessary replace both front stub axles.

peugeot.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY. Over a period of time it is possible for the front brake hoses to deteriorate through contact with other components. If left for some time it is possible that the brake hoses will leak fluid and there to be a loss of braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace both the front brake flexi hoses.

peugeot.defect: REDUCED BRAKING EFFICIENCY Some vehicles may have been fitted incorrect specification flexible brake hoses which if not checked and replaced could lead to a brake failure.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection of the flexible brake hoses and replacement if found to be out of specification.

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

peugeot.defect: STEERING BOLTS MAY BE TIGHTENED INCORRECTLY Incorrect assembly of the steering rack which could cause the loss of the mechanical link between the steering pinion valve and the steering rack during parking manoeuvres at full lock.
peugeot.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the steering rack.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel tank shield may foul the fuel supply pipes. Over a period of time this may cause a fuel leak.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check condition of fuel pipes and replace where necessary. In addition add extra protection to existing and replacement pipes.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

peugeot.defect: FAILURE OF CAMSHAFT DRIVE BELT The camshaft drive belt may fail before the recommended replacement interval of 72000 miles. This could result in a complete loss of engine power without warning.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement camshaft drive belt.

peugeot.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
peugeot.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque

peugeot.defect: WATER MAY ENTER COOLING FAN  - RISK OF FIRE. There is a possibility that water may collect within the casing of the cooling fan and in a limited number of cases an under-bonnet fire.
peugeot.remedy: Fit a modified cooling fan assembly.

peugeot.defect: STEERING  POWER ASSISTANCE MAY BE REDUCED It has been identified that an incorrect version of the steering power assistance software has been uploaded.The effect of which may lead to stiffness within the steering system
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a steering power assistance ECU upgrade.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE. It has been identified that the heat shield which protects the exhaust system may contact one of the rear brake hoses. In extreme situations this may cause leakage within a brake circuit which would be represented by extended brake pedal travel.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for heat shield to brake hose contact and if necessary the shield will be adjusted. The brake hose will be replaced if rubbing contact has been made.

peugeot.defect: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

peugeot.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that water may ingress the brake drums causing premature brake lining wear. Should this occur the brake effort produced by the rear wheels may be reduced.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a seal fitted to the handbrake cable  and the subject brake linings replaced.

peugeot.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE BRACKET The welding attaching the front suspension lower wishbone bracket to the subframe may be suspect. In extreme conditions this could affect the driving quality of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the integrity of the subject welding. Where this is not to specification the subframe attachment will be reinforced by bolting or in extreme cases the subframe will be changed.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel tank shield may foul the fuel supply pipes. Over a period of time this may cause a fuel leak.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check condition of fuel pipes and replace where necessary. In addition add extra protection to existing and replacement pipes.

peugeot.defect: DOOR MAY OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY A manufacturing defect in one of the components of the door locks could cause jamming of the internal mechanism and prevent the closing of one or more of the vehicle's doors. In rare cases the door could unlock and open unexpectedly.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace door locks.

peugeot.defect: WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY FAIL It has been identified that on subject vehicles the windscreen wiper mechanism has not been manufactured to specification. As a result in time the windscreen wipers could fail.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the windscreen wiper mechanism replaced.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID There is a risk of internal cracking of the 4-way brake pipe unions (non- ABS models) or the 2 x 4-way brake pipe unions (ABS models). This could result in a gradual loss of brake fluid and reduced braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the four way brake pipe unions.

peugeot.defect: TIGHTENING OF REAR SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The tightening of some rear suspension fixings may not be correct to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Correcting some tightening torques and replacing some nuts and bolts.

peugeot.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY On the affected vehicles the fixing of the handbrake cable support stop may not be to specification which could cause long term loss of handbrake efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: The strengthening of the fixing of the handbrake cable support stop on the chassis. This operation will avoid any long term loss of handbrake efficiency.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
peugeot.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

peugeot.defect: BATTERY MAY DISCHARGE AND/OR HEATED SEATS MAY OVERHEAT On the affected vehicles the electrical harnesses connecting the heated seats may under certain conditions and over time cause the heated seats to either not work or to operate permanently. This may cause the battery to discharge and can be uncomfortable/distracting to the driver.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the two affected harnesses. If necessary the harnesses will be modified.

peugeot.defect: WHEEL FIXING BOLTS MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED One or more of the wheel fixing bolts may be insufficiently tightened.
peugeot.remedy: Examine wheels and fixing bolts tighten or replace where necessary.

peugeot.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION MAY COLLAPSE There is a possibility that the front stub axle on one or both sides of the vehicle may have been incorrectly machined. This could result in excessive wear the lower ball joint becoming displaced and the collapse of the suspension.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and if necessary replace both front stub axles.

peugeot.defect: THE INNER TIE RODS ARE NOT CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The inner tie rods connecting the steering rack to the track rod end are not correct to specification
peugeot.remedy: Replace the steering rack inner tie rods (on both sides)

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

peugeot.defect: THE UREA INJECTOR MAY BLOCK AND LEAD TO NOx EMISSIONS GOING OUT OF REGULATORY LIMITS The vehicles may be affected by a defect in the urea injector which might block and lead to NOx emissions going out of the regulatory limits.
peugeot.remedy: Updating the ECU software to avoid the gradual blocking of the urea injector

peugeot.defect: On affected vehicles the A Pillar trim may be incorrectly assembled which could lead to detachment of the trim through lateral airbag deployment. On affected vehicles the A Pillar trim may be incorrectly assembled which could lead to detachment of the trim through lateral airbag deployment.
peugeot.remedy: Remove A Pillar trim check clip assembly and refit correctly if necessary.

peugeot.defect: FUEL FEED PIPE SEEPAGE Due to possible defective sealing there is a risk of seepage from the fuel feed pipe where it connects to the injector rail on some 405 models.
peugeot.remedy: All vehicles potentially affected by this campaign are being recalled to Peugeot dealers for the fitment of a modified clip to the fuel feed pipe.

peugeot.defect: SEAT BELT BRACING ACTION MAY BE AFFECTED The seat belt locking action may not be as fast as it is designed to be.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that may be affected to check the date of manufacture of the seat belts and where necessary replace the seat belts.

peugeot.defect: Engine could overheat leading to failure Engine could overheat leading to failure in extreme cases
peugeot.remedy: Download new engine management software

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On certain vehicles the front brake discs may not be the required thickness for the vehicle definition. This concern may result in reduced braking efficiency.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the front brake discs.

peugeot.defect: FRONT AIR BAG(S) MAY NOT DEPLOY. The driver and where fitted passenger air bags may not deploy correctly in an accident due to a fault in the electronic control unit (ECU).
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles conduct a diagnostic check on the ECU and rectify or replace as appropriate.

peugeot.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION SPRING MAY BREAK In countries where salt is used extensively on the roads the paint sub layer on certain springs produced over a specific manufacturing period shows very little resistance to corrosion. This can in exceptional circumstances cause a front suspension spring to break with the attendant risk that the spring could contact the tyre.
peugeot.remedy: To prevent an occurrence of this type likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time a suspension cup will be fitted on each front side of the vehicle to prevent a failed spring from making contact with the tyre.

peugeot.defect: OIL LEAK MAY DAMAGE ENGINE An oil leak could develop at the turbocharger lubrication union retaining bolt due to a non-conformity of this part.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger lubrication union bolt and its seals.

peugeot.defect: STEERING MAY BECOME STIFF It has been identified that a problem may arise with the steering mechanism which can result in hardness whilst manoeuvring.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering mechanism checked and lubricated. The mechanism will be replaced if found to be damaged. At the same time certain vehicles will have key components reinforced against the ingress of water. Thus preventing operating faults in the long term.

peugeot.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS FITTED MIGHT NOT BE TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION The High Voltage Harness might not be to the correct specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the harness conformity and replace it if necessary

peugeot.defect: HEADRESTS ON THE FRONT MODULAR SEAT DO NOT CONFORM TO THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION Affected vehicles may have been equipped with headrests on the front modular seat which do not conform to the design specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the conformity of the front headrests (presence of the catch); in cases of non-conformity the front headrests will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF WIRING HARNESS It is possible for the ignition switch harness to foul on the steering column coupling. This could lead to short circuiting and electrical malfunction.
peugeot.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for the harness to be repositioned.

peugeot.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the shield which protects the diesel fuel filter in the event of an impact may be incorrectly positioned. This can result in the possibility that the impact shield is in too close a proximity to the positive terminal of the alternator.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the position of the impact shield checked. Additionally the component will be fitted with an insulator.

peugeot.defect: On affected vehicles due to a potential lack of electric parking brake application when the driver presses the throttle pedal to start driving from a parking position on a slope the vehicle could move in the opposite direction until the driver pushes the brakes and stops the vehicle. On affected vehicles due to a potential lack of electric parking brake application when the driver presses the throttle pedal to start driving from a parking position on a slope the vehicle could move in the opposite direction until the driver pushes the brakes and stops the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Update the MCU (Motor Control Unit) with modified software.

peugeot.defect: WHEEL STUDS MAY BECOME LOOSE A possible substandard tapping of one or more of the wheel stud holes may result in a reduction of the wheel stud to hub torque setting.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace hubs.
