peugeot.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
peugeot.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

peugeot.defect: A PLASTIC COMPONENT INSIDE THE EXHAUST LINE COULD UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS DAMAGE THE DIESEL PARTICLE FILTER A plastic component inside the exhaust line could under certain conditions damage the Diesel particle filter.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the particle filter.

peugeot.defect: POTENTIAL COLLAPSE OF FRONT SUSPENSION It has been identified that there is a possibility that the front suspension lower ball joint pinch bolt has been incorrectly tightened leading to potential collapse of the front suspension.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all potentially affected vehicles to check and if required tighten the pinch bolt.

peugeot.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE ON SEVERAL REAR AXLE COMPONENT FIXINGS Vehicles may have an incorrect tightening torque on several rear axle component fixings.
peugeot.remedy: Check and retighten all fixings to the correct torque settings.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE NON CONFORMITY OF SEALS IN FRONT WHEEL ARCHES COULD LEAD TO WATER INGRESS INTO CERTAIN ELECTRONIC UNITS Possible non-conformity of certain seals in the front wheel arches could lead to water ingress into the passenger compartment.
peugeot.remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required.

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminaL. Correct it if necessary and add additional protection.

peugeot.defect: A NON-CONFORMITY IN AN INTERNAL COMPONENT COULD AFFECT DEPLOYMENT OF THE PASSENGER AIRBAG An internal component of the passenger's airbag triggering module may not conform to specification. This could affect the triggering of the device in the event of an impact.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger's air bag assembly

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On some 2.0 l HDI vehicles potential contact between the fuel return pipe and the diesel filter support may eventually cause the pipe to become worn through friction.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer has requested that some protection be added to the pipe to ensure its long-term resistance to wear.

peugeot.defect: BREAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED An internal component of the Brake Master Cylinder may not be in conformity and as such braking performance/efficiency may be affected.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace Master Cylinder.

peugeot.defect: VEHICLE HANDLING COULD BE AFFECTED It has been identified that on subject vehicles certain front suspension components have not been correctly tightened. In time this can result in noise additionally affect vehicle handling.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject components tightened.

peugeot.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY Incorrect specification passenger airbag internal module.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles replace airbag.

peugeot.defect: VEHICLES AFFECTED MAY HAVE A SINGLE WHEEL BOLT ON BOTH LEFT HAND SIDE WHEELS WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY A single wheel bolt on both left-hand wheels may not be tightened to the correct tightening torque.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace wheel bolts and any other associated parts if consequential damage has occurred.

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAG MAY INCORRECTLY DEPLOY On affected vehicles the driver's air bag inflation device may not conform to specification. As a result may not deploy correctly during an impact.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the driver's air bag module on affected vehicles

peugeot.defect: REAR SCREEN COULD DETACH On the affected vehicles the rear screen seal may not conform which could lead to water ingress in the boot and poor ageing of the seal. In very rare cases the rear screen could detach.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to remove and refit the rear screen.

peugeot.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
peugeot.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

peugeot.defect: REAR BENCH SEAT MAY NOT LOCK IN PLACE Rear bench seat in third row may not lock in place and tip forward during harsh deceleration
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and modify routing of check strap.

peugeot.defect: A PLASTIC COMPONENT INSIDE THE EXHAUST LINE COULD UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS DAMAGE THE DIESEL PARTICLE FILTER A plastic component inside the exhaust line could under certain conditions damage the Diesel particle filter.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the particle filter.

peugeot.defect: A PLASTIC COMPONENT INSIDE THE EXHAUST LINE COULD UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS DAMAGE THE DIESEL PARTICLE FILTER A plastic component inside the exhaust line could under certain conditions damage the Diesel particle filter.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the particle filter.

peugeot.defect: CORROSION OF ELECTRICAL CONNECTION WHICH COULD CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT It is necessary to check and reinforce the sealing of the electrical connections for the ABS system. As under certain conditions the repeated entry of salt water into this connection could cause short circuits which may lead to a fire within the engine compartment
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have numerous checks carried out and repairs completed dependent upon what is found.

peugeot.defect: BRAKE PEDAL ASSEMBLY MAY DISENGAGE There is a possibility that the nuts securing the support for the brake pedal assembly may be loose or missing with a risk of disengagement of the support and loss of braking control during hard braking.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and if required replace or tighten the nuts on the pedal return support.

peugeot.defect: AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR SUPPORT MOUNTINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The tightness of one of the air conditioning compressor support mountings may not be correct to specification. This will result in an abnormal noise and possibility of the compressor becoming insecure
peugeot.remedy: On  affected vehicles check the tightness of the support; where necessary the support will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: POTENTIAL FOR REDUCED STEERING CONTROL The steering column link bolt which retains the steering wheel to the steering column may not have been tighten to the correct specification. This can result in a gradual increase in movement between the steering wheel and shaft with an associated rattle. This should identify the issue to the driver however if the driver does not heed this warning then the steering control of the vehicle could be reduced.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required re-torque the steering column link bolt.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The battery earth return cable maybe too short which during vehicle operation may cause it to fail at its gearbox mounting point.  This could result in the engine cutting out.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and replace the battery earth return cable.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

peugeot.defect: WINDSCREEN TRIM MAY DETACH The security of the windscreen trim may deteriorate over a period of time. This could ultimately result in detachment of the trim.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check security of trim and if required replace trim.

peugeot.defect: LOSS OF ELECTRICAL FUNCTIONS The main underbonnet harness may become damaged through chafing on the scuttle panel. This could result in stalling and loss of electrical functions.
peugeot.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a protective sleeve to the main wiring harness to prevent chaffing.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The battery earth return cable is not to the correct specification which during vehicle operation may cause it to fail.  This could result in the engine cutting out.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the battery earth return cable.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT BE TRIGGERED IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION On the affected vehicles an internal component within the airbag triggering ECU may have been damaged which could lead to non deployment. There are no early warning signs or symptoms for the customer to indicate if the ECU is incorrect.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer has no simple method to check the internal component.  Therefore all ECU's in affected vehicles to be changed as a precaution.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The engine electronic cooling management control strategy and the maximum temperature alert threshold could cause the engine to overheat. This could result in a warning light and a message being displayed on the instrument panel.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

peugeot.defect: THE REAR SPRING CENTRALISER MIGHT BE WELDED INCORRECTLY The rear spring centraliser might be welded incorrectly.
peugeot.remedy: Add 3 weld spots to the rear spring centralisers

peugeot.defect: LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL On affected vehicles the upper section of the front right shock absorber may not be correctly tightened. This could eventually cause noise or banging and if left may affect the efficiency of the shock absorber.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the front right shock absorber.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The brake servo pump system could develop problems with malfunction indicator lamps and audible warnings accompanied by the vacuum pump stopping. This will require the driver to apply greater force on the brake pedal to stop the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download the vacuum pump with a new version of the control software.

peugeot.defect: LIGHTS MAY SWITCH OFF UNEXPECTEDLY In rare cases the lighting management system may incorrectly detect the lighting switch ring position which may cause the lights to cut out.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and download new version of vehicle exterior lighting software

peugeot.defect: INDICATOR SIDE REPEATERS MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY It has been identified that; with the engine switched off the side indicator repeaters do not operate when the parking lights are on.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the relevant operating software upgraded.

peugeot.defect: THE FRONT SUSPENSION MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION Possible slackening of the front wishbone ball joint.
peugeot.remedy: Increasing the tightening torque of the ball joint and adding thread lock if the ball joint threads are found to be rusty or loose the ball joint will be replaced

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There may be a fault in the machining of the crankshaft that could lead to a lubrication problem which overtime could lead to the engine seizing.
peugeot.remedy: The recalled vehicles will have the engine replaced.

peugeot.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY NOT RETURN WHEN RELEASED The throttle pedal may not return to its initial position as a result of a nonconformity to specification.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the pedal mechanism.

peugeot.defect: THE OPEN CIRCUIT DETECTION SYSTEM COULD BE OVER SENSITIVE CAUSING A NUMBER OF OPERATIONAL ISSUES A possibility that the open circuit detection system could be over-sensitivite causing a number of operational issues including sudden power loss.
peugeot.remedy: Download the latest software configuration check some electronic units and replace them if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may have been supplied with a Mode 2 (orange) charging cable that was not according to specification (a risk of a wrong safety calibration feature of the temperature sensor of the charging cable pins). In worst-case this could lead to a thermal incident during charging. Affected vehicles may have been supplied with a Mode 2 (orange) charging cable that was not according to specification (a risk of a wrong safety calibration feature of the temperature sensor of the charging cable pins). In worst-case this could lead to a thermal incident during charging.
peugeot.remedy: Check Mode 2 (orange) charge cable production date and replace if necessary.

peugeot.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL The front shock absorber rod may have an internal fault which could cause it to brake. This could have an adverse affect on the front suspension and the driver's ability to control the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles replace both front shock absorbers.

peugeot.defect: IGNITION KEY MAY FOUL STEERING COLUMN COWLING There is a possibility that the steering column cowling may move out of alignment causing the ignition switch to foul on the steering cowling and possibly stick in the start position.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and where necessary replace the steering column clamp.  The cowling unit is replaced on all vehicles recalled.

peugeot.defect: THE STITCHING PATTERN USED ON THE REAR SEAT BELT MATERIAL IS NOT TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION On affected vehicles some rear seat belts may have incorrect stitching on the belt material to connect the buckle to the anchor plate.
peugeot.remedy: Check seat belts and relace if necessary.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE NON CONFORMITY OF SEALS IN FRONT WHEEL ARCHES COULD LEAD TO WATER INGRESS INTO CERTAIN ELECTRONIC UNITS Possible non-conformity of certain seals in the front wheel arches could lead to water ingress into the passenger compartment.
peugeot.remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required.

peugeot.defect: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT On the affected vehicles a possible nonconformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body could lead to water ingress in the passenger compartment. This may affect the operation of the passenger air bag. Unintended deployment is possible.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles add extra sealant and replace wet or water damaged components.

peugeot.defect: THE UREA INJECTOR MAY BLOCK AND LEAD TO NOx EMISSIONS GOING OUT OF REGULATORY LIMITS The vehicles may be affected by a defect in the urea injector which might block and lead to NOx emissions going out of the regulatory limits.
peugeot.remedy: Updating the ECU software to avoid the gradual blocking of the urea injector

peugeot.defect: COOLING SYSTEM STRATEGY COULD OVERHEAT THE ENGINE. The cooling system strategy and the maximum temperature alert could cause the engine to overheat this may cause an oil leak from the sump drain cap.  Due to the incorrect operation of the warning system there is no driver alert.
peugeot.remedy: The remedy involves downloading new engine management software.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The engine electronic cooling management control strategy and the maximum temperature alert threshold could cause the engine to overheat. This could result in a warning light and a message being displayed on the instrument panel.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

peugeot.defect: INADVERTENT RELEASE OF THE HANDBRAKE Due to manufacturing defect the handbrake can be inadvertently released from its applied position.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original handbrake assembly with a quality assured unit.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On some 2.0 l HDI vehicles potential contact between the fuel return pipe and the diesel filter support may eventually cause the pipe to become worn through friction.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer has requested that some protection be added to the pipe to ensure its long-term resistance to wear.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE SEEPAGE OF FUEL Fuel may seep from the fuel filter pipe unions.
peugeot.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the filter pipe unions examined and secured where required.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
peugeot.remedy: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.

peugeot.defect: BRAKE PEDAL RELAY LEVER Brake pedal relay lever may fracture and adversely affect the operation of the braking system.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement relay lever.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAG MAY OPERATE INCORRECTLY The passenger airbag wiring harness connector may not be to specification which can cause the illumination of the warning light on the dash or if involved in a impact the incorrect deployment of the airbag.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the passenger airbag wiring harness.

peugeot.defect: FRAME MAY CRACK Cracks may appear on the side tubes between the engine mounting point and the lower cradle which could cause the frame to fail.
peugeot.remedy: On affected machines inspect the frame for signs of damage. Fit t reinforcement plates and where cracks are found replace the frame.  For other damage in the designated area the manufacturer should be contacted for further advice.

peugeot.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.�
peugeot.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

peugeot.defect: AIRBAG ECU IS NOT TO SPECIFICATION The airbag Electronic Control Unit (ECU) is incorrect to specification this reduces the number of impact configurations taken into consideration when activating the airbags. So an airbag may not deploy in as many advantageous situations.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag ECU.

peugeot.defect: GLASS PANEL MAY DETACH WITHOUT WARNING The bonding of the tailgate components may not be to specification this could affect the retention of bonded parts over time. The owner could notice the individual components becoming loose or detached from the tailgate such as brackets bonded trim panels etc� If left unnoticed bonded items could become detached from the tailgate.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the complete tailgate assembly.

peugeot.defect: DUE TO THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE THE NOX EMISSIONS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS The calibration of the engine management software could result in emissions of NOx which do not comply with the regulatory limits.
peugeot.remedy: Download new engine management software

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL An internal component of the injector may not be to specification which could reduce the fuel pressure in the injection system. The concern can prevent the engine starting and/or cause the engine to stall.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the identification number of the engine injectors. Where necessary replace the injectors.

peugeot.defect: STEERING MAY DETACH It is possible the mountings for the steering mechanism to engine subframe may not have been torqued to the correct specification. If this is the case the issue will be highlighted to the driver by noise or play in the steering. If the driver fails to take action to rectify the issue the steering may detach causing a possible loss of control.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check the torque of the mountings and if necessay replace the steering mechanism.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On some 2.0 l HDI vehicles potential contact between the fuel return pipe and the diesel filter support may eventually cause the pipe to become worn through friction.
peugeot.remedy: The manufacturer has requested that some protection be added to the pipe to ensure its long-term resistance to wear.

peugeot.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
peugeot.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

peugeot.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL It is necessary to check the fitting of the pedal box transfer bar levers on (RHD only). In rare cases where the return bar lever is faulty the braking efficiency could be affected.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the transfer bar checked and replaced if found to be faulty.

peugeot.defect: WATER INGRESS MAY CAUSE WINDSCREEN WIPER MOTOR TO FAIL On the affected vehicles the windscreen wiper motor breather system may not be To the correct specification. This could in some cases result in water ingress leading to jamming of the motor due to corrosion. This could cause the wipers to cease operation or not start which in turn could result in restricted visibility for the driver.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the windscren wiper motor and one of the windscreen wiper mechanism rods.

peugeot.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
peugeot.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque

peugeot.defect: EXCESSIVE OSCILLATION OF THE THROTTLE VALVE The original software may generate excessive oscillation of the motorised throttle valve which in extremely rare cases causes the failure of its throttle stop. This results in the engine operating in safety mode with a possible reduction in braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the ECU and either perform a download or replace the ECU.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel heating device integrated in to the diesel fuel filter cover may be defective and allow heat to build up within the electrical supply connector causing the cover to distort and air to enter the fuel circuit. This could make the vehicles difficult to start and a warning light will be illuminated on the dash board. The engine could be difficult or not possible to start. In the worst cases a diesel fuel leak could eventually appear.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel heater cover. Additionally the electrical connector will be inspected and where necessary replaced.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

peugeot.defect: The fuel line could make contact with the body and lead to fuel leakage Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.�
peugeot.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.�

peugeot.defect: HEADRESTS ON THE FRONT MODULAR SEAT DO NOT CONFORM TO THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION Affected vehicles may have been equipped with headrests on the front modular seat which do not conform to the design specification.
peugeot.remedy: Check the conformity of the front headrests (presence of the catch); in cases of non-conformity the front headrests will be replaced.

peugeot.defect: THE REAR BRAKE HOSE MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE HOSE AND HOLDING CLIP There is a possibility that the rear brake hose may become damaged due to relative movement between the hose and the holding clip.
peugeot.remedy: Check the condition of the left and right rear brake hoses and replace them if necessary.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with tyres containing rubber of non-conformity that could affect handling and also impact regulatory requirements. Affected vehicles may have been fitted with tyres containing rubber of non-conformity that could affect handling and also impact regulatory requirements.
peugeot.remedy: Check and replace tyres if necessary.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

peugeot.defect: FUSE BOX MAY CAUSE EQUIPMENT OPERATIONAL FAILURES It has been identified that the main engine fuse box is not to the correct specification. This can result in operating faults or the failure of certain equipment.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuse box replaced.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE FLUID SEEPAGE FROM REAR BRAKE CIRCUIT There is a possibility of seepage from the rear brake pipe unions above the spare wheel. This will lead to the need for periodic topping up or illumination of the brake fluid low level warning lamp and in extreme circumstances the effectiveness of the foot brake could be impaired.
peugeot.remedy: Recall potentially affected vehicles to check and if required replace the brake pipes.

peugeot.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
peugeot.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

peugeot.defect: DRIVESHAFT MAY DETACH FROM GEARBOX An incorrect left hand drive shaft may have been fitted. The shaft could separate from the gearbox on a sharp bend or during excessive suspension deflection.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a correct specification left hand drive shaft where necessary.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY BE REDUCED One of the vacuum hose unions in the braking system may not be to specification. This could cause a reduction in braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the hose.

peugeot.defect: UNINTENTIONAL DEPLOYMENT OF SIDE AIR BAGS Possibility of unintentional deployment of either side air bags
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace both side air bag control units.

peugeot.defect: FAILURE OF BRAKE SERVO As a result of incorrect material specification the brake servo diaphragm may fail. This would result in extra pedal effort and an increase in stopping distance.
peugeot.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the brake servo replaced with a quality assured unit.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT EGR SUPPORT BRACKET MAY BREAK There is a possibility that the EGR support bracket may break and cause a short circuit which may stop the engine.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace EGR bracket.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance). The timing belt will be checked and if needed replaced with other components of the braking assistance system and the vacuum pump.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible that the engine may stall when lifting your foot off of the accelerator immediately after high speed usage of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download a new piece of software to the engine ECU.

peugeot.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED It is possible that the front subframe and suspension wishbones mounting bolts may not have been torqued to the correct specification.  This could result in the mounting bolt working loose and falling from the vehicle plus the possibility of the insecurity of the subframe or the front suspension wishbone. This can cause an issue with the handling or even loss of control of the vehicle.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and retorque the front subframe and suspension wishbone mounting bolts.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There may be a fault in the machining of the crankshaft that could lead to a lubrication problem which overtime could lead to the engine seizing.
peugeot.remedy: The recalled vehicles will have the engine replaced.

peugeot.defect: FUSE BOX MAY CAUSE EQUIPMENT OPERATIONAL FAILURES It has been identified that the main engine fuse box is not to the correct specification. This can result in operating faults or the failure of certain equipment.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuse box replaced.

peugeot.defect: THE VEHICLE MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY FITTED WITH A REAR SEAT ANCHORAGE POINT STRENGTHENER It is a possibility that vehicles may not be correctly fitted with a rear seat anchorage point strengthener. If the strengthener is not fitted the vehicle will not comply with the defined retention criteria in the case of an accident.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for the presence of the seat anchorage strengthener. In cases where it is not in place the vehicle will be returned to specification.

peugeot.defect: WINDOW CONTROLS COULD REMAIN ACTIVE AFTER SWITCHING OFF THE IGNITION. The window controls could remain active for 45 seconds after switching off the ignition even after opening one of the doors.  This could allow unintentional use of windows which could result in an injury.  Additionally it contravenes anti-theft regulations.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and install upgrades software.

peugeot.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED It is possible that the connection torque settings for certain steering components on the wheel/strut assembly may not be to specification. The issue will be highlighted to the driver by an increase in the play in the steering but in extreme circumstances could lead to a loss of directional control.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles check and if required retorque the steering components.

peugeot.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE INTERNAL CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE SUBFRAME IS NOT DURABLE ENOUGH. There is a possibility that the internal corrosion protection of the front subframe is not durable enough.
peugeot.remedy: Replacing the front subframe assembly.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE SUPPORT YOKE WELD MAY FAIL. There is a possibility that the lower engine mounting point is weak.  This may lead to significant engine vibration which in turn could result in the right hand drive shaft coming adrift.
peugeot.remedy: Examine and replace the engine support yoke where found necessary.

peugeot.defect: OIL MAY LEAK A deterioration of the brake assistance may occur because it is possible for the brake servo valve to leak oil which can damage the membrane of the brake servo.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to change the valve and the vacuum circuit pipe connecting the vacuum pump to the brake servo.

peugeot.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
peugeot.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

peugeot.defect: INSTRUMENT DISPLAY MAY TURN OFF INTERMITTENTLY The electrical switch of the steering lock may not conform to specification. This could cause the intermittent unwanted switching off of information displays on the instrument panel.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ignition switch.

peugeot.defect: STARTER SUPPLY WIRE MAY CHAFE The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary.

peugeot.defect: SERVICE BRAKE LINKAGE MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED It is necessary to exchange the two clevis pins on the brake pedal system to avoid any loss of braking.  Peugeot have experienced a limited number of incidents where one of the pins has not been locked properly during fitting.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the potentially affected vehicles and replace the two clevis pins on the brake pedal system.

peugeot.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

peugeot.defect: THE INNER TIE RODS ARE NOT CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The inner tie rods connecting the steering rack to the track rod end are not correct to specification
peugeot.remedy: Replace the steering rack inner tie rods (on both sides)

peugeot.defect: THE PASSENGER OUTER SEAT BELTS MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION The passenger outer seat belts may not be correct to specification
peugeot.remedy: Replace the front outer passenger seat belt.

peugeot.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL It is necessary to check the fitting of the pedal box transfer bar levers on (RHD only). In rare cases where the return bar lever is faulty the braking efficiency could be affected.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the transfer bar checked and replaced if found to be faulty.

peugeot.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On affected vehicles; Under certain conditions the fuel leak off pipe may become insecure at the connection to the injector. If this happens fuel may leak form the connection. Fuel may accumulate in the engine compartment and vehicle users will be aware of a smell of fuel.
peugeot.remedy: Inspect connection on affected vehicles and where necessary replace the fuel leak off return pipe fixing with new adhesive.

peugeot.defect: Affected vehicles may have a steering tie rod/track rod end nut that has not been tightened to the correct torque. Affected vehicles may have a steering tie rod/track rod end nut that has not been tightened to the correct torque.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the steering tie rod/track rod end nut and tighten to the correct torque.

peugeot.defect: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
peugeot.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

peugeot.defect: On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil. On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
peugeot.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance). The timing belt will be checked and if needed replaced with other components of the braking assistance system and the vacuum pump.

peugeot.defect: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT On the affected vehicles a possible nonconformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body could lead to water ingress in the passenger compartment. This may affect the operation of the passenger air bag. Unintended deployment is possible.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles add extra sealant and replace wet or water damaged components.

peugeot.defect: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
peugeot.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque

peugeot.defect: The chrono tachograph fitted was not to the correct specification and does not meet Regulatory Requirements. The chrono tachograph fitted was not to the correct specification and does not meet Regulatory Requirements.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the chrono tachograph manual transmission electrical harness & windshield.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE PLUS ENGINE OPERATING PROBLEMS. In adverse wet weather conditions water may enter the engine management solenoid valve operating circuit. This could result in engine operating problems and a reduction in power assistance to the brake pedal if the water enters the brake vacuum circuit via the solenoid valves.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to examine and if necessary replace the engine management solenoid valves with ones sealed against the ingress of water.

peugeot.defect: TAILGATE MAY SHUT WITHOUT WARNING Affected vehicles may have struts with a non compliant internal component. This may prevent the struts from maintaining the tailgate in the open position.
peugeot.remedy: Non compliant struts are determined by using manufacturer test methods. If replacement is required both struts must be replaced.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The earth cable for the battery maybe too short this may resulting in it breaking.  Should this occur the vehicle electrical circuit will fail which will cause the engine to cut out.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the battery earth cable.

peugeot.defect: REAR CROSS MEMBER MAY CRACK Over a period of time a small crack can appear on the rear axle cross member particularly under conditions of repeated maximum suspension travel. The small crack could increase in size and eventually lead to the rear wheel rubbing on the wheel arch.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the rear axle cross member and suspension bump stops.

peugeot.defect: BRAKE CIRCUIT MAY LEAK Under certain circumstances a brake pipe may chafe on the turbo charger air intake securing clip. In extreme situations the wear caused could lead to leakage within a brake circuit and the illumination of the red brake warning light.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for the chafe condition and if necessary the turbo air intake securing clip will be relocated. The affected brake pipe will also be changed if it displays any sign of wear.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It is possible that the con-rod bearing shells will not conform to manufacturer specification. This could lead to premature deterioration of the shells and in time cause the engine to fail.
peugeot.remedy: To replace the con-rod bearing shells

peugeot.defect: MALFUNCTIONS IN ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS It has been identified that some ground connections of the cabin wiring harness and the fixings of the airbag control unit may not be to specification. This issue or non-compliance could cause erratic malfunctions of certain electrical equipment even in very rare cases causing the engine to cut-off or airbags malfunction.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check tightness of the ground connections and airbag control unit fixings.  If required these will need rectification.

peugeot.defect: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY In very rare circumstances the vacuum pump one way valve may not function correctly which could affect the level of braking assistance.
peugeot.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the brake vacuum pump one way valve.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

peugeot.defect: VEHICLE EXTERIOR LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING The lighting management system may incorrectly detect the position of the exterior lighting control switch.  This may cause the exterior light to switch off without warning.
peugeot.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and install a new version of the exterior lighting management software to the vehicle.

peugeot.defect: TAILGATE MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY It has been identified that the possibility exists that the mounting ball on both tailgate support struts may rotate when the tailgate is opened or closed. Should one of the support struts dislocate the tailgate may not remain in the open position.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the mounting ball joints on the tailgate support struts replaced.

peugeot.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF WIRING LOOM There is a possibility that the wiring loom may be damaged as a result of contact being made between components in the heater blower and gear lever.  This may result in a short circuit and failure of the heater.
peugeot.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a  protector and an additional grooved sleeve.

peugeot.defect: FUEL PIPE MAY LEAK It has been identified that on subject vehicles a fuel pipe may not be correctly sealed. Should this be the case seepage of fuel may occur.
peugeot.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuel pipe checked and replaced as necessary.

peugeot.defect: DUE TO THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE THE NOX EMISSIONS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATORY LIMITS The calibration of the engine management software could result in emissions of NOx which do not comply with the regulatory limits.
peugeot.remedy: Download new engine management software

peugeot.defect: ON SOME TRACTION BATTERY CELLS THE ALIGNMENT OF THE ELECTRODES MAY BE OUT OF SPECIFICATION On affected vehicles the alignment of the electrodes may be out of specification on some cells of the traction batteries which may result in the release of toxic fumes or a thermal runaway.
peugeot.remedy: Replace the traction / drive battery.

peugeot.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The engine electronic cooling management control strategy and the maximum temperature alert threshold could cause the engine to overheat. This could result in a warning light and a message being displayed on the instrument panel.
peugeot.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

peugeot.defect: THE REAR SPRING CENTRALISER MIGHT BE WELDED INCORRECTLY The rear spring centraliser might be welded incorrectly.
peugeot.remedy: Add 3 weld spots to the rear spring centralisers

peugeot.defect: VEHICLES AFFECTED MAY HAVE A SINGLE WHEEL BOLT ON BOTH RIGHT HAND SIDE WHEELS WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY A single wheel bolt on both right-hand wheels may not be tightened to the correct tightening torque.
peugeot.remedy: Check and if necessary replace wheel bolts and any other associated parts if consequential damage has occurred.

peugeot.defect: SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE CONCERN. There is a risk that the lower attachment on the front and rear left hand seat belts could be loose.

polaris.defect: POSSIBLE OVER HEATING OF ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE Some ATV models may have been assembled with Electronic Control Modules (ECM) that could contain a defective cooling fan Field Effect Transistor (FET) which affects the ATV's cooking fan system.  Should the FET fail in most cases it will drain the vehicle battery and the vehicle will not start.  However in extreme circumstances it can cause the ECM to fail and overheat which could cause a fire.
polaris.remedy: The manufacturer is to recall all affected vehicles to replace the ECM with a die-cast version which does not contain any combustible material.

polaris.defect: FUEL LEAK WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF FIRE The affected machines have been manufactured with Fuel Pump Nuts that do not meet Polaris quality standards. As a result of a manufacturing defect the nut may crack near the top of the cap and a fuel leak could occur. A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source could create a fire hazard.
polaris.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the old fuel pump nut with one of a modified design.

polaris.defect: CERTAIN IMMI 4 POINT AND 6 POINT SEAT BELT HARNESSES  MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH MISSING BELT STITCHING Certain 4-point and 6-point seat belt harnesses may have been manufactured with missing belt stitching.
polaris.remedy: Check and replace the belt assembly if required.

polaris.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING CONTROL Riders could experience a loss of fluid pressure in the rear brake as a result of the master cylinder not being to specification. The loss of rear brake can increase the risk of a collision.
polaris.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the rear brake master cylinder. Where necessary replace the master cylinder.

polaris.defect: POSSIBLE OVER HEATING OF ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE Some ATV models may have been assembled with Electronic Control Modules (ECM) that could contain a defective cooling fan Field Effect Transistor (FET) which affects the ATV's cooking fan system.  Should the FET fail in most cases it will drain the vehicle battery and the vehicle will not start.  However in extreme circumstances it can cause the ECM to fail and overheat which could cause a fire.
polaris.remedy: The manufacturer is to recall all affected vehicles to replace the ECM with a die-cast version which does not contain any combustible material.

polaris.defect: HEAT SHIELD UPGRADE REQUIRED Heat shield may not adequately shield exhaust gasses in the event of an exhaust silencer crack. This could cause nearby components to melt and pose a fire hazard.
polaris.remedy: Replace heat sheild on affected vehicles.

polaris.defect: FUEL PUMP FLANGE MAY DEGRADE OVER TIME AND RESULT IN FUEL LEAK A fuel pump flange assembly that when exposed to certain chemicals may degrade over time.
polaris.remedy: Install a model specific fuel pump cover to shield the pump flange from potential contamination.

polaris.defect: RISK OF FIRE In the event of an engine misfire unburned fuel can be routed into the exhaust system which can cause excessive exhaust heat that may pose a fire hazard. Consumers should immediately stop using the affected vehicles.
polaris.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and install a revised EU calibration to detect misfire and prevent excessive exhaust temperatures.

polaris.defect: LEAK AT FUEL TANK VENT FITTING The fuel tank may leak in the vicinity of the vent fixing.
polaris.remedy: Recalled machines will have the fuel tank replaced.

polaris.defect: A wiring harness may have been improperly assembled by the supplier and wires may contact the brake line and/or vehicle frame resulting in potential loss of front brakes and/or fire A wiring harness may have been improperly assembled by the supplier and wires may contact the brake line and/or vehicle frame.
polaris.remedy: Inspect and then secure the stator wires.

polaris.defect: FUEL MAY ESCAPE FROM THE FUEL TANK Polaris Industries Inc. (Polaris) have issued a STOP ride and STOP sale notice on a small number of machines. These machines  were manufactured with a fuel tank vent line end location in the headlight pod which may result in liquid fuel exiting the vent line and create a risk of fire.
polaris.remedy: On affected machines fit a new and rerouted vent pipe.

polaris.defect: EXHAUST PIPE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH QUALITY STANDARDS Some vehicles may have been manufactured with an exhaust head pipe that does not meet Polaris quality standards. As a result the exhaust temperatures may degrade the exhaust head pipe to the point where a hole or crack may form. This could pose a potential fire and/or burn hazard.
polaris.remedy: To resolve this concern the exhaust head pipe will be replaced.

polaris.defect: RISK OF FIRE The vehicles may have been manufactured with heat shields that are inadequate. The resulting issue could lead to the cab or cargo box overheating which may pose a fire hazard. Revised shields will also provide additional protection from flammable liquid spills that may pose a separate fire hazard. Consumers should immediately stop using the affected vehicles.
polaris.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and inspect and replace the existing heat shielding. Install additional heat shielding.

polaris.defect: THE THROTTLE PEDAL MAY BE SLOW TO RELEASE OR MAY STICK IN THE DEPRESSED POSITION Throttle pedals that may be slow to release or may stick in the depressed position.
polaris.remedy: An updated throttle pedal needs to be installed in all affected vehicles.

polaris.defect: RISK OF PRIMARY DRIVE CLUTCH FAILURE Some 2020-2021 RZR models may have an increased risk of primary (drive) clutch failure
polaris.remedy: Inspect the and replace the primary clutch if necessary.

polaris.defect: Some snowmobiles may pose a risk of fire due to electrostatic discharge (ESD) inside the fuel tank With degraded fuel and especially after extended storage some snowmobiles may pose a risk of fire due to electrostatic discharge (ESD) inside the fuel tank.
polaris.remedy: If a rider needs to start their snowmobile they must make sure the fuel tank is full and if it is not then they need to add fresh gasoline to fill the tank. To resolve this concern Polaris has developed a procedure to update the fuel pump assembly.

polaris.defect: POSSIBILITY OF UNINTENDED ACCELERATION Some vehicles may have been manufactured with improper throttle cable routing. As a result the throttle cable may come in contact with the engine exhaust system during operation which could cause throttle cable damage and unintended throttle behaviour.
polaris.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a new throttle cable and/or correct the routing of the throttle cable.

polaris.defect: BRAKE LINES COULD LEAK The front brake lines could leak due to the fragility of the junction block with the result that the braking system could fail.
polaris.remedy: Recalled machines will be inspected for brake fluid leaks from the front brake lines. Should a leak be found the lines will be replaced and a replacement retainer kit fitted. Should no leakage be present the retainer kit only will be fitted.

polaris.defect: POSSIBLE OVER HEATING OF ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE Some ATV models may have been assembled with Electronic Control Modules (ECM) that could contain a defective cooling fan Field Effect Transistor (FET) which affects the ATV's cooking fan system.  Should the FET fail in most cases it will drain the vehicle battery and the vehicle will not start.  However in extreme circumstances it can cause the ECM to fail and overheat which could cause a fire.
polaris.remedy: The manufacturer is to recall all affected vehicles to replace the ECM with a die-cast version which does not contain any combustible material.

polaris.defect: RISK OF FIRE Some vehicles may have been manufactured with wiring harnesses that may short to ground with no circuit protection.
polaris.remedy: A harness kit will be fitted to add an in-line fuse for the un-switched power circuit together with chafing protection for the starter cable. The overall condition of the harness will also be inspected to ensure the ground circuits are properly connected.

polestar.defect: PS2 Seat Bolts On affected vehicles it has been identified that the four bolts on the left front seat may not have been torqued correctly at the factory.
polestar.remedy: On the affected vehicles Inspection the torque of all four bolts will be carried out and if necessary adjust the torque to the correct specification.

polestar.defect: Investigations have identified that there may be a potential issue with the high-voltage battery. Investigations have identified that there may be a potential issue with the high-voltage battery.
polestar.remedy: As an interim solution due to hardware component availability issues software should be downloaded to the vehicle which will prevent the battery from being fully charged.

polestar.defect: There is a potential for the high voltage battery to overheat when fully charged and the vehicle remains plugged in once full charge is reached. There is a potential for the high voltage battery to overheat when fully charged and the vehicle remains plugged in once full charge is reached.
polestar.remedy: Replace the battery cell modules and restore the electric driving range to full capacity if the temporary software fix from R10202 has been previously downloaded to the vehicle.

polestar.defect: HIGH VOLTAGE CONTACTORS IN THE BATTERY ENERGY CONTROL MODULE MAY OPEN DURING DRIVING High voltage contactors may open during driving resulting in a risk that the high voltage system may be unintentionally disconnected causing a loss of propulsion.
polestar.remedy: Software upgrade to be carried out.

polestar.defect: AN INTERNAL RESET IN THE BATTERY ENERGY CONTROL MODULE CAUSES THE CONTROL UNIT TO OPEN THE HIGH VOLTAGE CONECTORS DURING DRIVING An internal reset in the Battery Energy Control Module (BECM) causes the control unit to open the high voltage connectors during driving.

PS3 HLCM Replacement On affected vehicles a fault within the High to Low voltage Converter Module (HLCM) reduces the available charging capacity to the 12V battery. In a worst-case scenario this could cause the vehicle to lose propulsion power without any prior warning message to the driver.
polestar.remedy: Replace the High to Low voltage Converter Module (HLCM).

polestar.defect: PS2 FSAB On affected vehicles the Far-Side Airbag (FSAB) in the left-hand front seat of the car may fail to deploy as intended increasing the risk of injury in impacts from the right-hand side of the vehicle.

A joint in the front suspension may have been incorrectly attached during the manufacturing process. A joint in the front suspension may have been incorrectly attached during the manufacturing process.
polestar.remedy: Inspect the front suspension to ensure that the joint is correctly attached and if applicable adjust accordingly.

polestar.defect: TIN PLATING ON BULK CAPACITOR TERMINALS COULD CAUSE SHORT CURCUIT AND STALLING WHILE DRIVING Tin plating on the bulk capacitor terminals may create a short circuit
polestar.remedy: Replace the affected inverters as appropriate

polestar.defect: BCM2 SW – Safety Notice Affected vehicles may experience a temporary loss of braking functionality after coasting downhill when using One Pedal Drive. This could potentially lead to a collision.
polestar.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) update.

polestar.defect: RP1063 PS3 Cable Harness Replacement On affected vehicles there is an issue with the inline connector that joins the bumper wiring harness and the engine bay harness. There is a risk of fluid ingress into the connector housing resulting in corrosion of the connector pins.
polestar.remedy: Replace the bumper wiring harness and the inline connector on the engine bay harness.

polestar.defect: THE HEADLAMPS ARE ADJUSTED TOO HIGH The headlamps are adjusted too high.
polestar.remedy: Adjust the headlamps to the correct level.

polesworth.defect: SEATS MAY DETACH Passenger seats may detach during a collison
polesworth.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and secure seats as per the seat manufacturers recommendations

polyplastic.defect: WINDOW MAY DETACH The two panes of glazing that make up the window may separate as a result of UV degradation. The separation takes about two years to progress to failure after the separation has started. In the worst case a separated pane could come loose from the unit.
polyplastic.remedy: Recall the units that are likely to be affected to repair the windows by fixing them together with a specially developed screw material. If the owner requires new improved windows can be purchased at a reduced price.

porsche.defect: ARA7 Recall campaign - Replace shift cable On affected vehicles the transmission shift cable may have had the safety clip on the shift cable incorrectly fitted or the cable sheath on the shift cable may be damaged resulting in the risk of a roll away incident after the vehicle is placed in park (P) if the parking brake is not applied.
porsche.remedy: Replace shift cable

porsche.defect: ARA7 Recall campaign - Replace shift cable On affected vehicles the transmission shift cable may have had the safety clip on the shift cable incorrectly fitted or the cable sheath on the shift cable may be damaged resulting in the risk of a roll away incident after the vehicle is placed in park (P) if the parking brake is not applied.
porsche.remedy: Replace shift cable

porsche.defect: THE PASSENGER SEAT OCCUPANCY DETECTION SYSTEM DOES NOT CURRENTLY MEET THE REQUIRED STANDARD The passenger seat occupancy detection system does not currently meet the required standard.
porsche.remedy: The passenger seat occupancy detection sensor mats must be replaced.

porsche.defect: AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED WITH A FAULTY CAPACITOR Possible fault within the air bag control unit.
porsche.remedy: Software upgrade to the control unit and replacement if faulty.

porsche.defect: LOUDSPEAKER COVER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE DOOR SUB FRAME Possible missing cover in the door sub-frame.
porsche.remedy: Inspect retrofit cover if required.

porsche.defect: THE LOWER TRAILING ARMS ON THE RIGHT FRONT AXLE MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS There is a possibility that the right front lower trailing arms do not meet the required specifications.
porsche.remedy: The lower trailing arm on the right front axle must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

porsche.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT A CRACK FORMATION COULD OCCUR ON THE ENGINE CYLINDER BORES There is a possibility that a crack formation could occur on the engine cylinder bores.
porsche.remedy: The engine on the affected vehicles will be replaced.

porsche.defect: BONNET CATCH ASSEMBLY MAY FAIL On affected vehicles the upper part of the catch mechanism fitted to the  front luggage compartment lid  may not be secured to the correct specification.  The mechanism may become detached from the lid allowing it to open unintentionally.
porsche.remedy: Replace upper part of catch mechanism and secure with new screws

porsche.defect: REAR HEATER BLOWER RESISTOR MAY OVERLOAD The rear heater blower resistor can become electrically overloaded due to binding or seizure of the heater blower. The overloaded resistor may become hot enough to ignite the plastic air pipe in which it is located.
porsche.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the installation of a modified resistor unit which incorporates a thermal link.

porsche.defect: On affected vehicles due to insufficient sealing under certain circumstances liquid can enter the interior of the high-voltage battery. On affected vehicles due to insufficient sealing under certain circumstances liquid can enter the interior of the high-voltage battery.�
porsche.remedy: Check the battery for leaks and replace if necessary.

porsche.defect: INDIVIDUAL THREADED CONNECTIONS AT THE VEHICLE'S SUSPENSION MIGHT NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFICATION DUE TO INSUFFICIENTLY CUT THREAD OF LOCKNUTS Individual threaded connections at the vehicle's suspension might not be tightened to the specification due to insufficiently cut thread of locknuts.
porsche.remedy: The affected screw joints must be replaced with a new nut and bolt and tightened to the original specification.

porsche.defect: On affected vehicles the front and rear axles trailing arms and wishbones are susceptible to corrosion and do not meet the required specification for durability. On affected vehicles the front and rear axles trailing arms and wishbones are susceptible to corrosion and do not meet the required specification for durability.
porsche.remedy: Replace affected components with new parts.

porsche.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The high fuel pressure that builds up in the injection system when the engine is running can cause cracking and ultimately press the relevant fuel collection pipe off the injectors. This can cause a fuel leak in the engine compartment.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fastening screws for the fuel collection pipes with different screws.

porsche.defect: REAR AXLE CARRIER SIDE PARTS MAY NOT MEET REQUIRED SPECIFICATIONS The carrier side parts installed on the rear axle during a certain period may not meet the required specifications.
porsche.remedy: The left and right carrier side parts of the affected vehicles must be replaced.

porsche.defect: REDUCED BRAKE PERFORMANCE A vacuum supply line for the brake booster may not have been fitted correctly. The vacuum supply line could become loose resulting in reduced braking assistance. The brakes will still work but the driver will have to supply additional input for the required brake effort.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected where the connection points of the vacuum supply line will be checked/adjusted/replaced as necessary.

porsche.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE HAZARD WARNING LIGHTS WILL NOT BE ACTIVATED AFTER PRESSING THE CENTRE CONSOLE BUTTON There is a possibility that the hazard warning lights will not be activated after pressing the button in the center console.
porsche.remedy: Re-program the operator control unit in front center console.

porsche.defect: INDIVIDUAL THREADED CONNECTIONS AT THE VEHICLE'S SUSPENSION MIGHT NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFICATION DUE TO INSUFFICIENTLY CUT THREAD OF LOCKNUTS Individual threaded connections at the vehicle's suspension might not be tightened to the specification due to insufficiently cut thread of locknuts.
porsche.remedy: The affected screw joints must be replaced with a new nut and bolt and tightened to the original specification.

porsche.defect: MISSING ASSIGNMENT WITHIN THE SOFTWARE OF THE INSTRUMENT CLUSTER Brake pad wear warning light function is incorrect.
porsche.remedy: Update software of instrument cluster.

porsche.defect: RISK OF FIRE A fuel pipe quick connector located under the vehicle could be contacting a heating pipe. The contact of the pipe and connector could impair the locking function of the connector and in the worst case could cause the fuel pipe to leak and the possibility of the engine cutting out or fire.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check for contact of the heating pipe and fuel line and if there is sufficient clearance fit a spacing ring and if there has been contact fit a new fuel line and spacer.

porsche.defect: FUEL INJECTION PIPES MAY BECOME INSECURE The screws retaining the fuel collection pipe(s) may shear under stress. This may allow the pipe(s) to separate from the injector(s) and cause fuel to leak.
porsche.remedy: On affected vehicle replace the collection pipes' securing screws

porsche.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF REAR AXLE SIDE PARTS Crack like surface defects may be present on the mould parting line on the rear axle side parts.
porsche.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and inspect the rear axle side parts for surface defects where these are present the original side part(s) will be replaced with quality assured parts.

porsche.defect: STEERING COULD BE IMPAIRED It has been identified that it is possible that the threaded joints on the chassis of subject vehicles may not have been tightened to the prescribed torque. This may result in the screws becoming loose resulting in noises from around the vehicle. Should the screws detach steering control can become impaired.
porsche.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject joints checked to ensure that they are tightened to the correct torque.

porsche.defect: REDUCED BRAKE PERFORMANCE A vacuum supply line for the brake booster may not have been fitted correctly. The vacuum supply line could become loose resulting in reduced braking assistance. The brakes will still work but the driver will have to supply additional input for the required brake effort.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected where the connection points of the vacuum supply line will be checked/adjusted/replaced as necessary.

porsche.defect: INDIVIDUAL SCREW CONNECTIONS OF THE SHOCK ABSORBERS ON THE FRONT AND REAR AXLE MAY HAVE BEEN IMPERMISSIBLY TIGHTENED SEVERAL TIMES Individual screw connections of the shock absorbers on the front axle and rear axle may have been impermissibly tightened several times.
porsche.remedy: The affected fastening screws must be replaced and tightened according to the original specifications. On vehicles where the front axle is affected the mounting saddles must also be replaced.

porsche.defect: THE TIGHTNESS OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL LINE ON CYLINDER BANK 2 CANNOT BE GUARANTEED DUE TO A MANUFACTURING ERROR Cylinder bank 2 high-pressure fuel line might not be tight
porsche.remedy: Replace the high-pressure fuel line and sensor on cylinder bank 2.

porsche.defect: PARTICLE FILTER BRACKET MAY DETACH There is a possibility the clamp between the particle filter and the front exhaust pipe is not closed fully due to an unfavourable tolerance pairing.The particle filter could become detached from the exhaust pipe when travelling over bumps for example. This can then cause exhaust gas to leak out and rattling noises. If this happens the customer will notice an exhaust smell and the pre-mentioned noise.
porsche.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled so the clamp can be checked. Where necessary relevant components will be replaced.

porsche.defect: INADEQUATE CRASH RESISTANCE FOR FRONT LEFT SEAT FRAME Inadequate crash resistance for left hand front seat frame
porsche.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a replacement seat

porsche.defect: THE VEHICLE MAY NOT MEET THE PRESCRIBED EMISSION LIMITS The affected vehicle may not meet prescribed emission limits.
porsche.remedy: The engine and transmission control units must be updated

porsche.defect: ELECTRIC POWER STEERING MAY SPORADICALLY BE UNAVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED PERIOD OF TIME Electric power steering may be unavailable.
porsche.remedy: Re-programme power steering control unit with software upgrade.

porsche.defect: THE AIRBAG SENSORS IN THE SIDE MEMBERS ON THE VEHICLE MAY NOT BE SCREWED TIGHTLY ENOUGH There is a possibility that the side airbag sensors are not tightened to specification.
porsche.remedy: Check both side airbag sensors and rework the fixing where necessary.

porsche.defect: FASTENING NUTS TO SECURE THE DRIVE SHAFT AND WHEEL HUB ON THE REAR AXLE ARE INCORRECTLY COATED Incorrectly coated nuts were used to secure the drive shaft and wheel hub on the rear axle.
porsche.remedy: Replace the fastening nuts and torque to specification.

porsche.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK A connector bolt may be loose which could cause a steering fluid leak and loss of power assistance to the steering and and on the 911 Turbo to the power assistance to the clutch. Leaking fluid may ignite if it comes into contact with the exhaust system.
porsche.remedy: Vehicles must be recalled and the connector bolts must be tightened with the correct torque.

porsche.defect: THE SPRING OF THE FOOT OPERATED HANDBRAKE MAY RUB ON THE MAIN WIRING HARNESS Possibility that the spring of the foot operated handbrake may rub on the main wiring harness and damage it
porsche.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a cover to protect the harness.

porsche.defect: THE TIGHTNESS OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL LINE ON CYLINDER BANK 2 CANNOT BE GUARANTEED DUE TO A MANUFACTURING ERROR Cylinder bank 2 high-pressure fuel line might not be tight
porsche.remedy: Replace the high-pressure fuel line and sensor on cylinder bank 2.

porsche.defect: WELD SEAMS ON THE EXHAUST TAILPIPE MAY FAIL The welded seams on the exhaust tailpipe may fail. This can cause rattling noises while driving and can result in the loss of the exhaust tailpipe if the driver continues to drive the vehicle.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the exhaust tailpipes with modified units.

porsche.defect: On the affected vehicles it is possible that the screw connection of the seat belt mount to the rear left and/or right seat was not carried out in accordance with the specifications. On the affected vehicles it is possible that the screw connection of the seat belt mount to the rear left and/or right seat was not carried out in accordance with the specifications.
porsche.remedy: The screw connection of the seat belt mount to the rear left and/or right seat must be replaced.

porsche.defect: STEERING COULD BE IMPAIRED It has been identified that it is possible that the threaded joints on the chassis of subject vehicles may not have been tightened to the prescribed torque. This may result in the screws becoming loose resulting in noises from around the vehicle. Should the screws detach steering control can become impaired.
porsche.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject joints checked to ensure that they are tightened to the correct torque.

porsche.defect: INCORRECT DETONATORS FITTED TO FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAGS Incorrect passenger air bag detonators were installed during manufacturer. this may adversely affect the airbag's deployment in the event of an impact.
porsche.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger's air bag module.

porsche.defect: HEADLIGHT MAY DETACH If a headlight module is not locked correctly relative movements with respect to the wing can occur. In rare cases this can cause the headlight to become detached from the wing.  Based on results from internal quality control checks and individual complaints Porsche has decided to incorporate measures to make the locking system more robust into standard production and they will retrofit these changes on existing models.
porsche.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to have the locking mechanism on both headlights replaced.

porsche.defect: THE SCREW CONNECTION OF THE PRESSURE INPUT ROD OF THE BRAKE BOOSTER WAS NOT CARRIED OUT ACCORDING TO REGULATIONS The screw connection of the pressure input rod of the brake booster may not have been tightened according to regulations.
porsche.remedy: The brake booster must be replaced or reworked depending on the vehicle type.�

porsche.defect: THE FABRIC PROTECTIVE HOSE OF THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE FRONT SEATS CAN BE DAMAGED WHEN ADJUSTING THE SEAT IN THE LONGITUDINAL DIRECTION There is a possibility that the fabric protective hose of the wiring harness of the front seats can be damaged when adjusting the seat in the longitudinal direction and subsequently be pulled into the drive spindle of the seat adjustment.
porsche.remedy: On affected vehicles check the wiring harness of the front seats rework with textile tape and repair if necessary.

porsche.defect: FRONT AXLE COMPONENT PARTS MAY CRACK The front axle has been fitted with chassis components whose durability cannot be guaranteed. The lower control arms can start to crack and eventually break which will result in the vehicle handling being impaired.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the lower control arms.

porsche.defect: BONNET CATCH ASSEMBLY MAY FAIL On affected vehicles the upper part of the catch mechanism fitted to the  front luggage compartment lid  may not be secured to the correct specification.  The mechanism may become detached from the lid allowing it to open unintentionally.
porsche.remedy: Replace upper part of catch mechanism and secure with new screws

porsche.defect: THE SELECTOR LEVER CABLE PLASTIC SLEEVE DOES NOT HAVE THE REQUIRED DURABILITY AND MAY BREAK The transmission selector lever plastic sleeve does not have the required durability.
porsche.remedy: Replace the plastic sleeve on the selector cable.

porsche.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL A bearing flange on the parking brake lever is likely to break. If this occurs the parking brake will be ineffective.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the parking brake lever assembly.

porsche.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The low fuel pressure sensor may not be fully tight. Over the life of the car the sensor may loosen allowing fuel to leak in the engine compartment.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to tighten the low fuel pressure sensor to the correct torque.

porsche.defect: On affected vehicles certain software parameters used in Type Approval were not used in production.  There are no indications the deviations affect safety and declared fuel consumption and CO2 emissions values. On affected vehicles certain software parameters used in Type Approval were not used in production.  There are no indications the deviations affect safety and declared fuel consumption and CO2 emissions values.
porsche.remedy: Update software.

porsche.remedy: The affected vehicles will be recalled to Porsche dealers for inspection. Any tail pipes where the cover sleeves are attached by two welds will be replaced with four weld version pipes.

porsche.defect: CONVERTIBLE TOP FRONT LOCKS MAY FRACTURE The front latch hooks securing the convertible top to the windscreen frame may fracture and in the worst case allow the convertible top to retract without warning whilst the vehicle is being driven.
porsche.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the original latch hooks with modified versions.

porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check for contact of the heating pipe and fuel line and if there is sufficient clearance fit a spacing ring and if there has been contact fit a new fuel line and spacer.
