porsche.defect: INDIVIDUAL THREADED CONNECTIONS AT THE VEHICLE'S SUSPENSION MIGHT NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFICATION DUE TO INSUFFICIENTLY CUT THREAD OF LOCKNUTS Individual threaded connections at the vehicle's suspension might not be tightened to the specification due to insufficiently cut thread of locknuts.
porsche.remedy: The affected screw joints must be replaced with a new nut and bolt and tightened to the original specification.

porsche.defect: INTERNAL SOFTWARE ERROR IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE POWER ELECTRONICS It is possible for the affected vehicles to display the warning message Drive control disturbed - Park vehicle safely in the instrument cluster.
porsche.remedy: The high-voltage power electronics must be reprogrammed with corrected software.

porsche.defect: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAGS MAY BE DEACTIVATED The seat occupancy detector system may not be to the correct standard and the passenger's airbags may be deactivated
porsche.remedy: On affected vehicle replace the sensor mat.

porsche.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It has been identified that the possibility exists that a fuel line within the scuttle panel area may be in contact with the engine compartment cover. This can result in a knocking noise and the fuel line becoming damaged with the attendant possibility that a fuel leak may occur.
porsche.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the routing of the fuel line changed and an additional spacer fitted. In the event of damage to the fuel line it will be replaced.

porsche.defect: STEERING COULD BE IMPAIRED It has been identified that it is possible that the threaded joints on the chassis of subject vehicles may not have been tightened to the prescribed torque. This may result in the screws becoming loose resulting in noises from around the vehicle. Should the screws detach steering control can become impaired.
porsche.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject joints checked to ensure that they are tightened to the correct torque.

porsche.defect: EMISSION VALUES MAY BE HIGHER ON AFFECTED VEHICLES WITH HIGH MILEAGE Emission values may be higher than expected.
porsche.remedy: Replace the suction hoses and re-programme vehicle control units.

porsche.defect: FRONT SIDE AIRBAGS MAY BE IMPAIRED It has been identified that the front side airbags may have been fitted with the incorrect detonators. If the vehicle is involved in a collision then the airbags may not operate as intended.
porsche.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the front side airbags with a quality assured replacement.

porsche.defect: DUE TO FAULTY SOFTWARE THE DISPLAY LOGIC OF THE BRAKE WEAR INDICATOR IS NOT FULFILLED SUFFICIENTLY The required display logic of the brake wear indicator is incorrect.
porsche.remedy: The instrument cluster must be re-programmed with updated software.

porsche.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK -  POSSIBILITY OF FIRE Fuel may leak from the injector fuel rails. Occupants may notice a smell and  though small there is a risk of fire.
porsche.remedy: Replace injector fuel rails

porsche.defect: On affected vehicles the rear spoiler setting may not meet specifications due to incorrect coding during production making it too high.  The high-mounted brake light may become less visible while driving and the aerodynamics of the vehicle may change. On affected vehicles the rear spoiler setting may not meet specifications due to incorrect coding during production making it too high.� The high-mounted brake light may become less visible while driving and the aerodynamics of the vehicle may change.
porsche.remedy: Re-code the rear vehicle electronics control unit on affected vehicles.�

porsche.defect: ELECTRICAL POWER STEERING WIRE COULD BECOME TRAPPED BETWEEN THE CROSS BEAM AND UNDERFLOOR COVER The electric power steering harness could become trapped and damaged.
porsche.remedy: Check and replace the electric power steering harness if necessary.

porsche.defect: BOTTOM SIDE OF FUEL PUMP SERVI CE COVER MAY GET INTO CONTACT WITH CONNECTION PIPE OF THE FUEL PUMP The fuel pump connection pipe may come into contact with the fuel pump service cover and become damaged
porsche.remedy: Re-work the bottom of the service cover

porsche.defect: THE TIGHTNESS OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL LINE ON CYLINDER BANK 2 CANNOT BE GUARANTEED DUE TO A MANUFACTURING ERROR Cylinder bank 2 high-pressure fuel line might not be tight
porsche.remedy: Replace the high-pressure fuel line and sensor on cylinder bank 2.

porsche.defect: AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED WITH A FAULTY CAPACITOR Possible fault within the air bag control unit.
porsche.remedy: Software upgrade to the control unit and replacement if faulty.

porsche.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED The circlip on the bearing bracket for the pedals may detach. If this occurs the brake pedal will become unsecured axially and come out of one of the two bearings leading to decreased brake functionality.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fitment of the circlip and replaced as necessary.

porsche.defect: BONDING ON WINDSCREEN IS INSUFFICIENT On 911 Cabriolet and Targa models only the windscreen may have been fitted with insufficient bonding product. There is a possibility that the windscreen could detach from the vehicle in the event of an accident.
porsche.remedy: Recall the likely affected vehicles and rebond the windscreen.

porsche.defect: THE THREADED CONNECTIONS OF THE UPPER CONTROL ARMS AT THE REAR AXLE WERE NOT TIGHTENED WITH THE SPECIFIC TIGTENING TORQUE Threaded connections of the upper control arms at the rear axle may not be tightened with the specified tightening torque.
porsche.remedy: The chassis bolts will be replaced and tightened with the specified tightening torque.

porsche.defect: FRONT SIDE AIRBAGS MAY BE IMPAIRED It has been identified that the front side airbags may have been fitted with the incorrect detonators. If the vehicle is involved in a collision then the airbags may not operate as intended.
porsche.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the front side airbags with a quality assured replacement.

porsche.defect: THE LOCKING MECHANISM FOR CONVERTIBLE TOP MAY FAIL There is a possibility that when the convertible top is closed the convertible top is not completely locked even though the warning lamp is extinguished. This could lead to the roof opening whilst the vehicle is in motion.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit modified locking-mechanism motors. In addittion check that the correct locating pegs are installed and that the convertible top is set correctly.

porsche.defect: THE LOWER TRAILING ARMS ON THE RIGHT FRONT AXLE MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS There is a possibility that the right front lower trailing arms do not meet the required specifications.
porsche.remedy: The lower trailing arm on the right front axle must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

porsche.defect: THE DATA VERSION OF THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MUST BE UPDATED TO IMPROVE THE NITROGEN OXIDE EMISSIONS The affected vehicle may not meet prescribed emission limits.
porsche.remedy: The engine control unit must be updated in order to improve the engine control system.

porsche.defect: INADEQUATE CONNECTION BETWEEN LOWER LONGITUDINAL MEMBER AND CROSS MEMBER Inadequate connection between the lower longitudinal member and cross member.
porsche.remedy: Secure the lower longitudinal member to the cross member using additional blind rivets.

porsche.defect: THE TIGHTNESS OF THE QUICK CONNECTOR OF THE FUEL SUPPLY LINE MAY NOT BE ENSURED The tightness of the quick connector of the fuel supply line may not be ensured.
porsche.remedy: The fuel supply line in the engine compartment has to be replaced.

porsche.defect: REAR HUB MAY DETACH Current market observations have shown that the track usage of many vehicles in the 911 model line now comes close to that of pure GT3 racing vehicles.  The component stresses associated with race track use and competitive driving are much higher than for a sporty driving style on public roads. The revision intervals for race track use must be observed particularly for highly stressed chassis components in the same way as is required for GT3 racing vehicles.  If these revision intervals are not observed the failure of highly stressed components and breakage of hubs on the rear axle for example cannot be ruled out particularly in the case of components in advanced stages of wear.
porsche.remedy: In order to standardise revision intervals the wheel hubs on the rear axle will be replaced by standard wheel hubs on the affected vehicles with central wheel lock

porsche.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The turbo chargers fitted to the affected vehicles may not be manufactured to the required standard. The result of one or both of the turbo chargers failing is rough running and lack of power. In the worst case scenario there is a possibility that fire could occur.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the turbo chargers.

porsche.defect: LOUDSPEAKER COVER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE DOOR SUB FRAME Possible missing cover in the door sub-frame.
porsche.remedy: Inspect retrofit cover if required.

porsche.defect: AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED WITH A FAULTY CAPACITOR Possible fault within the air bag control unit.
porsche.remedy: Software upgrade to the control unit and replacement if faulty.

porsche.defect: IMPROVE THE ENGINE CONTROL SYSTEM IN TERMS OF NITROGEN OXIDE EMISSIONS Improve the engine control system in terms of nitrogen oxide emissions.
porsche.remedy: Engine control software will be updated.

porsche.defect: A POSSIBILITY THAT LOCK NUTS WERE INSTALLED ON THE REAR AXLE TRAILING ARMS THAT WERE NOT MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO THE REQUIRED PARAMETER FIELD A possibility that lock nuts were installed on the rear axle trailing arms that were not manufactured according to the required parameter field.
porsche.remedy: The lock nuts on the axle trailing arms of the rear axle must be replaced with nuts manufactured in accordance with the specifications.

porsche.defect: On affected vehicles the side airbag installed in bucket seats may be activated unnecessarily. On affected vehicles the side airbag installed in bucket seats may be activated unnecessarily.
porsche.remedy: Recode the airbag control unit

porsche.defect: FUEL INJECTION PIPES MAY BECOME INSECURE The screws retaining the fuel collection pipe(s) may shear under stress. This may allow the pipe(s) to separate from the injector(s) and cause fuel to leak.
porsche.remedy: On affected vehicle replace the collection pipes' securing screws

porsche.defect: IF FUEL NOZZLE IS TURNED OR NOT INSERTED FULLY INTO FILLER TUBE FUEL CAN GET INTO CARBON CANISTER IN FUEL TANK SYSTEM Fuel may enter the carbon canister whilst refuelling.
porsche.remedy: Replace fuel filler tube and carbon canister.

porsche.defect: SCREWS SECURING STEERING COLUMN TO STEERING GEAR DON'T MEET SPECIFICATIONS The screws securing the steering column to the steering gear may not meet� the required specifications on�affected vehicles.�
porsche.remedy: The steering column screws must be replaced.�

porsche.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL A bearing flange on the parking brake lever is likely to break. If this occurs the parking brake will be ineffective.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the parking brake lever assembly.

porsche.defect: CONNECTING LINKS ON THE REAR AXLE ANTI ROLL BAR The connecting links on the rear axle anti roll bar cannot be ensured over the life of the vehicle. This may lead to noise and an activated yellow warning light. This may impair the function which is characterised by greater understeer and increased roll behaviour.
porsche.remedy: Replacement of the links on the anti roll bar.

porsche.defect: INCORRECT DETONATORS FITTED TO FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAGS Incorrect passenger air bag detonators were installed during manufacturer. this may adversely affect the airbag's deployment in the event of an impact.
porsche.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger's air bag module.

porsche.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The high fuel pressure that builds up in the injection system when the engine is running can cause cracking and ultimately press the relevant fuel collection pipe off the injectors. This can cause a fuel leak in the engine compartment.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fastening screws for the fuel collection pipes with different screws.

porsche.defect: VEHICLE MAY NOT MEET REQUIRED SAFETY STANDARDS Necessary technical acceptance not carried out by Porsche AG prior to sale of certain Porsche company cars. As a result one pre-owned vehicle does not comply to the latest standards and related quality standards.
porsche.remedy: The one car affected will be bought back by Porsche AG through their Porsche centre network.

porsche.defect: THE THREADED CONNECTIONS OF THE UPPER CONTROL ARMS AT THE REAR AXLE WERE NOT TIGHTENED WITH THE SPECIFIC TIGTENING TORQUE Threaded connections of the upper control arms at the rear axle may not be tightened with the specified tightening torque.
porsche.remedy: The chassis bolts will be replaced and tightened with the specified tightening torque.

porsche.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR One or more engine con rod bolts may fail and lead to the crankcase being damaged and in the worst case fire.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the engine and vehicle specific identification stickers.

porsche.defect: SEAT BACKS DO NOT MEET THE RIGIDITY OF PORCHE SPECIFICATION Front seats are fitted with seat backs that do not meet the rigidity Porsche AG demands.
porsche.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the front seats with those which meet all the appropriate requirements.

porsche.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE The wiring harness for the left hand radiator could be touching a heat guide plate made of carbon fibre. Therefore the harness could be damaged causing the radiator fan to stop working and an electric short circuit to the low resistance heat guide plate cannot be ruled out. This electric short circuit can cause the vehicle to catch fire even a long time after stopping the vehicle.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the routing of the wiring harness and the harness condition. The harness must be secured to the water tube using an additional tie wrap clamp. If the wire harness is damaged it must also be repaired.

porsche.defect: LONGITUDINAL AND TRANSVERSE CONTROL ARMS MAY BE PRONE TO CORROSION Internal tests have shown that the longitudinal and transverse control arms installed on the affected vehicles may be prone to corrosion. The durability of these components cannot therefore be unequivocally guaranteed. f the fastening bolts on the longitudinal and transverse control arms crack due to corrosion vehicle handling in extreme situations e.g. during race track driving may be restricted and this can increase the risk of an accident.
porsche.remedy: The affected components on the vehicles will therefore be replaced by components made of more robust material.

porsche.defect: FILLING THE FUEL TANK MAY CAUSE AN ELECTROSTATIC CHARGE There is a possibility that the ground connection between the thread of the tank filler neck and the connecting pipe to the fuel tank may not be sound which may result in an electrostatic charge which in rare cases could create a spark which could ignite fuel vapours in the area outside of the tank filler neck which could lead to a muffled detonation..
porsche.remedy: Recall affected vehicles inspect and if necessary rework ground connection.

porsche.defect: POTENTIAL MALFUNCTION OF THE A/C BLOWER CONTROL UNIT Possible short circuits in the heater blower control unit.
porsche.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace the control unit.

porsche.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that the durability of the lower trailing arm cannot be guaranteed. The arm can start to crack or fracture which if used on race track use or similar events can cause the arm to fail and result in loss of control of the vehicle.
porsche.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles to replace the lower trailing arms with a more durable component.

porsche.defect: REDUCED BRAKE PERFORMANCE A vacuum supply line for the brake booster may not have been fitted correctly. The vacuum supply line could become loose resulting in reduced braking assistance. The brakes will still work but the driver will have to supply additional input for the required brake effort.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected where the connection points of the vacuum supply line will be checked/adjusted/replaced as necessary.

porsche.defect: THE AIRBAG SENSORS IN THE SIDE MEMBERS ON THE VEHICLE MAY NOT BE SCREWED TIGHTLY ENOUGH There is a possibility that the side airbag sensors are not tightened to specification.
porsche.remedy: Check both side airbag sensors and rework the fixing where necessary.

porsche.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL A bearing flange on the parking brake lever is likely to break. If this occurs the parking brake will be ineffective.
porsche.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the parking brake lever assembly.

porsche.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK -  POSSIBILITY OF FIRE Fuel may leak from the injector fuel rails. Occupants may notice a smell and  though small there is a risk of fire.
porsche.remedy: Replace injector fuel rails

porsche.defect: On the affected vehicles it is possible that the screw connection of the seat belt mount to the rear left and/or right seat was not carried out in accordance with the specifications. On the affected vehicles it is possible that the screw connection of the seat belt mount to the rear left and/or right seat was not carried out in accordance with the specifications.
porsche.remedy: The screw connection of the seat belt mount to the rear left and/or right seat must be replaced.

porsche.defect: CONNECTING RODS INSTALLED MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION Connecting rods that were not manufactured according to specifications may have been installed in the engines of the affected vehicles.
porsche.remedy: The engine must be replaced.

porsche.defect: THE CHASSIS GEOMETRY ON THE REAR AXLE HAS DEVIATED IN SOME CASES During a data analysis with regard to carrying out recall campaign AMA9 we discovered that the chassis geometry on the rear axle has deviated in some cases.
porsche.remedy: The chassis setting on the affected vehicles must be checked and corrected if necessary.

porsche.defect: IMPROVE THE ENGINE CONTROL SYSTEM IN TERMS OF NITROGEN OXIDE EMISSIONS Improve the engine control system in terms of nitrogen oxide emissions.
porsche.remedy: Engine control software will be updated.

posilock.defect: FILLER NECK SEAL MAY LEAK The sealing arrangement within the filler neck may be distorted and allow fuel to leak. This may be noticeable as wetting  or a small volume within the dust cap. It is more likely to be noticeable immediately after filling.
posilock.remedy: On affected vehicles check poppet valve and where necessary replace.

pownall.defect: TRAILER BRAKES MAY NOT APPLY Parking brake may not apply when manually operated or when red line is disconnected
pownall.remedy: When likely to be affected vehicles are presented for routine maintenance the Pownall Trailer Park Brake Control valve is to be replaced with a modified version.

prestige.defect: DISC MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION As a result of excessive brake disc thickness variation it is possible that when braking heavily from very high speeds (in excess of 100mph) the brakes may judder and the vehicle may develop a wobble.
prestige.remedy: Recall the potentially affected brake discs and exchange for quality assured units.

priden.defect: ANTI-SPILL VALVE FLAP MAY FAIL TO PREVENT FUEL BACK-FLOW The fuel cap seal effectiveness may be compromised by the flap retention spring and fuel may leak in the event of a vehicle rolling over.
priden.remedy: Depending on assembly carry out modifications to the sealing arrangement as specified by the manufacturer.

prorail.defect: SHOCK ABSORBER UPPER MOUNTING FAILURE The shock absorber top bracket may fail leading to a deterioration in handling quality
prorail.remedy: The affected trailers are being recalled for strengthening of the shock absorber top brackets.

proton.defect: BATTERY HARNESS TIE BAND NEEDS REROUTING The battery harness may not be sufficiently secured. There is a chance if not noticed during servicing that the insulation of the harness could chaff and expose the wiring. This could then generate sparks and excessive heat within the engine bay.
proton.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and where necessary fit an extra cable securing band.

proton.defect: STARTER MOTOR RELAY The starter relay may allow the starter motor to operate independently of the ignition switch. In extreme cases this could lead to the movement of the vehicle if left in gear or a fire hazard.
proton.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured starter motor relay.

proton.defect: LEAKAGE FROM FUEL TANK As a consequence of broken or missing spot welds leakage from the fuel tank may occur at the fuel pump mounting flange.
proton.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of the fuel tanks. Where any spot welds are broken or missing the fuel tank will be replaced.

proton.defect: SUSPENSION STABILISER BAR MAY BREAK The front suspension stabiliser bar may break which can adversely affect the driving stability and handling of the car.
proton.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit a quality assured replacement stabiliser bar.

proton.defect: JACK MAY FAIL DURING WHEEL CHANGE In certain loaded conditions the vehicle jack may fail causing the vehicle to drop during a wheel change operation.
proton.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the existing jack with one of a new design.

proton.defect: WHEEL MAY DETACH The rear wheel bearings may fail causing axle spindle breakage. In extreme circumstances the wheel may become detached.
proton.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to improve manufacture and assembly of rear wheel hub.

proton.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF ENGINE POWER The target wheel may give the ECU a false misfire signal. In extreme cases this could lead to a loss of engine power and poor driveability.
proton.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace target wheel with a rigid target wheel (without damper) and the control unit and keys.

proton.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the replacement of the Clock Spring and associated wiring.

q'straint.defect: WHEELCHAIR SECUREMENT Retractor may not lock as designed Affected retractors may intermittently fail to auto-lock when a wheelchair is installed at a seating position equipped with an affected retractor. If this should occur a wheelchair may be inadequately restrained and the wheelchair occupant could be injured in the event of a crash.
q'straint.remedy: Affected retractors will be replaced with a free replacement retractor.

q'straint.remedy: Affected retractors will be replaced with a free replacement retractor.

quadzilla.defect: RH HANDLEBAR SWITCH ASSY REPLACEMENT — CFORCE 850/1000 TOURING On affected vehicles the throttle lever may not fully return to the idle position.
quadzilla.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the handlebar switch assembly replaced.

quadzilla.defect: CF2025-003R REAR TIRE REPLACEMENT- 700MT CFMOTO has become aware of a safety-related issue affecting the rear tire on some 700MT motorcycles. This tyre may be inadequate for some severe off-road conditions. Damage from intense impacts or extended riding with low tire pressure could lead to tire failure during riding a potentially hazardous situation. Therefore CFMOTO is issuing a Safety Recall to address this concern
quadzilla.remedy: A newly optimized tire has been developed featuring higher-strength steel cord and enhanced toughness. All on-hand (affected) inventory must have this rear tire replaced prior to sale or delivery to customers. Owners of sold (affected) units must be contacted as soon as possible to replace the rear tire.

quadzilla.defect: RH HANDLEBAR SWITCH ASSY REPLACEMENT — CFORCE 850/1000 TOURING On affected vehicles the throttle lever may not fully return to the idle position.
quadzilla.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the handlebar switch assembly replaced.

raleigh.defect: HANDLEBAR POST MAY CRACK It has been identified that due to a combination of inaccurate machining and inconsistent material quality the handlebar radius hinge may fail. Should this occur a fall hazard would be present for the rider.
raleigh.remedy: Recalled machines will have the radius handlebar post replaced as necessary.

rally.defect: STEERING ARM MAY FAIL These components are of a fabricated design which were originally designed and manufactured by a company called RACELEDA who have now ceased trading. They can be identified by their Gold Zinc passive finish. It is possible that the welds on the fabricated steering arm can under certain circumstances fail which can lead to loss of directional control.
rally.remedy: To overcome this concern Rally Design Ltd originally a retail supplier of these arm and independent of RACELEDA are contacting all recipients of these components and offering free of charge a new improved drop forged replacement arm. Rally Design Ltd are not obliged to take this action but are doing so because they believe that their customer and public safety is paramount.

renault.defect: FIFTH WHEEL SUBFRAME MOUNTING BOLTS INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED It has been identified that during production the fifth wheel sub-frame mounting bolts were not tightened to the correct torque.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked for the correct torque.

renault.defect: LOSS OF STEERING Risk of losing steering due to the incorrect tightness of the universal joint fixing screw.
renault.remedy: Retighten screw if required to the correct torque and paint mark on screw and the clamp

renault.defect: RISK OF A FAULT IN THE TRAILER COUPLING SOCKET DUE TO INCORRECT POSITIONING OF THE GROUND WIRE POTENTIALLY CAUSING THE LIGHTS ON THE TRAILER TO NOT FUNCTION Risk of a fault in the trailer coupling socket due to incorrect positioning of the ground wire potentially causing the lights on the trailer to not function.
renault.remedy: Cutting the existing ground wire and creating a mechanical splice for adding a ground wire using a specific realignment kit.

renault.defect: EGR PIPE MAY CRACK AND ALLOW EXHAUST GASES TO LEAK It has been identified that during production the EGR pipe has been manufactured from incorrect thickness material. Due to the affect of stresses i.e. heat vibration etc on the pipe it can lead to cracking. If there is significant crack there is a possibility exhaust gases could leak. This could cause surrounding parts to deteriorate. If this happens the vehicle will emit black smoke from the exhaust there will be a loss of power and a warning light will illuminate on the instrument panel.
renault.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace to the EGR pipe.

renault.defect: DRIVERS SEAT MAY DETACH Due to the non-conformity of some welds under situations of extreme braking the driver's seat may detach from the floor fixing.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject welds and fixing lugs re-welded.

renault.defect: BALL JOINT MAY DETACH FROM TIE ROD The tie rod may separate from the ball joint which could result in loss of directional control.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new tie rods.

renault.defect: PREHEATER MAY CATCH FIRE It has been identified on a pre series vehicle that the fuel pre-heater may over heat with the result that a fire might ensue.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pre-heater circuit connected and a heat insulator fitted.

renault.defect: FRONT PASSENGER SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER MAY NOT TRIGGER IN AN IMPACT It has been identified that the front passenger seatbelt pretensioner has not been configured correctly. In the event of an impact the pretensioner will not trigger. The front seat passenger will however still be retained by the seatbelt but without the pretensioner function.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front passenger seatbelt configured.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: STOP LIGHT FAILURE Under particular circumstances of use the potential exists for the stop light switch to melt due to overheating of the grease in the circuit switches with the potential for coking of the contacts. This can result in failure of the stop lights and overheating at the pedal floor or smoke in the passenger compartment.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the stop light switch replaced.

renault.defect: REAR SUSPENSION SPRING EYE BOLT MAY FAIL It has been identified that the rear axle suspension spring hanger bracket bolt may not have been tightened to the correct specification. This can result in the bolt/nut loosing its torque which can result in the failure of the spring eye bolt. This could then affect the stability of the vehicle.
renault.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the rear axle suspension spring hanger/spring eye bolt and replace if required.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT. Emissions control component could degrade earlier than expected
renault.remedy: Replace the silencer module

renault.defect: SEATBELT MAY FAIL There is a possible issue with the security of the lower seat belt mounting bolt which could cause it to loosen. If this were to occur then the bolt could ultimately fully unwind and detach. This could result in the occupant not being restrained by the seat belt in the event of a collision.
renault.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the lower seat belt mounting bolts.

renault.defect: OIL MAY LEAK FROM FILTER HOUSING It has been identified that there exixts a sustatial risk of leakage from the engine oil filter housing.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the functionality of the oil sprayer ramp and supply valve checked and if necessary replace filter housing.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE RESTRICTION IN HYDRAULIC BRAKING SYSTEM There is a possibility of a restriction in a plastic double pipe union on the brake master cylinder. This could prevent or reduce the operation of the hydraulic braking circuit.
renault.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the plastic union examined for evidence of any restriction. If a restriction is found the plastic pipe union will be replaced with a quality assured version.

renault.defect: BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER ATTACHMENT Due to the effect of corrosion on the aluminium spacer at the master cylinder mounting it is possible for the brake master cylinder to detach from the airpac unit rendering one half of the service brake system inoperative.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a re-designed spacer to the brake master cylinder mounting.

renault.defect: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCTION IN VACUUM SERVO ASSISTANCE A specific batch of vacuum pumps may have a potential defect (blockage) which may cause a reduction in servo assistance.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace vacuum pump.

renault.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL It has been identified that the possibility exists that the stop for the foot brake pedal collapse system is missing. This can result in the loss of braking efficiency when the brake pedal is at full travel.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for the presence of the brake pedal collapse system stop and where this is found to be missing the brake pedal will be replaced.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE DEVIATION IN THE TORQUE VALUE ON THE REAR RIGHT SUSPENSION BLADE U BOLT Possible of deviation in the torque value on the U bolt for the rear right suspension blade
renault.remedy: Check and adjust and if necessary replace the rear axle suspension U bolts.

renault.defect: SOME STEERING SHAFTS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT COMPONENT Some steering shafts were assembled with an incorrect component.
renault.remedy: Inspect the steering shaft identification number and replace the shaft if necessary.

renault.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the possibility exists that the handbrake cable intermediate connector may break. Should this occur the handbrake function would be lost.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the handbrake intermediate connector replaced.

renault.defect: REAR SHELF MAY DETACH It is possible that the rear body shelf fixing may not be secured to the vehicle sufficiently. This may lead to the detachment of the shelf and place other road users at risk.
renault.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and fit additional fixings.

renault.defect: SIDE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY OR THEY MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY The airbag computer (ECU) incorrectly interprets the data provided by the lateral shock sensors and can reverse it. In the event of a side impact that is severe enough to cause side air bag deployment  there is a risk of either non-deployment or activation of the airbags on the opposite side to the impact
renault.remedy: On affected vehicles re-programme of the airbag ECU

renault.defect: REAR WHEEL COULD DETACH It is possible that the rear wheel bearing was damaged whilst it was assembled onto the stub axle.  This could result in bearing failure and the detachment of the wheel and hub.
renault.remedy: Replace rear wheel bearing and hub carrier.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK Under certain circumstances the fuel filter outlet pipe union may contact the heating element fitted to the fuel filter body. This will result in a short circuit with possible fire risk.
renault.remedy: Recall the subject vehicles for the inclusion of a fuse link in the fuel filter heating element circuit and the fitment of a clip to ensure that the filter outlet pipe union is held clear of the element body.

renault.defect: STOP LIGHT FAILURE Under particular circumstances of use the potential exists for the stop light switch to melt due to overheating of the grease in the circuit switches with the potential for coking of the contacts. This can result in failure of the stop lights and overheating at the pedal floor or smoke in the passenger compartment.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the stop light switch replaced.

renault.defect: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING IN THE EMS Error in emission control readings.
renault.remedy: Carry out update to EMS and SW software.

renault.defect: ENGINE POWER AND/OR BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On affected vehicles the drive to brake vacuum pump may fail. This may cause a loss of brake servo assistance and a hard brake pedal. It may also cause a reduction in engine power.
renault.remedy: Check the manufacture date of the vacuum pump and where necessary replace the pump.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE SPONTANEOUS RELEASE OF PARKING BRAKE A batch of vehicles has been identified where the parking brake pawl teeth have been incorrectly formed and are of insufficient depth. This may result in damage to the pawl teeth as well as those on the handbrake ratchet and could permit spontaneous release
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the parking brake ratchet and pawl mechanisms with quality assured components. This recall supersedes former campaign R1992/17 since Renault have decided to replace the ratchet and pawl mechanisms on

renault.defect: RISK OF FIRE IN CAB The possibility exists that due to an electrical overload within the ECU of the night heater there is a risk of a fire within the cab.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a supplementary fused wiring harness fitted.

renault.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE The prop shaft to axle flange bolts may not be tightened to the correct torque. The condition could develop noise and vibration and if not corrected loss of drive.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to either re torque the prop shaft to axle flange mounting bolts or where necessary replace the nuts and bolts and apply the correct torque.

renault.defect: STUB AXLE FAILURE Possible fracture of the stub axle(s) on high mileage passenger carrying vehicles. This could result in loss of the wheel and hub assembly with attendant loss of vehicle control and braking effort on one brake circuit.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the stub axle during normal routine servicing or repair with new units incorporating a revised heat treatment requirement.

renault.defect: AUTO BRAKE ADJUSTER BALL PIN BREAKAGE The Auto brake adjuster may fail allowing the brake adjustment to wind off.
renault.remedy: Replace the automatic brake adjuster housing on the calliper of each affected wheel.

renault.defect: AUTO BRAKE ADJUSTER BALL PIN BREAKAGE The Auto brake adjuster may fail allowing the brake adjustment to wind off.
renault.remedy: Replace the automatic brake adjuster housing on the calliper of each affected wheel.

renault.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED The injection computer requires reprogramming. If this is not carried out reduced braking assistance may be noticed
renault.remedy: Preventive operation: 1. Reprogramme the injection computer; 2. Reconfigure the UPC computer.

renault.defect: CRACKED WHEEL HUB** Cracked R/H/F hub carrier.  This has the potential risk of the hub carrier rupturing.
renault.remedy: Replacement of the hub carrier.

renault.defect: ENGINE SPEED CONTROL CONCERNS 1) Accelerator pedal may stick in the open position. (Petrol and diesel engine models). 2) Engine may stall at idle or after hard acceleration. (Diesel engine models).
renault.remedy: 1) Reposition pad at base of accelerator. 2) Repalce the pressure regulator valve on the diesel fuel pump.

renault.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk of corrosion in the steering extension shaft which might affect the steering manoeuvrability. On affected vehicles there is a risk of corrosion in the steering extension shaft which might affect the steering manoeuvrability.
renault.remedy: Replace the steering shaft with a new improved version.

renault.defect: GEARBOX MAY FAIL TO HOLD IN PARK POSITION WHEN VEHICLE IS STATIONARY The gearbox may not hold the vehicle in the park position when the vehicle is stationary (Position �P�). The vehicle may roll if the handbrake is not applied.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the gearbox parking pin.

renault.defect: FAILURE OF ROOF BARS The roof bars may fail when loaded to the limit of their carrying capacity. Failure could result in loss of luggage.
renault.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the original roof bars replaced with quality assured examples.

renault.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY The parking brake cable may not have been assembled correctly which can result in either the inability to apply the parking brake or the inability to release the parking brake.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the parking brake cable.

renault.defect: STEERING COLUMN HOUSING MAY CRACK The steering column housing may crack making the steering wheel adjustment not as expected and/or some control arms may become difficult to use them (indicators headlight control wipers).
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the upper steering column complete with housing  and associated fixings.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF THE FIXED GLASS SUNROOF WHILST DRIVING Possible detachment of the fixed glass sunroof while driving.
renault.remedy: Check the bonding and replace if required replace the fixed glass sunroof.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: FRONT HEAD RESTRAINT MAY NOT RETAIN ITS POSITION IN THE EVENT OF AN IMPACT. It has been identified that the possibility exists that the front seat head restraint components may have been incorrectly welded into position in the seat frame. This in certain cases can cause the sleeve to become loose to the seat frame. This has the potential to prevent the front seat head restraints retaining their position in the event of an impact.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fabrication of the two front seat back frames checked. These will be replaced if found to be necessary.

renault.defect: BONNET MAY OPEN WITHOUT WARNING On a small number of vehicles one or more of the bonnet lock bolts may not be correctly tightened. In exceptional cases this may cause the  bonnet to open whilst driving.
renault.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary tighten  bonnet lock bolts.

renault.defect: SEAT FRAME MAY FAIL The integrity of the front seat bench frame for the passengers may be compromised because of non-compliance during the manufacturing processes. Customer may hear noises coming from underneath the bench. They may also notice some cracking on the seat frame angles. If the seat fails during a collision the passengers have an elevated risk of injury.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the seat frame. Replace the seat where necessary.

renault.defect: WIPERS MAY NOT PERFORM AS INTENDED In sub-zero weather conditions the front windscreen blades arms may become frozen to the screen. In extreme circumstances when the wipers are activated the wiper arm linkage may weaken detach or bend.  Should the linkage break or bend the wipers will not clear the screen effectively.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the wiper linkage with a more robustly designed linkage.

renault.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY LOOSEN It is possible for the servo mounting bolts to loosen. If the noises are ignored over time it is possible for the brakes to be compromised.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the brake pedal/servo mounting nuts.

renault.defect: ACCELERATOR CABLE CONCERN. The accelerator cable may break and cause a sudden loss of engine power.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a modified accelerator cable.

renault.defect: AIR BAG WARNING LIGHT On vehicles equipped with both driver and passenger air bags unscheduled illumination of the air bag warning light may occur in conditions of low ambient temperature.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified computer to the air bag system

renault.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL It has been identified that the  possibility exists that the air suspension leaves of the rear axle may fail. This in the worst case can lead to loss of directional control.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear axle air suspension leaves replaced.

renault.defect: SIDE AIR CURTAIN MAY NOT DEPLOY The curtain airbag (one or both side) may not deploy in the event of a side impact because the pyrotechnic mix ratio in the ignitor could be incorrect..
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the serial number of the curtain airbag. Replace airbag if required.

renault.defect: SEAT BELT MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY The seat belt positioning may be incorrect due to the front seat brackets not being to specification. This could affect the seat security and seat belt performance if an accident occurs.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit new seat assemblies.

renault.defect: CRYSTALLIZATION IN SILENCER AND ACTIVE MIL WITH ENGINE DERATE Crystallization in silencer and active MIL with engine derate.
renault.remedy: Update EMS and ACM software.

renault.defect: THE LEFT HAND SIDE SEATBELT BUCKLE (REEL) FIXING BOLT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SET TO CORRECT TORQUE OR MAY BE OR BECOME MISSING The left hand seatbelt fixing bolt may not have been set to the correct torque.
renault.remedy: Check for the presence of the bolt and factory torque confirmation marking. If either are not present replace the bolt.

renault.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL The parking brake control levers on the rear calipers may not be to specification
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the  parking brake control levers on the rear calipers. Where the levers are not to specification replace the calipers.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE POWER ASSISTANCE Non air conditioned Megane and Scenics equipped with K4J or K4M engines with a pre-catalytic convertor fitted may have a hard brake pedal (lack of braking assistance). This is caused by the deterioration of the braking assistance pipe as it passes too close to the source of heat emitted by the pre-catalytic convertor.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace and/or reroute the brake assistance (vacuum) pipe.

renault.defect: WELDING ON FRONT SUSPENSION LOCATING LUG The welding on the front suspension arm locating lug may not be to the manufacturers specification.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and inspect the integrity of the subject welding. Where required the welding will be reworked to comply with the manufacturers specification.

renault.defect: ENGINE POWER AND/OR BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED On affected vehicles the drive to brake vacuum pump may fail. This may cause a loss of brake servo assistance and a hard brake pedal. It may also cause a reduction in engine power.
renault.remedy: Check the manufacture date of the vacuum pump and where necessary replace the pump.

renault.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk of corrosion in the steering extension shaft which might affect the steering manoeuvrability. On affected vehicles there is a risk of corrosion in the steering extension shaft which might affect the steering manoeuvrability.
renault.remedy: Replace the steering shaft with a new improved version.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF SPARE WHEEL The spare wheel winch cable may seize or break and allow the wheel to fall onto the road.
renault.remedy: Fit a modified spare wheel support cross member and winch unit.

renault.defect: OVERHEATING OF IGNITION WIRING CONNECTORS Quality inspections by the manufacturer have revealed the possibility of a faulty connection between the high tension leads and the ignition coil. The connector could overheat if not replaced.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the ignition harness and ignition coil.

renault.defect: RISK OF A FUEL LEAK IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT Risk of a fuel leak in the engine compartment.
renault.remedy: Inspect and install protection to the fuel pipe or replace the fuel pipe if damaged

renault.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK A fuel leak could occur at the fuel pressure sensor to injector rail seal due to a non conformance of production methods. If the leak occurs a smell will be noticed by the occupants of the vehicle.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and re-tighten the fuel pressure sensor to a specified higher torque value.

renault.defect: RUBBER CAP ON SERVICE BRAKE AIR TANKS EBS VALUES AND TRAILER AIR BRAKE TANK MIGHT BE MISSING The rubber caps on the service brake air tanks EBS valves and trailer brake air tanks might be missing
renault.remedy: Check rubber caps are assembled and if found to be missing fit caps as required

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Degradation of emissions control component.
renault.remedy: Replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that the possibility exists that the front brakes hoses may become disconnected resulting in a loss of brake hydraulic fluid and a reduction in braking efficiency.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have both front brake hoses replaced.

renault.defect: INCORRECT CRIMPING OF REAR HUB BEARING NUT It is possible that the rear axle wheel bearing securing nut may not be correctly crimped. This could result in the slackening of the torque on the bearing and possible in extreme conditions detachment of the hub assembly. Warning of the issue is provided to the driver in the form of either a vibration or the illumination of the ABS warning light.
renault.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the bearing securing nut.

renault.defect: STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY A risk exists that the steering column intermediate shaft has been incorrectly fitted.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the position of the mounting yolk of the intermediate shaft checked and modified as necessary.

renault.defect: DIPPED HEADLIGHT MAY FAIL TO LIGHT THE ROAD AHEAD TO SUFFICIENT LEVEL Headlight (dipped beam) may not adjust correctly when switched on and therefore not light the road ahead sufficiently.
renault.remedy: On affected vehicles make an adjustment of the headlight beam sensor.

renault.defect: HOT COOLANT MAY ENTER PASSENGER COMPARTMENT There is a risk of scalding to occupants of the front seats as a result of hot coolant leaking from the heater matrix into the passenger compartment.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of the heater matrix. Where this is found to be of an unmodified design (visually apparent) it will be replaced with a modified unit.

renault.defect: BENCH SEAT MAY MOVE FORWARD WITHOUT WARNING The beach seat base mounting screws may break when the bench is repeatedly repositioned to allow a flat load area. Should this happen a noise will be heard from the bench. In exceptional cases if the screw has broken this may cause a loss of protection during an impact.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the vehicle. A metal insert will be fitted between the seatback folding pivot and the mounting screw (left and right). Additionally the mounting screws (left and right) will also be replaced.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Emissions control component could degrade earlier than expected.

renault.defect: ELECTRONIC BOARD CAPACITORS MAY CRACK UNDER MECHANICAL STRESS Capacitors for the engine cooling fan assembly do not comply with specification.

renault.defect: SOME STEERING SHAFTS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT COMPONENT Some steering shafts were assembled with an incorrect component.

renault.defect: RISK OF ENGINE WIRING LOOM SHORT CIRCUIT It has been identified that the risk of a short circuit exists between individual wires of the engine wiring loom.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the engine wiring loom checked for condition and wear and will proceed as follows. If no wiring cores are visible a protective sheath will be fitted to the wiring loom. If the core of one or more of the wires is visible the wiring loom will be replaced.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL Wear in the area of the support bearings may lead to failure of the primary steering shaft and cause loss of directional control.
renault.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the original shaft replaced with a complete assembly.

renault.defect: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING Improved emission control and monitoring.
renault.remedy: Update EMS and SW software.

renault.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk of damage to the wiper relay causing the wipers to stop working. On affected vehicles there is a risk of damage to the wiper relay causing the wipers to stop working.
renault.remedy: Update software and replace the relay.

renault.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY It is possible that the front wheel liners have been incorrectly positioned giving potential for them to rub against the front brake hoses.  This in turn could in rare circumstances cause increased brake pedal travel and affect the braking efficiency of the vehicle.  This issue may be highlighted by a warning message Braking system fault and a warning light on the dashboard.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the front wheel arch liners and brake hoses.  If they are found to be incorrectly positioned they will be replaced free of charge.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE RESTRICTION IN HYDRAULIC BRAKING SYSTEM There is a possibility of a restriction in a plastic double pipe union on the brake master cylinder. This could prevent or reduce the operation of the hydraulic braking circuit.
renault.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the plastic union examined for evidence of any restriction. If a restriction is found the plastic pipe union will be replaced with a quality assured version.

renault.defect: REAR BOLTS ON FRONT SEAT RUNNER MAY NOT BE TORQUED CORRECTLY The bolts that hold the front seats to the floor may not be correctly tightened. This may cause the seat to become insecure and control of the vehicle to be compromised. Prior to failure there will be increased movement of the seat when getting in and out of the vehicle which should be noticeable to the driver.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary adjust  the torque tightening of the rear bolts on the front seat runners.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Degradation of emissions control component.
renault.remedy: Replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: On affected vehicles the driver and passenger airbag and seatbelt pre-tensioners may not deploy. On affected vehicles the driver and passenger airbag and seatbelt pre-tensioners may not deploy.�
renault.remedy: Replace the airbag collision sensors.�

renault.defect: SIDE AIR BAG CONCERN The electrical connections to the side air bags may be transposed.  This could result in the air bag on the opposite side to an impact being deployed.
renault.remedy: Check side air bag wiring for transposed connections and correct where necessary.

renault.defect: THERE IS A POTENTIAL FOR THE INTERNAL AGGRESSION IN THE FUEL HOSE CAUSING A FUEL LEAK There is a potential for the internal aggression in the fuel hose causing a fuel leak.
renault.remedy: Replace the fuel supple pipe

renault.defect: RISK OF UNINTENDED ACCELERATION Due to an error in the engine ECU software it is possible that the vehicle will suffer an unintended acceleration or not able to decelerate. The driver should still be able to control the vehicle by applying the brakes and manipulating the clutch and gears.
renault.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to reprogram the engine ECU with new software.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERTENT DEPLOYMENT OF BOTH AIRBAGS The computer which controls the deployment of the Airbags may be incorrectly programmed. The Airbags may inadvertently deploy.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and change the computer which controls the deployment of the Airbags.

renault.defect: SEATBELTS MAY MALFUNCTION IN A COLLISION Due to an error in the manufacturing process the seat belt buckle may not retain the belt during a frontal impact.
renault.remedy: On affected vehicles check build date of seat belt assembly and replace if necessary.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Degradation of emissions control component.
renault.remedy: Replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: With an active EBS DTC EBS yellow tell-tale is displayed instead of EBS red tell-tale With an active EBS DTC EBS yellow tell-tale is displayed instead of EBS red tell-tale.
renault.remedy: Update MID140 software

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: Possible abrasion wear of the fuel supply pipe On affected vehicles there is a possibility of abrasive wear of the fuel supply line. This can cause one or several possible effects:  Fuel odour in the passenger compartment High fuel consumption Fuel leak in the engine compartment visible under the vehicle Risk of fire.
renault.remedy: Check the fuel pipe and replace if required. All affected vehicles will be fitted with a mounting clip to protect the fuel pipe.

renault.defect: VECU SOFTWARE UPDATE On affected vehicles the accelerator pedal calibration is not working correctly which can cause the vehicle to accelerate at brake pedal release when selecting drive or reverse.
renault.remedy: Update the accelerator pedal software.

renault.defect: VECU SOFTWARE UPDATE On affected vehicles the accelerator pedal calibration is not working correctly which can cause the vehicle to accelerate at brake pedal release when selecting drive or reverse.
renault.remedy: Update the accelerator pedal software.

renault.defect: REAR AXLE STUB AXLE CHECK On affected vehicles the rear stub axle material is not compliant to hardness specification. There is a risk the stub axle could break while driving.
renault.remedy: Check the stub axle for cracks and replace if necessary.

renault.defect: C0446 Traction Battery Replace & C0485 Traction Battery repair There is a risk that a small metal piece from a broken terminal fixation might come loose and create a short circuit between battery cells inside the traction battery which might lead to overheating. There will be a red warning in the instrument cluster to the driver if a short-circuit is detected inside the battery before the battery overheats.
renault.remedy: Replace Traction batteries

renault.defect: C0446 Traction Battery Replace & C0485 Traction Battery repair There is a risk that a small metal piece from a broken terminal fixation might come loose and create a short circuit between battery cells inside the traction battery which might lead to overheating. There will be a red warning in the instrument cluster to the driver if a short-circuit is detected inside the battery before the battery overheats.
renault.remedy: Replace Traction batteries

renault.defect: REDUCER SUPPORTCHECK/REPLACE On affected vehicles the electric motor support bracket screws could break allowing the electric motor to fall with risk of rupturing the power steering hydraulic hose resulting in a loss of steering power assistance.
renault.remedy: Replacing fixing screws and support where necessary.

renault.defect: Accelerator Pedal Assembley For certain vehicles the end-stop breaking force of the accelerator pedal is lower than the intended technical specification. This may lead to a rupture of the accelerator pedal assembly if the pedal is pressed vigorously.
renault.remedy: Replacement of the accelerator pedal assembly.

renault.defect: Traction Battery – Check/replace C0346 Affected vehicles will not start and the traction battery cannot be recharged.
renault.remedy: Check and change the traction battery if required.

renault.defect: EMS/ECM and SOFTWARE ROLLBACK On affected vehicles there is a risk that the silencer may overheat when performing a regeneration which may result in a thermal event if there is excessive soot accumulated inside it
renault.remedy: Install modified software.

renault.defect: UDS Pump. Replace On affected vehicles there is a possible fault with the UDS Ad Blue pump which might cause it to lose efficiency and lead to the vehicle emissions being non-compliant.
renault.remedy: Change the UDS pump for a modified version.

renault.defect: Airbag Sensors C0340 On affected vehicles airbag sensors and brackets were not fitted on production.  The airbags and seatbelt pre-tensioners will not be activated when needed.
renault.remedy: Fit the missing components.

renault.defect: ACTUAL ENGINE SPEED CAN DIFFER FROM SPEED REQUESTED BY THE DRIVER In certain cases the risk exists that there may be a faulty contact between the accelerator pedal sensor and the injection computer. In such cases the SERV warning light will illuminate on the dashboard.The situation remains under control by simply by applying the brake pedal.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will undergo preventive reprogramming of the injection computer

renault.defect: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING IN THE EMS Error in emission control readings.
renault.remedy: Update Engine Management System (EWS) software.

renault.defect: DOOR SECURITY CONCERN Customers may find that they are unable to secure the front and side doors of their vehicles due to wear of the locking bolt due to omission of heat treatment.
renault.remedy: Rectified by replacing both the front and side door locks.

renault.defect: REAR LEFT HAND SEAT BELT MOUNTING MAY FAIL The near side rear seat belt upper mounting bolt may not have been tightened to the correct specification. In the event of an accident the belt may be insecure and not act as intended.
renault.remedy: On affected vehicles tighten bolt to correct specification

renault.defect: VEHICLE REAR LIGHTING SYSTEMS MAY FAIL There is a possibility that the rear lights may cease to function due to the wiring insulation being abraded on a roof lining angle bracket. If the rear lights cease to function there is an increased risk of collision as other road users are not warned of vehicle; position directional intent or braking intent. Warnings for the driver can be gained from acrid smell indicator tell-tale flashing faster than normal and other electrical items in the rear not working.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the wiring. In all cases protection for the wiring will be fitted.

renault.defect: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING Improved emission control and monitoring.
renault.remedy: Update EMS and SW software.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: WHEEL MAY DETACHED The wheel retaining nuts may not have been tightened top the correct specification during assembly.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles; Check and if necessary tighten wheel nuts to correct specification.

renault.defect: POTENTIAL FUEL LEAKS There is a risk of the diesel return pipe rubbing against the alternator and there is a risk of leakage from the connections of the high pressure pipes to the injectors. It is possible that the high pressure pump supply pipe may wear against the acoustic protector.
renault.remedy: Reposition or replace any chafing fuel pipes as appropriate. Check the union connections for correct tightness on the high pressure pipes to the injectors.

renault.defect: FLEXIBLE FRONT BRAKE LINES MAY BE LOCATED TOO CLOSE TO THE FRONT BRAKE DISKS. In certain cases the front brake flexible hoses may be located too close to the front discs and become worn through contact with them. This poses the risk of a deterioration of brake performance.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the front brake flexible hose retaining brackets replaced.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE ENGINE FAILURE / RISK OF FIRE On affected vehicles the turbocharger induction pipe may fail allowing oil to leak. Vehicle users may notice a drop in oil level which should also cause the oil warning lamp to illuminate. This may lead to engine failure and In extreme cases a risk of fire.
renault.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the turbocharger oil induction pipe.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSION CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Emissions control component could degrade earlier than expected.
renault.remedy: Replace the silencer module

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Degradation of emissions control component.
renault.remedy: Replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer

renault.defect: INCORRECT WELDING OF THE CATALYTIC CONVERTOR Incorrect welding of the catalytic convertor.
renault.remedy: Check the welding of the catalytic converter and replace it if necessary.

renault.defect: CHAFING OF FOG LAMP WIRING LOOM The left hand fog light wiring loom may chafe in the area of the towing eye. This could cause a short circuit with possible risk of fire.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the condition of the loom adjacent to the towing eye. Where contact damage has occurred this will be repaired and in all cases the wiring loom will be protected by the addition of a foam rubber block

renault.defect: BENCH BELT MAY NOT PERFORM AS INTENDED Under excessive force to the belt the lock ring in the passenger seat belt retractor might break and the belt could become extendable. This will increase the risk of injury during a collision.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the passenger seat belt retractor and support.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE BREAKAGE OF FRONT SUSPENSION ARM. Due to a manufacturing defect there is a potential risk of the front right or left suspension arm breaking if subjected to an impact.
renault.remedy: Check the manufacturing markings on the suspension arms and replace where found necessary.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Emissions control component could degrade earlier than expected.
renault.remedy: Replace the silencer module

renault.defect: FRONT STABILISER BAR BRACKETS CONCERN The front suspension stabiliser bar brackets may fracture.
renault.remedy: Replace both front stabiliser bar brackets.

renault.defect: STEERING MAY BE ADVERSELY AFFECTED The customer may experience vibrations or noise from the steering wheel due to cracks starting in the steering wheel hub. If not rectified in the worst case over time the steering wheel could break and affect the directional control of the vehicle.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check of the manufacturing date of the steering wheel hub. The steering wheel hub will be replaced it if the date is inside the identified period.

renault.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL It has been identified that the  possibility exists that the air suspension leaves of the rear axle may fail. This in the worst case can lead to loss of directional control.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear axle air suspension leaves replaced.

renault.defect: OVER HEATING OF AN INTERNAL COMPONENT IN THE ELECTRIC POWER STEERING Overheating of an internal component in the Electric Power Steering.
renault.remedy: Recalibration of the Electronic Power Steering Calculator limiting the overheating at the end lock.

renault.defect: GEARBOX MAY MALFUNCTION Possible malfunction of the gearbox control causing: 1. Gearbox switching to manual mode without driver intervention; 2. gearbox changing to 3rd gear without driver intervention; 3.incorrect display of lever position on the instrument panel; 4. Auto gearbox warning light illuminates.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the automatic transmission computer.

renault.defect: REAR WHEEL BEARING MAY SHEAR It is possible that the rear wheel bearing has been damaged whilst it was assembled onto the stub axle.  This should be identified by excessive noise however in the worst case if not detected it could result in bearing failure and the detachment of the wheel and hub.
renault.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the wheel bearings with new items which will have protective sleeves to aid correct installation.

renault.defect: CONTACT BETWEEN THE POSITIVE ALTERNATOR WIRING AND THE ALTERNATOR CASING COULD CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT Contact between the positive alternator wiring and the alternator casing which could cause an electrical short circuit.
renault.remedy: Modify the wiring route and if necessary replace the alternator

renault.defect: ENGINE HESITATION AND IDLING CONCERN Vehicles fitted with 1.4 16v engines and having the MGI motorised throttle housing and Sirius 34 injection computer may have engine hesitation and idling speed instability. This due to incorrect locking of the connector to the throttle housing causing instability in the operation of the injection system.
renault.remedy: Rectified by replacing the motorised throttle housing connector.

renault.defect: LOSS OF STEERING Risk of losing steering due to the incorrect tightness of the universal joint fixing screw.
renault.remedy: Retighten screw if required to the correct torque and paint mark on screw and the clamp

renault.defect: SEATBELT MAY BECOME STUCK DUE TO INCORRECT FITTING OF THE REEL HOUSING Rear seatbelt may become stuck due to incorrect fitting of the reel housing.
renault.remedy: Check the fitting of the seat belt inertia reel housings and adjust as required.

renault.defect: SUSPENSION TURRET MAY FAIL The suspension turret panel may fail due to inadequate welding being applied at the factory.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply further weld to the nearside inner wing suspension turret.

renault.defect: LOCKING OF FRONT SEAT PIVOT MECHANISM The front seat pivoting mechanism may not operate correctly. This may lead to imprecise locking of the front seats which under certain driving conditions may have safety implications if the driving seat is not retained in the normal driving mo
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for replacement of the seat pivot flange and the fitment of an additional ring washer on both front seats.

renault.defect: SOME STEERING SHAFTS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT COMPONENT Some steering shafts were assembled with an incorrect component.
renault.remedy: Inspect the steering shaft identification number and replace the shaft if necessary.

renault.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE It has been identified that a potential loss of engine cooling fan function (cooling fan number 2) will cause the engine to seize without warning due to overheating. The STOP warning light may or may not illuminate.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have front-end wiring replaced.

renault.defect: OUTER SKIN OF REAR SPOILER AND BONNET MAY DETACH Operations 1) or 2) or operations 1) and 2) could be required: 1) The upper part of the bonnet (the bonnet skin) may detach from the rest of the bonnet due to poor adhesive being applied at the factory and deterioration over time. There would be no obvious signs to the customer. 2) The outer part (skin) of the rear spoiler may detach from the vehicle and /or the pins on the glass tailgate. There would be no warning to the customer.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and add re-enforcement to the spoiler and/or bonnet or both as required.

renault.defect: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING IN THE EMS Error in emission control readings.
renault.remedy: Update Engine Management System (EWS) software.

renault.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF CONTROL The front shock absorber (strut) mounting for the anti-roll bar rod may not be welded correctly. If the welding should fail there will initially be noise leading to the possibility for adversely affected vehicle handling because the anti-roll bar will no longer be connected the risk of contact and damage to the wheel rim tyre brake hose and ABS cable.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the shocker absorber (strut) build dates. The shock absorber that are in the affected range will be replaced.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE UNSCHEDULED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG The air bag control electrical wiring attached to the drivers swivelling seat may become damaged and cause unscheduled deployment of the drivers' air bag.
renault.remedy: Examine wiring for damage and re-route and secure as necessary

renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will undergo preventive reprogramming of the injection computer

renault.defect: BRAKING FUNCTION MAY BE COMPROMISED It has been identified that due to a quality issue the T Valve within the brake systems may develop a leak. The compressor should be able to keep up with this leak and the driver should be made aware of the issue. However the brake system pressure will be reduced which will potently affect the brake efficiency of the vehicle.
renault.remedy: Replace all affected vehicles and check the valve numbers. If found to be within the affected batch replace with a new quality assured valve.

renault.defect: REAR BENCH SEATBELT BUCKLE BOLTS MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY TIGHTENED Rear bench seatbelt buckle bolts may not be correctly tightened.
renault.remedy: Check the buckle bolts are at the correct torque.

renault.defect: Rear door hinges For certain vehicles there is an issue involving the conformity of the four hinges of the rear doors for where a missing shaft cannot be ruled out.
renault.remedy: Inspect the hinges and if required replace.

renault.defect: Automatic Front Seat “Easy Access” Function When the  easy access function is used on the front seats they may move and come in to contact with someone in the rear passenger seat possibility causing injury.
renault.remedy: As a preventive measure the remedy consists of updating the configuration files of the front seats' computers.

renault.defect: Checking the secure mounting of the reducer gearbox. On affected vehicles there is a potential risk the electrical powertrain may not be secured correctly.
renault.remedy: Check and change the electric traction reducer mounting if necessary.

renault.defect: Risk of parking brake actuator failing For certain vehicles a concern involving the electric traction reducer parking brake mechanism actuator or gearbox engagement actuator within the transmission may result in the parking brake mechanism actuator no longer correctly positioning the locking pawl in the “P lock”.
renault.remedy: Replacement of the electric traction reducer parking brake mechanism actuator or gearbox Engagement Actuator.

renault.defect: Risk of parking brake actuator failing For certain vehicles a concern involving the electric traction reducer parking brake mechanism actuator or gearbox engagement actuator within the transmission may result in the parking brake mechanism actuator no longer correctly positioning the locking pawl in the “P lock”.
renault.remedy: Replacement of the electric traction reducer parking brake mechanism actuator or gearbox Engagement Actuator.
