renault.remedy: Replacement of the electric traction reducer parking brake mechanism actuator or gearbox Engagement Actuator.

renault.defect: C0456 Gear selector switch  replace On affected vehicles there is a risk of premature wear inside the gear selector switch. This could lead to the vehicle decelerating and moving backwards unintentionally without any command by the driver.
renault.remedy: Fit a modified gear selector switch and install updated software.

renault.defect: C0456 Gear selector switch  replace On affected vehicles there is a risk of premature wear inside the gear selector switch. This could lead to the vehicle decelerating and moving backwards unintentionally without any command by the driver.
renault.remedy: Fit a modified gear selector switch and install updated software.

renault.defect: Steering box and the steering column intermediate shaft For affected vehicles there is an issue involving the steering gear in the area of the torque sensor for where damage or cracking cannot be ruled out. The consequences are that loss of assistance or in some cases loss of control.
renault.remedy: Replacement of the the steering box and the steering column intermediate  shaft.

renault.defect: Rear Door Top Door Strikers On certain vehicles the rear swing door strikers have a prominent character.  Injuries may occur when entering or exiting from the rear of the vehicle (e.g. during loading or unloading).
renault.remedy: The preventive measure is the addition of protective covers on the door strikers at the top of the two rear swing doors.

renault.defect: CHILD LOCK DISENGAGES AFTER BEING ACTIVATED The child lock disengages after it was activated by the customer.
renault.remedy: Fit a retaining clip to the door locks.

renault.defect: Error in Handbook for Operation of Window Lock Amendment to the Owners Handbook – Correction of an error in the operating instructions in paragraph 3.22 relating to the operation of the window lifter: incorrect description of  the rear door locking procedure
renault.remedy: Registered keeper will be sent a corrected page

renault.defect: Front lower arm Bolts For certain vehicles and as a preventative measure there is concern involving the locking nuts in the area of the front suspension lower arm ball joints for where loosening of the fixings cannot be ruled out.
renault.remedy: Check of the tightening of the front suspension lower arm ball joint nuts and if necessary replace both nuts

renault.defect: C0544 Rear Axle Hub nut replace There is a combined risk that rear axle hub nuts might have the tightening torque relaxed and the hub might not have been locked looked correctly. In the worst case it could lead the vehicle to lose a rear wheel set on road.
renault.remedy: The current hub nut will be replaced by a new hub nut the specified torque will be applied and the nut will be crimped against the axle housing.

renault.defect: C0515  – Accelerator pedal support replace For certain vehicles there is a concern involving the accelerator pedal for where breakage cannot be ruled out.
renault.remedy: Replacement of the accelerator pedal assembly.

renault.defect: C0500  – IRMU Replace The AC inlet socket and the power outlet for body builder equipment might be incorrectly energized. It happens because these two features are not fully electrically isolated from each other. Therefore in vehicles where AC or DC power outlets are installed there might be voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present inside the AC inlet socket when the power outlet is active. Also when AC charging there might be a voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present on the power outlet .
renault.remedy: Inspection and replacement of the Insulation Resistance Monitoring (IRM) Junction box.

renault.defect: DASHBOARD WIRING MY SHORT CIRCUIT It has been identified that the dashboard wiring hs been mounted incorrectly. This may result in the vehicle failing to start the reversing lights failing to operate the risk of a short circuit of the FRH headlights damage to the wiring and high temperatures.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the dashboard wiring refitted and replaced as necessary.

renault.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT Laguna II's fitted with the 1.6 16v engine may cut out and stall at idle/lift off when the air conditioning is switched on.
renault.remedy: Rectified by recalibrating the injection computer.

renault.defect: CONTACT OF THE FUEL SUPPLY HOSE WITH THE CLYNDER HEAD COVER CAUSING HOSE WEAR Contact of the fuel supply hose with the cylinder head cover causing hose wear.
renault.remedy: Carry out a visual inspection of the fuel supply hose and fit a protective sleeve. If necessary replace the fuel supply hose.

renault.defect: SOME STEERING SHAFTS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT COMPONENT Some steering shafts were assembled with an incorrect component.
renault.remedy: Inspect the steering shaft identification number. Depending on the identification number on the part then the steering shaft may require replacement.

It is possible that the high pressure pump supply pipe may wear against the acoustic protector.
renault.remedy: Reposition or replace any chafing fuel pipes as appropriate. Check the union connections for correct tightness on the high pressure pipes to the injectors.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a risk of a loss of brake servo assistance due to the incorrect positioning of the air pressure sensor in the inlet manifold.
renault.remedy: Check the position of the air pressure sensor and correct where necessary.

renault.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY There is a risk the passenger airbag mounting bolts are incorrectly installed which can lead to the airbag not correctly deploying. If a heavy front end collision occurs the passenger could sustain additional injury.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check for the presence of the bolts and if missing fit new one(s).

renault.defect: INCORRECT THROTTLE PEDAL FITTED An incorrect accelerator pedal may be fitted which could cause discomfort or in extreme circumstances the pedal may get suck under the floor mat.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the accelerator pedal fitted. Replace the pedal where necessary.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: INCORRECT POSITIONING OF WIRING POTENTIALLY CAUSING A RISK OF THE SERVICE INDICATOR OR VEHICLE STOP WARNING LIGHT COMING Incorrect positioning of the wiring causing a risk of the service indicator or vehicle stop warning light coming. The vehicle engine may no longer start or even shut down during use.
renault.remedy: Check the battery wiring replacing it if necessary and in any case protecting it.

renault.defect: GEARBOX MAY DISENGAGE FROM THE PARK POSITION Due to the possible non-conformity of the gearbox control there is a risk that the transmission may disengage from the parking position (without the footbrake having first been applied)
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the conformity of the gearbox control checked and replaced as necessary.

renault.defect: VEHICLE MAY BE EQUIPPED AND FITTED WITH THE INCORRECT REAR RIGHT BRAKE CALIPER Vehicle may be equipped and fitted with the incorrect rear right brake Caliper.
renault.remedy: Visual inspection of the rear right brake Caliper to check the ��date of manufacture�� code. Replace the caliper if affected.

renault.defect: NO ISOFIX MOUNTING RINGS AT REAR OF VEHICLE There is a possibility that there are no Isofix mounting rings at the rear. It is therefore not possible to secure an Isofix child seat in the rear seats nor the luggage net in the boot.

renault.remedy: Update  NOX MOMITOR software.

renault.defect: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING IN THE EMS Error in emission control readings.
renault.remedy: Carry out update to EMS and SW software.

renault.defect: LOSS OF STEERING Risk of losing steering due to the incorrect tightness of the universal joint fixing screw.
renault.remedy: Retighten screw if required to the correct torque and paint mark on screw and the clamp

renault.defect: THE SOLENOID VALVE DOES NOT SWITCH TO THE HIGH OIL PRESSURE POSITION WHEN REQUIRED The oil pressure solenoid valve may not switch correctly.
renault.remedy: Check the solenoid and modify or replace if required

renault.defect: RISK OF TYRE FAILURE Tyres of an incorrect size have been fitted which could result in tyre failure.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to replace the five tyres the spare wheel carrier mountings and reconfigure the ABS computer.

renault.defect: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCTION IN VACUUM SERVO ASSISTANCE A specific batch of vacuum pumps may have a potential defect (blockage) which may cause a reduction in servo assistance.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace vacuum pump.

renault.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE It is possible that the front wheel liners have been incorrectly positioned giving potential for them to rub against the front brake hoses.  This in turn could in rare circumstances cause increased brake pedal travel and affect the braking efficiency of the vehicle.  This issue may be highlighted by a warning message Braking system fault and a warning light on the dashboard.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the front wheel arch liners and brake hoses.  If they are found to be incorrectly positioned they will be replaced free of charge.

renault.defect: VALVE COTTER FAULT COULD LEAD TO DESTRUCTION OF THE ENGINE Possibility that the nonconformance of the valve cotter could lead to the destruction of the engine.
renault.remedy: Replace the cotters on relevant engines

renault.defect: POTENTIAL RISK OF FAILURE TO THE SECONDARY PARKING BRAKE Possible failure of the parking brake due to a non-conformity (crimping) at cable connection ends.
renault.remedy: Replace the secondary cables and connectors.

renault.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY RESULT IN A FIRE It has been identified that there is a risk of contact between the starter motor cable and the exhaust heat shielding. Should this occur and the cable insulation become damaged an electrical short circuit with the attendant risk of fire might ensue.
renault.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the exhaust heat shielding re-shaped to prevent contact with the starter cable.

renault.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL. The rear pneumatic suspension leaves may fail this will result in noise from the suspension and if not rectified may result in loss of directional control.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the replacement of the rear pneumatic suspension leaves.

renault.defect: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCTION IN VACUUM SERVO ASSISTANCE A specific batch of vacuum pumps may have a potential defect (blockage) which may cause a reduction in servo assistance.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace vacuum pump.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT. Emissions control component could degrade earlier than expected
renault.remedy: Replace the silencer module

renault.defect: DRIVERS SEAT MAY NOT LOCK SAFELY It has been identified that the driver's seat may suffer permanent or intermittent non-locking on it's runners. This can occur when the vehicle is stationary or when being driven..
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a latch fitted to the seat's locking device.

renault.defect: RISK OF FIRE It has been identified that the potential exists for the generation of an oil leak caused by the turbo oil supply pipe becoming loose. Should an oil leak from this component occur the possibility exists that a fire could ensue.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the turbo oil supply pipe checked and replaced as necessary.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF FRONT SUSPENSION UPPER MOUNTING The front suspension upper mounting plate cups may crack. Under certain conditions this could affect vehicle handling.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the front suspension upper mounting plates with examples incorporating an alternative metal specification.

renault.defect: AUTO BRAKE ADJUSTER BALL PIN BREAKAGE The Auto brake adjuster may fail allowing the brake adjustment to wind off.
renault.remedy: Replace the automatic brake adjuster housing on the calliper of each affected wheel.

renault.defect: BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED The front wheel arch liners may have been incorrectly positioned which may cause them to rub against the front brake hoses. In rare circumstances this could cause a low leakage from both front flexible brake hose leading to gradual increased brake pedal travel in extreme cases a sudden bursting of the flexible hose with sudden increased brake travel and a resultant affect on the braking efficiency. A warning light indicating a low brake fluid level will be displayed on the dashboard.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the front wheel arch liners and brake hoses. Where necessary reposition the wheel arch liners and replace the brake hose/s.

renault.defect: RISK OF RAPID LOSS OF TYRE PRESSURE There is a possibility of a rapid loss of tyre pressure on Kleber C100 165/70 R14 85 R tyres due to low inner rubber thickness on casing ply cord in tyre shoulder zone. This may affect the vehicle's road holding.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicle's and replace tyres with quality assured tyre.

renault.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY RESULT IN A FIRE It has been identified that there is a risk of contact between the starter motor cable and the exhaust heat shielding. Should this occur and the cable insulation become damaged an electrical short circuit with the attendant risk of fire might ensue.
renault.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the exhaust heat shielding re-shaped to prevent contact with the starter cable.

renault.defect: SOME STEERING SHAFTS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT COMPONENT Some steering shafts were assembled with an incorrect component.
renault.remedy: Inspect the steering shaft identification number and replace the shaft if necessary.

renault.defect: INADEQUATE AIRBAG TRIGGERING IN THE EVENT OF A SIDE IMPACT It has been identified that there has been a left to right inversion of the side impact sensor wiring which in certain cases may result in inadequate deployment of the airbags in the event of a side impact.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the airbag ECU replaced.

renault.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED The protectors for the front brake hoses may have been fitted incorrectly which could in the worst case scenario lead to a reduction in braking efficiency. If there is leakage of brake fluid the warning lamp will illuminate and more effort will have to be applied to the brakes to stop in good time. Additionally there is a possibility that brake fluid may leak from the rear brake cylinders with the same effects as above.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the front brake hoses and protectors. Where necessary reposition or replace the protectors and brake hoses. Replace the fixing dome caps that retain the rear brake shoes to the back plate.

renault.defect: RISK OF FUEL LEAKAGE AT THE FUEL RAIL FEED PIPE Risk of fuel leakage due to incorrect machining of the fuel injection bar.
renault.remedy: Replace the fuel injection bar.

renault.defect: REAR SPOILER MAY DETACH The rear spoiler may detach at high speed due to high variance in temperature change. This is a result of a non-conformity with the production process.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected for inspection and where necessary rebonding.

renault.defect: PETROL SMELL IN CAR Incorrect positioning and/or tightening of the fuel pipe clips on the injection bar may cause petrol fumes or smell in the passenger compartment.
renault.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection. Where the subject pipes have been incorrectly positioned and/or tightened the pipes will be replaced.

renault.defect: DIPPED HEADLIGHT MAY FAIL TO LIGHT THE ROAD AHEAD TO SUFFICIENT LEVEL Headlight (dipped beam) may not adjust correctly when switched on and therefore not light the road ahead sufficiently.
renault.remedy: On affected vehicles make an adjustment of the headlight beam sensor.

renault.defect: The screws for the front axle attachment might lose torque or come loose. On affected vehicles there is a risk that some of the screws that attach the front axle to the suspension may become loose.
renault.remedy: Check screws for the correct torque.

renault.defect: AUTO BRAKE ADJUSTER BALL PIN BREAKAGE The Auto brake adjuster may fail allowing the brake adjustment to wind off.
renault.remedy: Replace the automatic brake adjuster housing on the calliper of each affected wheel.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: FRONT WHEEL HUBS MAY CRACK The front wheel hub may suffer cracking. Drivers may notice abnormal noise and in extreme cases the hub may fail.
renault.remedy: On affected vehicles check manufacturing date of the wheel hubs and replace if required

renault.defect: FUEL LEAK / EMERGENCY BRAKE ASSIST CONCERN. Danger of leakage from the Diesel injection high pressure pipes which can result in destruction of the Emergency Brake Assist connector located on the Brake Booster.
renault.remedy: Replace diesel fuel injection high pressure rail and pipes and Emergency Brake Assist connector seal at Brake Booster Unit.

renault.defect: RISK OF STALLING The engine may stall at idle and/or when lifting off the throttle following a period of hard acceleration.
renault.remedy: Check the serial number on the fuel pressure regulator and replace it if it is within the affected range.

renault.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
renault.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

renault.defect: TOWING BALL MOUNTING MAY CRACK The towing ball mounting panel may flex under load and eventually crack causing the towing ball to become insecure.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to fit towing ball mounting panel reinforcement kit.

renault.defect: LABEL MISSING AT VEHICLE CHARGING INLET Mandatory label may be missing at vehicle charging inlet
renault.remedy: Install the decal in the front side of the charging plug on the vehicle

renault.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE STEERING WHEEL MAY BECOME LOOSE ON THE COLUMN SPLINES It is possible that the steering wheel may become loose on the steering column mounting splines which could eventually damage the splines.
renault.remedy: Recall affected vehicles replace the steering wheel and mounting bolt with quality assured items.

renault.defect: SPARE WHEEL MAY BECOME DETACHED The spare wheel carrier winch system may allow the spare wheel to be loosely installed after the customer has used the winch. In this condition the spare wheel might move during driving which may damage and eventually break the cable and guiding pin of the winch system. In this worst case the spare wheel would become detached from the vehicle.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the complete spare wheel winch system.

renault.defect: THE POWER CABLE FROM THE BATTERY BOX TO THE CAB AND ENGINE MIGHT BE DAMAGED BY CHAFING The power cable from the battery box to the cab and engine might be damaged by chafing.
renault.remedy: Check the routing of the cable and re-route if necessary.

renault.defect: INADEQUATE TIGHTENING OF THE REAR HUB NUTS AND POTENTIALLY THE CALIPER FIXING SCREWS ON THE LEFT AND RIGHT SIDE Inadequate tightening of the rear hub nuts and potentially of the calliper fixing screws on the left and right side
renault.remedy: Check the torque of the fixing screws hub nuts and if required replace the screws bolts and the calliper.

renault.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO THE STEERING Power assistance to the steering might be lost because of a problem in the software.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to reprogramme the ECU.

renault.defect: STEERING WHEEL MAY BECOME LOOSE It has been identified that the steering wheel securing bolt may work loose. This can ultimately result in the securing bolt unscrewing and the steering wheel detaching. This would then result in loss of directional control. However the concern should be identified to the driver by the movement in the wheel before it becomes an issue.
renault.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and replace the steering wheel securing bolt.

renault.defect: SEATBELT BUCKLE MAY NOT HOLD SEATBELT TONGUE Seat belt tongue may not hold in the buckle sufficiently. In a collision the tongue may separate from the buckle putting the occupant of the affected belt at risk.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the seatbelt buckle on the passenger side (x 75) and driver side (x6).

renault.defect: GEARBOX MAY FAIL TO HOLD IN PARK POSITION 'P' AND VEHICLE COULD ROLL AWAY If the vehicle is parked on a hill with park selected and the parking brake off or not fully applied the vehicle may not stay stationary. This results in a higher risk of collision.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the parking brake mechanism and park wheel which are inside of the reducer.

renault.defect: BALL JOINT MAY DETACH FROM TIE ROD The tie rod may separate from the ball joint which could result in loss of directional control.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new tie rods.

renault.defect: ENGINE OIL MAY LEAK Engine oil may leak due to the turbocharger oil pipe not being to specification. If not corrected this concern could lead to a skid danger to other road users catastrophic failure of the turbo/engine or in the worst case fire.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the turbocharger oil l pipe.

renault.defect: RISK OF FIRE It has been identified that the mounting bolts of the turbo hose mounting flanges may not have been tightened to the correct torque. In this condition oil may leak with the attendant risk of fire.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts tightened to the correct torque.

renault.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL It is possible that the rear caliper handbrake lever to crack and weaken. In the worst case there is a possibility that the parking brake cables will release.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the caliper handbrake lever for evidence of a crack. Where a crack exists on the lever the caliper will be replaced.

renault.defect: OIL MAY LEAK FROM FILTER HOUSING It has been identified that there exixts a sustatial risk of leakage from the engine oil filter housing.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the functionality of the oil sprayer ramp and supply valve checked and if necessary replace filter housing.

renault.defect: SLIDING FIFTH WHEEL MOVE INADVERTENTLY It has been identified that the near and offside locking plunger fixing bolts may have been incorrectly located. Should this be the case the fifth wheel would not be correctly locked to the slider frame.
renault.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked for correct fitment with the fifth wheel being changed if this is not the case.

renault.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL PUMP SYSTEM Possible fuel leakage of the high pressure fuel pump system
renault.remedy: Replace the high pressure pump and pipes

renault.defect: GEARBOX MAY MALFUNCTION Possible malfunction of the gearbox control causing: 1. Gearbox switching to manual mode without driver intervention; 2. gearbox changing to 3rd gear without driver intervention; 3.incorrect display of lever position on the instrument panel; 4. Auto gearbox warning light illuminates.
renault.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the automatic transmission computer.

renault.defect: PREMATURE DEGRADATION OF EMISSION CONTROL COMPONENT Emissions control component could degrade earlier than expected
renault.remedy: Replace the silencer

renaulttrucks.defect: BRAKE CHAMBER MAY BECOME DETACHED FROM MOUNTING BRACKET The  studs securing the front and rear brake chambers may have received the incorrect heat treatment. As a consequence a brake chamber could become detached from it's mounting bracket.
renaulttrucks.remedy: Check and replace the front and rear brake chambers where found necessary.

renaulttrucks.defect: BRAKE CHAMBER MAY BECOME DETACHED FROM MOUNTING BRACKET The  studs securing the front and rear brake chambers may have received the incorrect heat treatment. As a consequence a brake chamber could become detached from it's mounting bracket.
renaulttrucks.remedy: Check and replace the front and rear brake chambers where found necessary.

renaulttrucks.defect: PIPE CONNECTED TO NON RETURN VALVE ON PARKING BRAKE MAY DETACH The pipe connection on the non return valve fitted to the park brake circuit may separate from the connector due to a manufacturing defect. This could cause unintended application of the parking brake.
renaulttrucks.remedy: Fit a replacement quality assured non return valve.

renaulttrucks.defect: BRAKE CHAMBER MAY BECOME DETACHED FROM MOUNTING BRACKET The  studs securing the front and rear brake chambers may have received the incorrect heat treatment. As a consequence a brake chamber could become detached from it's mounting bracket.
renaulttrucks.remedy: Check and replace the front and rear brake chambers where found necessary.

renthal.defect: HANDLEBARS MAY BECOME LOOSE / INSECURE The clip-on handlebar is susceptible to Stress Corrosion Cracking. This can cause the part to fail during use and could affect control of the machine. The manufacturer recommends to immediately STOP using the clip-ons
renthal.remedy: Replace affected components with an alternative version with a superior resistance  to Stress Corrosion Cracking.

rewaco.defect: HANDLEBAR MAY DETACH Possible bad weld joint at the handlebar clamping plate.  The weld joint could break leading to loss of steering.

ridex.defect: Asbetos in gaskets For affected engine gaskets  these contain certain asbestos fibers  (chrysotile asbestos also known as white asbestos) and thus do not  comply with the legal requirements.
ridex.remedy: Consumers users and customers will be informed of the product risk. This action is to remove the products by withdrawing them from the supply  chain and destroying them. In addition conspicuous and permanent labelling will be used on  motor vehicles in which the affected products are installed.

ridex.remedy: An offer of either replacement brake discs or�the cost of replacement will be made to affected customers.�

rieju.defect: RISK OF FIRE Starter relay contacts may short circuit due to vibration.
rieju.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit rubber mounting for starter relay.

rohill.defect: VEHICLE MAY BECOME UNSTABLE. The rear axle can become overloaded and the vehicle may become unstable when driven with a full load.  (Too many passenger seats on the off side of the vehicle).
rohill.remedy: Remove two passenger seats and reposition others to balance load.

rohill.defect: UNEVEN LOADING CAN RESULT IN LOSS OF TRACTION ON DRIVE AXLE Loss of Traction on the front drive axle when vehicle fully loaded
rohill.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and adjust rear axle loading

rolls royce.defect: RR31 Rear Seat Belt Bolt Connection Check ​​This safety recall involves bolts which fix the left and right side rear seat safety belts to the vehicle body or bolts which fix the rear bench seat configuration backrest locking brackets to the vehicle body. One of these bolts may not have been tightened to specifications and over time could loosen and also potentially cause damage to either the left or right side rear seat safety belt webbing.​
rolls royce.remedy: ​​The possibly affected fixing bolts will be checked and either tightened to specifications or replaced as necessary.  The condition of the left and right side rear seat safety belts will be checked and if necessary replaced.​

rolls royce.defect: On affected vehicles the ground connection cable between the front electric motor and the vehicle chassis may contain adhesive residue on the cable connector eyelet at the end of the cable which attaches to the electric motor. On affected vehicles the ground connection cable between the front electric motor and the vehicle chassis may contain adhesive residue on the cable connector eyelet at the end of the cable which attaches to the electric motor.�
rolls royce.remedy: Inspection of the cable and removal of excessive adhesive.�

rolls royce.defect: THE PLUG CONNECTOR PINS ATTACHMENT BETWEEN FRONT SEAT SAFETY BELTS AND THE ACSM CONTROL MODULE WAS REVERSED The attachment of the plug connector pins between the front seat safety belts and the ACSM control module was reversed.
rolls royce.remedy: The pin configuration at the plug connector to the ACSM will be corrected.

rolls royce.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE It is possible that engine oil can enter the brake servo via the brake vacuum pump and vacuum hose. If this occurs it could damage the brake servo membrane which may leak so causing a reduction in braking assistance and a requirement to apply increased pedal force to achieve the same braking efficiency.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified servo hose. In addition the checking of the brake servo for contamination and replacement if required.

rolls royce.defect: FRONT MOUNTED SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

rolls royce.defect: Affected vehicles manufactured with instrument single layer tempered glass may in certain conditions break. Affected vehicles manufactured with instrument single layer tempered glass may in certain conditions break.
rolls royce.remedy: A protective coating will be applied to the single layer tempered glass.�

rolls royce.defect: THE FUEL TANK FEED LINE CONNECTION MAY NOT BE FITTED CORRECTLY The fuel tank feed line connection that is pre-fitted at the supplier to the fuel pump may not be fitted correctly.
rolls royce.remedy: The fuel tank will need to be lowered and the fuel line feed connection to be checked and refitted as necessary.

rolls royce.defect: Integrated Brake Module For the affected vehicle there is an issue involving the integrated brake (IB) system where an unexpected loss of hydraulic brake assist cannot be ruled out
rolls royce.remedy: The Integrated Brake System will be replaced.

rolls royce.defect: STEERING LINKAGE MAY FOUL A BRAKE PIPE There is a possibility of a foul condition between the lower steering linkage heatshield and a high pressure hydraulic pipe that feeds the front brakes on left hand drive naturally aspirated cars.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall the one affected vehicle and check the subject brake pipe for condition and clearance between it and the heatshield. If necessary the pipe will be repositioned to ensure adequate clearance is achieved. Should the pipe show signs

rolls royce.defect: SIDE CURTAIN AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY The side curtain air bags for both left and right sides of the vehicle may not have been produced to specification. It is possible for the side curtain air bag may not position itself as intended during a collision thereby further increasing the risk of injury to the occupants.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the side curtain air bags on both left and right of the vehicle. Where necessary the side curtain air bag will be replaced.

rolls royce.defect: HEAD AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY The Head airbag may have been damaged during installation. As a result the airbag may not deploy correctly after activation.
rolls royce.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and where necessary relace the Head airbag module

rolls royce.defect: AIR CAN ENTER PRIMARY CIRCUIT OF BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER The low pressure brake fluid feed pipe between the master cylinder and remote reservoir has the potential to trap air which may in certain circumstances cause partial failure of the primary brake circuit.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace both brake fluid feed hoses and reservoir with a new assembly to a revised specification.

rolls royce.defect: AIR CAN ENTER PRIMARY CIRCUIT OF BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER The low pressure brake fluid feed pipe between the master cylinder and remote reservoir has the potential to trap air which may in certain circumstances cause partial failure of the primary brake circuit.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace both brake fluid feed hoses and reservoir with a new assembly to a revised specification.

rolls royce.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR Some engines are fitted with an additional water pump for the turbo charger. In some circumstances a crack may develop which then leads to melting of the plug connections and the housing. Further heat development may then lead to scorch damage. In exceptional cases such overheating can lead to smouldering of the water pump.  If smouldering occurs an engine compartment fire and vehicle fire cannot be excluded.
rolls royce.remedy: The water pump will be replaced for a new more robust version.

rolls royce.defect: INCORRECT OIL IN BRAKING SYSTEM During manufacture the braking systems were filled with mineral oil from identified batches which could have an adverse effect on braking performance.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to have the braking systems drained and filled with new mineral oil.

rolls royce.defect: Integrated Brake Module On affected vehicles the Intergrated Brake System module may experience an electronic signal interference which may reduce braking power.
rolls royce.remedy: On affected vehicles the Intergrated Brake System Module will be replaced.

rolls royce.defect: FRONT AIRBAGS AND BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT BE TRIGGERED IN A COLLISON It has been identified that the airbag/SRS central sensor has been programmed with faulty software. If the vehicle is involved in a frontal or rearward collision then the airbag and seat belt tensioners may not be triggered which could lead to an increased risk of injury to the occupants.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the airbag/SRS central sensor.

rolls royce.defect: THE FUEL TANK FEED LINE CONNECTION MAY NOT BE FITTED CORRECTLY The fuel tank feed line connection that is pre-fitted at the supplier to the fuel pump may not be fitted correctly.
rolls royce.remedy: The fuel tank will need to be lowered and the fuel line feed connection to be checked and refitted as necessary.

rolls royce.defect: Low Pressure Fuel Line Connection On affected vehicles a low-pressure fuel line may not have been secured to the correct specification.
rolls royce.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the low-pressure fuel line removed and reinstalled to the correct torque specification.

rolls royce.defect: RR31 Rear Seat Belt Bolt Connection Check ​​This safety recall involves bolts which fix the left and right side rear seat safety belts to the vehicle body or bolts which fix the rear bench seat configuration backrest locking brackets to the vehicle body. One of these bolts may not have been tightened to specifications and over time could loosen and also potentially cause damage to either the left or right side rear seat safety belt webbing.​
rolls royce.remedy: ​​The possibly affected fixing bolts will be checked and either tightened to specifications or replaced as necessary.  The condition of the left and right side rear seat safety belts will be checked and if necessary replaced.​

rolls royce.defect: EMERGENCY CALL (eCall) FUNCTION IS NOT AVAILABLE Due to a coding error during production affected vehicles received an incorrect option code that blocks connected services. As a result the Emergency call (eCall) function is not available.
rolls royce.remedy: A new vehicle order will be installed on affected vehicles to unblock connected services (including eCall).

rolls royce.defect: Affected vehicles manufactured with instrument single layer tempered glass may in certain conditions break. Affected vehicles manufactured with instrument single layer tempered glass may in certain conditions break.
rolls royce.remedy: A protective coating will be applied to the single layer tempered glass.�

rolls royce.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR Due to the ingress of moisture it is possible that a short circuit can occur in the additional coolant pump for the exhaust turbocharger. The driver will be informed of the issue by a warning message on the display in the instrument panel.  If not addressed it is possible for further heat build up in the pump which may cause the plug connection and housing to melt and in extreme cases a localised fire in the engine compartment or vehicle.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the additional coolant pump.

rolls royce.defect: Affected vehicles manufactured with instrument single layer tempered glass may in certain conditions break. Affected vehicles manufactured with instrument single layer tempered glass may in certain conditions break.
rolls royce.remedy: A protective coating will be applied to the single layer tempered glass.�

rolls royce.defect: HEATED SEATS MAY REACH AN UNACCEPTABLY HIGH TEMPERATURE On the vehicles affected the potential exists for the surface of each heated seat to reach an unacceptably high temperature. In extreme cases this could cause damage to anything in contact with the seat cushion.
rolls royce.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit an additional control unit to each heated seat.

rolls royce.defect: THE AUXILLIARY WATER PUMP'S ELECTRONIC CIRCUIT BOARD CAN LEAD TO SHORT CIRCUIT The auxiliary water pump may short circuit causing a thermal incident.
rolls royce.remedy: The Auxiliary Water Pump of the affected vehicles will be replaced.

rolls royce.defect: EMERGENCY CALL (eCall) FUNCTION IS NOT AVAILABLE Due to a coding error during production affected vehicles received an incorrect option code that blocks connected services. As a result the Emergency call (eCall) function is not available.
rolls royce.remedy: A new vehicle order will be installed on affected vehicles to unblock connected services (including eCall).

rover.defect: POSSIBLE LOOSENING OF DAMPER FIXING BOLT. The bolt that attaches the damper to the upper suspension arm may loosen and in extreme cases fracture.
rover.remedy: Check the torque of the front and rear suspension damper attachment bolts and tighten or replace as appropriate.

rover.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION SPRING CONCERN Vehicles operating in high corrosion areas may experience fracture of the front suspension road springs.  A broken spring may in exceptional circumstances damage the inside wall of the tyre.
rover.remedy: Change the original springs for quality assured repalcements.

rover.defect: SEAT BELT PRE- TENSIONER MALFUNCTION. Possible electrical short circuit in wiring harness may cause seat belt pre-tensioners to activate unnecessarily when ignition switched on.
rover.remedy: Examine seat belt pre-tensioner wiring harness for damage and fit an additional protective sleeve.

rover.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF STEERING GEARBOX The steering gearbox securing bolts may not have been tightened in the correct sequence. This could result in relaxation of the retaining torque at the pinion end with a reduction in steering precision and the possibility of stiffness
rover.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and remove the steering box pinion end bolts one by one to check the condition of the threads Any bolt showing signs of thread damage will be replaced and in all cases the bolts will be retightened in the correct sequence

rover.defect: REAR WHEEL BEARING MAY FAIL There is a possibility of water ingress to the rear wheel bearings. If ignored this could result in bearing failure and in extreme cases possible loss of a road wheel.
rover.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace rear wheel bearings.

royal.defect: CORROSION OF THE BRAKE CALIPERS CAN OCCUR Corrosion due to salt may cause brake bind.
royal.remedy: Inspect and clean replace the seals or callipers as required.

royal.defect: A FRONT BRAKE PAD MAY DISLODGE UNDER BRAKING The brake pad could detach from its retaining clip and fall away from the brake disc
royal.remedy: Fit a 3mm spacer ring to the wheel before the brake disc to prevent the pad detaching

royal.defect: CORROSION OF THE BRAKE CALIPERS CAN OCCUR Corrosion due to salt may cause brake bind.
royal.remedy: Inspect and clean replace the seals or callipers as required.

royal.remedy: Royal Enfield will Replace the rear and/or front side reflectors as required free of charge.

royal.defect: A FRONT BRAKE PAD MAY DISLODGE UNDER BRAKING The brake pad could detach from its retaining clip and fall away from the brake disc
royal.remedy: Fit a 3mm spacer ring to the wheel before the brake disc to prevent the pad detaching

royal.defect: REAR WHEEL MAY LOCK It has been identified that due to oil starvation caused by incorrect tolerances third gear may seize on the gear box main shaft. Should this occur the possibility exists that the rear wheel could lock whilst the machine was being ridden.
royal.remedy: Recalled machines will have 3rd and 4th gears replaced additionally the gearbox main shaft.

royce.defect: FRONT FORKS MAY BREAK There is a possibility that the front shock forks may break resulting in loss of control.
royce.remedy: Recall affected cycles for inspection and if necessary front fork replacement.

saab.defect: CRACKING OF DRIVING SEAT RAILS The driving seat rail on manually adjustable seats may be subject to fatigue cracking.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original seat rails with quality assured examples.

saab.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK - FIRE MAY OCCUR Fuel may leak from the return hose because it is not to specification and will age/crack prematurely. In the worst case fire may occur.
saab.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel return hose.

saab.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERENT DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG The ECU controlling the airbag and seat belt tensioner functions may be affected by the ingress of moisture. Should corrosion subsequently occur in the printed circuit this could result in malfunction of these systems and in extreme cases cause inadvertent deployment of the airbag or seat belt tensioners.
saab.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for inspection and replacement where necessary of the airbag/seat belt tensioner control module.

saab.defect: TOWBALL CAME ADRIFT FROM TOWBAR A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurely detach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
saab.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

saab.defect: LOSS OF BRAKE PRESSURE AND/OR ABS FACILITY As a result of water penetration corrosion may be present on the brake pressure warning switch connection. This could result in the loss of braking system pressure and may also negate the ABS function.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the warning switch connections for signs of corrosion. If corrosion is present on the connector this will be changed and the switch terminals will be treated with a protective agent. Where corrosion is pres

saab.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY BECOME INSECURE. Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
saab.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing  with a calibrated unit.

saab.defect: MISSING WELDS ON SEAT FRAME On some vehicles some welds may be missing from the back frames of the front seats.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for checking of the front seat frames. Where a fault is identified the seat frame will be replaced.

saab.defect: TOWBALL CAME ADRIFT FROM TOWBAR A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurely detach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
saab.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

saab.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY BECOME INSECURE. Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
saab.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing  with a calibrated unit.

saab.defect: POSSIBILITY OF THE THROTTLE BINDING Binding of the throttle lever may occur due to the possibility of white corrosion.
saab.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the zinc coated bushing in the throttle lever with a nickel coated version.

saab.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a manufacturing deviation the handbrake cables on certain 9-3s may deform under load. Should this occur a reduced or non-existent handbrake force will ensue.
saab.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the handbrake cables replaced with quality assured items.

saab.defect: POSSIBLE INADVERTANT DEPLOYMENT OF FRONT AIRBAG(S). A capacitor in the front air bag control unit may short circuit  This could lead to an inadvertent deployment of the air bag(s).
saab.remedy: Check the air bag control module and renew where found necessary.

saab.defect: FUEL PUMP MOUNTED PIPE RETAINING TABS MAY FAIL The fuel pipe plastic retaining tabs mounted on the fuel pump may fail and possibly result in a fuel leak.
saab.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and install a new securing bracket made of steel to hold the fuel pipes in place.

saab.defect: POSSIBLE CONTAMINATION OF BRAKE FLUID As a result of a production process concern a specific batch of brake calliper pistons may release hot hydrogen gas into the braking system fluid.
saab.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for a check on the brake calliper batch numbers.  Vehicles equipped with calliper units from the affected batch will have these replaced with quality assured examples.

saab.defect: REAR AXLE HUB MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The hardening process applied to the rear wheel bearing inner ring may be incorrect. There is a possibility that a rumbling noise may become apparent which if not checked could in extreme circumstances result in the detachment of the hub and severely impaired road holding/handling.
saab.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the date stamp on the rear wheel hubs. Where necessary replace the hub bearing assembly.

saab.defect: FRONT SEAT SECURITY. The front seats may not lock properly on the longitudinal adjustment/mounting rails.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of new trigger springs to the seat adjusting mechanism.

saab.defect: SPECIFICATION OF SEAT BELT TONGUE The tongue at the end of the seat belt has not been hardened to the correct specification.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the seat belt assembly.

saab.defect: SEAT BELT MAY NOT RETRACT The front seat belt retractors may malfunction with the effect that the spooled out portion of the webbing  will not retract.
saab.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the seat front seat belts replaced.

saab.defect: STEERING WHEEL AIRBAG MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY IN A COLLISION It has been identified that in the unlikely event of a collision where there is a need for the deployment of the driver airbag it is a possible that the drivers airbag module may separate form its mounting on the steering wheel horn plate.
saab.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the drivers airbag module.

saab.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been identified that under certain conditions a valve within the brake servo may have a shortened service life due to high ambient and engine bay temperatures. This could affect the functioning of the servo resulting in reduced braking performance
saab.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject valve checked and replaced if necessary.

saab.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT The security siren wiring terminal which is tied back by the left hand headlamp assembly has not been sufficiently insulated. This could result in a short circuit.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and fit a plastic insulating sleeve to the subject terminal.

saab.defect: RIGHT HAND FRONT SEAT MAY NOT LOCK CORRECTLY It has been established that due to a process problem at a sub supplier the right hand side front seat recliner mechanism may fail. This will result in that the back-rest can't be moved back into the locking position.  The condition is very obvious  but if ignored and the vehicle is involved in a crash the seat belt which is integral to the seat structure will not restrain the occupant as designed.
saab.remedy: The seat should be inspected and if necessary replaced.

saab.defect: DELAYED BRAKING ACTION. The front brake discs/pads could be affected by slush water or salt when driving in snow or heavy rain. This could adversely affect the efficiency of the brakes upon initial application.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the front brake disc shields with modified units giving increased weather protection.

saab.defect: DEFECTIVE BRAKE LIGHT SWITCH The brake light switch may stick in the on or off position.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the brake light switch with a quality assured unit.

saab.defect: TOWBALL CAME ADRIFT FROM TOWBAR A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurely detach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
saab.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

saab.defect: POSSIBLE FAULT IN THE LOCKING MECHANISM OF THE FRONT SEAT RECLINER. The front seat recliner locking mechanism could have abnormal free play which may result in an unsatisfactory locking function. Because the seat belt is integrated in the seat back failure of the locking mechanism would affect the crash safety protection.
saab.remedy: Check the front seat production number  and where necessary install a new seat assembly.

saab.defect: UNINTENTIONAL DEPLOYMENT OF PASSENGER AIR BAG A build up of static electricity may cause unintentional deployment of the front passenger air bag.
saab.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a grounding wire between the air bag module and the vehicle body.

saab.defect: MISALIGNMENT OF STEERING COLUMN The steering column may have been misaligned during assembly. This could cause fatigue in the column and result in loss of steering control.
saab.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of the steering column. Where misalignment is found the steering column assembly will be replaced.

saf.defect: Kingpin type 50165S15L delivered by our company may no longer conform to the approval requirements Kingpin type 50165S15L delivered by our company may no longer conform to the approval requirements�
saf.remedy: Customers will be provided with replacement kingpins to exchange with identified components.�

saf.defect: KINGPIN  MAY FAIL It has been identified that a number of kingpins manufactured by SAF- Holland are under certain conditions likely to fail. Should this occur trailer detachment would result.
saf.remedy: Recalled vehicles will  have the subject kingpins replaced with a quality assured item.

safetex.defect: SAFETY HARNESS LAP STRAP ANCHOR PLATE COULD FAIL UNDER IMPACT LOADING Due to a non-conformity in production a specific number of safety harness lap strap anchor plates may potentially not meet the strength requirements under impact loading set for this product. This could result in an inability of the harness in use to provide the optimum level of protection required during an accident.
safetex.remedy: Recall likely to be affected harnesses and replace with quality assured items.

safety.defect: SOME SEATBELT TONGUES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY HEAT TREATED Some seatbelt tongues may not have been sufficiently heat treated.
safety.remedy: Inspect and test the affected components and replace if defective.

salvador.defect: ENTRANCE DOOR HEATED GLASS COULD SPONTANEOUSLY SHATTER The front entrance door heated glass may spontaneously shatter with the consequence that persons may be hit by fragments of glass.
salvador.remedy: Operators of affected vehicles will be contacted and instructed to remove the fuse from the electrical circuit of the relevant heater element.

salvador.defect: ENTRANCE DOOR HEATED GLASS COULD SPONTANEOUSLY SHATTER The front entrance door heated glass may spontaneously shatter with the consequence that persons may be hit by fragments of glass.
salvador.remedy: Operators of affected vehicles will be contacted and instructed to remove the fuse from the electrical circuit of the relevant heater element.

sao.defect: STEERING RACK BEARING It is possible that the steering rack pinion nose bearing may have been omitted during manufacture. This would result in stiffness of the steering.
sao.remedy: The affected vehicles will be recalled and examined to establish that the pinion nose bearing has been fitted. Where the bearing is found to be missing the steering rack will be replace with quality assured unit.

sargent.defect: PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD MAY OVERHEAT The printed circuit in the power supply unit may overheat.
sargent.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the power supply unit with an unaffected version

scania.defect: BATTERY CABLES COULD SHORT CIRCUIT AND CAUSE A FIRE. It has been identified that the electrical cables adjacent to the battery have not been properly secured in their respective fuse holders. This may result in the cables working loose with the attendant risk of a short circuit and a fire.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cables checked for security within their fuse holders and be replaced if this is not the case.

scania.defect: THE MATERIAL COMPOSITION OF THE GAS SYSTEM HIGH PRESSURE REGULATOR IS OUT OF SPECIFICATION The material composition of the gas system high pressure regulator has been found to be outside of specification.
scania.remedy: Check the component serial number and renew the high pressure regulator if it is in the defined batch of defective components.

scania.defect: BRAKE PEDAL FOOT PLATE MAY DETACH The brake and clutch pedal foot plates may detach due to deficient quality of welding that holds them to the brake pedal lever. This could cause the foot to fall off either control and cause an incident.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the welding brake foot plate to brake lever and where necessary fit new brake and/or clutch pedal assemblies.

scania.defect: STEERING DROPARM LOCK NUT MAY WORK LOOSE It has been identified that the possibility exists that the steering intermediate drop arm bearing circlip may be missing. Should this be the case the drop arm lock nut may become loose.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the presence of the circlip checked. If the circlip is found to be missing the bearing housing will be replaced.

scania.defect: POTENTIAL OF SMOKE AND NON  START The wiring connectors in the main junction box located in the engine compartment may not have been torqued correctly. This could lead to loose connections initially causing smoke being emitted and if ignored the vehicle not starting.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check whether the torque for the electrical connections are to specification. Where necessary adjust the torque to specification.

scania.defect: There may be a risk of the propeller shaft breaking and damaging adjacent parts There may be a risk of the propeller shaft breaking and damaging adjacent parts
scania.remedy: Replace one (1) piece propellor shaft with two (2) piece propellor shaft and centre bearing

scania.defect: WHEEL MAY FRACTURE Due to a deviation in the production process the wheel may crack and possibly fracture between the ventilation holes of the rim.
scania.remedy: On affected vehciles replace wheels.

scania.defect: SAFETY BELT ANCHOR POINT MAY FAIL On affected vehicles the bolts retaining wall mounted seat belts and grab handles may not conform to specifications. These bolts could become loose and affect the security of the seat belt and grab handle.
scania.remedy: Renew the retaining bolts for the seat belts and grab handles.

scania.defect: TACHOGRAPH SPEED SENSOR NOT SEALED CORRECTLY It has been identified that the speed sensor on the gearbox is not correctly sealed.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the sensor sealed correctly and the tachograph re-calibrated.

scania.defect: STEERING TRACK ROD END CLAMP BOLTS MAY NOT BE FULLY TIGHT It has been identified that during manufacture the nuts on the clamp joint on the steering track rod may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This could result in the clamping force being lost.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the clamp bolt nuts checked to ensure compliance with the specification.

scania.defect: POTENTIAL FAILURE OF STEERING COLUMN SHAFT CONNECTION The clamping bolt connecting the upper steering column to the lower steering column might not have the correct clamping force due to the incorrect machining of the shaft clearance hole. In extreme circumstances this could result in disconnection of the shaft and loss of steering control.
scania.remedy: Recall the potentially affected vehicles and replace any defective shafts with quality assured units.

scania.defect: BATTERY CABLES COULD SHORT CIRCUIT AND CAUSE A FIRE. It has been identified that the electrical cables adjacent to the battery have not been properly secured in their respective fuse holders. This may result in the cables working loose with the attendant risk of a short circuit and a fire.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cables checked for security within their fuse holders and be replaced if this is not the case.

scania.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The mounting rail which connects the 24v supply between chassis and cab may be incorrectly torqued and heat may build up
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the torque checked on the nuts which secure the connection rail.

scania.defect: HUB COVERS MAY WORK LOOSE There is a possibility that the hub covers on front and tag axles could work loose.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new hub covers.

scania.defect: INSUFFICIENT WARNING REGARDING TILT CAB SAFETY On a small number of vehicles the cab tilt warning label is not displayed on the tilt ram. This label advises workshop staff not to remove the ram on a tilted cab without first ensuring that the cab is adequately supported to prevent it falling back
scania.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and attach the appropriate warning label to the cab tilt ram.

scania.defect: BATTERY CABLES COULD SHORT CIRCUIT AND CAUSE A FIRE. It has been identified that the electrical cables adjacent to the battery have not been properly secured in their respective fuse holders. This may result in the cables working loose with the attendant risk of a short circuit and a fire.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cables checked for security within their fuse holders and be replaced if this is not the case.

scania.defect: DIRT ACCUMULATION ON THE REAR AXLES MAY AFFECT HUB SEALS Accumulation of road dirt in the vicinity of the hub seal
scania.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a protective plate to protect from major dirt accumulation.

scania.defect: The clamping force on the pinion bearing has become too low when fitting the nut to the end yoke The clamping force on the pinion bearing may have been too low when fitting the nut to the end yoke.
scania.remedy: The nut must be renewed and torque tightened according to a new method.

scania.defect: CAB KITCHENETTE FUSES HAVE BEEN MARKED INCORRECTLY The fuses for the kitchenette are incorrectly labelled which could lead to wrong size fuse being fitted.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit an amended sticker over the existing incorrect sticker.

scania.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY BECOME LOOSE It has been identified that the brake pedal mounting shaft may not be fully engaged in it's retaining nut. Should this be the case the brake pedal may become loose.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject nut replaced.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE UNINTENDED ACCELERATION Should a short circuit occur in the EDC (Electronic Diesel Control) wiring this could result in uncontrolled acceleration.
scania.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a fuse with an improved rating to the EDC system.

scania.defect: The wheel nuts may come loose. The wheel nuts may come loose.
scania.remedy: The vehicle's wheel nuts must be check-tightened.

scania.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE LOST It is possible that some brake hoses within the brake system may have been manufactured without the crimping of the clamping sleeve. This could result in the detachment of a hose from its connection. If this occurred then it could result in the braking efficiency being lost from a wheel station or the application of the parking brake. In extreme cases this could affect the directional control of the vehicle.
scania.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle to check and if required replace the brake hoses with a quality assured hose.

scania.defect: WHEEL BEARINGS MAY FAIL Due to defective inner hub seals the wheel bearings may fail
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace wheel bearings and spacing rings.

scania.defect: EBS MAY FAIL There have been instances where the Electronic Brake System Module has stopped working leaving only the normal braking system.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the Electronic Brake System Module with a quality assured unit.

scania.defect: FIFTH WHEEL MOUNTING PLATE MAY DETACH The fifth wheel mounting plate may become loose or in the worst case fall off as a result of the mounting bolts being inadequate.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fifth wheel mounting plate screws with longer higher strength screws spacing sleeves and lock nuts.

scania.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY BECOME LOOSE It has been identified that the brake pedal mounting shaft may not be fully engaged in it's retaining nut. Should this be the case the brake pedal may become loose.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject nut replaced.

scania.defect: STEERING JOINT BOLT MAY FAIL The nut and bolt that clamp the track rod end to the track rod may be defective resulting in the clamping force applied being insufficient.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the nuts and bolts for the track rod end clamp.

scania.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SECURED Securing nuts at one of the upper steering column attachments may be issing or loose. Also the universal joint cross screw joint in the upper steering column must be checked
scania.remedy: Check nuts are fitted and tightened to the correct tightening torque. Also check the vertical steering column is fitted correctly in the upper steering column universal joint cross rectifying where necessary.

scania.defect: REAR U BOLT SECURITY The rear axle U bolts on some vehicles have been secured with galvanised nuts resulting in incorrect tightening torque and in some cases fracture of the U bolts.
scania.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the galvanised nuts with phosphated examples.

scania.defect: THE LOWER NUT THAT SECURES THE CAB TILT CYLINDER TO A MOUNTING BRACKET MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY TIGHTENED The lower nut that secures the cab tilt cylinder to a mounting bracket may not be correctly tightened.
scania.remedy: Check and ensure the tightening torque of the affected nut.

scania.defect: There may be a risk of the propeller shaft breaking and damaging adjacent parts There may be a risk of the propeller shaft breaking and damaging adjacent parts
scania.remedy: Inspect and replace the propeller shaft where required.

scania.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The drag link may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. There may be clearance between the draglink nut and the draglink arm which could potentially result in loss of steering control.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check for clearance between the nut and the draglink arm.  If there is a gap the draglink arm must be renewed.

scania.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY BECOME LOOSE The bolt securing the steering shaft to the upper steering column may become loose
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check that the securing bolt is firmly located and correctly torqued. If found loose fit new bolt and tighten to the correct torque.

scania.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The drag link may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. There may be clearance between the draglink nut and the draglink arm which could potentially result in loss of steering control.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check for clearance between the nut and the draglink arm.  If there is a gap the draglink arm must be renewed.

scania.defect: CAB CONNECTION RAIL MAY NEED TO BE RETORQUED  OR REPLACED. The mounting rail which connects the 24 volt positive supply between the chassis and the cab may be under torqued.
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-torque the mounting rail. If found to be necessary the connection panel will also be replaced.

scania.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SECURED Securing nuts at one of the upper steering column attachments may be issing or loose. Also the universal joint cross screw joint in the upper steering column must be checked
scania.remedy: Check nuts are fitted and tightened to the correct tightening torque. Also check the vertical steering column is fitted correctly in the upper steering column universal joint cross rectifying where necessary.

scania.defect: The wheel nuts may come loose. The wheel nuts may come loose.
scania.remedy: The vehicle's wheel nuts must be check-tightened.

scania.defect: ALTERNATOR BRACKET BOLTS MAY LOOSEN It has been identified that the bracket which carries the alternator has been constructed incorrectly. Due to this the securing bolts may become loose.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will  be fitted with a modified alternator bracket.

scania.defect: STEERING TRACK ROD END CLAMP BOLTS MAY NOT BE FULLY TIGHT It has been identified that during manufacture the nuts on the clamp joint on the steering track rod may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This could result in the clamping force being lost.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the clamp bolt nuts checked to ensure compliance with the specification.

scania.defect: The clamping force on the pinion bearing has become too low when fitting the nut to the end yoke The clamping force on the pinion bearing may have been too low when fitting the nut to the end yoke.
scania.remedy: The nut must be renewed and torque tightened according to a new method.

scania.defect: ALTERNATOR BRACKET BOLTS MAY LOOSEN It has been identified that the bracket which carries the alternator has been constructed incorrectly. Due to this the securing bolts may become loose.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will  be fitted with a modified alternator bracket.

scania.defect: AXLE MAY BECOME INSECURE It has been identified that during production the U bolt nuts on all axles may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the U bolt nuts checked for correct torque. The U bolts will be changed if any of the nuts are found to be loose.

scania.defect: TYRE TREAD MAY SEPARATE The tyre tread may detach and adversely affect the control of the vehicle. The separated tread could also adversely affect other road users.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to have tyres from the affected batches. All tyres fitted to the vehicle are to be checked including the spare. The tyres that are in the affected batches are to be changed out.

scania.defect: FUEL TANK PIPE UNION MAY DETACH Instances have occurred where the fuel pipe bayonet connection in the nearside tank on vehicles fitted with twin tanks has dislodged causing a discharge of fuel onto the road.
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a modified fuel pipe connector.

scania.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR It has been established that the fuse holder mounting screws have been fitted to close to the power supply terminal for the front air conditioning. This could result in a short circuit and in extreme cases a fire.
scania.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the mounting bolts with smaller headed bolts.

scania.defect: The wheel nuts may come loose. The wheel nuts may come loose.
scania.remedy: The vehicle's wheel nuts must be check-tightened.

scania.defect: MALFUNCTION IN THE HEAT EXCHANGER FOR THE LNG FUEL TANK HEATING Malfunctions in the heat exchanger for the LNG fuel tank heating may result in very cold liquefied gas reaching components that are not designed to withstand such low temperatures.
scania.remedy: Carry out a software update to Engine and Gas Management systems creating control measures and a warning light in the event of a fault occurring.

scania.defect: WHEEL MAY FRACTURE Due to a deviation in the production process the wheel may crack and possibly fracture between the ventilation holes of the rim.
scania.remedy: On affected vehciles replace wheels.

scania.defect: SEAT CUSHIONS MAY BURN An element fault on heated cab seats has led to burning of the seat cushions on some vehicles.
scania.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a modified heating element to the cab seats.

scania.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SECURED Securing nuts at one of the upper steering column attachments may be issing or loose. Also the universal joint cross screw joint in the upper steering column must be checked
scania.remedy: Check nuts are fitted and tightened to the correct tightening torque. Also check the vertical steering column is fitted correctly in the upper steering column universal joint cross rectifying where necessary.

scania.defect: VEHICLES MAY NOT COMPLY WITH SPECIFIC EMISSIONS CRITERIA Vehicles may not comply with specific emissions criteria.
scania.remedy: Carry out a SOPS software conversion or evidence exemption compliance

scania.defect: POSSIBLE DEFECTIVE SILENCER SEAM It is possible that exhaust gas escaping from a defective silencer seam may melt an adjacent plastic brake pipe and cause inadvertent application of the spring brakes.
scania.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for reinforcement of the silencer seams or replacement with a silencer incorporating superior re-inforcing on both seams.

scania.defect: DEVIATION IN ENGINE CONTROL UNIT SOFTWARE The engine control unit may not have the correct software. This may affect power and emissions outputs.
scania.remedy: On affected vehicles update the control unit with the correct software.

scania.defect: SAFETY BELT ANCHOR POINT MAY FAIL On affected vehicles the bolts retaining wall mounted seat belts and grab handles may not conform to specifications. These bolts could become loose and affect the security of the seat belt and grab handle.
scania.remedy: Renew the retaining bolts for the seat belts and grab handles.

scania.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It has been identified that when the fuel tank is filled to it's maximum capacity fuel may leak from the filler neck aperture.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a fuel cap which incorporates an anti-splash valve.

scania.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL A deviation has been detected in the joint between the two halves of the spring brake chambers in the parking circuit. This may cause the two halves to separate and inadvertently apply the parking brake.
scania.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the spring chambers

scania.defect: POSSIBLE DEFLATION OF TYRES Incorrect manufacture of threads on the Schrader valve fitted to Michelin disc brake rims causing possible deflation of the tyres.
scania.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and fit quality assured replacement valves.

scania.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering column to steering gear UJ clamp bolt may not have been tightened to design specification.
scania.remedy: On affected vehicle check joints for damage and replace where necessary. Check tightness of the retaining bolt. Replace lock nut.

scania.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE The grommets for the alternator protection fall out and the wires chafe against the alternator body. In the worst case fire could ensue.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and where 140A alternators are fitted replace the protective casing grommets and plugs.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that during production the nuts on the track rod end clamps may not have been tightened to the correct torque resulting in insufficient clamping force on the joint. scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the track rod end clamps checked and changed as necessary.

scania.remedy: On affected vehicles update the control unit with the correct software.

scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the Electronic Brake System Module with a quality assured unit.

scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the track rod end clamps checked and changed as necessary.

scania.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE STEERING WHEEL POSITION  MAY LOOSEN It is possible that the gear segment that holds the steering wheel in its set position can break.  This will result in the steering wheel position suddenly working loose.  Directional control is still possible however the unexpected nature of the concern raises a potential risk.
scania.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the upper lower gears and associated screws with quality assured items.

scania.defect: There may be a risk of the propeller shaft breaking and damaging adjacent parts There may be a risk of the propeller shaft breaking and damaging adjacent parts
scania.remedy: Replace one (1) piece propellor shaft with two (2) piece propellor shaft and centre bearing

scania.defect: WHEEL BEARINGS MAY SEIZE The seals of the inner rear wheel bearings may be defective and could fail causing loss of lubricant and overheating of the bearing causing it to seize.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the inner rear wheel bearings and seals changed as a precautionary measure.

scania.defect: AXLE MAY BECOME INSECURE It has been identified that during production the U bolt nuts on all axles may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the U bolt nuts checked for correct torque. The U bolts will be changed if any of the nuts are found to be loose.
