scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the track rod end clamps checked and changed as necessary.

scania.defect: RISK OF FIRE An isolated case of a fire appears to have originated in the wiring harness adjacent to the fuel tank.
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and secure wiring replacing any damaged cables.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that during production the nuts on the track rods likewise the drag link end clamps may not have been tightened to the correct torque resulting in insufficient clamping force on the joint. Under conditions of high steering load the track rod may detach resulting in loss of steering control.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the track rod end and drag link clamps checked and changed as necessary.

scania.defect: POTENTIAL OF SMOKE AND NON  START The wiring connectors in the main junction box located in the engine compartment may not have been torqued correctly. This could lead to loose connections initially causing smoke being emitted and if ignored the vehicle not starting.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check whether the torque for the electrical connections are to specification. Where necessary adjust the torque to specification.

scania.defect: STEERING JOINT BOLT MAY FAIL The nut and bolt that clamp the track rod end to the track rod may be defective resulting in the clamping force applied being insufficient.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the nuts and bolts for the track rod end clamp.

scania.defect: DIRECTIONAL STABILITY & CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that the torque of the anti-roll bar may not be to specification. This could result in the securing screws/bolts failing allowing anti-roll bar to become insecure and affect the stability or directional control of the vehicle.
scania.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if require re-torque the mounting screws/bolts.

scania.defect: Check the cable routing next to the battery on ScaniaTouring The manufacturer has identified there is a risk that the battery cable could chafe against the battery holder bracket and make short circuit.
scania.remedy: Chafe protection to be fitted to affected battery cables.

scania.defect: Check the cable routing next to the battery on ScaniaTouring The manufacturer has identified there is a risk that the battery cable could chafe against the battery holder bracket and make short circuit.
scania.remedy: Chafe protection to be fitted to affected battery cables.

scania.defect: CRACKING OF POWER STEERING HYDRAULIC CYLINDER MOUNTING BRACKET The bracket which mounts the steering hydraulic ram to the chassis is a casting manufactured from an incorrect material. The bracket is too brittle and therefore proven to developing cracks which can give rise to steering difficulties.
scania.remedy: Brackets on recalled vehicles will be checked for the serial number 3431/31 which indicates that the bracket has been made from the wrong material. If this is the case the bracket will be changed.

scania.defect: TRACK ROD BALL JOINT CLAMP BOLT MAY  NOT BE TO THE CORRECT TORQUE It has been identified that the torque setting of the track rod ball joint clamp bolts may be insufficient.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the clamp bolts checked and re-torqued as necessary.

scania.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY BECOME LOOSE The bolt securing the steering shaft to the upper steering column may become loose
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check that the securing bolt is firmly located and correctly torqued. If found loose fit new bolt and tighten to the correct torque.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF AIR DEFLECTOR Cracked end pieces for the roof rail may allow the roof mounted air deflector to come adrift.
scania.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the roof rail inspected for signs of cracking. Where no cracks are present the fixing will be reinforced by the fitment of extra washers. Where roof rails are found to be cracked they will be replaced and s

scania.defect: REAR U BOLT SECURITY The rear axle U bolts on some vehicles MAY have been secured with galvanised nuts as opposed to phosphated nuts. This has resulted in incorrect tightening torque and in some cases fracture of the U bolts.
scania.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the type of nut securing the rear axle U bolts. Where phosphated nuts are fitted - check torque setting and increase if necessary.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE UNINTENDED ACCELERATION Should a short circuit occur in the EDC (Electronic Diesel Control) wiring this could result in uncontrolled acceleration.
scania.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a fuse with an improved rating to the EDC system.

scania.defect: There should be 2 or 3 slots at each end of the track rod link. The ball joints at the ends of the track rod are secured by tightening a clamp over the slots. scania.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FAILURE OF THE WHEEL BEARING Premature failure of rear wheel bearings caused by dirt and water penetration due to a defective inner seal
scania.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the bearings and seals of both rear hubs.

scania.defect: INCORRECT HEAT SHRINK TUBING ON THE BATTERY POSITIVE CABLE TERMINAL/HARNESS Incorrect heat shrink tubing on the battery positive cable terminal/harness connected to the fuse board.

scania.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle to check and if required replace the brake hoses with a quality assured hose.

scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cables checked for security within their fuse holders and be replaced if this is not the case.

scania.defect: THE MATERIAL COMPOSITION OF THE GAS SYSTEM HIGH PRESSURE REGULATOR IS OUT OF SPECIFICATION The material composition of the gas system high pressure regulator has been found to be outside of specification.
scania.remedy: Check the component serial number and renew the high pressure regulator if it is in the defined batch of defective components.

scania.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the nut along with a locking washer and tighten to the recommended torque.

scania.defect: SAFETY BELT ANCHOR POINT MAY FAIL On affected vehicles the bolts retaining wall mounted seat belts and grab handles may not conform to specifications. These bolts could become loose and affect the security of the seat belt and grab handle.

scania.defect: IF THE HAND CONTROL IS RELEASED WHEN ACTIVATING PARKING BRAKE THE BRAKE SYSTEM MAY RELEASE THE PARKING BRAKE INADVERTENTLY Possible unintentional deactivation of the parking brake and vehicle roll away.

scania.defect: FRONT WHEEL CHAIR LIFT CONTROL WIRE INCORRECTLY FUSED. The front wheelchair lift control wire has been fused incorrectly leading to the possibility of an electrical short circuit and subsequently an electrical fire.
scania.remedy: The remedy involves inspecting the electrical circuit and protecting the wire with a lower rated fuse.

scania.defect: SPRING BRAKE CYLINDER MAY LEAK AND CAUSE THE PARKING BRAKE TO APPLY Air may leak from the parking brake chamber due to a faulty seal causing the parking brake to apply.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF FIFTH WHEEL COUPLING Fifth wheel trailer coupling may detach from slider mechanism and result in the separation of the trailer from the towing vehicle.
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit an additional cross member at the rear of the fifth wheel.

scania.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY The plastic pipe where the union on the relay valve for the parking brake is located can loosen and lead to involuntary application of the brakes
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles inspect the relevant plastic pipes and replace the insert connection if faulty

scania.defect: PASSENGER SALOON OVERHEAD HEATER PIPES MAY LEAK It has been identified that the saloon interior roof mounted heater hoses may degrade and leak.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject heater hoses replaced with quality assured items.

scania.defect: BRAKES MAY ACTIVATE WITHOUT WARNING It has been identified that the software on vehicles equipped with Advanced Emergency Braking (AEB) system has an error in its programming. This could cause the AEB system to incorrectly registered a collision risk with a stationary object and brake the vehicle to avoid a collision. This could result in the drive loosing control or an emergency braking situation without the drivers knowledge.
scania.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and upload new software to the AEB system.

scania.defect: WHEEL MAY FRACTURE Due to a deviation in the production process the wheel may crack and possibly fracture between the ventilation holes of the rim.
scania.remedy: On affected vehciles replace wheels.

scania.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE The grommets for the alternator protection fall out and the wires chafe against the alternator body. In the worst case fire could ensue.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and where 140A alternators are fitted replace the protective casing grommets and plugs.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that during production the nuts on the track rod end clamps may not have been tightened to the correct torque resulting in insufficient clamping force on the joint. Under conditions of high steering load the track rod may detach resulting in loss of steering control.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the track rod end clamps checked and changed as necessary.

scania.defect: ELECTRIC CABLE MAY OVERHEAT It has been identified that the B+ electrical cable has been routed so that it is in contact with the compressor pipe. This can result in the cable becoming hot with the likelihood of damage occurring to the insulation.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cable routed and secured to prevent it contacting the compressor pipe.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE UNSCHEDULED APPLICATION OF PARKING BRAKE The steel ball in ports 1 and 2 of the air brake system interlock valve may come loose and cause the parking brake to self apply.
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a modified interlock valve.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It has been identified that during production the nuts on the track rod end clamps may not have been tightened to the correct torque resulting in insufficient clamping force on the joint. Under conditions of high steering load the track rod may detach resulting in loss of steering control.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the track rod end clamps checked and changed as necessary.

scania.defect: STEERING DRAGLINK ARM MAY CONTACT  FIFTH WHEEL MOUNTING BRACKET The steering draglink may come into contact with the fifth wheel mounting bracket.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have one corner of the mounting bracket removed.

scania.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT RUBBISH MIGHT ENTER THE AIR INTAKE AND REDUCE CAPACITY The possibility exists that debris might enter the engine air intake thus reducing it's capacity
scania.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a protective mesh to the air intake.

scania.defect: There may be a risk of the propeller shaft breaking and damaging adjacent parts There may be a risk of the propeller shaft breaking and damaging adjacent parts
scania.remedy: Replace one (1) piece propellor shaft with two (2) piece propellor shaft and centre bearing

scania.defect: DRIVER'S SEAT BACKREST MAY DETACH FROM SEAT BASE Due to a deviation in the manufacturing process  the back rest on the driver's seat may have a lower durability than designed. This may cause it to come loose or detach.
scania.remedy: On affected models with a Premium  driver's seat replace the seat back rest.

scania.defect: WHEEL MAY FRACTURE Due to a deviation in the production process the wheel may crack and possibly fracture between the ventilation holes of the rim.
scania.remedy: On affected vehciles replace wheels.

scania.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The drag link may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. There may be clearance between the draglink nut and the draglink arm which could potentially result in loss of steering control.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check for clearance between the nut and the draglink arm.  If there is a gap the draglink arm must be renewed.

scania.defect: STEERING JOINT BOLT MAY FAIL The nut and bolt that clamp the track rod end to the track rod may be defective resulting in the clamping force applied being insufficient.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the nuts and bolts for the track rod end clamp.

scania.defect: CAB KITCHENETTE FUSES HAVE BEEN MARKED INCORRECTLY The fuses for the kitchenette are incorrectly labelled which could lead to wrong size fuse being fitted.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit an amended sticker over the existing incorrect sticker.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE OVERLOADING OF FRONT AXLE The operation of the Optimal traction axle weight distribution device may under certain circumstances cause the front axle to be overloaded.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the relevant control system re-programmed with the latest setting.

scania.defect: BURNING OF TRAILER BRAKE HOSES Exhaust air from the cab heater may cause burning of the trailer brake hoses.
scania.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a plate to the cab rear wall which will protect the brake hoses from the heater exhaust air.

scania.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The drag link may not have been manufactured to the correct specification. There may be clearance between the draglink nut and the draglink arm which could potentially result in loss of steering control.
scania.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check for clearance between the nut and the draglink arm.  If there is a gap the draglink arm must be renewed.

scania.defect: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK It has been identified that fuel pipes may chafe against the induction and charge air pipe.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuel pipe replaced and prevented from chafing against the induction and air charge pipes.

scania.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF BRAKE SYSTEM PROTECTION VALVE 4-Way Circuit Protection Valves have not been cleaned thoroughly during manufacturer. Affected vehicles could suffer a malfunction of the valve if there is a loss of air pressure in any of its circuits.
scania.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the circuit protection valve with a quality assured unit.

scania.defect: BATTERY POSITIVE CABLE MAY BE DAMAGED It has been identified that the battery positive cable could come into contact with the compressor outlet pipe and suffer damage as a consequence.
scania.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject cable secured with a cable tie.

scania.defect: LOOSE BOLTS IN FRONT CHASSIS Bolts in the front chassis module may become loose.
scania.remedy: Replace missing bolts and tighten all of the bolts to manufacturers recommended torque setting.

scarab.defect: FAILURE OF THE FRONT AXLE BEAM Possible failure of the front axle beam due to inadequate welds.
scarab.remedy: Weld a strengthening plate to the axle beam.

schmitz.defect: Inspection of Kingpin Bolted Connection F329 In the case of tipper semi-trailers (S.KI) from a limited production period the bolted connection of the kingpin may not correspond to the prescribed torque. In extreme cases this can result in the tipper semi-trailer becoming separated from the tractor unit.
schmitz.remedy: To avoid damage it is necessary that the kingpin bolts be inspected and if necessary retightened by an authorised Schmitz Cargobull service partner.

schmitz.defect: KINGPIN BED PLATE MAY FAIL It has been identified during trials that in situations of extremely heavy use it may be possible for a crack to develop in the sem-i trailer bed plate just ahead of the king pin. If a crack does develop and is ignored then ultimately the risk exists that the king pin could be torn away.
schmitz.remedy: The subject area of the bed plate will be modified as necessary.

schmitz.defect: Partial detachment of profiles and/or scuff plates and/or underbody protection on the S.KO V7 due to defective adhesive bonding. Partial detachment of profiles and/or scuff plates and/or underbody protection
schmitz.remedy: Inspect trailers and rework affected trim and panels as necessary.

schmitz.defect: KINGPIN BED PLATE MAY FAIL It has been identified during trials that in situations of extremely heavy use it may be possible for a crack to develop in the sem-i trailer bed plate just ahead of the king pin. If a crack does develop and is ignored then ultimately the risk exists that the king pin could be torn away.
schmitz.remedy: The subject area of the bed plate will be modified as necessary.

schwalbe.defect: TYRE OUTER CASING MAY SEPARATE It has been identified that possible separation of the tyres inner casing layers might occur resulting in puncturing of the inner tube.
schwalbe.remedy: End users are to be contacted by wholesalers/dealers and by public advert and if necessary will have the tyres replaced.

scorpion.defect: ALARM/IMMOBILISER MAY MALFUNCTION Over time corrosion of the internal circuit board can lead to unpredictable functionality of the alarm. This can cause the alarm to operate  and in the most severe cases may cause the motorcycle not to start or to immobilise the motorcycle in use.  The rider maybe warned of the issue by the alarm LED glowing slightly with the ignition on (LED should not illuminate when ignition is on).
scorpion.remedy: Recall all affected units and replace with a new quality assured unit.

scorpion.defect: ALARM/IMMOBILISER MAY MALFUNCTION Over time corrosion of the internal circuit board can lead to unpredictable functionality of the alarm. sdc.defect: RUBBING PLATE MAY SPLIT AROUND KING PIN MOUNTING. The coupling rubbing plate may split around the king pin and cross member mountings.
sdc.remedy: Insert a stiffening cross member in front of the king pin.

sdc.defect: TRAILER RUBBING PLATE MAY CRACK. Trailer rubbing plate may crack around the king pin.
sdc.remedy: Recall affected vehicles apply strengthening welds and stiffening angle members to the rubbing plate.

sdc.defect: DRAWBAR BEAM MAY CRACK It is possible reinforcing plates for the drawbar mounting on the trailer may have been manufactured out of brittle steel. This has resulted in fractures around the mounting point on the trailer. If this was not identified during routine maintenance a trailer detachment could have occured.
sdc.remedy: Recall the affected trailer and rework the drawbar mounting on the chassis.

sdc.defect: TRAILER KING PIN RUBBING PLATE MAY CRACK There is a possibility that cracking may occur around the rubbing plate area on certain tipping trailers if king pin is fitted in rear position.
sdc.remedy: Recall affected trailers to check condition of rubbing plate and to fix decal to trailer advising customers to fit king pin in forward position.

sea.defect: TRAILER I-CATCH MAY FAIL The I CATCH boat to trailer locking device may be maladjusted and not properly securing the front end of the watercraft. If the rear latching straps are not used to properly secure the back end of the watercraft it is possible for the watercraft to slide off the trailer.
sea.remedy: Recall the trailers that are likely to be affected to install a safety cable on the front latch mechanism to affix an updated label to the trailer and to give the owner an updated user guide.

seat.defect: Battery check Certain vehicles manufactured during a limited production period a high-voltage battery module may not meet quality standards. This may result in significantly reduced autonomy a yellow warning light coming on or a thermal overload inside the high-voltage battery. A thermal overload of this kind may cause a fire in the vehicle
seat.remedy: A battery check is carried out on the vehicles. If the check identifies high-voltage battery modules which may be faulty the identified modules must be replaced.

seat.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
seat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

seat.models: Roof Box CUPRA part number 000 071 200 AK
seat.defect: CUPRA Roof Box Affected roof boxes could be fitted with defective plastic covers on the locking mechanism which may lead to damage to the roof box itself and to the vehicle.  In extreme cases the lid of the roof box can detach and fly off.
seat.remedy: Replace defective roof boxes.

seat.defect: Drivers side front airbag On affected vehicles a deterioration of the driver airbag propellant could occur. In the event of an accident and the activation of the driver airbag fragments of the generator housing could become detached and injure the vehicle occupants.
seat.remedy: The driver side front airbag gas generator must be replaced in all affected vehicles.

seat.defect: 48T7 - Steering housing bolt Ateca and Tarraco SEAT S.A. has identified that in vehicles manufactured during a specific  production period there is a possibility that moisture ingress may cause  corrosion of a steering mounting bolt. If this corrosion progresses the  steering attachment may become compromised. This could ultimately lead  to a loss of steering control and increase the risk of an accident.
seat.remedy: In affected vehicles this steering mounting bolt will be replaced with a bolt  featuring enhanced corrosion resistance. If you notice unusual metallic rattling noises coming from the front axle area or any irregularities while steering you must not continue driving the vehicle.  Park the vehicle safely and contact an authorised SEAT Service Partner  immediately.

seat.defect: THE BRACKET OF THE DOUBLE BELT BUCKLE MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING THE FORMING PROCESS It is possible that the bracket of the double belt buckle has been damaged during the forming process.
seat.remedy: The double belt buckle must be replaced in all affected vehicles.

seat.defect: CRACKS IN THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE SEAT FRAME/PAN There is a possibility that due to a manufacturing error there is a crack on the frame of the left front seat.
seat.remedy: Check and replace the seat frame if a crack is found.

seat.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On 2.0l Common Rail engines of a limited production period faulty material can cause leaks on the high pressure pipes during the service life of the vehicle.
seat.remedy: Anti-vibration balance weights will be fitted on the high-pressure pipes.

seat.defect: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY NOT INFLATE FAST ENOUGH IN THE EVENT OF ACTIVATION Drivers air bag may not inflate at the correct rate.
seat.remedy: Replace the drivers front air bag.

seat.defect: In certain vehicles within a range of specified VINs it has been detected that an engine support that did not receive the correct heat treatment may have been fitted. In certain vehicles within a range of specified VINs it has been detected that an engine support that did not receive the correct heat treatment may have been fitted.�

seat.defect: HEAD AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO  ACTIVATE UNDER CERTAIN COLLISION CONDITIONS. It has been identified that some SEAT vehicles fitted with right hand drive head airbag equipment due to an assembly error in the wiring may experience incorrect head airbag activation under certain collision conditions.
seat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject wiring connections checked and corrected if necessary.

seat.defect: THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT MAY POSSIBLY HAVE BEEN CAUGHT BY THE CLUTCH PEDAL DURING INSTALLATION There is a possibility that the wiring harness of the airbag control unit was caught by the clutch pedal during installation.
seat.remedy: The correct position of the airbag control unit wiring harness must be checked and if required secured in the correct position. Repair any existing damage as necessary.

seat.defect: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY NOT INFLATE FAST ENOUGH IN THE EVENT OF ACTIVATION Drivers air bag may not inflate at the correct rate.
seat.remedy: Replace the drivers front air bag.

seat.defect: ENGINE DESIGN COVERS COULD DETACH FROM THEIR FIXING In some vehicles within the range of specified VINs it is possible that they have engine design covers installed that could detach from their fixing depending on use (very sporty driving or poor road conditions) and the operating time.
seat.remedy: The engine design cover must be removed on all affected vehicles.

seat.defect: TENSION CRACKS MAY OCCUR ON THE VACUUM PIPE TO THE SERVO Tension cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo in the area of the connections due to a manufacturing fault. Should a vacuum pipe leak the brake servo will loose it's function. This will result in an increase of force which must be applied to the brake pedal. But will not result in a total failure of the braking system.
seat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pipes checked and if necessary replaced.

seat.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. seat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

seat.defect: FLYWHEEL MAY FAIL The two mass flywheel can become damaged because of a non-optimally designed through-flow restrictor in the clutch pressure pipe. This can lead to a total failure of the flywheel and under unfavourable circumstances to a vehicle fire.
seat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and establish the manufacturer of the two mass flywheel. Where necessary replace the flywheel and the breather of the clutch pressure pipe.

seat.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
seat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

seat.defect: On certain vehicles with electromechanical brake servo and DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox) of a limited production period there is a possibility that a heat protection mat was incorrectly fitted. In individual cases the brake fluid reservoir can melt and cause a brake fluid leak into the engine compartment. On certain vehicles with electromechanical brake servo and DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox) of a limited production period there is a possibility that a heat protection mat was incorrectly fitted. In individual cases the brake fluid reservoir can melt and cause a brake fluid leak into the engine compartment.
seat.remedy: A check of the installation of the heat protection mat on affected vehicles will be conducted. If necessary the correct heat shield condition will be restored and an additional heat shield installed.�

seat.defect: MANUAL CHILD LOCK MAY DISENGAGE WITHOUT WARNING The child lock can disengage without the driver knowing and the door can again be opened from the inside. If children leave the car unnoticed and run into the road there is a risk of accident.
seat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the function of the manual child lock. If necessary the door lock/s will be replaced.

seat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified cooling fan and pulley.

seat.remedy: Replace the batteries.

seat.defect: CLUTCH MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY WITH UNEXPECTED LOSS OF DRIVE. In rare cases an incorrect interpretation of the clutch temperature can occur which results in the clutch opening unexpectedly with loss of drive.

seat.defect: ANTI LOCK BRAKE CONTROL UNIT CONCERN There is a risk that an electrical fault in the anti lock brake control unit (ABS) can cause overheating of related electrical components. This may lead to fire damage and cause the service brake to revert to a non-anti lock mode of operation.
seat.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check the part number and supplier code of the ABS control unit. Renew the ABS control unit where found necessary.

seat.defect: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT/FIRE RISK The wiring loom from the ignition coil to the ECU may chafe on a cylinder head bolt. This could eventually result in an electrical short circuit and/or fire risk.
seat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of brackets and cable ties to secure the wiring loom clear of the cylinder head bolt in question.

seat.defect: BRAKE VACUUM SUPPLY PIPE CONCERN On Arosa vehicles in the affected chassis number range tension cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo in the area of the connections of the pipes because of a manufacturing fault.  If a vacuum pipe leaks the brake servo loses its function.  Without the servo assistance a lot more force must be used on the pedal.  But this will not lead to a failure of the brake system
seat.remedy: The fitted vacuum pipes will be checked and if necessary replaced.

seat.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On affected vehicles the fuel filter may crack around inlet connection. This will allow fuel to leak which may cause a smell within the vehicle interior and possibly contaminate the road environment. This may affect the handling of the vehicle and of other traffic..
seat.remedy: Check type of filter fitted. If not of improved type then replace with improved filter.

seat.defect: Possibility that four of the six welding points on the bottom connection of the impact beam for the rear left door are too small On vehicles manufactured in a specific period there is a possibility that four of the six welding points on the bottom connection of the impact beam for the rear left door are too small.
seat.remedy: The serial number of the rear left door must be checked and if necessary the rear left door must be replaced.�

seat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the twin-mass flywheel replaced.

seat.defect: Passenger airbag replacement Takata has advised that in the event of an accident with airbag activation the front passenger airbag gas generator housing may explode. The cause may be a deterioration of the propellant caused by high air humidity and temperature changes during an extended period of time. In the event of an accident with front passenger airbag activation fragments from the gas generator can cause injuries and endanger the life of the passengers.
seat.remedy: Replace the passenger airbag as necessary.

seat.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. seat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

seat.defect: THE BRACKET OF THE DOUBLE BELT BUCKLE MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING THE FORMING PROCESS It is possible that the bracket of the double belt buckle has been damaged during the forming process.

seat.defect: 48T7 - Steering housing bolt Ateca and Tarraco SEAT S.A. has identified that in vehicles manufactured during a specific  production period there is a possibility that moisture ingress may cause  corrosion of a steering mounting bolt. If this corrosion progresses the  steering attachment may become compromised. This could ultimately lead  to a loss of steering control and increase the risk of an accident.
seat.remedy: In affected vehicles this steering mounting bolt will be replaced with a bolt  featuring enhanced corrosion resistance. If you notice unusual metallic rattling noises coming from the front axle area or any irregularities while steering you must not continue driving the vehicle.  Park the vehicle safely and contact an authorised SEAT Service Partner  immediately.

seat.defect: STEERING COLUMN UJ PINCH BOLT MAT NOT BE TIGHTENED TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION The steering column UJ pinch bolt may not have been tightened to the correct specification. Under heavy steering loads such as at low speeds movement between UJ and column is possible.
seat.remedy: Check the tightness the steering column bolt on affected vehicles. Where necessary tighten to correct torque.

seat.defect: THE ADJUSTED HANDBRAKE LEVER TRAVEL FOR PARKING CAN INCREASE Hand brake lever travel increase due to adjuster nut movement.

seat.defect: REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS MAY FAIL It is possible the tempering process for the rear wheel bearing housing was not correct. This could allow the housing to crack and fail

seat.defect: WINDSCREEN WIPER MOTOR MAY FAIL The windscreen wiper motor may cease to work because of an electrical software fault.

seat.defect: TENSION CRACKS MAY OCCUR ON THE VACUUM PIPE TO THE SERVO Tension cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo in the area of the connections due to a manufacturing fault. Should a vacuum pipe leak the brake servo will loose it's function. This will result in an increase of force which must be applied to the brake pedal. But will not result in a total failure of the braking system.
seat.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pipes checked and if necessary replaced.

seat.defect: THE FRONT ASSIST IS NOT CONFIGURED CORRECTLY The Front Assist is not configured correctly.

seat.defect: LEAKAGE FROM FUEL FILLER PIPE. The handbrake cable may chafe on the fuel filler pipe causing perforation of the pipe and leakage of fuel.
seat.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for repositioning and securing of the handbrake cable to ensure adequate clearance between the cable and the filler pipe. At the same time any filler pipes found to be perforated will be replaced.

seat.defect: ENGINE DESIGN COVERS COULD DETACH FROM THEIR FIXING In some vehicles within the range of specified VINs it is possible that they have engine design covers installed that could detach from their fixing depending on use (very sporty driving or poor road conditions) and the operating time.

seat.defect: AIR CONDITIONING HIGH PRESSURE HOSE MAY BE FITTED INCORRECTLY A faulty air conditioning high pressure hose may have been fitted. In the event of a frontal collision there could be a leak of polluting and flammable gas.

seat.defect: SIDE AIRBAG GAS GENERATOR CANISTER MAY FAIL For certain vehicles manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the gas generator housing may be damaged if a side airbag is deployed. seat.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the dates of manufacture for the left and or right side airbags. Where a possibly affected airbag is found it will be replaced.

seat.defect: THE INLET CAMSHAFT ADJUSTER PULLEY IS LIABLE TO BREAK The pulley of the inlet camshaft adjuster is liable to brake.

seat.defect: POTENTIAL FAILURE OF BATTERY CHARGING CIRCUIT The power supply of the vehicle can be disrupted without warning (the alternator warning light does not illuminate) due to a break in the wiring loom at the alternator connector.

seat.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED Due to a process deviation in the production front passenger airbag module the connection between detonator and generator may not be sufficient. This may cause the airbag not to deploy as intended.

segway.defect: REVERSE TORQUE MAY UNEXPECTEDLY APPLY TO THE WHEELS Under certain circumstances due to a software issue the subject Sedway PT can unexpectedly apply reverse torque to the wheels which can result in the rider falling off.
segway.remedy: Recall affected machines and update software.

segway.defect: CHARGER MAY BE INCORRECTLY WIRED When charging the battery externally from the vehicle there is a possibility that the earth provision for some sides of charger enclosure may not function.  This is due to the anodising and bonding of the charger enclosure not being sufficiently conductive. For the unit to be affected the hot AC wire must detach and contact a part of the charger enclosure that does not have effective earth provision. If the above situation occurs the user could be subject to an electric shock.
segway.remedy: A power supply cable with Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter will be supplied for all affected charger units.

segway.defect: WIRING FAULT COULD RESULT IN USER RECEIVING ELECTRIC SHOCK When charging the battery externally from the vehicle there is a possibility that the earth provision for some sides of charger enclosure may not function. For the unit to be affected the hot AC wire must detach and contact a part of the charger enclosure that does not have effective earth provision. If the above situation occurs the user could be subject to an electric shock.
segway.remedy: A power supply cable with Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter will be supplied for all affected charger units.

setra.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL The radial seal on left and right hand idler arms may have been fitted incorrectly.  There is a risk that access lubricating grease would not be able to escape from the bearing during routine lubrication maintenance.  This would lead to damage to the adjustment and retaining screws of the idler arms caused by overstretching.  If a retaining screw was to break as a consequence the vehicle would lose its ability to steer.
setra.remedy: Replace the radial seals and adjustment screws.

siarr.remedy: Check the identity label and replace the tow bar if affected.

sinnis.defect: BRAKES COULD FAIL On affected vehicles the front brake hose(s) may have been incorrrectly routed and rub against the front mudguard. Hose may chafe through and after a period of time may fail. If the hose fails the rider will notice a spongy feel to the front brake but eventually a total loss of fluid will occur and front braking lost.
sinnis.remedy: Inspect front brake hoses and correctly route. Where necessary replace damaged hoses.

sinnis.defect: THE ECU MODULE CAN BECOME OVERLOADED AND MAY CAUSE THE FUEL PUMP RELAY TO REMAIN LIVE AFTER THE IGNITION SYSTEM IS TURNED OFF. The ECU module can become overloaded and may cause the fuel pump relay to remain live after the ignition system is turned off.
sinnis.remedy: Fit an electrical diode within the wiring harness and replace the ECU if required.

sinnis.defect: WELD MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION Reports of chassis weakness.  After extensive research on a variety of frames it was confirmed that the weakness was not metal fatigue but down to the width of the weld on the subframe.
sinnis.remedy: Inspection of the unit checking the welds at specific points if below 8mm a new design subframe will be fitted.

sirus.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY BE INADVERTENTLY APPLIED Customer reported that the Handbrake was inadvertently switched on whilst the driver was driving causing the wheels to lock resulting in an accident
sirus.remedy: The handbrake operating switch to be replaced with a modified switch to eliminate the problem.

skf.defect: THE THREAD PITCH OF THE SCREWS DOES NOT MATCH WITH THE THREAD PITCH OF THE BEARING The thread pitch of the screws do not match with the thread pitch of the bearing housing.
skf.remedy: Supply and fit replacement wheel bearing kits.

skoda.defect: Seat backrest frame cover Škoda Auto has discovered that there is a risk with the Kodiaq model from a limited production period that the edge of the inner frame of the front seats may compromise the integrity of the side airbag when activated. This situation may reduce the protective effect of the side airbag which could result in an increased risk of injury to passengers in the event of an accident.For safety reasons your vehicle must be repaired. We strongly recommend that you contact an authorized Škoda service center as soon as possible to arrange a repair date. In the first instance we ask that you contact your local ŠKODA authorised repairer as soon as possible to make an appointment. The ŠKODA authorised repairer closest to you can be found on https://tools.skoda.co.uk/find-a-retailer
skoda.remedy: The vehicle will be fitted with sharp edge protection for the inner frame of the front seats to prevent damage to the integrity of the side airbag when it is deployed.

skoda.remedy: Check and replace the seat frame if a crack is found.

skoda.defect: MANUAL CHILD LOCKS ON  REAR PASSENGER DOORS MAY DISENGAGE WITHOUT WARNING The door child locks may disengage without driver knowledge. Though the door remains close it is possible for the door to then be opened from the inside.
skoda.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect lock mechanism and replace where necessary.

skoda.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On 2.0l Common Rail engines of a limited production period faulty material can cause leaks on the high pressure pipes during the service life of the vehicle.
skoda.remedy: Anti-vibration balance weights will be fitted on the high-pressure pipes.

skoda.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
skoda.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

skoda.defect: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system
skoda.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

skoda.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF ELECTRICAL CIRCUITS/HANDBRAKE LEVER MOUNTING BRACKET SECURITY. A. Potential loss of electrical power in any one of the fuse board circuits e.g. lights or windscreen wipers) due to poor quality soldered connections and possible damage to wiring behind the central console as a result of contact with the heater
skoda.remedy: A. Replace the fuse board with a quality assured unit and fit a protective clip to the heater controls on all the affected vehicles.

skoda.defect: PASSENGER AIR BAG CONCERN The passenger airbag may not release correctly because of a leak in the pressure reservoir of the gas generator.
skoda.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the passenger air bag.

skoda.defect: INCORRECT CURTAIN AIRBAG MAY ACTIVATE It has been identified that some of the wires within airbag control unit block connector have been incorrectly installed. In the event of a collision this will result in the activation of the curtain airbag on the opposite side to the impact.
skoda.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the wiring to the control unit checked and rectified should this be necessary.

skoda.defect: REAR WINDOW WIPER MAY BREAK OFF The rear window wiper may loosen during high speed driving.  This may cause the wiper to break off.
skoda.remedy: Replace the wiper arm and blade

skoda.defect: THE eCALL FUNCTION MAY BE REDUCED DUE TO A FAULT IN THE DATA COMMUNICATION The eCall function may be reduced.
skoda.remedy: The OCU unit of the vehicles affected has to be restarted

skoda.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED There is a possibility of a faulty weld on the gas generator. If the airbag is deployed there is a risk that parts could be projected into the cabin with risk of injury to the occupants.
skoda.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front passenger air bag module with a correctly manufactured version.

skoda.defect: TOWING EYE IN THE VEHICLE TOOL KIT  MAY DETACH DURING USE The welding of the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit may not be to specification. As a result the weld on the eye may fail during use causing loss of propulsion and the towrope with the attached eye can potentially cause property damage and personal injury.
skoda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit.

skoda.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG GENERATOR HOUSING COULD COME LOOSE Increased humidity may have got into the propellant of the gas generator for the drivers air bag.
skoda.remedy: The gas generator of the front airbag on the driver side is replaced.

skoda.defect: THE SIDE AIR BAG WIRING MAY BE INCORRECT The wires for the Air Bag Unit block connector were incorrectly located for the side airbags which could result in the opposite side air bag being ignited
skoda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and if necessary correct control unit

skoda.defect: THE E-CALL FUNCTION MAY NOT WORK CORRECTLY Due to a fault of the software of the OCU control unit (Online Connectivity Unit) the e-call function may work incorrectly.
skoda.remedy: An update of the software of the OCU control unit has to be carried out.

skoda.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On affected vehicles the fuel filter may crack around inlet connection. This will allow fuel to leak which may cause a smell within the vehicle interior and possibly contaminate the road environment. This may affect the handling of the vehicle and of other traffic..
skoda.remedy: Check type of filter fitted. If not of improved type then replace with improved filter.

skoda.defect: THE ELECTRO-MECHANICAL  PARKING BRAKE MAY BE  RELEASED INAPPROPRIATELY WHEN DISENGAGING THE CLUTCH PEDAL The electro-mechanical park brake may be released inappropriately when disengaging the clutch pedal.
skoda.remedy: The software for the brake control will be updated.

skoda.defect: POSSIBLE DISCREPANCY IN THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS OF THE CENTRE REAR SEAT HEAD RESTRAINT The centre rear head restraint may not be to specification.
skoda.remedy: Check the head restraint and replace if necessary.

skoda.defect: SUNROOF MAY INJURE OCCUPANTS WHEN IT IS CLOSED FROM OUTSIDE VEHICLE On certain vehicles with Panorama sun roof the legally specified limits of the clamping forces for convenience opening and closing of the sun roof may not be kept. When closing the Panorama sun roof from outside with the vehicle key (convenience closing) if any body parts are in the operating area of the sun roof they can get pressed against the roof frame and possibly get injured.
skoda.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and deactivate the convenience opening and closing of the Panorama sun roof. To do this the software for the on-board supply control unit and the sun roof control unit must be updated/ configured.

skoda.defect: On certain vehicles with electromechanical brake servo and DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox) of a limited production period there is a possibility that a heat protection mat was incorrectly fitted. In individual cases the brake fluid reservoir can melt and cause a brake fluid leak into the engine compartment. On certain vehicles with electromechanical brake servo and DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox) of a limited production period there is a possibility that a heat protection mat was incorrectly fitted. In individual cases the brake fluid reservoir can melt and cause a brake fluid leak into the engine compartment.
skoda.remedy: A check of the installation of the heat protection mat on affected vehicles will be conducted. If necessary the correct heat shield condition will be restored and an additional heat shield installed.

skoda.defect: ANTI LOCK BRAKE CONTROL UNIT CONCERN There is a risk that an electrical fault in the anti lock brake control unit (ABS) can cause overheating of related electrical components. This may lead to fire damage and cause the service brake to revert to a non-anti lock mode of operation.
skoda.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check the part number and supplier code of the ABS control unit. Renew the ABS control unit where found necessary.

skoda.defect: DAMAGED BATTERY CELLS COULD HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY WHICH COULD LEAD TO A THERMAL OVERLOAD On affected vehicles damaged battery cells could have been installed in the high voltage battery which could lead to a thermal overload.
skoda.remedy: Replace the batteries.

skoda.defect: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM OF PLUG-IN HYBRID VEHICLES WAS PARTLY PRODUCED WITH AN INSUFFICIENT AMOUNT OF SO-CALLED FIRE EXTINGUISHING SAND The fuse in the high-voltage system of plug-in hybrid vehicles was partly produced with an insufficient amount of so-called fire extinguishing sand.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO START The adhesive used to fix the circuit board to the outer casing of the regulator/rectifier may have been affected by moisture. Due to the insufficient adhesion the heat generated can cause the circuit board to deform and lift away from the case. This condition causes excessive heat and uncontrolled electric current output which can result in the poor charging to the battery battery discharge the engine stalling and or a No-start condition.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the regulator rectifier.

suzuki.defect: DRIVE CHAIN MAY STRETCH COME OFF OR BREAK When upshifting between first and second gear if the rider fails to engage second gear a neutral condition will exist continued opening of the throttle will cause high engine RPM. If the rider shifts in to second gear without disengaging the clutch under the very high RPM condition an excess load can be applied to the powertrain. This could cause the drive chain to stretch and in the worst case the drive chain could come off or break.
suzuki.remedy: Replace ECM. Inspect drive chain if free play is detected replace drive chain assembly.

suzuki.defect: IGNITION SWITCH FAULT COULD CAUSE ENGINE TO STOP DURING USE Excess soldering flux is left on the terminals of the ignition switch; continuing to drive in this condition the remaining flux may soften and spread across and cause poor conduction of the ignition switch. In the worst-case scenario the engine could stop when the motorcycle is running.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the ignition lock set.

suzuki.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The sealing area of the fuel tank may not be to specification.  This can result in fuel being allowed to leak pass the fuel pump to tank seal.
suzuki.remedy: Recall all affected machine to check the width of the sealing surface and if found to be out of specification replace the fuel tank.

suzuki.defect: BRAKE AND TAIL LIGHTS MAY FAIL Water ingress may occur in to the harness which can cause corrosion inside the brake light switch. Continued use in this condition can cause a short circuit to occur in the internal circuit of the brake switch. In the worst case the fuse could melt causing the brake and tail lamps not to activate.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the brake light switch.

suzuki.defect: FRAME MAY CRACK AND DETACH It has been identified that there may be a weld of insufficient strength joining a mounting bush to the attachment bracket of the main rear suspension pivot. The circular bush is joined by two opposing welds of approximately a quarter of the circumference each. Under heavy use the welds can develop a fracture and prolonged use in this condition can lead to detachment.
suzuki.remedy: Recalled machines whether displaying the concern or not will have the brackets over-welded around the full circumference of the bush. In cases where the fracture has opened up a modified frame will be fitted.

suzuki.defect: DL800DE Genuine Rear Tyre Recall On affected motorcycles the rear tyre can develop cracking or other deformation of the tyre tread under higher-speed operation conditions. In the worst case under continued use portions of the tyre tread may separate from the tyre structure and impact overall motorcycle dynamics.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the rear tyre

suzuki.defect: Jimny Fuel Pump Replacement The fuel feeding impeller may interfere with the fuel pump housing resulting in the fuel pump malfunction
suzuki.remedy: Replace the fuel pump fitted to affected vehicles

suzuki.defect: Measures Against Loosening of Steering Shaft Nut Steering wheel fastening insufficient the mounting nut may loosen resulting in an abnormal sound or rattling if the use is continued the fitting may become disengaged in the worst case the steering wheel operation may not be possible.
suzuki.remedy: Check and clean the installation condition of the steering wheel in all vehicles install the steering wheel correctly and tighten the nut to the revised specified torque of 43Nm (before: 33Nm).

suzuki.defect: Measures Against Loosening of Steering Shaft Nut Steering wheel fastening insufficient the mounting nut may loosen resulting in an abnormal sound or rattling if the use is continued the fitting may become disengaged in the worst case the steering wheel operation may not be possible.
suzuki.remedy: Check and clean the installation condition of the steering wheel in all vehicles install the steering wheel correctly and tighten the nut to the revised specified torque of 43Nm (before: 33Nm).

suzuki.defect: Rear Brake reservoir cap screw tightening For affected machines the tightening torque of the screws for fixing the rear brake reservoir tank cap was insufficient. If the motorcycle continues to be used in this condition the screw might be loosened.
suzuki.remedy: Tighten the rear brake reservoir tank cap screws to the specified torque during factory assembly.

suzuki.defect: Rear Brake reservoir cap screw tightening For affected machines the tightening torque of the screws for fixing the rear brake reservoir tank cap was insufficient. If the motorcycle continues to be used in this condition the screw might be loosened.
suzuki.remedy: Tighten the rear brake reservoir tank cap screws to the specified torque during factory assembly.

suzuki.defect: On affected motorcycles the tightening torque of the flare nuts that fasten the brake pipes to the ABS unit may be insufficient. On affected motorcycles the tightening torque of the flare nuts that fasten the brake pipes to the ABS unit may be insufficient.
suzuki.remedy: Retighten the ABS unit brake pipe flare nuts to the new torque level then check the brake fluid level and replenish if necessary.

suzuki.defect: Left Rear Brake Pipe Inspection On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the left rear brake pipe was damaged during the tightening process.
suzuki.remedy: Check the left rear brake pipe and replace if damaged.

suzuki.defect: Left Rear Brake Pipe Inspection On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the left rear brake pipe was damaged during the tightening process.
suzuki.remedy: Check the left rear brake pipe and replace if damaged.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO START The adhesive used to fix the circuit board to the outer casing of the regulator/rectifier may have been affected by moisture. Due to the insufficient adhesion the heat generated can cause the circuit board to deform and lift away from the case. This condition causes excessive heat and uncontrolled electric current output which can result in the poor charging to the battery battery discharge the engine stalling and or a No-start condition.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the regulator rectifier.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO START The regulator/rectifier circuit board may have absorbed moisture during storage under high humidity conditions which reduced the strength of the adhesive used to fix the circuit board to the outer casing. Due to the insufficient adhesion the heat generated can cause the circuit board to deform and lift away from the case. This condition causes excessive heat and uncontrolled electric current output which can result in the poor charging to the battery. This can cause the battery to discharge and lead to engine stalling and/or a no-start condition.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the regulator/rectifier.

suzuki.defect: THE GEARSHIFT CABLE MAY BREAK WHILST IN SERVICE The manual transmission gearshift control cable may break due to a lack of maximum strength and durability. This will result in the inability of the driver to either select or de-select the gears.
suzuki.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the gearshift cable.

suzuki.defect: FUEL TANK MAY LEAK It has been identified that a small number of fuel tanks were manufactured with a thinner then specified wall thickness. It is therefore possible that these fuel tanks may not withstand normal impacts and could leak fuel.
suzuki.remedy: Recalled machines will have their fuel tanks replaced with tanks having a wall thickness which meets the specification.

suzuki.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED The brake servo booster  may not have been correctly manufactured. This may cause a harder feel to the brake pedal operation and require more effort from the driver.
suzuki.remedy: Replace Brake Servo Booster on affected vehicles.

suzuki.defect: Some vehicles have an inappropriate design and material on check valve of vacuum pump Some vehicles have an inappropriate design and material on the check valve of brake vacuum pump.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the vacuum pump check valve.

suzuki.defect: UNDER LOW TEMPERATURES THE PRESSURE REGULATOR MAY FREEZE AND CAUSE LEAKAGE Under extremely low ambient temperatures the fuel pressure regulator may become frozen and cause leakage from the junction point of the fuel hose due to an increase in pressure.
suzuki.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and subject them to the following rework action. 1 Replace the fuel pressure regulator.2 Change the vacuum system routing utilising new parts.3 Replace the fuel delivery hose with new improved parts and a new clip. On Grand Vitara XL-7 models items 1 and 2 only will be carried out.

suzuki.defect: FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG BRACKET MAY BE INSECURE The front seat side airbag bracket may not be secured and may not work correctly in the event of an accident. The airbag may fail to deploy in an accident.
suzuki.remedy: On affected vehicles check and secure bracket if required.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible for contamination to get between the tappet and the cam and cause surface damage and wear to the cam. If this condition occurs the valve clearance can become large and cause abnormal engine noises and in worst case engine to stall.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the tappet clearances and in some cases replace cams and adjust tappets.

suzuki.defect: GEAR SELECTION MAY BE LOST It has been identified that due to an improper design of the gear change cable retaining clip contact on the gear lever housing by the clip is possible if excessive force is applied when selecting first gear. In this situation the clip may detach at which point gear selection will be lost.
suzuki.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the gear change cable clip replaced with a quality assured part.

suzuki.defect: 1. POSSIBLE LOSS OF DRIVE 2. THROTTLE MAY STICK 3. RISK OF FIRE 1) The kick starter may not be correctly secure and slip during use. 2) A bolt may have dropped into the air cleaner during assembly. If a bolt is in the air cleaner assembly it is possible for it to enter the throttle body causing the throttle to stick so the rpm cannot be reduced by throttle operation. 3) A fuel hose connector may not have been properly fitted to the injector which can lead to fuel leakage increasing the risk of fire.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and 1) Torque kick starter nut to 55NM 2) Check for foreign material in the air cleaner box. 3) Insert fuel feed pipe onto injector until secure

suzuki.defect: REAR AXLE MAY FAIL The fixing bolts for the rear axle were mixed with bolts that have no anti friction coating. It is possible that a bolt/s may loosen come off or break and the vehicle could become impossible to drive.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace rear axle bolts.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible for contamination to get between the tappet and the cam and cause surface damage and wear to the cam. If this condition occurs the valve clearance can become large and cause abnormal engine noises and in worst case engine to stall.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the tappet clearances and in some cases replace cams and adjust tappets.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible for contamination to get between the tappet and the cam and cause surface damage and wear to the cam. If this condition occurs the valve clearance can become large and cause abnormal engine noises and in worst case engine to stall.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the tappet clearances and in some cases replace cams and adjust tappets.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT Regulator/Rectifier unit may fail in use due to poor adhesion between an internal circuit board and the external heat sink (external casing). resulting in an open circuit and failure.  This causes insufficient battery charging current to the battery and can lead to engine stalling and non start when in use.
suzuki.remedy: Replacement of all Regulator/Rectifiers in VIN range with quality assured units.

suzuki.defect: REDUCED BRAKING EFFICIENCY The ABS system may not function correctly causing longer stopping distances than expected and also the fault may not illuminate the ABS warning lamp. This is due to a none conformance on production with the ABS unit.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the ABS unit.

suzuki.defect: Some vehicles have an inappropriate design and material on check valve of vacuum pump Some vehicles have an inappropriate design and material on the check valve of brake vacuum pump.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the vacuum pump check valve.

suzuki.defect: CVT DRIVE PULLY NUT MAY WORK LOOSE Insufficient torque of the CVT drive pulley securing nut. On affected machines this may cause an abnormal noise leading to the risk of engine stopping and crankshaft damage
suzuki.remedy: On affected machines replacement of CVT nut and crankshaft if required.

suzuki.defect: OIL PUMP COULD DRAW AIR INTO OIL PUMP INLET - ENGINE FAILURE MAY OCCUR There is a possibility that the oil pump could draw air into the pump inlet during certain engine running conditions. As a result it may not deliver adequate lubrication to the engine resulting in damage to the con-rod big end bearing. If major damage did occur to the big end bearings this would be accompanied by abnormal engine noise and in the worse case sudden engine failure possibly causing the rear wheel to momentarily lock up disturbing the riders ability to control the motorcycle.
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit oil guide plate.

suzuki.defect: UNINTENDED VEHICLE BRAKING Due to an error in production the Radar Brake Support System may not have been correctly programmed. In certain instances the system may not recalibrate and could cause unnecessary braking.
suzuki.remedy: Reprogram the Radar Brake Support Control unit.

suzuki.defect: RISK OF FIRE There is a risk of damage (shorting) between the cable connections and glow plugs due to insufficient torque on the connector securing nuts on the relay end posts.
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check the security of the glow plug relay cables and if required replace the glow plug relay.

suzuki.defect: THE TAPER OF THE SURFACE OF THE CRANKSHAFT WHICH FIXES TO THE ROTOR IS INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED The taper of the surface of the crankshaft may be incorrectly manufactured.
suzuki.remedy: Replace rotor and or crankshaft.

suzuki.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The sealing area of the fuel tank may not be to specification.  This can result in fuel being allowed to leak pass the fuel pump to tank seal.
suzuki.remedy: Recall all affected machine to check the width of the sealing surface and if found to be out of specification replace the fuel tank.

suzuki.defect: HEADLIGHT MAY FAIL The headlamp filament may snap as incorrect material has been used in the filament. Should the aforementioned happen the headlamp will stop working and in the worst case scenario the filament can short circuit the lighting system and cause the fuse to fail and the engine to stall.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the headlamp bulb.

suzuki.defect: DL800DE Genuine Rear Tyre Recall Affected vehicles may have been equipped with a rear tyre that can develop cracking or other deformation of the tyre tread under higher-speed operation conditions. In the worst case under continued use portions of the tire tread may separate from the tyre structure and impact overall motorcycle dynamics.
suzuki.remedy: Replace rear tyre.

suzuki.defect: AN400A Fuel Hose Replacement On affected vehicles improper installation of the fuel supply hose assembly during production may cause the fuel supply hose to come into contact with the fuel vapor hose assembly. In a worst-case scenario the fuel supply hose can be abraded to the extent that fuel leaks resulting in an increased risk of fire.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the fuel supply hose assembly and fuel vapor hose assembly

suzuki.defect: Combination Meter Reprogramming or Replacement – Early Notification On affected vehicles equipped with a combination meter system where various information is displayed (warning and indicator lights vehicle gauges messages etc.) due to improper programming the memory device within the combination meter can deteriorate. If this occurs the monitor will not be displayed after IG-ON and will remain in this state permanently. Driving without speedometer and any warning may result in an increased risk of an accident in certain driving conditions.
suzuki.remedy: For Across (PHEV) models check and install modified software or if necessary replace the combination meter. For Swace models install modified software.

suzuki.defect: Combination Meter Reprogramming or Replacement – Early Notification On affected vehicles equipped with a combination meter system where various information is displayed (warning and indicator lights vehicle gauges messages etc.) due to improper programming the memory device within the combination meter can deteriorate. If this occurs the monitor will not be displayed after IG-ON and will remain in this state permanently. Driving without speedometer and any warning may result in an increased risk of an accident in certain driving conditions.
suzuki.remedy: For Across (PHEV) models check and install modified software or if necessary replace the combination meter. For Swace models install modified software.

suzuki.defect: Canister Replacement On affected vehicles the EVAP Carbon canister should be filled with activated carbon however an air gap may develop on the inside during use which may degrade its performance. There is a risk that fuel evaporation gas will leak into the atmosphere resulting in non-compliance with regulations.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the EVAP Carbon cannister.

suzuki.defect: Canister Replacement On affected vehicles the EVAP Carbon canister should be filled with activated carbon however an air gap may develop on the inside during use which may degrade its performance. There is a risk that fuel evaporation gas will leak into the atmosphere resulting in non-compliance with regulations.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the EVAP Carbon cannister.

suzuki.defect: Skid control ECU Reprogramming On affected vehicles when the brake pedal is applied during cornering the driver may temporarily experience a hard brake pedal with reduced braking force causing the brake stopping distance to be more than expected. This may result in an increased risk of a crash.
suzuki.remedy: Install modified software to Skid Control Electronic Control Unit.

suzuki.defect: GSX1300RRQ(Hayabusa) Front Brake Master Cylinder Replacement Recall Campaign (2ND) On affected vehicles under certain conditions the front braking system may experience a negative pressure which can lead to an in increase in brake lever play and in a worst-case scenario the lever contacts the throttle grip.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the front brake master cylinder with a modified part.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE AND CAUSE REAR WHEEL TO LOCK The cam chain adjuster may not provide consistent tension to the cam chain in the engine. This could lead to cam chain breakage. Sudden engine failure while riding could cause rear wheel lockup.
suzuki.remedy: The affected machines will be fitted with a modified cam chain adjuster and modified cam chain guide number two.

suzuki.defect: REAR SEATBELT ANCHORAGES MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to corrosion build up it is possible that the rear seatbelt anchorages may become structurally weak and may fail under heavy braking.
suzuki.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear luggage compartment inspected for corrosion. In all cases the carpet will be changed and the area cleaned. In cases where corrosion is found the area will be cleaned and treated as necessary.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY NOT REMAIN AT IDLE SPEED Gear engagement from neutral and low speed control of the machine could be affected by the idle speed control valve being of incorrect specification
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the idle speed control valve and to reprogramme the Electronic Control Module.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO START The regulator/rectifier circuit board may have absorbed moisture during storage under high humidity conditions which reduced the strength of the adhesive used to fix the circuit board to the outer casing. Due to the insufficient adhesion the heat generated can cause the circuit board to deform and lift away from the case. This condition causes excessive heat and uncontrolled electric current output which can result in the poor charging to the battery. This can cause the battery to discharge and lead to engine stalling and/or a no-start condition.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the regulator/rectifier.

suzuki.defect: STEERING MAY BE LOST It has been found that some front suspension wishbone mounting eyes have insufficient weld applied. This could cause a front suspension to collapse and the loss of directional control.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the senpension arms and replace the suspension arms where necessary.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT Two concerns. 1. If corrosive liquids enters the ignition switch it can cause the terminals inside to corrode. This can result in either the engine still running after the key has been taken out or a disconnection of the power supply allowing the engine to cut out. 2. A wiring loom may abrade on the underside of the fuel tank which can lead to rough running and eventually the engine will cut out.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the wiring loom and reposition the earth point which will solve both the aforementioned concerns.

suzuki.defect: FRONT ENGINE MOUNTING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION If continuously ridden in the condition the front engine mounting bolts may break and in the worse case the frame could break and cause a loss of control on the motorcycle: If continuously ridden in the condition the front engine mounting bolts may break and in the worse case the frame could break and cause a loss of control on the motorcycle.This could seriously affect the handling of the machine.
suzuki.remedy: On affected machines check bolts for security and depending upon outcome of the inspection clean frame and replace bolts or replace bolts and frame.

suzuki.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE It is possible that if the blower motor becomes jammed the temperature fuse of the resistor may not cut out. This can then cause a section of the air conditioning unit to overheat and possibly result in a vehicle fire.
suzuki.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the resistor assembly.

suzuki.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE DRIVERS SIDE AIRBAG WHEN ACTIVATED MAY DEPLOY WITH A FORCE GREATER THAN ORIGINALLY DESIGNED During manufacture of the airbag propellant module the propellant crystals were exposed to a high humidity environment which increased the moisture content to 1.2% with the result that during activation the airbag might deploy with a greater force than originally designed.
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the drivers airbag with a quality assured unit.

suzuki.defect: CHAFING ELECTRICAL WIRING CONCERN The crankshaft position sensor lead may be abraded by the offside drive shaft. Prolonged contact could result in the shaft severing the wire. In this instance the engine would stall.
suzuki.remedy: Recall vehicles and fit an additional clip to the wiring harness to hold the harness away from the drive shaft.

suzuki.defect: REAR DRIVE COULD COME OFF SPROCKETS The left hand drive chain adjuster block may deform and in certain riding conditions allow the adjuster to move forward in the swing arm and cause the rear drive chain to become slack. In the worse case the chain could come off the sprockets while the engine is running and possibly damage the engine.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the drive chain adjuster blocks and nut.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO START The regulator/rectifier circuit board may have absorbed moisture during storage under high humidity conditions which reduced the strength of the adhesive used to fix the circuit board to the outer casing. Due to the insufficient adhesion the heat generated can cause the circuit board to deform and lift away from the case. This condition causes excessive heat and uncontrolled electric current output which can result in the poor charging to the battery. This can cause the battery to discharge and lead to engine stalling and/or a no-start condition.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the regulator/rectifier.

suzuki.defect: FUEL LEAK Due to the incorrect sealing design of the of the fuel pump fitting onto the fuel tank the O-ring on the fuel pump can become twisted during installation. This may allow fuel to leak.
suzuki.remedy: On affected machines replace the Fuel Pump O-ring.

suzuki.defect: INTERNAL DAMAGE TO THE FUEL PUMP MAY RESULT IN A FUEL LEAK Possible malfunction of the fuel pump caused by damage to the inner diaphragm which in the worst case may lead to fuel leaking from the pump body.
suzuki.remedy: Recalled scooters will have the fuel pump replaced.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO START The adhesive used to fix the circuit board to the outer casing of the regulator/rectifier may have been affected by moisture. suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the regulator rectifier.

suzuki.defect: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY IRREGULARLY The airbag may deploy in an irregular fashion and possibly cause the passenger personal injury.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag bracket with a countermeasure part.

suzuki.defect: FUEL LEAK Due to the incorrect sealing design of the of the fuel pump fitting onto the fuel tank the O-ring on the fuel pump can become twisted during installation. This may allow fuel to leak.
suzuki.remedy: On affected machines replace the Fuel Pump O-ring.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE FAILURE MAY OCCUR The bolts fixing the pulley to the water pump may work loose and drop out. If they drop out the water pump will not function and the engine will overheat leading to possible engine damage.
suzuki.remedy: Check bolts for tightness. If existing bolts are to correct torque replace with new bolts. If existing bolts are not to correct torque replace bolts water pump and drive belt.

This can cause the battery to discharge and lead to engine stalling and/or a no-start condition.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO RESTART The insulation material of wiring for the stator may be damaged by engine heat and a short-circuit between the wiring may occur. Continued use of the motorcycle with this condition may cause the generating current of the stator coil to be reduced and insufficient charging to the battery may result. In the worst case it can lead to the engine stalling during running and/or the engine may be impossible to restart.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the Stator Set.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE Rear differential oild level may not be correct due to issue with filling procedure during production. This shortfall in filling could be approx 50% of the required amount. If oil level  in  rear differential is  low the differential could become noisey and eventually seize.
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check oil level. If the level is low the official advice is for the dealer to contact head office. This is a new model and a large percentage are still in manufacturer/dealer control.

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO RESTART The insulation material of wiring for the stator may be damaged by engine heat and a short-circuit between the wiring may occur.
