suzuki.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL Under certain conditions there is a possibility that one of the two brake circuits may fail.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected to replace the brake master cylinder.

suzuki.defect: RISK OF FIRE It has been identified that affected vehicles have been fitted with an ignition switch which encompasses an improper design of the contact points.
suzuki.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the ignition switch replaced.

suzuki.defect: HANDBRAKE CONTROL BUTTON FAULTY Parking Brake release button may become detached
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check operational functionality and if found to be faulty replace handbrake assembly.

suzuki.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF REAR BRAKE DISC PAD There is a possibility that the securing e-ring of the rear brake caliper retaining pad pin could work loose during long high speed riding. In the worst possible case the pad retaining pin can become completely detached and the rear disc pads drop out of the caliper giving a loss of braking performance.
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected machines and replace rear caliper and swinging arm.

suzuki.defect: Some vehicles have an inappropriate design and material on check valve of vacuum pump Some vehicles have an inappropriate design and material on the check valve of brake vacuum pump.
suzuki.remedy: Replace the vacuum pump check valve.

suzuki.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION FASTNERS MAY NOT  BE TO THE CORRECT TORQUE Vehicles may have been produced with the front suspension fastenings incorrectly tightened.
suzuki.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled during which time the subject fastenings will be slackened off and then re-torqued.

suzuki.defect: FUEL TANK MAY LEAK It has been identified that the retaining ring which fastens the fuel pump to the fuel tank may have been incorrectly fitted. This could result in fuel leaking from a full tank if the machine were to be placed on the side stand.
suzuki.remedy: Recalled machines will have the original fuel pump retainer replaced with a new part.

suzuki.remedy: The affected motorcycles are being recalled and fitted with a new steering damper assembly.

suzuki.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM FUEL TANK It has been identified due to the method used to mount the fuel tank that under certain engine conditions it is possible for a hairline crack to develop in the fuel tank. This can result in the fuel tank leaking.
suzuki.remedy: Recalled machines will have the fuel tank removed and visually inspected for cracks following which the tank will be subject to pressure testing. If the tank should be found to leak it will be replaced. In any event all affected machines will be fitted with a re-designed fuel tank mounting kit to prevent future problems.

suzuki.defect: VEHICLE EMISSION OUTPUTS MAY NOT BE CORRECT Vehicle emission outputs may not be correct.
suzuki.remedy: Software upgrade to be carried out

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL AND/OR FAIL TO START The regulator/rectifier circuit board may have absorbed moisture during storage under high humidity conditions which reduced the strength of the adhesive used to fix the circuit board to the outer casing. Due to the insufficient adhesion the heat generated can cause the circuit board to deform and lift away from the case. This condition causes excessive heat and uncontrolled electric current output which can result in the poor charging to the battery. This can cause the battery to discharge and lead to engine stalling and/or a no-start condition.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the regulator/rectifier.

suzuki.defect: DUE TO ENGINE VIBRATION THE FILAMENT INSIDE THE HEADLAMP BULB MAY FAIL IN A SHORT PERIOD OF TIME Due to engine vibration the filament inside the headlamp bulb may fail in a short period of time
suzuki.remedy: Carry out a headlamp bulb replacement

suzuki.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT Regulator/Rectifier unit may fail in use due to poor adhesion between an internal circuit board and the external heat sink (external casing). resulting in an open circuit and failure.  This causes insufficient battery charging current to the battery and can lead to engine stalling and non start when in use.
suzuki.remedy: Replacement of all Regulator/Rectifiers in VIN range with quality assured units.

suzuki.defect: REAR BRAKE CALIPER MAY BECOME DETACHED There is a possibility that the rear brake caliper mounting bolts may become loose. This could cause the rear brake caliper to become detached and the rear brake becoming inoperative. In extreme cases the rear brake caliper may become entangled in the rear wheel possibly causing loss of control and a possible accident.
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected machines to slacken and retorque rear caliper retaining bolts.

suzuki.defect: LOSS OF STEERING    ASSISTANCE. Steering assistance may be lost because the power steering tensioner pulley material is not to specification. The pulley may fail and cause a loss of drive to the hydraulic pump.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected  to inspect and where necessary replace the power steering tensioner pulley.

suzuki.defect: POSSIBILITY OF TANK DEFORMING AND FUEL LEAK The fuel tank breather may have been positioned incorrectly during assembly and become kinked. If the hose is kinked the air flow through the breather hose will be obstructed and the fuel tank internal vacuum can become high and cause the tank to deform with the possibility damage to the tank and fuel leaking.
suzuki.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the fuel tank breather for airflow. The fuel tank breathers will be replaced. If tank damage is found replace fuel tank.

suzuki.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK The fuel tank can split close to the filler neck. This will allow fuel to be spilled onto the rear wheel. This could cause a loss of traction and may cause the rider to fall off.
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit a modified quality assured fuel tank.

suzuki.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The sealing area of the fuel tank may not be to specification.  This can result in fuel being allowed to leak pass the fuel pump to tank seal.
suzuki.remedy: Recall all affected machine to check the width of the sealing surface and if found to be out of specification replace the fuel tank.

suzuki.remedy: Replace the door harnesses of the affected vehicles.

suzuki.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF GRAB RAIL The fixing bracket portion of the Pillion Passenger Grab Handle may not have enough strength and if excessive force is applied to this area such as using the Grab Handle to lift or drag the motorcycle the Grab Handle could break or partially fail at this point. This in turn could lead to the complete failure of the Grab Handle during sudden hard braking with a pillion passenger.
suzuki.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit a modified grab handle.

suzuki.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit ratchet type chain tensioner adjuster kit.

swift.defect: Trekker Brake Line Issue There is a potential issue with a vehicle brake line installation on a MY24/25 Trekker motorhome product. swift.remedy: Removal inspection and relocating of the tank.

swift.defect: INCORRECT TYRE VALVES FITTED Risk that some wheels are fitted with the incorrect tyre pressure valves. If the valve fails the wheel could deflate whilst in use and effect the directional control of the vehicle.

switch.defect: Handpole Casting failure On affected vehicles the hand pole fixing bracket/casting at the celling may fracture and break free resulting in the potential risk of passenger fall and injury when using the hand pole.
switch.remedy: Remedy is to replace the current hand pole casting with the previous design casting which can handle more force.

switch.defect: Solo EV Roof Pod Detached On affected vehicles the GRP roof panels / POD may detach during adverse weather conditions. If the GRP roof pod detaches this may cause harm to pedestrians and other road users.
switch.remedy: Remedy is to inspect roof panels in area of fixing screws and re-bond panels as required.

switch.defect: Anti Roll Bar C Clamp Crack On affected vehicles the C Clamp supporting the anti-roll bar may deform and shear at the upper mounting face resulting in increased body roll.
switch.remedy: Replace Anti-roll bar C clamps with redesigned clamp.

switch.defect: Solo ramp failure debonding On affected vehicles the bonding strength of the wheelchair ramp to hinge plate may not meet requirements. A de-bonded ramp could collapse without warning while in use.
switch.remedy: Inspect wheelchair ramp and replace as necessary.

sym.defect: THROTTLE CONTROL MAY BE LOST The throttle return spring may fail which will affect throttle control and lead to a general fluctuation in engine revs possibly resulting in constant hight rpm.
sym.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the carburettors.

sym.defect: FRAME MAY FAIL The frame may crack adjacent to the rear footrests which if not rectified in the worst case will lead to the frame collapsing and loss of control.
sym.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to identify the frame and where necessary replace the frame with one of a modified design.

sym.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It is possible for a crack to form around the fuel outlet to tank joint. This could lead to a fuel leak and in the worst case fire.

tadano.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL Possibility that leaking exhaust could damage the electric wiring directing steering control resulting in loss of directional control of the vehicle.
tadano.remedy: Recall affected vehicles inspect electric wiring directing steering control and install protection devices.

tata.defect: FAILURE OF SWIVEL JOINT BALL PIN The front suspension lower swivel joint ball pin may break and cause a loss of steering control.
tata.remedy: Fit modified swivel joints to the right and left side front suspension units.

tata.defect: SUSPENSION TIE-ROD MAY FRACTURE Under rigorous driving conditions there is a possibility that the tie-rod may fracture and may affect steering control.
tata.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace tie-rod with modified type.

tata.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The steering idler arm may not have adequate end clearance on its fulcrum and could pick up on its retaining nut shearing the split pin. This could allow detachment of the nut with an adverse effect on steering control.
tata.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check that the steering idler arm has adequate end clearance on its fulcrum. Where the clearance is insufficient the correct clearance will be established by shimming.

tata.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL. There is a possibility of welds cracking on the steering wheel.  In extreme circumstances if the symptoms are ignored the cracks can progress into total separation causing loss of steering control.
tata.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the steering wheel with a redesigned steering wheel.

teal.defect: DRAW BAR MAY HAVE MOVEMENT IF LOAD IS SECURED INCORRECTLY Draw bar attached to light board may have movement if load is secured incorrectly and light board may become detached
teal.remedy: Fit a revised longer clamping bar

temared.defect: The shafts to accommodate the extendable ramps have been manufactured with insufficient wall strength The shafts to accommodate the extendable ramps have been manufactured with insufficient wall strength.
temared.remedy: Inspect and repair any existing damage. Fit additional reinforcement plates to the frame for the extendable ramps.�

temsa.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY RELEASE UNINTENTIONALLY The Hand Brake Valve handle automatic locking function may not maintain the park position. The handle may remain in the lock only temporarily and flip back from the parking position into the driving position in which case the vehicle can runaway.
temsa.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and exchange the Hand Brake Valve with a quality assured unit.

temsa.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It is possible that the coupling of the intermediate steering shaft may become damaged.  If this occurs it could ultimately result in the loss of steering control.
temsa.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required replace the intermediate steering shaft.

temsa.defect: VEHICLE MAY CATCH FIRE Due to a production error the air-conditioning fan may overheat and in extreme cases cause fire.
temsa.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the air-conditioning fan motor. These vehicles should not be left unattended without first isolating the power supply.

tenneco.defect: POOR WELDING CAUSING FOOT BRACKET TO BREAK It has been established that the welding on the foot bracket of the shock absorber is not to specification. This can result in the failure/detachment of the foot bracket which could cause loss of control of the vehicle.
tenneco.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the shock absorber and if found to be one of the affected unit then replace the unit with a quality assured item.

tesla.defect: Update Vehicle Firmware to Remedy Anti Pinch Feature of Right Front Window On affected vehicles a firmware feature that allowed for high-speed sampling of the right front window motor encoder was not enabled bringing vehicles out of compliance with   the relevant regulations for Auto-reversing Requirements.
tesla.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) update.

tesla.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE Potential failure of steering gear motor bolts when exposed to long term high corrosive environment. This can lead to loss of power assistance to the steering which would result in additional effort from the driver to steer the vehicle.
tesla.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the aluminium bolts with stainless steel bolts. Where necessary the steering rack will be replaced.

tesla.defect: THE UPPER STEERING COLUMN BOLT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FITTED The upper steering column bolt may not have been fitted.
tesla.remedy: Inspect the upper steering column bolt fitment and replace where necessary.

tesla.defect: SEAT BELT D RING Front Seat belt top loop may not be secured correctly.
tesla.remedy: Check and secure the top loop as necessary.

tesla.defect: SEAT MAY NOT CORRECTLY LATCH The left-side fold-flat second row seat may have a misadjusted cable that controls the recliner mechanisms. Incorrect adjustment may prevent one of the recliners from fully latching.
tesla.remedy: On affected vehicles check cable and adjust if necessary.

tesla.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG WILL NOT DEPLOY Due to a firmware error the vehicle's restraint control module will not recognise the passenger seat is occupied. In the event of an accident the passenger airbag will not deploy
tesla.remedy: On affected vehicles the updated software will be downloaded to the vehicle. However the installation of the software will immobilise the vehicle and the vehicle keepr should install when the vehicle is suitably parked up. .

tesla.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED The propellant in the front passenger airbag inflator might degrade over time which could cause the inflator body torture in the event the airbag is deployed. This could cause injury to occupants.
tesla.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger airbag.

tesla.defect: THE FRONT SUSPENSION LATERAL LINK MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY TORQUED The front suspension lateral link may be insufficiently torqued.
tesla.remedy: Inspect the connection of both front suspension lateral links to the sub-frame. Replace any related damaged components and ensure correct torque of fastening bolts.

tesla.defect: Loss of Rearview Camera Display Recall On a small percentage of affected vehicles upon vehicle power up the car computer board may experience a short resulting in the loss of rear view camera functionality .
tesla.remedy: Over the air software update or Car Computer replacement if necessary.

tesla.defect: Update Vehicle Software To Rectify EPAS Functionality On affected vehicles operating with a software release prior to 2023.38.4 an overvoltage breakdown in the steering rack may overstress motor drive components on the printed circuit board. If the overstress condition occurs while the vehicle is driving steering assistance will not be affected and a visual alert will illuminate. Once the vehicle speed comes to a standstill a loss of steering assistance may occur and loss of steering assistance will persist when the vehicle is driven again. Manual steering without steering assistance remains available to the driver.
tesla.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update.

tesla.remedy: Firmware release 2022.12.3 or later reverses the power management process introduced in firmware release 2022.8 and maintains eCall audio functionality.

tesla.defect: THE BRAKE CALLIPER BOLTS MAY NOT BE SECURED TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION The brake calliper bolts may not be secured to the correct specification.

tesla.remedy: Ensure current software is installed and upgrade the VCM daughterboard to a 64GB Micron eMMC.

tesla.remedy: Inspect rear lamp housing and wiring harness and repair or replace the defective components as necessary.

tesla.defect: THE PROPELLANT IN THE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY DEGRADE OVER TIME The front passenger airbag inflator could rupture in the event the airbag is deployed.
tesla.remedy: Replace the front passenger  air bag on affected vehicles.

tesla.defect: MISALIGNMENT OF THE HOOD LATCH MAY PREVENT LATCHING OF THE SECONDARY LATCH Misalignment of the hood latch may prevent latching of the secondary latch.
tesla.remedy: Inspect the secondary hood latch on affected vehicles. If the hood is not properly retained by the secondary latch the latch mechanism will be reassembled and repositioned to assure proper alignment.

tesla.defect: THE REAR-VIEW CAMERA HARNESS MAY FAIL CAUSING NO IMAGE IN THE CENTRE DISPLAY The rear-view camera harness may fail causing no image in the centre display.
tesla.remedy: Fit a harness guide protector and if necessary install a new harness.

tesla.defect: THE CURTAIN SIDE AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY The curtain side airbags may not deploy correctly.
tesla.remedy: Inspect for proper alignment and orientation of the left- and right-curtain side airbag. Re-align as necessary.

tesla.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR Although highly unlikely it is possible that the wiring harness for the 12V auxiliary battery could as a result of incorrect routing chaff on the carbon fibre armature of the vehicle. If this condition exists and is not addressed it could in time result in a short circuit and electrical arching which could cause a fire. The high voltage main battery pack and associated wiring is not affected in any way and the issue poses no threat to the electrical system that powers the vehicle.
tesla.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the wiring and install a protective sleeve as an additional precautionary measure.

tesla.defect: SEATBELT MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY The driver and/or front passenger seatbelt could be improperly connected to the outboard lap pretensioner. The connection is secured by means of a bolt that fastens the steel anchor plate on the end of the seat belt to a steel anchor plate on the end of the pretensioner cable. If a collision occurs and the aforementioned condition exists there is an elevated risk of additional injury to the occupant of the seat.
tesla.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected for inspection of the seatbelt connection to the pretensioner and the anchor plates. If the condition is evident the seatbelt/s will be reassembled to ensure proper connection.

the.defect: SEAT FIXING REAR BOLTS MAY FAIL The rear fixing bolts of the FASP swivel seat can under extreme circumstances fail.
the.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts replaced with those of a higher specification.

the.defect: Starter Ring Gear For certain machines an issue involving the starter ring gear fixings may lead to the machine coming to a sudden stop during operation due to mechanical lock up.
the.remedy: Clean and degrease of the primary drive gear and starter ring gear and apply validated thread locker to each fixing.

the.defect: DAMPER MOUINT BRACKET MAY FAIL The damper upper mounting brackets may fail.  If ignored for an extended period chassis damage may develop.  Additionally it is possible that either or both of the axle parallel links may fail which in worse case would allow the axles to move out of position.
the.remedy: Recall the trailers that are likely to be affected to replace the top damper mounting brackets and related parts including the parallel link assemblies.

the.defect: SEAT FIXING REAR BOLTS MAY FAIL The rear fixing bolts of the FASP swivel seat can under extreme circumstances fail.
the.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts replaced with those of a higher specification.

the.defect: WELD ON PIN BOX MOUNTING PLATE MAY FAIL Insufficient weld applied to king pin box mounting which in exceptional circumstances could lead to the separation of trailer from the drawing vehicle.
the.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to apply the correct weld detail and additional support brace.

thompsons.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL Under certain conditions it is possible for the steering arm to contact the bolts retaining the exhaust mounting bracket. Over a protracted period it is possible for the drag link to weaken sufficiently for the steering to fail with attendant loss of directional control.
thompsons.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to modify the exhaust bracket fit different bolts to the exhaust bracket and replace the steering arm.

thule.defect: LOAD CARRIER FIXPOINTS MAY BECOME LOOSE It is possible for the bolt that fixes the load carrier to the roof to fail which can allow the carrier and its load to become insecure.
thule.remedy: Recall the kits that are likely to be affected to replace the affected bolts.

thule.defect: LOAD CARRIER FIXPOINTS MAY BECOME LOOSE It is possible for the bolt that fixes the load carrier to the roof to fail which can allow the carrier and its load to become insecure.
thule.remedy: Recall the kits that are likely to be affected to replace the affected bolts.

timberwolf.defect: TRAILER CHASSIS MAY CRACK Affected machines may have been constructed using a steel grade other than that specified by the manufacturer leading to a risk of the chassis structural integrity being compromised.
timberwolf.remedy: Repair the chassis using chassis members constructed of the correct grade steel

timken.defect: A POSSIBLE INTERFERENCE CONDITION MAY PRESENT ITSELF ON INSTALLATION OF THE BEARING AND CAUSE SPINDLE FAILURE Design error leading to improper mounting of bearing inner ring and damage to wheel spindle.
timken.remedy: Replace bearing kits with corrected design.

tmd.defect: PRODUCT DEMONSTRATES A LOWER THAN SPECIFIED FRICTION COEFFICIENT IN CERTAIN TESTS Brake pads supplied with incorrect friction material.

Textar bi-metallic (two piece) brake disc Some brake discs within the aforementioned article numbers have not been manufactured in accordance with specifications. These defective brake discs pose a risk that the vehicle may skid when braking or experience a longer braking distance.

topran.defect: BRACKET MAY FAIL The casting bracket for the front axle rear mounting may not have been produced to the correct specification. This could result in failure of the bracket and loss of direction control.
topran.remedy: Recall all affected components and replace with new quality control components.

toyama.defect: WHEEL MAY CRACK It has been identified that reports of wheel breakages following impact were higher than was thought to be normal.
toyama.remedy: To address the concern the importer will contact known retailers and populate the wolfrace.com web site with relevant recall information in an attempt to retrieve subject wheels which will be replaced with a quality assured product.

toyota.defect: Incorrect Rear Coil Springs Installed on Certain Toyota Proace and Proace Verso On affected vehicles incorrect specification rear coil springs may have been installed.
toyota.remedy: Carry out check and replace coil springs if required.

toyota.defect: Engine control unit reprogramming due to IUPR calculation problem on certain Toyota Proace and Proace Verso models For certain vehicles there is an error in the specific software calibrations of the Engine Control Unit. In certain cases this condition may result in a delayed activation of the malfunction indicator (MIL) allowing the vehicle to operate with tailpipe emissions exceeding limits before the MIL is triggered
toyota.remedy: Update to the software calibration of the Engine electronic control unit (ECU).

toyota.defect: Engine control unit reprogramming due to IUPR calculation problem on certain Toyota Proace and Proace Verso models For certain vehicles there is an error in the specific software calibrations of the Engine Control Unit. In certain cases this condition may result in a delayed activation of the malfunction indicator (MIL) allowing the vehicle to operate with tailpipe emissions exceeding limits before the MIL is triggered
toyota.remedy: Update to the software calibration of the Engine electronic control unit (ECU).

If this occurs the circuit inside the camera can short leading to an inability to display an image of the area in front of and/or behind the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Inspect camera and replace if necessary

toyota.defect: 2nd Seat Spring Replacement on Highlander For certain  vehicles equipped with second row seats that use recliner assemblies to unlock the seatbacks allow for seatback angle adjustment and locking due to a design change made by the supplier the recliner teeth may not fully engage during seatback adjustment. This could lead to the seatback not remaining in a locked position increasing the risk of injury in the event of a crash at higher speeds.
toyota.remedy: Replace the return springs in the recliner assembly with improved ones.

toyota.defect: Low pressure fuel pump replacement For certain vehicles which are equipped with a low-pressure fuel pump that supplies fuel  through use of an impeller made of resin the material in this impeller may swell sufficiently to interfere with surrounding components potentially causing the fuel pump to become inoperative
toyota.remedy: Replacement of the fuel pump

toyota.defect: Low pressure fuel pump replacement For certain vehicles which are equipped with a low-pressure fuel pump that supplies fuel  through use of an impeller made of resin the material in this impeller may swell sufficiently to interfere with surrounding components potentially causing the fuel pump to become inoperative
toyota.remedy: Replacement of the fuel pump

toyota.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: Inconsistent Tyre pressure monitoring system alert on certain Toyota Proace City For certain vehicles the indirect tyre pressure monitoring within the Electronic Stability Control (ESC) software may result in the warning light not illuminating illuminating with a delay or triggering a false warning.
toyota.remedy: Update to the software calibration of the Electronic Stability Control unit (ESC).

toyota.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY FAIL TO RETURN TO IDLE It has been identified that on affected vehicles condensation resulting from cold-weather use of the heater or other causes may form on the worn surface of a component within the throttle pedal assembly known as the friction device. If this occurs there is a possibility that in the worst case the accelerator pedal may return slowly or does not return to the engine idle position.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a precision-cut steel reinforcing bar fitted into the accelerator pedal assembly which will create a space in order to reduce the surface tension between the friction device and  a component referred to as the pedal arm. The subject bar also strengthens the reaction force of the spring that returns the accelerator pedal to it's non-pressed position.

toyota.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY CAUSE FAILURE OF THE POWER ASSISTANCE It is possible for condensation water droplets to form within the relay in the electric power steering control module. This can cause a short circuit across terminals within the relay. If this occurs and abnormally high voltage is detected by the control module it will shut down the power to the EPS which will coincide with a warning buzzer and light illuminating on the dash. This will result in the loss of power assistance to the steering.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the power control module.

toyota.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY COULD BE REDUCED Due to possible contamination within a brake pipe on right-hand drive vehicles foreign material can potential enter the brake master cylinder and cause damage to the brake seals.  This can result in a reduction of braking efficiency and increased brake travel.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles where the brake master cylinder and offending brake pipe will be replaced.

toyota.defect: REAR BRAKE PIPE CONCERN In frequent stop/start conditions in snow and severely cold weather  compacted snow/ice may build up on the inner face of the wheel disc.  In extreme circumstances the snow/ice may strike and distort the metal pipe that connects to the rear brake cylinder.  Impaired braking and a hydraulic fluid leak may result.
toyota.remedy: Fit a modified and re-routed brake pipe.

toyota.defect: Remote Parking via Mobile App on Certain Toyota C-HR Affected vehicles are equipped with an advanced park system which can be operated remotely by the driver when outside the vehicle using a smartphone application. There is a risk an error may occur in an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) when the finger movements on the smartphone application are stopped or the finger is removed within three seconds after the remote-control function is activated. If this occurs the shift range will be changed from Park to Drive or Reverse and the brakes will be released without any finger operation on the smartphone resulting in the vehicle creeping forward or backward which could increase the risk of a crash.
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Clearance Sonar Electronic Control Unit (ECU) and Brake Electronic Control Unit (ECU) with modified software.

toyota.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY NOT FUNCTION The steering column assembly in affected vehicles contains electrical connections to the driver's air bag module housed in a spiral cable assembly which includes a Flexible Flat Cable (FFC). Due to the shape and location of the FFC's retainer the FFC could contact a small point of the retainer and become damaged when the steering wheel is turned. In FFC's with seven channel circuits this damage could occur to a circuit on the FFC that provides connectivity to the driver's air bag module. If connectivity is lost the air bag warning light will illuminate. In addition the driver's air bag could become deactivated causing it not to deploy in the event of a crash. This could increase the risk of injury to the driver.
toyota.remedy: Replace spiral cables with new ones

toyota.defect: REAR SUSPENSION ARM MAY SEPARATE If the rear suspension arm is adjusted as part of a wheel alignment or other repairs whilst in service it is possible that backlash can occur. This can allow corrosion to develop and cause the threads to deteriorate. Ultimately this could result in failure of the arm with a resultant loss of control of the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the torque on the arm. Where necessary the arm will be replaced.

toyota.defect: THE EMERGENCY CALLING SYSTEM (eCall) MAY NOT FUNCTION WHEN REQUIRED The emergency calling system (eCall) may not function when required.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the emergency calling system and update DCM software. If the DCM is found to be damaged replace it with updated software.

toyota.defect: HORN MAY NOT OPERATE Due to a none conformity of the steering wheel it is possible that frequent quick steering movements could cause the horn wiring which is internal to the steering wheel to fail and therefore the horn will not function.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicle that are likely to be affected to replace the steering wheel.

toyota.defect: RISK OF FIRE Oil may accumulate in the turbo charger and in certain circumstances flow into the combustion chamber. This may cause engine damage. In extreme cases oil can be ejected from the engine and if it comes in contact with an ignition source may result in a fire.
toyota.remedy: Depending vehicle diagnosis modify intercooler layout to improve air flow; upgrade ECU software; upgrade turbo charger and/or vacuum pump

toyota.defect: INCORRECT PROGRAMMING IN RELATION TO TRANSMISSION SHIFT POSITION STATUS MIGHT CAUSE HYBRID SYSTEM TO SHUT DOWN Due to incorrect programming the hybrid vehicle ECU can incorrectly determine that the validation signal is erroneous for the shifter position
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Hybrid ECU.

toyota.defect: CRACKS MAY APPEAR IN THE BYPASS PIPE IN THE RECIRCULATING GAS COOLING UNIT Cracks may occur in the pipe connection of the Exhaust Gas Recirculation device�s cooler.
toyota.remedy: Replace EGR cooler on affected vehicles.

toyota.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR In the Hybrid system of the subject vehicles  there is an electrically driven water pump assembly that circulates coolant through the hybrid components. It is possible the coil wire of the electric motor installed in the water pump may have been scratched during the coiling manufacturing process at the supplier. In this condition the coil wire may corrode at the scratched portion and in some cases break. If this occurs the water pump could stop working leading to illumination of various warning lights in the instrument panel. In some cases a short circuit occurs between adjacent coil wires resulting in a blown fuse for the electric power supply circuit. This will cause the hybrid system to stop while the vehicle is being driven which increases the risk of an accident.
toyota.remedy: Replace the HV Electric Water Pump

toyota.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The tightening torque of the fuel pipes and the injectors of the engine may be incorrect. This could cause excessive stress at the tightening area and result in cracking. These cracks may occur in the injector resulting in fuel leaking onto the road surface. This could affect other road users.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the injectors.

toyota.defect: ELECTRIC POWER STEERING SENSOR MAY MALFUNCTION If the vehicle is driven over/on certain types of roadside safety side strips (Rumble Strips) it is possible that the Electric Power Steering (EPS) control unit could incorrectly interpret the signal from the sensor. This could result in the need for the driver to apply extra effort into steering the vehicle under some driving conditions.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and either reprogramme the EPS control unit or the replacement of the steering column and control unit.

toyota.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED It is possible that a brake fluid leak could develop on brake pipe unions of either of the rear brake calipers or rear brake cylinders. If this occurs then the driver will receive a warning in the form of a warning light illuminating on the instrument panel. However if the driver does not heed this warning the braking efficiency of the vehicle could be impaired and the stopping distance increased.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check re-tighten the unions and if required replace any damaged/defective components.

toyota.defect: POSSIBILITY OF TYRE DEFLATION On certain Avensis vehicles equipped with 16 inch steel wheels due to the shape of the wheel trim there is a possibility that the edge of the wheel trim may interfere with the sidewall of the tyre. Should this occur whilst the vehicle is being driven the wheel trims may rotate which could lead to interference with the tyre valve. In the worst case and if the vehicle is continuously driven in this condition loss of tyre pressure could ensue.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steel wheels (standard equipment) replaced with aluminium alloy wheels.

toyota.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF STEERING The steering intermediate shaft pinch bolt may not have been tightened correctly during assembly. The bolt may loosen and cause abnormal noise and freeplay at the steering wheel. Prolonged use in this state may cause loss of steering.
toyota.remedy: Inspect steering pinch bolt. If necessary replace intermediate shaft and bolt or intermediate shaft bolt and steering link assembly.

toyota.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED Some of the recalled vehicles will have been fitted with brake discs which have incorrect mechanical resistance characteristics. Vehicles with the incorrect brake discs fitted could have reduced braking efficiency and the discs could crack.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check which brake discs are fitted and where necessary fit the correct brake discs.

toyota.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT INFLATE DURING A COLLISION Due to improper assembly of the airbag inflator used in the side airbag curtain shield airbag and knee airbag systems the subject airbags may not fully inflate during a collision resulting in an increased risk of injury to the vehicle's occupants.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject airbags replaced.

toyota.defect: FRONT COIL SPRING MAY FRACTURE RESULTING IN THE POSSIBILITY OF TYRE DAMAGE Due to insufficient surface treatment prior to painting the paint on the front coil springs may not have adhered properly. This can render the spring susceptible to corrosion in environments where road salt is used. Prolonged use of the vehicle in this condition may cause the spring to fracture which in extreme cases can lead to tyre damage.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have both front coil springs replaced with quality assured items.

toyota.defect: LOSS OF POWER Internal cluctch pistons may have been incorrectly manufacturerd. This may cause incorrect transmission operation.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect clutch opertaion. Depending on out come either replace clutch component or transmission unit.

toyota.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK Due to an improper washing process of a metal part within the brake master cylinder there is a possibility that the groove for installing the rubber seal ring which is located at the end of the master cylinder may be corroded. In this condition brake fluid may leak from the seal or a small amount of air may enter the master cylinder which could lead to an increase in vehicle stopping distance.
toyota.remedy: Vehicles that are likely to be affected will be checked and a quality assured part fitted if necessary.

toyota.defect: VEHICLE MAY NOT ENTER FAILSAFE DRIVING MODE AS INTENDED IN RESPONSE TO CERTAIN HYBRID SYSTEM FAULTS The vehicle may not enter a failsafe driving mode as intended.
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Power Management ECU.

toyota.defect: ROAD WHEEL SPOKES MAY CRACK AND SEPARATE It has been identified that steel wheels of insufficient strength have been fitted to some grades of RAV4 vehicles fitted with diesel engines. The possibility then exist that a crack may appear on the spoke(s) of the wheel which in the worst case could cause the spoke to separate.
toyota.remedy: Affected vehicles will have their wheels replaced with those of an improved quality.

toyota.defect: BEDLINER MAY DETACH FROM DECK It is possible that on single cab versions of the Hilux the body bedliner may not have been secured to body correctly. This could result in the bedliner detaching from the vehicle if it travels at high speeds.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and secure the body bedliner. If damaged the bedliner will be replaced.

toyota.defect: SEATBELT MAY NOT PERFORM AS DESIGNED In the event of a high-speed collision principally in the frontal direction there is a possibility that the lap belt webbing on the outboard seats of the second row  could contact a portion of the seat cushion frame become cut and separate.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a plastic protector to the seat frame.

toyota.defect: LOSS OF STEERING It is possible that the splines of the extension shaft on vehicles equipped with Electric Motor assisted Power Steering (EMPS) may not have received the correct hardness treatment. This can cause the spline to distort and wear and eventually result in loss of steering.
toyota.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and if necessary replace the shaft.

toyota.defect: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT There is a possibility that water could enter the cabin through the panels separating the cabin and the engine compartment. If this occurs water could reach and affect some electrical components such as the airbag module and possibly cause unexpected airbag deployment.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and apply sealant to close the gap between the affected body panels.

toyota.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY The subject vehicles are equipped with right front seat side airbags which may not deploy in a collision as intended.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right front seat side airbags.

toyota.defect: Affected vehicles are fitted with a high-pressure fuel pump which over time could develop a crack which could lead to a fuel leak and a risk of a vehicle fire. Affected vehicles are fitted with a high-pressure fuel pump which over time could develop a crack which could lead to a fuel leak and a risk of a vehicle fire.�
toyota.remedy: Check and replace high pressure fuel pump if necessary.�

toyota.defect: TOW BALL MAY FRACTURE On Toyota Avensis Previa and Lexus GS fitted with a Toyota or Lexus genuine or Brink branded (only on Avensis) detachable towing hitch the possibility exists that the detachable towing ball in some exceptional cases (under severe mechanical stress) might develop a crack. In a worst case the detachable towing ball might fracture and/or fail.
toyota.remedy: Lexus/Toyota dealers will replace the detachable towing ball and housing at no cost to vehicle owners.

toyota.defect: ROOF WINDOW GLASS MAY DETACH The roof window glass may not have been correctly installed . This may allow the glass to separate from its frame. Initially this will lead to wind noise but continued use could cause the glass to detach from the frame.
toyota.remedy: Replace roof glass.

toyota.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the possibility exists that the sound insulator beneath the front seatbelt pretensioner may become damaged by the high temperature gas generated when the device is activated during a collision. In the worst case should the insulator ignite a post-collision fire may ensue.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the sound insulator removed from beneath the centre body pillars.

toyota.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER COULD DEVELOP AN INTERNAL COOLANT LEAK A possibility that the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) cooler could develop an internal coolant leak
toyota.remedy: Replace the EGR cooler in all involved vehicles and if necessary replace the inlet manifold.

toyota.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK LEADING TO ENGINE CUT OUT It has been identified that due to a quality issue a crack or fracture can develop in the fuel passage of the fuel injector. This could therefore result in a fuel leak and possibly cause an engine stalling situation.
toyota.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the affected components with countermeasure components.

toyota.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY BECOME UNSECURED The steering column mounting bracket may not be of sufficient strength if the steering is repeatedly and forcibly turned on full lock. This over a prolonged period can result in the failure of the bracket and ultimate detachment of the steering column.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the steering column mounting bracket.

toyota.defect: FRONT WIPER MAY FAIL Due to a welding fault in the wiper motor assembly it is possible that the wiper may malfunction. In the extreme cases the wipers may fail totally.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the wiper motor assembly.

toyota.defect: TOWING HITCH MAY DETACH It has been identified thaton certain vehicles equipped with a genuine Toyota towing hitch the hitch installation bolts were over-tightened. In the worst case the bolts may break under certain conditions of usage.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hitch installation bolts replaced and tightened to the correct torque.

toyota.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY CAUSE FAILURE OF THE POWER ASSISTANCE It is possible for condensation water droplets to form within the relay in the electric power steering control module. This can cause a short circuit across terminals within the relay. If this occurs and abnormally high voltage is detected by the control module it will shut down the power to the EPS which will coincide with a warning buzzer and light illuminating on the dash. This will result in the loss of power assistance to the steering.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the power control module.

toyota.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the DCM may not complete the shutdown process within a specific period of time when the ignition is turned off causing the DCM to not restart at the next ignition cycle and making the e-Call function unavailable. As a result the vehicles do not comply with relevant regulations. On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the DCM may not complete the shutdown process within a specific period of time when the ignition is turned off causing the DCM to not restart at the next ignition cycle and making the e-Call function unavailable. As a result the vehicles do not comply with relevant regulations.
toyota.remedy: The software of the DCM (Data Communication Module) will be updated via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update.

toyota.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING ASSISTANCE It has been identified there is a possibility one of the nuts fixing the brake pedal to the brake booster may not have been tightened to the correct specification. This could result in the brake booster opening without warning and causing a sudden loss of brake assistance.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the torque setting of the nuts fixing the brake pedal to the brake booster. If found not to be within specification then the brake booster will be replaced and the new nuts will be tightened to the correct specification.

toyota.defect: CAR SPOILER MAY BECOME DETACHED There is a possibility that the car spoiler may become loose or detached.
toyota.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to revise spoiler fixing method to bolts.

toyota.defect: A POTENTIAL CRACK COULD DEVELOP IN THE FUEL EVAPORATIVE EMISSION CONTROL UNIT MOUNTED IN THE FUEL TANK Possible fuel leak from fuel tank.
toyota.remedy: Replace the fuel tank emission control Canister.

toyota.defect: ENGINE WIRE HARNESS CONNECTED TO HYBRID VEHICLE POWER CONTROL UNIT COULD CONTACT COVER Due to assembly variation a portion of the engine wire harness could contact the cover.Should the insulation wear and the core wires become exposed there is an increased risk of a vehicle fire.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the engine wire harness and repair or replace it if necessary.

toyota.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It is possible moisture or other fluids may enter the drivers window and contaminate the main power window switch. If this occurs and the switch is damaged it could overheat and cause it to melt and/or smoke.  If this situation is not identified it could result in a vehicle fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and check the switch. If the switch is not damaged a waterproof cover will be fitted. If the switch is damaged it will be replaced and a waterproof cover will be fitted.

toyota.defect: WHEEL HUB MAY BECOME LOOSE One or more of the rear hub retaining bolts may have not been tightened to the correct specification. A bolt or bolts  may work loose and could have an adverse affect on the braking performance or could cause a wheel to lock unintentionally.
toyota.remedy: Recall affected vehicles. Check bolts for tightness and if required tighten to correct specification. Where necessary replace bolts.

toyota.defect: Certain transmission front suspension and battery terminal fixings may not be tightened correctly. Certain transmission front suspension and battery terminal fixings may not be tightened correctly.
toyota.remedy: Check and tighten all fixings to the correct torque.

toyota.defect: ONE OR BOTH HEADRESTS OF THE FIRST ROW 2-PERSON BENCH SEAT CANNOT BE LOCKED INTO PLACE There is a possibility that one or both headrests of the first row 2-person bench seat cannot be locked into place.
toyota.remedy: Inspect and replace the headrest(s) if necessary.

toyota.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE CENTRE REAR SEAT BELT MAY BE DAMAGED BY A SHARP EDGE OF THE BRACKET There is a possibility that the centre rear seat belt may be damaged a sharp edge of the bracket.
toyota.remedy: Add a protective material to the seat belt anchor bracket.

toyota.defect: WRONG DRIVER AIRBAG INFLATOR IS FITTED Affected vehicles may have received the wrong replacement airbag assembly through a previous recall. This replacement air bag may not deploy as intended.
toyota.remedy: Recall affected vehicles remove existing air bag assembly and replace it with the correct version.

toyota.remedy: Depending vehicle diagnosis modify intercooler layout to improve air flow; upgrade ECU software; upgrade turbo charger and/or vacuum pump

toyota.defect: LOSS OF STEERING It is possible that the splines of the extension shaft on vehicles equipped with Electric Motor assisted Power Steering (EMPS) may not have received the correct hardness treatment. This can cause the spline to distort and wear and eventually result in loss of steering.
toyota.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and if necessary replace the shaft.

toyota.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL SPILLAGE WHEN PETROL CAP IS OPENED The check valve in the fuel tank inlet that prevents reverse fuel flow is incorrectly fitted on some vehicles . This could cause fuel to spill out when the cap is opened if there is high internal pressure in the fuel tank.
toyota.remedy: Correctly fit the check valve or if necessary replace the fuel tank and check valve.

toyota.defect: SKID CONTROL ECU MAY MALFUNCTION The Skid Control ECU may incorrectly interpret signals and may malfunction. This may affect the operation of the Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) although an EPB warning lamp will illuminate and a warning message will display.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicle reprogramme the skid control ECU to correct this.

toyota.defect: A POSSIBILITY THAT A BOLT OF THE BRAKE PEDAL BRACKET MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TORQUED CORRECTLY A possibility that a bolt of the brake pedal bracket may not have been torqued correctly.
toyota.remedy: Tighten the bolt of the brake pedal bracket to the appropriate torque.

toyota.defect: TAKATA AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE ON DEPLOYMENT The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture
toyota.remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly.  Toyota is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts

This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF CONTROL It is possible that the wrong specification differential unit (Crown Wheel & Pinion) has been installed. Not only can this give an incorrect speedometer reading but if four wheel drive is selected on hard surface/road with low friction then directional control of the vehicle can be affected.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and inspect differential if found to be the incorrect specification then replace with the correct specification differential.

In this condition brake fluid may leak from the seal or a small amount of air may enter the master cylinder which could lead to an increase in vehicle stopping distance.
toyota.remedy: Vehicles that are likely to be affected will be checked and a quality assured part fitted if necessary.

toyota.defect: ENGINE WIRE HARNESS CONNECTED TO HYBRID VEHICLE POWER CONTROL UNIT COULD CONTACT COVER Due to assembly variation a portion of the engine wire harness could contact the cover.Should the insulation wear and the core wires become exposed there is an increased risk of a vehicle fire.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the engine wire harness and repair or replace it if necessary.

toyota.defect: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED The subject vehicles are equipped with brake pressure accumulators consisting of a metal plunger containing brake fluid encased in a metal housing. The plunger is designed with metal pleated bellows to allow for motion. Nitrogen gas is sealed between the plunger and housing. It is possible that a fatigue crack could develop in the bellows due to vertical vibration of the plunger while driving. If this occurs nitrogen gas could leak into the brake fluid and gradually cause the brake pedal stroke to become longer resulting in decreased hydraulic pressure which could result in increased stopping distance.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to first check which type of brake booster is fitted and if the at risk type is fitted; replace the brake booster assembly with an improved one.

toyota.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: DRIVER AND/OR FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED An incorrect specification driver or front passenger air bag assembly may have been installed during production. As a result the airbag(s) may not deploy as intended.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the air bag with the correct module.

toyota.defect: STEERING RELAY ROD MAY CRACK If the steering wheel is repeatedly turned under conditions where high steering effort is required such as when fully turning the steering wheel whilst the vehicle is stationary a fatigue crack may develop in the relay rod. In extreme cases the steering rod may fracture causing a loss of steering control.
toyota.remedy: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles and replace the steering relay rod.

toyota.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT SUSPENSION ARM BRACKET BOLTS MAY LOOSEN Anti-chipping paint (foam filled vinyl chloride) was applied in error to the clamping area where the rear lower suspension arm brackets are connected. This could lead to the bolts loosening over time.
toyota.remedy: Recall the potentially affected vehicles. Check and if necessary remove the incorrectly applied paint then re torque the bolts.

toyota.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The connector between injectors and return fuel pipe may wear out. If this happens fuel may leak and driver's will notice a fuel smell.
toyota.remedy: Replace pipe and connect with new sealant.

toyota.defect: REPLACEMENT AIRBAG INFLATOR INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT ORIENTATION Affected vehicles received a recall remedy in which the replacement inflator may have been installed in an incorrect orientation.This may prevent the front passenger air bag from inflating as intended during deployment as designed.
toyota.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the inflator checked and corrected if it is necessary.

toyota.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: Affected vehicles have an inappropriate design of the control circuit of the rear combination lamp and the voltage applied to the LEDs in the rear combination lamp could be reduced in certain circumstances. If this were to occur the rear turn signals and/or the hazard warning flasher may temporarily become inoperable. If the condition is present the driver may notice the turn signal indicator rapidly flashing on the instrument panel when the turn signal switch is turned on but other road users may not realize that the rear turn signal or the hazard warning flasher have been activated potentially increasing the risk of a crash. Affected vehicles have an inappropriate design of the control circuit of the rear combination lamp and the voltage applied to the LEDs in the rear combination lamp could be reduced in certain circumstances. If this were to occur the rear turn signals and/or the hazard warning flasher may temporarily become inoperable.
