toyota.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the DCM may not complete the shutdown process within a specific period of time when the ignition is turned off causing the DCM to not restart at the next ignition cycle and making the e-Call function unavailable. As a result the vehicles do not comply with relevant regulations. On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the DCM may not complete the shutdown process within a specific period of time when the ignition is turned off causing the DCM to not restart at the next ignition cycle and making the e-Call function unavailable. As a result the vehicles do not comply with relevant regulations.
toyota.remedy: The software of the DCM (Data Communication Module) will be updated via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update.

toyota.defect: STEERING - WEAR OF THE INTERMEDIATE SHAFT SPLINE It is possible on certain Avensis models fitted with Electric Motor assisted Power Steering (EMPS) that the intermediate steering shaft was incorrectly assembled this can result in premature wear of the shaft splines.  This is identified by the abnormal noise produced however if the vehicle continues to be driven in this condition it may become difficult or in the worst case impossible to steer.
toyota.remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the intermediate steering shaft.

toyota.defect: WATER MAY ENTER CABIN THROUGH FRONT LEFT AND RIGHT WHEEL ARCH AREAS Water could enter the cabin through the panels in front left and right wheel arch areas affecting electrical components
toyota.remedy: Inspect for water leak and replace affected parts if necessary and apply sealant to close the gap between the affected body panels.

toyota.defect: THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP LOCATED IN THE FUEL TANK COULD BECOME INOPERATIVE On affected vehicles the low pressure fuel pump located in the fuel tank could become inoperative.
toyota.remedy: Replace the fuel pump

toyota.defect: SEATING HEADRESTS MAY DETACH & AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY SUFFICIENTLY IN AN IMPACT It has been identified that the following seat defects may occur  a Front and rear seats - the locking performance of the headrest may be insufficient during an impact and may cause ejection of the headrest from the seat back. b Front seats only-  The reliability of the side airbag deployment on the front seats may be insufficient during an impact and may not offer the protection intended.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the following remedial actions performed:-a) The rear seat headrest guide springs and buttons will be replaced.b) The front seat headrest supports will be replaced.  c) The front seat back pads and covers will be replaced.

toyota.defect: RISK OF FIRE Affected vehicles  are equipped with a driver�s side Power Window Master Switch (PWMS) containing sliding electrical contact modules. These modules may not have been incorrectly coated during the manufacturing process. This may cause a short circuit which could cause the switch to overheat and melt
toyota.remedy: Inspect switch and apply coating. If switch indicates signs of malfunction it should be replaced.

toyota.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It is possible that the connections at the intermediate shaft and sliding yoke of the steering column may become loose and if the symptoms are ignored steering control can be lost.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the steering intermediate shaft. In addition inspect the sliding yoke and intermediate shaft extension and replace if necessary.  This recall is staggered starting with Prius and  Corrolla.   Avensis customer letters will be sent out over the next three months

toyota.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY FAIL UNEXPECTEDLY A component of the steering column may not be to specification and could fail. If this occurs there would be a loss of directional control.
toyota.remedy: The manufacturer will contact keepers of affected vehicles and advise not to use the vehicle.  Examine vehicles and on those with the affected component replace  the steering column.

toyota.defect: BOLTS ON THE EXHAUST SIDE OF THE TURBOCHARGER ASSEMBLY MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED Affected vehicles have a 2.0 litre turbocharged diesel engine. There is a possibility that the bolts on the exhaust-side of the turbocharger assembly may not have been correctly tightened during manufacture.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles check bolts. Where necessary replace the turbocharger.

toyota.defect: DUE TO AN INAPPROPRIATE SOFTWARE THE SKID CONTROL ECU MAY NOT COMPLETE ALL ITS PROCESSING TASKS Due to an inappropriate software the Skid Control ECU may not complete all its processing tasks.
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Skid control ECU.

toyota.defect: AN INCORRECT TOOLING SETUP DURING THE MANUFACTURING OF THE FUEL TANK MAY RESULT IN REDUCED WALL THICKNESS OR SMALL PIN HOLE IN THE TANK'S BOTTOM SURFACE An incorrect tooling setup during the manufacturing of the fuel tank may result in reduced wall thickness
toyota.remedy: Check the serial number and replace the fuel tank if necessary.

toyota.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: THE EMERGENCY CALLING SYSTEM (eCall) MAY NOT FUNCTION WHEN REQUIRED The emergency calling system (eCall) may not function when required.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the emergency calling system and update DCM software. If the DCM is found to be damaged replace it with updated software.

toyota.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It is possible that during the manufacturing process the wall thickness of the high pressure supply pipe may have been reduced.  If the driving conditions of the vehicle cause fuel pressure fluctuations this could cause cracking and result in a fuel leak.  Also due to gasket fatigue and prolonged usage the high pressure fuel pump check valve may be come loose and leak.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the fuel pipe and fuel pump check valve plus gasket.

toyota.defect: PASSENGER FRONT AIR BAG CONCERN The front passenger airbag inflator module check valve pin is missing in the affected vehicle. In the event of airbag activation the partition which separates the inflator and the bag may not be properly broken resulting in insufficient pressure to properly deploy the airbag. This could result in injury to the front seat passenger in the event of a frontal impact.
toyota.remedy: Replace the inflator module.

toyota.defect: DC-DC converter may have been damaged during production The plug-in hybrid system of the subject vehicles includes a DC-DC converter that reduces the voltage of the electricity from the Hybrid Vehicle (HV) battery in order to charge the vehicle�s 12V battery. Contained within the DC-DC converter is a current rectifying module that is installed on the circuit board. Some of these modules may have been damaged during production by the supplier and could fail so creating a short circuit. This allows current from the 12V battery to continue to flow through the module and the module will generate heat. Under certain conditions if excessive heat is generated components within and outside the DC-DC converter could sustain thermal damage increasing the risk of a vehicle fire.
toyota.remedy: Replace the DC-DC Converter.

toyota.defect: STEERING WHEEL MAY DETACH It is possible that the nut securing the steering wheel was not correctly tightened when the vehicle was assembled. This could lead to abnormal noise and free play at the steering wheel. If these warnings are ignored the nut could eventually come off and the steering wheel could separate from the steering shaft causing loss of steering ability.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the steering wheel securing nut is tightened to the correct torque.

toyota.defect: REAR SUSPENSION ARM MAY SEPARATE If the rear suspension arm is adjusted as part of a wheel alignment or other repairs whilst in service it is possible that backlash can occur. This can allow corrosion to develop and cause the threads to deteriorate. Ultimately this could result in failure of the arm with a resultant loss of control of the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the torque on the arm. Where necessary the arm will be replaced.

toyota.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY The subject vehicles are equipped with right front seat side airbags which may not deploy in a collision as intended.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right front seat side airbags.

toyota.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK / RISK OF FIRE The vehicles are equipped with a fuel evaporative emission control unit (canister) assembled to the fuel tank. There is a possibility that a crack could develop on the resin channel for the emission gas flow due to an improper shape of the channel edge at that location. The crack could expand over time and eventually fuel may leak from the crack when the vehicle has a full tank. Fuel or fuel vapour in the presence of an ignition source could increase the risk of a vehicle fire
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel suction plate sub-assembly.

toyota.defect: BODY TRIM MAY CAUSE INJURY Due to the improper installation of the left A-pillar trim there ia a possibility that the trim may become detached when the curtain shield airbag would deploy during a crash.  If this happens the loose garnish could injure the LH seat occupant of the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Inspection of the installation and repair if needed.

toyota.defect: DRIVER SIDE AIRBAG MAY RUPTURE Subject vehicles are fitted with driver's air bag assemblies with single stage inflators. There is an increases potential for moisture ingress which could make the inflator more susceptible to rupture during deployment. Fragments may injure occupants.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It is possible that the connections at the intermediate shaft and sliding yoke of the steering column may become loose and if the symptoms are ignored steering control can be lost.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the steering intermediate shaft. In addition inspect the sliding yoke and intermediate shaft extension and replace if necessary.  This recall is staggered starting with Prius and  Corrolla.   Avensis customer letters will be sent out over the next three months

toyota.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It is possible moisture or other fluids may enter the drivers window and contaminate the main power window switch. If this occurs and the switch is damaged it could overheat and cause it to melt and/or smoke.  If this situation is not identified it could result in a vehicle fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and check the switch. If the switch is not damaged a waterproof cover will be fitted. If the switch is damaged it will be replaced and a waterproof cover will be fitted.

toyota.defect: CURTAIN AIRBAGS AND SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONERS MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY Due to improper programming of the airbag system in the Airbag Sensor Assembly (airbag control module) there is a possibility that the Airbag Sensor Assembly may erroneously detect a rollover and deploy the Curtain Shield Airbags (CSA) and seat belt pre-tensioners. The deployment of the CSA could cause minor injury to a vehicle occupant.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the Airbag Control Unit.

toyota.defect: THE STRENGTH OF THE BRAKE BOOSTER PISTON COULD DEGRADE On affected vehicles the strength of the brake booster piston could degrade.
toyota.remedy: Check the brake booster piston serial number and replace if necessary.

toyota.defect: THE FRONT SEAT BELT INSTALLATION MAY BE LOOSE. The front seat belt installation may be loose at its uppermost position on the B post due to incorrect reinstallation following conversion to a commercial vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Examine the front seat belt installation and correct and make secure where found necessary.

toyota.defect: CURTAIN SHIELD AIRBAG STRAPS THAT SUPPORT PROPER AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN ROUTED CORRECTLY There is a possibility curtain airbag straps may not have been routed in the correct orientation.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the straps used to assist in curtain shield airbag deployment and correct any improperly assembled straps.

toyota.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY BECOME UNSECURED The steering column mounting bracket may not be of sufficient strength if the steering is repeatedly and forcibly turned on full lock. This over a prolonged period can result in the failure of the bracket and ultimate detachment of the steering column.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the steering column mounting bracket.

toyota.defect: AIRBAG MAY INCORRECTLY DEPLOY The passenger air bag inflator may have been incorrectly manufactured/assembled. This may allow leakage of compressed gas and partial inflation of the airbag without a deployment command.
toyota.remedy: Replace passenger airbag unit.

toyota.defect: CURTAIN AIRBAGS AND SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONERS MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY Due to improper programming of the airbag system in the Airbag Sensor Assembly (airbag control module) there is a possibility that the Airbag Sensor Assembly may erroneously detect a rollover and deploy the Curtain Shield Airbags (CSA) and seat belt pre-tensioners. The deployment of the CSA could cause minor injury to a vehicle occupant.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the Airbag Control Unit.

toyota.defect: FRONT SEAT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY ACTIVATE WHEN TURNED OFF The airbag and seat belt pretensioner ECU system may be incorrectly programmed.
toyota.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled and airbag sensors replaced.

toyota.defect: REAR SEAT BELT MAY FAIL The vehicles are equipped with 3-point lap-shoulder belt assemblies in all-three rear seating positions. The inner belt (buckle portion) of each of the rear three seat belt assemblies is secured to the floor of the vehicle with an anchor plate. The anchor plate might have been manufactured with a sharp edge around the punched portion. In the event of a collision there is a possibility that the inner seat belt webbing could become cut and separate at the anchor plate. If this occurs the inner seat belt may not properly restrain the occupant which could increase the risk to injury.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the Lot number of the anchor plate. Where necessary the rear inner belt assembly will be replaced with a new one.

toyota.defect: PANORAMIC ROOF GLASS MAY DETACH There is a possibility that the panoramic roof glass might partially peel from the frame due to insufficient adhesion strength of the paint on the panoramic roof frame.  In this condition the roof glass might separate from the frame which could lead to wind noise.  If the vehicle is continuously operated the panoramic roof glass may detach from the frame.
toyota.remedy: Inspect and replace if needed.

toyota.defect: DUE TO AN IMPROPER LUBRICANT USED DURING THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS THE IMPROPER LUBRICANT MIGHT CONTAMINATE THE VACUUM CHECK VALVE Due to an improper lubricant used during the manufacturing process the improper lubricant might contaminate the vacuum check valve.
toyota.remedy: Replace the VCV (Vacuum Check Valve) on the brake booster.

toyota.defect: AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE FOR THE SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM COULD BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO INTERNAL SHORTING Possible inadvertent air bag deployment.
toyota.remedy: Replace the airbag sensor assembly.

toyota.defect: STEERING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY There is a possibility that the bolts holding the steering valve on the steering rack are missing or have not been correctly tightened. This may affect control of the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles check the steering rack and replace if found to be defective.

toyota.defect: REAR BRAKE AND HUB SECURITY CONCERN It is possible for the bolts to be loose that join the rear brake and hub assembly to the rear axle carrier due to insufficient tightening. 1 or more of the 4 bolts could come loose causing an abnormal noise from the rear wheel axle area. In the event that all 4 bolts loosen completely separation of the rear brake and hub assembly from the rear axle carrier may occur which in the worst case could lead to a loss of vehicle control.
toyota.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the rear brake and hub securing bolts for correct tightness.

toyota.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK The fuel pipes connecting the fuel pump to fuel injection nozzles may crack. If not attend to the crack can widen and leak fuel.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new injector pipes and brackets.

toyota.defect: On affected vehicles minor impact to the lower front bumper cover could break the mounting tabs resulting in the lower bumper cover the engine under cover and the front wheel arch liners detaching from the vehicle while driving. On affected vehicles minor impact to the lower front bumper cover could break the mounting tabs resulting in the lower bumper cover the engine under cover and the front wheel arch liners detaching from the vehicle while driving.�
toyota.remedy: Inspect the mounting tabs of the upper front bumper cover for damage if no damage is found modified retention hardware will be fitted. If damage is found the upper and lower front bumper cover will be replaced and modified retention hardware fitted.�

toyota.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It is possible that the connections at the intermediate shaft and sliding yoke of the steering column may become loose and if the symptoms are ignored steering control can be lost.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the steering intermediate shaft. In addition inspect the sliding yoke and intermediate shaft extension and replace if necessary.  This recall is staggered starting with Prius and  Corrolla.   Avensis customer letters will be sent out over the next three months

toyota.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY NOT FUNCTION The steering column assembly in affected vehicles contains electrical connections to the driver's air bag module housed in a spiral cable assembly which includes a Flexible Flat Cable (FFC). Due to the shape and location of the FFC's retainer the FFC could contact a small point of the retainer and become damaged when the steering wheel is turned. In FFC's with seven channel circuits this damage could occur to a circuit on the FFC that provides connectivity to the driver's air bag module. If connectivity is lost the air bag warning light will illuminate. In addition the driver's air bag could become deactivated causing it not to deploy in the event of a crash. This could increase the risk of injury to the driver.
toyota.remedy: Replace spiral cables with new ones

toyota.defect: The force-limiter in the seat belt retractor may not operate as designed The subject front seat belt assemblies are service parts designed for certain Toyota and Lexus models containing a seat belt retractor with a force-limiter function using a torsion shaft which helps control the loads on the occupant applied by the shoulder belt after the seat belt retractor locks up during a crash. During production the torsion shaft may have been manufactured incorrectly and the seat belt may not operate as designed allowing the seat belt to extend further than intended after locking. This can increase the amount of forward displacement of the occupant increasing the risk of an injury in the event of a crash severe enough to activate a force-limiter.
toyota.remedy: To inspect and replace the seat belt assembly if required.

toyota.defect: POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE MAY BE LOST Under certain conditions the electrical terminal of the wiring harness connected to the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) of the EPS slide causes abrasion on the tin-plating layer of the connector. This can cause wear debris to form which can accumulate and become oxidized. Occasionally the driver�s knee may press against the lower cover when entering or exiting the vehicle causing the cover to press against the EPS wiring harness. This contact may result in the connector terminal sliding onto the �electrical insulator� (oxidized accumulation) resulting in electrical contact failure. The EPS ECU then turns on the EPS warning light/sound and steering assist stops.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the EPS ECU and EPS harness.

toyota.defect: TAKATA AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE ON DEPLOYMENT The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture
toyota.remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly.  Toyota is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts

toyota.defect: EGR FLANGE COULD CORRODE AND CRACK The urea water injector mounting flange on the exhaust front pipe may fail and allow the urea water injector to separate from the front pipe. This situation could result in noncompliance with requirements prescribed in applicable safety or emission regulations in the involved countries.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace front exhaust pipe.

toyota.defect: LOSS OF POWER The inverter assembly may overheat which will cause warning lamps to illuminate and the vehicle to enter a fail safe mode. Fail safe allows the vehicle to be driven on reduced power to a place of safety. However it is possible for the hybrid system to shut down causing the vehicle to stop which increases the risk of a collision.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogramme the Motor Generator and Power Management ECUs.

toyota.defect: DUE TO AN IMPROPER PROGRAMMING OF HYBRID SYSTEM VEHICLE MIGHT NOT ENTER A FAILSAFE DRIVING MODE. There is a possibility that the vehicle will not enter a failsafe driving mode if a temporary slip occurs in the input damper of the hybrid transaxle.�
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the HV ECU.

toyota.defect: SPECIFIC POINTS ON THE FRONT SEAT BACK FRAMES WERE NOT MANUFACTURED WITH THE MINIMUM RADIUS CRITERIA AND DO NOT COMPLY WITH ECE UNR17 Certain specific points on the seat-back frames were not manufactured with the minimum radius criteria.  In this condition these seat-back frames do not comply with ECE UNR17.
toyota.remedy: Modify the seat back frame

toyota.defect: POSSIBLE IMBALANCE UNDER HEAVY BRAKING. The brake pipes leading into the ABS actuator may have been incorrectly positioned. This could cause an imbalance in performance under heavy braking.
toyota.remedy: Check and reposition the brake pipes if necessary.

toyota.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY FAIL TO RETURN TO IDLE It has been identified that on affected vehicles condensation resulting from cold-weather use of the heater or other causes may form on the worn surface of a component within the throttle pedal assembly known as the friction device. If this occurs there is a possibility that in the worst case the accelerator pedal may return slowly or does not return to the engine idle position.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a precision-cut steel reinforcing bar fitted into the accelerator pedal assembly which will create a space in order to reduce the surface tension between the friction device and  a component referred to as the pedal arm. The subject bar also strengthens the reaction force of the spring that returns the accelerator pedal to it's non-pressed position.

toyota.defect: REAR BRAKE CALIPERS MAY DETACH It has been identified that the rear brake caliper retaining bolts may become loose due to their being tightened to an insufficient torque.This would in the first instance; result in an unusual noise and in the worst case detachment of the caliper which may result  in the breakage of the brake disc.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the near and offside brake caliper retaining bolts replaced.

toyota.defect: TAKATA AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE ON DEPLOYMENT The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture
toyota.remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly.  Toyota is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts

toyota.defect: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY RUPTURE IF DEPLOYED On affected vehicles the drivers front airbag inflator could produce excessive internal pressure. If an affected airbag deploys the increased internal pressure may cause the inflator to rupture. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the inflator inside the drivers airbag module with a new one.

toyota.defect: INCORRECTLY INSTALLED COVERS COULD PREVENT THE SEAT-MOUNTED SIDE AIRBAG FROM DEPLOYING Incorrectly installed covers could prevent the seat-mounted side air bag from deploying properly.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the covers installed on the front seats and replace any incorrectly installed covers

toyota.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT INFLATE DURING A COLLISION Due to improper assembly of the airbag inflator used in the side airbag curtain shield airbag and knee airbag systems the subject airbags may not fully inflate during a collision resulting in an increased risk of injury to the vehicle's occupants.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject airbags replaced.

toyota.defect: FRONT PASSENGER AIR BAG INFLATORS CONTAINING DEGRADED PROPELLANT MAY RESULT IN AN INFLATOR RUPTURE Passenger air bag may cause injury if activated.
toyota.remedy: Replace affected air bag assembly.

toyota.defect: ONE OF THE BOLTS HOLDING THE FRONT SUSPENSION ARM ON THE CHASSIS COULD POTENTIALLY BE DEFORMED/ELONGATED Front suspension arm securing bolt may break.
toyota.remedy: Replace the affected front lower arm screw on both sides of the vehicle.

toyota.defect: LOSS OF POWER The inverter assembly may overheat which will cause warning lamps to illuminate and the vehicle to enter a fail safe mode. Fail safe allows the vehicle to be driven on reduced power to a place of safety. However it is possible for the hybrid system to shut down causing the vehicle to stop which increases the risk of a collision.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogramme the Motor Generator and Power Management ECUs.

toyota.defect: RISK OF FIRE Oil may accumulate in the turbo charger and in certain circumstances flow into the combustion chamber. This may cause engine damage. In extreme cases oil can be ejected from the engine and if it comes in contact with an ignition source may result in a fire.
toyota.remedy: Depending vehicle diagnosis modify intercooler layout to improve air flow; upgrade ECU software; upgrade turbo charger and/or vacuum pump

toyota.defect: When the data is read out from the vehicle ECU an incorrect IUPR (In-Use Performance Ratio) value is shown. This does not comply with regulations however there is no impact on safety or vehicles' exhaust emissions When the data is read out from the vehicle ECU an incorrect IUPR (In-Use Performance Ratio) value is shown. This does not comply with regulations however there is no impact on safety or vehicles' exhaust emissions
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Engine Control Unit (ECU) with updated software and calibration.

toyota.defect: INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE WAS POSSIBLY APPLIED DURING PREVIOUS INJECTOR REMOVAL OR REPLACEMENT An incorrect tightening torque was applied at the moment of injector re-installation.
toyota.remedy: Check the injector clamp bolt torque and replace the parts if necessary.

toyota.defect: ENGINE MAY SURGE OR STALL It has been established that when the ambient temperature is cold and the fuel in the fuel tank is low air could be inhaled from the fuel tank vent tube into the fuel filter. This air could then pass into the fuel pump resulting in the vehicle surging or in the worst case the engine stalling.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel tank vent tube replaced.

toyota.defect: ELECTRIC FUEL CELL SYSTEM MAY STOP RUNNING Under unique driving conditions such as if the accelerator pedal is depressed to the wide open throttle position after driving on a long descent with the use of cruise control there is a possibility that Fuel Cell system may malfunction.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles update the control software of Fuel Cell Boost control module.

toyota.defect: The DCM (Data Communication Module) was not activated prior to delivery The DCM (Data Communication Module) that supports an emergency calling system which enables emergency calls to be made manually or automatically in the event of certain severe crashes was not activated prior to delivery.
toyota.remedy: Inspect activation status and activate DCM if not activated.

toyota.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: RISK OF FIRE Affected vehicles  are equipped with a driver�s side Power Window Master Switch (PWMS) containing sliding electrical contact modules. These modules may not have been incorrectly coated during the manufacturing process. This may cause a short circuit which could cause the switch to overheat and melt
toyota.remedy: Inspect switch and apply coating. If switch indicates signs of malfunction it should be replaced.

toyota.defect: DRIVER SIDE AIRBAG MAY RUPTURE Subject vehicles are fitted with driver's air bag assemblies with single stage inflators. There is an increases potential for moisture ingress which could make the inflator more susceptible to rupture during deployment. Fragments may injure occupants.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: LOSS OF STEERING It is possible that the splines of the extension shaft on vehicles equipped with Electric Motor assisted Power Steering (EMPS) may not have received the correct hardness treatment. This can cause the spline to distort and wear and eventually result in loss of steering.
toyota.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and if necessary replace the shaft.

toyota.defect: WHEEL MAY DETACH It has been identified there is a possibility that the bolt(s) securing the road wheel(s) may not have been tightened to the correct specification. This could result a risk that the road wheel rim(s) may crack/fracture over time or the wheel could detach from the vehicle which could cause loss of control of the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the wheel bolts have been tightened to the correct specification and if required replace any damaged/defective wheel rim(s).

toyota.defect: SECURITY OF ROOF RACK Under certain loading conditions or as a result of incorrect installation the roof rack may become loose and fall from the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Owners who have purchased the subject roof racks are being contacted by Toyota dealers and requested to take the vehicles back for the fitment of improved clamps to the roof rack system.

toyota.defect: CURTAIN AIRBAGS AND SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONERS MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY Due to improper programming of the airbag system in the Airbag Sensor Assembly (airbag control module) there is a possibility that the Airbag Sensor Assembly may erroneously detect a rollover and deploy the Curtain Shield Airbags (CSA) and seat belt pre-tensioners. The deployment of the CSA could cause minor injury to a vehicle occupant.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the Airbag Control Unit.

toyota.defect: BOLTS ON THE EXHAUST SIDE OF THE TURBOCHARGER ASSEMBLY MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED Affected vehicles have a 2.0 litre turbocharged diesel engine. There is a possibility that the bolts on the exhaust-side of the turbocharger assembly may not have been correctly tightened during manufacture.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles check bolts. Where necessary replace the turbocharger.

toyota.defect: FRONT DRIVER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE On affected vehicles the drivers front airbag inflator could produce excessive internal pressure. If an affected airbag deploys the increased internal pressure may cause the inflator to rupture. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the inflator inside the drivers airbag module with a new one.

toyota.defect: HEADLIGHT MAY MALFUNCTION Headlamps manufactured to the incorrect specification may have been fitted and  not may distribute light correctly.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles replace headlamp units.

toyota.defect: CURTAIN SHIELD AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNINTENTIONALLY On affected vehicles the curtain side air bag inflator may have a crack in a weld. If this crack propagates gas may leak and in certain conditions partially in inflate the air bag.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles install retention brackets on the curtain shield air bag inflators.

toyota.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE LOST On subject vehicles there is a possibility that a wld on the rear axle may not be sufficient. In the worst case scenarios this could cause a break in connection between rear axle and the body. This could cause difficulty in controlling the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Owners of subject vehicles to be contacted by first class post (using DVLA records). Inspect subject vehicles and if fault found replace rear axle.

toyota.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the DCM may not complete the shutdown process within a specific period of time when the ignition is turned off causing the DCM to not restart at the next ignition cycle and making the e-Call function unavailable. As a result the vehicles do not comply with relevant regulations. On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the DCM may not complete the shutdown process within a specific period of time when the ignition is turned off causing the DCM to not restart at the next ignition cycle and making the e-Call function unavailable. As a result the vehicles do not comply with relevant regulations.
toyota.remedy: The software of the DCM (Data Communication Module) will be updated via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update.

toyota.defect: DRIVER'S SIDE AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE It has been identified that in the subject vehicles there is a possibility the container of the inflator of the driver�s side may rupture. Toyota has not been able to establish the cause of the failure and is conducting a safety recall to recover the relevant parts to enable them to investigate the cause of the failure.
toyota.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles to replace the driver's side airbag inflator.

toyota.defect: THE PANORAMIC GLASS ROOF DEFLECTOR MAY NOT BE SECURED CORRECTLY The panoramic roof deflector may not be secured correctly.
toyota.remedy: Inspect and repair the panoramic roof deflector as necessary.

toyota.defect: POSSIBLE NON-OPERATION OF STOP LIGHTS Surplus grease applied to the stop light switch during production may carbonise and result in the stop lights not illuminating when the footbrake is applied.
toyota.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for inspection and if required replacement of the stop light switch.

toyota.defect: STEERING CONTROL COULD BE AFFECTED The nut that secures the pinion to the electric power steering system motor shaft may become loose if excessive force is used in full lock manoeuvrers. This could in extreme cases have an affect on the steering operation.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the securing nut.

toyota.defect: AFTER LOW MILEAGE USE ALL OF THE HUB BOLTS ON A WHEEL CAN LOOSEN TO THE POINT WHERE THE WHEEL CAN DETACH FROM THE VEHICLE After low-mileage use all of the hub bolts on a wheel can loosen to the point where the wheel can detach from the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Replace the hub bolts with newly designed hub bolts (with a washer).

toyota.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT INFLATE DURING A COLLISION Due to improper assembly of the airbag inflator used in the side airbag curtain shield airbag and knee airbag systems the subject airbags may not fully inflate during a collision resulting in an increased risk of injury to the vehicle's occupants.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject airbags replaced.

toyota.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY FAIL TO RETURN TO IDLE It has been identified that on affected vehicles condensation resulting from cold-weather use of the heater or other causes may form on the worn surface of a component within the throttle pedal assembly known as the friction device. If this occurs there is a possibility that in the worst case the accelerator pedal may return slowly or does not return to the engine idle position.
toyota.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a precision-cut steel reinforcing bar fitted into the accelerator pedal assembly which will create a space in order to reduce the surface tension between the friction device and  a component referred to as the pedal arm. The subject bar also strengthens the reaction force of the spring that returns the accelerator pedal to it's non-pressed position.

toyota.defect: TOW BALL MAY FRACTURE On Toyota Avensis Previa and Lexus GS fitted with a Toyota or Lexus genuine or Brink branded (only on Avensis) detachable towing hitch the possibility exists that the detachable towing ball in some exceptional cases (under severe mechanical stress) might develop a crack. In a worst case the detachable towing ball might fracture and/or fail.
toyota.remedy: Lexus/Toyota dealers will replace the detachable towing ball and housing at no cost to vehicle owners.

toyota.defect: INCORRECTLY INSTALLED COVERS COULD PREVENT THE SEAT-MOUNTED SIDE AIRBAG FROM DEPLOYING Incorrectly installed covers could prevent the seat-mounted side air bag from deploying properly.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the covers installed on the front seats and replace any incorrectly installed covers

toyota.defect: REAR SUSPENSION ARM MAY SEPARATE If the rear suspension arm is adjusted as part of a wheel alignment or other repairs whilst in service it is possible that backlash can occur. This can allow corrosion to develop and cause the threads to deteriorate. Ultimately this could result in failure of the arm with a resultant loss of control of the vehicle.
toyota.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the torque on the arm. Where necessary the arm will be replaced.

toyota.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK / RISK OF FIRE The vehicles are equipped with a fuel evaporative emission control unit (canister) assembled to the fuel tank. There is a possibility that a crack could develop on the resin channel for the emission gas flow due to an improper shape of the channel edge at that location. The crack could expand over time and eventually fuel may leak from the crack when the vehicle has a full tank. Fuel or fuel vapour in the presence of an ignition source could increase the risk of a vehicle fire
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel suction plate sub-assembly.

toyota.defect: On affected vehicles due to a design error there is a risk that the e-Call automatic call back function may not work. On affected vehicles due to a design error there is a risk that the e-Call automatic call back function may not work.
toyota.remedy: The software of the telematic unit for e-call will be updated via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update. Should the (OTA) wireless update fail the telematic unit will be replaced.

toyota.defect: THE INSIDE OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL PUMP MAY BE WORN OR DAMAGED OVER TIME DURING OPERATION The inside of the high-pressure fuel pump may be worn or damaged over time during operation.
toyota.remedy: Inspect* and if necessary replace the high-pressure fuel pump. (*Based on engine variant and/or pump manufacturer/pump serial number.)

toyota.defect: THE INITIALIZATION OF THE RADAR SENSOR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN COMPLETED CORRECTLY The initialization of the radar sensor may not have been completed correctly.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the radar sensor and if necessary properly initialize the radar sensor.

toyota.defect: INVERTOR CAPACITOR MAY NOT BE SECURE The hybrid system of the subject vehicles includes an inverter assembly which contains a capacitor that may not have been properly bolted to the inverter housing. In this condition the terminal of the capacitor could be damaged by vibration during normal vehicle operation.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the invertor assembly

toyota.defect: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK Due to an improper washing process of a metal part within the brake master cylinder there is a possibility that the groove for installing the rubber seal ring which is located at the end of the master cylinder may be corroded. In this condition brake fluid may leak from the seal or a small amount of air may enter the master cylinder which could lead to an increase in vehicle stopping distance.
toyota.remedy: Vehicles that are likely to be affected will be checked and a quality assured part fitted if necessary.

toyota.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL COULD BE COMPROMISED There is a possibility that a strut top mounting bearing could be damaged when a high load is applied to the strut such as when the vehicle is driven over a large bump. If this occurs there could be abnormal noise when driving on uneven roads or when turning the steering wheel. If the vehicle continues to be operated the upper side of the strut rod could separate causing a loss of vehicle stability which could increase the risk of a crash.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the strut mounting bearings with improved ones. If a strut mounting bearing is found to be damaged the dealer will replace the strut and front suspension support sub-assembly with a new one.

toyota.defect: THE REAR WINDOW HEATER CABLE MAY BECOME DAMAGED DUE TO INSUFFICIENT FIXATION DESIGN The rear window heater cable may become damaged due to insufficient fixation design
toyota.remedy: Inspect and add a fixation clip. If necessary the tailgate glass will be replaced

toyota.defect: UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES THE HYBRID UNIT MAY SHUT DOWN AND CAUSE LOSS OF MOTIVE POWER Under certain circumstances the hybrid unit may shut down and cause loss of motive power.
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Power Management ECU.

toyota.defect: POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE INSULATION MIGHT BE DAMAGED The starter motor supply cable from the battery may interfere with the EGR valve. This could cause damage to the insulation and cables.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicle inspect cable for position and condition. Where necessary replace cable.

toyota.defect: HEADLIGHT MAY MALFUNCTION Headlamps manufactured to the incorrect specification may have been fitted and  not may distribute light correctly.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles replace headlamp units.

toyota.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the airbag.

toyota.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the DCM may not complete the shutdown process within a specific period of time when the ignition is turned off causing the DCM to not restart at the next ignition cycle and making the e-Call function unavailable. As a result the vehicles do not comply with relevant regulations. On affected vehicles there is a possibility that the DCM may not complete the shutdown process within a specific period of time when the ignition is turned off causing the DCM to not restart at the next ignition cycle and making the e-Call function unavailable. As a result the vehicles do not comply with relevant regulations.
toyota.remedy: The software of the DCM (Data Communication Module) will be updated via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update.

toyota.defect: Affected vehicles may have an engine that was incorrectly assembled due to improper setting of the high-pressure fuel pump and/or improper setting of the timing belt. Affected vehicles may have an engine that was incorrectly assembled due to improper setting of the high-pressure fuel pump and/or improper setting of the timing belt.
toyota.remedy: Check high pressure fuel pump setting and replace engine if not correct. If high pressure fuel pump setting is correct check timing belt setting and replace timing belt if necessary.

toyota.defect: On affected vehicles due to an error in the software calibrations of the Engine Control Unit the Malfunction Indicator Light (MIL) will not illuminate when the urea injection system (which is part of the exhaust after treatment system) shuts down due to a fault resulting in non-compliance with regulations. On affected vehicles due to an error in the software calibrations of the Engine Control Unit the Malfunction Indicator Light (MIL) will not illuminate when the urea injection system (which is part of the exhaust after treatment system) shuts down due to a fault resulting in non-compliance with regulations.
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Engine Control Unit (ECU) with updated software and calibration.

toyota.defect: VARIOUS ELECTRICAL MALFUNCTIONS Some ground cable eyelets and/or the fixation of the airbag control unit may not have been tightened correctly. As a result there is a risk of various electrical malfunctions e.g. engine stall fire hazard and airbag malfunction.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the condition of the ground cables and replace them if necessary. Then the various fixations will be checked and tightened if needed.

toyota.defect: LOSS OF POWER MAY OCCUR In certain circumstances components within the inverter assembly may overheat which can lead to the selection of: fail safe mode where the vehicle can still drive with reduced power for a certain distance or in the worst case the drive systems shut down and the vehicle stop.
toyota.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to reprogramme the Motor Generator E.C.U. and Power Management Control E.C.U.

toyota.defect: ENGINE COMPONENT  MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

toyota.defect: There is an error in the specific software calibration of the traction battery control unit. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of drive and an increased risk of an accident.
toyota.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

toyota.defect: On affected vehicles due to a design error there is a risk that the e-Call automatic call back function may not work. On affected vehicles due to a design error there is a risk that the e-Call automatic call back function may not work.
toyota.remedy: The software of the telematic unit for e-call will be updated via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update. Should the (OTA) wireless update fail the telematic unit will be replaced.

toyota.defect: THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE ENGINE TIMING BELT MAY WEAR OUT PREMATURELY The possibility that the engine timing belt may wear out prematurely.
toyota.remedy: Replacement of the timing belt crankshaft gear high pressure fuel pump gear and camshaft gear and add sealing to the timing belt cover.

toyota.defect: THE ELECTRIC VEHICLE (EV) FUSE MAY MALFUNCTION The Electric Vehicle (EV) fuse which may malfunction if the vehicle isrepeatedly operated by the electric motor under high-load driving conditions such as during a long hill climb. If the fuse malfunctions warning lights and warning messages will illuminate. In some cases the vehicle can be driven but with reduced power. In other cases the hybrid system could shut down resulting in the loss of motive power.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuse.

toyota.defect: Oil plug incorrectly tightened There is a possibility that an oil plug located on the side of the engine may not be properly tightened.  An engine oil leak could occur that could lead to a certain amount of oil hitting the ground.
toyota.remedy: The remedy involves tightening the engine oil plug to the correct torque.

toyota.defect: A TRANSISTOR TO THE CIRCUIT BOARD IN THE DC-DC CONVERTOR COULD BE INADEQUATE The hybrid system could shut down resulting in loss of motive power
toyota.remedy: Inspect and replace the DC-DC converter with new one if necessary

toyota.defect: REAR WHEELS MAY LOCK UNDER HARD BRAKING There is a possibility that under certain conditions when applying the brakes hard and suddenly as in a panic situation a locking of the rear wheels may occur. The vehicle handling will then become unstable.
toyota.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace brake proportioning valve with a modified type.

toyota.defect: Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe. Some vehicles may have been equipped with an incorrectly positioned fuel pipe.
toyota.remedy: Check fuel pipe positioning correct if necessary and fit protective sleeve.

toyota.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE OUTSIDE PASSENGER SEAT BELT OF THE FRONT BENCH SEAT MAY UNBUCKLE UNINTENTIONALLY. The outside passenger seat belt of the front bench seat may unbuckle unintentionally
toyota.remedy: Replace the seat belt buckle

toyota.defect: THE FRONT LOWER SUSPENSION ARMS MAY HAVE CRACKS ON SOME PORTIONS OF ITS SURFACE The front lower suspension arms may have cracks on some portions of its surface.
toyota.remedy: Replace the front lower arms of affected vehicles.

toyota.defect: VEHICLE MAY NOT ENTER FAILSAFE DRIVING MODE AS INTENDED IN RESPONSE TO CERTAIN HYBRID SYSTEM FAULTS The vehicle may not enter a failsafe driving mode as intended.
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Power Management ECU.

toyota.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK There is a possibility that the wall thickness of the fuel tank may be thinner than specification due to improper tank moulding at the supplier. This may allow fuel to leak which could ignite if an ignition source is present..
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect walls of tank and replace where necessary

toyota.defect: THE TIGHTENING TORQUE SET TO THE THREADED CONNECTION BETWEEN THE BALL JOINT AND KNUCKLE MAY DECREASE Lower arm ball joint may be damaged and become insecure.
toyota.remedy: Check and fit additional securing device or replace the ball joint where damage exists.

toyota.defect: INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE WAS POSSIBLY APPLIED DURING PREVIOUS INJECTOR REMOVAL OR REPLACEMENT An incorrect tightening torque was applied at the moment of injector re-installation.
toyota.remedy: Check the injector clamp bolt torque and replace the parts if necessary.

toyota.defect: IT MAY NOT BE POSSIBLE TO SWITCH HEADLIGHTS FROM HIGH BEAM TO LOW BEAM OR LOW BEAM TO HIGH BEAM It may not be possible to switch headlights from high beam to low beam or low beam to high beam.
toyota.remedy: Replace the Headlamp Units

toyota.defect: UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES THE HYBRID UNIT MAY SHUT DOWN AND CAUSE LOSS OF MOTIVE POWER Under certain circumstances the hybrid unit may shut down and cause loss of motive power.
toyota.remedy: Reprogram the Power Management ECU.

toyota.defect: ENGINE WIRE HARNESS CONNECTED TO HYBRID VEHICLE POWER CONTROL UNIT COULD CONTACT COVER Due to assembly variation a portion of the engine wire harness could contact the cover.Should the insulation wear and the core wires become exposed there is an increased risk of a vehicle fire.
toyota.remedy: Inspect the engine wire harness and repair or replace it if necessary.

toyota.defect: CURTAIN SHIELD AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY UNINTENTIONALLY On affected vehicles the curtain side air bag inflator may have a crack in a weld. If this crack propagates gas may leak and in certain conditions partially in inflate the air bag.
toyota.remedy: On affected vehicles install retention brackets on the curtain shield air bag inflators.

trailertech.defect: TRAILER MAY DETACH The trailer swan neck may have been weakened around the drilling for the brake rod. This may cause the swan neck to fracture and in extreme instances the trailer may detach from the towing vehicle.
trailertech.remedy: Reinforce swan neck with specific manufacturer designed flitch plate.

transbus.remedy: To address the concern affected vehicles will be re-worked by operators under the terms of the Code of Practice by the fitting of quality assured switches (2 per vehicle).

trayal.remedy: Recall potentially affected tyres and replace with quality assured units.

tridec.remedy: Recalled vehicles will  have the subject kingpins replaced with a quality assured item.

triumph.defect: Alternator connector wire alignment clip The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the wires in the alternator connector system may form a bridge if they are exposed to a combination of different factors such as high temperatures heavy current loads and excessive lateral pulling on the wiring.
triumph.remedy: Fit a new cable alignment clip

triumph.defect: Alternator connector wire alignment clip The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the wires in the alternator connector system may form a bridge if they are exposed to a combination of different factors such as high temperatures heavy current loads and excessive lateral pulling on the wiring.
triumph.remedy: Fit a new cable alignment clip

triumph.defect: Addition of Engine Oil & Dipstick Replacement Air may enter the oil system during aggressive deceleration which could cause the engine to degrade prematurely and fail due to internal damage.
triumph.remedy: Increase the engine oil capacity and install a redesigned dipstick to ensure accurate oil level measurement.

triumph.defect: CYLINDER HEAD REPLACEMENT The exhaust rocker shaft can seize or stick causing the exhaust valves to remain open or break leading to a progressive decrease in engine performance. Affected motorcycles can experience a progressive decrease in engine performance increasing the risk of a crash.
triumph.remedy: Triumph authorised repairer will replace the affected cylinder head assembly with an updated component at no cost to the owner.

triumph.defect: SIDE STAND MAY FAIL The the main frame left hand centre stand lug may fail and allow the machine to fall over.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to add a centre stand bracket to the left hand side of the motorcycle frame.

triumph.defect: BOTTOM EYELET COULD BECOME DETACHED FROM THE REAR SUSPENSION UNIT BODY. There is a possibility of poor weld penetration between the bottom eyelet and the main rear suspension unit body. Under certain conditions there is a potential for the power eyelet to become detached compromising the machines' stability.
triumph.remedy: Recall affected machines and fit new suspension unit.

triumph.defect: MACHINE MAY BECOME UNSTABLE The ABS might not operate although no Malfunction Indicator Lamp illuminates. This is due to a non conformity during the manufacturing process. The brakes will function albeit without the ABS capability.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the modulator unit.

triumph.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF CONTROL Premature wheel bearing wear/play can occur as the bearings may not be manufactured to specification.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the affected wheel bearings.

triumph.defect: ENGINE STALL Certain riding styles can cause the engine to stall.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and download revised software for the engine management.

triumph.defect: INCORRECTLY SEALED ELECTRICAL CIRCUITS IN LEFT HAND SWITCH CUBE Affected vehicles may have been fitted with an incorrectly sealed left hand switch cube. This may cause the turn signal indicators and headlamp not to function correctly.
triumph.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a newer version switch cube.

triumph.defect: REAR REFLEX REFLECTOR MAY DETACH The rear reflex reflector may detach from the motorcycle.
triumph.remedy: Replace the rear reflex reflector.

triumph.defect: OIL MAY LEAK FROM SHOCK ABSORBER AND REDUCE EFFECTIVENESS OF REAR SUSPENSION The rear suspension unit has a possible assembly defect in that the piston-shaft nut has in some cases not been correctly tightened. If a defective suspension unit is fitted there could be an oil leak and a gradual loss of damping control which over time can adversely affect the handling of the machine.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the rear suspension unit.

triumph.defect: OIL MAY WEEP FROM THE DRIVE UNIT Oil weeping from the final drive unit which if ignored could result in sufficient oil loss such that the bearing overheats and seizure of the rear wheel occurs.
triumph.remedy: Recalled machines will have their final drive units replaced.

triumph.defect: THE SIDE STAND MAY BEND OVER TIME AND USE CAUSING AN AFFECTED MOTORCYCLE TO LEAN BEYOND ITS DESIGNATED ANGLE WHEN PARKED The side stand leg may bend over time and use causing an affected motorcycle to lean beyond its designed angle when parked.
triumph.remedy: Replace the motorcycle side stand assembly

triumph.defect: HAZARD WARNING LIGHTS MAY FAIL The hazard warning lamps wiring may not be of the correct length and can become damaged during steering operations. This may cause the hazard lamps not to work but will not affect the individual direction indicators.
triumph.remedy: On affected machines extend the wiring by installing a new electrical block connector and fly lead.

triumph.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The coolant by-pass hose may split causing loss of coolant from the engine resulting in possible engine overheating damage and seizure.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and fit a modified hose.

triumph.defect: TYRE MAY DEFLATE The fixings for the front mudguard may become loose. The head of the screw could make contact with the sidewall of the tyre which if not noticed could cause the tyre to deflate.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to fit alternative screws to the mudguard.

triumph.defect: On affected motorcycles inaccurate MAP data can lead to unstable idle and sometimes an engine stall increasing the risk of a crash. The cause of the defect is an obstruction of the restrictor as fitted within the MAP hose. triumph.remedy: Fit a modified 3-part MAP hose.

triumph.defect: UNINTENDED ACCELERATION Heated handlebar (throttle twist) grip may when turned �on� bind on the end weight or optional accessory mirror resulting in the throttle not returning without manual action by the rider.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and install a spacer to provide a sufficient air gap for the throttle to move freely.

triumph.defect: AIR MAY ENTER THE BRAKE SYSTEM If the motorcycle is dropped onto its left side to the horizontal position for any reason air may enter the rear brake master cylinder reservoir to master cylinder hose. The air will be unable to escape when the machine is righted and this could result in the rear brake becoming inoperative.
triumph.remedy: Raise the height of the rear brake master cylinder reservoir mounting.

triumph.defect: WELD FRACTURES IN FRAME A possibility exists of weld fractures in the main frame after impact.
triumph.remedy: Affected machines are being recalled to have the original frame replaced with a quality assured unit.

triumph.defect: Rear brake pedal travel may increase prior to feeling the brake engage. Rear brake pedal travel may increase prior to feeling the brake engage.
triumph.remedy: Fitment of new brake master cylinder.

triumph.defect: ACCESSORY  RACK MAY CAUSE INSTABILITY IF OVERLOADED It has been identified that the luggage top carriage may have insufficient lateral movement. Should this be the case the stability of the machine might be affected if ridden with the accessories fitted at speeds far in excess of the 80 mph/130kph limit warning.
triumph.remedy: Recalled machines will be checked to ensure that the carriage has sufficient lateral movement.

triumph.defect: THE FRONT BRAKE PADS FRICTION MATERIAL MAY DETACH FROM THE BACK PLATE WHEN USED IN A CORROSIVE ENVIRONMENT The front brake pads could have potential issues involving detachment of brake pad friction material from the back plate.
triumph.remedy: Replace all the affected brake pads

triumph.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF CONTROL Premature wheel bearing wear/play can occur as the bearings may not be manufactured to specification.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the affected wheel bearings.

triumph.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL The engine may stall due to a nonconformity in the with the regulator rectifier.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the regulator rectifier with a revised component.

triumph.defect: POSSIBLE OIL CONTAMINATION OF REAR TYRE In some extreme cases oil can weep from between the engine crankcase halves due to slackening of the securing bolts. This seepage occurs forward of the rear tyre and may in extreme cases cause vehicle instability.
triumph.remedy: Recall affected machines and replace the original lower crankcase bolts with quality assured bolts.

triumph.defect: MACHINE MAY NOT BE ADEQUATELY SUPPORTED WHEN PARKED There is a possibility that the side stand assembly securing bolts to main frame may become loose. The stand may not then adequately support the machine.
triumph.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check and correctly tighten the side stand bolts.

triumph.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF THE FINAL DRIVE CHAIN Due to an inappropriate heat treatment being applied during the manufacturing process a possibility exists that the final drive chain may fracture whilst the motorcycle is in use. Should failure occur loss of drive and possibly motorcycle instability may result.
triumph.remedy: Recall all affected motorcycles for the fitment of a quality controlled replacement drive chain.

triumph.defect: IGNITION MAY FAIL Components within the ECU are incompatible when operating at extremes of tolerance. This condition can cause damage to the injector driver and can lead to the injector being constantly on. The engine will either fail to start or if running the fuel injector circuit can malfunction causing one cylinder to lose power.
triumph.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the ECU.

triumph.defect: CLUTCH CABLE MAY CONTACT MAIN HARNESS SHEATH The clutch cable may contact the main harness sheath potentially causing damage to the wiring within the main harness.
triumph.remedy: The original headstock tidy will be replaced with a new version.

triumph.defect: TOP BOX MAY DETACH Excessive play in the top box to base unit locking mechanism which under certain road conditions could cause the top box to detach from the base unit.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the clip to the locking handle which will eliminate the excessive play.

triumph.defect: ABILITY TO CHANGE GEAR MAY BE AFFECTED AND NEUTRAL INDICATED WITH GEAR SELECTED The instruments may indicate neutral is selected when the machine is in gear which could lead to the machine jumping forward at junctions or the rider changing gear unnecessarily. Additionally a weak detent arm spring could cause poor gear changing necessitating additional time selecting gears.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the detent arm spring and replace the neutral switch washer.

triumph.defect: STOP BOLT MAY SHEAR The rear brake caliper anti-rotation device (stop bolt) may shear. If this occurs the caliper will strike the swinging arm.
triumph.remedy: Recall the motorcycles that are likely to be affected to remove the original stop bolt and replace for a modified bolt

triumph.defect: ENGINE STALL Certain riding styles can cause the engine to stall.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and download revised software for the engine management.

triumph.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The four bolts securing two cable guides located on either side of the main head stock could work loose and restrict the steering movement.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to fit new bolts that have patchlock applied.

triumph.defect: REAR WHEEL MAY LOCK The front bevel box fitted to the engine assembly has not been manufactured to specification. The deficiency can lead to oil starvation to the input gear shaft could result in 6th gear input becoming seized thereby locking the transmission with the attendant loss of control.
triumph.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and fit a replacement front bevel box and input & output gear shaft assemblies.

triumph.defect: Rear brake pedal travel may increase prior to feeling the brake engage. Rear brake pedal travel may increase prior to feeling the brake engage.
