vauxhall.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST The retaining ring of the steering gear pinion might be out of it's retaining groove. In the worst case the steering gear pinion may lose engagement resulting in loss of steering control
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering gear assembly

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF WIRING Under certain conditions the alternator feed wire/terminal may contact the clutch cable and the instrument panel harness may chafe against the steering column. Either of these concerns could lead to short circuiting and.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles reposition the alternator terminal and secure the wiring harnesses in the bulkhead area away from moving parts.

vauxhall.defect: RISK OF FIRE It has been identified that on vehicles fitted with the Z16XEP engine the upper oil pressure switch might release oil onto the exhaust manifold heat protection shield which could result in self ignition.
vauxhall.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the upper oil pressure switch replaced by a screw plug. Additionally a modified oil pressure switch will be fitted in a lower position.

vauxhall.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL The steering column intermediate shaft may have a loose press fit on the upper joint yoke. If left increased free play and a knocking noise will develop which if ignored could lead to loss of steering.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new intermediate steering shaft.

vauxhall.defect: SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY SEPARATE FROM SEAT FRAME A certain number of Insignia A - Model Year 17 the front seat belt buckles may not be produced according specification. In a worst case the seat belt buckles may separate from the seat frame in the event of an accident.
vauxhall.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to check and if necessary replace the seat belt buckles on all affected vehicles.

vauxhall.defect: FRONT BRAKE HOSES  INCORRECTLY INSTALLED On a certain number of Astra K - Model Year 2016-2017 (Only converted UK Police vehicles are affected)  the front brake hoses might be incorrectly installed. This can lead to contact with the drive shaft boots finally resulting in failure/leakage.
vauxhall.remedy: Vauxhall authorised repairers or Police Workshops are asked to reroute the brake hoses and to inspect the brake hose installation if necessary replace any damaged parts to guarantee accurate functionality of the brakes.

vauxhall.defect: THE ENGINE PISTONS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The engine pistons may not be according to specification leading to oil entry in the inlet circuit. In a worst case this may cause an increased engine rpm for a few seconds possibly resulting in a total engine failure.
vauxhall.remedy: Perform a test of the engine to establish if the pistons are to specification. Where necessary the engine will be replaced.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The thread on the swivel pin of the track rod end might not be to specification. Therefore when the nut was tightened onto the thread the correct clamping force may not have been attained. After high mileage damage might occur and develop. If not attended to there is a possiblility that the component might fail and steering control would be lost.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the thread on the swivel joint of the track rod end. Where it does not conform to specification replace the track rod end.

vauxhall.defect: WINDOW ANTI-TRAP MAY MALFUNCTION The anti-pinch or auto reverse function of the window regulator may not work correctly to ECE R21 requirements. So it is possible to trap items including fingers and limbs between the window and its closure.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary replace the window regulator motor.

vauxhall.defect: FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY A front seat side air bag may not deploy as intended
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

vauxhall.defect: RISK OF FIRE Vauxhall has conducted an in depth investigation of fires in Zafira B models. Vauxhall has presented the evidence to DVSA and analysis has determined the root cause is improper repair to heater blower motor resistors. These actions are outside of Vauxhall�s design specifications and authorised maintenance processes.
vauxhall.remedy: At the request of DVSA Vauxhall is now reclassifying its ongoing rework activity to a safety recall. The recall entails replacing the resistor pack and any other faulty components to return the heating and ventilation system to its original design condition.

vauxhall.defect: INCORRECT TORQUE APPLIED TO TRAILER HITCH FITTING BOLTS It has been identified that during production an incorrect torque was applied to the trailer hitch fitting bolts.
vauxhall.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the trailer hitch bolts replaced and tightened to the correct torque.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE PERFORMANCE Potential soft brake pedal and reduced brake performance due to water induced corrosion of the brake master cylinder and consequential fluid leakage.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the brake master cylinder and refill brake system with fresh fluid.

vauxhall.defect: IT MAY NOT BE POSSIBLE TO ENGAGE THE HANDBRAKE LEVER It may not be possible to engage the handbrake lever.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the handbrake lever locking mechanism and if necessary replace the handbrake lever.

vauxhall.defect: ON BOARD DIAGNOSTIC SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION on a certain number of Movano B - Model Year 16 and 17 with LWK or L0D engine there are some problems of the OBD (on Board Diagnostic) which should be indicated but do not trigger the MIL (Malfunction Indication Lamp). occurs  Possible faults  which should be indicated but do not trigger the MIL (Malfunction Indication Lamp). Under worst-case conditions the OBD would recognize a failure on Exhaust System components (e.g. components of the Exhaust Gas Recirculation EGR) but would not display the failure with a malfunction indicator lamp.
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogram the K20 Engine Control Module via SPS with the latest software available on TIS2WEB:

vauxhall.defect: INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF THE REAR WHEEL HUB BOLTS Noises may come from the rear wheel brake and wheel pinion socket due to incorrect tightening of the rear wheel hub bolts.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the affected rear wheel hub bolts.

vauxhall.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY PARTIALLY RELEASE Following a small number of complaints of Vauxhall Vectra and Signum vehicles rolling away due to allegedly defective handbrakes. Vauxhall engineers in conjunction with consultants and other bodies have conducted rigorous testing and found that provided the handbrake is applied correctly without depressing the release button the handbrake is perfectly safe.
vauxhall.remedy: In line with it's priority of continuous improvement recalled vehicles will be fitted with a modified handbrake mechanism to reduce the possibility of a partial release.

vauxhall.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that the welds to the left front suspension-strut turret many not be to specification. This could lead to detachment of the suspension-strut turret detachment and subsequent loss of control of the vehicle.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and apply additional weld seams to the turret.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ENGINE MAY STALL On affected vehicles there is a  potential chafing condition between an engine wiring harness and the transmission housing which might cause miscellaneous engines failures e.g.  engine telltale on illuminates  vehicle may not start or the engine stalls during driving.
vauxhall.remedy: Reroute loom on affected vehicles. If necessary repair or replace loom.

vauxhall.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

vauxhall.defect: SUSPENSION MAY BECOME INSECURE The longitudinal control arm of the rear axle may not be correctly fastened. This may cause the arm to break and/or detach.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles check the torque of the screw connection on the longitudinal rod  and replace nuts bolts or rear axle where necessary.

vauxhall.defect: SEVERAL REAR AXLE FASTENING BOLTS NEED TO BE REPLACED Rear axle bolts may break or become loose
vauxhall.remedy: Check the fastening torque and replace affected bolts on all affected vehicles

vauxhall.defect: REAR EXHAUST PIPE MAY MOVE BACKWARDS SLIPPING OFF THE FRONT PIPE The possibility exists that the rear exhaust pipe can move backwards and slip off the front pipe. With the possibility that under body components may become damaged.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check likely to be affected under body areas and install a new exhaust clamp.

vauxhall.defect: RIGHT FRONT SEAT WELD MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The welding to the right hand front single seat may not be to specification. In the event of an accident the right hand front seat may separate from the floor panel.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles to add two welding seams on each rear bracket on the right hand front seat pedestal.

vauxhall.defect: FRONT PASSENGER SEAT COULD MOVE WITHOUT WARNING. The fixing bolts of the front passenger seat rails to seat frame may fail and leave the seat insecure. In the event of an accident this could lessen the effectiveness of the seat belt.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front passenger seat rails to seat frame fixing bolts.

vauxhall.defect: THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE COMPENSATION (VACUUM) PUMP MAY NOT GET ACTIVATED . Under specific conditions (vacuum loss) the Hydraulic Brake Compensation (vacuum pump) may not get activated
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogram the Electronic Brake Control Module (EBCM) with improved software.

vauxhall.defect: SEAT SECURITY CONCERN Driver and front passenger seat adjuster rails may fracture and cause seat to become insecure.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcing plates to the seat runners. Fit new runners if the original ones are fractured.

vauxhall.defect: LOSS OF STABILITY The connection between the steering knuckle and the lower control arm may not be assembled correctly. If this condition is evident the connection could become insecure. The event can happen suddenly and unexpectedly in which case the vehicle is no longer controllable.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the connection between the steering knuckle and the lower control arm on both sides of the vehicle. Where necessary the connection will be reassembled correctly.

vauxhall.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Moisture can ingress and accumulate inside the ABS control unit. Excessive accumulation of moisture may cause a fire.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles install an additional ABS module protection cover.

vauxhall.defect: AUXILIARY HEATER HARNESS CONNECTOR COULD OVER HEAT It is possible that the auxiliary heater harness connection could over heat or burn due to oxidization.  In extreme cases it is possible that this could result in a thermal incident.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and install heat shrink sleeves to the wining.

vauxhall.defect: The rear toe link may have material loss over vehicle lifetime due to corrosion. The rear toe link may have material loss over vehicle lifetime due to corrosion which weakens the part. This leads to a risk of breakage while driving. In case of breakage this leads to a reduced ability to control the vehicle.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and replace the rear toe link if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: SEATBELTS MAY STICK WHEN PULLED OUT OR RETRACTED On affected vehicles certain seat belts might stick when pulled out and retracted.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the affected seat belts on the affected vehicles.

vauxhall.defect: THE BRAKE PEDAL BOX IS NOT ASSEMBLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS There is a risk that the Brake Pedal may fall down while driving resulting in the total loss of brake performance.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the assembly date range and replace the brake pedal box if affected.

vauxhall.defect: Movano Smart Tachograph Affected vehicles have a smart tachograph fitted that may not comply with regulatory requirements.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the Tachograph Sensor Antenna(s) and adding Wiring Harnesses if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Astra Grandland Fuel pipe leakage Affected vehicles may face potential leakage of the under-bonnet fuel pipe due to a weakness of its crimping.
vauxhall.remedy: Change the fuel pipe.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Astra Grandland Fuel pipe leakage Affected vehicles may face potential leakage of the under-bonnet fuel pipe due to a weakness of its crimping.
vauxhall.remedy: Change the fuel pipe.

vauxhall.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update. Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
vauxhall.remedy: Change the ATB.

vauxhall.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update. Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
vauxhall.remedy: Change the ATB.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Corsa Jet cooling nozzle failure. On affected vehicles the engine is at risk of becoming damaged because of an inadequate oil supply from an oil jet cooling nozzle.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the engine oil and filter.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain. Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain. Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

vauxhall.defect: Cross carline Engine software On affected vehicles below 12500 miles under certain conditions engine emissions may lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the mileage of the vehicle and update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration on vehicles below 12500 miles.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Combo 4x4 Transfer Box On affected vehicles a defective 4x4 transfer box oil seal might leak resulting in the rear wheels locking up and a loss of control of the vehicle.
vauxhall.remedy: Remove and replace the front transfer box oil seal.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Grandland X PHEV Traction Battery Affected vehicles may have a fault in the High Voltage Battery which could potentially lead to it overheating and in the worst case a battery or vehicle fire. Customers are advised to stop any plug-in charging and eSave charging until the vehicle is reworked.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the battery management software or replace the High Voltage Battery if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Astra Corsa Mokka eVCU update Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Astra Corsa Mokka eVCU update Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Astra Corsa Mokka eVCU update Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

vauxhall.defect: Instrument Panel Cluster Software On affected vehicles a low AdBlue level message may not be displayed on the Instrument Panel Cluster.  This could lead to the possibility of not being able to start the vehicle due to an empty AdBlue tank.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the Instrument Panel Cluster software.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Automomous Telematics Box. Affected vehicles may experience an autonomous telematic box that cannot connect to the remote server making it not possible to make calls or use other connected services.
vauxhall.remedy: Disconnect the 12V battery and reconnect it after 15 seconds then check for a trouble code.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Vivaro  K0 Seat Fixation On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
vauxhall.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Corsa Radio software via OTA update. On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
vauxhall.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Grandland Risk of broken bolt front control arm ball joint On affected vehicles the fixing bolts on the front left or right bracket on the lower control arm may break.  In the worst-case scenario 2 broken bolts could affect the controllability of the vehicle.
vauxhall.remedy: Change the front left and right ball joint brackets.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Frontera Brake Pedal Bracket Connection. On affected vehicles there may be an insufficient brake pedal bracket connection due to a missing or incorrectly assembled pin. If the pin falls out the brake pedal will potentially disengage.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the brake pedal connection confirm proper assembly and rework it if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: MCU software On affected vehicles incorrect MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration may result in a loss of propulsion while driving.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall cross carline Driver’s Airbag - Takata On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbag inflators may deteriorate over time.  This may cause the inflators to rupture with too much force in a crash leading to serious injury or death in a worst-case scenario.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the driver airbag module.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Combo (K9) Headlamp Height Level Sensor Affected vehicles may have the Headlamp Height Level sensor fitted with incorrect orientation causing the Headlamp beam to be aimed too low and does not adjust as it should.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the Height Level Sensor for correct assembly and replace if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: Low Pressure Fuel Pipe On affected vehicles the low-pressure fuel pipe could come in to contact with one of the ignition coil screws. This could lead to fuel pipe damage over time resulting in a fuel leak.
vauxhall.remedy: Fix the low-pressure fuel pipe to the crankcase breather hose with a cable tie to ensure there is no contact between the ignition coil screw and the fuel pipe.

vauxhall.defect: Traction Battery software Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

vauxhall.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

vauxhall.defect: Movano – Fuel Pipe Leak Affected vehicles may experience a diesel fuel leak from the fuel pressure damper.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the lower section of the fuel pipe including the damper.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall cross carline Driver’s Airbag - Takata On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbags may deteriorate over time which may cause the inflator to rupture and lead to serious injury.
vauxhall.remedy: Owners of affected vehicles should immediately cease using their vehicle when safe to do so until the recall action has been completed. Affected vehicles will have the airbag modules replaced.

vauxhall.defect: Autonomous Telematics Box Affected vehicles have been fitted with the wrong Autonomous Telematic Box.  This means it cannot connect to the remoter server making it impossible to make E-Calls or use Intelligent Speed Assistance.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the Autonomous Telematic Box.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Fuel Pipe On affected vehicles there there may be loose connections between a high-pressure fuel pipe and the engine fuel rail which potentially could lead to a leak and risk of fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Fuel Pipe On affected vehicles there there may be loose connections between a high-pressure fuel pipe and the engine fuel rail which potentially could lead to a leak and risk of fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

vauxhall.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

vauxhall.defect: Vauxhall Astra L E-call not working due to duplicate IMEI On affected vehicles equipped with E-call the device may not function when trying to connect to E-Call (Emergency Call) and B-Call (Breakdown Call) due to incorrect BSRF (On-board radiocommunication transmitter) configuration and as a result does not comply with regulatory requirements.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and replace the Radio frequency connectivity box.

vauxhall.defect: THE FIXED ROOF LUGGAGE CARRIER RAILS MAY BECOME LOOSE The vehicle�s fixed roof luggage carrier rails may become loose.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and replace the fixed roof luggage carrier rails if necessary

vauxhall.defect: LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE The brake vacuum pump fitted to the F8Q diesel engine can leak with the potential to allow oil to enter the brake servo with the consequence that a sudden loss of servo assistance and reduction of braking efficiency could occur.
vauxhall.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles will be recalled and the make of the vacuum pump checked. Should this be found to be of Magnetti Marelli manufacture the pump will be changed for a quality assured unit. In addition the servo and associated vacuum pipe will be examined for oil ingress and replaced where necessary.

vauxhall.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL THE MANUFACTURER HAS RECOMMENDED THAT AFFECTED VEHICLES ARE NOT DRIVEN UNTIL CHECKED BY THEIR OFFICIAL AGENTS. The steering system may not have been produced according to specification. There is a risk that the steering intermediate shaft may break while driving resulting in the loss of steering control.
vauxhall.remedy: The affected vehicles must not be driven until a new intermediate shaft that does meet the manufacturer's specification has been fitted.

vauxhall.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING POWER WHERE THE BRAKE PEDAL IS APPLIED SLOWLY AND CONSTANTLY Extended brake pedal travel and a reduction in braking power where the brake pedal is applied slowly and constantly.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace numerous brake and clutch hydraulic components.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING IN STEERING DROP ARM AND BRACKET Cracking may occur in the steering drop arm or idler arm and bracket assembly which if not detected could ultimately affect steering control.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for examination of the subject components. Any arms or brackets identified as belonging to the affected batches will be replaced with quality assured examples.

vauxhall.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL The mounting end of the handbrake cable may move in its support bracket.  This might result in the loss of the handbrake function.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to either have a washer installed or the replacement of the cable.

vauxhall.defect: INCORRECT GEAR AND STEERING KNUCKLE FITTED As a result of an incorrect steering gear and steering knucle combination being fitted during manufacture the front tyres may contact the lower front suspension arms when the steering is turned on to a full lock.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace both the steering knucles. Additionally the lower suspension arms and tyres will be checked for damage.

vauxhall.defect: THE REAR END IMPACT LIMITER MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN PRODUCTION The rear end impact limiter might not have been installed in production.
vauxhall.remedy: Check if the rear end impact limiter is present and install one if required.

vauxhall.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL A small number of steering knuckles on hub swivels have been manufactured incorrectly. In time these knuckles might fail with the attendant loss of directional control of the vehicle.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the production date code on steering knuckles fitted to both sides. Replace the steering knuckles where required.

vauxhall.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN ENGINE COOLING RADIATOR AIR INTAKE MODULE SEALING BAFFLE MISSING Vehicles may have an engine cooling radiator air intake module sealing baffle missing.
vauxhall.remedy: Install the missing radiator air intake sealing baffle.

vauxhall.defect: THE FRONT MODULAR BENCH SEAT HEADRESTS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION. The front modular bench seat headrests may not be to specification and might not be locked correctly.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected headrests and guides

vauxhall.defect: AIRBAG MAY INADVERTENTLY DEPLOY In some circumstances there is a possibility that the side airbag may inadvertently deploy.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit additional springs to the front seats so that any electrostatic discharge will correctly earthed.

vauxhall.defect: RISK OF FIRE In the event the heater fan resistor thermal fuse is affected by a combination of several factors there is a possible risk of fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the resistor fuse with modified type. Fit new moulding to base of windscreen and where not already done so replace heater motor assembly.

vauxhall.defect: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE An incorrect front brake hose may have been fitted which may allow brake fluid to leak
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace front brake hoses

vauxhall.defect: 18 INCH ALLOY WHEELS MAY BECOME INSECURE 18 inch alloy wheels may develop cracking at high mileages in excess of 62000 miles. This may lead to a loss of clamping force at the wheel bolts and in a worse case scenario wheel detachment.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles replace all four wheels.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE In order for proper regeneration of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) system the vehicle in the active regeneration mode directs the driver by illuminating the DPF warning light to drive the vehicle at constant speed without interruption until the DPF warning light turns off. In the event that the driver ignores the DPF warning light and the corresponding direction the DPF system as well as exhaust pipe will be abnormally overheated. This may cause a fire at the Lower Engine Compartment Cover located near the DPF system and exhaust pipe.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and initially remove and discard the Lower Engine Compartment Cover. When parts are available the vehicles will be recalled to have the new Lower Engine Compartment Cover fitted.

vauxhall.defect: EGR VALVE PIPE MAY FAIL It has been identified that the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) valve pipe may fail/break. This will allow hot exhaust gases to escape and potentially damage component in the surrounding area.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the EGR valve pipe.

vauxhall.defect: FRONT DUAL SEAT MAY BE UNSTABLE IN A COLLISION The front dual passenger seat may fail as the welded seams may not be to specification.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect and inspect the seat frame and where necessary replace the frame.

vauxhall.defect: VSM software Interior door handles Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

vauxhall.defect: VSM software Interior door handles Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

vauxhall.defect: Movano software - turn signal detection. On affected vehicles the Body Control Module is not correctly configured to detect a failure in the indicator lamps.  As a result if a turn indicator bulb fails it's not detected and the indicator warning does not activate.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the vehicle configuration and the Secure Gateway Electronic Control Unit.

vauxhall.defect: WATER INGRESS THROUGH WHEEL ARCHES INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT Water ingress into the passenger compartment due to poor wheel arch sealing may lead to airbag malfunction
vauxhall.remedy: Seal the wheel arch body seams.  Replace wiring harness and airbag control unit if necessary

vauxhall.defect: RISK OF FIRE Water ingress to the relay on the electrical vacuum pump may cause a short. In extreme instances this may lead to fire.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles replace Vacuum Pump/Relay Assembly and apply special grease to electrical connectors

vauxhall.defect: SEAT BELTS MAY BECOME INSECURE The bolt securing the outer seat belt buckles may become loose on the 2nd and if fitted 3d row seats
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles remove bolt remove washer clean and refit bolt applying thread lock

vauxhall.defect: SEAT SECURITY CONCERN Driver and front passenger seat adjuster rails may fracture and cause seat to become insecure.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcing plates to the seat runners. Fit new runners if the original ones are fractured.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE UNEXPECTED SIDE AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT DUE TO INSUFFICIENT ELECTRICAL GROUNDING Possible unexpected side airbag deployment due to insufficient electrical grounding.
vauxhall.remedy: Rework the affected ground studs to ensure sufficient electrical grounding.

vauxhall.defect: LOSS OF PARKING BRAKE FUNCTION Incorrect crimping of the secondary parking brake cable ferrules.
vauxhall.remedy: Replacement of the secondary parking brake cables the adjuster and the adjustment nut.

vauxhall.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY FAIL It has been identified that cracking of the parking brake actuating levers of the rear axle disc brake calipers may lead to loss of parking brake function.
vauxhall.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected and affected parts replaced as necessary.

vauxhall.defect: RISK OF DRIVESHAFT FAILURE Due to insufficient coating during manufacture the drive-shafts) may corrode and fracture. In the event that the drive-shaft is fractured the vehicle loses drive but steering and braking will be still be available.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles replace both drive shafts.

vauxhall.defect: SEAT ADJUSTER CONCERN The driver and front passenger seat longtitudinal adjuster latch spring may weaken and fail to lock the seat in the selected position. This could affect the drivers control of the vehicle and/or passenger safety.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check the effectiveness of the adjuster latch spring. Fit a new seat base in cases where the spring is found to be defective.

vauxhall.defect: SEATBELT MAY MALFUNCTION IF VEHICLE IS INVOLVED IN A COLLISION The front seat belts on vehicles with height adjustable seats  may not react as designed during a collision.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles; Initially check and if necessary  replace the steel cable linking the pretensioner to the seat. At a later date  the outer pretensioner will be replaced with an improved version.

vauxhall.defect: CRACK IN THE REAR AXLE KNUCKLE CASING Possible crack in the rear axle knuckle casting.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the rear axle knuckle.

vauxhall.defect: OIL PLUG LEAKAGE On a certain number of Grandland X - Model Year 18 with LCI engine (D20DTH) Engine oil might leak from an oil plug in the cylinder block. This could lead to oil stains on the floor low engine oil volume (warning on dashboard if volume is low) or MIL on if the oil pressure is low.
vauxhall.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to  tighten the oil plug in the cylinder block on the timing case side to 42 Nm

vauxhall.defect: ON BOARD DIAGNOSTIC SYSTEM MAY FAIL TO DISPLAY FAILURE OF THE POWER STEERING ASSIST PUMP on a certain number of Movano B - Model Year 17 and 18 the alerts on failures from power steering assist pump might not be indicated in the instrument cluster due to incorrect calibration file in Instrument Cluster. OBD System does not work to specification because a potential failure on the power steering assist pump might not be indicated in the instrument cluster
vauxhall.remedy: Apply the new calibration file for Instrument Cluster

vauxhall.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY INCREASE UNINTENTIONALLY It is possible that the internal contact resistance of the crimped joints for the grounding between the throttle position sensor (TPS) and engine control module may increase due to engine vibration. This can lead to an increased TPS voltage output which could lead to an increase in engine revolutions whilst at idle without any throttle input.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the installation of a new wiring harness.

vauxhall.defect: ON VEHICLES WITHOUT A PASSENGER AIRBAG THE SEAT BELT MAY NOT SUFFICIENTLY RETAIN THE PASSENGER The front passenger seatbelt may not retain the passenger sufficiently in case of an accident with high impact.
vauxhall.remedy: Replacement of the front passenger seat belt with correct retention force specification.

vauxhall.defect: THE REAR WHEEL HUB SHOCK ABSORBER AND BRAKE CALIPER ARE POSSIBLY NOT TIGHTENED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION The rear wheel hub the shock absorber and the brake calliper are possibly not tightened according to specification.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the affected bolted connections on the rear axle for correct tightening torque application and replace affected components if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: THE FRONT SUSPENSION SPRINGS MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY POSITIONED IN THE STRUT ASSEMBLY The front suspension springs may not be correctly positioned in the strut assembly.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the front suspension springs and correct the position of the spring if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: A POTENTIAL FOR AN INTERMITTENT INTERNAL CONNECTION ISSUE ON THE DC/DC CHIP OF THE ON-BOARD CHARGER A potential for an intermittent internal connection issue on the DC/DC chip of the on-board charger.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the on-board charger and update with the latest software.

vauxhall.defect: FRONT AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT CONCERN Child seat safety cradle with transponder may not interact as intended with front passenger smart Airbag deactivation function. Software concern with control unit.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace front Airbag control unit with a quality assured item.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The thread on the swivel pin of the track rod end might not be to specification. Therefore when the nut was tightened onto the thread the correct clamping force may not have been attained. After high mileage damage might occur and develop. If not attended to there is a possiblility that the component might fail and steering control would be lost.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the thread on the swivel joint of the track rod end. Where it does not conform to specification replace the track rod end.

vauxhall.defect: THE MATERIAL THICKNESS OF THE WHEEL RIMS MAY BE INCORRECT SPECIFICATION The material thickness of the wheel rims might be out of specification
vauxhall.remedy: Check and replace the wheel rims if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: SECURITY OF FUEL PIPES In a small number of cases the fuel supply and/or return pipes may detach from their connection at the fuel tank.
vauxhall.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the security of the supply and return pipes checked. Where any of the pipes is found to be insecure the securing clip and if necessary the tank sender unit will be replaced.

vauxhall.defect: A HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY WHERE THERE IS A MISMATCH IN THE VOLTAGE OF THE INDIVIDUAL CELLS A high voltage battery where there is a mismatch in the voltage of the individual cells.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the HV traction battery.

vauxhall.defect: REAR EXHAUST PIPE MAY MOVE BACKWARDS SLIPPING OFF THE FRONT PIPE The possibility exists that the rear exhaust pipe can move backwards and slip off the front pipe. With the possibility that under body components may become damaged.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check likely to be affected under body areas and install a new exhaust clamp.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE LEAKY CONNECTION ON THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL PUMP Possible leaky connection on the high pressure fuel pump.
vauxhall.remedy: Re-tighten the high pressure fuel pump and replace the fuel supply pipe.

vauxhall.defect: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL THE MANUFACTURER HAS RECOMMENDED THAT AFFECTED VEHICLES ARE NOT DRIVEN UNTIL CHECKED BY THEIR OFFICIAL AGENTS. The steering system may not have been produced according to specification. There is a risk that the steering intermediate shaft may break while driving resulting in the loss of steering control.
vauxhall.remedy: The affected vehicles must not be driven until a new intermediate shaft that does meet the manufacturer's specification has been fitted.

vauxhall.defect: WIRING MAY CHAFE ON BRAKE PIPE As a result of engine movement a wiring harness may chafe on a steel brake pipe adjacent to the brake master cylinder. This could cause short circuiting and possible loss of braking efficiency should the brake fluid temperature rise as a result.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified clip to the wiring harness. Additionally the harness will be sheathed for additional protection in the area adjacent to the brake pipe.

vauxhall.defect: Update the vehicle s software in order to improve the diagnosis of the braking assistance system and avoid any risk of reduction or loss of braking assistance On the affected vehicles the operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt caused by the ageing of the engine oil.
vauxhall.remedy: To rectify this issue a software update will be downloaded which will improve the vacuum diagnosis (in order to warn earlier about the risk of loss or reduction of braking assistance).

vauxhall.defect: A fuel pipe could develop a leak in the engine compartment which could lead to a risk of a vehicle fire. A fuel pipe could develop a leak in the engine compartment which could lead to a risk of a vehicle fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and replace the fuel pipe if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: TAILGATE MAY DROP ABRUPTLY AFTER IT IS OPENED Due to a gradual gas leak inside the left-hand tailgate strut the strut may become unable to support the opened tailgate. The tailgate may drop abruptly after first opening normally potentially causing serious injuries to persons present in the opening range of the tailgate.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replaced the left hand gas strut.

vauxhall.defect: BONNET LOCK MAY FAIL The tightening torque of both hood primary latch bolts may not be to specification and cause the locking function of the hood to not work correctly. The loosening of the hood latch screws under the influence of vibrations together with the aerodynamic pressure under the hood can lead to the bonnet not staying in the closed position.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the tightening torque of both hood primary latch bolts. Where necessary the bolts will be replaced.

vauxhall.defect: SEAT BELT MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY It has been found that some of the front seat mounting brackets have not been correctly fitted to the seats. The front seat mountings could fail if the fitting brackets have been incorrectly fitted.  Vehicle control could be affected.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit new seat assemblies.

vauxhall.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving. There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

vauxhall.defect: THE PARKING BRAKE LEVER MIGHT NOT LOCK IN THE ENGAGED POSITION OR MIGHT DISENGAGE AFTER APPLICATION The parking brake lever might not lock in the engaged position or might disengage after application
vauxhall.remedy: Check the handbrake mechanism and replace if required

vauxhall.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO ABS  WIRING MAY CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT AND A FIRE It has been identified that the above vehicles could be affected by moisture ingress at the ABS connector. The moisture can enter through the ground wiring connection  which can lead to the ABS not functioning correctly overheating within the connector and in extreme cases a fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the ABS harness plug checked for moisture ingress and where necessary the wiring harness and control unit will be replaced. In all other cases the ground cable will be secured against ingress of moisture by soldering the cable sockets and applying shrink tubes.

vauxhall.defect: ROOF SIDE RAIL AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY A roof side rail  air bag may not deploy as intended
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

vauxhall.defect: STEERING WHEEL CENTRE SCREW MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY. The steering wheel centre screw may not have been tightened correctly.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the centre torx screw and tighten to the specified torque.

vauxhall.defect: VEHICLES MAY DELIVER A HIGHER DIESEL PARTICULATE RATE THAN SPECIFIED Vehicles might deliver a higher diesel particulate rate than specified.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the DPF. Some models will also need a software change.

vauxhall.defect: Insufficient tightening torque of the steering gear fastening bolts can lead to vibration or improper steering behaviour. Insufficient tightening torque of the steering gear fastening bolts can lead to vibration or improper steering behaviour.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and replace the steering gear if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: SUNROOF GLASS PANEL INSECURE A deviation in the supplier manufacturing printing process on the glass panel caused may cause a   loss of adhesion over vehicle lifetime. This may cause the sunroof panel to detach.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles rework the adhesive connection between the sunroof panel and the vehicle body.

vauxhall.defect: THE TURBO CHARGER OIL RETURN PIPE MAY CRACK AND LEAK ENGINE OIL The turbo charger oil return pipe may get damaged by cracks which may lead to oil leaks.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the oil return pipes on affected vehicles

vauxhall.defect: On the affected vehicles equipped with a manual handbrake the efficiency of the handbrake and service brake may be compromised On the affected vehicles equipped with a manual handbrake the efficiency of the handbrake and service brake may be compromised.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the rear brake caliper references and replace as necessary.

vauxhall.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
vauxhall.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

vauxhall.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST It has been identified that on a certain number of 2007 model year vehicles the front lower suspension control arms might fracture near the bushing due to a production deviation during the welding process. The control arm may then lack rigidity; which may impair driving stability. In the worst case the driver may loose control of the vehicle.
vauxhall.remedy: Subject vehicles will have the control arm welds checked and replaced as necessary.

vauxhall.defect: Affected vehicles have Engine Control Unit software not according to specification. Affected vehicles have Engine Control Unit software not according to specification.
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogramme the ECU (Engine Control Unit) with updated software.

vauxhall.defect: SEAT BELT LATCHING CONCERN Driver and front passenger seat belt latching mechanism may separate when loaded in a frontal impact.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit quality assured seat belt buckles.

vauxhall.defect: THE REAR SPRING CENTRALISER MIGHT BE WELDED INCORRECTLY The rear spring centraliser might be welded incorrectly.
vauxhall.remedy: Add 3 weld spots to the rear spring centralisers.

vauxhall.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY IN AN ACCIDENT The laser cut split line of the passenger air-bag cover may not be present.  In the case of an accident it is possible that the passenger air-bag may not deploy.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles and replace the passenger air-bag module cover.

vauxhall.defect: THE BOLTS AND NUTS OF THE CONTROL ARMS MIGHT BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED The bolts and nuts of both the control arms might be incorrectly tightened.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the bolts and nuts of both the control arms and tighten to the correct specifications.

vauxhall.defect: REAR ALLOY ROAD WHEEL MAY FRACTURE In extreme driving conditions it is possible that the rear wheel/s may fracture.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check that H.T. is stamped on the inside of one of the spokes. I there is no such marking the wheel/s must be replaced.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

vauxhall.defect: THE ENGINE PISTONS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The engine pistons may not be according to specification leading to oil entry in the inlet circuit. In a worst case this may cause an increased engine rpm for a few seconds possibly resulting in a total engine failure.
vauxhall.remedy: Perform a test of the engine to establish if the pistons are to specification. Where necessary the engine will be replaced.

vauxhall.defect: WINDOW ANTI-TRAP MAY MALFUNCTION The anti-pinch or auto reverse function of the window regulator may not work correctly to ECE R21 requirements. So it is possible to trap items including fingers and limbs between the window and its closure.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary replace the window regulator motor.

vauxhall.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

vauxhall.defect: ABS MAY FAIL It is possible for moisture to enter the ABS connector/control unit. This can cause the ABS system not to function correctly and in the worst case overheating which may lead to fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the ABS control unit fit a protective cover to the control unit and seal the earth point with wax.

vauxhall.defect: THE FRONT SEAT BACK FRAME LOWER CROSS MEMBER STRUCTURE MAY NOT BE WELDED CORRECTLY Front seat frames may not be welded correctly
vauxhall.remedy: Check seat frame welds and replace front seats if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: HEATED WASHER NOZZLE MAY SHORT CIRCUIT It is possible that moisture may enter the heated washer nozzle housing and cause a short circuit of the heating elements. In the worse case a fire may ensue.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to disconnect the heated washer nozzle housings.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING IN STEERING DROP ARM AND BRACKET Cracking may occur in the steering drop arm or idler arm and bracket assembly which if not detected could ultimately affect steering control.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for examination of the subject components. Any arms or brackets identified as belonging to the affected batches will be replaced with quality assured examples.

vauxhall.defect: THE CLIP OF A FUEL LINE BUNDLE MIGHT CHAFE AGAINST THE FUEL PUMP The clip of a fuel line bundle might chafe against the fuel pump hose.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the hose routing turn the clip by 180�.  Replace the hose and add a grommet to the fuel hose if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: THE BOLTS SECURING THE REAR AXLE BEAM TO THE VEHICLE UNDERBODY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED The bolts securing the rear axle beam to the vehicle underbody could break.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace the rear axle affected  bolts.

vauxhall.defect: WINDSCREEN MAY NOT BE INSTALLED CORRECTLY on a certain number of Insignia B - Model Year 18 with special color option (RPO code: GAF) the windscreen might not be installed correctly and can potentially detach from body. The one affected vehicle was repaired in the Luton Technical Centre
vauxhall.remedy: Check the bonding of the windscreen and rework if required.

vauxhall.defect: SOFTWARE DOES NOT ALLOW CONFORMITY TESTING Software does not allow the authorities to test according to regulation.
vauxhall.remedy: Re-flash the Body Control software.

vauxhall.defect: 1) POSSIBLE STATIC SPARKING DURING REFUELLING (ASTRA MODELS ONLY) 2) AIR BAG SYSTEM MAY NOT DEPLOY 1) During refuelling the flow of fuel can cause static electricity to build up in the tank filler neck with the possibility of static sparking. 2) On some vehicles an electrical connector plug in the air bag system may not be correctly possible
vauxhall.remedy: A) The fitting of a metal earthing clamp to the lower end of the metal ring for the fuel filler cap to ensure a conductive connection between the filler neck and the vehicle body. B) Checking that in potentially affected vehicles the subject elect

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK Under certain conditions the engine wiring harness may touch the bonnet hinge. With prolonged chafing this may lead to a possible electrical short circuit and if not dealt with eventual combustion.
vauxhall.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the engine wiring harness re-routed and secured clear of the bonnet hinge.

vauxhall.defect: TAIL LIGHTS MAY FAIL IF REAR BICYCLE CARRIER IS FOLDED BACK INCORRECTLY It has been identified on certain Mokka models produced between 2013 & 2017 equipped with a rear bicycle carrier that if the rear bicycle carrier is not folded back into its correct stowed position after use then the body control module will not recognise this and will not illuminate the vehicles rear/tail lights when required.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to attach a sticker on the rear bicycle carrier instructing driver how to stow the rear bicycle carrier correctly.

vauxhall.defect: SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY FAIL Seat-belt buckle for the double cab second seat row may separate from seat connector under load.
vauxhall.remedy: Check all seat-belt buckles of the second seat row according to the following rework instruction and install a new seat-belt buckle if necessary

vauxhall.defect: STEERING RACK MAY FRACTURE Due to a manufacturing process deviation the toothed rack of the steering gear might break under extensive force application i.e. when manoeuvring at slow speed.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the build date of the steering rack. Where the steering rack is proved to be from the affected batch the steering rack will be replaced.

vauxhall.defect: REAR AXLE HUB MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The hardening process applied to the rear wheel bearing inner ring may be incorrect. There is a possibility that a rumbling noise may become apparent which if not checked could in extreme circumstances result in the detachment of the hub and severely impaired road holding/handling.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the date stamp on the rear wheel hubs. Where necessary replace the hub bearing assembly.

vauxhall.defect: Affected vehicles may not conform to regulatory emission requirements EU R83. Affected vehicles may not conform to regulatory emission requirements EU R83.
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogram ECU with updated software and calibration.

vauxhall.defect: A FUEL LEAK MAY OCCUR DUE TO A CHAFING CONDITION BETWEEN THE FUEL FEED HOSE AND THE CAMSHAFT COVER A fuel leak may occur due to a chafing condition between the fuel feed hose and the camshaft cover.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the fuel feed hose replace it if damaged and add a protection to the hose to prevent a future chafing condition.

vauxhall.defect: FASTENING NUT OF THE REAR AXLE HUB MAY WORK LOOSE on a certain number of Crossland X - Model Year 18 the Fastening Nut of the Rear Axle Hub might potentially become loose. This can lead to a separation of the rear wheel resulting in a loss of steering control.
vauxhall.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to check both Rear Axle Hub Nuts for correct application of the securing punch if correct no further action.  if incorrect replace hubstud and nut assembly

vauxhall.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK on a certain number of Antara (RHD) with 2.0L Diesel Engine Model Year 2007 - 2010 there is a potential for a fuel leak caused by a partial or complete disconnection of a fuel feed hose connector. This fuel leak leads to engine stalling and in a worst case it might potentially result in an engine bay fire. This fuel leak leads to engine stalling and in a worst case it might potentially result in an engine bay fire. No reported cases of fires.
vauxhall.remedy: to  Check and correct the fuel feed hose routing replace the fuel feed hose quick connector retainer and apply a warning sticker to advice that the retainer is a single-use part

vauxhall.defect: RISK OF DRIVESHAFT FAILURE Due to insufficient coating during manufacture the drive-shafts) may corrode and fracture. In the event that the drive-shaft is fractured the vehicle loses drive but steering and braking will be still be available.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles replace both drive shafts.

vauxhall.defect: THE PASSENGER SEATBELT WARNING CHIME MIGHT BE INOPERATIVE The passenger seatbelt warning chime might be inoperative.
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogram the Body Control Module software.

vauxhall.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT FUNCTION TO SPECIFICATION The drivers airbag may not deploy in the case of a frontal collision. This because the passenger airbag pigtail is not to specification.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the passenger airbag pigtail.

vauxhall.defect: LOSS OF BRAKING PERFORMANCE The servo vacuum pump may fail causing a hard bake pedal loss of engine power and the vehicle may adopt limp home  mode. A warning lamp may also illuminate.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles replace vacuum pump.

vauxhall.defect: ABS MAY FAIL It is possible for moisture to enter the ABS connector/control unit. This can cause the ABS system not to function correctly and in the worst case overheating which may lead to fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the ABS control unit fit a protective cover to the control unit and seal the earth point with wax.

vauxhall.defect: SEAT SECURITY CONCERN Driver and front passenger seat adjuster rails may fracture and cause seat to become insecure.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcing plates to the seat runners. Fit new runners if the original ones are fractured.

vauxhall.defect: THE HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS MIGHT NOT BE TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION. The High Voltage Harness might not be to the correct specification.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the harness conformity and replace it if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: BRAKE PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED It is possible that a number of vehicles may have had the brake system filled with the incorrect brake fluid which can cause corrosion in the hydraulic ABS modulator. This can cause internal valves to stick which can result in possible longer brake pedal travel.  In extreme cases this could result in increased brake pedal travel and stopping distances.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the ABS modulator and to replace the brake fluid.  If found defective replace the hydraulic ABS modulator.

vauxhall.defect: A front seatbelt pre-tensioner may malfunction which can cause the driver seatbelt pretensioner not to be activated when the passenger airbag is locked. A front seatbelt pre-tensioner may malfunction which can cause the driver seatbelt pretensioner not to be activated when the passenger airbag is locked.
vauxhall.remedy: Check and replace the seatbelt pretensioner

vauxhall.defect: THE CUSTOMER MIGHT NOT BE ALERTED TO A MALFUNCTION OF THE TURN INDICATOR The customer might not be alerted to a malfunction of the turn indicator.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the Built-in System Interface (BSI) module with new software.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE CONTAMINATION OF BRAKE FLUID As a result of a production process concern a specific batch of brake calliper pistons may release hot hydrogen gas into the braking system fluid.
vauxhall.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for on the brake calliper batch numbers.  Vehicle equipped with calliper units from the affected batch will have these replaced with quality assured examples.

vauxhall.defect: FUEL TANK PROTECTION In the event of an exhaust tail pipe fracture an unacceptably high level of heat radiation may occur in the area surrounding the fuel tank.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the installation of a protective shield over the fuel tank.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE OIL LEAKAGE FROM TURBO CHARGER OIL FEED PIPE We would like to make you aware that on a certain number of Astra J GTC Insignia B - Model Year 18 there is the possibility of oil leakage from the turbo charger oil feed pipe. In worst case the spilled oil may inflame on hot engine parts. Possible oil leakage from turbo charger oil feed pipe. In worst case the spilled oil may inflame on hot engine parts.
vauxhall.remedy: check/adjust turbo oil feed pipe connector on all affected vehicles

vauxhall.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY The passenger air bag may not deploy as intended
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

vauxhall.defect: On affected vehicles due to a potential lack of electric parking brake application when the driver presses the throttle pedal to start driving from a parking position on a slope the vehicle could move in the opposite direction until the driver pushes the brakes and stops the vehicle On affected vehicles due to a potential lack of electric parking brake application when the driver presses the throttle pedal to start driving from a parking position on a slope the vehicle could move in the opposite direction until the driver pushes the brakes and stops the vehicle.
vauxhall.remedy: Update the MCU (Motor Control Unit) with modified software.

vauxhall.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY The parking brake cable may not have been assembled correctly which can result in either the inability to apply the parking brake or the inability to release the parking brake.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the parking brake cable.

vauxhall.defect: LANE KEEPING ASSIST MODE Vauxhall Combo - Model Years 2021-23 may have been built with a Built-in Systems Interface Module (BSI) software not according to specification. In some cases there is a missing sound alert in case of hands off the steering wheel for more than 10 seconds during Lane Keeping Assist (LKA) Mode.
vauxhall.remedy: Program the BSI module with improved software.

vauxhall.defect: THE LAMBDA CONTROL MIGHT NOT BE ROBUST/PRECISE ENOUGH AT HIGH SPEED lambda control may result in NOx limit being exceeded during the vehicle lifetime.
vauxhall.remedy: An engine management system software upgrade will be installed.

vauxhall.defect: ENGINE WIRING HARNESS MAY CHAFE ON POWER STEERING PUMP PULLEY The engine wiring harness may chafe on the power steering pump pulley resulting in a possible fire hazard.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and secure the wiring harness with cable ties as per the manufacturers instructions. At the same time the wiring will be checked for damage and where this has occurred it will be rectified as required.

vauxhall.defect: STEERING WHEEL VIBRATING COULD IMPAIR CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE Steering wheel mounting may not have been tightened to specification. This may lead to the steering wheel vibrating so impairing control of the vehicle.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected replace the steering wheel and fix with a new bolt to a new tightening specification.

vauxhall.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED There could be an unexpected loss of braking performance due to the ABS/ESP Modulator not being correctly filled with hydraulic oil at the factory.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the ABS/ESP hydraulic modulator and control unit.

vauxhall.defect: REAR WHEEL BEARING MAY SHEAR It is possible that the rear wheel bearing has been damaged whilst it was assembled onto the stub axle.  This should be identified by excessive noise however in the worst case if not detected it could result in bearing failure and the detachment of the wheel and hub.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the wheel bearings with new items which will have protective sleeves to aid correct installation.

vauxhall.defect: REMOTE POSSIBILITY OF BRAKE FLUID CONTAMINATION Vauxhall in conjunction with DETR and VI have agreed to conduct a Customer Care Initiative whereby drivers of old style Astra F models will be advised that brake fluid is a service item due to its' hygroscopic (water absorbing) tendency.
vauxhall.remedy: Customers will be offered a free inspection and a special promotion brake fluid change should the fluid be found to be outside the manufacturers specified limits. A minor modification to the vehicle bonnet will also be carried out to eliminate the remote possibility of water entering the engine compartment along the bulkhead and contaminating the brake fluid. It should be noted that this Customer Care Initiative is being recorded under the Code of Practice.

vauxhall.defect: 1) POSSIBLE STATIC SPARKING DURING REFUELLING (ASTRA MODELS ONLY) 2) AIR BAG SYSTEM MAY NOT DEPLOY 1) During refuelling the flow of fuel can cause static electricity to build up in the tank filler neck with the possibility of static sparking. 2) On some vehicles an electrical connector plug in the air bag system may not be correctly possible
vauxhall.remedy: A) The fitting of a metal earthing clamp to the lower end of the metal ring for the fuel filler cap to ensure a conductive connection between the filler neck and the vehicle body. B) Checking that in potentially affected vehicles the subject elect

vauxhall.defect: OUTER REAR SEATBELTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED AT THE ANCHOR POINT In a certain number of Insignia B - Model Year 18 the outer rear seatbelts might be incorrectly routed at anchor point. In the event of a frontal crash this may lead to a higher load than the belt system is designed for or it may allow the passenger to slip through under the seatbelt.
vauxhall.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to  check the seatbelt and change the routing if necessary on all affected vehicles.

vauxhall.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving. On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

vauxhall.defect: THE OPTIONAL SPEED LIMITER DOES NOT WORK The optional Speed Limiter does not work.
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogramming of the Engine Control Module

vauxhall.defect: RISK OF FIRE Water may penetrate into the Electronic Brake Control Module (EBCM) connector. In the worst case water can enter the EBCM where a short circuit may lead to a risk of fire. Warning before the fire element could occur is: flashing warning lamp which will give sufficient warning for the vehicle to be parked safely or if nearby taken to the dealership for repair.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check if the water cowl fastening clip correctly seals the water channel and that proper sealing of the EBCM connector is ensured.  If necessary the EBCM and/or the hydraulic modulator will be replaced.

vauxhall.defect: STEERING COLUMN MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION Steering columns were produced not according to specification
vauxhall.remedy: Replacement of the steering column

vauxhall.defect: FRONT BRAKE CALIPER BOLTS CONCERN There is a slight chance that one or more of the tapped holes for the four bolts securing the two halves of the brake caliper body together has not been threaded through the full depth of the hole.  The structural integrity of any such caliper may be compromised with the risk of fatigue failure of the caliper occurring after an extended period.
vauxhall.remedy: Check the caliper tapped holes.  If any incomplete threading is found the brake caliper is to be replaced.

vauxhall.defect: AN INCORRECT CALIBRATION FILE FOR NOX CALCULATION WAS USED IN PRODUCTION An incorrect calibration file for NOx calculation was used in production.
vauxhall.remedy: Reprogram the Reductant Control Module with the latest software.

vauxhall.defect: ABS MAY FAIL It is possible for moisture to enter the ABS connector/control unit. This can cause the ABS system not to function correctly and in the worst case overheating which may lead to fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the ABS control unit fit a protective cover to the control unit and seal the earth point with wax.

vauxhall.defect: THE LAMBDA CONTROL MAY NOT WORK SUFFICIENTLY ACCURATELY ENOUGH WHICH MAY RESULT IN A NOX LIMIT EXCEEDANCE. The lambda control may not work sufficiently which may result in a NOx limit exceedance
vauxhall.remedy: A software calibration for the lambda control

vauxhall.defect: WATER INGRESS INTO ABS  WIRING MAY CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT AND A FIRE It has been identified that the above vehicles could be affected by moisture ingress at the ABS connector. The moisture can enter through the ground wiring connection  which can lead to the ABS not functioning correctly overheating within the connector and in extreme cases a fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the ABS harness plug checked for moisture ingress and where necessary the wiring harness and control unit will be replaced. In all other cases the ground cable will be secured against ingress of moisture by soldering the cable sockets and applying shrink tubes.

vauxhall.defect: MODEL MAY BE AFFECTED BY UNEXPECTED OPENING OF THE HOOD WHILE DRIVING Unexpected opening of the hood while driving.
vauxhall.remedy: Check operation and repair if required.

vauxhall.defect: THE UREA INJECTOR MAY BLOCK AND LEAD TO NOX EMISSIONS OUT OF REGULATORY LIMITS The urea injector might block and lead to NOx emissions out of regulatory limits.
vauxhall.remedy: Updating the ECU software to avoid the future blockage of the urea injector

vauxhall.defect: THE PARKING BRAKE LEVER MAY NOT LOCK OR MAY DISENGAGE AFTER APPLICATION The parking brake lever might not lock in the engaged position or might disengage after application
vauxhall.remedy: Check the handbrake mechanism and replace if required

vauxhall.defect: AIRBAG COULD BECOME LOOSE Constant quality controls have revealed that on some vehicles the passenger side airbag mounting fixing screws were not torqued to the correct specification. This could result in the airbag unit becoming loose.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and tighten the two airbag retaining screws

vauxhall.defect: SEAT BELT MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY Repeated occupant movement into the seat over the fastener leading to bending of the steel cable. Possible damage of safety belt anchor cable - worst case: Loss of seat belt function
vauxhall.remedy: This recall is additional to Recall R/2015/201.Improved parts are now available and the manufacturer will now replace the outer pre tensioners.

vauxhall.defect: POTENTIAL MELTING AND FIRES WITHIN THE BLOWER MOTOR REGULATOR Zafira B Right Hand Drive (RHD) - Electronic Climate Control (ECC)   a small number of incidents of potential melting and fires within the blower motor regulator of the Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) unit of Zafira B RHD vehicles with Electronic Climate Control (ECC). There is a small risk that in rare circumstances melting and fire incidents may occur in the HVAC system
vauxhall.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to  Carry out the following rework steps according to the instructions: A  Install the water deflector B  Replace the blower motor C  Replace the heater fan motor regulator D Replace the wiring harness of the HVAC housing.

vauxhall.defect: WATER INGRESS THROUGH WHEEL ARCHES INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT Water ingress into the passenger compartment due to poor wheel arch sealing may lead to airbag malfunction
vauxhall.remedy: Seal the wheel arch body seams.  Replace wiring harness and airbag control unit if necessary

vauxhall.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT WITH POSSIBILITY THAT FIRE MAY OCCUR If the radiator-cooling fan becomes blocked there is a risk that an electrical short circuit can occur. This in turn could cause damage to the cooling fan module and in the worst case potentially resulting in a vehicle fire.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to programme the Engine Control Module with the latest software.

vauxhall.defect: INCORRECT STEERING INNER TIE RODS HAVE BEEN INSTALLED Vehicles have been built with incorrect steering inner tie rods
vauxhall.remedy: Replacement of the steering inner tie rods.

vauxhall.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST The retaining ring of the steering gear pinion might be out of it's retaining groove. In the worst case the steering gear pinion may lose engagement resulting in loss of steering control
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering gear assembly

vauxhall.defect: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST The retaining ring of the steering gear pinion might be out of it's retaining groove. In the worst case the steering gear pinion may lose engagement resulting in loss of steering control
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering gear assembly

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKING IN STEERING DROP ARM AND BRACKET Cracking may occur in the steering drop arm or idler arm and bracket assembly which if not detected could ultimately affect steering control.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for examination of the subject components. Any arms or brackets identified as belonging to the affected batches will be replaced with quality assured examples.

vauxhall.defect: THE FRONT SEAT BACK FRAME LOWER CROSS MEMBER STRUCTURE MAY NOT BE WELDED CORRECTLY Front seat frames may not be welded correctly
vauxhall.remedy: Check seat frame welds and replace front seats if necessary.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK Under certain conditions the engine wiring harness may touch the bonnet hinge. With prolonged chafing this may lead to a possible electrical short circuit and if not dealt with eventual combustion.
vauxhall.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the engine wiring harness re-routed and secured clear of the bonnet hinge.

vauxhall.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED One or both bolts  retaining the passenger air bag may have been omitted during production. As a result the airbag may not deploy as intended during a frontal collision.
vauxhall.remedy: On affected vehicles check bolts are present for tightness and fit new bolts where required.

vauxhall.defect: THE GROUND TERMINAL OF THE TRAILER HITCH SOCKET MAY BE INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT PORT The ground terminal of the trailer hitch socket might be installed in an incorrect port.
vauxhall.remedy: Relocate the ground terminal in the trailer hitch socket from pin location 10 to location 3.

vauxhall.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
vauxhall.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

vauxhall.defect: On affected vehicles the hydraulic power steering hose is not according to specification which could lead to deterioration in power steering assistance or sudden loss of steering assistance. On affected vehicles the hydraulic power steering hose is not according to specification which could lead to deterioration in power steering assistance or sudden loss of steering assistance.�
vauxhall.remedy: Check and replace power steering hose if necessary.�

vauxhall.defect: PIPING SEAM OF FRONT SEAT DOES NOT OPEN IF AIR BAG IS DEPLOYED A certain number of Grandland X - Model Year 18 the piping seam of the front leather seat cover does not open as required in case of a seat airbag deployment.
vauxhall.remedy: Replace all affected leather front seat leather covers.

vauxhall.defect: Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire. Affected vehicles may experience HV Battery overheating that may lead to a HV Battery thermal runaway and in a worst case to a battery or vehicle fire.
vauxhall.remedy: The BMS (Battery Management System) will be reprogrammed with enhanced battery monitoring software.

vauxhall.defect: Affected vehicles may face the risk of perforation of the HV battery reinforcing plate/battery cover over the vehicle lifetime due to water intrusion. Affected vehicles may face the risk of perforation of the HV battery reinforcing plate/battery cover over the vehicle lifetime due to water intrusion.
vauxhall.remedy: A protective wax will be applied between HV battery reinforcing plate and battery cover.

vauxhall.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE WITH HILL START ASSIST FEATURE The hill start hold feature exceeds the correct time specification.
vauxhall.remedy: A Software Update to the Electronic Brake Control Module.

vauxhall.defect: FIXING BOLTS OF THE REAR SEAT BELT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TORQUED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION Fixing bolts of the rear seat belt on the height adjuster C pillar and body sill may not have been torqued according to specification
vauxhall.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles check torque rear seat belts and tighten to specification.

vdl.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF SERVICE BRAKE It has been identified that the possibility exists that the footvalve piston may become dislodged. Should this occur the service brakes may become inoperative.
vdl.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the service brake footvalve replaced.

vdl.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF SERVICE BRAKE It has been identified that the possibility exists that the footvalve piston may become dislodged. Should this occur the service brakes may become inoperative.
vdl.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the service brake footvalve replaced.

vdl.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF SERVICE BRAKE It has been identified that the possibility exists that the footvalve piston may become dislodged. Should this occur the service brakes may become inoperative.
vdl.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the service brake footvalve replaced.

vdl.defect: FRONT SUSPENSION MAY FAIL Metal swarf can be in the housing due to a nonconformity in production. This can lead to problems in the airbag system and in the worst case an unintentional deployment of the airbags. An unintentional airbag deployment can cause accidents.
vdl.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag control module.

vectrix.defect: BATTERIES MAY OVERHEAT It has been identified that due to a loose terminal connection overheating of the battery pack may occur.
vectrix.remedy: Recalled machines will have the batteries replaced.

vega.defect: Two wheeler motorcycle helmets Type: JET ‘J’  Approval No.: E11*22R05/03*0527*02 Affected helmets do not meet the requirements of ECE 22.05 and present a danger to users.
vega.remedy: Affected helmets will be replaced and scrapped.

vega.defect: Two wheeler motorcycle helmets Type: JET ‘J’  Approval No.: E11*22R05/03*0527*02 Affected helmets do not meet the requirements of ECE 22.05 and present a danger to users.
vega.remedy: Affected helmets will be replaced and scrapped.

vega.defect: Two wheeler motorcycle helmets Type: JET ‘J’  Approval No.: E11*22R05/03*0527*02 Affected helmets do not meet the requirements of ECE 22.05 and present a danger to users.
vega.remedy: Affected helmets will be replaced and scrapped.

vmoto.remedy: The vehicle will be inspected and the handlebar riser and fastening bolts will be replaced with a revised design.�
