vmoto.remedy: The vehicle will be inspected and the handlebar riser and fastening bolts will be replaced with a revised design.�

volkswagen.defect: Natural gas system leak test On Crafter “Grand California” vehicles of a limited production period there is a  possibility that the leak test of the natural gas system was not correctly carried out. Leaks from the natural gas system cannot be ruled out.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles a leak test of the natural gas system must be performed and if unsuccessful necessary repairs completed. After the repair the leak test of the natural gas system must be carried out again.

volkswagen.defect: Bracket for air conditioning rear On affected vehicles brackets with sharp edges were fitted to the rear air conditioning block.  In the event of an accident when the side airbags are triggered there is a risk of damage from the sharp edges which could significantly affect the function of the airbag.
volkswagen.remedy: Replace the bracket for one without sharp edges.

volkswagen.defect: Battery Check For affected vehicles battery cells were fitted in the high-voltage battery that can demonstrate an increased self-discharge due to a production fault. In the event of heavy self-discharge the yellow indicator lamps may light up.
volkswagen.remedy: The affected battery modules must be checked and if necessary replaced. The vehicle may only be charged outdoors and up to maximum 80%.

volkswagen.defect: Battery Check For affected vehicles battery cells were fitted in the high-voltage battery that can demonstrate an increased self-discharge due to a production fault. In the event of heavy self-discharge the yellow indicator lamps may light up.
volkswagen.remedy: The affected battery modules must be checked and if necessary replaced. The vehicle may only be charged outdoors and up to maximum 80%.

volkswagen.defect: ABS control unit On affected vehicles there is a possibility of a loss of braking assistance caused by a fault with the electromechanical brake servo.
volkswagen.remedy: Update the software for the electromechanical brake servo control unit.

volkswagen.defect: Rear axle shock absorbers On affected vehicles there is a possibility the rear axle shock absorbers could break.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and replace the rear shock absorbers if necessary.

volkswagen.defect: Takata front passenger airbag On affected vehicles with passenger airbags from the manufacturer Takata in the event of an accident with airbag activation the passenger airbag gas generator housing may burst and produce fragments.
volkswagen.remedy: : Replace the passenger’s airbag on affected vehicles.

volkswagen.defect: 48VS - Steering rack bolt replacement On vehicles of a limited production period corrosion can cause a tear of a bolt head on the steering rack. This can result in a loss of steering functionality.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the affected bolted connection of the steering rack is replaced on the right-hand side of the subframe.

volkswagen.defect: 48VS - Steering rack bolt replacement On vehicles of a limited production period corrosion can cause a tear of a bolt head on the steering rack. This can result in a loss of steering functionality.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the affected bolted connection of the steering rack is replaced on the right-hand side of the subframe.

volkswagen.defect: KEY INFORMATION ABOUT PASSEGER PROTECTION SYSTEMS IS NOT INCLUDED IN OWNER'S MANUAL Owner's Manuals with incomplete information about the restraint system were delivered. Warnings instructions and information for 'Proactive Passenger Protection System' 'Airbag System' and 'Transporting Children Safely' are missing from the Owner's Manual. Without correct instruction it is possible for someone to unknowingly put another in danger.
volkswagen.remedy: Notify the vehicle owners so a supplement can be be added to the Owner�s Manual.

volkswagen.defect: AIRBAG/BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT TRIGGER IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag  assembly and seatbelt pretensioner where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: THE JOINT BETWEEN THE SUN ROOF TRIM AND SUN ROOF FRAME IS INCORRCTLY BONDED A possible faulty bonded joint between sun roof trim panel and sun roof frame.
volkswagen.remedy: The sun roof trim panel is replaced on affected vehicles.

volkswagen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

volkswagen.defect: B+ CABLE WAS WRONGLY CONNECTED AT THE B+ DISTRIBUTOR There is the possibility that the B+ cables were wrongly connected at the B+ distributor and that the fuses (60 A and 300 A) could be installed in the wrong order.
volkswagen.remedy: Conduct a visual check of the two fuses and cables to confirm they are in the correct position if incorrect re-position the fuses and/or cables to the correct position and re-torque the connection.

volkswagen.defect: REPLACE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG The front passenger airbag may be faulty. There may be insufficient protection especially for smaller passengers in the front seat because of incorrectly folded passenger airbags.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger airbag.

volkswagen.defect: ON T5/T6 CALIFORNIA VEHICLES WITH KITCHEN THE BOLTED CONNECTIONS ON THE GAS SYSTEM MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY FITTED Kitchen bolted gas connections may not have been correctly fitted.
volkswagen.remedy: Perform gas systems check and re-tighten connections.

volkswagen.defect: STEERING RACK MOUNTINGS MAY LOOSEN Wax residue may not have been removed from the steering rack attachment points on the subframe which may result in a loosening of the steering rack.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles remove wax from the attachment area and re-tighten rack. At the same time the cooling fan control unit will be checked and if necessary replaced on affected vehicles.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF THE WIRING LOOM One of several wiring looms located in the engine compartment may not be securely fixed. This could allow over a long time period the loom to chafe with the possibility of short circuiting and in extreme circumstances create a fire risk.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles. Fit protective sleeving to the loom in question and secure the assembly with clips.

volkswagen.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE LOST On vehicles with torsion beam rear axle the trailing arm of the rear axle can be deformed in a rear impact of the vehicle or when reversing too quickly over a relatively high obstacle (such as very high kerbs). If this deformation or pre-damage is not recognised a trailing arm of the rear axle can suddenly break later because of the related weakening of the rear axle.
volkswagen.remedy: On vehicles which have been involved in a rear impact or reversed at  speed  over a high obstacle.  The trailing arm of the torsion beam rear axle is checked for accident damage and replaced if necessary. In other instances a brace plate will be fitted to the trailing arms.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF HUMIDITY INGRESS IN THE BOWDEN CABLES OF THE DOORS Possibility of humidity ingress in the Bowden cables of the doors due to missing seals.
volkswagen.remedy: Remove cables and humidity and seal off.  Poznan produced cables to be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: WHEELS ORDERED AND BOUGHT AT THE DEALERS MAY NOT BE COMPATIBLE Wheels ordered and bought at the dealers may not be compatible.
volkswagen.remedy: Incompatible wheels in the customer's possession must be replaced

volkswagen.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING It has been identified that due to a programing issue with the On-Board Supply Control Unit it is possible that the failure of one of the vehicle lights (dipped beam/main beam/daytime running light/rear fog light or indicator) may not be recognised by the control unit and therefore not shown in the instrument cluster. It is also possible that vehicle lights may be shown as faulty when they are not. Furthermore a failure of a dipped beam may not trigger a replacement response (activation of side lights). A light failure without a display in the instrument cluster or without replacement response can pose a danger of an accident especially in the dark.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to reprogramme the On-Board Supply Control Unit.

volkswagen.defect: Faulty wheel bearing housings can fail and break prematurely Certain vehicles may be fitted with a wheel bearing housing containing cavities in the material.
volkswagen.remedy: Inspect the vehicle and if necessary replace the rear left wheel bearing housing.

volkswagen.defect: REAR SPOILER COULD BECOME DETACHED WHEN DRIVING. It has been identified that the holders of the rear spoiler may break. Should this occur whilst the vehicle is being driven the spoiler may detach completely.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the three attachment areas of the rear spoiler modified with additional bonded on reinforcements

volkswagen.defect: THE BOLTED CONNECTION OF THE PULL ROD BETWEEN THE ELECTROMECHANICAL BRAKE SERVO AND BRAKE PEDAL COULD COME LOOSE The bolted connection of the pull rod between the electromechanical brake servo and brake pedal may come loose resulting in a loss of all service braking ability.
volkswagen.remedy: Vehicles are not to be driven and the bolted connection of the input rod between the electromechanical brake servo and brake pedal must be checked and if necessary retightened

volkswagen.defect: WINDSCREEN WIPER MOTOR MAY FAIL The windscreen wiper motor may cease to work because of an electrical software fault.
volkswagen.remedy: Replace the windscreen wiper motor of all affected vehicles.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL HOSES MAY CRACK AND LEAK Some fuel hoses were not manufactured to specification and as a result could crack and leak fuel. The fuel could affect the drivability of the subject vehicle and possibly others using the roads.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect and replace 3 fuel hoses.

volkswagen.defect: On certain vehicles there is a possibility that because of a production problem the propshaft securing bolts for the final drive on gearbox side were not tightened with the correct tightening torque. On certain vehicles there is a possibility that because of a production problem the propshaft securing bolts for the final drive on gearbox side were not tightened with the correct tightening torque.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the propshaft bolted connection is retightened with the correct tightening torque. If bolts are found to be loose all 4 securing bolts must be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: WIPERS MAY DETACH It has been identified that on some Passat vehicles the windscreen wipers may fail to operate because of a software fault.
volkswagen.remedy: Affected vehicles will have a cap for the windscreen wiper motor fitted

volkswagen.defect: REAR SEAT BENCH WELDED CONNECTION MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY PERFORMED The rear back rest head restraint mounting is not correctly welded.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and replace rear back rest frame if required.

volkswagen.defect: CHILD SEAT SECURITY CONCERN Welding faults on the seams of the ISOFIX mounting bars may occur. The safe support of ISOFIX child seats can therefore not be guaranteed in a crash.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall vehicles in order to re-weld the ISOFIX mounting bars.

volkswagen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

volkswagen.defect: REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS MAY BE INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED AND COULD FAIL PREMATURELY The hardening process for the rear wheel bearing housings may not have been correctly performed. In the worst case this could lead to a fractured housing. Should a fractured housing occur there would be abnormal noises bad tyre wear and a theoretical possibility of wheel loss.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the 420 vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right and left rear wheel bearing housings.

volkswagen.defect: CHILD LOCK MAY DISENGAGE The door child locks may disengage without driver knowledge. Though the door remains close it is possible for the door to then be opened from the inside.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect lock mechanism and replace where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: THE RETRACTOR OF THE THREE POINT AUTOMATIC SEAT BELT ON THE FRONT RIGHT SEAT MAY BE FAULTY. The retractor of the three-point automatic seat belt on the front right seat may be faulty.
volkswagen.remedy: The three-point automatic seat belt of the front right seat is to be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: STEERING RACK AND LOWER WISHBONE FASTENINGS AND CHAFING OF THE LIGHT SWITCH HARNESS b) The light switch harness may chafe on the dash support with a consequent fire risk. Note that the scope of the defect will depend upon the particular chassis number of the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and b) Secure the light switch harness and protect it by fitting beading to the edge of the dash support.

volkswagen.defect: FAILURE OF HEADLAMPS The headlamp switch may overheat and result in headlamp failure.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitting of a cable harness with control relay. In addition the light switch is to be replaced on Passat and Golf Ecomatic models as appropriate.

volkswagen.defect: HEAD RESTRAINT MAY BE INSECURE On a limited production period a burr may have developed on the locking bar of the head restraint guide.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles the left head restraint guide on both front seats must be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG GENERATOR HOUSING COULD  COME LOOSE Increased humidity may have got into the propellant of the gas generator for the drivers air bag.
volkswagen.remedy: The gas generator of the front airbag on the driver side is replaced.

volkswagen.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG GENERATOR HOUSING COULD  COME LOOSE Increased humidity may have got into the propellant of the gas generator for the drivers air bag.
volkswagen.remedy: The gas generator of the front airbag on the driver side is replaced.

volkswagen.defect: CHILD LOCK MAY DISENGAGE The door child locks may disengage without driver knowledge. Though the door remains close it is possible for the door to then be opened from the inside.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect lock mechanism and replace where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: INSECURITY OF FAN BLADE The pulley on the engine cooling fan may loosen causing the fan motor to seize leading to a possible electrical     overload with fire risk.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified cooling fan and pulley.

volkswagen.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG CONCERN The passenger airbag may not release correctly because of a leak in the pressure reservoir of the gas generator.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the front passenger airbag.

volkswagen.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING It has been identified that due to a programing issue with the On-Board Supply Control Unit it is possible that the failure of one of the vehicle lights (dipped beam/main beam/daytime running light/rear fog light or indicator) may not be recognised by the control unit and therefore not shown in the instrument cluster. It is also possible that vehicle lights may be shown as faulty when they are not. Furthermore a failure of a dipped beam may not trigger a replacement response (activation of side lights). A light failure without a display in the instrument cluster or without replacement response can pose a danger of an accident especially in the dark.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to reprogramme the On-Board Supply Control Unit.

volkswagen.defect: A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE LED MODULE OF THE PANORAMA SUN ROOF CAN OCCUR Possible short circuit in LED lighting module  of the panoramic roof.
volkswagen.remedy: Modify wiring with integrated fuse adapter cables.

volkswagen.defect: On vehicles of a limited production period there is a very small probability that one or two incorrectly welded transverse links to the front axle have been fitted. On vehicles of a limited production period there is a very small probability that one or two incorrectly welded transverse links to the front axle have been fitted.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the two front transverse links have to be checked and if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: TENSION CRACKS MAY OCCUR ON THE VACUUM PIPE TO THE SERVO Tension cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo in the area of the connections due to a manufacturing fault. Should a vacuum pipe leak the brake servo will loose it's function. This will result in an increase of force which must be applied to the brake pedal. But will not result in a total failure of the braking system.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pipes checked and if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: FAULTY REAR SEAT BELT LOCKS It has been identified that on a number of Tourag vehicles the rear seat belts may have been fitted with locks which have a revetting defect.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and check the rear seat belt locks for compliance. Should they be found to be suffering from the defect the locks will be changed.

volkswagen.defect: ANTI LOCK BRAKE CONTROL UNIT CONCERN There is a risk that an electrical fault in the anti lock brake control unit (ABS) can cause overheating of related electrical components. This may lead to fire damage and cause the service brake to revert to a non-anti lock mode of operation.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check the part number and supplier code of the ABS control unit. Renew the ABS control unit where found necessary.

volkswagen.defect: DRIVER AIRBAG GENERATOR HOUSING COULD  COME LOOSE Increased humidity may have got into the propellant of the gas generator for the drivers air bag.
volkswagen.remedy: The gas generator of the front airbag on the driver side is replaced.

volkswagen.defect: BRAKE SERVO VACUUM PIPE MAY CRACK AND LEAK. The brake servo vacuum supply pipe may crack and leak. This could result in a loss of power assistance and require the driver to apply  a lot more force to the brake pedal.
volkswagen.remedy: Examine the condition of the vacuum supply pipe and fit an improved quality replacement where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: INSECURITY OF FAN BLADE The pulley on the engine cooling fan may loosen causing the fan motor to seize leading to a possible electrical     overload with fire risk.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified cooling fan and pulley.

volkswagen.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Water ingress may gather in the spare wheel well may accumulate and cause the battery to short circuit.In extreme cases this could cause a fire.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles fit an additional drain valve to the spare wheel well.

volkswagen.defect: PANORAMIC SUNROOF MAY DETACH The front panel of the panorama sunroof may not have been bonded correctly. This can lead to rattling noises during a journey. If the loosening front panel is not detected this poses a danger for the following traffic.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front panel of the panorama roof.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF COOLANT LEAKAGE INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT Operation of the vehicle for prolonged periods with the cooling system at very high temperatures can result in cooling system damage which in rare instances may cause rupturing of the heat exchanger In consequence high temperature coolant may enter the
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a bypass valve to the heat exchanger inlet and a non-return valve to the system. At the same time the heat exchanger box will be lined with absorbent foam.

volkswagen.defect: THE ELECTRIC CHILD LOCK MAY NOT BE MECHANICALLY LOCKED ALTHOUGH SWITCHED ON BY DRIVER Under very specific conditions the electric child lock is not mechanically locked although it has been switched on by the driver.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the software of the on-board supply control unit has to be reconfigured.

volkswagen.defect: AIRBAG/BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT TRIGGER IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag  assembly and seatbelt pretensioner where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: THE JOINT BETWEEN THE SUN ROOF TRIM AND SUN ROOF FRAME IS INCORRCTLY BONDED A possible faulty bonded joint between sun roof trim panel and sun roof frame.
volkswagen.remedy: The sun roof trim panel is replaced on affected vehicles.

volkswagen.defect: WATER MAY GET INTO INTERIOR AND RUN ONTO CONTROL UNITS FOR THE REAR LID Water may get into the vehicle interior and run onto the control units for the rear lid
volkswagen.remedy: The motor lead-through for the electric sliding door is to be sealed to the right side panel.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On 2.0l Common Rail engines of a limited production period faulty material can cause leaks on the high pressure pipes during the service life of the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: Anti-vibration balance weights will be fitted on the high-pressure pipes.

volkswagen.defect: ENGINE COMPARTMENT COVERS COULD COME LOOSE FROM THEIR ATTACHMENT On affected vehicles engine compartment covers were fitted that regardless of use (very sporty driving style or poor road condition) and operating period could come loose from their attachment.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles the engine compartment cover has to be removed.

volkswagen.defect: AIRBAG/BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT TRIGGER IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag  assembly and seatbelt pretensioner where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On 2.0l Common Rail engines of a limited production period faulty material can cause leaks on the high pressure pipes during the service life of the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: Anti-vibration balance weights will be fitted on the high-pressure pipes.

volkswagen.defect: LOOSENING OF STEERING U/J CLAMPING BOLT The steering shaft top universal clamping bolt may loosen .This will allow free movement in the steering and if not rectified could lead to loss of steering control.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the steering shaft top universal clamping bolt and nut with new components.

volkswagen.defect: SEAT COVER MAY PREVENT SIDE AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT Seatcovers have been supplied which may affect deployment of the combined side/curtain airbags.
volkswagen.remedy: Supply seat covers suitable for vehicle application.

volkswagen.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED There is a possible faulty weld to the gas generator. If the airbag is deployed there is a potential danger to the vehicle occupants by gas generator parts being ejected into the cabin.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator unit.

volkswagen.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE ROOF SPOILER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN BONDED TO THE REAR LID WITH THE SPECIFIED PROCESS MATERIALS On all affected Polo vehicles there is a possibility that the roof spoiler may not have been bonded to the rear lid with the specified process materials.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles the roof spoiler has to be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: GEARBOX PROP SHAFT MAY DETACH The balance weight on the prop shaft may detach. This can lead to the prop shaft becoming insecure and in extreme cases where the concern is not rectified the prop shaft can detach. This will lead to significant damage to the vehicle and increase the risk of a collision.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replaced the balance weight on the prop shaft.

volkswagen.defect: UNINTENTIONAL AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT In rare cases an air bag acceleration sensor may give an incorrect signal which can lead to an unintentional airbag deployment
volkswagen.remedy: Recall vehicle check if vehicle is affected and replace the control unit as required.

volkswagen.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING It has been identified that due to a programing issue with the On-Board Supply Control Unit it is possible that the failure of one of the vehicle lights (dipped beam/main beam/daytime running light/rear fog light or indicator) may not be recognised by the control unit and therefore not shown in the instrument cluster. It is also possible that vehicle lights may be shown as faulty when they are not. Furthermore a failure of a dipped beam may not trigger a replacement response (activation of side lights). A light failure without a display in the instrument cluster or without replacement response can pose a danger of an accident especially in the dark.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to reprogramme the On-Board Supply Control Unit.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBLE CRACKS IN LEFT FRONT SEATS There is a possibility that due to a fault in the production process there is a crack on the frame of the left front seat.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and replace the seat frame if a crack is found

volkswagen.defect: THE WALL THICKNESS OF THE FUEL TANK MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The specified wall thickness of the fuel tank can in some places fall below the threshold.
volkswagen.remedy: For all affected vehicles the fuel tank has to be replaced

volkswagen.defect: ENGINE COMPARTMENT COVERS COULD COME LOOSE FROM THEIR ATTACHMENT On affected vehicles engine compartment covers were fitted that regardless of use (very sporty driving style or poor road condition) and operating period could come loose from their attachment.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles the engine compartment cover has to be removed.

volkswagen.defect: FRONT RIGHT HAND TYRE MAY FAIL It has been identified that during production the right-hand front tyre may have suffered damage to the inside face.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject tyre checked for damage and replaced as necessary.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF HEADLAMPS The wiring harness can cause the headlamp switch to overheat with consequent failure of the headlamps.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for modification to the light switch cable and replacement of the headlamp switch.

volkswagen.defect: THE AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM EVAPORATOR HOUSING DRAINPIPE MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED The drainpipe of the evaporator housing of the air conditioning system may have been incorrectly manufactured leading to water accumulating and dripping onto the airbag control unit.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the drainpipe of the evaporator housing. If found to be incorrectly manufactured the drainpipe must be modified and the airbag control unit replaced.

volkswagen.defect: CHILD LOCK MAY DISENGAGE The door child locks may disengage without driver knowledge. Though the door remains close it is possible for the door to then be opened from the inside.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect lock mechanism and replace where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: THE DRIVERS AIR BAG COULD HAVE BEEN UNINTENTIONALLY DEACTIVATED On certain vehicles were the owner had requested to have the passengers air bag deactivated it is possible that during the deactivation process the drivers air bag could have been deactivated instead of the passengers.
volkswagen.remedy: Interrogate the air bag control unit and reconnect the wiring to the drivers air bag

volkswagen.defect: ENGINE MAY START UP WITHOUT WARNING The earth attachment for the on board power supply control unit may not be to specification. This can lead to various electrical events. In the most unfavourable case the engine may start when using the central locking remote control.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the torque of the earth attachment. If necessary the earth attachment is to be tightened to the correct specification.

volkswagen.defect: LOSS OF TYRE PRESSURE The valve hole in the steel road wheel is 0.5mm out of its correct position. This results in a poor valve fit and loss of tyre air pressure.
volkswagen.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the original wheels replaced with quality assured examples.

volkswagen.defect: BACKREST MAY NOT PERFORM CORRECTLY IN A COLLISION The fitting for the backrest frame to the front seats (mounting of backrest to seat frame) may not have been correctly welded. This can cause noises on the front seats and in an accident the backrest/s can break. There is an increased risk of injury.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the production date of the backrest frames of the front seats. Where the date is within the affected range the backrest/s will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBLE MISSING BEARING BUSH IN THE AREA OF THE STEERING WORM GEAR Possible missing bearing bush in the area of the steering worm gear.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles the steering rack must be replaced

volkswagen.defect: ENGINE COMPARTMENT COVERS COULD COME LOOSE FROM THEIR ATTACHMENT On affected vehicles engine compartment covers were fitted that regardless of use (very sporty driving style or poor road condition) and operating period could come loose from their attachment.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles the engine compartment cover has to be removed.

volkswagen.defect: CLUTCH MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY WITH UNEXPECTED LOSS OF DRIVE In rare cases an incorrect interpretation of the clutch temperature can occur which results in the clutch opening unexpectedly with loss of drive.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and update/reprogramme gearbox control unit.

volkswagen.defect: AIRBAG MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY FOLDED WHEN PASSENGER AIRBAG  MODULE WAS PRODUCED On Tiguan Allspace vehicles of a limited production period faulty passenger airbags may have been fitted.  When the passenger airbag module was produced the airbag may have been incorrectly folded.  As a result there is risk that in case of deployment the airbag may not open up correctly and would therefore be ineffective leading to injury of vehicle occupants.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles the passenger airbag unit has to be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL The handbrake may not fully engage and a sudden release of the handbrake potentially allowing the vehicle to 'run away' cannot be ruled out.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles and replace the handbrake lever and the push button.

volkswagen.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED The central wiring harness may not have been correctly connected to the central electrics unit. If the connector comes loose it can affect certain electrical components including braking assistance.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles Check wiring connection and if necessary secure connection.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL SUPPLY AND RETURN PIPE CAN LEAK On a small number of 5 cylinder diesel engines the welding on a seal plug in the H piece between the fuel supply and return pipes has the potential to leak.  In extreme unfavourable conditions this leaking fuel may lead to a vehicle fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to have the fuel pipe replaced with a quality assured component.

volkswagen.defect: SIDE AIRBAG GAS GENERATOR CANISTER MAY FAIL For certain vehicles manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the gas generator housing may be damaged if a side airbag is deployed. If the airbag/s were deployed the gas generator could explode and dislodge small metal parts which could cause injury to the vehicle occupants.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the dates of manufacture for the left and or right side airbags. Where a possibly affected airbag is found it will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: UNINTENTIONAL DEPLOYMENT OF AN AIRBAG Due to an  incorrect manufacturing process swarf may accumulate in the airbag control module and cause a short circuit. In extreme instances this may cause unintentional deployment of an air bag.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag control module.

volkswagen.defect: BONNET MAY OPEN It has been established that the mounting bolts on the bonnet catch may loosen. This may cause the lock to become loose and could result in the bonnet suddenly opening.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to have the bolts checked and tighten if required.

volkswagen.defect: HEAD RESTRAINT MAY BE INSECURE On a limited production period a burr may have developed on the locking bar of the head restraint guide.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles the left head restraint guide on both front seats must be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: 2ND ROW SEAT BACKREST MAY NOT LATCH CORRECTLY The back-rest of the 2nd seat row may not completely latch in. In an accident this could increase the risk of injury because the seat belts are attached to the back-rest.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the bowden cable of the double seat bench.

volkswagen.remedy: Anti-vibration balance weights will be fitted on the high-pressure pipes.

volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the manufacturer of the two mass flywheel checked and if necessary the flywheel and the breather of the clutch pressure pipe will be replaced.

volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace injector rails and seals.

volkswagen.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The contact resistance on the earth connection of the heating element for the additional air heater can exceed specification.  This could lead to excessive heat developing in the connection area of the cable which could result in localised scorching.  However if not rectified this could result in a vehicle fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and check the torque on the earth connection.

volkswagen.defect: SIDE AIRBAG GAS GENERATOR CANISTER MAY FAIL For certain vehicles manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the gas generator housing may be damaged if a side airbag is deployed. If the airbag/s were deployed the gas generator could explode and dislodge small metal parts which could cause injury to the vehicle occupants.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the dates of manufacture for the left and or right side airbags. Where a possibly affected airbag is found it will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG CONCERN The passenger airbag may not release correctly because of a leak in the pressure reservoir of the gas generator.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the front passenger airbag.

volkswagen.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE COMPROMISED Front wheel bearing housings with insufficient hardness may have been fitted. This can lead to a fracture of a wheel bearing housing which can affected the directional control of the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the casting dates of both front wheel bearing housings. Where the affected wheel bearing housings are found they will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: A TOW BAR WITH A POSSIBLY DEFECTIVE LOCKING MECHANISM IN THE SWIVELLING MODULE HAS BEEN FITTED A tow bar with a possibly defective locking mechanism in the swivelling module has been fitted.
volkswagen.remedy: The tow bar has to be checked and if necessary the swivelling module of the tow bar replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM OF PLUG-IN HYBRID VEHICLES WAS IN SOME CASES PRODUCED WITH TOO LITTLE SO-CALLED FIRE SAND The fuse in the high-voltage system of plug-in hybrid vehicles was in some cases produced with too little so-called fire sand.
volkswagen.remedy: An additional protective insulating mat is to be fitted to the switching unit for high-voltage battery.

volkswagen.defect: A CONDENSER MAY FAIL IN THE AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT A condenser in the airbag control unit may fail.
volkswagen.remedy: The software of the airbag control unit must be updated.

volkswagen.defect: THE E-CALL SERVICE FUNCTION MAY NOT ALWAYS FUNCTION On affected vehicles the e-call service may not function
volkswagen.remedy: Update the Online Control Unit software on affected vehicle.

volkswagen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

volkswagen.defect: HEATING ELEMENT MAY OVERHEAT The additional air heater heating element earth connection may overheat and in the most unfavourable cases may lead to a fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the earth connection is sufficiently tight.

volkswagen.defect: REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS MAY BE INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED AND COULD FAIL PREMATURELY The hardening process for the rear wheel bearing housings may not have been correctly performed. In the worst case this could lead to a fractured housing. Should a fractured housing occur there would be abnormal noises bad tyre wear and a theoretical possibility of wheel loss.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the 420 vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right and left rear wheel bearing housings.

volkswagen.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY FAIL AND MAKE HARD BRAKING IMPOSSIBLE On affected vehicles the retaining clip for the pivot shaft of the brake pedal bearing may have inadvertently been lost during assembly. Movement of the shaft may affect braking efficiency and in extreme cases cause loss of braking.
volkswagen.remedy: Inspect pivot shaft mounting and where necessary fit a new clip.

volkswagen.defect: TAILGATE CAN DROP DOWN AND CAUSE INJURY On Caddy vehicles of a limited production period Volkswagen AG has established that on  vehicles of certain model years the attachment of the ball pin where the tailgate gas strut is mounted on the body can loosen and in the most unfavourable case tear off. If such damage occurs the Tailgate can drop down as one tailgate gas strut alone cannot keep it open. There is a risk of injury.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles a new ball pin with a washer will be fitted . On Caddys produced from November 2003-July 2008 the welded nut inside the D pillar can loosen and fall off when replacing the pin. In these instances two support brackets with blind rivets must be fitted.

volkswagen.defect: WITH TEMPERATURES BELOW ZERO THE DOOR LOCK BOWDEN CABLES CAN FREEZE With temperatures below zero the door lock Bowden cables can freeze.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the door Bowden cables are replaced and all door locks are given a sealing foil.

volkswagen.defect: OWNER'S MANUALS FOR THE TRANSPORTER WERE INCLUDED INSTEAD OF FOR THE MULTIVAN On T6.1 California vehicles owner's manuals for the Transporter were included instead of for the Multivan.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the Transporter owner's manual is replaced with the Multivan owner's manual.

volkswagen.defect: THE BONDED JOINT BETWEEN THE UPPER AND LOWER SECTION OF THE REAR SPOILER MAY BE FAULTY The bonding of the upper and lower sections of the rear spoiler may be faulty.
volkswagen.remedy: Inspect and repair or replace the spoiler if required.

volkswagen.defect: THE BOLTED CONNECTION OF THE BRAKE LINE ON THE FRONT RIGHT WHEEL HOUSING MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY TIGHTENED DURING PRODUCTION The bolted connection of the brake line on the front right wheel housing may not have been correctly tightened during production.

volkswagen.defect: Front seat belt On affected vehicles there is a possibility the seat belt for the driver seat was incorrectly anchored.

volkswagen.defect: Brake line bolted connection On Caddy vehicles of a limited production period a fault when tightening the rear left  brake line can cause leaks from the brake hose connection. The loss of brake fluid   level can adversely affect the braking performance.
volkswagen.remedy: The affected rear left brake line bolted connection at the connection to the brake hose must be checked and modified.

volkswagen.defect: Analysis vehicle modification On affected vehicles the software specification of safety-related systems and component groups may not have been in line with the standard condition at the time
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles the system software will be checked and updated accordingly

volkswagen.defect: Curtain Airbag In Tiguan Allspace vehicles within a specified range of VINs curtain airbags with a defective gas generator may have been installed due to a manufacturing error. A defective gas generator may cause the airbag not to work correctly and therefore not provide the required level of protection. volkswagen.defect: ID.Buzz Cargo Shelf system strength Properties On affected vehicles the cargo shelf in the luggage compartment may become loose and penetrate into the passenger compartment presenting a risk of injury.
volkswagen.remedy: Remove the old rack with a new one to be built by the shelf system manufacturer.

volkswagen.defect: 93MV - Charging restricted to 80% — with workshop On vehicles of the ID. product line equipped with high-voltage  batteries from a certain supplier there is a suspicion that individual  components of the high-voltage battery may not meet our high  quality standards.    In rare cases when the high-voltage battery is at a high charge level  the battery may overheat. This creates a risk of fire which could lead  to severe or deadly injuries of persons within and outside of the  vehicle as well as to significant material damage.
volkswagen.remedy: As part of the workshop visit an ODIS diagnostic log is created that  includes information on the condition and functionality of the high voltage battery. Based on this data a check of the battery status is  undertaken.    If the analysis shows that the high-voltage battery is not abnormal  the currently valid charging restriction to 80 % is lifted after  successful evaluation of the data. This has the prerequisite that the  ODIS diagnostic log be fully uploaded.    However if irregularities are found on the high-voltage battery the  charging restriction remains in place until replacement of the  affected battery modules. In this case check whether the required  warning stickers are already attached to the instrument panel and  the charging socket. If the warning stickers are not there these must  be attached to the vehicle according to the work instruction.  Until the check and if necessary repair of the vehicle it is very  important that the high-voltage battery only be charged to a  maximum charge level of 80 %.    Furthermore the warnings (stickers) included with the campaign  letter must be applied to the vehicle. This measure is both for the  safety of the vehicle owner and to protect any other people who use  the vehicle.    To increase safety where technically possible the maximum  available charging capacity of the vehicle has already been  temporarily restricted to 80 % on the system side.    Taking these requirements into account the vehicle can continue to  be used.    Maintaining the charging restriction and attaching the warning  stickers are important prerequisites in order to minimise possible  risks until the final check of the high-voltage battery.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL PUMP MAY FAIL - ENGINE MAY CUT OUT The power supply to the fuel pump may fail due to widened plug contacts in the central electrics unit

volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original pawl spring with a longer version.

volkswagen.remedy: The drive unit(s) for the rear lid are to be checked and if within the affected rangereplaced.

volkswagen.defect: RISK OF FAILURE OF REAR AXLE TRANSVERSE LINK. Moisture can enter the rear axle ball joints this moisture can start corrosion of the joints ultimately causing the joints to seize.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for replacement of ball joints and transverse links.

volkswagen.defect: ANTI LOCK BRAKE CONTROL UNIT CONCERN There is a risk that an electrical fault in the anti lock brake control unit (ABS) can cause overheating of related electrical components. This may lead to fire damage and cause the service brake to revert to a non-anti lock mode of operation.

volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator unit.

volkswagen.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: SIDE AIRBAG DIAGNOSTIC FUNCTION DISABLED Some vehicles may be fitted with airbag control units with incorrect parameters programmed. On these vehicles the diagnostic function for the side crash sensors is deactivated resulting in potential faults not being recognised and the airbag warning not illuminating.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to re programme the airbag control unit.

volkswagen.defect: A CONDENSER MAY FAIL IN THE AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT A condenser in the airbag control unit may fail.
volkswagen.remedy: The software of the airbag control unit must be updated.

volkswagen.defect: REAR SEAT BENCH WELDED CONNECTION MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY PERFORMED The rear back rest head restraint mounting is not correctly welded.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and replace rear back rest frame if required.

volkswagen.defect: FRONT BRAKE DISCS MAY NOT BE CORRECT THICKNESS The front brake discs may not meet the required thickness dimension. Under extreme loads this could cause cracking which may lead to fractures.
volkswagen.remedy: The front discs on affected vehicles will be checked for conformity and where necessary they will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE CLIPS FOR ATTACHMENT OF THE CURTAIN AIRBAGS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY SET The clips for attachment of the curtain airbags may not have been correctly set.
volkswagen.remedy: Check to ensure the curtain airbag fasteners are correctly fitted. Cable routing is also checked and if necessary corrected.

volkswagen.defect: OIL MAY GET INTO THE BRAKE SERVO THROUGH THE VACUUM LINES OF THE TANDEM PUMP. Oil may get into the brake servo through the vacuum lines of the tandem pump leading to a loss of braking assistance.
volkswagen.remedy: Replace the vacuum line from the tandem pump.  Check other components for oil and replace if necessary.

volkswagen.defect: INCORRECTLY COATED BRAKE PISTONS Rear caliper pistons incorrectly coated.
volkswagen.remedy: Replace rear calipers.

volkswagen.defect: FAILURE OF HEADLAMPS The headlamp switch may overheat and result in headlamp failure.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitting of a cable harness with control relay. In addition the light switch is to be replaced on Passat and Golf Ecomatic models as appropriate.

volkswagen.defect: IN A SIDE CRASH THERE MAY BE A DELAY IN DEPLOYMENT OF THE SIDE AIRBAG Side air bag deployment may be delayed if triggered.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the door wiring harness and secure or replace as necessary.

volkswagen.defect: Exterior door handle software update On affected vehicles there is a possibility a door may open unexpectedly.
volkswagen.remedy: Update the software on the door handle control units so a message is displayed in the event of malfunction.

volkswagen.defect: Exterior door handle software update On affected vehicles there is a possibility a door may open unexpectedly.
volkswagen.remedy: Update the software on the door handle control units so a message is displayed in the event of malfunction.

volkswagen.defect: Exterior door handle software update On affected vehicles there is a possibility a door may open unexpectedly.
volkswagen.remedy: Update the software on the door handle control units so a message is displayed in the event of malfunction.

volkswagen.defect: Brake line botled connection On affected vehicles a fault when tightening the rear left brake line can cause leaks from the brake hose connection leading to a gradual loss of brake fluid.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and secure the affected connection.  Replace affected parts if leaking.

volkswagen.defect: Track rod ball joint and wishbone bolted connection On certain vehicles there is a possibility that on one side of the front axle the bolted connection of the track rod ball joint and the wishbone were incorrectly carried out.
volkswagen.remedy: The bolted connection of the track rod ball joint on the wheel bearing housing and the wishbone on the swivel joint will be checked and if necessary the nuts are replaced.

volkswagen.defect: Passenger Airbag On affected vehicles there is a possibility in the event of a crash the front passenger airbag may not open as intended because of a fault in the dash panel.
volkswagen.remedy: Visually check the vehicle dash panel and change the airbag if necessary.

volkswagen.defect: Curtain airbag 2nd seat row On affected vehicles the curtain airbags at the height of the C-pillar (2nd seat row) may not have been correctly fitted.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the curtain airbags for correct installation and reposition if necessary.

volkswagen.defect: Lever for seat height adjustment Volkswagen AG has established that on VW Tiguan vehicles of a limited production period there is the possibility that because of a faulty protective felt in the event of a front crash a tear in the seat belt on the front seats could occur. In the event of an accident the seat belt could get caught in the side lever for seat height adjustment. The faulty protective felt on the lever for the seat height adjustment can cause the seat belt to tear in the event of a front crash. A torn seat belt increases the risk of severe or deadly injuries in the event of accidents.
volkswagen.remedy: For safety reasons the replacement of the faulty protective felt on the lever to the seat height adjustment of your vehicle is necessary. Until the check do not use your vehicle with the front seats in a seat position that is far back and low down. Otherwise there is a risk that the seat belt could tear in the event of a front crash and the risk of severe or deadly injuries is increased.

volkswagen.defect: Check rear diffuser On affected vehicles the rear diffuser may not be correctly attached.
volkswagen.remedy: Affected vehicles will be checked and repaired if necessary.

volkswagen.defect: Curtain airbag On Tiguan Allspace vehicles of a limited production period there is a possibility that one or several faulty curtain airbags may have been fitted in the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the left and/or right curtain airbag must be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: Checking front seat backrest frame/301 On affected vehicles there is a possibility a faulty part was fitted in the backrest frame of the front seats.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the seat back rest and replace if necessary.

volkswagen.defect: Front belt webbing On Golf vehicles of a limited production period belt systems were fitted to front passenger seat that may not have been correctly attached to the anchoring point near the lower B pillar.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the anchoring point of the belt system on the front passenger seat is inspected and dependant on results seat belt may need replacing.

volkswagen.defect: Front belt webbing On Golf vehicles of a limited production period belt systems were fitted to front passenger seat that may not have been correctly attached to the anchoring point near the lower B pillar.
volkswagen.remedy: The anchoring point of the belt system on the front passenger seat is inspected and dependant on results seat belt may need replacing.

volkswagen.defect: BALL JOINT TO WISHBONE SECURITY As a result of an assembly fault the bolts securing the ball joints on the wishbone may loosen. In extreme cases this could result in loss of steering control.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for a check on the torque of the ball joint mounting nuts/bolts. If any bolt is insufficiently torqued all three mounting bolts will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: USA Imported vehicle Recall Driver side airbag module replacement USA Recall for Imported vehicles NITSA 20V785. Volkswagen has detected  that on some USA Imported Beetle models that the driver front airbag  inflator can explode due to propellant degradation that occurs after  exposure to high absolute humidity high temperatures and high temperature cycling. An inflator explosion in these circumstances can result  in injury to the driver or other occupants due to the ejection of metal  fragments during the airbag explosion.
volkswagen.remedy: For safety reasons the driver airbag unit must be replaced. The work required will take approximately 1.5 hours and will of course be performed free of charge.

volkswagen.defect: Check rear axle bolted connection STOP -DRIVE - Do not drive your vehicle until the repair has been completed; it must be recovered to a workshop. The rear axle bolted connecting may not have been completed to specification. Risk of axle becoming detached and resultant loss of control and possible collision or injury.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and if necessary re-work rear axle bolted connection

volkswagen.defect: Hybrid battery management reprogramming On Touareg vehicles with hybrid drive systems and of a limited production period there may be deviations on the high-voltage battery system. A measure is necessary because on individual battery modules deviations with important technical parameters were established. Over the life of the vehicle these can cause a fault in the affected battery modules. As a result charging the high-voltage battery can cause a danger of fire with the risk of severe to life threatening injuries for persons in and/or outside of the vehicle as well as severe material damage. NOTE: Until the check of your vehicle has been completed we ask that you do not charge the high-voltage battery externally. In hybrid mode select the setting “battery hold” at a charge level of max. 50%. Also avoid pure electric driving.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the software in the control unit for hybrid battery management is updated

volkswagen.defect: Replace battery modules On affected vehicles a module in the high-voltage battery may not meet the manufacturer's quality standards. This could lead to a noticeable loss of range or to the yellow warning lamp coming on. Furthermore there is a risk of overheating within the high-voltage battery. Overheating can lead to a vehicle fire with a risk of severe or deadly injuries for the vehicle occupants.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and replace affected battery modules.

volkswagen.defect: Replace battery modules On affected vehicles a module in the high-voltage battery may not meet the manufacturer's quality standards. This could lead to a noticeable loss of range or to the yellow warning lamp coming on. Furthermore there is a risk of overheating within the high-voltage battery. Overheating can lead to a vehicle fire with a risk of severe or deadly injuries for the vehicle occupants.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and replace affected battery modules.

volkswagen.defect: 48VS - Steering rack bolt replacement On vehicles of a limited production period corrosion can cause a tear of a bolt head on the steering rack. This can result in a loss of steering functionality.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the affected bolted connection of the steering rack is replaced on the right-hand side of the subframe.

volkswagen.defect: 48VT - Steering rack bolt replacement On affected vehicles corrosion can cause a tear of a bolt head on the steering rack. This can result in a loss of steering functionality and increase the risk of injury.
volkswagen.remedy: The steering bolt will be replaced with a more corrosion-resistant one.

volkswagen.defect: 48VT - Steering rack bolt replacement On affected vehicles corrosion can cause a tear of a bolt head on the steering rack. This can result in a loss of steering functionality and increase the risk of injury.
volkswagen.remedy: The steering bolt will be replaced with a more corrosion-resistant one.

volkswagen.defect: Rear lid gas strut For affected vehicles applying excess pressure to open the rear lid to its end position may cause the upper ball socket to detach from the gas strut allowing the rear lid to fall without restraint as one gas strut alone cannot hold it open.
volkswagen.remedy: The gas struts of the rear lid will be checked and if necessary replaced.
