volkswagen.defect: Faulty wheel bearing housings can fail and break prematurely Certain vehicles may be fitted with a wheel bearing housing containing cavities in the material.
volkswagen.remedy: Inspect the vehicle and if necessary replace the rear left wheel bearing housing.

volkswagen.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE LED MODULE OF THE PANORAMA SUN ROOF CAN OCCUR Possible short circuit in LED lighting module  of the panoramic roof.
volkswagen.remedy: Modify wiring with integrated fuse adapter cables.

volkswagen.defect: SEAT MAY CATCH FIRE It has been identified that due to an incorrectly sewn-in tension wire strap for the back-rest cover of the front seats there may be contact between the tension wire of the seat and the filaments of the seat heater. The resulting short circuit can lead to fire damage on the front seat covers.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the tension wires of the front seats insulated.

volkswagen.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE COMPROMISED Front wheel bearing housings with insufficient hardness may have been fitted. This can lead to a fracture of a wheel bearing housing which can affected the directional control of the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the casting dates of both front wheel bearing housings. Where the affected wheel bearing housings are found they will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE BOLTED CONNECTION OF THE PULL ROD BETWEEN THE ELECTROMECHANICAL BRAKE SERVO AND BRAKE PEDAL COULD COME LOOSE The bolted connection of the pull rod between the electromechanical brake servo and brake pedal may come loose resulting in a loss of all service braking ability.
volkswagen.remedy: Vehicles are not to be driven and the bolted connection of the input rod between the electromechanical brake servo and brake pedal must be checked and if necessary retightened

volkswagen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK A tooling problem during manufacture could result in the cylinder head not being to specification. It is possible that the fuel rail could loosen and fuel leaks cannot be ruled out. The customer may notice a smell of fuel because of the leak. In the most unfavourable case it is thought possible the fuel could ignite in the engine compartment.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the cylinder head.

volkswagen.defect: BRAKE VACUUM SUPPLY PIPE CONCERN On Polo and Lupo vehicles in the affected chassis number range tension cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo in the area of the connections of the pipes because of a manufacturing fault. If a vacuum pipe leaks the brake servo loses its function. Without the servo assistance a lot more force must be used on the pedal. But this will not lead to a total failure of the brake system.
volkswagen.remedy: The fitted vacuum pipes will be checked and if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: Certain vehicles have had a front passenger airbag unit fitted that does not fit the vehicle. Certain vehicles have had a front passenger airbag unit fitted that does not fit the vehicle.�
volkswagen.remedy: Replace the front passenger airbag.

volkswagen.defect: TOW BAR BALL END MAY LOOSEN Advised by manufacturer for vehicles with PEKA tow bar the description of the ball end installation in the instruction manual is unclear. In isolated cases the ball end can loosen because of a wrong installation.
volkswagen.remedy: A new instruction manual will be sent to owners of affected vehicles.

volkswagen.defect: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

volkswagen.defect: On certain vehicles with electromechanical brake servo and DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox) of a limited production period there is a possibility that a heat protection mat was incorrectly fitted. In individual cases the brake fluid reservoir can melt and cause a brake fluid leak into the engine compartment. On certain vehicles with electromechanical brake servo and DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox) of a limited production period there is a possibility that a heat protection mat was incorrectly fitted. In individual cases the brake fluid reservoir can melt and cause a brake fluid leak into the engine compartment.
volkswagen.remedy: A check of the installation of the heat protection mat on affected vehicles will be conducted. If necessary the correct heat shield condition will be restored and in a damage case the damaged components will be replaced.� �

volkswagen.defect: BRAKE VACUUM SUPPLY PIPE CONCERN On Polo and Lupo vehicles in the affected chassis number range tension cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo in the area of the connections of the pipes because of a manufacturing fault. If a vacuum pipe leaks the brake servo loses its function. Without the servo assistance a lot more force must be used on the pedal. But this will not lead to a total failure of the brake system.
volkswagen.remedy: The fitted vacuum pipes will be checked and if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE HOUSING BOLTS ON THE CAMSHELF ADJUSTER MAY COME LOOSE The housing bolts on the camshaft adjuster may come loose and break the pulley
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the camshaft adjuster has to be replaced

volkswagen.defect: ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL SYSTEM MAY FAIL The electronic stability control (ESC)  unit may have not have been manufactured to the correct specification. This may cause the control unit to malfunction during operation
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles check the ESC unit and where necessary replace.

volkswagen.defect: FAULTY CRASH SENSORS FOR AIR BAG AND RESTRAINT SYSTEMS MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED IN THE FRONT DOORS Faulty crash sensors for airbag and restraint systems may have been fitted in the front doors.
volkswagen.remedy: The crash sensors in the front doors are to be checked and if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: WHEELS ORDERED AND BOUGHT AT THE DEALERS MAY NOT BE COMPATIBLE Wheels ordered and bought at the dealers may not be compatible.
volkswagen.remedy: Incompatible wheels in the customer's possession must be replaced

volkswagen.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The earth terminal of the additional air heater may not be correctly attached. This can lead to overheating of the connection and in the most unfavourable case to a vehicle fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to modify the attachment of the earth cable on the heating element of the additional air heater.

volkswagen.defect: RISK OF FAILURE OF REAR AXLE TRANSVERSE LINK. Moisture can enter the rear axle ball joints this moisture can start corrosion of the joints ultimately causing the joints to seize.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for replacement of ball joints and transverse links.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WELDED CONNECTION OF REAR SEAT BENCH A welded connection of the rear seat bench may not have been correctly performed.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the welding of the mounting for right rear head restraint guides and if necessary replace the backrest frame.

volkswagen.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE CRANK ROOF WINDOW COULD COME LOOSE BECAUSE OF INCORRECT BONDING TO ITS HINGE The crank roof window could come loose because of incorrect bonding to its hinge.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the bonding must be checked. Depending on the test result the roof window is then modified or if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: FRONT WHEELS MAY LOCK The retaining bolts for the front calipers may not have been tightened to the specified torque. The caliper may loosen wedge against the wheel rim  and lock the wheel. Detachment of the caliper may happen.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace all front caliper retaining bolts.

volkswagen.defect: AIRBAG/BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT TRIGGER IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag  assembly and seatbelt pretensioner where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: ROOF SPOILER MAY DETACH BECAUSE UNSUITABLE ADHESIVE USED The roof spoiler can partially or completely detach from the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the roof spoiler is additionally fixed in position with two bolts

volkswagen.defect: TOO LITTLE TORQUE MAY BE PROVIDED BY THE ENGINE AT LOW ENGINE SPEEDS Too little torque may be provided by the engine at low engine speeds.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the software of the engine control unit must be updated.

volkswagen.defect: RISK OF FUEL LEAK It is possible that fuel leaks could develop on the fuel pipes in the engine compartment. This could then leak onto the road surface or cause a risk of fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and install protection devices.

volkswagen.defect: TOO LITTLE TORQUE MAY BE PROVIDED BY THE ENGINE AT LOW ENGINE SPEEDS Too little torque may be provided by the engine at low engine speeds.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the software of the engine control unit must be updated.

volkswagen.defect: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF HEADLAMPS The wiring harness can cause the headlamp switch to overheat with consequent failure of the headlamps.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for modification to the light switch cable and replacement of the headlamp switch.

volkswagen.defect: RH SHOCK ABSORBER MOUNTING MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY TORQUED It has been identified that on some Passat vehicles within the affected Vin range the rear securing bolt of the right hand shock absorber mounting may not have been tightened to the correct torque. The consequence of this being that the securing bolt may break.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the subject bolt.

volkswagen.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY The drivers air bag propellant cannister may not have been fitted correctly. This may affect the deployment of the airbag.
volkswagen.remedy: Replace driver's air bag unit.

volkswagen.defect: ENGINE COMPARTMENT COVERS COULD COME LOOSE FROM THEIR ATTACHMENT On affected vehicles engine compartment covers were fitted that regardless of use (very sporty driving style or poor road condition) and operating period could come loose from their attachment.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles the engine compartment cover has to be removed.

volkswagen.defect: SPORADIC MALFUNCTIONS IN A PRESSURE CASTING SYSTEM CAUSED INDIVIDUAL REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS TO BE FITTED WITH OXIDE INCLUSIONS On Tiguan LWB vehicles of a limited production period sporadic malfunctions in a pressure casting system caused individual rear wheel bearing housings to be fitted with oxide inclusions.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the production date of the two rear wheel bearing housings is checked and if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: Volkswagen AG has established that on a few ID.3 vehicles the front passenger airbag may not be securely bolted in place as intended. On certain vehicles the front passenger airbag may not be securely bolted in place as intended.
volkswagen.remedy: The front passenger airbag is to be deactivated until this recall campaign is carried out. It must then be inspected and if necessary resecured.

volkswagen.defect: SIDE AIRBAG OF FRONT LEFT SEAT MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY IN COLLISION & MAY HAVE SOME PASSENGER COLLISION PROTECTION MISSING On affected vehicles the near side front side air bag may have been incorrectly fitted in its module. As a result it may not deploy as intended during a collision increasing the risk of injury.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the nearside front side airbag.

volkswagen.defect: CLUTCH MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY WITH UNEXPECTED LOSS OF DRIVE In rare cases an incorrect interpretation of the clutch temperature can occur which results in the clutch opening unexpectedly with loss of drive.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and update/reprogramme gearbox control unit.

volkswagen.defect: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

volkswagen.defect: UNINTENTIONAL AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT In rare cases an air bag acceleration sensor may give an incorrect signal which can lead to an unintentional airbag deployment
volkswagen.remedy: Recall vehicle check if vehicle is affected and replace the control unit as required.

volkswagen.defect: INADVERTENT RELEASE OF HANDBRAKE The pawl spring fitted as original equipment to the parking brake may be insufficiently long and consequently fail to exert enough pressure to ensure that the pawl engages positively in the ratchet teeth. This could allow the parking brake to release
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original pawl spring with a longer version.

volkswagen.defect: WITH TEMPERATURES BELOW ZERO THE DOOR LOCK BOWDEN CABLES CAN FREEZE With temperatures below zero the door lock Bowden cables can freeze.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the door Bowden cables are replaced and all door locks are given a sealing foil.

volkswagen.defect: BONDED WINDOWS AND/OR FASTENING RAILS MAY DETACH It is possible that some vehicles have poor paint adhesion which can lead to a reduced retaining force of the bonded windows/fastening rails. The windows may not remain attached to the vehicle when it is subject to high forces during a collision.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to remove the windscreen and prepare and repaint the receiving surfaces then re-bond the windscreen. If there are also windows in the load area these will be treated the same.

volkswagen.defect: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM OF PLUG-IN HYBRID VEHICLES WAS IN SOME CASES PRODUCED WITH TOO LITTLE SO-CALLED FIRE SAND The fuse in the high-voltage system of plug-in hybrid vehicles was in some cases produced with too little so-called fire sand.
volkswagen.remedy: An additional protective insulating mat is to be fitted to the switching unit for high-voltage battery.

volkswagen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

volkswagen.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The contact resistance on the earth connection of the heating element for the additional air heater can exceed specification.  This could lead to excessive heat developing in the connection area of the cable which could result in localised scorching.  However if not rectified this could result in a vehicle fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and check the torque on the earth connection.

volkswagen.defect: STEERING SHAFT CLAMPING BOLTS MAY LOOSEN The clamp bolt on one of three steering column universal couplings may not have been fully tightened on initial assembly. Should this bolt loosen it could allow excess free movement in the steering and if not rectified loss of steering control.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check the torque of the subject bolt and where necessary re-tighten it to the manufacturers specifications. Where a clamp bolt is found to be below the specified torque the splines on the shaft will be examined for

volkswagen.defect: RISK OF FIRE The cooling fan may continue to run until the battery is drained. In the most unfavourable scenario this can even lead to a vehicle fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an additional wiring loom.

volkswagen.defect: FLYWHEEL MAY FAIL The possibility exists that the two mass flywheel may fail due to the design of the through-flow restrictor in the clutch pressure pipe. In the worst case the failure can result in a vehicle fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled  to establish the manufacturer of the two-mass flywheel and if necessary replace the flywheel and breather of the clutch pressure pipe.

volkswagen.defect: A FAULTILY INSTALLED NET FOR THE DESIGN BREAKAGE POINT FOR THE DISCHARGE OF THE PASSENGER AIRBAG HAS BEEN FITTED A dash panel with a faulty installed net for the design breakage point for the discharge of the passenger airbag has been fitted.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the dash panel has to be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED There is a possible faulty weld to the gas generator. If the airbag is deployed there is a potential danger to the vehicle occupants by gas generator parts being ejected into the cabin.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator unit.

volkswagen.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: POWER STEERING RETURN HOSE CAN BECOME DAMAGED AND CAUSE HYDRAULIC FLUID TO LEAK AND/OR THE POWER STEERING TO FAIL A hose clip can damage the power steering return hose for the steering rack. The power steering hose can also contact the wheel housing. If the hose is damaged hydraulic fluid can discharge and the power steering assistance could fail. In unfavourable cases the hydraulic fluid can get in contact with hot vehicle component or on the brake disc. This could create a danger of accident or fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a serrated ring. Fit or remove a spacer as appropriate.

volkswagen.defect: CLUTCH MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY WITH UNEXPECTED LOSS OF DRIVE In rare cases an incorrect interpretation of the clutch temperature can occur which results in the clutch opening unexpectedly with loss of drive.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and update/reprogramme gearbox control unit.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF COOLANT LEAKAGE INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT Operation of the vehicle for prolonged periods with the cooling system at very high temperatures can result in cooling system damage which in rare instances may cause rupturing on the heat exchanger. In consequence high temperature coolant
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a bypass valve to the heat exchanger inlet and a non-return valve to the system. At the same time the heat exchanger box will be lined with absorbent foam.

volkswagen.defect: THE AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM EVAPORATOR HOUSING DRAINPIPE MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED The drainpipe of the evaporator housing of the air conditioning system may have been incorrectly manufactured leading to water accumulating and dripping onto the airbag control unit.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the drainpipe of the evaporator housing. If found to be incorrectly manufactured the drainpipe must be modified and the airbag control unit replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE BRAKE SERVO PULL ROD BALL COUPLING MAY HAVE BEEN PUT INTO THE MOUNTING OF THE BRAKE PEDAL INCORRECTLY The ball coupling of the push rod of the electromechanical brake servo may have been wrongly slotted into the mounting on the brake pedal.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the ball coupling into the mounting of the brake pedal. If the ball coupling is incorrectly slotted in the brake servo and mounting in the brake pedal must be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: A WRONG MULTIPLE FUSE WAS INSTALLED IN THE ELECTRONICS BOX An incorrect multiple fuse was installed in the electronics box.
volkswagen.remedy: The incorrect multiple fuse in the electronics box has to be replaced

volkswagen.defect: CURTAIN AIRBAG UNITS MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE GAS GENERATOR WELDED TO THE OUTLET PIPE WHICH IS NOT FAIL PROOF The curtain airbag unit gas generators may not be fail-proof leading to the airbags not opening completely in the event of an accident.
volkswagen.remedy: Replace affected airbag units.

volkswagen.defect: POSSIBILITY OF COOLANT LEAKAGE INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT Operation of the vehicle for prolonged periods with the cooling system at very high temperatures can result in cooling system damage which in rare instances may cause rupturing on the heat exchanger. In consequence high temperature coolant
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a bypass valve to the heat exchanger inlet and a non-return valve to the system. At the same time the heat exchanger box will be lined with absorbent foam.

volkswagen.defect: TRACK ROD NUT MAY NOT BE TORQUED CORRECTLY AND BECOME LOOSE During manufacture the steering track rod locking nuts may been tightened to an insufficient torque. As a result the attachment of the track rod may become loose.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the track rod locking nuts replaced on both the left and right hand sides.

volkswagen.defect: TWIN-MASS FLYWHEEL MAY FAIL AND RESULT IN A VEHICLE FIRE It has been advised that the twin-mass flywheel can become damaged because of poor internal installation. This can result in a failure of the twin-mass flywheel and under unfavourable circumstances a vehicle fire.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the twin-mass flywheel replaced.

volkswagen.defect: A WELDED CONNECTION OF THE GEARBOX OIL PIPE CAN CAUSE A LEAK OF GEAR OIL A welded connection of the gearbox oil pipe can cause a leak of gear oil.
volkswagen.remedy: Check whether the gearbox oil pipe is within the affected production period. If this is the case the pipe is replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE BOLTED CONNECTION OF THE PULL ROD BETWEEN THE ELECTROMECHANICAL BRAKE SERVO AND BRAKE PEDAL COULD COME LOOSE The bolted connection of the pull rod between the electromechanical brake servo and brake pedal may come loose resulting in a loss of all service braking ability.
volkswagen.remedy: Vehicles are not to be driven and the bolted connection of the input rod between the electromechanical brake servo and brake pedal must be checked and if necessary retightened

volkswagen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On affected vehicles the fuel filter may crack around inlet connection. This will allow fuel to leak which may cause a smell within the vehicle interior and possibly contaminate the road environment. This may affect the handling of the vehicle and of other traffic..
volkswagen.remedy: Check type of filter fitted. If not of improved type then replace with improved filter.

volkswagen.defect: ANTI LOCK BRAKE CONTROL UNIT CONCERN There is a risk that an electrical fault in the anti lock brake control unit (ABS) can cause overheating of related electrical components. This may lead to fire damage and cause the service brake to revert to a non-anti lock mode of operation.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to check the part number and supplier code of the ABS control unit. Renew the ABS control unit where found necessary.

volkswagen.defect: SUNROOF MAY INJURE OCCUPANTS WHEN IT IS CLOSED FROM OUTSIDE VEHICLE On certain vehicles with Panorama sun roof the legally specified limits of the clamping forces for convenience opening and closing of the sun roof may not be kept. When closing the Panorama sun roof from outside with the vehicle key (convenience closing) if any body parts are in the operating area of the sun roof they can get pressed against the roof frame and possibly get injured.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and deactivate the convenience opening and closing of the Panorama sun roof. To do this the software for the on-board supply control unit and the sun roof control unit must be updated/ configured.

volkswagen.defect: DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY IF ACTIVATED Drivers airbag may not deploy correctly if activated.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the airbag unit for the driver is to be checked and if necessary the gas generator replaced.

volkswagen.defect: DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY IF ACTIVATED Drivers airbag may not deploy correctly if activated.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the airbag unit for the driver is to be checked and if necessary the gas generator replaced.

volkswagen.defect: TENSION CRACKS MAY OCCUR ON THE VACUUM PIPE TO THE SERVO Tension cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo in the area of the connections due to a manufacturing fault. Should a vacuum pipe leak the brake servo will loose it's function. This will result in an increase of force which must be applied to the brake pedal. But will not result in a total failure of the braking system.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pipes checked and if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT TYRES COULD SUDDENLY LOSE AIR There is a possibility that tyres could suddenly lose air.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the production data (DOT number) of all tyres including spare wheel are checked and if necessary tyres will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: FRONT BRAKE DISCS MAY NOT BE CORRECT THICKNESS The front brake discs may not meet the required thickness dimension. Under extreme loads this could cause cracking which may lead to fractures.
volkswagen.remedy: The front discs on affected vehicles will be checked for conformity and where necessary they will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: CLUTCH OPERATION MAY BE AFFECTED A fracture may occur in the area of the clutch pedal attachment because of poor welding which may affect the operation of the clutch.
volkswagen.remedy: On all affected vehicles an additional foot pedal support (additional welding seam) will be fitted

volkswagen.defect: CLUTCH MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY WITH UNEXPECTED LOSS OF DRIVE In rare cases an incorrect interpretation of the clutch temperature can occur which results in the clutch opening unexpectedly with loss of drive.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and update/reprogramme gearbox control unit.

volkswagen.defect: MALFUNCTION OF AIR BAG The wiring to the air bag control unit can chafe on the brake/clutch lever. This may lead to malfunction of the air bag unit.
volkswagen.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the air bag wiring re-routed and fixed to the bulkhead. Any wiring found to be damaged will be replaced or repaired.

volkswagen.defect: DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY IF ACTIVATED Drivers airbag may not deploy correctly if activated.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the airbag unit for the driver is to be checked and if necessary the gas generator replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM OF PLUG-IN HYBRID VEHICLES WAS IN SOME CASES PRODUCED WITH TOO LITTLE SO-CALLED FIRE SAND The fuse in the high-voltage system of plug-in hybrid vehicles was in some cases produced with too little so-called fire sand.
volkswagen.remedy: An additional protective insulating mat is to be fitted to the switching unit for high-voltage battery.

volkswagen.defect: THERE IS THE POSSIBILITY THAT A SMALL CHILD COULD CLIMB FROM THE BUNK BED OUT THROUGH THE OPENED ROOF HATCH There is the possibility that small children could climb from the bunk bed out through the opened roof hatch.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles protection against climbing out is to be fitted.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On 2.0l Common Rail engines of a limited production period faulty material can cause leaks on the high pressure pipes during the service life of the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: Anti-vibration balance weights will be fitted on the high-pressure pipes.

volkswagen.defect: AIRBAG/BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT TRIGGER IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag  assembly and seatbelt pretensioner where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: THE BELT BUCKLE HOLDER OF REAR RIGHT SEAT MAY NOT MEET THE STRENGTH REQUIREMENTS The seat belt buckle holder of the right rear seat may not meet specification.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and replaces seat belt buckle assembly.

volkswagen.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY NOT FULLY APPLY It has been identified that on some vehicles the rear brake shoe adjustment bushes can because of insufficient wall thickness break when the handbrake is applied.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject adjustment bushes replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE WALL THICKNESS OF THE FUEL TANK MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The specified wall thickness of the fuel tank can in some places fall below the threshold.
volkswagen.remedy: For all affected vehicles the fuel tank has to be replaced

volkswagen.defect: HEAD RESTRAINT MAY BE INSECURE On a limited production period a burr may have developed on the locking bar of the head restraint guide.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles the left head restraint guide on both front seats must be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: BOLTED CONNECTION BETWEEN STEERING SHAFT AND STEERING RACK MAY LOOSEN The bolted connection between the steering shaft and the steering rack may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
volkswagen.remedy: The bolted connection of the intermediate steering shaft has to be replaced

volkswagen.defect: TOO LITTLE TORQUE MAY BE PROVIDED BY THE ENGINE AT LOW ENGINE SPEEDS Too little torque may be provided by the engine at low engine speeds.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the software of the engine control unit must be updated.

volkswagen.defect: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT TYRES COULD SUDDENLY LOSE AIR There is a possibility that tyres could suddenly lose air.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the production data (DOT number) of all tyres including spare wheel are checked and if necessary tyres will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

volkswagen.defect: THE HOUSING BOLTS ON THE CAMSHELF ADJUSTER MAY COME LOOSE The housing bolts on the camshaft adjuster may come loose and break the pulley
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the camshaft adjuster has to be replaced

volkswagen.defect: DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY IF ACTIVATED Drivers airbag may not deploy correctly if activated.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the airbag unit for the driver is to be checked and if necessary the gas generator replaced.

volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

volkswagen.defect: THE ROOF SPOILER CAN PARTIALLY OR COMPLETELY DETACH FROM THE VEHICLE The roof spoiler can partially or completely detach from the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: The roof spoiler is additionally fixed in position with bolts on the rear lid.

volkswagen.defect: CHAFING OF WIRING LOOMS AND POSSIBLE FUEL LEAKAGE 1) Certain cable looms in the engine compartment may chafe on adjacent sharp edges with the possibility of a short circuit. 2) Leakage may develop in the hose connections to the fuel manifold.
volkswagen.remedy: 1) Recall the affected vehicles re-route secure and protect the subject cable looms as required to eliminate chafing. 2) Replace the fuel hose securing clamps check the condition of the hoses and replace as required.

volkswagen.defect: LOOSENING OF STEERING U/J CLAMPING BOLT The steering shaft top universal clamping bolt may loosen .This will allow free movement in the steering and if not rectified could lead to loss of steering control.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the steering shaft top universal clamping bolt and nut with new components.

volkswagen.defect: REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS MAY BE INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED AND COULD FAIL PREMATURELY The hardening process for the rear wheel bearing housings may not have been correctly performed. In the worst case this could lead to a fractured housing. Should a fractured housing occur there would be abnormal noises bad tyre wear and a theoretical possibility of wheel loss.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the 420 vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right and left rear wheel bearing housings.

volkswagen.defect: A WELDING TO THE TUBULAR FRAME OF THE DRIVER SEATMAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY PERFORMED A welding to the tubular frame of the driver seat may have been incorrectly performed.
volkswagen.remedy: The welding on the rear tubular frame of the driver seat will be checked and if necessary replaced.

volkswagen.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY On affected Crafter vehicles some airbag control units may be incorrectly coded.  It is also possible the wrong parameter set has been assigned to the airbag control unit.
volkswagen.remedy: Where necessary the airbag control unit will be replaced

volkswagen.defect: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

volkswagen.defect: IN A SIDE CRASH THERE MAY BE A DELAY IN DEPLOYMENT OF THE SIDE AIRBAG Side air bag deployment may be delayed if triggered.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the door wiring harness and secure or replace as necessary.

volkswagen.defect: Seat belt webbing was damaged during production Seat belt webbing was damaged during production
volkswagen.remedy: Affected seat belts to be replaced

volkswagen.defect: BRAKE PIPES MAY CHAFE ON OTHER COMPONENTS On the subject vehicles it is possible that the brake pipe holder may not have been correctly positioned on the steering rack. This could allow the brake pipe to chafe on adjoining components and cause pipe damage.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and if necessary modify the position of the pipe holder and pipes to eliminate the possibility of the pipes chafing on other components.

volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles check the torque of the subject bolt and where necessary re-tighten it to the manufacturers specifications. Where a clamp bolt is found to be below the specified torque the splines on the shaft will be examined for

volkswagen.defect: BRAKE SERVO VACUUM PIPE MAY CRACK AND LEAK. The brake servo vacuum supply pipe may crack and leak. This could result in a loss of power assistance and require the driver to apply  a lot more force to the brake pedal.
volkswagen.remedy: Examine the condition of the vacuum supply pipe and fit an improved quality replacement where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: SUSPENSION MAY CRACK The mountings on the axle where the rear leaf springs are fixed may crack. If this cracking is not repaired the suspension will eventually fail to its lowest point on that side.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit reinforcement plates extended U-bolts and nuts.

volkswagen.defect: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE AND THE CONTROL UNIT CABLE MAY HAVE BEEN MIXED UP The positive battery cable and the cable to the control unit for battery monitoring on the main fuse box in the boot may have been mixed up.
volkswagen.remedy: Inspect the two connected cables on the main fuse box and if necessary swap them into the correct positions.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK RESULTING IN POSSIBLE FIRE It is possible that fuel can leak from a fuel delivery rail due to  insufficient soldering during production.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace fuel rail.

volkswagen.defect: REPLACE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG The front passenger airbag may be faulty. There may be insufficient protection especially for smaller passengers in the front seat because of incorrectly folded passenger airbags.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger airbag.

volkswagen.defect: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
volkswagen.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: THE ELECTRIC PARKING BRAKE CAN BE UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASED WHEN DISENGAGING THE CLUTCH PEDAL The electric parking brake can be unintentionally released when disengaging the clutch pedal.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the brake control unit has to be recoded

volkswagen.defect: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

volkswagen.defect: BRAKE SERVO VACUUM PIPE MAY CRACK AND LEAK The brake servo vacuum supply pipe may crack and leak.  This could result in a loss of power assistance and require the driver to apply a lot more force to the brake pedal.
volkswagen.remedy: Examine the condition of the vacuum supply pipe and fit an improved quality replacement where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On 2.0l Common Rail engines of a limited production period faulty material can cause leaks on the high pressure pipes during the service life of the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: Anti-vibration balance weights will be fitted on the high-pressure pipes.

volkswagen.defect: SHATTER CRACKS MAY OCCUR ON VACUUM PIPE TO BRAKE SERVO Shatter cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo near the connections. If a vacuum pipe leaks a lot more force will be necessary to operate the brake pedal.
volkswagen.remedy: The fitted vacuum pipes will be checked and replaced if necessary.

volkswagen.defect: THE SIDE OR REAR WINDOWS MAY BECOME LOOSE Some side or rear windows may become loose
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the side or rear windows have to be replaced

volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and update/reprogramme gearbox control unit.

volkswagen.defect: HEAD RESTRAINT MAY BE INSECURE On a limited production period a burr may have developed on the locking bar of the head restraint guide.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles the left head restraint guide on both front seats must be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: TOWING EYE IN THE VEHICLE TOOL KIT  MAY DETACH DURING USE The welding of the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit may not be to specification. As a result the weld on the eye may fail during use causing loss of propulsion and the towrope with the attached eye can potentially cause property damage and personal injury.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit.

volkswagen.defect: WATER INGRESS TO INJECTORS It is possible for water to enter the injection mechanism resulting in a sudden loss of engine power.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the fuel distributors injectors and hoses.

volkswagen.defect: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE LOST On vehicles with torsion beam rear axle the trailing arm of the rear axle can be deformed in a rear impact of the vehicle or when reversing too quickly over a relatively high obstacle (such as very high kerbs). If this deformation or pre-damage is not recognised a trailing arm of the rear axle can suddenly break later because of the related weakening of the rear axle.
volkswagen.remedy: On vehicles which have been involved in a rear impact or reversed at  speed  over a high obstacle.  The trailing arm of the torsion beam rear axle is checked for accident damage and replaced if necessary. In other instances a brace plate will be fitted to the trailing arms.

volkswagen.defect: NUTS FITTED IN THE BOLTED CONNECTION OF THE RIGHT AND LEFT TRANSVERSE LINK MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFCATION Nuts of deviating material quality were fitted in the bolted connection of the right and left transverse link on the bottom of the multi-link rear axle.
volkswagen.remedy: The nuts of the right and left transverse link on the bottom of the multi-link rear axle will be replaced.

volkswagen.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK On 2.0l Common Rail engines of a limited production period faulty material can cause leaks on the high pressure pipes during the service life of the vehicle.
volkswagen.remedy: Anti-vibration balance weights will be fitted on the high-pressure pipes.

volkswagen.defect: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED A connection between the detonator and generator in the front passenger airbag module may not be correctly welded. Therefore the airbag may not be triggered in the event of a collision.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front passenger airbag module.

In the worse case this could jam the throttle valve causing an increase in engine speed. Examine fuel pipes for chafing damage and renew or reposition and secure as appropriate. 2) Examine brake pipe for chafing damage and renew or reposition and secure brake pipe as appropriate.

volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag  assembly and seatbelt pretensioner where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: FRONT SEAT BACKREST MAY COLLAPSE IN A COLLISION The back-rests of the front seats may not have been assembled correctly. This may increase risk of injury to occupants during a collision.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles check frames and if necessary replace affected components.

volkswagen.defect: A SOFTWARE FAULT IN THE INSTRUMENT CLUSTER CONTROL UNIT A software fault in the instrument cluster control unit can lead to the driver not being shown any optical or acoustic warnings if a person on the rear seat bench is not fastened in.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the software for the instrument cluster must be updated.

volkswagen.defect: LIGHTS MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING It has been identified that due to a programing issue with the On-Board Supply Control Unit it is possible that the failure of one of the vehicle lights (dipped beam/main beam/daytime running light/rear fog light or indicator) may not be recognised by the control unit and therefore not shown in the instrument cluster. It is also possible that vehicle lights may be shown as faulty when they are not. Furthermore a failure of a dipped beam may not trigger a replacement response (activation of side lights). A light failure without a display in the instrument cluster or without replacement response can pose a danger of an accident especially in the dark.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to reprogramme the On-Board Supply Control Unit.

volkswagen.defect: THE ADJUSTED HANDBRAKE LEVER TRAVEL FOR PARKING THE VEHICLE CAN INCREASE Hand brake lever travel increase due to adjuster nut movement.
volkswagen.remedy: Re-adjust assembly and fit locking device to nut.

volkswagen.defect: CLUTCH MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY WITH UNEXPECTED LOSS OF DRIVE In rare cases an incorrect interpretation of the clutch temperature can occur which results in the clutch opening unexpectedly with loss of drive.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and update/reprogramme gearbox control unit.

volkswagen.defect: THE ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM OF THE BACKREST FRAME OF THE FRONT SEATS MAY BE INCORRECTLY WELDED There is the possibility that the adjustment mechanism of the backrest frame of the front seats was incorrectly welded.
volkswagen.remedy: On the affected vehicles the backrests of the front seats are to be checked and replaced if necessary.

volkswagen.defect: CHILD LOCK MAY DISENGAGE The door child locks may disengage without driver knowledge. Though the door remains close it is possible for the door to then be opened from the inside.
volkswagen.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect lock mechanism and replace where necessary.

volkswagen.defect: TOW BAR MAY DETACH The bolts fixing the tow bar towing eye or rear step and support (5.0t only) are of an incorrect grade and as a result may affect the security of the components.
volkswagen.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the bolts of the incorrect grade with ones of the correct grade.

volkswagen.defect: DUE TO A POSSIBLE FAULTY BONDING THE  ROOF WINDOW COVER MAY COMPLETELY COME LOOSE Due to a possible faulty bonding the roof window cover may completely come loose.
volkswagen.remedy: Check the bonding and modify or replace the roof window as necessary.

volkswagen.defect: THE LEFT REAR SEAT BELT DOUBLE BUCKLE MAY UNFASTEN INVOLUNTARILY Left rear seat belt may unfasten involuntarily.
volkswagen.remedy: On Affected vehicles a spacer will be fitted in the double buckle of the rear seat.

volkswagen.defect: THE LIFT CABLE OF THE SPARE WHEEL WINCH COULD SNAP UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS On affected vehicles the lift cable of the spare wheel winch could snap under certain conditions.
volkswagen.remedy: Retrofit an anti-theft device.

volkswagen.defect: THE SUN ROOF FRAME MAY NOT HAVE BEEN BONDED TO THE BODY ROOF The sunroof frame may not have been correctly bonded to the body roof.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and if necessary correctly bond the sunroof frame to the body roof.

volkswagen.defect: REAR SEAT BENCH WELDED CONNECTION MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY PERFORMED The rear back rest head restraint mounting is not correctly welded.
volkswagen.remedy: Check and replace rear back rest frame if required.

volvo.defect: HV Battery On affected vehicles following charging there is a risk of an overheating High Voltage Battery Cell which could lead to a risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Volvo Cars is confident that limiting the battery s maximum state of charge to 70% will eliminate the risk of overheating.    Additionally we would advise the following precautions.  Do not leave your vehicle unattended whilst charging within buildings or covered areas. If you see any vehicle warnings in the car or app during or after charging seek assistance.  The HV Battery modules will be inspected and replaced.

volvo.defect: C0519 Front axle screws retightening/replace On affected vehicles there is a risk that screws for the front axle attachment might lose torque or come loose. It might lead to strange behaviour of the truck and noise and in worst case loss of steering control.
volvo.remedy: Check the torque level on the screws retorque and if necessary replace parts.

volvo.defect: Roof Cover Reinforcement Roof Spoiler fixing bolts can loosen or fall out.
volvo.remedy: Additional and improvement fixings to be installed.

volvo.defect: C0440 Traction Battery Inspect/Replace On affected vehicles there is a risk of an internal short circuit within the HV Traction Battery that may result in overheating with a risk of a thermal event.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and replace HV Traction Battery.

volvo.defect: ECU cable to daytime running light Chaffing ECU cable to daytime running light chaffing that may cause the daytime running lights to stop working
volvo.remedy: Inspect and replace if required

volvo.defect: Front seat belts On affected vehicles the front left seat bolts may not have been torqued according to specification which could reduce the occupant protection in an impact.
volvo.remedy: Re-torque front seat bolts.

volvo.defect: Wheel Rims check On affected vehicles the front Wheel Rims potentially have the wrong maximum Load weight stamped which will make the vehicle be non-compliant to regulations.
volvo.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the front wheel rims.

volvo.defect: Identification plate wrong value Affected vehicles have been delivered with missing labels that carry information about the manufacturer’s representative and wrongly stamped chassis plates.
volvo.remedy: Replace the incorrect chassis plate and install the missing information label.

volvo.defect: Identification plate wrong value Affected vehicles have been delivered with missing labels that carry information about the manufacturer’s representative and wrongly stamped chassis plates.
volvo.remedy: Replace the incorrect chassis plate and install the missing information label.

volvo.defect: Identification plate wrong value Affected vehicles have been delivered with missing labels that carry information about the manufacturer’s representative and wrongly stamped chassis plates.
volvo.remedy: Replace the incorrect chassis plate and install the missing information label.

volvo.defect: Identification plate wrong value Affected vehicles have been delivered with missing labels that carry information about the manufacturer’s representative and wrongly stamped chassis plates.
volvo.remedy: Replace the incorrect chassis plate and install the missing information label.

volvo.defect: Identification plate wrong value Affected vehicles have been delivered with missing labels that carry information about the manufacturer’s representative and wrongly stamped chassis plates.
volvo.remedy: Replace the incorrect chassis plate and install the missing information label.

volvo.defect: Power cable chafing On affected vehicles power cables may chafe on the edge of an encapsulation plate due to edge protecting material might not have been correctly installed resulting in a potential risk of a short circuit and a consequential risk of a thermal event.
volvo.remedy: Check and adjust cable routing as necessary add rubber protection moulding as required.

volvo.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE Investigations have identified the wiper arm mechanism may chafe against the brake booster vacuum line. If this chafing occurs it could lead to a gradual reduction of the power assisted braking and more effort would need to be applied to the brake pedal than usual to slow the vehicle down. In a worst case the reduction of braking assistance could occur suddenly without any prior warning
volvo.remedy: Inspect the brake booster vacuum line. If it is chafed then it should be replaced and routed correctly. If the line is not chafed it should re-routed to ensure no issues going forward.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: WHEEL MAY BECOME LOOSE It has been identified that the standard wheel securing bolts may not have undergone the correct hardening process. This will result in corrosion a noise and/or vibration. If this condition is not rectified there is a possibility that the wheel may become loose and detach.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the standard wheel bolts.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG MAY INADVERTENTLY DEPLOY Possibility that passenger side air bag may be sensitive to electrostatic discharge and may inadvertently deploy.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit an additional grounding wire to electrical system.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE THERMAL ESCALATION IN CAB HEATER DUE TO RELAY FAILURE Possible thermal escalation in cab heater due to relay failure.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of the power relays for cooling heater.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Volvo quality follow-up procedures have identified an issue on a number of model year 2007 C30 S40 and V50s relating to the engine cooling fan control module.  Under certain operating conditions water intrusion could occur into the control module causing a short circuit which in very rare instances could result in a fire in the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: To install a water shield and a cable harness with relay in order to control the engine cooling fan module power supply.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING A power steering hose may come into contact with the engine cooling fan. As a consequence the hose may become damaged and subsequently leak resulting in loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new pipe clamp and where necessary a new power steering hose.

volvo.defect: TURBO PRESSURE HOSE MAY LEAK It has been identified that due to an issue with the crimping process during production the turbo pressure hose may leak. In extreme circumstances it its possible that an oil leak could occur which could result in a risk of a fire if the oil comes into contact with a hot surface.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the turbo pressure hose.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the electrical cables attached to the fuse boxes may not be sufficiently tight. Should this be the case local overheating of the terminals and fuse board may occur.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject connections checked to ensure that they are at the correct torque being rectified as necessary. Should any overheating type damage have occurred (cables or fuse card) the affected component will be changed.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK As a result of the radio voltage transformers being incorrectly connected the master switch does not isolate the electrical system. It is therefore possible to start the engine with the master switch OFF which could melt the 3 amp voltage transformer and cause a fire within the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of an alternative voltage transformer with modification to the associated wiring.

volvo.defect: A SOFTWARE ERROR MAY PREVENT THE ENGINE CONTROL MODULE FROM STARTING THE ENGINE The Engine Control Module (ECM) may prevent the combustion engine from starting.�
volvo.remedy: Download updated software.

volvo.defect: LEFT DOOR HANDLE MAY NOT PERFORM IN A COLLISION The left hand door handle cable might have been incorrectly assembled.  This may allow the door to become unlatched in certain side collision scenarios
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to adjust the door handle cables.

volvo.defect: SEATBELT MAY SEPARATE FROM THE BUCKLE It has been identified there is a possibility the front seatbelt buckle stud may not have been punched correctly during production. This may result in a separation between the buckle and seatbelt bracket if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the seatbelt buckle and if required to replace the seatbelt buckle.

volvo.defect: EXHAUST EMISSION CRITERIA IS NOT MET It has been identified that an issue with the engine software may affect the vehicle's exhaust emissions and an issue with the regenerations of the SCR brick.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to update the engine software.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING In certain cases a driver may experience sudden loss of power assistance to the steering due to voltage irregularities in the Electro Hydraulic Power Steering (EHPS) system.
volvo.remedy: This is a further action to a previous recall. On affected vehicles the invertor software is to be further updated to cope with voltage spikes / drops and to improve fault tracing. The braided earth cable will also be replaced by a copper cable to ensure the invertor earthing is secured.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY LOOSE DRIVE AND POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE. The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF AN UNDERBONNET FIRE A faulty electrical connection at the rear of the alternator can cause arcing with a possible risk of an underbonnet fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for:- A) The installation of a line fuse between the battery and the B+ connection on the alternator. B) Install a non rotational device at the B+ connection at the rear of the alternator. Any B+ cable showing signs of damage

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY INADVERTENTLY APPLY Affected vehicles maty be assembled with T nipples in the air tubes which are not to specification. Air tubes may become insecure amd may cause the parking brake to inadvertently apply.
volvo.remedy: Identify defective T nipples and replace.

volvo.defect: INSUFFICIENT FORGING STATUS IN STEERING ARM Steering arm may have insufficient forging status and become insecure
volvo.remedy: Replacement of steering arm on front axle

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: SELF ADJUSTING OUT OF FUNCTION IN THE BRAKE CALIPER HOUSING Self-Adjusting function in the brake caliper housing out of function.
volvo.remedy: Inspection of the brake housings and replacement if found faulty.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF STEERING ROD The steering rod may not be sufficiently torqued to either the Pitman arm or the steering arm on the stub axle.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for checking and where required retorqueing of both connections on the steering arm.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
volvo.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: HUB BEARING MAY FAIL Water and dirt can penetrate into the trailing axle hub which can lead to severe damage and eventual failure of the hub bearings
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a deflector to the axle hub mounting. Inspect the bearings hubs and axle for damage. Replace parts where necessary.

volvo.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL On retrofit Low Entry Cab the steering limiter valve  does not offload the system pressure correctly. This may cause  high stress/forces on the link rod adjusting sleeve and ball joint which could lead to damaged or broken parts. This may lead to  loss of steering
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles the pressure limiting valves are to be replaced and adjusted (this is a mandatory operation). The steering link rod should be checked and  replaced if there is any sign of stress

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE MATERIAL DEFECT WHICH COULD REDUCE THE LIFE EXPECTANCY OF THE TOWING HOOK Possible material defect which could reduce the life expectancy of the Towing Hook.
volvo.remedy: Replace Towing hook for later version.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK There is a possibility of a restriction in a T - Piece in the fuel return line which could lead to a pressure build up which could blow the pipe off with resulting leakage of fuel.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace T - Piece with quality assured type.

volvo.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MODULE MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED Due to a potential manufacturing defect the gas generator in the driver�s airbag module may not deploy as intended. This may reduce the affectivities of the airbag.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag module.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING  THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
volvo.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

volvo.defect: REAR AXLE SUSPENSION MAY BECOME INSECURE Rear leaf spring retaining bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles check spring hangers and replace as required.

volvo.defect: HAND CONTROL VALVE FAILURE Failure of the parking brake valve upper cam plate around the central boss may allow the parking brake to release and could result in the vehicle running away.
volvo.remedy: Strip the valve and replace the upper cam plate tensioning springs and 'O' ring with quality assured items.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING  THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
volvo.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: CAB MAY TILT UNEXPECTEDLY It has been identified that some vehicles may have left the production facility with insufficient torque having been applied to the lower fixation of the cab tilt cylinder.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the torque of the fixing checked and adjusted as necessary.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SOFTWARE ISSUE IN THE VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY MODULE (VCM) There may be a software issue in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.
volvo.remedy: Upgrade software in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.

volvo.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY IN A COLLISION It has been identified that the wiring harness for the SRS system may not have been correctly attached to the front seat frames. It is possible that continued adjustment of the seat position may cause the harness to become detached. If this should occur a warning light will illuminate on the instrument panel warning the driver of a fault with the SRS system.  However in this condition the front and side airbags may not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for an inspection of the wiring harnesses and ensure that it is correctly routed and secured.  If not then reroute and securing of the wiring harness.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The electric cooling fan control unit's metal cover may not have the correct corrosion protection. Should corrosion occur water may enter the control unit causing an electrical malfunction and in extreme cases cause a fire in the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an improved fan assembly.

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the main switch can crack which can cause an electrical short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have initially had the subject switch disconnected.  However an exchange switch has now been mae availagble to all customers who require it and will be fitted free of charge.

volvo.defect: STALLING AND LOSS OF STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE Involved vehicles may have a software issue which could cause the engine to momentarily cut-out and restart while driving. This could also cause disturbances in some electrical systems such as shut down of the instrument cluster infotainment system and loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and upgrade the software of the control units.

volvo.defect: THE GATEWAY FUNCTION IN THE EBS IS NOT ACTIVATED The red indicator lamp for the EBS function will not activate when a trailer with EBS is connected. The EBS functionality is not affected.
volvo.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and initiate the appropriate software function.

volvo.defect: A CABLE HARNESS IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT MAY BE ASSEMBLED IN THE INCORRECT POSITION A cable harness in the engine compartment may be assembled in the incorrect position.
volvo.remedy: The cable harness is to be secured in the correct position.

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: FAULTY SOFTWARE INSTALLED IN ENGINE ECU Engine speed maybe reduced to idle without warning due to faulty software in the ECU.
volvo.remedy: Re programme the ECU with new software.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM ADEQUATELY Brake assistance from the vacuum pressure pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the non-return valve in the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: THE RETAINER FOR THE BATTERY POWER CABLE AT THE ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION CENTRAL MIGHT HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED The retainer for the battery power cable at the electrical distribution central might have been incorrectly assembled.
volvo.remedy: Inspect the retainer and cable. Where necessary repair the cable and reassemble the retainer.

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: REPROGRAMMING OF ENGINE ECU Faulty software in the engine ECU will result in the engine exhaust emissions failing to comply with the regulations.
volvo.remedy: Re program the engine ECU.

volvo.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE Investigations have identified the wiper arm mechanism may chafe against the brake booster vacuum line. If this chafing occurs it could lead to a gradual reduction of the power assisted braking and more effort would need to be applied to the brake pedal than usual to slow the vehicle down. In a worst case the reduction of braking assistance could occur suddenly without any prior warning
volvo.remedy: Inspect the brake booster vacuum line. If it is chafed then it should be replaced and routed correctly. If the line is not chafed it should re-routed to ensure no issues going forward.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner can suffer from premature wear which may cause it to fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: FUSE BOX CONNECTIONS INSECURE The flange nut can seize on the thread of the studs in the fuse box which could mean the terminals do not have the correct torque and may be loose. This could cause arcing.
volvo.remedy: Check fuse box; Replace all fuse box cable flange nuts to new correct type nuts and tighten to correct torque. If necessary replace the fuse box

volvo.defect: FLUID MAY LEAK INTO WIRING HARNESS WHICH MAY CAUSE FIRE A number of Volvo C30S40V50 and C70 may experience a problem with washer fluid leaking inside the washer pump unit through the wires into the central control electronic module.  This can impact on a number of different features of the vehicle but in the worst case it may lead to a fire.
volvo.remedy: The solution is to replace and then modify the wiring harness for the washer fluid pump.  In addition to this the washer pump connector will be inspected for any signs of corrosion and the washer pump will be replaced if necessary

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT - FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that on vehicles fitted with a supplementary cabin heater the unit may contain a faulty valve which links the heater to the climate control. The valve in question may become clogged which could lead to poor water drainage and in extreme cases a short circuit. Should sufficient heat be generated by the short circuit a fire behind the instrument panel below the radio may occur.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject valve replaced.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM ADEQUATELY Brake assistance from the vacuum pressure pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the non-return valve in the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: AN ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM HOSE MAY BREAK An engine cooling system hose may break and could cause a coolant leak.
volvo.remedy: Replace the hose on affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: THRUST BEARING IN TURBO CHARGER MIGHT NOT BE ROBUST ENOUGH The thrust bearing in the turbo charger may not be robust enough.
volvo.remedy: Replace turbocharger with a modified version which has an improved thrust bearing.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX  MAY NOT ENGAGE OR SHIFT GEARS AS INTENDED It has been identified that due to internal leakage the gearbox hydraulic control module may not be able to engage or shift gears as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the gearbox replaced.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY LOOSE DRIVE AND POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE. The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: AXLE MAY BECOME INSECURE The mounting screws for the steered axles may not have been tightened correctly at the factory. If the screws are not fully tight the screws may undo and in the very worst case scenario if warnings are not heeded lead to the axle/s becoming insecure with the attendent loss of directional control.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check torque of the axle screws. Where necessary the axle locating pin will be checked and new screws fitted. Additionally where necessary the suspension anchorage will be replaced.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX  NOISE SHIELD MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH HIGH TEMPERATURE HEAT SOURCE. It has been identified that the gearbox noise shield may come into contact with high a temperature heat source
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the noise shield removed.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: SUPPORT MEMBER MAY CRACK It is possible that stress cracks may occur in the offside main support member within the engine bay which could affect the vehicle structural performance if it is involved in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection of the subject member and report findings to Volvo Car UK Ltd; who will then decide on the level of the repair.

volvo.defect: THE TAILGATE LIFTING ARMS MAY FREEZE Under certain conditions in cold climates the tailgate lifting arms may freeze and separate.
volvo.remedy: Replace both lifting arms on the tailgate.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY OVERHEAT On axles with parking brake it has been found that some brakes are binding which can cause overheating of the brakes.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the brake pads.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software.

volvo.defect: RETORQUE OF HYDRAULIC PUMP TEST NIPPLE The hydraulic pump test nipple may not have been fully tightened. This could result in an oil leak from the power steering system and a consequential reduction in and eventual loss of power assistance to the steering.
volvo.remedy: Check and tighten the hydraulic pump test nipple to the specified torque.

volvo.defect: RETAINING BOLT FOR INFLATABLE CURTAIN MAY BE BROKEN The retaining bolts used to assemble the Inflatable Curtain may be broken and offer less protection in the event of an incident.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace all retaining bolts.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: BRAKE VACUUM PUMP CONCERN The brake vacuum pump may fail and cause a reduction in brake servo assistance.  This will make the brake pedal heavy to operate.
volvo.remedy: Fit a modified brake vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL The crankshaft may not have been sufficiently hardened and may fail this in turn can lead to sudden and catastrophic engine failure. The failure may be preceded by loss of power and a knocking noise.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine.

volvo.defect: WHEEL MAY BECOME LOOSE It has been identified that the standard wheel securing bolts may not have undergone the correct hardening process. This will result in corrosion a noise and/or vibration. If this condition is not rectified there is a possibility that the wheel may become loose and detach.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the standard wheel bolts.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAKAGE Certain injectors may suffer quality problems affecting the connection to the pressure pipe.  This can result in cracking of the injector connection and a subsequent fuel leak.
volvo.remedy: Remove and examine the fuel injectors and renew any found to be part of the faulty batch.

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MODULE MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED Due to a potential manufacturing defect the gas generator in the driver�s airbag module may not deploy as intended. This may reduce the affectivities of the airbag.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag module.

volvo.defect: SEATBELT MAY SEPARATE FROM THE BUCKLE It has been identified there is a possibility the front seatbelt buckle stud may not have been punched correctly during production. This may result in a separation between the buckle and seatbelt bracket if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the seatbelt buckle and if required to replace the seatbelt buckle.

volvo.defect: ECM/ACM Software Update Due to an error in our engine software if there is a key-off / key-on signal during operation (i.e. driver turning the key during driving) engine will stop and remain stopped. The original software design is that the engine will not stop if there is a key-off and the vehicle speed is above 10 Km/h. The consequences when the engine stops is there is no steering support.
volvo.remedy: Update software

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.
