volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASE Vehicles with manual gearboxes and start/stop functionality have Parking Brake Module (PBM) software that may allow the parking brake to unintentionally release. The unintended release of the parking brake can only occur when the engine is running and the gearstick moved so it will happen when the vehicle is attended.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download upgraded Parking Brake Module (PBM) software.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: FRONT WIPER ARM SECURING NUTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED Vehicles may have incorrectly tightened front wiper arm securing nuts
volvo.remedy: Check and tighten the nuts to an increased torque setting.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL Vehicles may have an incorrectly manufactured fuel supply line which could lead to fuel leakage.  In worst cases the fuel line could become detached and the engine would stall without warning to the driver.
volvo.remedy: Replace fuel supply line.

volvo.defect: RETORQUE OF HYDRAULIC PUMP TEST NIPPLE The hydraulic pump test nipple may not have been fully tightened. This could result in an oil leak from the power steering system and a consequential reduction in and eventual loss of power assistance to the steering.
volvo.remedy: Check and tighten the hydraulic pump test nipple to the specified torque.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF THROTTLE STICKING The throttle plate screws may not have been sufficiently torqued. This could result in sticking of the throttle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a replacement throttle housing.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT When driving at low speeds a fault within the software calibration of the engine and transmission control modules may lead to a drop in the engine idle speed when braking or releasing the accelerator. In extreme cases this may result in the engine cutting out without warning.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the engine/transmission software.

volvo.defect: EXHAUST SLEEVE MAY DETACH It has been established that the securing process for the exhaust tail pipe sleeve may not be to specification and result in the tail pipe sleeve detaching. This could cause an issue for other road users.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and secure the exhaust tail pipe sleeve.

volvo.defect: SEAT BELT MAY DETACH Under certain side impact scenarios the side panel on the driver's seat may contact the quick fix seatbelt release button and the belt may detach.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to modify the side panel.

volvo.defect: INSECURITY OF STEERING ARM BRACKETS Instances have occurred where the threads on the screws securing the intermediate steering arm brackets have stripped due to the presence of foreign particles in the screw holes.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the brackets removed the screw hole threads inspected and cleaned and new bracket securing screws fitted.

volvo.defect: ENGINE COOLING FAN MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a software issue with the engine cooling fan control module the air conditioning performance may be reduced and the engine coolant temperature may increase. This will result in warning messages being displayed.  In extreme cases if the driver does not heed the warnings the engine may fail.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cooling fan control module replaced.

volvo.defect: WIPERS MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY The wipers could function without being turned on or not at all because of a software error in the central electronic module.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the software in the central electronic module.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner can suffer from premature wear which may cause it to fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF ENGINE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM The engine management system could possibly continue to use the the last received data from the vehicle ECU. For example in the event of a datalink short  the vehicle may not switch to limp home  mode but continue to respond to the last received command from either the throttle or   cruise control.
volvo.remedy: Re-programme  the engine ECU (EECU).

volvo.defect: CRACKING OF SEAT BELT BUCKLE The steel braided tether of the seat belt buckle is being deformed which can cause it to crack. This can occur as the seats are being moved on the sliding rail. At the same time the tether can be caught and pinched under the seat frames.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for inspection and replacement of either the complete seat belt or the seat belt buckle depending on the type of seat fitted.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: THE RETAINER FOR THE BATTERY POWER CABLE AT THE ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION CENTRAL MIGHT HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED The retainer for the battery power cable at the electrical distribution central might have been incorrectly assembled.
volvo.remedy: Inspect the retainer and cable. Where necessary repair the cable and reassemble the retainer.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT When driving at low speeds a fault within the software calibration of the engine and transmission control modules may lead to a drop in the engine idle speed when braking or releasing the accelerator. In extreme cases this may result in the engine cutting out without warning.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the engine/transmission software.

volvo.defect: THE RETAINER FOR THE BATTERY POWER CABLE AT THE ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION CENTRAL MIGHT HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED The retainer for the battery power cable at the electrical distribution central might have been incorrectly assembled.
volvo.remedy: Inspect the retainer and cable. Where necessary repair the cable and reassemble the retainer.

volvo.defect: AIR BELLOWS ON THE TRAILING AXLE COULD BECOME LOOSE. The retaining bolts for the suspension spring lower mountings on the tag axle may fail. The worst scenario is that all bolts fail leading to the loss of suspension function and security of the tag axle air suspension shock absorbers reaction rods and stabilizer bar.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the retaining bolts and add spacer sleeves to the tag axle suspension airbag lower mountings.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SOFTWARE ISSUE IN THE VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY MODULE (VCM) There may be a software issue in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.
volvo.remedy: Upgrade software in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.

volvo.defect: BRAKE BACKPLATE MAY BECOME INSECURE The studs that secure the front brake backplate to the front axle may not have gone through the hardening process. This means the studs are soft and could crack causing the brake backplates to loosen from the front axle.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the studs with quality assured fixings.

volvo.defect: STEERING ARM MAY FRACTURE Upper steering arm may fracture where bolted to stub axle. (Left hand drive vehicles only)
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the upper steering arm with a quality assured unit.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The electric cooling fan control unit's metal cover may not have the correct corrosion protection. Should corrosion occur water may enter the control unit causing an electrical malfunction and in extreme cases cause a fire in the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an improved fan assembly.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL  LEAK FROM INJECTOR PIPES. The fuel injector pipes may not have been fitted correctly and as a consequence could leak.
volvo.remedy: Examine all potentially affected vehicles and replace any incorrectly fitted injector pipes.

volvo.defect: WIRE OF SEAT BELT BUCKLE CAN RUB AGAINST THE PLASTIC COVER Wire of seat belt buckle can rub against the plastic cover.
volvo.remedy: Replace affected buckle for new designed buckle.

volvo.defect: RISK OF REAR UNDERRUN DETACHING It has been identified the mounting bolts/nuts for the rear underrun device may not have been torqued to the correct specification.  This could result in the rear underrun device becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check for damage replace the mounting bolts/nuts and torque them to the correct specification.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Volvo quality follow-up procedures have identified an issue on a number of model year 2007 C30 S40 and V50s relating to the engine cooling fan control module.  Under certain operating conditions water intrusion could occur into the control module causing a short circuit which in very rare instances could result in a fire in the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: To install a water shield and a cable harness with relay in order to control the engine cooling fan module power supply.

volvo.defect: STALLING AND LOSS OF STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE Involved vehicles may have a software issue which could cause the engine to momentarily cut-out and restart while driving. This could also cause disturbances in some electrical systems such as shut down of the instrument cluster infotainment system and loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and upgrade the software of the control units.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the wrong fuse may have been installed during production. This could cause an overload of the tachograph system wiring and ultimately a vehicle fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the fuse with a lower rated item.

volvo.defect: FHE/FME vehicles have been delivered with screw joints inside the traction voltage batteries that might not have been tightened according to our assembly process. FHE/FME vehicles have been delivered with screw joints inside the traction voltage batteries that might not have been tightened according to our assembly process.
volvo.remedy: Replace the affected batteries in the concerned vehicles.� �

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY APPLY WITHOUT WARNING OR LONGER THAN EXPECTED STOPPING DISTANCES COULD OCCUR The brake hoses for the front spring actuators are of insufficient length and the hoses for the front service brakes could be of insufficient length. In certain circumstances the hoses can detach from the nipple allowing the parking brakes to apply or in the case of service brake hose failure longer than expecting stopping distances could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front spring brake hoses and where necessary front service brake hoses with ones of sufficient length.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: THE INCORRECT UPPER CONTROL ARM HAS BEEN ASSEMBLED ON THE LEFT SIDE The incorrect upper control arm has been assembled on the left side.
volvo.remedy: The correct upper control arm is to be installed

volvo.defect: BRAKE CHAMBER MOUNTING BRACKETS The drive and trailing axle brake chamber mounting bracket welds may be faulty and subsequently crack.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles examine the mounting brackets and renew where necessary.

volvo.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SYSTEM CONTROL UNIT INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED TO THE CAR BODY Vehicles may have the Supplementary Restraint System (SRS) control unit incorrectly tightened to the car body.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and tighten the SRS control unit.

volvo.defect: DRAG LINK JOINTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TORQUED It has been identified that the drag link rod ball joints and/or at the link rod clamp may not have been torqued to the correct specification.  It is therefore possible that the securing nuts may become loose. This can result in the drag link rod detaching from the spindle arm or the pitman arm.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and check the torque of the securing nuts. If found to be incorrect then replace the drag link.

volvo.defect: REAR SEAT BACK LOCK STRIKERS MAY BE MISSING ON BOTH SIDES OF THE SEAT The rear seat back lock strikers may be missing on both sides of the seat which could cause the backrest not to remain in the upright position.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles install the missing striker plates.

volvo.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE FROM CAB HEATER PUMP There is a possibility of fuel leakage between the cab heater fuel pump housing and its cover.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and inspect the cab heater pump for signs of fuel leakage. Where there is evidence of this the fuel pump will be replaced. On pumps not exhibiting signs of leakage the pump cover retaining screws will be replaced.

volvo.defect: ELECTRICAL CONNECTORS CONCERN Faulty electrical connectors could result in loss of headlights and warning signals and failure of the engine to start.
volvo.remedy: Check the electrical connectors for compliance with the specification and renew where necessary.

volvo.defect: REAR AXLE V-STAY BALL JOINT CAN PREMATURELY WEAR. At high inclination the sealing boot of the axle 'V' stay ball joint can be damaged and allow the ingress of water and dirt which can cause the ball joint to wear prematurely and cause the axle to become loose.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit modified 'V' stay

volvo.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE Investigations have identified the wiper arm mechanism may chafe against the brake booster vacuum line. If this chafing occurs it could lead to a gradual reduction of the power assisted braking and more effort would need to be applied to the brake pedal than usual to slow the vehicle down. In a worst case the reduction of braking assistance could occur suddenly without any prior warning
volvo.remedy: Inspect the brake booster vacuum line. If it is chafed then it should be replaced and routed correctly. If the line is not chafed it should re-routed to ensure no issues going forward.

volvo.defect: ELECTRIC COOLING FAN MAY OVERHEAT Volvo have identified that due to certain climatic conditions the electric cooling fan may overheat and in extreme cases cause a fire within the engine bay.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cooling fan assembly replaced.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE RISK OF FUEL AND ENGINE OIL LEAKING ONTO ROAD SURFACE Seal between fuel injector and cylinder head may have been incorrectly fitted. This could result in fuel dilution of the engine oil and subsequent spillage onto the road surface.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit new cylinder head to injector seals where necessary.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY ENGAGE WHILST DRIVING It has been identified that the rear spring brake chambers may have possibly seal damage which can cause the brake to apply whilst the vehicle is being driven.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the spring brake chambers changed.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY LOOSE DRIVE AND POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE. The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: THE RADIATOR FAN CABLE HARNESS HAS THE WRONG TYPE OF WIRE SEALS IN THE POWER SUPPLY CONNECTORS FOR THE ELECTRIC COOLING FANS The radiator fan cable harness has the wrong type of wire seals in the power supply connectors for the electric cooling fans.
volvo.remedy: Replace the wire seal and if needed change components that have been damaged by water intrusion.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: There is a risk that the parking brake efficiency is reduced/lost or that the rear brake is blocked/dragging on one or two of the rear wheels. There is a risk that the parking brake efficiency is reduced/lost or that the rear brake is blocked/dragging on one or two of the rear wheels.
volvo.remedy: Replace the concerned spring brake cylinder/cylinders.

volvo.defect: INCORRECT OIL PAN FITTED It has been established that on certain vehicles fitted with an MDE5 engine they may have been delivered with a lower volume oil pan during production.  There is a risk of the sump being overfilled with oil. This could result in either the engine suffering a runaway due to it consuming its own oil or the Catalytic Converter can be contaminated which will affect the exhaust emissions.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the oil pan and dip stick also to update the Engine Management System (EMS) software.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAKAGE The engine fuel injectors may suffer a quality problem concerning the connection to the supply pipe.  This may cause cracking of the connection and a consequential fuel leak.
volvo.remedy: Check and/or change the injectors.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF UPPER STEERING ARM The screws securing the upper steering arm may have been overtightened damaging the threads of the screws and the threads in the steering arm knuckle. In the worst case situation a loss of steering control could result.
volvo.remedy: Remove the screws from the steering arm knuckle and examine the threads on both components for damage. Fit new bolts in all cases and new steering arms when the threads in the knuckle are found to be damaged.

volvo.defect: COOLANT LEAKAGE MAY RESULT IN A FIRE It has been identified that during the engine warm-up process and under certain driving/climate conditions for instance periods of high acceleration or high engine load immediately after a cold start in cold climates there is the possibility for coolant leakage or oil seepage. This can lead to the possibility in a worst-case scenario of smoke or a slow developing fire in the engine compartment. However the driver will receive a warning message on the Driver�s Information Module indicating a low coolant level.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to modify the coolant bypass valve and install a new exhaust manifold gasket.

volvo.defect: Due to a software error the left rear indicator may stop working.  Should this happen it will be an intermittent issue and a message will be shown in the driver display.  By turning the indictor off and back on again the indicator should return to full functionality: if the warning message is no longer displayed the indicator has full functionality. Due to a software error the left rear indicator may stop working.  Should this happen it will be an intermittent issue and a message will be shown in the driver display.  By turning the indictor off and back on again the indicator should return to full functionality: if the warning message is no longer displayed the indicator has full functionality.
volvo.remedy: Solution is to upgrade the software.

volvo.defect: UNINTENDED SELECTION OF REVERSE GEAR Faulty software may activate reverse gear when travelling at speeds below 3 kph.
volvo.remedy: Provide new software for the engine transmission and gearshift control units.

volvo.defect: FOOTBRAKE VALVE MAY FAIL The top bushing of the footbrake valve may move which in the worst case can decrease the ability to stop the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check test and where necessary replace the footbrake valve.  In addition a yoke securing kit will be installed to all affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: SELF ADJUSTING OUT OF FUNCTION IN THE BRAKE CALIPER HOUSING Self-Adjusting function in the brake caliper housing out of function.
volvo.remedy: Inspection of the brake housings and replacement if found faulty.

volvo.defect: INSECURITY OF SUN VISOR The external sun visor (which is an optional extra) is not sufficiently secured to its mounting bracket on the cab.
volvo.remedy: Recall all potentially affected vehicles (only a small number will have visors) for checking. All vehicles equipped with a visor will have additional screws fitted to the four mounting brackets.

volvo.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED. It is possible that an electrical short circuit within a connector could result in the illumination of the Airbag System Service Required message and Supplemental Restraint System warning lamp on the dashboard. Should this occur the driver's airbag would not deploy as intended if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and rework the connector.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INCORRECT MESHING OF STEERING ANGLE GEARS Steering angle gears may not be correctly meshed which may result in a possible loss of steering control.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check steering angle gear input and output shafts for axial looseness and renew where necessary.

volvo.defect: RETAINING BOLT FOR INFLATABLE CURTAIN MAY BE BROKEN The retaining bolts used to assemble the Inflatable Curtain may be broken and offer less protection in the event of an incident.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace all retaining bolts.

volvo.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY IN A COLLISION It has been identified that the wiring harness for the SRS system may not have been correctly attached to the front seat frames. It is possible that continued adjustment of the seat position may cause the harness to become detached. If this should occur a warning light will illuminate on the instrument panel warning the driver of a fault with the SRS system.  However in this condition the front and side airbags may not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for an inspection of the wiring harnesses and ensure that it is correctly routed and secured.  If not then reroute and securing of the wiring harness.

volvo.defect: STEERING GEAR SECURITY The bolts securing the steering gear to its mounting bracket may be loose.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the steering gear mounting bolts for tightness. Where bolts are found to be loose the mounting brackets and bolts will be examined for damage. Damaged bolts will be replaced and any burring of the bracket removed.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software

volvo.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component
volvo.remedy: Check and If found then replacement of Silencer.

volvo.defect: POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE COULD BE LOST AND FLUID MAY LEAK A leak may occur from the internal pipes of the steering gear. In most cases the leak will be gradual and will drain the power steering oil generating noise and a slow decrease in the power steering assistance. In the worst case there could be a complete loss of power steering fluid and steering assistance without any warning to the driver.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the internal pipe set.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE MAY FAIL It has been identified thatthe steering gear pressure hose may become damaged due to  conflict with the engine cooling fan. Should the hose come into contact with the cooling fan there could be a sudden draining of the hydraulic oil from the system and loss of steering power assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pressure hose secured to avoid possible engine cooling fan contact.

volvo.defect: BRAKE CHAMBER MOUNTING BRACKETS The drive and trailing axle brake chamber mounting bracket welds may be faulty and subsequently crack.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles examine the mounting brackets and renew where necessary.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that water can enter the engine bay via the nearside air cleaner filter panel and ingress into the top alternator. This can then cause the bearing to fail which leads to an internal short circuit and in extreme cases possibly a fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit a water trap to prevent water ingress into the alternator.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY REMAIN IN GEAR WHEN NEUTRAL IS SELECTED It is possible that an internal gear selector fork may failure which can result in the gearbox still being in gear when neutral is selected. This could unintentionally allow the vehicle to move off on its own.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the gear selector fork.

volvo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK - POSSIBILITY OF FIRE It has been identified that the fuel line is sensitive to the extreme temperatures that occur in the area where the turbo and exhaust manifold are located. This can result in a fuel leak a non-start and in extreme cases a fire.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the existing fuel line replaced with one made from Teflon which is capable of withstanding the extreme temperatures encountered.

volvo.defect: STALLING AND LOSS OF STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE Involved vehicles may have a software issue which could cause the engine to momentarily cut-out and restart while driving. This could also cause disturbances in some electrical systems such as shut down of the instrument cluster infotainment system and loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and upgrade the software of the control units.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: Under certain circumstances there is a risk that the two 12V batteries and its power cables might overheat. Under certain circumstances there is a risk that the two 12V batteries and its power cables might overheat.
volvo.remedy: The software will be updated with a new strategy to prevent excessive electrical currents into the 12V batteries.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: COLLISION AVOIDENCE WARNING LIGHT MAY NOT ILLUMINATE Collision avoidance warning lamp may not illuminate
volvo.remedy: Update system software on affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: SEAT BELT MAY NOT BEEN TORQUED CORRECTLY One or more screws holding the outer rear seat belts may not have been torqued correctly. This could lead to the seat belt not being as affective as it could be in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to re torque the mounting bolts.

volvo.defect: AIR BAG MOUNTING MAY LOOSEN Part of the horn operating mechanism may foul the drivers air bag module and cause it to become loose on its mounting.
volvo.remedy: Replace the air bag mounting plate.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE TRAILER DETACHMENT It has been identified that in adverse conditions the securing pin of the coupling release handle can become unfastened due to an oversize drilling. Loss of the pin can result in the coupling not being securely fastened.
volvo.remedy: Operators will be sent a repair kit to secure the pin. In addition a work method advising as to the pre-driving checks that need to be carried out.

volvo.defect: ELECTRICAL CONNECTORS CONCERN Faulty electrical connectors could result in loss of headlights and warning signals and failure of the engine to start.
volvo.remedy: Check the electrical connectors for compliance with the specification and renew where necessary.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: AUXILIARY DRIVE BELT MAY DETACH The Auxiliary Belt Tensioner may fail resulting in loss of Power Assisted Steeering and loss of Drive
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to replace the Tensioner and Drive Belt.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There could be a sudden and unexpected failure of the bottom end of the engine because of a non-conformity during production of the connecting rods.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the engine.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF DRIVE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. If the tensioner fails it would cause a loss of power steering assistance and possible loss of drive.
volvo.remedy: Replace the auxiliary drive belt tensioner.

volvo.defect: FLUID MAY LEAK INTO WIRING HARNESS WHICH MAY CAUSE FIRE A number of Volvo C30S40V50 and C70 may experience a problem with washer fluid leaking inside the washer pump unit through the wires into the central control electronic module.  This can impact on a number of different features of the vehicle but in the worst case it may lead to a fire.
volvo.remedy: The solution is to replace and then modify the wiring harness for the washer fluid pump.  In addition to this the washer pump connector will be inspected for any signs of corrosion and the washer pump will be replaced if necessary

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY OVERHEAT On axles with parking brake it has been found that some brakes are binding which can cause overheating of the brakes.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the brake pads.

volvo.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SYSTEM CONTROL UNIT INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED TO THE CAR BODY Vehicles may have the Supplementary Restraint System (SRS) control unit incorrectly tightened to the car body.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and tighten the SRS control unit.

volvo.defect: A SOFTWARE ERROR MAY PREVENT THE ENGINE CONTROL MODULE FROM STARTING THE ENGINE The Engine Control Module (ECM) may prevent the combustion engine from starting.�
volvo.remedy: Download updated software.

volvo.defect: ENGINE FUEL PUMP MAY FAIL It has been identified that long term exposure to salt or wet conditions may lead to internal corrosion of the fuel pump electronic module. A faulty signal from the module may lead to incorrect amounts  or no fuel being delivered to the fuel pump.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel pump module replaced.

volvo.defect: CAB HEATER DOES NOT MEET LEGLISLATION REQUIREMENTS Some ADR vehicles have a common cab heater assembled instead of a cab heater for ADR vehicles. Because of this the ADR vehicles do not fulfil the ADR Regulations.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the cab heater if the vehicle has been fitted with the wrong specification heater.

volvo.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been identified that internal leakage of the brake master cylinder could occur. Should this be the case the driver may experience reduced braking performance whilst applying and maintaining force on the brake pedal.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake master cylinder inspected and possibly replaced. At the same time the brake fluid reservoir will be checked and the affected pipes cleansed.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER SEAT MAY NOT BE FITTED CORRECTLY It is possible that the driver's and passenger's front powered seats may not be fitted with the front stop lug. The lug restricts the movement of the seats and if not fitted it is possible to position the seats too far forward or backwards. This could increase the chances of injury should the vehicle be involved in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect for fitment of the lugs and if found to be missing fit new lugs.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE Due to exposure of water and dirt intrusion in the engine compartment the alternators may fail prematurely due to seized bearings. In the worst case the alternators could overheat causing an engine compartment fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the alternators with new improved versions equipped with protection washers on front and rear bearing. Update engine encapsulation and exchange the alternator protective shield to reduce the amount of dirt and water entering the engine compartment.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: Dependent on affected Model update software. Until updated the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: A FAILING ESS HEATER RELAY CAN CAUSE AN UNEXPECTED HEAT DEVELOPMENT AND CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGE TO ELECTRIC WIRING A failing ESS heater relay can cause an unexpected heat development and consequential damage to electrical wiring.
volvo.remedy: Carry out a replacement of the ESS Heater relay with a modified version.

volvo.defect: A FAILING ESS HEATER RELAY CAN CAUSE AN UNEXPECTED HEAT DEVELOPMENT AND CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGE TO ELECTRIC WIRING A failing ESS heater relay can cause an unexpected heat development and consequential damage to electrical wiring.
volvo.remedy: Carry out a replacement of the ESS Heater relay with a modified version.

volvo.defect: BATTERY GROUND CABLE MAY SHORT CIRCUIT The battery positive cable may be in  conflict with the starter motor solenoid. If a conflict does develop a short circuit of the battery ground cable will occur. This may result in smoke appearing from under the bonnet or a failure to start with warning lamps illuminated.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the distance between the battery positive cable checked and adjusted if the clearance is less than 4mm.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF ABS CONTROL UNIT Some electronic control units for the ABS circuit may not be able to analyse information correctly. This may cause damage to the ABS solenoid valves and could affect braking performance.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles will be recalled to have the electronic control units checked. Where this is found to display a fault code it will be replaced together with the ABS solenoid valves.

volvo.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED It has been identified that due to a software deviation within the supplementary restraint system (SRS) the inflatable curtain and side impact protection system may not deploy as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the SRS software updated.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING FLUID It is possible that the upper power steering return line may become detached which will result in the loss of power steering fluid.  This will result in fluid leaking onto the road surface leaking into the engine bay and the driver experiencing heavy steering.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the replacement of the power steering return line.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL  LEAK FROM INJECTOR PIPES. The fuel injector pipes may not have been fitted correctly and as a consequence could leak.
volvo.remedy: Examine all potentially affected vehicles and replace any incorrectly fitted injector pipes.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: Dependent on affected Model update software. Until updated the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY MOVE FORWARD WHEN ENGAGING REVERSE GEAR There is a possibility that the vehicle may move forward when reverse gear is engaged due to a defect in the gearbox software program.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-program gearbox software.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE The engine oil  level may rise. This situation may lead to the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In an extreme situation the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and carry out a ECM software upgrade adjust engine oil level and install a decal to confirm oil level to the consumer.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF  POWER STEERING. The power steering servo hose may become detached at its connection with the steel pressure supply pipe. This will result in loss of the servo oil and make the vehicle difficult to steer.
volvo.remedy: Cut the original hose and remove it from the steering gear. Fit a new high pressure  hose which has a nut and ferrule fixing arrangement.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL LOSS OF  POWER STEERING. The power steering servo hose may become detached at its connection with the steel pressure supply pipe. This will result in loss of the servo oil and make the vehicle difficult to steer.
volvo.remedy: Cut the original hose and remove it from the steering gear. Fit a new high pressure  hose which has a nut and ferrule fixing arrangement.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY NOT MEET STANDARD ECE R55 WHERE A TOWING HOOK MUST HAVE AN ATTACHMENT FOR THE SAFETY WIRE Vehicle may not meet standard ECE R55 where a towing hook must also have an attachment for the safety wire.
volvo.remedy: Add attachment for safety wire.

volvo.defect: AXLE MAY BECOME INSECURE The mounting screws for the steered axles may not have been tightened correctly at the factory. If the screws are not fully tight the screws may undo and in the very worst case scenario if warnings are not heeded lead to the axle/s becoming insecure with the attendent loss of directional control.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check torque of the axle screws. Where necessary the axle locating pin will be checked and new screws fitted. Additionally where necessary the suspension anchorage will be replaced.

volvo.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SYSTEM CONTROL UNIT INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED TO THE CAR BODY Vehicles may have the Supplementary Restraint System (SRS) control unit incorrectly tightened to the car body.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and tighten the SRS control unit.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF ENGINE OIL SPILLAGE Incidents have occurred where Bosch unit injectors built within a certain period can leak fuel into the engine lubrication system leading to the spillage of engine oil onto the roadway.
volvo.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles to be recalled for checking and where necessary fit quality assured units.

volvo.defect: HAND CONTROL VALVE FAILURE Failure of the parking brake valve upper cam plate around the central boss may allow the parking brake to release and could result in the vehicle running away.
volvo.remedy: Strip the valve and replace the upper cam plate tensioning springs and 'O' ring with quality assured items.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Some vehicles may have had excessive underbody protection applied which when drying.  could have formed small stalactite shaped formations. These formations may have formed close to the underbody fuel lines and could damage them and cause a fuel leak.  Due to the positioning of the fuel lines escaping fuel or fuel vapour could potentially lead to a fire.
volvo.remedy: Inspect all vehicles and cut any stalactite shaped formations off. If the fuel line is damaged it will be replaced.  Only 1% of vehicles are expected to have any damage to the fuel line.

volvo.defect: TRACK ROD CLAMPING BOLTS The front axle track rod clamping bolts may have been insufficiently torqued on assembly.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the clamping bolt torque. If required the bolts will be retorqued to the correct tightness.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT The B+ cable can chafe against the cab anchorage.  This will cause the insulation on the cable to wear and ultimately result in a short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Examine B+ cable for chafing damage and repair or renew as appropriate.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL It is possible that the steering drag link end ball joint nut may not have been torqued to the correct specification. This can lead to a loosening of the nut and in extreme cases detachment of the joint with the associated loss of control of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and check torque of drag link end nut. If loose replace nut and torque to the correct specification.

volvo.defect: DURING CAB TILT CAB COULD FALL WITHOUT ANY DAMPING There is a potential risk of an internal oil leakage in the cab tilt cylinder. As a consequence  during cab tilt the cab could fall when  over top dead centre without any damping  .
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace reservoir filler plug. Inspect tilt ram and cylinder and where necessary replace.

volvo.defect: BRAKE CALIPER CONCERN Some front brake calipers on the affected vehicles may have been manufactured using an incorrect material and may crack and leak under heavy load.
volvo.remedy: Recall potentially affected vehicles and replace all front brake calipers that are found to be in the suspect range.

volvo.defect: FRONT HUB CAP MAY COME LOOSE The front hub cap may loosen and allow the ingress of road grit and water.  Subsequent failure of the hub bearing may result.
volvo.remedy: Fit an inproved design hub cap.

volvo.defect: During driving or idle the O-Ring may become twisted or break.  Should this occur there could be an oil leak a message for low engine oil level displayed in the vehicle or an unusual smell in the cabin.  In a worst case scenario this could cause a thermal event. During driving or idle the O-Ring may become twisted or break.  Should this occur there could be an oil leak a message for low engine oil level displayed in the vehicle or an unusual smell in the cabin.  In a worst case scenario this could cause a thermal event.
volvo.remedy: Replace O-Ring

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF REAR AXLE U BOLTS The material hardness of the rear axle spring U bolts may be too high. As a consequence they could break and allow dislocation of the axle.
volvo.remedy: Check the tioghtness of the rear axle spring U bolts. If any U bolt breaks before the the specified torque is achieved all U bolts on the affected axle must be replaced.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE On effected petrol and diesel engines a spring clamp on the radiator hose connecting it to the water inlet pipe may be insecure. If not rectified the engine may lose coolant overheat seize and suddenly slow the vehicle rapidly to a halt.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to have the radiator hose adequately secured.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SUSPENSION COLLAPSE The nut securing the front suspension strut lower ball joint to the control arm may loose its axial tension due to an out tolerance condition. This could adversely affect the directional control of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Fit a modified ball joint to control arm securing nut.

volvo.defect: SELF ADJUSTING OUT OF FUNCTION IN THE BRAKE CALIPER HOUSING Self-Adjusting function in the brake caliper housing out of function.
volvo.remedy: Inspection of the brake housings and replacement if found faulty.

volvo.defect: ERRATIC ACCELERATOR BEHAVIOUR A faulty accelerator pedal sensor may cause erratic accelerator operation during operation of the accelerator pedal.This may vary between no throttle reaction to a speed greater than expected for a throttle position
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the accelerator pedal with a new variant and install an adapter wiring harness

volvo.defect: BRAKE CALIPER CONCERN Some front brake calipers on the affected vehicles may have been manufactured using an incorrect material and may crack and leak under heavy load.
volvo.remedy: Recall potentially affected vehicles and replace all front brake calipers that are found to be in the suspect range.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: ELECTRIC COOLING FAN MAY OVERHEAT Volvo have identified that due to certain climatic conditions the electric cooling fan may overheat and in extreme cases cause a fire within the engine bay.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cooling fan assembly replaced.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING The driver may experience sudden loss of power assistance to the steering due to voltage irregularities in the Electro Hydraulic Power Steering system. The driver will have to apply increased effort to steer the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download new software to the inverter which can cope with voltage spikes and/or drops.

volvo.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MODULE MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED Due to a potential manufacturing defect the gas generator in the driver�s airbag module may not deploy as intended. This may reduce the affectivities of the airbag.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag module.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF OFFSIDE REAR BRAKE CAMSHAFT It has been identified that the possibility exists that the offside rear brake camshaft may be subject to failure caused by excessive force imparted due to the upgrading of the spring brake chamber. In the event of camshaft failure braking effort will be lost at the affected wheel station.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have both rear spring brake actuators changed.

volvo.defect: ROOF HATCH MAY DETACH During production the roof hatch could have been attached incorrectly. It is possible for the roof hatch to detach and cause a risk of personal injury and vehicle damage.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary fit a new roof hatch.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY INADVERTENTLY BE ACTIVATED The non-return valve on the 4-way protection valve has been fitted in the wrong position. If there is a large leak in the main brake air feed circuit to the trailer brakes all air pressure will be lost in the parking brake circuit. The parking brake will then be activated therein locking the rear wheels on the tractor unit.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and remove the non-return valve from the inlet side to the outlet side of the 4-way protection valve.

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT - FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that on vehicles fitted with a supplementary cabin heater the unit may contain a faulty valve which links the heater to the climate control. The valve in question may become clogged which could lead to poor water drainage and in extreme cases a short circuit. Should sufficient heat be generated by the short circuit a fire behind the instrument panel below the radio may occur.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject valve replaced.

volvo.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SYSTEM CONTROL UNIT INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED TO THE CAR BODY Vehicles may have the Supplementary Restraint System (SRS) control unit incorrectly tightened to the car body.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and tighten the SRS control unit.

volvo.defect: STEERING MAY BECOME LIMITED OR BLOCKED The front suspension road spring eye mounting bolts may not have been torqued to the correct specification. During operation it is possible that the spring eye mounting bolts could work loose and unwind. This could result in the movement of the axle which could compromise the directional control of the vehicle. However the driver should become aware of the issue by noise or found by the maintenance staff during routine maintenance.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to retorque the mounting bolts.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The power steering return line may fail and cause a sudden loss of steering assistance (more input will be required by the driver to steer the vehicle) loss of power steering fluid and although unlikely there is a potential for a fire to occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fluid reservoir return hose and cooling coil.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK There is a possibility of a restriction in a T - Piece in the fuel return line which could lead to a pressure build up which could blow the pipe off with resulting leakage of fuel.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace T - Piece with quality assured type.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM ADEQUATELY Brake assistance from the vacuum pressure pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the non-return valve in the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: STEERING BALL JOINT TORQUE On some vehicles the bolts in the joint of the steering gear shafts may not be correctly torqued.
volvo.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles are being recalled to have the torque on all the bolts in the four joints in the steering shaft checked and where necessary tightened to the manufacturer's specification.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain five cylinder engines it is possible that the high pressure fuel pipes may not have been correctly installed and may leak. This should be identified by a smell of fuel from the engine bay. However it is possible that in extreme cases an engine bay fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the high pressure pipes.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: STALLING AND LOSS OF STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE Involved vehicles may have a software issue which could cause the engine to momentarily cut-out and restart while driving. This could also cause disturbances in some electrical systems such as shut down of the instrument cluster infotainment system and loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and upgrade the software of the control units.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT It is possible that the hose connection between the coolant expansion tank and the bleed hose can work loose. If this should occur then coolant will leak and air will enter the system. Under these conditions the low coolant level warning light will not function. If the vehicle is driven in this condition it will cause engine damage and in the extreme possible failure.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicle to replace the tank and bleeder hose.

volvo.defect: RISK OF OVERHEATING IN THE LCM The possibility exists that the light control module may overheat
volvo.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and upgrade the software.

volvo.defect: NEW SOFTWARE REQUIRED TO IMPROVE THE EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient emissions control and monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software

volvo.defect: A SOFTWARE ERROR MAY PREVENT THE ENGINE CONTROL MODULE FROM STARTING THE ENGINE The Engine Control Module (ECM) may prevent the combustion engine from starting.�
volvo.remedy: Download updated software.

volvo.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MODULE MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED Due to a potential manufacturing defect the gas generator in the driver�s airbag module may not deploy as intended. This may reduce the affectivities of the airbag.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag module.

volvo.defect: INADEQUATE WELDING OF TOWBAR On some towbars manufactured within a specified period the welding between the ball unit brackets and the crossmember may be defective. In extreme cases this could result in trailer detachment.
volvo.remedy: Recall all 850 models which have been fitted with towbars and check if the towbar is within the affected range. Where it is established that this is the case the towbar assembly will be replaced with a quality assured unit.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been identified that internal leakage of the brake master cylinder could occur. Should this be the case the driver may experience reduced braking performance whilst applying and maintaining force on the brake pedal.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake master cylinder inspected and possibly replaced. At the same time the brake fluid reservoir will be checked and the affected pipes cleansed.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE TRAILER DETACHMENT It has been identified that in adverse conditions the securing pin of the coupling release handle can become unfastened due to an oversize drilling. Loss of the pin can result in the coupling not being securely fastened.
volvo.remedy: Operators will be sent a repair kit to secure the pin. In addition a work method advising as to the pre-driving checks that need to be carried out.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING  THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
volvo.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: POWER STEERING MAY BE AFFECTED The hydraulic servo pipe can become loose from its connection which could leak and lead to the loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to reposition the hydraulic servo hose.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF UPPER STEERING ARM The screws securing the upper steering arm may have been overtightened damaging the threads of the screws and the threads in the steering arm knuckle. In the worst case situation a loss of steering control could result.
volvo.remedy: Remove the screws from the steering arm knuckle and examine the threads on both components for damage. Fit new bolts in all cases and new steering arms when the threads in the knuckle are found to be damaged.

volvo.defect: THE SEAT BELT CATCH COULD BECOME DETACHED IN A COLLISION SITUATION There is a possibility that the thread insert which attaches the seat belt catch to the power seat slide rail may not have been manufactured to the vehicle makers standards.
volvo.remedy: Recall all potentially affected vehicles for inspection and replacement of the thread inserts as required.

volvo.defect: SELF ADJUSTING OUT OF FUNCTION IN THE BRAKE CALIPER HOUSING Self-Adjusting function in the brake caliper housing out of function.
volvo.remedy: Inspection of the brake housings and replacement if found faulty.

volvo.defect: During driving or idle the O-Ring may become twisted or break.  Should this occur there could be an oil leak a message for low engine oil level displayed in the vehicle or an unusual smell in the cabin.  In a worst case scenario this could cause a thermal event. During driving or idle the O-Ring may become twisted or break.  Should this occur there could be an oil leak a message for low engine oil level displayed in the vehicle or an unusual smell in the cabin.  In a worst case scenario this could cause a thermal event.
volvo.remedy: Replace O-Ring

volvo.defect: PRESSURE IN THE FUEL TANK COULD CAUSE THE FUEL LEVEL SENDER TO INDICATE FUEL IN THE TANK WHEN IT COULD BE EMPTY Pressure in the fuel tank could cause the fuel level sender to indicate fuel in the tank when it could be empty.
volvo.remedy: Update software which will allow the electronic fuel tank ventilation valve to release pressure when required.

volvo.defect: THROTTLE MECHANISM MAY NOT RETURN TO IDLE POSITION. Under extreme climatic conditions eg low ambient temperature combined with high air humidity ice crystals may form in the crankcase ventilation system which includes the throttle housing. Should this condition occur ice build up may prevent the throttle from fully closing.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified throttle housing and a new vent hose.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.�
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software.�

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF AIR DEFLECTORS Due to poor bonding it is possible that the side air deflectors on the cab rear wall may become detached.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace air deflectors.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models.. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: SLIDING FIFTH WHEEL MAY MOVE INADVERTENTLY It has been identified that the near and offside locking plunger fixing bolts may have been incorrectly located. Should this be the case the fifth wheel would not be correctly locked to the slider frame.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked for correct fitment with the fifth wheel being changed if this is not the case.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL The crankshaft may not have been sufficiently hardened and may fail this in turn can lead to sudden and catastrophic engine failure. The failure may be preceded by loss of power and a knocking noise.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: CHILD RESTRAINT ANCHOR BRACKET CONCERN The bolts securing the child restraint anchor bracket to the rear floor at the right hand side may have been insufficiently tightened. If an ISOFIX type child restraint is fitted to this bracket it may be insecure.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and tighten the anchor bracket bolts where necessary.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY NOT MEET STANDARD ECE R55 WHERE A TOWING HOOK MUST HAVE AN ATTACHMENT FOR THE SAFETY WIRE Vehicle may not meet standard ECE R55 where a towing hook must also have an attachment for the safety wire.
volvo.remedy: Add attachment for safety wire.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: WIRING HARNESS MAY CHAFE ON STEERING COLUMN When turning the steering wheel the electrical wiring cable harness can chafe on the steering column.  In the worst case a short circuit may occur.
volvo.remedy: Examine harness for chafing damage and repair or renew as appropriate.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: TOWING EYE MAY NOT BE CAPABLE OF BEING CORRECTLY FITTED It has been identified that the front bumper energy absorber may be partially covering the aperture through which the towing eye is fixed. Customers will discover that it is not possible to fit the towing eye following removal of the bumper towing eye cover.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have a section of the bumper energy absorbing material removed thus allowing full access to the towing eye aperture.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER WHILST DRIVING Possible loss of power whilst driving.
volvo.remedy: Vehicles must have updated software downloaded.

volvo.defect: POOR CABLE TERMINAL CRIMPS The cable terminal crimps in the rear plate terminal block and battery box fuse block may be inadequate. The nut securing the ring cable terminal (terminal block) may also be insufficiently tight.
volvo.remedy: Check the crimps by pulling the specified cables.  Repair where necessary by undoing and re crimping or soldering.  Tighten ring cable terminal securing nut where necessary.

volvo.defect: CRACKING OF SEAT BELT BUCKLE The steel braided tether of the seat belt buckle is being deformed which can cause it to crack. This can occur as the seats are being moved on the sliding rail. At the same time the tether can be caught and pinched under the seat frames.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for inspection and replacement of either the complete seat belt or the seat belt buckle depending on the type of seat fitted.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT A fault exists in the light control module software (LCM) which could cause the LCM to overheat and result in a short circuit in the electrical system.
volvo.remedy: Replace the light control module.

volvo.defect: PARKING HEATER DOES NOT COMPLY WITH ADR SPECIFICATION The parking heater has not been fitted with a short duration timer to reduce the fire risk when carrying volatile loads.
volvo.remedy: Fit a short duration timing device to the heater system.

volvo.defect: ENGINE START DISABLE FUNCTION MAY WORK INCORRECTLY A software problem can lead to the rear start disable button working incorrectly and allow the engine to crank when it should not.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and perform a software update.

volvo.defect: AUXILIARY DRIVE BELT MAY DETACH The Auxiliary Belt Tensioner may fail resulting in loss of Power Assisted Steeering and loss of Drive
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to replace the Tensioner and Drive Belt.

volvo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It has been identified that a number of fuel pressure pipes may have a defect which could result in a fuel leakage. Although it can be identified by the smell of fuel it is possible although unlikely that an external heat source could ignite the fuel so resulting in a fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected for inspection of fuel pressure line and replacement if required.

volvo.defect: EXHAUST SLEEVE MAY DETACH It has been established that the securing process for the exhaust tail pipe sleeve may not be to specification and result in the tail pipe sleeve detaching. This could cause an issue for other road users.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and secure the exhaust tail pipe sleeve.

volvo.defect: POWER STEERING PIPE MAY LEAK. It has been established that the material in the power steering return line hose has not been manufactured to specification.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hose inspected and replaced as necessary.

volvo.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED Brake servo assistance from the vacuum pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a modified non-return valve to the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component
volvo.remedy: Check and If found then replacement of Silencer.

volvo.defect: FAULTY SOFTWARE INSTALLED IN ENGINE ECU Engine speed maybe reduced to idle without warning due to faulty software in the ECU.
volvo.remedy: Re programme the ECU with new software.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MALFUNCTION LIGHT MAY ILLUMINATE On petrol engined vehicles it has been found that the PCV (Positive Crank Ventilation) nipple may crack or become loose resulting in an air leak. This could cause a whistling sound and may cause the engine malfunction lamp to operate.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the PCV nipple.

volvo.defect: SPLIT PIN MAY BE MISSING FROM DRAG LINK SECURING NUT. A split pin may be missing from the steering drag link ball joint castle nut which could subsequently loosen.
volvo.remedy: Recall and examine the affected vehicles. If a split pin is found to be missing implement the repair procedure specified by the vehicle manufacturer.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT A fault exists in the light control module software (LCM) which could cause the LCM to overheat and result in a short circuit in the electrical system.
volvo.remedy: Replace the light control module.

volvo.defect: STEERING BALL JOINT TORQUE On some vehicles the bolts in the joint of the steering gear shafts may not be correctly torqued.
volvo.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles are being recalled to have the torque on all the bolts in the four joints in the steering shaft checked and where necessary tightened to the manufacturer's specification.

volvo.defect: RISK OF FIRE There is a possibility of a thermal malfunction on the fuel filter water separator bowl with the heater. This can result in overheating due to low fuel level in combination with a faulty thermostat in the water separator bowl
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles fit heat shield and check/reconnect cable in the electrical connector on the fuel filter/water separator housing

volvo.defect: INCORRECT BRAKING SYSTEM FLUID The subject vehicles have been equipped with incorrect braking system fluid which may overheat and cause vapour locking.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles purge the braking system of the incorrect brake fluid and refill with fluid of the correct specification.

volvo.defect: CRACKING OF REAR SUSPENSION VEE STAYS Instances of cracking on the tube section of the rear suspension vee stays have occurred.
volvo.remedy: The vee stays on affected vehicles are being inspected for cracks by Volvo dealers. Where there is no evidence of cracking the stays will be strengthened by the fitment of re-inforcing clamps. In cases where cracking has occurred this will be repaired

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY MOVE FORWARD WHEN ENGAGING REVERSE GEAR There is a possibility that the vehicle may move forward when reverse gear is engaged due to a defect in the gearbox software program.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-program gearbox software.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX SHIELD MAY OVERHEAT It is possible for the gearbox noise shield  to come in contact with a high temperature heat source such as the exhaust pipe.  This could under special driving conditions lead to smoke and glow from the gearbox noise shield. There will be no fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the gearbox noise shield.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL The ball joint of the steering link rod may detach due to wear between the pin and the housing leading to loss of directional control
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace link rod with new version

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE BLOCKAGE OF INJECTION PUMP CONTROL ROD On a specific batch of fuel injection pump pressure valve retainers the bottom washer may come undone. This would cause the valve to drop on to the pump element and in extreme cases fragments may block the control rod.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the original pressure valve retainers with quality assured examples.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Under certain circumstances there might be water ingress into the control unit of the overnight/parking heater which may cause a short circuit.  In extreme circumstances it may result in a fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the control unit with a quality assured component.

volvo.defect: HUB BEARING MAY FAIL Water and dirt can penetrate into the trailing axle hub which can lead to severe damage and eventual failure of the hub bearings
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a deflector to the axle hub mounting. Inspect the bearings hubs and axle for damage. Replace parts where necessary.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT It is possible that the hose connection between the coolant expansion tank and the bleed hose can work loose. If this should occur then coolant will leak and air will enter the system. Under these conditions the low coolant level warning light will not function. If the vehicle is driven in this condition it will cause engine damage and in the extreme possible failure.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicle to replace the tank and bleeder hose.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK There is a possibility of a restriction in a T - Piece in the fuel return line which could lead to a pressure build up which could blow the pipe off with resulting leakage of fuel.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace T - Piece with quality assured type.

volvo.defect: A FAILING ESS HEATER RELAY CAN CAUSE AN UNEXPECTED HEAT DEVELOPMENT AND CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGE TO ELECTRIC WIRING A failing ESS heater relay can cause an unexpected heat development and consequential damage to electrical wiring.
volvo.remedy: Carry out a replacement of the ESS Heater relay with a modified version.

volvo.defect: COOLANT LEAKAGE MAY RESULT IN A FIRE It has been identified that during the engine warm-up process and under certain driving/climate conditions for instance periods of high acceleration or high engine load immediately after a cold start in cold climates there is the possibility for coolant leakage or oil seepage. This can lead to the possibility in a worst-case scenario of smoke or a slow developing fire in the engine compartment. However the driver will receive a warning message on the Driver�s Information Module indicating a low coolant level.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to modify the coolant bypass valve and install a new exhaust manifold gasket.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL On affected vehicles   nuts securing the draglink(s) may not have been tightened to the correct specification during production. There is a risk that a drag link could detach and steering control would be lost.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles check tighness of securing nuts and if necessary tighten to correct specification.

volvo.defect: A SETTING OF THE SOFTWARE PARAMETER FOR THE REMOTE DRIVE EXTERNAL PARKING BRAKE REQUEST IS SET TO AN ERRONEOUS VALUE A setting of the software parameter for the remote drive external parking brake request is set to an erroneous value.
volvo.remedy: Software update.

volvo.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY BE INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED It has been identified there is a possibility that during production the split pin for the brake pedal cross shaft may not have been correctly  installed. This could result in the reduction of braking effort due to the movement of the cross shaft.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required fit a split pin or further secure the currently installed split pin.

volvo.defect: AUXILIARY DRIVE BELT MAY DETACH The Auxiliary Belt Tensioner may fail resulting in loss of Power Assisted Steeering and loss of Drive
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to replace the Tensioner and Drive Belt.

volvo.defect: DRIVER'S  AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED The driver's airbag inflator may rupture due to uncontrolled burning of propellant. As a consequence violent deployment of the airbag may cause injuries to occupants.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and replace the driver's air bag where necessary.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SOFTWARE ISSUE IN THE VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY MODULE (VCM) There may be a software issue in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.
volvo.remedy: Upgrade software in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There could be a sudden and unexpected failure of the bottom end of the engine because of a non-conformity during production of the connecting rods.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the engine.

volvo.defect: BOLTS IN THE BATTERY DISCONNECT UNIT ARE NOT TORQUED TO SPECIFICATION Bolts in the Battery Disconnect Unit (BDU) [a component of the High Voltage (HV) Battery] are not torqued according to specification and a bolt may come loose.
volvo.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery

volvo.defect: STEERING ARM MAY FRACTURE Upper steering arm may fracture where bolted to stub axle. (Left hand drive vehicles only)
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the upper steering arm with a quality assured unit.

volvo.defect: TEMPERATURE WARNING SYSTEM MAY NOT PROVIDE A WARNING WHEN INTENDED Temperature warning system for the third alternator may not provide a warning when intended.
volvo.remedy: Check if the temperature sensor is in correct position and adjust if required.

volvo.defect: CEM SOFTWARE MAY MALFUNCTION A software issue within the Central Electronic Module (CEM) may cause the left hand (nearside) rear light to stop functioning. This will result in the illumination of a warning light on the instrument panel.
volvo.remedy: Recall all effected vehicles to install new upgraded software into the CEM.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
volvo.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

volvo.defect: TOO LITTLE OR MISSING CLEARANCE FROM HYDRAULIC OIL PRESSURE HOSE TOWARDS FRAME MEMBER Too little or missing clearance from hydraulic oil pressure hose towards frame member causing chaffing and oil leakage.
volvo.remedy: Adjust hose clearance to ensure chaffing is avoided with the engine running.
