volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software.

volvo.defect: THE INJECTOR PUMP DELIVERY VALVE RETAINERS MAY FRACTURE RESULTING IN FUEL LEAKAGE The fuel delivery valve retainers may fracture. This may result in fuel mist being emitted in to the engine compartment and presenting a fire risk
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for the fitment of quality controlled delivery valve retainers

volvo.defect: A SOFTWARE ERROR MAY PREVENT THE ENGINE CONTROL MODULE FROM STARTING THE ENGINE The Engine Control Module (ECM) may prevent the combustion engine from starting.�
volvo.remedy: Download updated software.

volvo.defect: TRIM PANEL MAY CAUSE INJURY DURING COLLISION Volvo's quality follow-up procedures have identified an issue with a limited number of S60 & V60 Volvos (MY2013). The securing screws for the inner A-pillar panels may have been torqued incorrectly. This could cause the A-pillar panels to crack and this may affect the attachment of the trims during a collision should the inflatable curtain be activated. If the trims become detached they could cause injury to the occupants in the front seats. The corrective action is to replace both A-pillar trims as well as the securing screws.
volvo.remedy: Replace both trim panels and screws.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: CRACKING IN THE HEAT EXCHANGER A crack in the heat exchanger caused by high pressure peaks in the heating system may result in coolant entering the body-builder electrical centre.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for signs of coolant loss and fitted with a shield to protect the electrical centre.

volvo.defect: SEATBELT MAY SEPARATE FROM THE BUCKLE It has been identified there is a possibility the front seatbelt buckle stud may not have been punched correctly during production. This may result in a separation between the buckle and seatbelt bracket if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the seatbelt buckle and if required to replace the seatbelt buckle.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF CONTROL On affected vehicles   nuts securing the draglink(s) may not have been tightened to the correct specification during production. There is a risk that a drag link could detach and steering control would be lost.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles check tighness of securing nuts and if necessary tighten to correct specification.

volvo.defect: WHEEL MAY BECOME LOOSE It has been identified that the standard wheel securing bolts may not have undergone the correct hardening process. This will result in corrosion a noise and/or vibration. If this condition is not rectified there is a possibility that the wheel may become loose and detach.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the standard wheel bolts.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A TOO SHORT DISTANCE BETWEEN EXHAUST OUTLET AND THE RIGHT HAND FIRST DRIVEN AXLE BRAKE CHAMBER There is a too short distance between exhaust outlet and the right-hand first driven axle brake chamber.
volvo.remedy: A new design and installation of the exhaust end pipe will be implemented.

volvo.defect: THE ELECTRIC PUMP INVERTER SHUTS OFF WHEN THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED OFF EVEN IF THE VEHICLE IS MOVING The Electric Steering Pump inverter shuts off when the ignition is switched off even if the vehicle is moving.
volvo.remedy: Change to wiring to keep the EHPS function on when the vehicle is moving with ignition switched off.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: INCORRECT SEAT BOLTS FITTED It is possible that the wrong specification mounting bolts have been used on the passenger seat floor slider. If involved in an accident/collision it is extremely possible that the bolts could fail and result in detachment of the seat.
volvo.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicle to check the mounting bolt and replace if required.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner can suffer from premature wear which may cause it to fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: DIESEL FUEL MAY DILUTE ENGINE OIL A brass plug in the fuel injector body may come loose. If this happens diesel fuel will dilute engine oil. An increase in exhaust smoke may occur. There is also a possibility that oil and fuel would vent through the breather pipe to atmosphere.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check or replace fuel injectors.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component
volvo.remedy: Check and If found then replacement of Silencer.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX HEAT SHIELD IS NOT AS PER SPECIFICATION The incorrect gearbox heat shield has been assembled which does not fulfil the manufacturers demand regarding fire resistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the heat shield.

volvo.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY IN A COLLISION It has been identified that the wiring harness for the SRS system may not have been correctly attached to the front seat frames. It is possible that continued adjustment of the seat position may cause the harness to become detached. If this should occur a warning light will illuminate on the instrument panel warning the driver of a fault with the SRS system.  However in this condition the front and side airbags may not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for an inspection of the wiring harnesses and ensure that it is correctly routed and secured.  If not then reroute and securing of the wiring harness.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE JAMMING OF THROTTLE A plastic clip may have been left in the engine air inlet hose during initial assembly. Should this clip be drawn into the throttle housing it may cause the throttle to jam.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the engine air inlet hose removing the clip (if present).

volvo.defect: TRIM PANEL MAY CAUSE INJURY DURING COLLISION Volvo's quality follow-up procedures have identified an issue with a limited number of S60 & V60 Volvos (MY2013). The securing screws for the inner A-pillar panels may have been torqued incorrectly. This could cause the A-pillar panels to crack and this may affect the attachment of the trims during a collision should the inflatable curtain be activated. If the trims become detached they could cause injury to the occupants in the front seats. The corrective action is to replace both A-pillar trims as well as the securing screws.
volvo.remedy: Replace both trim panels and screws.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software.

volvo.defect: THE WIND SCREEN WIPER MIGHT STOP WORKING ON THE TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH RAIN SENSOR There is a risk that the wind screen wiper might stop working.
volvo.remedy: Update vehicle software and replace the wiper relay.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY APPLY UNINTENTIONALLY The brake pipe unions (Air Nipples) on the parking/hand brake system have been tightened above the specified torque setting.  This could result in the unions failing and cause an unintentional deployment of the parking/hand brake.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles where the unions will be replaced and the correct torque setting applied.

volvo.defect: INCORRECT OIL PAN FITTED It has been established that on certain vehicles fitted with an MDE5 engine they may have been delivered with a lower volume oil pan during production.  There is a risk of the sump being overfilled with oil. This could result in either the engine suffering a runaway due to it consuming its own oil or the Catalytic Converter can be contaminated which will affect the exhaust emissions.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the oil pan and dip stick also to update the Engine Management System (EMS) software.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: ENGINE COOLING FAN MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a software issue with the engine cooling fan control module the air conditioning performance may be reduced and the engine coolant temperature may increase. This will result in warning messages being displayed.  In extreme cases if the driver does not heed the warnings the engine may fail.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cooling fan control module replaced.

volvo.defect: SLIDING FIFTH WHEEL MAY MOVE INADVERTENTLY It has been identified that the near and offside locking plunger fixing bolts may have been incorrectly located. Should this be the case the fifth wheel would not be correctly locked to the slider frame.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts checked for correct fitment with the fifth wheel being changed if this is not the case.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER SEAT MAY NOT BE FITTED CORRECTLY It is possible that the driver's and passenger's front powered seats may not be fitted with the front stop lug. The lug restricts the movement of the seats and if not fitted it is possible to position the seats too far forward or backwards. This could increase the chances of injury should the vehicle be involved in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect for fitment of the lugs and if found to be missing fit new lugs.

volvo.defect: BATTERY MAY OVERHEAT Garmin have identified that certain model Nuvi portable navigation products fitted with a specific battery and printed circuit board design can under rare circumstances overheat.  This could result in a unit fire.
volvo.remedy: Volvo are assisting Garmin by writing to all owners who may have these units and requesting then to check their unit's serial number against information contained on Garmin's website.  If an affected unit is identified then return the unit to Garmin for the replacement of the battery.

volvo.defect: Screws that attach the front axle to the suspension may require tightening Potential that the screws for the front axle attachment might lose torque or come loose.
volvo.remedy: Apply correct torque value on concerned screws and/or replace defected parts.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: Dependent on affected Model update software. Until updated the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: STARTER MOTOR HEATSHIELD MAY BREAK OFF The starter motor heatshield may break off.
volvo.remedy: Replace the starter motor heatshield with a new version.

volvo.defect: LEAKAGE OF FUEL A particular batch of injectors may be of poor quality and allow fuel to leak on to the engine with a subsequent risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject injectors replaced with quality assured units.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY INCREASE WITHOUT WARNING. It is possible that the engine oil level may rise above its maximum level due to overfilling and/or dilution by fuel. This may result in the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal has been released. In extreme cases it is possible that the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and carry out an Engine Control Module software upgrade and adjust the engine oil.  The new ECM upgrade will improve adaption of different blends of fuel and include a dashboard text warning message if the oil level reaches too high a level.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: BRAKE PEDAL OPERATION MAY REQUIRE HIGHER PEDAL PRESSURE Under certain circumstances it is necessary to use a higher then normal brake pedal pressure in order to bring the vehicle to a halt. The existence of the fault or otherwise depending on the availability of a signal in the I-shift which reduces and disengages the drive torque.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will receive updated software tailored to the control unit fitted.

volvo.defect: CRACKS MAY DEVELOP AT THE CARRYING HANDLE PIVOT POINT. Cracks may occur at the carrying handle pivot point of the ISOFIX 3 - 10 kg child seat.  This could cause the handle to become detached from the seat.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected seats give a refund or replace with a new seat.  (If the customer wishes to continue to use the child seat until the child has outgrown the sea the handle will be removed).

volvo.defect: Seatbelt Torsion Bar For affected vehicles there is a potential defect in the torsion bar within the front seatbelt system.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of the affected seat belts.

volvo.defect: C0472 - HPCU SW update. FHE/FME/FMLE (4) On affected vehicles there is a risk for an unexpected acceleration in Heavy-Duty battery-electric trucks that use gearbox mounted power take-off and use it in non-stationary applications.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software to the Hybrid Powertrain Control Unit (HPCU).

volvo.defect: C0390 FAS parameter update FH FM FHE FME 4 There is a risk that the warnings and deactivation when the driver is not holding the steering wheel that is mandatory according to legal requirements do not occur when using the Pilot Assist System.
volvo.remedy: Update software to the latest level.

volvo.defect: C0390 FAS parameter update FH FM FHE FME 4 There is a risk that the warnings and deactivation when the driver is not holding the steering wheel that is mandatory according to legal requirements do not occur when using the Pilot Assist System.
volvo.remedy: Update software to the latest level.

volvo.defect: C0390 FAS parameter update FH FM FHE FME 4 There is a risk that the warnings and deactivation when the driver is not holding the steering wheel that is mandatory according to legal requirements do not occur when using the Pilot Assist System.
volvo.remedy: Update software to the latest level.

volvo.remedy: A Volvo retailer will check and if necessary tighten the rod to correct specification.

volvo.defect: ​C0506 - HPCU SW update. FHE/FME/FMLE (4) (Phase 1) / C0520 IRMU replace. FHE/FME (4) (Phase 2) / C0521 IRMU replace FHE/FME/FMLE (4) / FLE/FEE (3) (Phase 3)​ On affected vehicles the AC inlet socket and the power outlet for body builder equipment might be incorrectly energized. Therefore in vehicles where AC or DC power outlets are installed there might be voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present inside the AC inlet socket when the power outlet is active. Also when AC charging there might be a voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present on the power outlet.
volvo.remedy: The insulation monitoring device (IMD) will be replaced by an upgraded version a residual current device (RCPF sensor) will be installed inside the insulation resistance measurement unit and the OCEPS software will be updated. For vehicles built after 2025w21 until 2025w37 will also have the EMC filter reinstalled.

volvo.remedy: Replace faulty park brake valve.

volvo.defect: C0367 HPCU SW UPDATE FHE FME4 There is a risk that some screw joints inside the traction voltage batteries might not have been tightened according to our assembly process.
volvo.remedy: Update a software that can detect potential loose screw joints. It will then disconnect the suspect battery and prevent any incident.

volvo.defect: C0367 HPCU SW UPDATE FHE FME4 There is a risk that some screw joints inside the traction voltage batteries might not have been tightened according to our assembly process.

volvo.defect: GEARSHIFT STOPS WORKING Gearshift stops working.
volvo.remedy: Fit additional spring pin for the Control Cylinder.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: FUEL LINES MAY CHAFE IN CLAMPS. The fuel hoses' plastic clamps may wear through the hoses and cause a fuel leak.
volvo.remedy: Replace any wear damaged fuel hoses and fit new hose clamps. Additionally install a vent pipe in the fuel supply system.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE ENGINE BAY FIRE It has been identified that on subject vehicles the engine cooling fan module could under certain operating conditions develop a short circuit caused by water intrusion. This in rare circumstances could result in an engine bay fire.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a water shield and a cable harness with a relay in order to control the engine cooling fan module power supply.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY MOVE FORWARD WHEN REVERSE GEAR ENGAGED There is a possibility that the vehicle concerned has been delivered with a defect in the software program which could result in the vehicle moving forward when engaging reverse gear.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicle and reprogramme software. At the same time further upgrades will be carried out to the accelerator pedal.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING FLUID MAY CAUSE A FIRE A joint on the high pressure line of the power assisted steering may not have been assembled correctly.  This may lead to a leakage of steering fluid into the engine bay.  This could result in sudden loss of power assistance but in extreme cases it could result in a localised fire within the engine bay.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles  to check and if required torque the unit up to the correct specification.

volvo.defect: TURBO PRESSURE HOSE MAY LEAK It has been identified that due to an issue with the crimping process during production the turbo pressure hose may leak. In extreme circumstances it its possible that an oil leak could occur which could result in a risk of a fire if the oil comes into contact with a hot surface.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the turbo pressure hose.

volvo.defect: INTERNAL CONTACT FAILURE INSIDE THE WIPER SYSTEM MOTORS CAN CAUSE ISSUES WITH THE SYNCHRONISATION Synchronized wipers may fail and become stuck.
volvo.remedy: Check Wiper motors and replace if within the affected range.

volvo.defect: WIRE OF SEAT BELT BUCKLE CAN RUB AGAINST THE PLASTIC COVER Wire of seat belt buckle can rub against the plastic cover.
volvo.remedy: Replace affected buckle for new designed buckle.

volvo.defect: TORQUE REDUCTION VALUE LABEL MISSING ON ENGINE It has been identified that the engine information label does not indicate the torque reduction value.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicle will have the plate replaced.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL DEFECTIVE SELF-ADJUSTER FUNCTION IN THE BRAKE CALIPER HOUSING Possible defective self-adjuster function in the brake caliper housing.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace the caliper brake housing on affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MALFUNCTION LIGHT MAY ILLUMINATE On petrol engined vehicles it has been found that the PCV (Positive Crank Ventilation) nipple may crack or become loose resulting in an air leak. This could cause a whistling sound and may cause the engine malfunction lamp to operate.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the PCV nipple.

volvo.defect: HANDBRAKE MAY NOT APPLY CORRECTLY Due to an inadequate hardening process it is possible that the pawl plate in the top of the handbrake valve can be subjected to premature wear. This can in extremes affect the operation of the handbrake and possible result in a vehicle roll away.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the handbrake valve.

volvo.defect: STALLING AND LOSS OF STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE Involved vehicles may have a software issue which could cause the engine to momentarily cut-out and restart while driving. This could also cause disturbances in some electrical systems such as shut down of the instrument cluster infotainment system and loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and upgrade the software of the control units.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SOFTWARE ISSUE IN THE VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY MODULE (VCM) There may be a software issue in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.
volvo.remedy: Upgrade software in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX HEAT SHIELD IS NOT AS PER SPECIFICATION The incorrect gearbox heat shield has been assembled which does not fulfil the manufacturers demand regarding fire resistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the heat shield.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: Dependent on affected Model update software. Until updated the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: CAB MAY FALL BACK OR OVER WHEN TILTING It has been identified that the lower attachment bolt for the cab tilting ram may have been torqued to too high a torque specification. This can result in the bolt becoming stretched which could cause a breakage of the bolt and the cab may either fall backwards or right forwards whilst it is being tilted.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the lower cab attachment bolt and torque to the correct specification.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY RUN ON It is possible in certain circumstances for the engine oil level to rise above the maximum level. This situation could lead to engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In extreme cases the engine could continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to adjust the engine oil level and carry out a software upgrade.

volvo.defect: ELECTRIC COOLING FAN MAY OVERHEAT Volvo have identified that due to certain climatic conditions the electric cooling fan may overheat and in extreme cases cause a fire within the engine bay.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cooling fan assembly replaced.

volvo.defect: WHEEL MAY BECOME LOOSE It has been identified that the standard wheel securing bolts may not have undergone the correct hardening process. This will result in corrosion a noise and/or vibration. If this condition is not rectified there is a possibility that the wheel may become loose and detach.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the standard wheel bolts.

volvo.defect: THE SEAT ATTACHMENT RAILS MAY IN CERTAIN CASES LACK THE STIPULATED EXTRA RIVETS AT THE END OF EACH RAIL The seat attachment rails may lack the stipulated extra rivets at the end of each rail.
volvo.remedy: Check the assembly and install additional rivets as required.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE CAN BE DRIVEN WITHOUT THE DRIVER KNOWING THE MIDDLE DOOR IS OPEN It has been identified that in certain cases the driver is able to manoeuvre the vehicle with the middle door open without a visual or audible warning. Risk of the vehicle being driven with the middle door open.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and apply software updates to the Instrument Cluster and Body Builder Module to warn the driver when the middle door is open. At speeds below 5 km/h the �Any door open� icon and CHECK lamp are illuminated and at speeds above 5 km/h the �Any door open� icon STOP lamp and audible buzzer are activated.

volvo.defect: THE EGR OIL HOSE IS NOT TO CORRECT GEOMETRY SPECIFICATION The EGR oil hose is not according to specification regarding geometry.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of the EGR oil hose between the EGR valve and the oil filter housing

volvo.defect: SEAT BELT BUCKLE RUBBING AGAINST PLASTIC SEAT COVER On affected vehicles in certain circumstances the drivers seat belt buckle (steel rope) is rubbing against the plastic seat cover which may result in damage to the wire. In the event of an accident there is a risk the seat belt buckle steel rope could break.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the seat belt buckle and in the case of damage replace accordingly.

volvo.defect: FUSE BOX CONNECTIONS INSECURE The flange nut can seize on the thread of the studs in the fuse box which could mean the terminals do not have the correct torque and may be loose. This could cause arcing.
volvo.remedy: Check fuse box; Replace all fuse box cable flange nuts to new correct type nuts and tighten to correct torque. If necessary replace the fuse box

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE It has been identified that there is the possibility of a risk of an internal electrical short circuit in some cab interior lamps. In the worst situation this could result in a vehicle fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to fit additional fuses into the system.

volvo.defect: PRESSURE IN THE FUEL TANK COULD CAUSE THE FUEL LEVEL SENDER TO INDICATE FUEL IN THE TANK WHEN IT COULD BE EMPTY Pressure in the fuel tank could cause the fuel level sender to indicate fuel in the tank when it could be empty.
volvo.remedy: Update software which will allow the electronic fuel tank ventilation valve to release pressure when required.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models.. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING FLUID It is possible that the upper power steering return line may become detached which will result in the loss of power steering fluid.  This will result in fluid leaking onto the road surface leaking into the engine bay and the driver experiencing heavy steering.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the replacement of the power steering return line.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL The material of the steering arm bolts may not be to specification. As a result the bolts could crack and if not rectified the bolts could eventually fail totally causing loss of directional control.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering arm bolts.

volvo.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE Investigations have identified the wiper arm mechanism may chafe against the brake booster vacuum line. If this chafing occurs it could lead to a gradual reduction of the power assisted braking and more effort would need to be applied to the brake pedal than usual to slow the vehicle down. In a worst case the reduction of braking assistance could occur suddenly without any prior warning
volvo.remedy: Inspect the brake booster vacuum line. If it is chafed then it should be replaced and routed correctly. If the line is not chafed it should re-routed to ensure no issues going forward.

volvo.defect: TWO NUTS ON THE BRAKE BOOSTER HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED WITH INSUFFICIENT TORQUE Two nuts on the Brake Booster have been assembled with insufficient torque.
volvo.remedy: Replace the existing two nuts with two locks nuts assembled with the correct torque.

volvo.defect: Rivets attaching certain ventilation windows to the main frame of the vehicle side windows may be subject to fatigue and fail. Rivets attaching certain ventilation windows to the main frame of the vehicle side windows may be subject to fatigue and fail.
volvo.remedy: Inspect the affected windows and where required replace the rivets using a revised variant.

volvo.defect: THE THROTTLE CONTROL BALL JOINT. The throttle control ball joint may break away from the fuel injection pump lever and cause the engine to jump to full revs.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and reposition the throttle linkage connections. Renew any worn throttle control ball joints.

volvo.defect: EMERGENCY BRAKING SYSTEM MAY FUNCTION WITHOUT WARNING The Automatic Emergency Brake System (AEBS) may in certain traffic situations activate itself
volvo.remedy: Update the AEBS software

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE MATERIAL DEFECT WHICH COULD REDUCE THE LIFE EXPECTANCY OF THE TOWING HOOK Possible material defect which could reduce the life expectancy of the Towing Hook.
volvo.remedy: Replace Towing hook for later version.

volvo.defect: REAR WHEELS MAY LOOSEN It has been identified that on the subject vehicles the rear wheel studs may be of an incorrect size. This in rare cases may during particular forms of low speed manoeuvring result in the wheel becoming loose.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear wheel studs inspected and changed to a modified type as necessary.

volvo.defect: WEIGHT INFORMATION PRODUCT LABEL INCORRECTLY It has been identified that the product label fitted to the inside of the right hand door pillar does not contain any weight information
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles will have a replacement label affixed.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
volvo.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

volvo.defect: BATTERY GROUND CABLE MAY SHORT CIRCUIT The battery positive cable may be in  conflict with the starter motor solenoid. If a conflict does develop a short circuit of the battery ground cable will occur. This may result in smoke appearing from under the bonnet or a failure to start with warning lamps illuminated.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the distance between the battery positive cable checked and adjusted if the clearance is less than 4mm.

volvo.defect: OIL FROM THE TURBO CHARGER BEARINGS CAN PASS OVER THE COMPRESSOR SIDE OF THE TURBO AND INTO THE ENGINE AIR INTAKE A risk of an unwanted engine acceleration or an engine failure due to a hydraulic lock caused by oil from the turbo charger bearings passing over to the compressor side of the turbo.
volvo.remedy: Replace the turbocharger before oil carry over becomes critical. Increase engine idle speed to 650 rpm modify idle shutdown to 5 minutes at above 40 C and replace the DPF differential pressure sensor.

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the main switch can crack which can cause an electrical short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have initially had the subject switch disconnected.  However an exchange switch has now been mae availagble to all customers who require it and will be fitted free of charge.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX  MAY NOT ENGAGE OR SHIFT GEARS AS INTENDED It has been identified that due to internal leakage the gearbox hydraulic control module may not be able to engage or shift gears as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the gearbox replaced.

volvo.defect: INSUFFICIENT SEALING MAY CAUSE CORROSION ON THE BALL JOINT Insufficient sealing may cause corrosion of the ball joint which leads to premature wear of the rear axle V stay
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and if necessary replace ball joint.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF ENGINE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM The engine management system could possibly continue to use the the last received data from the vehicle ECU. For example in the event of a datalink short  the vehicle may not switch to limp home  mode but continue to respond to the last received command from either the throttle or   cruise control.
volvo.remedy: Re-programme  the engine ECU (EECU).

volvo.defect: M0410 EMS ECM SW Update FH FM 4 On affected vehicles aged NOx sensors could result in higher NOx emissions when driving leading to a noncompliance of regulations.
volvo.remedy: Install updated NOx monitoring software.

volvo.defect: M0410 EMS ECM SW Update FH FM 4 On affected vehicles aged NOx sensors could result in higher NOx emissions when driving leading to a noncompliance of regulations.
volvo.remedy: Install updated NOx monitoring software.

volvo.defect: Engine Management System (EMS) software Update On affected vehicles aged NOx sensors could result in higher NOx emissions when driving leading to a noncompliance of regulations.
volvo.remedy: Install updated NOx monitoring software.

volvo.defect: Battery Tray lockstop missing Potential issue with the 12V battery tray. The battery tray may become detached during service or maintenance work due to missing lock stop. Vehicles need to be inspected and install any missing stops where applicable.
volvo.remedy: Vehicles need to be inspected and install any missing stops where applicable.

volvo.defect: Battery Tray lockstop missing Potential issue with the 12V battery tray. The battery tray may become detached during service or maintenance work due to missing lock stop. Vehicles need to be inspected and install any missing stops where applicable.
volvo.remedy: Vehicles need to be inspected and install any missing stops where applicable.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE On effected petrol and diesel engines a spring clamp on the radiator hose connecting it to the water inlet pipe may be insecure. If not rectified the engine may lose coolant overheat seize and suddenly slow the vehicle rapidly to a halt.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to have the radiator hose adequately secured.

volvo.defect: THE ELECTRIC STEERING PUMP INVERTER SHUTS OFF WHEN THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED OFF EVEN IF THE VEHICLE IS MOVING The Electric Steering Pump inverter shuts off when the ignition is switched off even if the vehicle is moving.
volvo.remedy: Change the steering pump wiring.

volvo.defect: SEATBELT RETRACTOR MAY FAIL Under excessive force to the belt the lock ring in the passenger seat belt retractor might break and the belt could become extendable. This will increase the risk of injury during a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the passenger seat belt retractor and support.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SUSPENSION COLLAPSE The nut securing the front suspension strut lower ball joint to the control arm may loose its axial tension due to an out tolerance condition. This could adversely affect the directional control of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Fit a modified ball joint to control arm securing nut.

volvo.defect: DRIVER'S  AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED The driver's airbag inflator may rupture due to uncontrolled burning of propellant. As a consequence violent deployment of the airbag may cause injuries to occupants.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and replace the driver's air bag where necessary.

volvo.defect: SOME STEERING SHAFTS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT COMPONENT Some steering shafts were assembled with an incorrect component.
volvo.remedy: Check steering shaft and replace if necessary.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASE Vehicles with manual gearboxes and start/stop functionality have Parking Brake Module (PBM) software that may allow the parking brake to unintentionally release. The unintended release of the parking brake can only occur when the engine is running and the gearstick moved so it will happen when the vehicle is attended.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download upgraded Parking Brake Module (PBM) software.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL The material of the steering arm bolts may not be to specification. As a result the bolts could crack and if not rectified the bolts could eventually fail totally causing loss of directional control.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering arm bolts.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE The engine oil  level may rise. This situation may lead to the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In an extreme situation the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and carry out a ECM software upgrade adjust engine oil level and install a decal to confirm oil level to the consumer.

volvo.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY IN A COLLISION It has been identified that the wiring harness for the SRS system may not have been correctly attached to the front seat frames. It is possible that continued adjustment of the seat position may cause the harness to become detached. If this should occur a warning light will illuminate on the instrument panel warning the driver of a fault with the SRS system.  However in this condition the front and side airbags may not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for an inspection of the wiring harnesses and ensure that it is correctly routed and secured.  If not then reroute and securing of the wiring harness.

volvo.defect: COLLISION AVOIDENCE WARNING LIGHT MAY NOT ILLUMINATE Collision avoidance warning lamp may not illuminate
volvo.remedy: Update system software on affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software

volvo.defect: INSECURITY OF CAB MOUNTING CAP BOLTS There have been instances where the cab mounting cap bolts have been found to be loose.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject bolts replaced. Any cab mounting brackets found to be cracked will be replaced at the same time.

volvo.defect: THRUST BEARING IN TURBO CHARGER MIGHT NOT BE ROBUST ENOUGH The thrust bearing in the turbo charger may not be robust enough.
volvo.remedy: Replace turbocharger with a modified version which has an improved thrust bearing.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There could be a sudden and unexpected failure of the bottom end of the engine because of a non-conformity during production of the connecting rods.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the engine.

volvo.defect: THE SCREW/NUT FOR THE CAB LIFT CYLINDER MAY COME LOOSE The screw/nut for the cab tilt cylinder might come loose.
volvo.remedy: Inspection and if found necessary replacement of screw nut and spacer in tilt cylinder upper attachment.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK - POSSIBILITY OF FIRE It has been identified that the fuel line is sensitive to the extreme temperatures that occur in the area where the turbo and exhaust manifold are located. This can result in a fuel leak a non-start and in extreme cases a fire.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the existing fuel line replaced with one made from Teflon which is capable of withstanding the extreme temperatures encountered.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL The crankshaft may not have been sufficiently hardened and may fail this in turn can lead to sudden and catastrophic engine failure. The failure may be preceded by loss of power and a knocking noise.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE ENGINE BAY FIRE It has been identified that on subject vehicles the engine cooling fan module could under certain operating conditions develop a short circuit caused by water intrusion. This in rare circumstances could result in an engine bay fire.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a water shield and a cable harness with a relay in order to control the engine cooling fan module power supply.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL The material of the steering arm bolts may not be to specification. As a result the bolts could crack and if not rectified the bolts could eventually fail totally causing loss of directional control.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering arm bolts.

volvo.defect: ELECTRONIC PARKING BRAKE (EPB) MAY FAIL Due to an issue within the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) vehicles equipped with the auto release function on the electronic parking brake may not have the parking brake applied when requested by the driver.  It is possible that the driver may not be aware of the non-application of the parking brake.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and update ECU software.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED The cover on the top of the engine cover could chafe against the brake vacuum hose.  If this occurs it may lead to a vacuum leak in the brake booster system and a gradual reduction of brake booster assistance.  The will lead to the brake pedal becoming harder to push than normal and increased force would be required to stop the car.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and replace the vacuum hose if necessary.  The hose will also be fitted with a safety net to prevent chafing in the future.

volvo.defect: V-STAY BRACKET Insufficient sealing may cause corrosion and premature wear of the drive axle V stay ball joint.
volvo.remedy: Examine the condition of the V stay ball joint. Clean grease and reseal if satisfactory or fit a new V stay as necessary.

volvo.defect: Rivets attaching certain ventilation windows to the main frame of the vehicle side windows may be subject to fatigue and fail. Rivets attaching certain ventilation windows to the main frame of the vehicle side windows may be subject to fatigue and fail.
volvo.remedy: Inspect the affected windows and where required replace the rivets using a revised variant.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING FLUID MAY CAUSE A FIRE A joint on the high pressure line of the power assisted steering may not have been assembled correctly.  This may lead to a leakage of steering fluid into the engine bay.  This could result in sudden loss of power assistance but in extreme cases it could result in a localised fire within the engine bay.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles  to check and if required torque the unit up to the correct specification.

volvo.defect: FUEL PUMP CONTROL ROD BREAKAGE Instances of breakage of the control rod within the fuel injection pump have occurred. Should this happen at high engine revs it could affect control of the vehicle since the rod may jam and prevent the engine from returning to idling speed.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the fuel injection pump and its attachments.

volvo.defect: AIRBAG CURTAIN MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY The inflatable curtain may have been fitted incorrectly which could prevent it from deploying as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary adjust the curtain.

volvo.defect: ELECTRIC COOLING FAN MAY OVERHEAT Volvo have identified that due to certain climatic conditions the electric cooling fan may overheat and in extreme cases cause a fire within the engine bay.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cooling fan assembly replaced.

volvo.defect: STEERING BALL JOINT TORQUE On some vehicles the bolts in the joint of the steering gear shafts may not be correctly torqued.
volvo.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles are being recalled to have the torque on all the bolts in the four joints in the steering shaft checked and where necessary tightened to the manufacturer's specification.

volvo.defect: WEIGHT INFORMATION PRODUCT LABEL INCORRECTLY It has been identified that the product label fitted to the inside of the right hand door pillar does not contain any weight information
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles will have a replacement label affixed.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL The material of the steering arm bolts may not be to specification. As a result the bolts could crack and if not rectified the bolts could eventually fail totally causing loss of directional control.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering arm bolts.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The electric cooling fan control unit's metal cover may not have the correct corrosion protection. Should corrosion occur water may enter the control unit causing an electrical malfunction and in extreme cases cause a fire in the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an improved fan assembly.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models.. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK The glass fibre content in the fuel pipe clamps may wear through the various pipes which comprise the engine fuel supply system. This could result in fuel leaks and a loss of power.
volvo.remedy: Fit modified rubber protected fuel pipe clamps also cable ties where specified.

volvo.defect: DIESEL FUEL MAY DILUTE ENGINE OIL A brass plug in the fuel injector body may come loose. If this happens diesel fuel will dilute engine oil. An increase in exhaust smoke may occur. There is also a possibility that oil and fuel would vent through the breather pipe to atmosphere.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check or replace fuel injectors.

volvo.defect: PRESSURE IN THE FUEL TANK COULD CAUSE THE FUEL LEVEL SENDER TO INDICATE FUEL IN THE TANK WHEN IT COULD BE EMPTY Pressure in the fuel tank could cause the fuel level sender to indicate fuel in the tank when it could be empty.
volvo.remedy: Update software which will allow the electronic fuel tank ventilation valve to release pressure when required.

volvo.defect: 2nd Row Seat Bolts Volvo Cars investigations have identified that there is a potential risk that one or more of the fixation bolts for the 2nd row seats may have been torqued incorrectly at the factory. In the event of an impact this may increase the risk of injury.
volvo.remedy: Volvo retailer will inspect and if necessary re-torque all fixation bolts for the 2nd row seats.

volvo.defect: EMS Software Bug on M33B release Last EMS/ACM SW release introduced a bug in the Regeneration Management system on some B8R and B5LH/TL vehicles. This bug increases the AHI flow at start of regeneration resulting in too much fuel being injected into the muffler. As a consequence there is a risk of  very high temperatures inside the muffler with a risk of a thermal event.
volvo.remedy: Volvo retailer will Reprogram the affected ECUs.

volvo.defect: ​C0506 - HPCU SW update. FHE/FME/FMLE (4) (Phase 1) / C0520 IRMU replace. FHE/FME (4) (Phase 2) / C0521 IRMU replace FHE/FME/FMLE (4) / FLE/FEE (3) (Phase 3)​ On affected vehicles the AC inlet socket and the power outlet for body builder equipment might be incorrectly energized. Therefore in vehicles where AC or DC power outlets are installed there might be voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present inside the AC inlet socket when the power outlet is active. Also when AC charging there might be a voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present on the power outlet.
volvo.remedy: The insulation monitoring device (IMD) will be replaced by an upgraded version a residual current device (RCPF sensor) will be installed inside the insulation resistance measurement unit and the OCEPS software will be updated. For vehicles built after 2025w21 until 2025w37 will also have the EMC filter reinstalled.

volvo.defect: C0367 HPCU SW UPDATE FHE FME4 There is a risk that some screw joints inside the traction voltage batteries might not have been tightened according to our assembly process.
volvo.remedy: Update a software that can detect potential loose screw joints. It will then disconnect the suspect battery and prevent any incident.

volvo.defect: Starter Motor Cable On affected vehicles there is a risk that heat from the exhaust Turbo may cause the rubber protection cap covering the power feed cable terminal to the starter motor solenoid to heat up and ignite with a risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Remove the rubber protection cap and if necessary replace the heat shield.

volvo.defect: Fuse install to prevent unexpected stop Short circuit on low voltage side has in other cases caused instant stop on the road without ability to driver vehicle safely to the side of the road.
volvo.remedy: In order to ensure short circuits ability to drive vehicle to the side of the road in case of a300A fuse is to be installed on the low voltage side to ensure power supply to control units is maintained in case DC/DC converter fails.

volvo.defect: Urea Pump Unit Replace Affected vehicles are fitted with a faulty Urea pump which could result in non-compliance to emissions regulations.
volvo.remedy: Replace Urea pump.

volvo.defect: Engine management system (EMS)/Enginecontrol module (ECM) software update On affected vehicles the Engine Management System (EMS) Software causes an error where the Malfunction Indication Lamp (MIL) will not indicate a defective Lambda sensor so the driver will not be alerted upon a failure resulting in a non-compliance to emissions regulation.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software to the Engine Control Module (ECM).

volvo.defect: Engine management system (EMS)/Enginecontrol module (ECM) software update On affected vehicles the Engine Management System (EMS) Software causes an error where the Malfunction Indication Lamp (MIL) will not indicate a defective Lambda sensor so the driver will not be alerted upon a failure resulting in a non-compliance to emissions regulation.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software to the Engine Control Module (ECM).

volvo.defect: Engine management system (EMS)/Enginecontrol module (ECM) software update On affected vehicles the Engine Management System (EMS) Software causes an error where the Malfunction Indication Lamp (MIL) will not indicate a defective Lambda sensor so the driver will not be alerted upon a failure resulting in a non-compliance to emissions regulation.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software to the Engine Control Module (ECM).

volvo.defect: VASP (Volvo Active Safety Platform) software update Affected vehicles instrument clusters may not show the correct values regarding the Driver Support Systems.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles will have their software updated.

volvo.defect: VASP (Volvo Active Safety Platform) software update Affected vehicles instrument clusters may not show the correct values regarding the Driver Support Systems.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles will have their software updated.

volvo.defect: POT Separation On affected vehicles there is a risk the tailgate could close rapidly and cause injury due to a production issue with the Power Operated Tailgate (POT) drive units.
volvo.remedy: Replace both Power Operated Tailgate (POT) drive units.

volvo.defect: BCM2 SW – Safety Notice Affected vehicles may experience a temporary loss of braking functionality after coasting downhill with ‘B’ mode selected or when using One Pedal Drive. This could potentially lead to a collision.
volvo.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) update.

volvo.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) update.

volvo.defect: C0455 Traction Battery Inspect/Replace ESS Traction battery. There is a risk that a small metal piece from a broken terminal fixation might come loose and create a short circuit between battery cells inside the traction battery which might lead to overheating and a risk of fire. There will be a red warning in the instrument cluster to the driver if a short-circuit is detected inside the battery before the battery overheats.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of ESS Traction battery.

volvo.defect: Exhaust Aftertreatment System (EATS) Rework On affected vehicles there is a risk that the Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) may overheat when performing a regeneration if there is excessive soot accumulated inside it. In a worst-case scenario this could result in a vehicle fire.
volvo.remedy: Install modified software and pressure sensor.

volvo.defect: C0472 - HPCU SW update. FHE/FME/FMLE (4) On affected vehicles there is a risk for an unexpected acceleration in Heavy-Duty battery-electric trucks that use gearbox mounted power take-off and use it in non-stationary applications.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software to the Hybrid Powertrain Control Unit (HPCU).

volvo.defect: C0472 - HPCU SW update. FHE/FME/FMLE (4) On affected vehicles there is a risk for an unexpected acceleration in Heavy-Duty battery-electric trucks that use gearbox mounted power take-off and use it in non-stationary applications.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software to the Hybrid Powertrain Control Unit (HPCU).

volvo.defect: C0444 Traction Battery Replace FLE FEE 3 and C0470 Traction Battery repair FLE FEE 3 and C0510 Traction battery replace wave 2  FLE FEE 3 C0529 Traction battery replace wave 3 FLE FEE 3) There is a risk that a small metal piece from a broken terminal fixation might come loose and create a short circuit between battery cells inside the traction battery which might lead to overheating. There will be a red warning in the instrument cluster to the driver if a short-circuit is detected inside the battery before the battery overheats.
volvo.remedy: Replace Traction batteries

volvo.defect: C0406 EMS ECM and ACM SW rollback. FL FE 3 On affected vehicles there is a risk that the silencer may overheat when performing a regeneration which may result in a thermal event if there is excessive soot accumulated inside it.
volvo.remedy: Install modified software.

volvo.defect: C0406 EMS ECM and ACM SW rollback. FL FE 3 On affected vehicles there is a risk that the silencer may overheat when performing a regeneration which may result in a thermal event if there is excessive soot accumulated inside it.
volvo.remedy: Install modified software.

volvo.defect: C0397 Cab lower trim panel adjust. FH/FM/FHE/FME/FMLE (4) There is a risk that the lower trim panel might get loose and blow away mainly when driving on roadways at high speed.
volvo.remedy: The assembly of the panels will be inspected to make sure it is correctly done and the lower trim panel will be firmly attached to the cab by screws.

volvo.defect: C0397 Cab lower trim panel adjust. FH/FM/FHE/FME/FMLE (4) There is a risk that the lower trim panel might get loose and blow away mainly when driving on roadways at high speed.
volvo.remedy: The assembly of the panels will be inspected to make sure it is correctly done and the lower trim panel will be firmly attached to the cab by screws.

volvo.defect: Headlamp SW There is a potential risk that the headlamp hammer could temporarily close over the low/high beam lighting modules. Should this occur visibility will be reduced for a period of 2-3 seconds before it is restored.
volvo.remedy: Over the air software update the modified software can also be downloaded at a franchised Volvo retailer if preferred/requested

volvo.defect: FRONT HUB CAP MAY COME LOOSE The front hub cap may loosen and allow the ingress of road grit and water.  Subsequent failure of the hub bearing may result.
volvo.remedy: Fit an inproved design hub cap.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF DEMIST/DEFROST SYSTEM A diode in the climate control system may not be sufficiently durable. In consequence the fan may stop working resulting in failure of the demist/defrost system.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the installation of an additional heater fan cable harness which includes a climate control diode.

volvo.defect: M0399 UDS pump replace (wave 4). FL/FE (3) Faulty Urea pump membrane could lead to that the vehicle to be non-compliant to legislation.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of the UDS pump unit to correct membrane.

volvo.defect: M0399 UDS pump replace (wave 4). FL/FE (3) Faulty Urea pump membrane could lead to that the vehicle to be non-compliant to legislation.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of the UDS pump unit to correct membrane.

volvo.defect: CMA Cell Modules On affected vehicles the High Voltage (HV) Battery may have a manufacturing defect which could cause the Battery Cells to overheat when the HV Battery is fully charged. In a worst-case scenario there is a risk of fire when the vehicle is parked up with a fully charged HV Battery.
volvo.remedy: Check and replace the HV Battery Cells if necessary and install modified software.

volvo.defect: Emergency open door warning software Update On affected vehicles the Emergency door buzzer does not work when the passenger door is opened using the emergency switch.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software.

volvo.defect: C0519 Front axle screws retightening/replace On affected vehicles there is a risk that screws for the front axle attachment might lose torque or come loose. It might lead to strange behaviour of the truck and noise and in worst case loss of steering control.
volvo.remedy: Check the torque level on the screws retorque and if necessary replace parts.

volvo.defect: Engine Management System (EMS) software Update On affected vehicles the Engine Management System (EMS) Indicator Diagnostic Trouble Code (IDTC) may not update correctly.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software.

volvo.defect: Engine Management System (EMS) software Update On affected vehicles the Engine Management System (EMS) Indicator Diagnostic Trouble Code (IDTC) may not update correctly.
volvo.remedy: Install updated software.

volvo.defect: Urea Pump Replace On affected vehicles an inadequate flow of AdBlue causes increased NOx and other pollutant emissions.
volvo.remedy: Replace the AdBlue pump.

volvo.defect: ​C0506 - HPCU SW update. FHE/FME/FMLE (4) (Phase 1) / C0520 IRMU replace. FHE/FME (4) (Phase 2) / C0521 IRMU replace FHE/FME/FMLE (4) / FLE/FEE (3) (Phase 3)​ On affected vehicles the AC inlet socket and the power outlet for body builder equipment might be incorrectly energized. Therefore in vehicles where AC or DC power outlets are installed there might be voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present inside the AC inlet socket when the power outlet is active. Also when AC charging there might be a voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present on the power outlet.
volvo.remedy: The insulation monitoring device (IMD) will be replaced by an upgraded version a residual current device (RCPF sensor) will be installed inside the insulation resistance measurement unit and the OCEPS software will be updated. For vehicles built after 2025w21 until 2025w37 will also have the EMC filter reinstalled.

volvo.defect: Software Update to U-Baseline An issue has been found which may make the vehicle non-compliant . The concern we have noted relates to the instrument cluster warnings may not activate as intended in certain full emergency braking scenarios resulting in insufficient warning indications to the driver.
volvo.remedy: The vehicle will require the Vehicle Baseline Software to be updated to the latest level.

volvo.defect: Software Update to U-Baseline An issue has been found which may make the vehicle non-compliant . The concern we have noted relates to the instrument cluster warnings may not activate as intended in certain full emergency braking scenarios resulting in insufficient warning indications to the driver.
volvo.remedy: The vehicle will require the Vehicle Baseline Software to be updated to the latest level.

volvo.defect: HV Battery On affected vehicles following charging there is a risk of an overheating High Voltage Battery Cell which could lead to a risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Volvo Cars is confident that limiting the battery s maximum state of charge to 70% will eliminate the risk of overheating.    Additionally we would advise the following precautions.  Do not leave your vehicle unattended whilst charging within buildings or covered areas. If you see any vehicle warnings in the car or app during or after charging seek assistance.  The HV Battery modules will be inspected and replaced.

volvo.defect: M0387 Silencer particulate filter insert gasket replace On affected vehicles there is a risk DPF bypass leakage can occur due to gasket assembly and material issues at the supplier. The bypass leakage can lead to excessive particle number emissions from the engine and after treatment system.
volvo.remedy: Remove DPF and fit an improved gasket.

volvo.defect: M0387 Silencer particulate filter insert gasket replace On affected vehicles there is a risk DPF bypass leakage can occur due to gasket assembly and material issues at the supplier. The bypass leakage can lead to excessive particle number emissions from the engine and after treatment system.
volvo.remedy: Remove DPF and fit an improved gasket.

volvo.defect: Seat Recliner On affected vehicles equipped with manually operated front seats there is a potential issue on the front seats due to insufficient welding strength between the recliner and the lower bracket on the seat backrest which may compromise the backrest’s ability to provide optimal occupant protection in the event of an impact.
volvo.remedy: Inspect both front seats and install additional brackets as required.

volvo.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component
volvo.remedy: Check and If found then replacement of Silencer.

volvo.defect: Head Cushion On affected vehicles there is a potential issue with insufficient fastenings on the front seat head cushions.  This means that there is a risk that in the event of an impact the head cushions may not perform as expected and could pose a risk of injury.
volvo.remedy: Reinforce the head restraint cushion attachment.

volvo.defect: Head Cushion On affected vehicles there is a potential issue with insufficient fastenings on the front seat head cushions.  This means that there is a risk that in the event of an impact the head cushions may not perform as expected and could pose a risk of injury.
volvo.remedy: Reinforce the head restraint cushion attachment.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: CHAFING OF INJECTOR CABLE HARNESS The single point injector cable harness may chafe against the cylinder head. This could result in short circuiting and burning of the harness.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the injector cable harness for indications of chafing making good where necessary before securing the harness to the throttle mechanism body.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER SEAT MAY NOT BE FITTED CORRECTLY It is possible that the driver's and passenger's front powered seats may not be fitted with the front stop lug. The lug restricts the movement of the seats and if not fitted it is possible to position the seats too far forward or backwards. This could increase the chances of injury should the vehicle be involved in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect for fitment of the lugs and if found to be missing fit new lugs.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF FUEL PRESSURE RESULTING IN ENGINE STALLING WITHOUT WARNING. It has been identified that the fuel pump pressure regulator may detach from it's spigot within the fuel pump in conditions of high ambient temperature. Should this occur the vehicle would suffer loss of fuel pressure causing the engine to stall with no warning being given to the driver.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel pump replaced.

volvo.defect: TAG AXLE HUB MAY DISLODGE It has been identified that due to a misalignment of the weld and poor root penetration of the weld fillet material the TAG axle hub may dislodge from the axle.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the TAG axle replaced.

volvo.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL Under continuous exceptionally hard use it is possible for the track rod end ball joint to fracture. In extreme cases this could lead to loss of steering control.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace both the nearside and the offside outer track rod ends.

volvo.defect: ENGINE COOLING FAN MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a software issue with the engine cooling fan control module the air conditioning performance may be reduced and the engine coolant temperature may increase. This will result in warning messages being displayed.  In extreme cases if the driver does not heed the warnings the engine may fail.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cooling fan control module replaced.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INCORRECT MESHING OF STEERING ANGLE GEARS Steering angle gears may not be correctly meshed which may result in a possible loss of steering control.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check steering angle gear input and output shafts for axial looseness and renew where necessary.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified thatthe fuel pump electronic module may not operate as intended. This can result in failure of the fuel pump to start. Should this occur the vehicle may suffer a non start rough running or in the worst case the engine may stall without prior warning. Investigation has shown that it may be possible to drive the vehicle for up to 100 m before the fault manifests itself.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the software within the central electronic module upgraded.

volvo.defect: FUEL LINES MAY CHAFE IN CLAMPS. The fuel hoses' plastic clamps may wear through the hoses and cause a fuel leak.
volvo.remedy: Replace any wear damaged fuel hoses and fit new hose clamps. Additionally install a vent pipe in the fuel supply system.

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE BLOCKAGE OF INJECTION PUMP CONTROL ROD On a specific batch of fuel injection pump pressure valve retainers the bottom washer may come undone. This would cause the valve to drop on to the pump element and in extreme cases fragments may block the control rod.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the original pressure valve retainers with quality assured examples.

volvo.defect: Under certain circumstances there is a risk that the two 12V batteries and its power cables might overheat. Under certain circumstances there is a risk that the two 12V batteries and its power cables might overheat.
volvo.remedy: The software will be updated with a new strategy to prevent excessive electrical currents into the 12V batteries.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF UPPER STEERING ARM The screws securing the upper steering arm may have been overtightened damaging the threads of the screws and the threads in the steering arm knuckle. In the worst case situation a loss of steering control could result.
volvo.remedy: Remove the screws from the steering arm knuckle and examine the threads on both components for damage. Fit new bolts in all cases and new steering arms when the threads in the knuckle are found to be damaged.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: CLUTCH PEDAL MECHANISM MAY FAIL The rod connecting the clutch master cylinder and the clutch pedal may break.  It may not be possible to disengage the clutch.  In worst cases this may happen suddenly with no warning to the driver.  If this happens bring the car to a safe stop using the engine and switch off the ignition.
volvo.remedy: Replace clutch master cylinder with a new metal push rod in-place of the plastic one.

volvo.defect: WINDSCREEN MAY SEPARATE FROM SUPPORT AREAS ON IMPACT Internal test have shown that due to contamination of the windscreen primer if the vehicle is subject to an impact the windsceen may separate from the support area of the roof and pillars.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected inspect and where necessary replace the windscreen

volvo.defect: SEATBELT MAY SEPARATE FROM THE BUCKLE It has been identified there is a possibility the front seatbelt buckle stud may not have been punched correctly during production. This may result in a separation between the buckle and seatbelt bracket if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the seatbelt buckle and if required to replace the seatbelt buckle.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The incorrect torque setting has been applied to the oil turbo hose which may lead to an oil leak and risk of fire
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and rectify torque setting.

volvo.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SYSTEM CONTROL UNIT INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED TO THE CAR BODY Vehicles may have the Supplementary Restraint System (SRS) control unit incorrectly tightened to the car body.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and tighten the SRS control unit.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING The driver may experience sudden loss of power assistance to the steering due to voltage irregularities in the Electro Hydraulic Power Steering system. The driver will have to apply increased effort to steer the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download new software to the inverter which can cope with voltage spikes and/or drops.

volvo.defect: The installed 15 A fuse protecting the DRL (Daytime Running Lights) has an amperage rating which is too large The installed 15 A fuse protecting the DRL (Daytime Running Lights) has an amperage rating which is too large.
volvo.remedy: Replace the present fuse with a one of a revised amperage rating.

volvo.defect: STEERING MAY FAIL It has been identified that a number of vehicles may have left the assembly plant without a split pin in the track rod end securing nut. In this condition it is a possibility that the securing nuts may work loose.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for the presence of the split pins and if theses are in place no additional work will be carried out. If the spilt pins are found to be missing the assembly will be dismantled and then re-torqued ensuring that the split pins are in place.

volvo.defect: BONNET MAY OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY On a small number of S60 cars it is possible that secondary bonnet catch will not lock in the closed position correctly. If the bonnet is not closed correctly it is possible that the secondary bonnet catch will not secure the bonnet which could result in it opening unintentionally.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicle for inspection and adjustment to the lock if required.

volvo.defect: WEIGHT INFORMATION LABEL HAS BEEN SUPPLIED WITH INCORRECT INFORMATION On subject vehicles it has been identified that the wrong information has been given on the product label in respect of the maximum permitted front axle weight.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the label (which is a legal requirement) replaced.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY NOT RETURN TO RESTING POSITION Accelerator pedal may be prevented from returning to its rest position by the floor mat.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the floor mat with a shorter version.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTED STEERING AND ENGINE MAY STALL. It is possible that water can enter the electric hydraulic power assisted steering pump. This can affect the operation of the pump. The driver will receive warning in the form of warning messages and illumination of warning lights on the dashboard. However the power assistance for the steering can failure but in extreme circumstances the engine can unexpectedly stall.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the power assisted steering pump.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE UNINTENTIONAL OPERATION OF ABS There is a possibility that at certain temperatures (room temp or below) that the front wheel speed sensors can send faulty signals to a number of control units. It is possible that under braking the ABS could be activated when not needed and the ABS light will be illuminated.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace both front wheel sensors with modified type.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The incorrect torque setting has been applied to the oil turbo hose which may lead to an oil leak and risk of fire
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and check and rectify torque setting.

volvo.defect: CAB HEATER DOES NOT MEET LEGLISLATION REQUIREMENTS Some ADR vehicles have a common cab heater assembled instead of a cab heater for ADR vehicles. Because of this the ADR vehicles do not fulfil the ADR Regulations.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the cab heater if the vehicle has been fitted with the wrong specification heater.

volvo.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED. It is possible that an electrical short circuit within a connector could result in the illumination of the Airbag System Service Required message and Supplemental Restraint System warning lamp on the dashboard. Should this occur the driver's airbag would not deploy as intended if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and rework the connector.

volvo.defect: BOLTS COULD BECOME LOOSE ON BRAKE CALIPER BRIDGE. The holes on the brake caliper bridge may have been double threaded which may cause the bolts to become loose
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check part numbers and if necessary replace brake bridge

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL TO OPERATE CORRECTLY Following the washing process water may have been left in the rear spring brake chamber.  As a consequence it is possible that this water may freeze under cold conditions.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles remove brake chamber drain water and clean out.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM ADEQUATELY Brake assistance from the vacuum pressure pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
