volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the non-return valve in the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: A SOFTWARE ERROR MAY PREVENT THE ENGINE CONTROL MODULE FROM STARTING THE ENGINE The Engine Control Module (ECM) may prevent the combustion engine from starting.�
volvo.remedy: Download updated software.

volvo.defect: HIGH VOLTAGE CONTACTORS IN THE BATTERY ENERGY CONTROL MODULE MAY OPEN DURING DRIVING High voltage contactors may open during driving resulting in a risk that the high voltage system may be unintentionally disconnected causing a loss of propulsion.
volvo.remedy: Software upgrade to be carried out.

volvo.defect: ERRATIC ACCELERATOR BEHAVIOUR A faulty accelerator pedal sensor may cause erratic accelerator operation during operation of the accelerator pedal.This may vary between no throttle reaction to a speed greater than expected for a throttle position
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the accelerator pedal with a new variant and install an adapter wiring harness

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE UPDATE AND RESET REQUIRED TO ENSURE VEHICLE EMISSION COMPLIANCE Vehicle emission compliance may not be met.
volvo.remedy: An engine management software update & reset is required to ensure vehicle emission compliance.

volvo.defect: OIL MAY LEAK It has been established that on some vehicles the hydraulic hose feeding the engine fan may sustain chafing damage due to insufficient clamping which may over time result in severe oil leakage.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicle Inspect the hydraulic hose for damage and replace if necessary. Secure pipe with a new type of clamp and align the frame bracket according to manufacturer's  instruction.

volvo.defect: LOAD NET SUPPORT BRACKETS MAY FAIL It has been identified that; certain welds for the front and rear load net fixings may not be to the required specification. In this condition there is a risk that under certain driving conditions such as sudden braking the brackets may fail causing the luggage to become insecure.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject welds inspected and re-welded should this prove to be necessary.

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the main switch can crack which can cause an electrical short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have initially had the subject switch disconnected.  However an exchange switch has now been mae availagble to all customers who require it and will be fitted free of charge.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE Heat transmitted from the turbocharger may adversely affect the rubber membrane in the brake servo unit. This could result in loss of brake vacuum assistance and increase the pedal effort and stopping distance when the brakes are applied.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the brake servo unit and the installation of a heat shield between the servo unit and the turbocharger.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE BLOCKAGE OF INJECTION PUMP CONTROL ROD On a specific batch of fuel injection pump pressure valve retainers the bottom washer may come undone. This would cause the valve to drop on to the pump element and in extreme cases fragments may block the control rod.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the original pressure valve retainers with quality assured examples.

volvo.defect: Screws that attach the front axle to the suspension may require tightening Potential that the screws for the front axle attachment might lose torque or come loose.
volvo.remedy: Apply correct torque value on concerned screws and/or replace defected parts.

volvo.defect: TACHOGRAPH MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE A power loss to the tachograph may occur when the main switch is turned off because the wiring harnesses to the main switch were assembled incorrectly.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to reassemble the wiring harnesses to the correct specification.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE It is possible that the right hand driveshaft may not have been manufactured to the correct specification.  This can ultimately result in the failure of the drive shaft.  This will be identified to the driver by noise and the loss of drive.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the right hand driveshaft.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY MOVE FORWARDS UNINTENTIONALLY It is possible that a hybrid bus standing still with the diesel engine running on idle could suddenly move by itself. An incorrect accelerator pedal system can provide the gearbox with a corrupt acceleration request signal. The gearbox can change clutch status from disengaged to engaged which results in sudden vehicle movement if the vehicle is left in gear with the handbrake off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the I-shift gearbox software.

volvo.defect: BRAKE VACUUM PUMP CONCERN The brake vacuum pump may fail and cause a reduction in brake servo assistance.  This will make the brake pedal heavy to operate.
volvo.remedy: Fit a modified brake vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: SHORT-CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR / RISK OF FIRE The pre-heater power cable after time may exhibit chafing damages caused by movement over the support bracket on which the cable is attached. If the insulation is worn through this may result in short-circuit and if all the indicators are ignored the worst case scenario is fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the power cable to pre-heater to ensure there is no damage or contact with any abrasive surfaces or edges. The cable should be replaced if there is significant damage. Correct clamping by adding a rubber spacer at each of the two concerned clamping points according to instruction below. Also add a 7 mm spacer washer under the existing cable tie at the pre-heater relay box.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: ALTERNATOR CABLE TERMINALS MAY BE LOOSE. The alternator cable terminals may not have been tightened on the rear plate.
volvo.remedy: Check security of terminal fasteners and tighten them to the specified torque where found necessary.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL DEFECTIVE SELF-ADJUSTER FUNCTION IN THE BRAKE CALIPER HOUSING Possible defective self-adjuster function in the brake caliper housing.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace the caliper brake housing on affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF DRIVE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. If the tensioner fails it would cause a loss of power steering assistance and possible loss of drive.
volvo.remedy: Replace the auxiliary drive belt tensioner.

volvo.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been identified that internal leakage of the brake master cylinder could occur. Should this be the case the driver may experience reduced braking performance whilst applying and maintaining force on the brake pedal.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake master cylinder inspected and possibly replaced. At the same time the brake fluid reservoir will be checked and the affected pipes cleansed.

volvo.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE FROM CAB HEATER PUMP There is a possibility of fuel leakage between the cab heater fuel pump housing and its cover.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and inspect the cab heater pump for signs of fuel leakage. Where there is evidence of this the fuel pump will be replaced. On pumps not exhibiting signs of leakage the pump cover retaining screws will be replaced.

volvo.defect: REPROGRAMMING OF ENGINE ECU Faulty software in the engine ECU will result in the engine exhaust emissions failing to comply with the regulations.
volvo.remedy: Re program the engine ECU.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE'S PLASTIC INLET MANIFOLD MAY MELT AND DEFORM The engines plastic inlet manifold may melt and deform
volvo.remedy: Update vehicles with improved soot reducing software cleaning of TMAP and EMAP. Fit additional hoses where necessary.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Volvo quality follow-up procedures have identified an issue on a number of model year 2007 C30 S40 and V50s relating to the engine cooling fan control module.  Under certain operating conditions water intrusion could occur into the control module causing a short circuit which in very rare instances could result in a fire in the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: To install a water shield and a cable harness with relay in order to control the engine cooling fan module power supply.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: The passenger air bag may not have been correctly secured. The passenger air bag may not have been correctly secured.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and re torque retaining bolts.

volvo.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED Brake servo assistance from the vacuum pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a modified non-return valve to the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There could be a sudden and unexpected failure of the bottom end of the engine because of a non-conformity during production of the connecting rods.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the engine.

volvo.defect: OIL MAY LEAK Oil may leak as a result of incorrect sealing rings (O-rings) which have been fitted on the oil pipes connected to the filter housing and cooling duct. Oil may pool when the engine is running and the vehicle is at a standstill endangering other road users.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace both oil pipes with new ones (delivered complete with new sealing rings).

volvo.defect: ENGINE COOLING FAN MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a software issue with the engine cooling fan control module the air conditioning performance may be reduced and the engine coolant temperature may increase. This will result in warning messages being displayed.  In extreme cases if the driver does not heed the warnings the engine may fail.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the cooling fan control module replaced.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF ABS CONTROL UNIT Some electronic control units for the ABS circuit may not be able to analyse information correctly. This may cause damage to the ABS solenoid valves and could affect braking performance.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles will be recalled to have the electronic control units checked. Where this is found to display a fault code it will be replaced together with the ABS solenoid valves.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY RUN ON It is possible in certain circumstances for the engine oil level to rise above the maximum level. This situation could lead to engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In extreme cases the engine could continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to adjust the engine oil level and carry out a software upgrade.

volvo.defect: ONE OF THE NUTS SECURING THE BRAKE BOOSTER TO THE FIREWALL IS MISSING. On affected vehicles one of the nuts securing the brake booster to the firewall is missing
volvo.remedy: Fit the missing nut.

volvo.defect: STARTER MOTOR HEATSHIELD MAY BREAK OFF AND CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT The brackets retaining the heat shield of the starter motor may fail and allow the heat shield to fall on and chafe through the B+ cable. If left there is a theoretical risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the starter motor heat shield. Additionally the exhaust pipe will be inspected for signs of cracks on flange facing turbo outlet and the gasket will be replaced.

volvo.defect: INSUFFICIENT SEALING MAY CAUSE CORROSION ON THE BALL JOINT Insufficient sealing may cause corrosion of the ball joint which leads to premature wear of the rear axle V stay
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and if necessary replace ball joint.

volvo.defect: RISK OF FIRE Potential  leakage from base of the test point on the high-pressure hose connecting fan pump to fan drive motor on two chassis types.  If leakage occurs oil could spray on hot engine components and cause a fire.
volvo.remedy: Fitting of a rubber protection hose.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE On effected petrol and diesel engines a spring clamp on the radiator hose connecting it to the water inlet pipe may be insecure. If not rectified the engine may lose coolant overheat seize and suddenly slow the vehicle rapidly to a halt.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to have the radiator hose adequately secured.

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: CLUTCH PEDAL MECHANISM MAY FAIL The rod connecting the clutch master cylinder and the clutch pedal may break.  It may not be possible to disengage the clutch.  In worst cases this may happen suddenly with no warning to the driver.  If this happens bring the car to a safe stop using the engine and switch off the ignition.
volvo.remedy: Replace clutch master cylinder with a new metal push rod in-place of the plastic one.

volvo.defect: INSECURITY OF SUN VISOR The external sun visor (which is an optional extra) is not sufficiently secured to its mounting bracket on the cab.
volvo.remedy: Recall all potentially affected vehicles (only a small number will have visors) for checking. All vehicles equipped with a visor will have additional screws fitted to the four mounting brackets.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT When driving at low speeds a fault within the software calibration of the engine and transmission control modules may lead to a drop in the engine idle speed when braking or releasing the accelerator. In extreme cases this may result in the engine cutting out without warning.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the engine/transmission software.

volvo.defect: DURING VEHICLE OPERATION THE AIR SPRING MEMBER CAN GET LOOSEAND A STEERING EFFECTMIGHT APPEAR FOR THE REAR AXLE Nuts used for the rear axle snow chain installation may have wrong material hardness.�
volvo.remedy: Replace nuts on all affected trucks

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: CORROSION/ POOR ADHESION POTENTIALLY CAUSING THE FRONT SPOILER BRACKETS TO COME LOOSE The front spoiler brackets may become loose.
volvo.remedy: Secure brackets with additional screws.

volvo.defect: THE STEERING LINK ROD RETAINER NUT MAY HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED INCORRECTLY The steering link rod retainer nut may have been tightened incorrectly
volvo.remedy: The torque of the link rod retainer nut will be assessed and if necessary the link rod and upper steering arm will be replaced.

volvo.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED It has been identified that due to a software deviation within the supplementary restraint system (SRS) the inflatable curtain and side impact protection system may not deploy as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the SRS software updated.

volvo.defect: STEERING BOX MAY WORK LOOSE It is possible that the steering box to mounting bracket bolts maybe too long which will cause the bolts bottoming out. Should this occur it can result in the steering box working loose and if not rectified possible detachment of the steering box.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and check the steering box mounting bolts if it is found that the incorrect bolts have been fitted then the steering box will be removed and modified to accept the correct bolts and refitted using the correct bolts.

volvo.defect: INSECURITY OF SUN VISOR The external sun visor (which is an optional extra) is not sufficiently secured to its mounting bracket on the cab.
volvo.remedy: Recall all potentially affected vehicles (only a small number will have visors) for checking. All vehicles equipped with a visor will have additional screws fitted to the four mounting brackets.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF INCORRECT MESHING OF STEERING ANGLE GEARS Steering angle gears may not be correctly meshed which may result in a possible loss of steering control.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check steering angle gear input and output shafts for axial looseness and renew where necessary.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASE Vehicles with manual gearboxes and start/stop functionality have Parking Brake Module (PBM) software that may allow the parking brake to unintentionally release. The unintended release of the parking brake can only occur when the engine is running and the gearstick moved so it will happen when the vehicle is attended.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download upgraded Parking Brake Module (PBM) software.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: INTERNAL CONTACT FAILURE INSIDE THE WIPER SYSTEM MOTORS CAN CAUSE ISSUES WITH THE SYNCHRONISATION Synchronized wipers may fail and become stuck.
volvo.remedy: Check Wiper motors and replace if within the affected range.

volvo.defect: ADR SIGN MAY NOT COMPLY WITH FIRE RETARDENT REQUIREMENTS The ADR sign is fitted to the front grille in a way which will prevent it from resisting high temperatures and as such it will not comply with the ADR legal requirements
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and introduce a steel wire between the ADR sign and grille so that it will resist heat for 15 minutes.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain five cylinder engines it is possible that the high pressure fuel pipes may not have been correctly installed and may leak. This should be identified by a smell of fuel from the engine bay. However it is possible that in extreme cases an engine bay fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the high pressure pipes.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF FUEL PRESSURE RESULTING IN ENGINE STALLING WITHOUT WARNING. It has been identified that the fuel pump pressure regulator may detach from it's spigot within the fuel pump in conditions of high ambient temperature. Should this occur the vehicle would suffer loss of fuel pressure causing the engine to stall with no warning being given to the driver.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel pump replaced.

volvo.defect: SIDE AIRBAG MAY NOT WORK AS INTENDED It has been identified that the subject vehicles may have a software error within  the side impact protection system (SIPS)  As a result the inflatable side curtains may not operate as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the SIPS system ECU software upgraded.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
volvo.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY INADVERTENTLY APPLY Affected vehicles maty be assembled with T nipples in the air tubes which are not to specification. Air tubes may become insecure amd may cause the parking brake to inadvertently apply.
volvo.remedy: Identify defective T nipples and replace.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: EXHAUST FUMES MAY ENTER THE CAB It is possible for the exhaust pipe of the parking heater to be squeezed and restricted which could result in exhaust fumes entering the cab.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the exhaust pipe and clamp. Additionally the drain hole on the exhaust silencer is to be closed.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE PINS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SOLDERED CORRECTLY IN THE MAIN SWITCH CONTROL UNIT On affected vehicles there is a possibility that one or more pins might not be properly soldered in the main switch control unit.
volvo.remedy: Check the main control switch unit and replace if necessary.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SOFTWARE ISSUE IN THE VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY MODULE (VCM) There may be a software issue in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.
volvo.remedy: Upgrade software in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.

volvo.defect: BRAKE PEDAL OPERATION MAY REQUIRE HIGHER PEDAL PRESSURE Under certain circumstances it is necessary to use a higher then normal brake pedal pressure in order to bring the vehicle to a halt. The existence of the fault or otherwise depending on the availability of a signal in the I-shift which reduces and disengages the drive torque.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will receive updated software tailored to the control unit fitted.

volvo.defect: PRESSURE IN THE FUEL TANK COULD CAUSE THE FUEL LEVEL SENDER TO INDICATE FUEL IN THE TANK WHEN IT COULD BE EMPTY Pressure in the fuel tank could cause the fuel level sender to indicate fuel in the tank when it could be empty.
volvo.remedy: Update software which will allow the electronic fuel tank ventilation valve to release pressure when required.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY MOVE FORWARD WHEN ENGAGING REVERSE GEAR There is a possibility that the vehicle may move forward when reverse gear is engaged due to a defect in the gearbox software program.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-program gearbox software.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE INCORRECT FITTING OF SEAT BELT ATTACHMENTS There is a possibility that the seat belt attachments for the 2nd and 3d row may not have been fitted correctly. Some attachments may not have been tightened properly.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and inspect the attachments and if necessary replace the screws and tighten to correct specification

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR A potential chafing condition has been identified between the alternator power cables and P-clamp. If chaffing occurs it may result in a short circuit. This could lead to initially some flickering of certain Malfunction Indicator Lamps on the instrument display. If the concern is not corrected it is possible for a fire to occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the current P-clamp with a more robust clamp and secured with additional rubber protection in two locations. If serious cable chafing is identified (insulation worn through) the cable should be replaced.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SOFTWARE ISSUE IN THE VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY MODULE (VCM) There may be a software issue in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.
volvo.remedy: Upgrade software in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE It has been identified that internal leakage of the brake master cylinder could occur. Should this be the case the driver may experience reduced braking performance whilst applying and maintaining force on the brake pedal.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake master cylinder inspected and possibly replaced. At the same time the brake fluid reservoir will be checked and the affected pipes cleansed.

volvo.defect: TORQUE REDUCTION VALUE LABEL MISSING ON ENGINE It has been identified that the engine information label does not indicate the torque reduction value.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicle will have the plate replaced.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY STALL It has been identified that;  on assembly of the engine mounting bracket incorrect screws may have been used. This can result in breakage of the bracket which can lead to heavy engine vibrations/noise and reduced engine power or stalling due to the limp home mode being activated.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will the engine mounting bracket screws replaced.

volvo.defect: CHILD SAFETY LOCK CONCERN Possible faulty wiring harness in the rear doors may result in the powered child safety locks not operating.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check the child locks for effective and reliable operation and renew any faulty power supply wiring harness.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE The engine oil  level may rise. This situation may lead to the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In an extreme situation the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and carry out a ECM software upgrade adjust engine oil level and install a decal to confirm oil level to the consumer.

volvo.defect: FAULTY EARTH CABLE An interrupted earth cable can cause current to return to the battery through the steering shaft.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the earth cable checked for damage and continuity of earth connections.Should any damage be found this will be repaired and the steering shaft renewed.

volvo.defect: There is a risk that the parking brake efficiency is reduced/lost or that the rear brake is blocked/dragging on one or two of the rear wheels. There is a risk that the parking brake efficiency is reduced/lost or that the rear brake is blocked/dragging on one or two of the rear wheels.
volvo.remedy: Replace the concerned spring brake cylinder/cylinders.

volvo.defect: FUEL TANK MOUNTING BRACKET JOINT BREAKS/CRACKS On affected vehicles the fuel tank mounting bracket joint may break/crack  with the risk of the fuel tank dropping to the floor and parting from the fuel filler neck resulting in fuel spillage (environmental contamination).
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles the fuel tank mounting bracket is inspected implementing welding reinforcement to the mounting bracket.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY THAT THE AXLE MAY BECOME LOOSE IF THE U BOLT BREAK A reduction in torque for the front axle U bolts and  high material hardness of the rear axle U bolts may result in U bolt breakage and axle insecurity
volvo.remedy: Replace the front and rear axle U bolts and tighten to the appropriate torque.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING  THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
volvo.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF STEERING ASSISTANCE A hose for the power steering assistance hydraulics could come into contact with the cooling fan. This would cause a noise which an observant driver may be able to hear. If the hose and fan conflict for long enough then it is possible for the hose to leak power steering fluid to the degree that servo assistance could be lost.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the hydraulic hose for damage and relace as necessary. The hose will then be secured with a modified bracket.

volvo.defect: ALTERNATOR MAY OVERHEAT It has been identified that during production the temperature sensors for the alternator have been installed/located in the wrong position. This can result in the driver not receiving an early warning of the alternator overheating.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the location of all the temperature sensors for the alternator and if found incorrectly positioned reposition them as per the technical service instruction including checking of the alienator bearings/friction.

volvo.defect: WIPERS MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY The wipers could function without being turned on or not at all because of a software error in the central electronic module.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the software in the central electronic module.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT When driving at low speeds a fault within the software calibration of the engine and transmission control modules may lead to a drop in the engine idle speed when braking or releasing the accelerator. In extreme cases this may result in the engine cutting out without warning.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the engine/transmission software.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE The engine oil  level may rise. This situation may lead to the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In an extreme situation the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and carry out a ECM software upgrade adjust engine oil level and install a decal to confirm oil level to the consumer.

volvo.defect: POWER STEERING FLUID MAY LEAK - RISK OF FIRE It has been identified that a joint between the power steering high pressure lines and the steering gear may not have been assembled correctly. This may result in a power steering hydraulic fluid leak and a sudden loss of steering assistance. Due to the pressure within the hydraulic system hydraulic fluid may be sprayed onto the engine with the attendant risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will check the subject joint and if necessary replace any cross threaded bolt. At the same time the joint will be modified.

volvo.defect: NEW SOFTWARE REQUIRED TO IMPROVE THE EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient emissions control and monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK The engine fuel rail may leak and cause drivability disturbances and a fuel leak
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and secure fuel rail end cover with a V- clamp

volvo.defect: CAB MAY FALL BACK OR OVER WHEN TILTING It has been identified that the lower attachment bolt for the cab tilting ram may have been torqued to too high a torque specification. This can result in the bolt becoming stretched which could cause a breakage of the bolt and the cab may either fall backwards or right forwards whilst it is being tilted.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the lower cab attachment bolt and torque to the correct specification.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER SEAT MAY NOT BE FITTED CORRECTLY It is possible that the driver's and passenger's front powered seats may not be fitted with the front stop lug. The lug restricts the movement of the seats and if not fitted it is possible to position the seats too far forward or backwards. This could increase the chances of injury should the vehicle be involved in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect for fitment of the lugs and if found to be missing fit new lugs.

volvo.defect: ENGINE LIFTING EYE CONCERN Due to engine vibrations the nearside (left hand) lifting bracket eye may crack and possibly break when lifting the engine out.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and cut off the eye from the engine lifting bracket.

volvo.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED. It is possible that an electrical short circuit within a connector could result in the illumination of the Airbag System Service Required message and Supplemental Restraint System warning lamp on the dashboard. Should this occur the driver's airbag would not deploy as intended if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and rework the connector.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING  THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
volvo.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SOFTWARE ISSUE IN THE VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY MODULE (VCM) There may be a software issue in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.
volvo.remedy: Upgrade software in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.

volvo.defect: AIR BAG MOUNTING MAY LOOSEN Part of the horn operating mechanism may foul the drivers air bag module and cause it to become loose on its mounting.
volvo.remedy: Replace the air bag mounting plate.

volvo.defect: WIRING HARNESS MAY CHAFE ON STEERING COLUMN When turning the steering wheel the electrical wiring cable harness can chafe on the steering column.  In the worst case a short circuit may occur.
volvo.remedy: Examine harness for chafing damage and repair or renew as appropriate.

volvo.defect: BRAKE PEDAL MAY BE INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED It has been identified there is a possibility that during production the split pin for the brake pedal cross shaft may not have been correctly  installed. This could result in the reduction of braking effort due to the movement of the cross shaft.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required fit a split pin or further secure the currently installed split pin.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: BOLTS COULD BECOME LOOSE ON BRAKE CALIPER BRIDGE. The holes on the brake caliper bridge may have been double threaded which may cause the bolts to become loose
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check part numbers and if necessary replace brake bridge

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL Affected vehicles  may have a crankshaft that has been insufficiently hardened which may fail and nay cause engine failure.
volvo.remedy: Check identity of crankshaft. If the relevant marking is not present then replace engine.

volvo.defect: FRONT SPOILER SIDE COVER CAN COME ADRIFT DURING OPERATION OF VEHICLE The front spoiler side cover could come adrift during operation of the vehicle
volvo.remedy: Check the side covers and adjust if required

volvo.defect: NEW SOFTWARE REQUIRED TO IMPROVE THE EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient emissions control and monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: POWER STEERING PIPE MAY LEAK. It has been established that the material in the power steering return line hose has not been manufactured to specification.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hose inspected and replaced as necessary.

volvo.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED. It is possible that an electrical short circuit within a connector could result in the illumination of the Airbag System Service Required message and Supplemental Restraint System warning lamp on the dashboard. Should this occur the driver's airbag would not deploy as intended if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and rework the connector.

volvo.defect: COOLANT LEAKAGE MAY RESULT IN A FIRE It has been identified that during the engine warm-up process and under certain driving/climate conditions for instance periods of high acceleration or high engine load immediately after a cold start in cold climates there is the possibility for coolant leakage or oil seepage. This can lead to the possibility in a worst-case scenario of smoke or a slow developing fire in the engine compartment. However the driver will receive a warning message on the Driver�s Information Module indicating a low coolant level.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to modify the coolant bypass valve and install a new exhaust manifold gasket.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF ABS CONTROL UNIT Some electronic control units for the ABS circuit may not be able to analyse information correctly. This may cause damage to the ABS solenoid valves and could affect braking performance.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles will be recalled to have the electronic control units checked. Where this is found to display a fault code it will be replaced together with the ABS solenoid valves.

volvo.defect: ROOF RAIL BOLTS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION It is possible that the security of the roof rack might be compromised due to incorrect mounting bolts being fitted.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the roof rack mounting bolts.

volvo.defect: EMERGENCY BRAKING SYSTEM MAY FUNCTION WITHOUT WARNING The Automatic Emergency Brake System (AEBS) may in certain traffic situations activate itself
volvo.remedy: Update the AEBS software

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE TRAILER DETACHMENT It has been identified that in adverse conditions the securing pin of the coupling release handle can become unfastened due to an oversize drilling. Loss of the pin can result in the coupling not being securely fastened.
volvo.remedy: Operators will be sent a repair kit to secure the pin. In addition a work method advising as to the pre-driving checks that need to be carried out.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF ENGINE OIL SPILLAGE Incidents have occurred where Bosch unit injectors built within a certain period can leak fuel into the engine lubrication system leading to the spillage of engine oil onto the roadway.
volvo.remedy: Likely to be affected vehicles to be recalled for checking and where necessary fit quality assured units.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE The engine oil  level may rise. This situation may lead to the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In an extreme situation the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and carry out a ECM software upgrade adjust engine oil level and install a decal to confirm oil level to the consumer.

volvo.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MODULE MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED Due to a potential manufacturing defect the gas generator in the driver�s airbag module may not deploy as intended. This may reduce the affectivities of the airbag.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag module.

volvo.defect: UNINTENDED SELECTION OF REVERSE GEAR Faulty software may activate reverse gear when travelling at speeds below 3 kph.
volvo.remedy: Provide new software for the engine transmission and gearshift control units.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT Vehicles may have incorrect routing of the B+ wire adjacent to the injection pump possibly resulting in a short circuit.
volvo.remedy: All vehicles will be recalled through the Volvo Network for the B+ cable to be rerouted.

volvo.defect: HEADLIGHTS AND REAR LIGHT MAY BECOME DISABLED The NOx sensor has a built in over voltage protection which is triggered by a voltage above 32 volts. When this is over the voltage protection and is active faults codes can be produced for example Headlight and Rear Lights can be disabled.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and modify software.

volvo.defect: UNINTENTIONAL OPERATION OF THE MASTER SWITCH The valve for pneumatic operation of the electrical main switch is so located that it is possible for the driver to operate the switch unintentionally. This could cause a total black out of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the pneumatic valve with a modified unit.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: FAILURE OF CERTAIN HOSES In some instances the hoses on the pressure side of the steering servo and fan propulsion systems may not meet the manufacturers specification and could be liable to failure.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject hoses replaced with quality assured parts.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY INCREASE WITHOUT WARNING. It is possible that the engine oil level may rise above its maximum level due to overfilling and/or dilution by fuel. This may result in the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal has been released. In extreme cases it is possible that the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and carry out an Engine Control Module software upgrade and adjust the engine oil.  The new ECM upgrade will improve adaption of different blends of fuel and include a dashboard text warning message if the oil level reaches too high a level.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING In certain cases a driver may experience sudden loss of power assistance to the steering due to voltage irregularities in the Electro Hydraulic Power Steering (EHPS) system.
volvo.remedy: This is a further action to a previous recall. On affected vehicles the invertor software is to be further updated to cope with voltage spikes / drops and to improve fault tracing. The braided earth cable will also be replaced by a copper cable to ensure the invertor earthing is secured.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASE Vehicles with manual gearboxes and start/stop functionality have Parking Brake Module (PBM) software that may allow the parking brake to unintentionally release. The unintended release of the parking brake can only occur when the engine is running and the gearstick moved so it will happen when the vehicle is attended.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download upgraded Parking Brake Module (PBM) software.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY APPLY WITHOUT WARNING OR LONGER THAN EXPECTED STOPPING DISTANCES COULD OCCUR The brake hoses for the front spring actuators are of insufficient length and the hoses for the front service brakes could be of insufficient length. In certain circumstances the hoses can detach from the nipple allowing the parking brakes to apply or in the case of service brake hose failure longer than expecting stopping distances could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front spring brake hoses and where necessary front service brake hoses with ones of sufficient length.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASE Vehicles with manual gearboxes and start/stop functionality have Parking Brake Module (PBM) software that may allow the parking brake to unintentionally release. The unintended release of the parking brake can only occur when the engine is running and the gearstick moved so it will happen when the vehicle is attended.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download upgraded Parking Brake Module (PBM) software.

volvo.defect: FRACTURE OF BRAKE CHAMBER SUPPORT BRACKETS Instances of cracking or breakage of the brake chamber support brackets have occurred on the second steering axle of the subject vehicles.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of modified brake chamber support brackets.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified thatthe fuel pump electronic module may not operate as intended. This can result in failure of the fuel pump to start. Should this occur the vehicle may suffer a non start rough running or in the worst case the engine may stall without prior warning. Investigation has shown that it may be possible to drive the vehicle for up to 100 m before the fault manifests itself.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the software within the central electronic module upgraded.

volvo.defect: RISK OF FIRE There is a possibility of a thermal malfunction on the fuel filter water separator bowl with the heater. This can result in overheating due to low fuel level in combination with a faulty thermostat in the water separator bowl
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles fit heat shield and check/reconnect cable in the electrical connector on the fuel filter/water separator housing

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: FLUID MAY LEAK INTO WIRING HARNESS WHICH MAY CAUSE FIRE A number of Volvo C30S40V50 and C70 may experience a problem with washer fluid leaking inside the washer pump unit through the wires into the central control electronic module.  This can impact on a number of different features of the vehicle but in the worst case it may lead to a fire.
volvo.remedy: The solution is to replace and then modify the wiring harness for the washer fluid pump.  In addition to this the washer pump connector will be inspected for any signs of corrosion and the washer pump will be replaced if necessary

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE On effected petrol and diesel engines a spring clamp on the radiator hose connecting it to the water inlet pipe may be insecure. If not rectified the engine may lose coolant overheat seize and suddenly slow the vehicle rapidly to a halt.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to have the radiator hose adequately secured.

volvo.defect: BOLTS MAY CRACK It has been identified that certain size mounting bolts may suffer Hydrogen Embrittlement which can cause them to fail. This can result in the bolts falling from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicle for the fitment of a replacement bolt kit.

volvo.defect: STEERING BALL JOINT TORQUE On some vehicles the bolts in the joint of the steering gear shafts may not be correctly torqued.
volvo.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles are being recalled to have the torque on all the bolts in the four joints in the steering shaft checked and where necessary tightened to the manufacturer's specification.

volvo.defect: SEAT BELT MAY NOT BEEN TORQUED CORRECTLY One or more screws holding the outer rear seat belts may not have been torqued correctly. This could lead to the seat belt not being as affective as it could be in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to re torque the mounting bolts.

volvo.defect: REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE CONCERN Left and right hand rear outer seat belt bottom fixing bolts may have been incorrectly torqued.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicle check and tighten the seat belt fixing bolts to the correct torque where necessary.

volvo.defect: A FUSE RATING HAS BEEN UNDER SPECIFIED AND COULD BLOW DURING NORMAL OPERATION CAUSING THE FULL ELECTRIC DRIVETRAIN TO SHUTDOWN A fuse rating has been under specified and could blow during normal operation causing the full electric drivetrain to shutdown
volvo.remedy: Fit uprated 400amp fuse to position F251

volvo.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE It is possible that the right hand driveshaft may not have been manufactured to the correct specification.  This can ultimately result in the failure of the drive shaft.  This will be identified to the driver by noise and the loss of drive.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the right hand driveshaft.

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR Wiring and harnesses to alternators starter pre-heater and other ancilliary functions could abrade and cause a short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to re-route and secure the affected harnesses and cables.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED The cover on the top of the engine cover could chafe against the brake vacuum hose.  If this occurs it may lead to a vacuum leak in the brake booster system and a gradual reduction of brake booster assistance.  The will lead to the brake pedal becoming harder to push than normal and increased force would be required to stop the car.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and replace the vacuum hose if necessary.  The hose will also be fitted with a safety net to prevent chafing in the future.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY INCREASE WITHOUT WARNING. It is possible that the engine oil level may rise above its maximum level due to overfilling and/or dilution by fuel. This may result in the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal has been released. In extreme cases it is possible that the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and carry out an Engine Control Module software upgrade and adjust the engine oil.  The new ECM upgrade will improve adaption of different blends of fuel and include a dashboard text warning message if the oil level reaches too high a level.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE PARKING BRAKE AIR TUBE CAN BE AFFECTED BY HEAT EXPOSURE During operation of the vehicle with high loads on the engine combined with an exhaust leakage in the engine compartment there is a risk that the parking brake air tube can be affected by heat exposure.
volvo.remedy: Retrofit a protection sleeve on the parking brake tube.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY LOOSE DRIVE AND POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE. The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: SUPPORT MEMBER MAY CRACK It is possible that stress cracks may occur in the offside main support member within the engine bay which could affect the vehicle structural performance if it is involved in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection of the subject member and report findings to Volvo Car UK Ltd; who will then decide on the level of the repair.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software

volvo.defect: SIDE AIRBAG MAY NOT WORK AS INTENDED It has been identified that the subject vehicles may have a software error within  the side impact protection system (SIPS)  As a result the inflatable side curtains may not operate as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the SIPS system ECU software upgraded.

volvo.defect: REAR PASSENGER SEAT BELT PRE TENSIONER MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION The pre-tensioner in the driver�s side third row passenger seat belt may not have been produced according to the correct specification In the event of a collision the pre tensioner and seat belt will still operate as intended but a very small part could  enter the passenger compartment. As a temporary measure until the seat belt has been replaced it is recommended that the seat belt is not used.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the seat belt.

volvo.defect: LEAKAGE OF FUEL A particular batch of injectors may be of poor quality and allow fuel to leak on to the engine with a subsequent risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject injectors replaced with quality assured units.

volvo.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY NOT RETURN TO RESTING POSITION Accelerator pedal may be prevented from returning to its rest position by the floor mat.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the floor mat with a shorter version.

volvo.defect: OIL LEAK MAY OCCUR It is possible for oil leaks to develop as a result of o-rings of incorrect specification being fitted to the oil pipes connected to the filter housing and cooling duct. If not rectified oil can leak onto the road surface and endanger other road users.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the o-rings with ones of the correct specification.

volvo.defect: REAR AXLE V-STAY BALL JOINT CAN PREMATURELY WEAR. At high inclination the sealing boot of the axle 'V' stay ball joint can be damaged and allow the ingress of water and dirt which can cause the ball joint to wear prematurely and cause the axle to become loose.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit modified 'V' stay

volvo.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
volvo.remedy: Check and If found then replacement of Silencer

volvo.defect: CLUTCH PEDAL MECHANISM MAY FAIL The rod connecting the clutch master cylinder and the clutch pedal may break.  It may not be possible to disengage the clutch.  In worst cases this may happen suddenly with no warning to the driver.  If this happens bring the car to a safe stop using the engine and switch off the ignition.
volvo.remedy: Replace clutch master cylinder with a new metal push rod in-place of the plastic one.

volvo.defect: REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE CONCERN Left and right hand rear outer seat belt bottom fixing bolts may have been incorrectly torqued.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicle check and tighten the seat belt fixing bolts to the correct torque where necessary.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY APPLY UNINTENTIONALLY The brake pipe unions (Air Nipples) on the parking/hand brake system have been tightened above the specified torque setting.  This could result in the unions failing and cause an unintentional deployment of the parking/hand brake.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles where the unions will be replaced and the correct torque setting applied.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE The engine oil  level may rise. This situation may lead to the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In an extreme situation the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and carry out a ECM software upgrade adjust engine oil level and install a decal to confirm oil level to the consumer.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF IGNITION LOCK CABLE HARNESS The ignition lock cable harness may become damaged by chafing against the steering column. This could eventually cause a short circuit and possible fire risk.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles. Reposition the ignition lock cable harness and secure it clear of the steering column with a strip clip.

volvo.defect: TRACK ROD CLAMPING BOLTS The front axle track rod clamping bolts may have been insufficiently torqued on assembly.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the clamping bolt torque. If required the bolts will be retorqued to the correct tightness.

volvo.defect: FOOTBRAKE VALVE MAY FAIL The top bushing of the footbrake valve may move which in the worst case can decrease the ability to stop the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check test and where necessary replace the footbrake valve.  In addition a yoke securing kit will be installed to all affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: HAND CONTROL VALVE FAILURE Failure of the parking brake valve upper cam plate around the central boss may allow the parking brake to release and could result in the vehicle running away.
volvo.remedy: Strip the valve and replace the upper cam plate tensioning springs and 'O' ring with quality assured items.

volvo.defect: CRACKING IN THE HEAT EXCHANGER A crack in the heat exchanger caused by high pressure peaks in the heating system may result in coolant entering the body-builder electrical centre.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for signs of coolant loss and fitted with a shield to protect the electrical centre.

volvo.defect: There is a risk that the parking brake efficiency is reduced/lost or that the rear brake is blocked/dragging on one or two of the rear wheels. There is a risk that the parking brake efficiency is reduced/lost or that the rear brake is blocked/dragging on one or two of the rear wheels.
volvo.remedy: Replace the concerned spring brake cylinder/cylinders.

volvo.defect: SEATBELT MAY SEPARATE FROM THE BUCKLE It has been identified there is a possibility the front seatbelt buckle stud may not have been punched correctly during production. This may result in a separation between the buckle and seatbelt bracket if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the seatbelt buckle and if required to replace the seatbelt buckle.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: There is a risk that the parking brake efficiency is reduced/lost or that the rear brake is blocked/dragging on one or two of the rear wheels. There is a risk that the parking brake efficiency is reduced/lost or that the rear brake is blocked/dragging on one or two of the rear wheels.
volvo.remedy: Replace the concerned spring brake cylinder/cylinders.

volvo.defect: OIL MAY LEAK It is possible that the oil filter housing to be pierced by the valve cone. This could lead to loss of oil and engine seizure.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the oil filter housing.

volvo.defect: CHILD RESTRAINT ANCHOR BRACKET CONCERN The bolts securing the child restraint anchor bracket to the rear floor at the right hand side may have been insufficiently tightened. If an ISOFIX type child restraint is fitted to this bracket it may be insecure.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles check and tighten the anchor bracket bolts where necessary.

volvo.defect: SIDE IMPACT PROTECTION SYSTEM CONCERN Transposed wiring in the side impact protection system (SIPS) may result in deployment of the air bag opposite to the side of an impact.
volvo.remedy: Check the electrical wiring connections of the SIPS installation and correct any which are found to be transposed.

volvo.defect: RISK OF ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT A potential chafing condition has been identified between the alternator power cables and urea coolant pipe which may result in short circuit. Electrical cables might short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Add a rubber spacer with cable tie to secure power cables from chafing on coolant pipe. If the power cable is identified to be damaged the cable will be replaced.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF REAR AXLE U BOLTS The material hardness of the rear axle spring U bolts may be too high. As a consequence they could break and allow dislocation of the axle.
volvo.remedy: Check the tioghtness of the rear axle spring U bolts. If any U bolt breaks before the the specified torque is achieved all U bolts on the affected axle must be replaced.

volvo.defect: THE ELECTRIC STEERING PUMP INVERTER SHUTS OFF WHEN THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED OFF EVEN IF THE VEHICLE IS MOVING The Electric Steering Pump inverter shuts off when the ignition is switched off even if the vehicle is moving.
volvo.remedy: Change the steering pump wiring.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There could be a sudden and unexpected failure of the bottom end of the engine because of a non-conformity during production of the connecting rods.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the engine.

volvo.defect: AUXILIARY DRIVE BELT CONCERN A fault in the alternator drive pulley may cause the auxiliary drive belt to break which would result in a loss of power assistance to the steering.  A broken drive belt may also damage the cambelt and cause engine failure.
volvo.remedy: Fit a modified alternator drive pulley

volvo.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY IN A COLLISION It has been identified that the wiring harness for the SRS system may not have been correctly attached to the front seat frames. It is possible that continued adjustment of the seat position may cause the harness to become detached. If this should occur a warning light will illuminate on the instrument panel warning the driver of a fault with the SRS system.  However in this condition the front and side airbags may not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for an inspection of the wiring harnesses and ensure that it is correctly routed and secured.  If not then reroute and securing of the wiring harness.

volvo.defect: EXHAUST EMISSION CRITERIA IS NOT MET It has been identified that an issue with the engine software may affect the vehicle's exhaust emissions and an issue with the regenerations of the SCR brick.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to update the engine software.

volvo.defect: AUXILIARY DRIVE BELT CONCERN A fault in the alternator drive pulley may cause the auxiliary drive belt to break which would result in a loss of power assistance to the steering.  A broken drive belt may also damage the cambelt and cause engine failure.
volvo.remedy: Fit a modified alternator drive pulley

volvo.defect: Under certain circumstances there is a risk that the two 12V batteries and its power cables might overheat. Under certain circumstances there is a risk that the two 12V batteries and its power cables might overheat.
volvo.remedy: The software will be updated with a new strategy to prevent excessive electrical currents into the 12V batteries.

volvo.defect: TAG AXLE HUB MAY DISLODGE It has been identified that due to a misalignment of the weld and poor root penetration of the weld fillet material the TAG axle hub may dislodge from the axle.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the TAG axle replaced.

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT - FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that on vehicles fitted with a supplementary cabin heater the unit may contain a faulty valve which links the heater to the climate control. The valve in question may become clogged which could lead to poor water drainage and in extreme cases a short circuit. Should sufficient heat be generated by the short circuit a fire behind the instrument panel below the radio may occur.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject valve replaced.

volvo.defect: FOOTBRAKE VALVE MAY FAIL The top bushing of the footbrake valve may move which in the worst case can decrease the ability to stop the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check test and where necessary replace the footbrake valve.  In addition a yoke securing kit will be installed to all affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY NOT RETURN TO RESTING POSITION Accelerator pedal may be prevented from returning to its rest position by the floor mat.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the floor mat with a shorter version.

volvo.defect: INTERACTION OF SEAT BELT WITH AIR SUSPENDED DRIVING SEAT Operation of the air suspended driving seat could be impaired if due to normal vertical movement of the seat the drivers seat belt should retract beyond its normal rest position. Excessive retraction could also cause difficulty in disengaging the
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a button to the webbing which will prevent excessive retraction of the seat belt.

volvo.defect: INTERFERENCE BETWEEN STEERING SHAFT AND COLUMN When the steering column is extended to it's maximum position then as far as possible towards the driver an interference may occur between the lower part of the steering shaft and the column housing.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be checked for the existence of the fault if found the cause of the fouling will be removed with a file.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner can suffer from premature wear which may cause it to fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: WINDSCREEN MAY SEPARATE FROM SUPPORT AREAS ON IMPACT Internal test have shown that due to contamination of the windscreen primer if the vehicle is subject to an impact the windsceen may separate from the support area of the roof and pillars.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected inspect and where necessary replace the windscreen

volvo.defect: CLUTCH PEDAL MECHANISM MAY FAIL The rod connecting the clutch master cylinder and the clutch pedal may break.  It may not be possible to disengage the clutch.  In worst cases this may happen suddenly with no warning to the driver.  If this happens bring the car to a safe stop using the engine and switch off the ignition.
volvo.remedy: Replace clutch master cylinder with a new metal push rod in-place of the plastic one.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY LOOSE DRIVE AND POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE. The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models.. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: RISK OF FIRE There is a possibility of a thermal malfunction on the fuel filter water separator bowl with the heater. This can result in overheating due to low fuel level in combination with a faulty thermostat in the water separator bowl
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles fit heat shield and check/reconnect cable in the electrical connector on the fuel filter/water separator housing

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL Affected vehicles  may have a crankshaft that has been insufficiently hardened which may fail and nay cause engine failure.
volvo.remedy: Check identity of crankshaft. If the relevant marking is not present then replace engine.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT When driving at low speeds a fault within the software calibration of the engine and transmission control modules may lead to a drop in the engine idle speed when braking or releasing the accelerator. In extreme cases this may result in the engine cutting out without warning.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the engine/transmission software.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY NOT MEET STANDARD ECE R55 WHERE A TOWING HOOK MUST HAVE AN ATTACHMENT FOR THE SAFETY WIRE Vehicle may not meet standard ECE R55 where a towing hook must also have an attachment for the safety wire.
volvo.remedy: Add attachment for safety wire.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT It is possible that the hose connection between the coolant expansion tank and the bleed hose can work loose. If this should occur then coolant will leak and air will enter the system. Under these conditions the low coolant level warning light will not function. If the vehicle is driven in this condition it will cause engine damage and in the extreme possible failure.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicle to replace the tank and bleeder hose.

volvo.defect: INSUFFICIENT TORQUE ON FASTENERS FOR AUXILIARY STEERING ARMS The tightening torque of the threaded fasteners securing the auxiliary steering arms to the frame may be too low.
volvo.remedy: Check and  tighten the fasteners to the specified torque where found necessary.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM ADEQUATELY Brake assistance from the vacuum pressure pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the non-return valve in the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY LOSE POWER It has been identified that due to a problem within the engine ECU (flexi-fuel engines only) the engine torque may be reduced with the attendant possibility that limp home mode may be activated.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the engine ECU software upgraded.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY INCREASE WITHOUT WARNING. It is possible that the engine oil level may rise above its maximum level due to overfilling and/or dilution by fuel. This may result in the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal has been released. In extreme cases it is possible that the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and carry out an Engine Control Module software upgrade and adjust the engine oil.  The new ECM upgrade will improve adaption of different blends of fuel and include a dashboard text warning message if the oil level reaches too high a level.

volvo.defect: RISK OF FIRE There is a possibility of a thermal malfunction on the fuel filter water separator bowl with the heater. This can result in overheating due to low fuel level in combination with a faulty thermostat in the water separator bowl
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles fit heat shield and check/reconnect cable in the electrical connector on the fuel filter/water separator housing

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain five cylinder engines it is possible that the high pressure fuel pipes may not have been correctly installed and may leak. This should be identified by a smell of fuel from the engine bay. However it is possible that in extreme cases an engine bay fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the high pressure pipes.

volvo.defect: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT Premature degradation of emission control component.
volvo.remedy: Check and If found then replacement of Silencer

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: THE GATEWAY FUNCTION IN THE EBS IS NOT ACTIVATED The red indicator lamp for the EBS function will not activate when a trailer with EBS is connected. The EBS functionality is not affected.
volvo.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and initiate the appropriate software function.

volvo.defect: A SPECIFIC RELAY ASSEMBLED IN THE VEHICLE MAY SHORT CIRCUIT There is a risk that a specific relay assembled in the vehicle may short-circuit.
volvo.remedy: : Replace the power relay of affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: Dependent on affected Model update software. Until updated the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG MAY INADVERTENTLY DEPLOY Possibility that passenger side air bag may be sensitive to electrostatic discharge and may inadvertently deploy.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit an additional grounding wire to electrical system.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: THE STARTER MOTOR MAY ENGAGE INCORRECTLY The starter motor may engage incorrectly and this may lead to a noise when starting the engine or even non-start.
volvo.remedy: Download modified software.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY LOSE POWER It has been identified that due to a problem within the engine ECU (flexi-fuel engines only) the engine torque may be reduced with the attendant possibility that limp home mode may be activated.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the engine ECU software upgraded.
