volvo.defect: GEARBOX SHIELD MAY OVERHEAT It is possible for the gearbox noise shield  to come in contact with a high temperature heat source such as the exhaust pipe.  This could under special driving conditions lead to smoke and glow from the gearbox noise shield. There will be no fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the gearbox noise shield.

volvo.defect: DRAG LINK JOINTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TORQUED It has been identified that the drag link rod ball joints and/or at the link rod clamp may not have been torqued to the correct specification.  It is therefore possible that the securing nuts may become loose. This can result in the drag link rod detaching from the spindle arm or the pitman arm.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and check the torque of the securing nuts. If found to be incorrect then replace the drag link.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain five cylinder engines it is possible that the high pressure fuel pipes may not have been correctly installed and may leak. This should be identified by a smell of fuel from the engine bay. However it is possible that in extreme cases an engine bay fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the high pressure pipes.

volvo.defect: THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER SEAT RAILS MAY HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED INCORRECTLY The driver and passenger seat rails may have been incorrectly assembled.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and ensure that the seat rails are correctly installed.

volvo.defect: ENGINE HATCH MAY SHOW CLOSED IN ERROR ENABLING ENGINE TO BE STARTED It has been identified that due to corrosion the engine hatch switches may become stuck in closed or compressed position. This will indicate that the hatch is closed regardless of whether the hatch is in the open or closed position. In this condition the engine can be started with the hatch in the open position. This will therefore pose a risk of injury to any maintenance staff working in the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the current switches with new roller type switches.

volvo.defect: REAR WHEELS MAY LOOSEN It has been identified that on the subject vehicles the rear wheel studs may be of an incorrect size. This in rare cases may during particular forms of low speed manoeuvring result in the wheel becoming loose.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear wheel studs inspected and changed to a modified type as necessary.

volvo.defect: CRACKING OF STEERING PITMAN ARM There have been instances of some steering Pitman arms cracking.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the original Pitman arms with quality assured versions.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL There is a possibility that the clamp bolt on the drag link tube may not have been tightened to the correct torque. In the worst case a loss of steering control could occur.
volvo.remedy: Check clamp bolt for correct torque and tighten where necessary. If found finger loose replace the complete drag link assembly.

volvo.defect: WHEEL MAY BECOME LOOSE It has been identified that the standard wheel securing bolts may not have undergone the correct hardening process. This will result in corrosion a noise and/or vibration. If this condition is not rectified there is a possibility that the wheel may become loose and detach.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the standard wheel bolts.

volvo.defect: THIRD ROW PASSENGER AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED Affected vehicles have interior panels that may prevent the inflatable curtain airbags from deploying as intended. This could reduce the level of protection offered to third row passengers in the event of an accident.
volvo.remedy: Modify affected interior panels to allow the inflatable curtains to deploy as intended.

volvo.defect: RISK OF FIRE Due to exposure of water and dirt intrusion in the engine compartment the alternators may fail prematurely due to seized bearings. In the worst case an alternator could overheat causing an engine compartment fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and if the mileage is over 60000km replace both alternators and drive belt. All vehicles are to have existing protection shields replaced with new improved versions.

volvo.defect: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
volvo.remedy: Update EMS software

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR A heat shield mounted on the frame can fall down on the starter motor and could cause a short circuit.The heat shield breaks due to fatigue caused by vibrations.
volvo.remedy: Remove heat shield.

volvo.defect: AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY IN A COLLISION It has been identified that the wiring harness for the SRS system may not have been correctly attached to the front seat frames. It is possible that continued adjustment of the seat position may cause the harness to become detached. If this should occur a warning light will illuminate on the instrument panel warning the driver of a fault with the SRS system.  However in this condition the front and side airbags may not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles for an inspection of the wiring harnesses and ensure that it is correctly routed and secured.  If not then reroute and securing of the wiring harness.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT The B+ cable can chafe against the cab anchorage.  This will cause the insulation on the cable to wear and ultimately result in a short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Examine B+ cable for chafing damage and repair or renew as appropriate.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF TURBO OIL PIPE The clamp securing the turbo charger oil pipe may break and allow the pipe to fracture due to vibration. This would lead to oil being deposited on the engine with an attendant risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the turbo charger oil pipe replaced with a hose.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL It has been identified that due to a possible communication error between the Central Electronic Module (CEM)and the Engine Control Module (ECM) the engine may over run and break down.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have new software downloaded into the CEM

volvo.defect: FUEL LEAKAGE FROM CAB HEATER PUMP There is a possibility of fuel leakage between the cab heater fuel pump housing and its cover.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and inspect the cab heater pump for signs of fuel leakage. Where there is evidence of this the fuel pump will be replaced. On pumps not exhibiting signs of leakage the pump cover retaining screws will be replaced.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX  MAY NOT ENGAGE OR SHIFT GEARS AS INTENDED It has been identified that due to internal leakage the gearbox hydraulic control module may not be able to engage or shift gears as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the gearbox replaced.

volvo.defect: BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE AFFECTED Brake servo assistance from the vacuum pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a modified non-return valve to the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: Screws that attach the front axle to the suspension may require tightening Potential that the screws for the front axle attachment might lose torque or come loose.
volvo.remedy: Apply correct torque value on concerned screws and/or replace defected parts.

volvo.defect: Under certain circumstances there is a risk that the two 12V batteries and its power cables might overheat. Under certain circumstances there is a risk that the two 12V batteries and its power cables might overheat.
volvo.remedy: The software will be updated with a new strategy to prevent excessive electrical currents into the 12V batteries.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER HAND POLES MAY BECOME INSECURE Passenger hand poles may become insecure.
volvo.remedy: Fit modified seat consoles hand poles & roof poles.

volvo.defect: SPRING BRAKE CHAMBER OPERATION MAY BE AFFECTED IN LOW TEMPERATURES Water may have been left in the rear Spring Brake Chambers after the production washing process which may freeze under cold conditions and effect the operation of the system
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles to drain the actuators.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF ENGINE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM The engine management system could possibly continue to use the the last received data from the vehicle ECU. For example in the event of a datalink short  the vehicle may not switch to limp home  mode but continue to respond to the last received command from either the throttle or   cruise control.
volvo.remedy: Re-programme  the engine ECU (EECU).

volvo.defect: THE AFTER TREATMENT INJECTOR PIPE MAY CRACK AND LEAK The after treatment injector pipe may crack and leak.
volvo.remedy: Software update to provide a warning that system fault exists in the event of a cracked pipe.

volvo.defect: FLUID MAY LEAK INTO WIRING HARNESS WHICH MAY CAUSE FIRE A number of Volvo C30S40V50 and C70 may experience a problem with washer fluid leaking inside the washer pump unit through the wires into the central control electronic module.  This can impact on a number of different features of the vehicle but in the worst case it may lead to a fire.
volvo.remedy: The solution is to replace and then modify the wiring harness for the washer fluid pump.  In addition to this the washer pump connector will be inspected for any signs of corrosion and the washer pump will be replaced if necessary

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY LOOSE DRIVE AND POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE. The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: CRACKING OF REAR SUSPENSION VEE STAYS Instances of cracking on the tube section of the rear suspension vee stays have occurred.
volvo.remedy: The vee stays on affected vehicles are being inspected for cracks by Volvo dealers. Where there is no evidence of cracking the stays will be strengthened by the fitment of re-inforcing clamps. In cases where cracking has occurred this will be repaired

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL The crankshaft may not have been sufficiently hardened and may fail this in turn can lead to sudden and catastrophic engine failure. The failure may be preceded by loss of power and a knocking noise.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL The material of the steering arm bolts may not be to specification. As a result the bolts could crack and if not rectified the bolts could eventually fail totally causing loss of directional control.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering arm bolts.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY STALL It has been identified that;  on assembly of the engine mounting bracket incorrect screws may have been used. This can result in breakage of the bracket which can lead to heavy engine vibrations/noise and reduced engine power or stalling due to the limp home mode being activated.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will the engine mounting bracket screws replaced.

volvo.defect: COOLANT LEAKAGE MAY RESULT IN A FIRE It has been identified that during the engine warm-up process and under certain driving/climate conditions for instance periods of high acceleration or high engine load immediately after a cold start in cold climates there is the possibility for coolant leakage or oil seepage. This can lead to the possibility in a worst-case scenario of smoke or a slow developing fire in the engine compartment. However the driver will receive a warning message on the Driver�s Information Module indicating a low coolant level.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to modify the coolant bypass valve and install a new exhaust manifold gasket.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL There is a possibility that the clamp bolt on the drag link tube may not have been tightened to the correct torque. In the worst case a loss of steering control could occur.
volvo.remedy: Check clamp bolt for correct torque and tighten where necessary. If found finger loose replace the complete drag link assembly.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAKAGE The engine fuel injectors may suffer a quality problem concerning the connection to the supply pipe.  This may cause cracking of the connection and a consequential fuel leak.
volvo.remedy: Check and/or change the injectors.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: BOLTS MAY CRACK It has been identified that certain size mounting bolts may suffer Hydrogen Embrittlement which can cause them to fail. This can result in the bolts falling from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicle for the fitment of a replacement bolt kit.

volvo.defect: The turbocharger may permit an excessive amount of oil carry over to the charge air circuit after a short period of time in service. The turbocharger may permit an excessive amount of oil carry over to the charge air circuit after a short period of time in service.
volvo.remedy: Replace turbocharger with a newer version

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT When driving at low speeds a fault within the software calibration of the engine and transmission control modules may lead to a drop in the engine idle speed when braking or releasing the accelerator. In extreme cases this may result in the engine cutting out without warning.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the engine/transmission software.

volvo.defect: HAND CONTROL VALVE FAILURE Failure of the parking brake valve upper cam plate around the central boss may allow the parking brake to release and could result in the vehicle running away.
volvo.remedy: Strip the valve and replace the upper cam plate tensioning springs and 'O' ring with quality assured items.

volvo.defect: ERRATIC ACCELERATOR BEHAVIOUR A faulty accelerator pedal sensor may cause erratic accelerator operation during operation of the accelerator pedal.This may vary between no throttle reaction to a speed greater than expected for a throttle position
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the accelerator pedal with a new variant and install an adapter wiring harness

volvo.defect: THE FRONT AND SIDE SPOILER COVERS COULD COME ADRIFT DURING VEHICLE OPERATION The front and side spoiler side covers could come adrift during vehicle operation.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and if required carry out adjustments to the front spoiler side covers and add a new design to the side spoiler covers.

volvo.defect: FUEL GUAGE MAY NOT SHOW FUEL LEVEL CORRECTLY Fuel gauge may not show correct level
volvo.remedy: The remedy is not yet available for all models.. Until a remedy is available the manufacturer advises to maintain fuel level above approx one third.

volvo.defect: Screws that attach the front axle to the suspension may require tightening Potential that the screws for the front axle attachment might lose torque or come loose.
volvo.remedy: Apply correct torque value on concerned screws and/or replace defected parts.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SUSPENSION COLLAPSE The nut securing the front suspension strut lower ball joint to the control arm may loose its axial tension due to an out tolerance condition. This could adversely affect the directional control of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Fit a modified ball joint to control arm securing nut.

volvo.defect: ADAPTIVE CRUISE CONTROL  MALFUNCTION Should the adaptive cruise control (ACC) radar malfunction the cruise control will not deactivate automatically. As a consequence the vehicle will accelerate up to the set speed of the cruise control even though ACC is active.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and inspect the system; rectifying as necessary.

volvo.defect: FUSE BOX CONNECTIONS INSECURE The flange nut can seize on the thread of the studs in the fuse box which could mean the terminals do not have the correct torque and may be loose. This could cause arcing.
volvo.remedy: Check fuse box; Replace all fuse box cable flange nuts to new correct type nuts and tighten to correct torque. If necessary replace the fuse box

volvo.defect: STALLING AND LOSS OF STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE Involved vehicles may have a software issue which could cause the engine to momentarily cut-out and restart while driving. This could also cause disturbances in some electrical systems such as shut down of the instrument cluster infotainment system and loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and upgrade the software of the control units.

volvo.defect: POWER STEERING MAY BE AFFECTED The hydraulic servo pipe can become loose from its connection which could leak and lead to the loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to reposition the hydraulic servo hose.

volvo.defect: AIR FILTER IN THE AIR INTAKE MAY IGNITE There is a possibility that a foreign object may enter the air intake. Air intake efficiency could be reduced and the intake might ignite should for example a lighted cigarette be sucked into the system.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace existing air intake with a modified air intake equipped with a steel grille.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF FUEL PIPE The pipes between the fuel filter and the injection pump may fracture due to internal stress and allow fuel to leak into the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the pipes in question for leakage and/or damage replacing where necessary. In all cases a modified pipe support bracket will be fitted and certain early engines will be equipped with a modified fuel filter

volvo.defect: UNINTENTIONAL OPERATION OF THE MASTER SWITCH The valve for pneumatic operation of the electrical main switch is so located that it is possible for the driver to operate the switch unintentionally. This could cause a total black out of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the pneumatic valve with a modified unit.

volvo.defect: STALLING AND LOSS OF STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE Involved vehicles may have a software issue which could cause the engine to momentarily cut-out and restart while driving. This could also cause disturbances in some electrical systems such as shut down of the instrument cluster infotainment system and loss of power steering assistance.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and upgrade the software of the control units.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: ADR SIGN MAY NOT COMPLY WITH FIRE RETARDENT REQUIREMENTS The ADR sign is fitted to the front grille in a way which will prevent it from resisting high temperatures and as such it will not comply with the ADR legal requirements
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and introduce a steel wire between the ADR sign and grille so that it will resist heat for 15 minutes.

volvo.defect: SIPS SYSTEM MAY NOT DEPLOY WHEN REQUIRED It has been identified that the wiring harness for the Side Impact Protection System airbag (SIPS) on the drivers and passengers front seats may have been routed incorrectly. This could result in the wiring harness becoming damaged which will illuminate the Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) light on the instrument panel. If the SRS light is illuminated then additional care should be taken when driving the vehicle as SRS functions may be affected.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the routing of the wiring harness and if required reroute it and repair any damage.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Fuel may leak from a defective fuel pressure line. Although unlikely there is a potential that an external ignition source could ignite the fuel and result in a fire in the driver's side wheel arch area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the fuel pressure line.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL  LEAK FROM INJECTOR PIPES. The fuel injector pipes may not have been fitted correctly and as a consequence could leak.
volvo.remedy: Examine all potentially affected vehicles and replace any incorrectly fitted injector pipes.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF UPPER STEERING ARM The screws securing the upper steering arm may have been overtightened damaging the threads of the screws and the threads in the steering arm knuckle. In the worst case situation a loss of steering control could result.
volvo.remedy: Remove the screws from the steering arm knuckle and examine the threads on both components for damage. Fit new bolts in all cases and new steering arms when the threads in the knuckle are found to be damaged.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG MAY INADVERTENTLY DEPLOY Possibility that passenger side air bag may be sensitive to electrostatic discharge and may inadvertently deploy.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit an additional grounding wire to electrical system.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED The cover on the top of the engine cover could chafe against the brake vacuum hose.  If this occurs it may lead to a vacuum leak in the brake booster system and a gradual reduction of brake booster assistance.  The will lead to the brake pedal becoming harder to push than normal and increased force would be required to stop the car.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and replace the vacuum hose if necessary.  The hose will also be fitted with a safety net to prevent chafing in the future.

volvo.defect: THE ENGINE PRE-HEATER RELAY MAY OVERHEAT AND FAIL The engine pre-heater relay may overheat and fail due to short circuit between the 24V and ground on the printed circuit board (PCB).
volvo.remedy: Modify pre-heater relay harness by connection of extension cable with fuse. Replace pre-heater relay as required.

volvo.defect: STEERING GEAR SECURITY The bolts securing the steering gear to its mounting bracket may be loose.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the steering gear mounting bolts for tightness. Where bolts are found to be loose the mounting brackets and bolts will be examined for damage. Damaged bolts will be replaced and any burring of the bracket removed.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR Under certain circumstances there might be water ingress into the control unit of the overnight/parking heater which may cause a short circuit.  In extreme circumstances it may result in a fire.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace the control unit with a quality assured component.

volvo.defect: ADAPTIVE CRUISE CONTROL  MALFUNCTION Should the adaptive cruise control (ACC) radar malfunction the cruise control will not deactivate automatically. As a consequence the vehicle will accelerate up to the set speed of the cruise control even though ACC is active.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and inspect the system; rectifying as necessary.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING  THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
volvo.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

volvo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK It has been identified that the fuel rail beneath the vehicle that protects the fuel line may not be properly attached thereby exposing the fuel lines to possible damage.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicle will have the security of the subject rail checked. It will be secured if this is seen to be necessary.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY RUN ON It is possible in certain circumstances for the engine oil level to rise above the maximum level. This situation could lead to engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In extreme cases the engine could continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to adjust the engine oil level and carry out a software upgrade.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: LEAKAGE OF FUEL A particular batch of injectors may be of poor quality and allow fuel to leak on to the engine with a subsequent risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject injectors replaced with quality assured units.

volvo.defect: PRE-HEAT RELAY MAY STICK AND OVERHEAT The pre-heat relay may become stuck in the closed position which could cause an over heating of the relay.  If action is not taken to rectify this issue then there is the potential in extreme cases that the risk of fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and disconnect the relay.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF AIR DEFLECTORS Due to poor bonding it is possible that the side air deflectors on the cab rear wall may become detached.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace air deflectors.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified thatthe fuel pump electronic module may not operate as intended. This can result in failure of the fuel pump to start. Should this occur the vehicle may suffer a non start rough running or in the worst case the engine may stall without prior warning. Investigation has shown that it may be possible to drive the vehicle for up to 100 m before the fault manifests itself.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the software within the central electronic module upgraded.

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING  THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
volvo.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

volvo.defect: THE ELECTRIC PUMP INVERTER SHUTS OFF WHEN THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED OFF EVEN IF THE VEHICLE IS MOVING The Electric Steering Pump inverter shuts off when the ignition is switched off even if the vehicle is moving.
volvo.remedy: Change to wiring to keep the EHPS function on when the vehicle is moving with ignition switched off.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY RUN ON It is possible in certain circumstances for the engine oil level to rise above the maximum level. This situation could lead to engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In extreme cases the engine could continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to adjust the engine oil level and carry out a software upgrade.

volvo.defect: EXHAUST FUMES MAY ENTER THE CAB It is possible for the exhaust pipe of the parking heater to be squeezed and restricted which could result in exhaust fumes entering the cab.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the exhaust pipe and clamp. Additionally the drain hole on the exhaust silencer is to be closed.

volvo.defect: BRAKE CHAMBER MOUNTING BRACKETS The drive and trailing axle brake chamber mounting bracket welds may be faulty and subsequently crack.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles examine the mounting brackets and renew where necessary.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain five cylinder engines it is possible that the high pressure fuel pipes may not have been correctly installed and may leak. This should be identified by a smell of fuel from the engine bay. However it is possible that in extreme cases an engine bay fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the high pressure pipes.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE The engine oil  level may rise. This situation may lead to the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In an extreme situation the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and carry out a ECM software upgrade adjust engine oil level and install a decal to confirm oil level to the consumer.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF DRIVE It is possible that the right hand driveshaft may not have been manufactured to the correct specification.  This can ultimately result in the failure of the drive shaft.  This will be identified to the driver by noise and the loss of drive.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the right hand driveshaft.

volvo.defect: ROOF MOUNTED BATTERY HATCH MAY OPEN INADVERTENTLY The fixings for the roof mounted battery hatch may unwind and allow the hatch to open whilst the vehicle is in motion.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fixings for the safety hook the upper and lower lock mechanism brackets and include washers and thread locking compound.

volvo.defect: WIPERS MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY The wipers could function without being turned on or not at all because of a software error in the central electronic module.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to upgrade the software in the central electronic module.

volvo.defect: During driving or idle the O-Ring may become twisted or break.  Should this occur there could be an oil leak a message for low engine oil level displayed in the vehicle or an unusual smell in the cabin.  In a worst case scenario this could cause a thermal event. During driving or idle the O-Ring may become twisted or break.  Should this occur there could be an oil leak a message for low engine oil level displayed in the vehicle or an unusual smell in the cabin.  In a worst case scenario this could cause a thermal event.
volvo.remedy: Replace O-Ring

volvo.defect: On affected vehicles a Gel battery can without warning crack open. The GEL battery can produce an internal spark in the battery potentially igniting the hydrogen gas inside the battery. On affected vehicles a Gel battery can without warning crack open. The GEL battery can produce an internal spark in the battery potentially igniting the hydrogen gas inside the battery.�
volvo.remedy: Inspect Replace battery�

volvo.defect: INCORRECT LOAD DISTRIBUTION BETWEEN THE DRIVE AND PUSHER AXLE. A fault exists in ECS that controls the load distribution between the drive and pusher axle. This can cause incorrect loadings on the axles.
volvo.remedy: Download new software for the air suspension control model.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY SEIZE On effected petrol and diesel engines a spring clamp on the radiator hose connecting it to the water inlet pipe may be insecure. If not rectified the engine may lose coolant overheat seize and suddenly slow the vehicle rapidly to a halt.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to have the radiator hose adequately secured.

volvo.defect: ENGINE FUEL PUMP MAY FAIL It has been identified that long term exposure to salt or wet conditions may lead to internal corrosion of the fuel pump electronic module. A faulty signal from the module may lead to incorrect amounts  or no fuel being delivered to the fuel pump.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel pump module replaced.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE ENGINE BAY FIRE It has been identified that on subject vehicles the engine cooling fan module could under certain operating conditions develop a short circuit caused by water intrusion. This in rare circumstances could result in an engine bay fire.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a water shield and a cable harness with a relay in order to control the engine cooling fan module power supply.

volvo.defect: INTERACTION OF SEAT BELT WITH AIR SUSPENDED DRIVING SEAT Operation of the air suspended driving seat could be impaired if due to normal vertical movement of the seat the drivers seat belt should retract beyond its normal rest position. Excessive retraction could also cause difficulty in disengaging the
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a button to the webbing which will prevent excessive retraction of the seat belt.

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT TO CABIN HEATER The supplementary cabin heater may have a short circuit which normally leads to the battery being 'drained'. In extreme cases fire may occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to disable the heater. This is a temporary measure until the root cause has been found and a permanent fix can be developed and applied.

volvo.defect: AIR FILTER IN THE AIR INTAKE MAY IGNITE There is a possibility that a foreign object may enter the air intake. Air intake efficiency could be reduced and the intake might ignite should for example a lighted cigarette be sucked into the system.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace existing air intake with a modified air intake equipped with a steel grille.

volvo.defect: TACHOGRAPH MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE A power loss to the tachograph may occur when the main switch is turned off because the wiring harnesses to the main switch were assembled incorrectly.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to reassemble the wiring harnesses to the correct specification.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING FLUID It is possible that the upper power steering return line may become detached which will result in the loss of power steering fluid.  This will result in fluid leaking onto the road surface leaking into the engine bay and the driver experiencing heavy steering.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the replacement of the power steering return line.

volvo.defect: BRAKES MAY NOT PERFORM ADEQUATELY Brake assistance from the vacuum pressure pump may be reduced under certain cold start conditions. The brakes will still function but more pressure on the pedal will be required than normal.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the non-return valve in the vacuum pump.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY LOOSE DRIVE AND POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE. The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE A combination of internal and external forces caused the towball to prematurelydetach itself from the towball housing resulting in separation of the trailer from the drawing unit.
volvo.remedy: All towballs and housing will initially be modified and then replaced with calibrated units at a later date.

volvo.defect: TRACK ROD CLAMPING BOLTS The front axle track rod clamping bolts may have been insufficiently torqued on assembly.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and check the clamping bolt torque. If required the bolts will be retorqued to the correct tightness.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It has been identified thatthe fuel pump electronic module may not operate as intended. This can result in failure of the fuel pump to start. Should this occur the vehicle may suffer a non start rough running or in the worst case the engine may stall without prior warning. Investigation has shown that it may be possible to drive the vehicle for up to 100 m before the fault manifests itself.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the software within the central electronic module upgraded.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF DRIVE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. If the tensioner fails it would cause a loss of power steering assistance and possible loss of drive.
volvo.remedy: Replace the auxiliary drive belt tensioner.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE SOFTWARE ISSUE IN THE VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY MODULE (VCM) There may be a software issue in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.
volvo.remedy: Upgrade software in the Vehicle Connectivity Module.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF SHORT CIRCUITING WITH FIRE RISK The battery main cable may chafe against the front cross member. This could result in a short circuit and possible fire risk.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of an additional cable clamp which will hold the battery cable clear of the cross member. any cables found to have a chafe condition will be replaced.

volvo.defect: POTENTIALLY INSUFFICIENT OR  MISSING WELDING CONNECTION IN THE HYDRAULIC UNIT OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM There may be an insufficient or missing welding connection in the Hydraulic Unit of the Brake System.
volvo.remedy: Replace the Hydraulic Unit.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE JACK IS FAULTY The jack thrust bearing washer may have a material fault which could allow the vehicle jack to fall when holding the weight of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: A) Volvo have written to all involved customers advising them as a short term measure not to use the jack originally supplied with the vehicle. B) The original jacks are being replaced with quality assured units as soon as these become available.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
volvo.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

volvo.defect: SEATBELT MAY SEPARATE FROM THE BUCKLE It has been identified there is a possibility the front seatbelt buckle stud may not have been punched correctly during production. This may result in a separation between the buckle and seatbelt bracket if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the seatbelt buckle and if required to replace the seatbelt buckle.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX  MAY NOT ENGAGE OR SHIFT GEARS AS INTENDED It has been identified that due to internal leakage the gearbox hydraulic control module may not be able to engage or shift gears as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the gearbox replaced.

volvo.defect: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MODULE MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED Due to a potential manufacturing defect the gas generator in the driver�s airbag module may not deploy as intended. This may reduce the affectivities of the airbag.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver's air bag module.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILTY OF PAINTED WHEEL RIMS BECOMING LOOSE Possibility of painted wheel rims becoming loose
volvo.remedy: The wheels must be replaced.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR The electric cooling fan control unit's metal cover may not have the correct corrosion protection. Should corrosion occur water may enter the control unit causing an electrical malfunction and in extreme cases cause a fire in the engine compartment.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an improved fan assembly.

volvo.defect: FEED KNOB STARTER SWITCH SUPPORT SPRING FAILURE COULD POSSIBLY RESULT IN IGNITION OFF WHILST VEHICLE IS IN MOTION Feed Knob Starter switch support spring failure could possibly result in ignition off whilst vehicle is in motion.
volvo.remedy: Change Starter switch harness & cover to new version if not already fitted.

volvo.defect: P-CLIP HOLDING THE STARTER MOTOR CABLE MAY CHAFE THROUGH THE OUTER INSULATION OF THE CABLE AND CAUSE A POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT P-Clip holding the Starter Motor cable may chafe through the outer insulation of the cable and cause a possible short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Replace and re-position the P-Clips with new brackets. Replace affected cables as required.

volvo.defect: RETAINING BOLT FOR INFLATABLE CURTAIN MAY BE BROKEN The retaining bolts used to assemble the Inflatable Curtain may be broken and offer less protection in the event of an incident.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles replace all retaining bolts.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING FLUID It is possible that the upper power steering return line may become detached which will result in the loss of power steering fluid.  This will result in fluid leaking onto the road surface leaking into the engine bay and the driver experiencing heavy steering.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for the replacement of the power steering return line.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: WHEEL HUB SECURITY There is a possibility that the front and rear wheel hubs on both the left and right hand sides of the vehicle were not properly secured to the axles at initial assembly.
volvo.remedy: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the hub security arrangement checked and where necessary rectified. Any parts found to be damaged as a result of insecurity will be replaced at the same time.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain five cylinder engines it is possible that the high pressure fuel pipes may not have been correctly installed and may leak. This should be identified by a smell of fuel from the engine bay. However it is possible that in extreme cases an engine bay fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the high pressure pipes.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
volvo.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

volvo.defect: OIL MAY LEAK Hydraulic oil may leak from the high pressure pipe to flange joint fixed to the hydraulic fan. This could cause oil to be left on the carriageway or in the worst case fire. Note: The affected vehicles should be fitted with automatically operated fire suppression equipment.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to test and where necessary replace the high pressure hose and pipe assembly with quality assured components.

volvo.defect: BRAKE REACTION TIME On vehicles fitted with air suspension it has been found that the brake reaction time is too slow. This is due to an air flow restriction caused by the diameter of the brake piping being too small.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the fitment of larger diameter brake piping and connector between the front air tank and the footbrake valve.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
volvo.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

volvo.defect: POOR CABLE TERMINAL CRIMPS The cable terminal crimps in the rear plate terminal block and battery box fuse block may be inadequate. The nut securing the ring cable terminal (terminal block) may also be insufficiently tight.
volvo.remedy: Check the crimps by pulling the specified cables.  Repair where necessary by undoing and re crimping or soldering.  Tighten ring cable terminal securing nut where necessary.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
volvo.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX MAY JAM A section of the gear shift mechanism may over time become loose and cause the mechanism to become jammed. If this was to occur it might not be possible to change gear or select neutral.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check that the ball joint for the gear selector is properly secured.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER WHILST DRIVING Possible loss of power whilst driving.
volvo.remedy: Vehicles must have updated software downloaded.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain five cylinder engines it is possible that the high pressure fuel pipes may not have been correctly installed and may leak. This should be identified by a smell of fuel from the engine bay. However it is possible that in extreme cases an engine bay fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the high pressure pipes.

volvo.defect: RISK OF OVERHEATING IN THE LCM The possibility exists that the light control module may overheat
volvo.remedy: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and upgrade the software.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY MOVE FORWARD WHEN ENGAGING REVERSE GEAR There is a possibility that the vehicle may move forward when reverse gear is engaged due to a defect in the gearbox software program.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-program gearbox software.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There could be a sudden and unexpected failure of the bottom end of the engine because of a non-conformity during production of the connecting rods.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the engine.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: DUE TO AN INCORRECT SIGNAL VALUE RECEIVED BY THE VDS MOTOR THE STEERING MOTOR CAN PROVIDE STEERING INPUT WITHOUT ANY INPUT FROM THE DRIVER The steering motor can provide steering input without any input from the driver
volvo.remedy: Update VDS software and calibrate the active steering

volvo.defect: V-STAY BRACKET Insufficient sealing may cause corrosion and premature wear of the drive axle V stay ball joint.
volvo.remedy: Examine the condition of the V stay ball joint. Clean grease and reseal if satisfactory or fit a new V stay as necessary.

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: CAB MAY TILT UNEXPECTEDLY It has been identified that some vehicles may have left the production facility with insufficient torque having been applied to the lower fixation of the cab tilt cylinder.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the torque of the fixing checked and adjusted as necessary.

volvo.defect: THE SEAT ATTACHMENT RAILS MAY IN CERTAIN CASES LACK THE STIPULATED EXTRA RIVETS AT THE END OF EACH RAIL The seat attachment rails may lack the stipulated extra rivets at the end of each rail.
volvo.remedy: Check the assembly and install additional rivets as required.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: HAND CONTROL VALVE FAILURE Failure of the parking brake valve upper cam plate around the central boss may allow the parking brake to release and could result in the vehicle running away.
volvo.remedy: Strip the valve and replace the upper cam plate tensioning springs and 'O' ring with quality assured items.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK The engine fuel rail may leak and cause drivability disturbances and a fuel leak
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and secure fuel rail end cover with a V- clamp

volvo.defect: RISK OF ELECTRICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT A potential chafing condition has been identified between the alternator power cables and coolant pipe which may result in short circuit .Electrical cables might short circuit.
volvo.remedy: Add a rubber spacer with cable tie to secure power cables from chafing on coolant pipe.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTED STEERING AND ENGINE MAY STALL. It is possible that water can enter the electric hydraulic power assisted steering pump. This can affect the operation of the pump. The driver will receive warning in the form of warning messages and illumination of warning lights on the dashboard. However the power assistance for the steering can failure but in extreme circumstances the engine can unexpectedly stall.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the power assisted steering pump.

volvo.defect: REAR AXLE SUSPENSION MAY BECOME INSECURE Rear leaf spring retaining bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification.
volvo.remedy: On affected vehicles check spring hangers and replace as required.

volvo.defect: ONE OR MORE AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.

volvo.defect: THE LINK ROD RETAINER JOINT  TORQUE TIGHTENING PROCESS WAS NOT SUFFICIENTLY SECURED Steering link rod joint clamp may be insecure.
volvo.remedy: Check the torque on the link rod and if applicable replace the link rod.

volvo.defect: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAKAGE Certain injectors may suffer quality problems affecting the connection to the pressure pipe.  This can result in cracking of the injector connection and a subsequent fuel leak.
volvo.remedy: Remove and examine the fuel injectors and renew any found to be part of the faulty batch.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING The driver may experience sudden loss of power assistance to the steering due to voltage irregularities in the Electro Hydraulic Power Steering system. The driver will have to apply increased effort to steer the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download new software to the inverter which can cope with voltage spikes and/or drops.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX  MAY NOT ENGAGE OR SHIFT GEARS AS INTENDED It has been identified that due to internal leakage the gearbox hydraulic control module may not be able to engage or shift gears as intended.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the gearbox replaced.

volvo.defect: SOME STEERING SHAFTS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT COMPONENT Some steering shafts were assembled with an incorrect component.
volvo.remedy: Check steering shaft and replace if necessary.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF UPPER STEERING ARM The screws securing the upper steering arm may have been overtightened damaging the threads of the screws and the threads in the steering arm knuckle. In the worst case situation a loss of steering control could result.
volvo.remedy: Remove the screws from the steering arm knuckle and examine the threads on both components for damage. Fit new bolts in all cases and new steering arms when the threads in the knuckle are found to be damaged.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FRACTURE OF REAR AXLE U BOLTS The material hardness of the rear axle spring U bolts may be too high. As a consequence they could break and allow dislocation of the axle.
volvo.remedy: Check the tioghtness of the rear axle spring U bolts. If any U bolt breaks before the the specified torque is achieved all U bolts on the affected axle must be replaced.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE DISINTEGRATION OF TURBOCHARGER There have been instances where the turbocharger shaft wheel assembly has been ground to the incorrect tolerances. This may cause the turbocharger to disintegrate into small pieces.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the turbochargers with quality assured units.

volvo.defect: A REAR SUSPENSION LINK NUT AND SCREW MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY ASSEMBLED A rear suspension link nut and screw may not have been correctly assembled.
volvo.remedy: Check and replace nut and screw where required.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT The Soft Ware applied during manufacture was incorrect for Medium Duty Engines. All heat temperature sensors are affected and are not functioning. The Heat Sensor function is lost and there is no warning to driver if temperature reaches specified limit. If the driver does not stop the vehicle as it starts to overheat it is possible for the engine to seize.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download updated software.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF A SHORT CIRCUIT OCCURRING An electrical short circuit can occur if the engine is cranked whilst the main switch is turned off.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles will be fitted with a new cable within the voltage converter circuit.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL  LEAK FROM INJECTOR PIPES. The fuel injector pipes may not have been fitted correctly and as a consequence could leak.
volvo.remedy: Examine all potentially affected vehicles and replace any incorrectly fitted injector pipes.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR It has been identified that the electrical cables attached to the fuse boxes may not be sufficiently tight. Should this be the case local overheating of the terminals and fuse board may occur.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the subject connections checked to ensure that they are at the correct torque being rectified as necessary. Should any overheating type damage have occurred (cables or fuse card) the affected component will be changed.

volvo.defect: DETACHABLE TOW BAR MAY WORK LOOSE Under certain conditions the detachable tow bar may work loose resulting in the tow bar becoming detached from the vehicle.
volvo.remedy: Replace the tow ball and housing with a calibrated unit.

volvo.defect: DRIVE AXLE LOCK-UP WHEN BRAKING IN THE LIGHT LADEN CONDITION Instances of drive axle lock-up have occurred under normal braking with the outfit in the light laden condition. This could cause a jack-knife situation.
volvo.remedy: All potentially affected vehicles will be recalled to Volvo Truck dealers for brake threshold and predominance checks. Where required adjustments will be carried out on the trailer predominance and/or load sensing valves.

volvo.defect: SEATBELT MAY SEPARATE FROM THE BUCKLE It has been identified there is a possibility the front seatbelt buckle stud may not have been punched correctly during production. This may result in a separation between the buckle and seatbelt bracket if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the seatbelt buckle and if required to replace the seatbelt buckle.

volvo.defect: VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SYSTEM CONTROL UNIT INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED TO THE CAR BODY Vehicles may have the Supplementary Restraint System (SRS) control unit incorrectly tightened to the car body.
volvo.remedy: Inspect and tighten the SRS control unit.

volvo.defect: THE ELECTRIC STEERING PUMP INVERTER SHUTS OFF WHEN THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED OFF EVEN IF THE VEHICLE IS MOVING The Electric Steering Pump inverter shuts off when the ignition is switched off even if the vehicle is moving.
volvo.remedy: Change the steering pump wiring.

volvo.defect: FIRE MAY OCCUR On certain five cylinder engines it is possible that the high pressure fuel pipes may not have been correctly installed and may leak. This should be identified by a smell of fuel from the engine bay. However it is possible that in extreme cases an engine bay fire could occur.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the high pressure pipes.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY STALL It is possible that due to a software issue fuel may not be pumped from one side (passive side) of the fuel tank to the other side (active side). This can occur even if the fuel gauge is reading a quarter full. If fuel transfer is not possible it may cause the engine to stall.
volvo.remedy: In the first instance drivers are requested to keep their vehicle's fuel tanks above half full.  Then all affected vehicles will be recalled for the upgrade of the software.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FUEL  LEAK FROM INJECTOR PIPES. The fuel injector pipes may not have been fitted correctly and as a consequence could leak.
volvo.remedy: Examine all potentially affected vehicles and replace any incorrectly fitted injector pipes.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

volvo.defect: POWER STEERING PIPE MAY LEAK. It has been established that the material in the power steering return line hose has not been manufactured to specification.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hose inspected and replaced as necessary.

volvo.defect: HEADLAMPS MAY FAIL TO OPERATE The master lighting switch on the instrument panel may cease functioning. In such cases the headlamps may fail to operate.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and replace switch with quality assured unit.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner can suffer from premature wear which may cause it to fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: COLLISION AVOIDENCE WARNING LIGHT MAY NOT ILLUMINATE Collision avoidance warning lamp may not illuminate
volvo.remedy: Update system software on affected vehicles.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF DEMIST/DEFROST SYSTEM A diode in the climate control system may not be sufficiently durable. In consequence the fan may stop working resulting in failure of the demist/defrost system.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the installation of an additional heater fan cable harness which includes a climate control diode.

volvo.defect: SUPPORT MEMBER MAY CRACK It is possible that stress cracks may occur in the offside main support member within the engine bay which could affect the vehicle structural performance if it is involved in an accident.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection of the subject member and report findings to Volvo Car UK Ltd; who will then decide on the level of the repair.

volvo.defect: FUEL MAY LEAK Some vehicles may have had excessive underbody protection applied which when drying.  could have formed small stalactite shaped formations. These formations may have formed close to the underbody fuel lines and could damage them and cause a fuel leak.  Due to the positioning of the fuel lines escaping fuel or fuel vapour could potentially lead to a fire.
volvo.remedy: Inspect all vehicles and cut any stalactite shaped formations off. If the fuel line is damaged it will be replaced.  Only 1% of vehicles are expected to have any damage to the fuel line.

volvo.defect: FUSE BOX CONNECTIONS INSECURE The flange nut can seize on the thread of the studs in the fuse box which could mean the terminals do not have the correct torque and may be loose. This could cause arcing.
volvo.remedy: Check fuse box; Replace all fuse box cable flange nuts to new correct type nuts and tighten to correct torque. If necessary replace the fuse box

volvo.defect: LEAKAGE OF FUEL A particular batch of injectors may be of poor quality and allow fuel to leak on to the engine with a subsequent risk of fire.
volvo.remedy: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject injectors replaced with quality assured units.

volvo.defect: PASSENGER HAND POLES MAY BECOME INSECURE Passenger hand poles may become insecure.
volvo.remedy: Fit modified seat consoles hand poles & roof poles.

volvo.defect: GEARBOX  NOISE SHIELD MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH HIGH TEMPERATURE HEAT SOURCE. It has been identified that the gearbox noise shield may come into contact with high a temperature heat source
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the noise shield removed.

volvo.defect: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED. It is possible that an electrical short circuit within a connector could result in the illumination of the Airbag System Service Required message and Supplemental Restraint System warning lamp on the dashboard. Should this occur the driver's airbag would not deploy as intended if the vehicle is involved in a collision.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and rework the connector.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY LOOSE DRIVE AND POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE. The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE MAY MOVE FORWARD WHEN ENGAGING REVERSE GEAR There is a possibility that the vehicle may move forward when reverse gear is engaged due to a defect in the gearbox software program.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and re-program gearbox software.

volvo.defect: THERE IS A RISK FOR  TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
volvo.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

volvo.defect: REAR WHEELS MAY LOOSEN It has been identified that on the subject vehicles the rear wheel studs may be of an incorrect size. This in rare cases may during particular forms of low speed manoeuvring result in the wheel becoming loose.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the rear wheel studs inspected and changed to a modified type as necessary.

volvo.defect: REAR ENGINE LIFTING EYES CONCERN. Due to engine vibrations the rear engine lifting eyes may crack and possibly break when lifting the engine out.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and fit modified left and right hand rear lifting eyes.

volvo.defect: FUEL LEAK FROM INJECTOR CONNECTION Certain injectors may suffer quality problems affecting the connection to the pressure pipe.  This can result in cracking of the injector connection and a consequential fuel leak.
volvo.remedy: Remove and examine the fuel injectors and renew any found to be part of the faulty batch

volvo.defect: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING  THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
volvo.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

volvo.defect: THE STOP SCREWS FOR THE PIN BETWEEN THE FIFTH WHEEL PLATE AND PEDESTAL MIGHT BE MISSING The stop screws for the pin between the fifth wheel plate and pedestal might be missing.
volvo.remedy: Fit the stop screws where required

volvo.defect: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR A heat shield mounted on the frame can fall down on the starter motor and could cause a short circuit.The heat shield breaks due to fatigue caused by vibrations.
volvo.remedy: Remove heat shield.

volvo.defect: ENGINE MAY FAIL There could be a sudden and unexpected failure of the bottom end of the engine because of a non-conformity during production of the connecting rods.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the engine.

volvo.defect: INTERNAL CONTACT FAILURE INSIDE THE WIPER SYSTEM MOTORS CAN CAUSE ISSUES WITH THE SYNCHRONISATION Synchronized wipers may fail and become stuck.
volvo.remedy: Check Wiper motors and replace if within the affected range.

volvo.defect: There may be a potential software error in the brake control module. There may be a potential software error in the brake control module.
volvo.remedy: Update the brake control module software.

volvo.defect: POSSIBLE BLOCKAGE OF INJECTION PUMP CONTROL ROD On a specific batch of fuel injection pump pressure valve retainers the bottom washer may come undone. This would cause the valve to drop on to the pump element and in extreme cases fragments may block the control rod.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the original pressure valve retainers with quality assured examples.

volvo.defect: CRACKING OF REAR SUSPENSION VEE STAYS Instances of cracking on the tube section of the rear suspension vee stays have occurred.
volvo.remedy: The vee stays on affected vehicles are being inspected for cracks by Volvo dealers. Where there is no evidence of cracking the stays will be strengthened by the fitment of re-inforcing clamps. In cases where cracking has occurred this will be repaired

volvo.defect: A SOFTWARE ERROR MAY PREVENT THE ENGINE CONTROL MODULE FROM STARTING THE ENGINE The Engine Control Module (ECM) may prevent the combustion engine from starting.�
volvo.remedy: Download updated software.

volvo.defect: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
volvo.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

volvo.defect: SPLIT PIN MAY BE MISSING FROM DRAG LINK SECURING NUT. A split pin may be missing from the steering drag link ball joint castle nut which could subsequently loosen.
volvo.remedy: Recall and examine the affected vehicles. If a split pin is found to be missing implement the repair procedure specified by the vehicle manufacturer.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING In certain cases a driver may experience sudden loss of power assistance to the steering due to voltage irregularities in the Electro Hydraulic Power Steering (EHPS) system.
volvo.remedy: This is a further action to a previous recall. On affected vehicles the invertor software is to be further updated to cope with voltage spikes / drops and to improve fault tracing. The braided earth cable will also be replaced by a copper cable to ensure the invertor earthing is secured.

volvo.defect: CAN-BUS CONNECTION MAY BE AFFECTED It has been identified that upon insertion of the ignition key the engine control module may transmit a signal to shut down the Can-Bus network thus disabling functions such as the climate control.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the relevant software upgraded.

volvo.defect: PARKING BRAKE MAY UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASE Vehicles with manual gearboxes and start/stop functionality have Parking Brake Module (PBM) software that may allow the parking brake to unintentionally release. The unintended release of the parking brake can only occur when the engine is running and the gearstick moved so it will happen when the vehicle is attended.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download upgraded Parking Brake Module (PBM) software.

volvo.defect: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE The engine oil  level may rise. This situation may lead to the engine speed being maintained or possibly increased after the throttle pedal is released. In an extreme situation the engine may continue to run after it has been switched off.
volvo.remedy: Recall the affected vehicles and carry out a ECM software upgrade adjust engine oil level and install a decal to confirm oil level to the consumer.

volvo.defect: COOLANT LEAKAGE MAY RESULT IN A FIRE It has been identified that during the engine warm-up process and under certain driving/climate conditions for instance periods of high acceleration or high engine load immediately after a cold start in cold climates there is the possibility for coolant leakage or oil seepage. This can lead to the possibility in a worst-case scenario of smoke or a slow developing fire in the engine compartment. However the driver will receive a warning message on the Driver�s Information Module indicating a low coolant level.
volvo.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to modify the coolant bypass valve and install a new exhaust manifold gasket.

volvo.defect: HEADLIGHTS AND REAR LIGHT MAY BECOME DISABLED The NOx sensor has a built in over voltage protection which is triggered by a voltage above 32 volts. When this is over the voltage protection and is active faults codes can be produced for example Headlight and Rear Lights can be disabled.
volvo.remedy: Recall affected vehicles and modify software.

volvo.defect: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner can suffer from premature wear which may cause it to fail. This can lead to loss of steering power assistance and a slight possibility of loss of drive should the drive belt or tensioner invade the cambelt area.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the auxiliary drive belt and tensioner.

volvo.defect: VEHICLE CAN BE DRIVEN WITHOUT THE DRIVER KNOWING THE MIDDLE DOOR IS OPEN It has been identified that in certain cases the driver is able to manoeuvre the vehicle with the middle door open without a visual or audible warning. Risk of the vehicle being driven with the middle door open.
volvo.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and apply software updates to the Instrument Cluster and Body Builder Module to warn the driver when the middle door is open. At speeds below 5 km/h the �Any door open� icon and CHECK lamp are illuminated and at speeds above 5 km/h the �Any door open� icon STOP lamp and audible buzzer are activated.

volvo.defect: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF DRIVE The auxiliary drive belt tensioner may fail. If the tensioner fails it would cause a loss of power steering assistance and possible loss of drive.
volvo.remedy: Replace the auxiliary drive belt tensioner.

volvo.defect: The anchorage bolts for the second-row seat belts and seat belt buckles may not have been correctly secured. In a worst-case scenario this may not provide sufficient protection in the event of a collision. The anchorage bolts for the second-row seat belts and seat belt buckles may not have been correctly secured. In a worst-case scenario this may not provide sufficient protection in the event of a collision
volvo.remedy: Inspect and re-install.

volvo.defect: POWER STEERING PIPE MAY LEAK. It has been established that the material in the power steering return line hose has not been manufactured to specification.
volvo.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the hose inspected and replaced as necessary.

wabco.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL TO APPLY OR MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLY It has been identified that a disconnection of the air intake port may ocurr during service brake application. This can affect the correct functioning of the service brake and may cause the parking brake to apply inadvertently.
wabco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake assemblies replaced.

wabco.defect: UNINDENTED APPLICATION OF THE BRAKES It has been identified that in some cases overlapping of tolerances has the potential to make the black button of the PREV to stick in the pushed-in position when the trailer is coupled to the tractor unit.  When this malfunction occurs the red warning lamp or signal for the trailer braking system on the dashboard of the truck will alert the driver that the reservoir air pressure in the trailer is dropping below 4.5 Bar.  If this pressure falls below 2.5 Bar this will cause unintended braking of the vehicle.
wabco.remedy: To address the concern Wabco under the terms of the Code will contact customers who will be provided with a valve repair kit.

wabco.defect: VEHICLE BRAKES MAY RELEASE UNINTENTIONALLY The Hand Brake Valve handle automatic locking function may not maintain the park position. The handle may remain in the lock only temporarily and flip back from the parking position into the driving position in which case the vehicle can runaway.
wabco.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and exchange the Hand Brake Valve with a quality assured unit.

wabco.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL TO APPLY OR MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLY It has been identified that a disconnection of the air intake port may ocurr during service brake application. This can affect the correct functioning of the service brake and may cause the parking brake to apply inadvertently.
wabco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake assemblies replaced.

wabco.defect: BRAKES MAY FAIL TO APPLY OR MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLY It has been identified that a disconnection of the air intake port may ocurr during service brake application. This can affect the correct functioning of the service brake and may cause the parking brake to apply inadvertently.
wabco.remedy: Recalled vehicles will have the brake assemblies replaced.

wabco.defect: POTENTIAL FOR FAILURE OF FOOT BRAKE VALVE In extreme cases overlapping of tolerances in conjunction with wear can potentially cause the bushing of the Foot Brake Valve (FBV) to move from its correct position. When this potential malfunction occurs it may not be possible to use the FBV to brake the vehicle..  However it is possible to use the handbrake instead to bring the vehicle to a controlled stop.
wabco.remedy: To recall the affected components and replace them with quality assured components.

wabco.defect: ACTUATORS MAY LOSE FUNCTIONALITY On some TRISTOP� actuators the chambers may not have been correctly assembled and the load from power spring and pressure is not fully taken. Under certain circumstances the parking side and the service sides of the actuator could separate and the actuator could lose functionality. Ultimately this could lead to a loss of braking functionality and/or brake failure. Critical applications are vehicles such as city buses or garbage collection vehicles (subject to a high parking brake frequency). Long haul applications are not considered critical and thus do not require an exchange.

webasto.defect: SUNROOF MAY BECOME INSECURE It is possible that due to issues with the bonding adhesive between the glass and the metal frame  the bonding adhesive can start to fail.  This condition is gradual and is identified by metal corrosion of the frame wind noise vibrations visual separation and water leaks.  If this condition persists and is not rectified it is possible that the glass sunroof can detach from the vehicle.
webasto.remedy: Identification of the affected vehicles and replacement of the glass/metal frame panel.

webasto.defect: SUNROOF MAY BECOME INSECURE It is possible that due to issues with the bonding adhesive between the glass and the metal frame  the bonding adhesive can start to fail.
